passages.title: Little Orphan Kekek Of The Wolvar
passages.text: Orphan lady say Kekek go with you.

passages.title: Little Orphan Kekek Of The Wolvar
passages.text: You take Kekek hunting? Good to get away from mean old orphan lady who doesn't let Kekek hunt.

passages.title: The Biggest Tree Ever!
passages.text:
Before there was a big war and we left the village, we remember Soo-say telling us all about the biggest tree ever!

Soo-say call it Grizzlemaw or something. Soo-say tell us it in the middle Grizzle Hills. No, wait, that not what Soo-say say. Soo-say say Grizzly Hills. Now we remember! Tree is big and right in middle of Grizzly Hills. Can't miss!

You take us there, oki? We see inside of giant tree? Soo-say tell us big bear men live in tree too. Maybe we see them.

passages.title: The Biggest Tree Ever!
passages.text: Can we see the big tree? Can we?

passages.title: The Biggest Tree Ever!
passages.text: We never knew trees got that big! Nope. Maybe Great Ones had special plan for it?

passages.title: Home Of The Bear-Men
passages.text:
High Shaman Rakjak always tell stories of mighty warriors, even ones far away. Sometimes he tell stories about giant bear-men fighting great battle for tree-city.

Maybe you take Kekek there, see tree, see battle! High Shaman Rakjak tell Kekek that giant tree-city Grizzlemaw stand in the middle of Grizzly Hills.

Kekek never see a city before meeting orphan lady, but this city have no warriors, only men in purple dresses. Kekek want to see real warriors fight for real city.

passages.title: Home Of The Bear-Men
passages.text: Kekek want to visit bear-men tree. We go.

passages.title: Home Of The Bear-Men
passages.text: This is Kekek's kind of city. Bear-men fight for home just like Frenzyheart do. Orphan lady tell Kekek not to fight with other pups, but Kekek fight anyway.

passages.title: Another Year, Another Souvenir.
passages.text:
Not only are we supplying brew to everyone, we also have steins to give out! Beautiful, commemorative steins all obtained by the most legal of means! Here's a voucher for one.

Talk to Blix near the back of the Brewfest camp. He's pretty strange, even more so now that he's always wearing those goggles. He'll handle the voucher for you, and any other Brewfest transaction.

passages.title: The Bronze Dragonshrine
passages.text:
Sometimes High-Oracle Soo-say tell stories about a shrine to dragon-things, not like great rain stone, but different. Soo-say tell us maybe we see ourselves there, but not like in a shiny. Soo-say mean we could see what we are like many years from now.

You take us there? We remember shrine to bronze dragon-things in place called Dragonblight. Soo-say say great rain stone show him shrine to northeast of Wyrmrest Temple, or northwest of place dryskins call Wintergarde Keep. We go?

passages.title: The Bronze Dragonshrine
passages.text: We very glad you brought us here, <name>. We always worried what would happen to us when the orphan matron found us in Sholazar.

passages.title: The Bronze Dragonshrine
passages.text:
When Kekek was a pup, he sometimes heard elders talking about a far-off shrine. Sometimes they say that bronze dragon-things there know all about future.

Kekek tell you he be great warrior, now we go see. Bronze dragon-thing shrine somewhere in Dragonblight, northeast of dragon-thing temple called Wyrmrest, also northwest of man-town called Wintergarde.

We go there, see future. Prove orphan-lady wrong about Kekek. Kekek warrior, not bully.

passages.title: The Bronze Dragonshrine
passages.text:
See? Kekek never get tired of saying, "Kekek tell you so."

Maybe now you believe other things Kekek tell you, like how sky is green.

passages.title: Defend the Tree!
passages.text:
We have been using the power of the Forest Heart to defend the tree from the Horde, but its power is not without limit. We must use it to take the fight to them!

Shadumbra, the great cat of the forest, prowls nearby. It is from her that we shall draw our inspiration. You will become one with the shade of Shadumbra. You will take the essence of the panther into you and lay waste to those who dare attack the might of Ashenvale!

passages.title: Defend the Tree!
passages.text:
A brutal display, but one fitting for the enemies of Ashenvale. The Horde dares to think that they can take our beloved forest away from us.

They are fatally mistaken!

You have saved Raynewood from destruction, <name>. Surely we can find a reward suitable for our champion?

passages.title: Vile Touch
passages.text: Githyiss the Vile was known for possessing a poison more potent than any other webwood spider. Dirania Silvershrine at the base of Aldrassil would surely be interested in using Githyiss' engorged venom sac to concoct an antidote equally as potent. Perhaps so interested as to even offer a reward...

passages.title: Set Us Up the Bomb
passages.text:
I'm definitely on to something here!

I have enough volatile elements salvaged from our arsenal to make the explosives Goggath wants, but I need to stabilize it and pack it into bombs.

What I need is some clay - and not just any clay... moon-kissed clay.

It's only found on the northern banks of Astranaar Lake, and it possesses the qualities I need to bring out the full potential of my discovery!

passages.title: Set Us Up the Bomb
passages.text: Let's see what you've brought me, <race>.

passages.title: Set Us Up the Bomb
passages.text:
This is PERFECT!

Oh, just wait 'til you see what I can do with this....

passages.title: Breathing Room
passages.text:
Our forces are not ready to assault Astranaar just yet, <class>. They know we're coming, though, and they're not content to sit and wait for us. At the base of this cliff they've created a camp from which they launch bothersome attacks by the light of the moon.

Before these skirmishes bolster their confidence any further, I want you to visit them with the wrath of the Horde! Return to me when the elves have been humbled a bit.

passages.title: Breathing Room
passages.text: Well done, <race>. But there is much that remains to be done here.

passages.title: Small Stature, Short Fuse
passages.text:
<Tweedle gesticulates emphatically.>

I've done it! This should satisfy even Goggath!

We just need a test that will sufficiently show off our efforts... ahh, the wagon!

The bossman's wanted that rotted out piece of junk hauled off for days. Use my explosives to get rid of it, then see what the captain has to say!

passages.title: Small Stature, Short Fuse
passages.text: What have you done, <race>?

passages.title: Small Stature, Short Fuse
passages.text:
So, Tweedle found a way to get those explosives working, eh?

It's about time...

passages.title: Blastranaar!
passages.text:
So, Tweedle finally came through on those explosives, eh?

They couldn't have come at a better time. The elves of Astranaar are preparing to make a devastating assault on our camp as we speak.

Drop our new weapon on them from the skies! The destruction of Astranaar will be a dagger in the heart of night elves everywhere!

Speak with Thraka when you're ready to begin the assault.

Aim true, <class>.

passages.title: Blastranaar!
passages.text:
Astranaar is burning!

For the Horde!

passages.title: Blastranaar!
passages.text:
Your deeds today shall live long in the Horde's glorious history.

Your efforts have dealt a devastating blow to the enemy!

passages.title: Stepping Up Surveillance
passages.text:
The cultists appear to be digging out the remains of a being known as Soggoth the Slitherer.

Perhaps their superiors on the rafters above have more information.

passages.title: Stepping Up Surveillance
passages.text: Have you completed your scouting mission, <name>?

passages.title: Stepping Up Surveillance
passages.text:
This is dire news, <name>.  If you are correct, then we'd best act swiftly and decisively.

We cannot allow this "Soggoth" to be brought back to life.

passages.title: Crossroads Caravan Pickup
passages.text:
<Halga grins disarmingly, holding up an enormous firearm.>

Have you ever used one of these, <name>? It's a beast. Hell with a handgrip. Too heavy to use on foot, but perfect when riding at the head of a caravan. I call it my 'street sweeper.'

We need to get those supplies you've collected to the Crossroads, and I expect trouble. I'd like for you to ride shotgun. Literally! Say the word when you're ready and I'll put you at the head of our next caravan.

passages.title: Crossroads Caravan Pickup
passages.text: Mok'ra, stranger. Are you here from Far Watch?

passages.title: Crossroads Caravan Pickup
passages.text: You're a sight, <race>. That's the first caravan to make it through this week!

passages.title: Playmates!
passages.text:
Orphanage gets real lonely, you know? Sometimes we want to go places, meet new friends.

Maybe you can take us somewheres with other hatchlings? We heard about a place called Winterfin Retreat, in the big Borean Tundra. We think it's way in the northwest, near the edge of the Coldarra-island.

The orphan lady say someone brave save a bunch of hatchlings there. We think they lonely, too. We think they need friends. You take us there?

passages.title: Playmates!
passages.text: You take us to Winterfin Retreat? Meet new friends maybe?

passages.title: Playmates!
passages.text: That was fun! We go again sometime? We can't wait to see our new friend again!

passages.title: Playmates!
passages.text:
Kekek think there not enough other pups living with orphan-lady. Maybe we go visit some others?

Kekek know a tribe that lives in Dragonblight, at place called Snowfall Glade. You know? Snowfall Glade north of walrus-men town of Mo'aki Harbor and south of Ruby Dragonshrine.

<Kekek scowls at the mention of the tuskarr.>

You take Kekek there, to some of the villages there. Maybe we meet new wolvar, show them how fierce Frenzyheart are!

passages.title: Playmates!
passages.text: You take Kekek to Snowfall Glade now?

passages.title: Playmates!
passages.text: Kekek like new Snowfall friends, maybe come back and go hunting together sometime. Maybe we go tip over walrus-men when they sleeping.

passages.title: The Grateful Dead
passages.text:
It's good to visit with friends and family again, though I may have overdone it... I've already eaten everything they made for me!

Might I trouble you for some more of that delicious Bread of the Dead? I'd be most grateful...

Chapman there sells the recipe, I think.

passages.title: The Grateful Dead
passages.text: You don't have any Bread of the Dead, do you?

passages.title: The Grateful Dead
passages.text:
Ah, more delicious Bread of the Dead, thank you!

Please, take this in return... a little something fun for the holiday.

passages.title: The Dragon Queen
passages.text:
One of High-Oracle Soo-say's stories says Great Ones made all the dragons and a queen for the dragons, too. We want to see her! Would you take us to the top of Wyrmrest Temple? We remember Soo-say telling us the temple-thing was in the middle of Dragonblight.

We really want to meet dragon queen. She must be so big and pretty. Maybe she help us find new parents.

You take us?

passages.title: The Dragon Queen
passages.text: We go see dragon queen now?

passages.title: The Dragon Queen
passages.text: Do you think she ever saw an oracle before? We might be the first one ever to meet her! We thinks she liked us, but we're not sure. She doesn't talk a lot. Nope. But that was fun!

passages.title: The Dragon Queen
passages.text:
Kekek always liked dragons. Always wanted to be one, but orphan-lady said no. But she did say maybe you take Kekek to meet dragon queen.

Kekek think orphan-lady have good idea for once. You take Kekek to Wyrmrest Temple in the middle of Dragonblight? Fly all the way to top to meet dragon queen. She must be really big, to be queen of all dragons. Kekek can't wait to see!

passages.title: The Dragon Queen
passages.text: We go see dragon queen now?

passages.title: The Dragon Queen
passages.text: Queen not what Kekek expected, but Kekek understand why. Queen's visitors get crushed if she was always big dragon! Still want to see someday.

passages.title: Meeting a Great One
passages.text:
High-Oracle Soo-say always tell us about how Great Ones built shrines and we give them shinies, but he never see Great Ones. No one see Great Ones, but maybe you know how to find one?

Soo-say told us the Great Ones made a waygate and put it in the center of the southern part of Sholazar. Soo-say not say where it goes, but maybe it take us to a Great One! Take us through that waygate and let's find out, <name>.

passages.title: Meeting a Great One
passages.text: Do you know how to find a Great One? We've never seen one before.

passages.title: Meeting a Great One
passages.text:
We got to meet a Great One! Too bad it was during his nap time, but we understand. We like naps, too! Maybe we learn naps from Great Ones like we learn about shrines and shinies!

Can we come back and visit the Great One again when not sleeping?

passages.title: The Mighty Hemet Nesingwary
passages.text:
Know who Kekek always wanted to meet? Hemet Nesingwary.

Maybe you take Kekek to see him? Elder Harkek tell us all about him. He come to Sholazar to hunt biggest creatures anywhere! Even Frenzyheart elders respect Hemet Nesingwary as great hunter.

Elder Harkek tell Kekek that Nesingwary Base Camp in the middle of west side of Sholazar, right on river called Seabreach Flow. We go visit and learn how to hunt like Hemet?

passages.title: The Mighty Hemet Nesingwary
passages.text: Can't wait to meet Hemet Nesingwary.

passages.title: The Mighty Hemet Nesingwary
passages.text: You help Kekek learn him a book? Then, Kekek hunt with Hemet Nesingwary!

passages.title: Back To The Orphanage
passages.text:
We had the best time with you, <name>. We wish you could be our <daddy/mama> now, but you have to take us back to Orphan Matron Aria in Dalaran.

Maybe you could come visit us again sometime? We loved meeting Winterfin hatchlings and getting to see the dragon queen. No one will believe us when we say we met a Great One!

We going to miss you, <name>. We promise to write letter sometime, oki?

passages.title: Back To The Orphanage
passages.text: It sounds like little Roo had a great time this week. I know he was getting awfully lonely in the orphanage and was eager to make some new friends. Thank you so much for agreeing to look after him.

passages.title: Back To The Orphanage
passages.text:
Know what? You not so bad after all, <name>. You take Kekek a lot of fun places. Kekek meet a lot of new friends and do things no other pup get to do.

You, and Hemet Nesingwary, and Snowfall Glade pups all new best friends. Maybe sometime you bring Kekek that green hills book? Kekek promise to write sometimes, too, tell you how things go. Maybe even be nice to big-tongue kids sometimes.

Kekek gotta go back to orphan-lady Aria now, back in purple human city.

passages.title: Back To The Orphanage
passages.text: Thank you for agreeing to care for Kekek this week. I know he can be a handful, but I think that with more individual attention and a few more friends, he'll do a lot better. No doubt he's going to be telling stories of his adventures with you for weeks.

passages.title: Drag it Out of Them
passages.text: It is our instinct to simply lash out at our attackers, but wisdom dictates another path. We should interrogate one of these quilboar invaders and learn all we can. Take this net, <name>, and ensnare a quilboar pillager attacking our farm just west of here. Club the beast unconscious and bring him to me.

passages.title: Drag it Out of Them
passages.text: Don't be too harsh with our captive, he will still need his head attached to answer our questions.

passages.title: Drag it Out of Them
passages.text: Oh my. We want to question this Quilboar, not tenderize him!

passages.title: By Hook Or By Crook
passages.text:
I suppose he'll come around with some cold water to the face. What do you think he'll tell us?

I'll secure him inside our livestock pen behind me here. I don't think he'll stay conscious long. Find out what you can about why the quilboar are attacking our farms! I'll leave the interrogation methods up to your better judgment.

passages.title: By Hook Or By Crook
passages.text: Well, did he squeal?

passages.title: By Hook Or By Crook
passages.text:
Very interesting - our brute here seems both enthralled and terrified of the one they call "Tortusk." A powerful leader can inspire his people to acts of greatness or atrocity... but we orcs would know that more than others.

We should turn our attention to this Tortusk problem.

passages.title: Thinning the... Herd?
passages.text:
The furbolg are more numerous than we expected in these southern regions. They have also been far more aggressive here than we would like.

With our resources divided between hunting down elves and harvesting much-needed lumber, that leaves you to help me put an end to our furbolg distraction.

I have research to conduct here. In the meantime, I need you to take a more hands-on approach. Bring me the ears of nearby furbolg as proof to Tarkan that the problem is being dealt with.

passages.title: Thinning the... Herd?
passages.text:
Well, <name>.

Is it done?

passages.title: Thinning the... Herd?
passages.text:
Good work, <race>.

This should keep them licking their wounds for a time.

passages.title: The Tortusk Takedown
passages.text:
In the wake of the chaos down south, this "Tortusk" brute seems to have rallied all of the Razormane refugees to his banner. Under his leadership, he's turned them into little more than brigands. There's no negotiating with his type; Tortusk must be destroyed.

If our prisoner is to be believed, you'll find Tortusk southeast of here at a place called Thorn Hill. Search the bluffs where he has a commanding view of the road. Kill him, <name>, and the immediate threat should cease.

passages.title: The Tortusk Takedown
passages.text:
Ah, so Tortusk behaved as I expected? Went right for your throat? It is good that he's dead.

The Razormane quilboar have been separated from their leadership in the southern Barrens, no doubt allowing an animal like him to come to power. Perhaps without his influence we can start a dialogue with the survivors... Although hotter heads may prevail.

passages.title: The Kodo's Return
passages.text:
The great beast rises slowly to its feet, the loose Barrens soil spilling from its revitalized limbs. Instinctively it trudges back toward its home at Grol'dom Farm.

You'll want to check in with Kranal Fiss to make sure the kodo made it.

passages.title: The Kodo's Return
passages.text:
So that was your handiwork, <race>? Yes, the missing Kodo arrived just minutes ago. It will take many nights to nurse the poor beast's wounds, but thanks to you it's alive. And you saved a whole shipment!

Please, take your pick of the gear that the kodo was carrying.

passages.title: Tweedle's Tiny Parcel
passages.text:
Wahoo!!

Look at 'em burn! It's revolutionary! A real breakthrough in explosive technology - which, of course, is the only kind that matters....

I'm gunna be the envy of every goblin south of Northrend!

Believe it or not, I've actually refined the formula to be even more potent!

Here. Take a sample of this stuff southeast to Silverwind Refuge. Maybe my cousin Flooz can use it to help the Horde capture that objective.

passages.title: Tweedle's Tiny Parcel
passages.text:
Well, look at this! Little Tweedle has really come through this time. This stuff blew up Astranaar, you say?

As you can see, we don't need any help taking over Silverwind Refuge, but Tweedle's ideas are as small as his hands.

If this stuff's really as good as you say, there's no limit to what we might do....

passages.title: Crossroads Caravan Delivery
passages.text:
<Rocco hands you a familiar-looking shotgun.>

I took the liberty of cleaning up Halga's artillery for you. I'm sure I don't need to warn you about the kickback. Just ask me when you're ready to mount up for the Crossroads! Thork is waiting for you there. Be sure not to give him any lip.

Don't stop for nothing, <name>, and if someone gets too close, just give 'em a thump with the butt-end of your gun. Do us proud!

passages.title: Crossroads Caravan Delivery
passages.text: Was that you I saw waving a gun around from the back of my last caravan?

passages.title: Crossroads Caravan Delivery
passages.text: It's about time we got some supplies through here. It's bad enough to be severed from Mulgore, but this city would fall apart if we lost our trade with Orgrimmar.

passages.title: Mass Production
passages.text:
Wahoo!! Did you SEE that?!

We need to get this into production right away!

Here. Take the rest of the stuff to Jinx. You'll find him setting up our new facility just west of here.

passages.title: Mass Production
passages.text: Whatcha got there, boss?

passages.title: Mass Production
passages.text:
<Jinx examines the powder carefully for a moment.>

Hmmm.

It'll take a little time. But yes, we can put this into a bomb....

passages.title: The Goblin Braintrust
passages.text:
If we could just stop the damned bombing from the goblins' creations we'd be able to launch a counter-offensive to take back Silverwind Refuge!

It's been my experience that goblins are either lazy and unproductive, or too productive and end up killing themselves with their own explosives. Unfortunately for us, they're being motivated by the brilliant Chief Bombgineer Sploder.

Get up to the Skunkworks on the west side of the refuge and don't come back until you have the Chief Bombgineer's head!

passages.title: The Goblin Braintrust
passages.text: Did you shut that disgusting, wart-ridden goblin up for good?

passages.title: The Goblin Braintrust
passages.text: That's better. Without him, their technicians are sure to fall back to their normal laziness, which should result in fewer bombs and more accidents.

passages.title: They Set Them Up The Bomb!
passages.text:
This is clearly the biggest explosive that you've ever laid eyes upon. What in the world could the goblins be thinking about bombing with such a monstrosity?

To your eye the thing looks like it's almost complete. The goblins appear to have built it well -- it looks as if it's impervious to any damage that you could do to it, and certainly too big for you to carry out of here.

You'd better report The Bomb to Huntress Jalin at Stardust Spire to the southwest!

passages.title: They Set Them Up The Bomb!
passages.text:
They what? IT'S HOW BIG?!!!

I have a very bad feeling about this, <name>.

passages.title: Building Your Own Coffin
passages.text:
Once it's complete, we're going to need to get this bomb down to Saurboz.

And by 'we', I mean 'you'.

With so many of the enemy prowling about, I'll need to create something special if you're to have any chance of success.

I can modify one of these busted shredders, but I'll need a few parts. You should have no trouble finding them in the woods to the west.

Round them up while I finish work on the bomb.

passages.title: Building Your Own Coffin
passages.text: You got those parts I need, friend?

passages.title: Building Your Own Coffin
passages.text:
This looks right, <class>.

I should have your shredder put together in no time.

passages.title: King of the Foulweald
passages.text:
I care little for who you are, <race>. What I do care about is the salvation of the furbolg.

Take this Bloodtooth tribe banner a short ways northeast into Greenpaw Village and place it upon their totem mound. They will consider this an act of aggression and try to destroy the banner. Hold your ground until their chief, Murgut, appears to save face for the tribe, then kill the traitor!

Govern your strength wisely, friend, you're in for a long fight.

passages.title: King of the Foulweald
passages.text: Did you defeat Chief Murgut, <name>?

passages.title: King of the Foulweald
passages.text:
Good. Murgut sold his own tribe out to the Horde, allying with them when they took your precious Silverwind Refuge in order to 'save' his people.

He sold them into slavery, or worse. And now he has gotten what he deserved!

Let us speak now of a different traitor, one whom I believe has something that will make that rod of yours even more powerful.

passages.title: You're the Bomb!
passages.text:
Okay, <name>. You're all set.

I've pre-programmed the path to Stonetalon, so all you'll need to worry about is keeping the bomb intact.

You can use the sawblades to mow down any enemies from a distance, or short-circuit a fuse to zap anyone who gets too close.

You have ONE chance to repair the bomb if it gets dangerously damaged. Use it wisely!

Speak to me when you think you're ready.

Good luck!

passages.title: King of Centaur Mountain
passages.text:
We were sent here to track movements of the Kolkar centaur, but after a week of watching these dirty animals scamper all around this oasis, I'm itching to give my axe a taste of their necks. What do you say, <class>? Want to cause a little havoc with me?

Let's see if we can attract the attention of their strongest warrior, Kurak.

passages.title: King of Centaur Mountain
passages.text:
Aw mon, why you have to go settin' Gorgal off like that? Still, I can't argue with results. We'll need to watch these animals closely to see what they do with Kurak outta the way.

More watchin' and waitin'. Gorgal won't like that.

passages.title: In Fungus We Trust
passages.text:
I've cultured these unusual spores you dug up with a most magnificent cocktail of ... reagents ... that I'm fond of. I'm eager to see how my manipulated spores react to the waters of the Crossroads oases.

The Stagnant Oasis to the southeast should provide us an uncontaminated site for our experiment. Simply plant this culture in the moist soil anywhere near the oasis, and document the results for me.

Be sure to cover your mouth, <class>.

<Helbrim grins disarmingly.>

passages.title: In Fungus We Trust
passages.text:
Explosive spore clouds? You don't say ... tell me more. Choking? Stinging? Burning of the eyes? Was there itching? Nausea? Mortification? Delightful, DELIGHTFUL! You've certainly earned your commission, <name>.

That skin rash of yours should pass in a day or two.

passages.title: A Job for a Bloodhound
passages.text:
Take the collars over to those cages in the back. Show it to any of my bloodhounds -- they know what to do.

Once they find what you're looking for, you'd better be ready to fight. Report back to the mayor when you're done.

passages.title: Return to Samophlanger
passages.text:
Well, that didn't work. The structural integrity of the samophlange is at an all-time low. I could add some more dials to try and fix it, but...that might make things even worse.

Look what I discovered when I blocked the release valve and blew the cover off the differential casing, though: the personal stamp of "Boss Copperplug."

Take this back to Sputtervalve and tell him to find this Copperplug genius. When you're done here, just talk to me and I'll send you back using Brak's teleporter.

passages.title: Return to Samophlanger
passages.text: Is that my samophlange? I don't even recognize it.

passages.title: Return to Samophlanger
passages.text: Wenikee said what? Copperplug? BOSS Copperplug? Oh no, this might be tricky.

passages.title: The Vengeance of Elune
passages.text:
As Teldrassil purges itself of the corruption that has perverted its growth for all of these years, a malevolent growth has formed near the tree's edge, south of here. We have an opportunity to strike out and purge the source of the fel moss that has tainted the gnarlpine, the timberlings, and everything else.

With the water that you've collected from the moonwells and the renewed strength of Teldrassil herself, I can grant you great power for a short while. Put an end to this corruption, <name>.

passages.title: The Vengeance of Elune
passages.text: Did you find the source of the corruption?

passages.title: The Vengeance of Elune
passages.text:
Elune be praised!

Everything I had encountered suggested this corruption to be buried deep within Teldrassil itself... I had worried we might never be able to strike at the source without killing the world tree. I am thankful I was wrong!

Malfurion was the start to this great turn of fortune. Perhaps I will seek him out before I depart to the wilds again.

Thank you, <name>. Thank you for everything you have done. You are sure to be a great hero someday!

passages.title: Steady Shot
passages.text:
I'm Bamm Megabomb, your personal trainer, <sir/ma'am>.

I understand that you're interested in some new insight about being a <class>?

Look. Just get some more experience , and you'll learn how to do more of what it is you do best. Helpful, right?

So go, get some more experience, then when you learn how to do something new go ahead and try it out on one of the dummies here.

passages.title: Steady Shot
passages.text:
There you go, boss!

Come back anytime you want more training. I'll teach you what I know.

passages.title: Frost Nova
passages.text:
I'm Fizz Lighter, your personal trainer, <sir/ma'am>.

I understand that you're interested in some new insight about being a <class>?

Look. Just get better at what you already know, and you'll learn how to do more of what it is you do best. Helpful, right?

So go, get some more experience, then when you learn how to do something new go ahead and try it out on one of the dummy's here.

passages.title: Frost Nova
passages.text:
There you go, boss!

Come back anytime you want more training. I'll teach you what I know.

passages.title: Learning the Word
passages.text:
I'm Sister Goldskimmer, your personal trainer, <sir/ma'am>.

I understand that you're interested in some new insight about being a <class>? 

Look. Just get some more experience , and you'll learn how to do more of what it is you do best. Helpful, right?

So go, get some more experience, then when you learn how to do something new go ahead and try it out on one of the dummies here.

passages.title: Learning the Word
passages.text:
There you go, boss!

Come back anytime you want more training. I'll teach you what I know.

passages.title: Eviscerate
passages.text:
I'm Slinky Sharpshiv, your personal trainer, <sir/ma'am>.

So ya wanna get better at being a rogue, eh?

Look. Just get some more experience , and you'll learn how to do more of what it is you do best. Helpful, right?

So go, get some more experience, then when you learn how to do something new go ahead and try it out on one of the dummy's here.

passages.title: Eviscerate
passages.text:
There you go, boss!

Come back anytime you want more training. I'll teach you what I know.

passages.title: Primal Strike
passages.text:
I'm Maxx Avalanche, your personal trainer, <sir/ma'am>.

I've been hearing your name around here, thought you could use some training. Look no further.

As you get better at your job, you start to be able to do totally new, amazing things. Trust me, it works. I get paid to tell people about it all the time.

Anyways, get better at being a shaman, and then use your new abilities on a training dummy to the southeast.

passages.title: Primal Strike
passages.text:
There you go, boss!

Come back anytime you want more training. I'll teach you what I know.

passages.title: Corruption
passages.text:
I'm Evol Fingers, your personal trainer, <sir/ma'am>.

I understand that you're interested in some new insight about being a <class>?

Look. Just get some more experience , and you'll learn how to do more of what it is you do best. Helpful, right?

So go, get some more experience, then when you learn how to do something new go ahead and try it out on one of the dummies here.

passages.title: Corruption
passages.text:
There you go, boss!

Come back anytime you want more training. I'll teach you what I know.

passages.title: The Black Knight's Curse
passages.text:
I wanted to remove the Black Knight's remains from the tournament grounds after your victory, but Confessor Paletress insisted that he receive a decent burial. Ever since, a dark presence has lingered in the cemetery and people are afraid to go there to visit the fallen.

Would you visit the cemetery just past the eastern end of the tournament grounds and see if you can discover what's happening?

passages.title: The Black Knight's Curse
passages.text: Have you investigated the Black Knight's gravesite?

passages.title: The Black Knight's Curse
passages.text:
<Crusader Rhydalla frowns.>

Do you think they've been planning this? I suppose it doesn't matter, but I don't like the implication that we've been playing into their hands. Whatever is going on, we have to stop it.

passages.title: The Black Knight's Fate
passages.text:
You said the body was taken by cultists? I can only think of one place they would have gone, Deathspeaker's Watch, the encampment on the rise west of the tournament grounds.

Whatever the cultists are doing must be stopped. The rumors I've heard can only be true, then. The infamous Doctor Kohler must be among the cultists, practicing his arts. Look for a rise or an altar overlooking the cultist camp, slay the doctor, and look for proof of his plans. Slow down his work in any other way you can.

passages.title: The Black Knight's Fate
passages.text: Did you find out what they're doing with the Black Knight's remains?

passages.title: The Black Knight's Fate
passages.text: The doctor will not have time to complete his work, but his plan is already in motion. From what you've reported, the Lich King's servants have reanimated and empowered the Black Knight and there's no telling what the knight's master has in mind. You have done well in uncovering this plot. I will tell High Crusader Adelard of your findings and together, we will alert the tournament's participants.

passages.title: Monkey Business
passages.text:
We've got major problems with the monkeys in the jungle to the east. They've stolen all of our explosives, and now they're going around throwing them.

Sometimes at us!

I had Fizz Lighter take some of his nitro and put it in these bananas. No monkey can resist a bunch of bananas!

All you have to do is go out there and feed them.

passages.title: Monkey Business
passages.text: Did it work?

passages.title: Monkey Business
passages.text:
They launched up into the air when they ate the bananas?! That is hilarious!

I think I'm going to take a bunch out there and feed them myself!

passages.title: Spice Bread Stuffing
passages.text:
Our spice bread stuffing is the cornerstone of the Pilgrim's Bounty table. The recipe has always been a favorite in Stormwind and now it has taken its place in the bountiful cookbook.

If you are already a cook, pay a visit to the Pilgrim's Bounty vendor to get your copy of the cookbook and all the local ingredients you'll need to prepare holiday fare. And if you're not yet a cook, there's no better time to start!

Once you've made the stuffing, bring it to Jasper Moore over near the tables.

passages.title: Spice Bread Stuffing
passages.text: We can always use more of that delicious spice bread stuffing. It's very popular.

passages.title: Spice Bread Stuffing
passages.text: Excellent. This is just what we needed. It's going to be a chore keeping all the tables stocked with fresh food, but it's well worth it.

passages.title: Pumpkin Pie
passages.text:
That spice bread stuffing you made smells delicious, but no Pilgrim's Bounty feast is complete without a slice of pumpkin pie. It's another one of our favorite dishes here in Stormwind, since it uses ripe Elwynn pumpkins that only grow here.

If you don't know how to make pumpkin pie already, there's a recipe in your bountiful cookbook.

Would you mind cooking up a few slices and bringing them to Edward Winslow outside Ironforge? He's bound to be running low by now.

passages.title: Pumpkin Pie
passages.text: More pumpkin pie? Just in time.

passages.title: Pumpkin Pie
passages.text: The pumpkin pie's been a big hit up here. I've never seen a dwarf get so excited about anything made from a vegetable.

passages.title: Cranberry Chutney
passages.text:
If you haven't tried the cranberry chutney yet, you're in for a treat. It's made with the freshest tangy Wetlands cranberries. Just pick some up from the Pilgrim's Bounty vendor if you want to try your hand at making chutney.

The recipe should be in your bountiful cookbook.

If you've got some extra time on your hands, would you mind making some of the chutney and bringing it down to Jasper Moore outside Stormwind? I promised him I'd trade some for the pie you brought.

passages.title: Cranberry Chutney
passages.text: Is that cranberry chutney I smell?

passages.title: Cranberry Chutney
passages.text: Finally, the cranberry chutney I was promised. You wouldn't believe how fast the celebrants go through the stuff here.

passages.title: They're Ravenous In Darnassus
passages.text:
Thanks for bringing the cranberry chutney. There's so much cooking to do, I hardly have time to think of anything else. And on top of my responsibilities here, Isaac Allerton in Darnassus is out of almost everything. I don't suppose you'd be willing to step in and whip up some more spice bread stuffing and pumpkin pie? The vendor should have all the ingredients you need

You should be able to find him near the feasting tables near the entrance to Darnassus just beyond the Warrior's Terrace.

passages.title: They're Ravenous In Darnassus
passages.text: Have you come to partake of the Pilgrim's Bounty feast?

passages.title: They're Ravenous In Darnassus
passages.text:
Thanks for bringing everything. I was starting to get worried.

While you're here, you should try your hand at making some candied sweet potatoes.

passages.title: Capturing the Unknown
passages.text:
Heya, <name>, there are strange cave paintings and other artifacts all over the cavern.

Do you think you could use your belt-mounted KTC Snapflash camera to capture images at the designated spots? Also, snap a pic of the altar in the back of the cavern.

I'm sure that Sassy will want the intel.

passages.title: Capturing the Unknown
passages.text:
What are these?

<Sassy examines the pictures while listening to your tale from the Kaja'mite cavern.>

Clearly that pygmy witchdoctor is from some new race never seen before. Maybe we should call them <name>-ians?

They must be the ones that painted all of that stuff in the cavern. I'm not sure that I like what you're describing.

It sounds to me like they're paintings of them and us on an island with an exploding volcano!

passages.title: Candied Sweet Potatoes
passages.text:
While you're here, you might want to stock up on Teldrassil sweet potatoes. They're used to make the most delicious candied sweet potatoes you've ever tasted.

If you don't believe me, look up the recipe in your bountiful cookbook and give it a try. And if there are any extras, you might want to share them with Gregory Tabor at the feasting area just outside Stormwind. They're one of his favorites, but to hear him tell it, everything's his favorite!

passages.title: Candied Sweet Potatoes
passages.text: <name>, it's good to see you again.

passages.title: Candied Sweet Potatoes
passages.text: Ah, candied sweet potatoes! My favorite! Did Isaac tell you?

passages.title: Club Foote
passages.text:
All this new friction between the Alliance and the Horde was leading to windfall profits, until Rear Admiral Hartley sailed into MY harbor and started poking his prow into my business. He's been searching and seizing vessels flying horde colors with the goal of depriving them use of a neutral port.

I'm not about to allow some fat-fingered human to cut into my profits! Get me the schematics of his flagship. Hartley's Chief Engineer is soaking himself at the Broken Keel Tavern just up the hill...

passages.title: Club Foote
passages.text: You got the goods?

passages.title: Club Foote
passages.text:
Ah, this is it - this is it right here! So his flagship is named "The Bellipotent" eh?

Let's see what it'll take to send this nuisance to the bottom of the sea.

passages.title: Slow-roasted Turkey
passages.text:
Every Pilgrim's Bounty feast requires a magnificent centerpiece, and I'm not talking about a decorative horn of plenty, either. No, the focus of the meal is a magnificent roast turkey.

There's a good recipe for it in your bountiful cookbook. Why not hunt some wild turkeys and prepare a few? The turkeys wander all over Elwynn Forest, so you shouldn't have a problem finding one.

Once you're done roasting them, will you bring them to Isaac Allerton near the gates of Darnassus?

passages.title: Slow-roasted Turkey
passages.text: What brings you back to Darnassus, <name>?

passages.title: Slow-roasted Turkey
passages.text: These are beautiful and just in time to feed hungry feasters. Thank you, <name>. You've truly mastered all the courses of a traditional Pilgrim's Bounty meal.

passages.title: Spice Bread Stuffing
passages.text:
Our spice bread stuffing is the cornerstone of the Pilgrim's Bounty table. The recipe dates from better times in Lordaeron and now it has taken its place in the traditional meal.

If you are already a cook, pay a visit to the Pilgrim's Bounty vendor to get your copy of the bountiful cookbook and all the local ingredients you'll need to prepare holiday fare. And if you're not yet a cook, there's no better time to start!

Once you've made the stuffing, bring it to William Mullins over near the tables.

passages.title: Spice Bread Stuffing
passages.text: The tables could really use more of that spice bread stuffing.

passages.title: Spice Bread Stuffing
passages.text:
It's a chore keeping all these tables stocked. If you stop and think about it, it's strange going to so much trouble when we needn't eat anymore.

<William shrugs.>

Tradition is tradition.

passages.title: Pumpkin Pie
passages.text:
That spice bread stuffing you made is a hit, but no Pilgrim's Bounty feast is complete without a slice of pumpkin pie. It's another traditional local dish, since it uses ripe Tirisfal pumpkins that only grow around here.

If you don't know how to make pumpkin pie already, there's a recipe in your bountiful cookbook.

Would you mind cooking up a few slices and bringing them to Francis Eaton outside Orgrimmar? He's bound to be running low by now.

passages.title: Pumpkin Pie
passages.text: We can always use more pumpkin pie.

passages.title: Pumpkin Pie
passages.text: The pie always goes first. I think people must be skipping the meal and going directly for the dessert. Have you given it a try yet?

passages.title: Cranberry Chutney
passages.text:
Have you tried the cranberry chutney yet? It's made with fresh tangy Southfury cranberries. Just pick some up from the Pilgrim's Bounty vendor if you want to try your hand at making chutney.

The recipe should be in your bountiful cookbook.

If you've got some extra time on your hands, would you mind making some of the chutney and bringing it to Dokin Farplain at the base of the elevator on the western side of Thunder Bluff?

passages.title: Cranberry Chutney
passages.text: How are you enjoying Pilgrim's Bounty, <class>?

passages.title: Cranberry Chutney
passages.text: Ah, more cranberry chutney! You wouldn't believe how fast the celebrants go through it.

passages.title: Ammo Kerblammo
passages.text:
Hartley must've unloaded all of his ordnance along the beach. Let's pull his teeth out, <name>!

Run along the shore and look for his munitions stockpiles. Light 'em up and he'll be land-locked and unarmed while the Bellipotent is repaired.

I'll meet you back here in Ratchet.

passages.title: Ammo Kerblammo
passages.text:
Hah! Beautiful work, <name>. Those Alliance cretins will never trace this back to me. Meanwhile, it's back to business as usual: smuggling, double-dealing, price-gouging... I've got a lot of work to catch up on.

Here, I'll let you in on a cut of my future profits. Enjoy!

passages.title: Candied Sweet Potatoes
passages.text:
While you're here, you might want to stock up on Mulgore sweet potatoes. They're used to make delicious candied sweet potatoes, my favorite part of the Pilgrim's Bounty meal.

If you don't believe me, look up the recipe in your bountiful cookbook and give it a try. If you're headed back to Orgrimmar, bring them to Francis Eaton at the feasting area just outside the city. I've been trying to keep him supplied, but everything goes so fast over there.

passages.title: Candied Sweet Potatoes
passages.text: Welcome back, <name>.

passages.title: Candied Sweet Potatoes
passages.text:
So Dokin drafted you to help with the candied sweet potatoes?

<Francis smiles.>

It's the only way he can keep up. Thanks for bringing these.

passages.title: Undersupplied in the Undercity
passages.text:
Thanks for bringing the candied sweet potatoes. There's so much cooking to do, I can hardly keep up. And then, Miles sends me a note saying he's on the verge of running out of stuffing and cranberry chutney. I don't suppose you'd be willing to step in and whip up some more of each? The vendor should have all the ingredients you need.

You should be able to find Miles Standish near the feasting tables in the courtyard in the ruins above Undercity.

passages.title: Undersupplied in the Undercity
passages.text: It's good to see you again. <name>.

passages.title: Undersupplied in the Undercity
passages.text: Thanks for bringing everything. Some of the tables were starting to look a little bereft of serving dishes.

passages.title: Slow-roasted Turkey
passages.text:
Every Pilgrim's Bounty feast requires a centerpiece, and for us, that's a slow-roasted wild turkey. I can't think of anything better to bring the meal together.

There's a good recipe for it in your bountiful cookbook. Why not hunt some wild turkeys and prepare a few? The turkeys wander all over Tirisfal Glades, so you shouldn't have a problem finding any.

Once you're done roasting them, will you bring them to Francis Eaton outside Orgrimmar?

passages.title: Slow-roasted Turkey
passages.text: What brings you back to Orgrimmar, <name>?

passages.title: Slow-roasted Turkey
passages.text: These look perfect. Thank you, <name>. You've truly mastered all the courses of a traditional Pilgrim's Bounty meal.

passages.title: Gazlowe's Fortune
passages.text:
Sink me, you were right! There's a map tattooed on the skull.

That cursed Baron - he buried my treasure right under my nose. Or, above my head, anyway. The map points to a place on the bluffs over Ratchet, to the south.

Follow the road west out of the city, get atop the hill, head south, then run back towards the coast and look for an enormous tree overlooking the bay. Fetch my treasure and I'll split it with you!

passages.title: Gazlowe's Fortune
passages.text: I'm going to close my eyes, <name>. And when I open them, I expect to see wall-to-wall treasure. Deal?

passages.title: Gazlowe's Fortune
passages.text:
Nice work, <name>!

Oh, the Baron tried to stop you, did he? Well, I hope you gave him a pounding.

Now, I promised you a cut of the goods you recovered. Let's see... what's one percent of a half percent? Ah, here you go.

passages.title: Don't Forget The Stuffing!
passages.text:
Keeping these tables stocked can be overwhelming! I've got to make the cranberry chutney while keeping my eye on the sweet potatoes, and making sure the pies don't burn.

I think I've got everything covered. No, wait, I'm forgetting something. The stuffing! Oh, no. There won't be time to get another batch of stuffing started before everything else is done. Would you be willing to help me out? It shouldn't take long to buy or make some stuffing and you can buy the ingredients right here.

passages.title: Don't Forget The Stuffing!
passages.text: Were you able to get that stuffing?

passages.title: Don't Forget The Stuffing!
passages.text: Thank goodness! I wouldn't be able to serve the feast without spice bread stuffing.

passages.title: We're Out of Cranberry Chutney Again?
passages.text:
My husband, Jasper, was going to make more cranberry chutney, but it looks like he's busy trying to make sure there's enough candied sweet potatoes for all the guests. Would you be willing to help? If you're a cook, you can get the tangy Wetlands cranberries you'll need from the Pilgrim's Bounty vendor outside Ironforge.

If you don't feel up to cooking, you could always ask someone else to make the chutney, too.

passages.title: We're Out of Cranberry Chutney Again?
passages.text: Were you able to get your hands on any cranberry chutney?

passages.title: We're Out of Cranberry Chutney Again?
passages.text: Thanks. This looks great, and you're a fair bit faster than Jasper, but don't tell him I said so.

passages.title: Easy As Pie
passages.text:
Isaac's been hard at work helping celebrants learn about the traditional Pilgrim's Bounty feast and how to make dishes out of all the ingredients we harvest at this time of year. I've been trying to keep the tables stocked with as many of the dishes as I can, but we're running out of one of Isaac's favorites, pumpkin pie.

Would you be able to get some for us? If you want to make the pies yourself, you'll need to buy ripe Elwynn pumpkins from the Pilgrim's Bounty vendor outside Stormwind.

passages.title: Easy As Pie
passages.text: How are those pies coming along?

passages.title: Easy As Pie
passages.text: These are perfect. Isaac, and everyone else, will love them!

passages.title: She Says Potato
passages.text:
My wife Ellen has enlisted my help in keeping the tables stocked, but she can't make up her mind. First I was making pumpkin pie, but now she's changed her mind and she wants candied sweet potatoes.

Well, I've already started on the pie, so maybe you can help me whip up those sweet potatoes. She'll be pleasantly surprised if we can get everything she's asked for.

If you're going to cook the sweet potatoes yourself, you'll have to buy them from the Pilgrim's Bounty merchant in Darnassus. Thanks, <name>.

passages.title: She Says Potato
passages.text: Do you have those candied sweet potatoes?

passages.title: She Says Potato
passages.text: These are perfect. Thanks for helping me with this, <name>. The meal will get served on time and Ellen will be happy.

passages.title: She Says Potato
passages.text:
Roberta Carter has recruited me to help prepare one of the feast dishes, candied sweet potatoes. Normally, I'd love to help, but I've promised the hostess that I'd help her watch the tables.

I'd really appreciate it if you would help me come up with those candied sweet potatoes. Roberta would never forgive me if I let her down.

If you're going to cook the sweet potatoes yourself, you'll have to buy them from the Pilgrim's Bounty merchant in Thunder Bluff. Thanks, <name>.

passages.title: She Says Potato
passages.text: Do you have those candied sweet potatoes?

passages.title: She Says Potato
passages.text: Thanks, <name>. Now, I can help the hostess out and still keep my word to Roberta.

passages.title: We're Out of Cranberry Chutney Again?
passages.text:
I wish I knew why we're going through cranberry chutney so fast. Sometimes, I think they're feeding it to the abominations when I'm not looking. Would you be willing to help me make up a new batch? If you're a cook, you can get the tangy Southfury cranberries you'll need from the Pilgrim's Bounty vendor outside Orgrimmar.

If you don't feel up to cooking, you could always ask someone else to make the chutney, too.

passages.title: We're Out of Cranberry Chutney Again?
passages.text: Were you able to get your hands on any cranberry chutney?

passages.title: We're Out of Cranberry Chutney Again?
passages.text: Thanks for your help, and let me know if you ever get to the bottom of the case of the disappearing chutney.

passages.title: Easy As Pie
passages.text:
Dokin and Laha have been hard at work helping celebrants learn about the traditional Pilgrim's Bounty feast and how to make dishes out of all the ingredients we harvest at this time of year. I've been trying to keep the tables stocked with as many of the dishes as I can, but we're running low on pumpkin pie.

Would you be able to get some for us? If you want to make the pies yourself, you'll need to buy ripe Tirisfal pumpkins from the Pilgrim's Bounty vendor outside the Undercity.

passages.title: Easy As Pie
passages.text: How are those pies coming along?

passages.title: Easy As Pie
passages.text: These are great! Thank you for helping, <name>.

passages.title: Mutiny, Mon!
passages.text:
Now for my favorite part of any mutiny: the killin'! For pirates, it doesn't matter who's supposed to be in charge, only who's in control of the ships. Anchored on the east end of this island is the Maiden's Dagger, Cap'n Garvey's old flagship. He left his most trusted officer in charge: Alicia Cuthbert. Once we take her out, the ship is ours, and so's the sea.

I'll get the men onto the boats. I need you to board the Dagger and blow this horn from on deck - that'll be our signal to board. Yar!

passages.title: Mutiny, Mon!
passages.text: Is that the Maiden's Dagger I see weighing anchor in the distance? Did you have anything to do with that?

passages.title: Mutiny, Mon!
passages.text:
So Tony is running the show there now? Good! We need more pirates like him in these waters. He's a real businessman.

<Dizzywig rubs his hands together greedily.>

Speaking of business, I suppose I owe you a cut. Would you be interested in insuring any of your new loot? You never know what can happen in a town like this...

passages.title: Sharing a Bountiful Feast
passages.text:
You've not celebrated Pilgrim's Bounty properly until you've eaten your fill at a Bountiful Table.

Please, sit down, feast, and try everything! You can move from chair to chair yourself, or ask others at the table to pass you some of their food.

Once you eat enough of every dish, you'll be infused with the Spirit of Sharing.

passages.title: Sharing a Bountiful Feast
passages.text: Did you eat enough at a Bountiful Table?

passages.title: Sharing a Bountiful Feast
passages.text:
What a feast, hmmm?

I'm so glad you could celebrate the spirit of Pilgrim's Bounty with us.

passages.title: Sharing a Bountiful Feast
passages.text:
You've not celebrated Pilgrim's Bounty properly until you've eaten your fill at a Bountiful Table.

Please, sit down, feast, and try everything! You can move from chair to chair yourself, or ask others at the table to pass you some of their food.

Once you eat enough of every dish, you'll be infused with the Spirit of Sharing.

passages.title: Sharing a Bountiful Feast
passages.text: Did you eat enough at a Bountiful Table?

passages.title: Sharing a Bountiful Feast
passages.text:
What a feast, hmmm?

I'm so glad you could celebrate the spirit of Pilgrim's Bounty with us.

passages.title: Investigate the Wreckage
passages.text:
Not long ago, a shipment of silver was stolen en route from here to Crossroads. It was meant as payroll to the guards, and we want that silver back.

I'll ask around here for clues, but I want you to investigate the scene of the crime. Head west and look for a crashed caravan wagon just north of the road between here and Crossroads. Find out who took our silver and get it back!

passages.title: Investigate the Wreckage
passages.text: This Horde caravan was not merely robbed. It was savagely brutalized. Crates of supplies have been ripped apart by sharp claws. The wagon has been demolished. The food has been eaten and the silver is gone, and yet useful supplies have been left behind...

passages.title: The Stolen Silver
passages.text:
It's clear that these raptors acted alone to steal the Horde's silver.

It's time to teach these beasts a lesson.

passages.title: The Stolen Silver
passages.text: You look roughed up, <class>. Did you tussle with the thieves?

passages.title: The Stolen Silver
passages.text:
<Gazrog opens the lockbox and begins counting up the silver while you relate your story.>

What!? Raptors? Just the raptors? Assaulting our caravans and looting them? Perhaps they are as intelligent as the rumors say. As if we didn't have enough problems, now we've got to deal with brainy lizards with a lust for coin.

Here, <name> - you've earned a share of the rescued silver. Thank you.

passages.title: Waptor Twapping
passages.text:
Waptor twapping can be wough, but I've designed new waptor twaps that ewiminate much of the wisk.

Set the twap on the gwound and it will scweech wike a waptor, luwing one into the twap.

When a waptor steps on my waptor twap, it'll shwink down so that it's wess dangewous. It's wewwy easy! I would do it myself but wecentwy I wan acwoss King Weapercwaw.

passages.title: Waptor Twapping
passages.text: Where's the wittle waptors?

passages.title: Waptor Twapping
passages.text: Hooway! You twapped the waptors I was wooking for! Now we will twain them for twolls to wide to swaughter the Awwiance!

passages.title: Do it Yourself
passages.text:
We need to send a message to several deadbeats. Of course, they're hiding out in Drudgetown, the scum. I know how you hate going into the slums, boss-<man/lady>, but what can we do?

<Sassy rifles through some paperwork.>

I have all of the names right here.

Might I suggest a little 'personal visit'? A couple of strategic beatdowns will send a message to the other debtors AND your competition.

<name> is not a goblin to be trifled with!

passages.title: Do it Yourself
passages.text:
A complete success if I do say so myself, sir! Your debtors will think twice now about not paying up!

<Sassy taps her pencil against her lower lip for a moment, deep in thought.>

Perhaps we should increase interest rates on loans across the board?

passages.title: Rolling with my Homies
passages.text:
<name>, you're about to host the corporate party to end all corporate parties. My research says that if you're seen having a good time at the party, your promotion quotient will skyrocket and explode!

So, with that in mind, might I suggest that you take your new company hot rod out for a spin?

Go pick up your friends. Just remember me on the way up when it all comes together and you're the new Trade <Prince/Princess>, okay?

passages.title: Rolling with my Homies
passages.text: The party's almost ready. How was your trip to town?

passages.title: Rolling with my Homies
passages.text: Well done, sir. You all look very good riding around in the hot rod. I'm sure you made quite an impression on the citizenry.

passages.title: Deathgate's Reinforcements
passages.text:
<name>! Your reputation among the Horde grows. I've been hearing reports from both the Forgotten Pools and the Stagnant Oasis that you've been a real bane to our centaur foes. Well done, indeed.

Regthar Deathgate is in charge of our operations against the centaur all over the Northern Barrens. He could use a bold <class> like yourself to bolster his forces. Report to him at his outpost along the road west of here and aid him in any way he requires.

passages.title: Deathgate's Reinforcements
passages.text: Ah, I've heard about your work, <class>. Your timing is fortunate - I've got a major offensive in the works.

passages.title: A Leg Up
passages.text:
The Argent Crusade dispatched a fast ship carrying tallstrider meat and other supplies for us here at the tournament grounds, but it never arrived. Scouts reported seeing it attacked by the Kvaldir, fearsome vrykul raiders who roam the seas.

They've slain the crew and taken the cargo to an island called Hrothgar's Landing. If you look to the north, you can see it shrouded in the mist. Would you help us in recovering the stolen supplies? Without those tallstrider legs, we'll soon be out of food.

passages.title: A Leg Up
passages.text: Were you able to recover any of the missing supplies?

passages.title: A Leg Up
passages.text: These look a little worse for wear, but they're still edible. The crusaders will be glad to hear that we've managed to recover some of the ship's cargo.

passages.title: Breakfast Of Champions
passages.text:
Now that the coliseum is complete, the Argent Crusade has asked us to help look after the creatures that champions will be fighting.

The giant jormungar have perhaps the strangest diet; they grow strong by eating the eggs of their own kind and the best eggs come from deep jormungar.

Take this drum to the Foot Steppes in central Storm Peaks and play them near the snow mounds you see there. Rouse the deep jormungar, kill them, and gather their egg sacs.

passages.title: Breakfast Of Champions
passages.text: Were you able to get those eggs? Those worms will start eating their handlers if they're not fed soon.

passages.title: Breakfast Of Champions
passages.text: Well done, <name>. I'll take these to the Argent Crusade's keepers right away. They'll have no choice but to acknowledge that we're doing far more than the Sunreavers to keep the coliseum running smoothly.

passages.title: The Light's Mercy
passages.text:
I've been listening to Confessor Paletress speak, and I must tell you, her words have given me much to consider. It is not enough to fight beside the crusaders; we must take up their mission.

Off the north coast is Hrothgar's Landing, where the seagoing Kvaldir have overrun an old tuskarr settlement and slain the villagers. Take this book and read the rites for the dead near the corpses of the villagers. It will allow their spirits to escape the mists engulfing the island and find peace.

passages.title: The Light's Mercy
passages.text: Have you seen to the spirits of the slain Tualiq villagers?

passages.title: The Light's Mercy
passages.text:
<Narasi accepts the prayer book from you.>

Thank you. The book was a gift from Confessor Paletress herself. She would  be honored to know that you have used it to bring tranquility to the slain.

passages.title: Stop The Aggressors
passages.text:
The Kvaldir, fearsome vrykul raiders, have disrupted our shipments and murdered the tuskarr inhabitants of an island to the north, renaming it Hrothgar's Landing. If they are allowed to get a foothold there, there is no doubt that we will be their next target.

The crusade's forces have their hands full dealing with the Scourge, and we must defend the tournament grounds. Fly north from the grounds until you reach the island and take on the Kvaldir before they can destroy anything else.

passages.title: Stop The Aggressors
passages.text: Have you shown the Kvaldir that we will not let them threaten us?

passages.title: Stop The Aggressors
passages.text: Your actions have shown that we stand as one with the Argent Crusade, while the Sunreavers are too busy preening to take up their blades.

passages.title: Learn to Ride in the Eversong Woods
passages.text:
This pamphlet advertising riding training and mount purchases was sent from Perascamin.

Perascamin can be found at Thuron's Livery, southeast of the Shepherd's Gate leaving Silvermoon City.

passages.title: Learn to Ride in the Eversong Woods
passages.text: Ah, you received my letter? Good.

passages.title: Learn to Ride in the Eversong Woods
passages.text: So, shall we begin your Apprentice Riding training?

passages.title: Gormok Wants His Snobolds
passages.text:
Two of my men have already been killed trying to confine the magnataur called Gormok the Impaler, yet the creature still rages. It howls for hours about being without its favorite snobold.

If the Argent Crusade didn't wish to use this monster in the coliseum, I'd slay it myself. Perhaps it's time to bring the beast its playthings. Take this net and travel to Garm's Bane in southeast Storm Peaks. It's just northeast of K3. Capture some of those snobolds and pray to the Light you've found the right one.

passages.title: Gormok Wants His Snobolds
passages.text: Have you managed to round up those snobolds yet? Gormok's anger shows no signs of lessening.

passages.title: Gormok Wants His Snobolds
passages.text: The sooner we get these stinking things out of my sight and into their cage, the faster my mood will improve. I wish the Argent Crusade had given the Sunreavers the care of this creature. They're enough alike that they ought to be able to understand each other.

passages.title: Breakfast Of Champions
passages.text:
Now that the coliseum is complete, the Argent Crusade has asked us to help look after the creatures that champions will be fighting.

The giant jormungar have perhaps the strangest diet; they grow strong by eating the eggs of their own kind and the best eggs come from deep jormungar.

Take this drum to the Foot Steppes in central Storm Peaks and play them near the snow mounds you see there. The sound will rouse the deep jormungar. Kill them, collect their egg sacs, and return to the tournament grounds.

passages.title: Breakfast Of Champions
passages.text: Were you able to get those eggs? The jormungar are going to get nasty if they don't get fed.

passages.title: Breakfast Of Champions
passages.text: I'll let the crusaders know that you've just returned with a fresh load of food while the Silver Covenant was sitting on its heels.

passages.title: You've Really Done It This Time, Kul
passages.text:
Crusader Kul has gone and gotten himself into trouble again, only this time he's not alone. When he saw the cultists making camp at Deathspeaker's Watch, west of the tournament grounds, Kul gathered the aspirants for an assault.

Without reinforcements, Kul and his followers were easily captured. I have no doubt that the cult will sacrifice the prisoners unless we can mount a rescue. Any of those cultists could carry keys to the black cages. Find the keys and free Kul and the captive aspirants.

passages.title: You've Really Done It This Time, Kul
passages.text: Thanks to you, Kul and the aspirants will live to fight the Scourge again. That's far from the first time someone's had to save Kul from himself. My only hope is that the crusaders can find a better outlet for his enthusiasm than allowing him to impart all of his bad habits to impressionable young aspirants.

passages.title: Drottinn Hrothgar
passages.text:
The Kvaldir, seafaring vrykul who raid ships and coastal settlements, have overrun a tuskarr island across the strait to the north. Their leader is a veteran raider, Drottinn Hrothgar, who seeks to control these seas.

With him in power, our shipments and troop transports will never be safe. We will be stranded here at the Lich King's mercy.

Take this captured Kvaldir war horn to the circle of tuskarr statues on the northeastern part of Hrothgar's Landing and use it to challenge the Kvaldir leader.

passages.title: Drottinn Hrothgar
passages.text: We cannot allow Drottinn Hrothgar's men to continue their assault on our ships and our men.

passages.title: Drottinn Hrothgar
passages.text: The defeat of the drottinn will set the kvaldir to fighting amongst themselves, buying us time to use our advantage. The crusade and the tournament are in your debt, champion.

passages.title: Mistcaller Yngvar
passages.text:
The Kvaldir have returned to the coasts of Northrend and if left unchecked, they will prevent our supplies and reinforcements from arriving. One of them, known as Mistcaller Yngvar, has taken up residence in a cave on the western side of Hrothgar's Landing. There, he manipulates the mists to conceal the Kvaldir and the sea beasts they command.

Take this charm and travel across the strait north of the tournament grounds, to Hrothgar's Landing. Find the mistcaller's cave and use the charm to reveal him.

passages.title: Mistcaller Yngvar
passages.text: Have you defeated Mistcaller Yngvar and disrupted his rituals?

passages.title: Mistcaller Yngvar
passages.text: You have bought us valuable time to move against the Kvaldir and free the seas of these pests. Once again, the Argent Crusade is in your debt.

passages.title: Ornolf The Scarred
passages.text:
Ornolf the Scarred is a fearsome raider renowned among his Kvaldir brethren for raiding and capturing ships. From aboard Bor's Fury, he and his crew attack our ships and steal our goods.

Ornolf and his men are among those who slaughtered the inhabitants of a tuskarr island to the north and renamed it Hrothgar's Landing. His ship sits at anchor at the eastern end of the island's harbor. Take this captured banner and display it on his ship to provoke him into facing you in battle.

passages.title: Ornolf The Scarred
passages.text: Have you dealt with Ornolf the Scarred?

passages.title: Ornolf The Scarred
passages.text: Ornolf's crew will want to avenge their leader, but without him, they will be easier to defeat. We must live to carry out our mission, to see Icecrown rid of the Scourge and other evils.

passages.title: Deathspeaker Kharos
passages.text:
The Cult of the Damned has redoubled its efforts to see us destroyed. They have grown bold and are massing their strength at Deathspeaker's Watch on the ridge west of the tournament grounds.

The ruthless Deathspeaker Kharos has his men fortifying their positions, preparing to unleash all of the cult's weapons.

My men are preparing themselves and the valiants to defend the grounds, but I want champions like you, <name>, to lead our efforts to blunt the attack. Find Deathspeaker Kharos and slay him.

passages.title: Deathspeaker Kharos
passages.text: Have you defeated the leader of the cult's attack?

passages.title: Deathspeaker Kharos
passages.text: You are truly an example to all who have gathered beneath our banner, <name>. Together, we will show the Scourge that we will not be defeated.

passages.title: Get Kraken!
passages.text:
The Sunreavers and Silver Covenant sent ships north to engage the Kvaldir at Hrothgar's Landing, but were intercepted and detained by a Kvaldir Raiding vessel. To make matters worse, the Kvaldir have found a way to call forth the dreaded Kraken that lives beneath the North Sea. If anyone on board is to get out alive, that Kraken must be driven away and the Kvaldir's summoning ritual ... disrupted.

Crusader, take these spears and an Argent Hippogryph will take you to the battle.

passages.title: Get Kraken!
passages.text: Have you driven away the Kraken yet?  Hurry, Crusader! There isn't much time.

passages.title: Get Kraken!
passages.text: Crusader, you may have bought those sailors just enough time to escape,  Maybe next time, those Silver Covenant and Sunreavers will listen before running head first at the enemy.

passages.title: The New You
passages.text:
A new outfit? You don't say! There's quite a buzz surrounding your party. Everyone who's anyone on the island is going to be there.

Well, happy shopping. Swindle Street has some of the best bargains anywhere!

passages.title: The New You
passages.text:
Do you have it all, <name>? I can't wait to see it on you!

You bought the good stuff, right?

passages.title: The New You
passages.text:
Oh, you are going to look so fine, but not as gorgeous as me! You're going to replace the Trade Prince any day now at the rate you're going!

I can't wait to not have to work anymore! You're going to buy me everything that I want, right babe?

Let me have all that stuff and I'll help you get into it right before the party.

passages.title: The New You
passages.text:
A new outfit? You don't say! There's quite a buzz surrounding your party. Everyone who's anyone on the island is going to be there.

Well, happy shopping. Swindle Street has some of the best bargains anywhere!

passages.title: The New You
passages.text:
Do you have it all? I can't wait to see it on you!

Mmm hmm!

passages.title: The New You
passages.text:
Oh yeah, you're going to look hot! You're going to replace the Trade Prince any day now at the rate you're going!

I can't wait to be a kept man!

Let me have all that stuff and I'll help you get into it right before the party.

passages.title: What Do You Feed a Yeti, Anyway?
passages.text:
The crusaders have captured a yeti that they're calling Icehowl. He's to be a participant in the coliseum battles and we've been asked to help with his training and upkeep.

The crusaders weren't fond of my suggestion that we feed the beast surplus Sunreavers. The creature has a predilection for shark meat, so I want you to fly down to the Silver Blade, floating in the strait to the north. Get some fresh chum from one of the buckets on the boat, then spread it in the water to attract sharks.

passages.title: What Do You Feed a Yeti, Anyway?
passages.text: I hope you have something to feed Icehowl, otherwise I really will start bringing Sunreavers down to his cage.

passages.title: What Do You Feed a Yeti, Anyway?
passages.text: I'm glad we've gotten that done. It's not the most glorious task in the world, but when we partnered with the Argent Crusade, we promised to do all they asked of us without complaint. Of course, the same cannot be said of the Sunreavers.

passages.title: Life of the Party
passages.text:
Oh my gosh, babe! Everyone is here! Who cares about some stupid dragon?

We setup the party around the pool. Sounds like they're having a great time. You are going to look so good!

Why don't you head over to the pool and keep everyone entertained? I'll join you in a moment... I just have to slip into something even more amazing!

passages.title: Life of the Party
passages.text:
How's the party going?

You look amazing! So dashing and handsome, sir!

passages.title: Life of the Party
passages.text:
Very nicely done, sir. The party appears to have been a smashing success!

Er... what's that?

passages.title: The Uninvited Guest
passages.text:
While you were dealing with the pirates, I noticed the Trade Prince slip upstairs. He's up on the balcony at the top of the stairs.

<name>, I think he's the one that sent the pirates.

<Sassy cringes.>

You'd better get up there A.S.A.P.! You wouldn't want to keep him waiting.

passages.title: The Uninvited Guest
passages.text:
Well, well, well, if it isn't my wayward protege, Mr. <name>.

I'm hurt and disappointed. You didn't send me an invitation to your little party out there. Sorry about the crashers... you know how pirates can be.

So, shall we get down to business?

passages.title: The Eyes of Ashenvale
passages.text:
Our enemies abound, <class>, even here at our very doorstep. The night elves have reinforced Talrendis Point in an attempt to stop our advance into Ashenvale. As we speak, their scouts patrol the nearby hills, reporting every movement to and from these gates.

We must remove these eyes of Ashenvale.

Go. Your prey stalks all around these gates, especially to the east. Slay the scouts who shadow us!

passages.title: The Eyes of Ashenvale
passages.text: Excellent. As their scouts fail to report in, Talrendis will feel the terror they've tried in vain to inflict on us.

passages.title: Robbing Hoods
passages.text:
We're all going to die!!!

<You slap Megs to calm her down.>

Sorry about that, <Mr./Ms.> <name>. Okay, we need to find a way to get a lot of moolah quickly.

There are reports of the Trade Prince sending hired looters into the streets.

You could take the hot rod out there and run them down, snatching the loot that they've illegally stolen. There wouldn't be anything wrong with that, right?

passages.title: Robbing Hoods
passages.text: Were you able to steal a whole bunch of stolen loot?

passages.title: Robbing Hoods
passages.text:
Wow, you really did it?! Well, they had it coming, I guess.

That's an awful lot of loot. Do you think it's enough to get you a spot on the Trade Prince's yacht?

Are you going to be able to bring anyone with you? I don't make too much working in marketing.

passages.title: The Great Bank Heist
passages.text:
All of your assets have been frozen and the First Bank of Kezan is out of business!

You need an awful lot of moolah, boss. I think you're going to have to go break your own money out of the bank! The different widgets in your Goblin All-In-1-Der belt should be enough to crack the vault.

I just hope that you've been saving for a rainy day like I always told you to do. You might have noticed... it's raining hot liquid magma!!!

passages.title: The Great Bank Heist
passages.text: Did you get it? Did you crack the safe and get your personal riches out of the bank?

passages.title: The Great Bank Heist
passages.text:
Hey, you have been saving! I'm so proud of you!

<Sassy counts all of your macaroons.>

Um, boss... this isn't nearly enough.

We're close, but we still don't have enough macaroons. But, I've got a plan: we're going to collect on the headquarters insurance policy!

Hope you don't mind, but I filled the place with the leftover fireworks from your party. All you have to do is go in there and sabotage things.

Might I suggest the faulty generator, the leaky stove, and the flammable bed? Then, come back outside and use the control panel to send in the gasbot.

It's a foolproof plan!

This is nothing. You should see Bilgewater Port... the whole thing is going up in flames!

Fine, fine, I don't have time to inspect this place. Here's the moolah from the Bilgewater Cartel's insurance policy.

I've got to find a way off the island! Good luck, <name>!

passages.title: Life Savings
passages.text:
We've got all of the moolah that we need. There's only one thing left to do now, boss: get you to the Trade Prince's yacht. It's about to leave port!

We're gonna have to hurry. Hop in, 'cause I'm driving!

passages.title: Life Savings
passages.text: Oh, <name>, it's you. What an unexpected surprise.

passages.title: Life Savings
passages.text:
Congratulations, you just made it. I see that you've brought me all that I asked for, including your hot rod.

<The Trade Prince flashes an evil grin.>

A bazillion macaroons couldn't have been easy to come by. I'm now the wealthiest, most powerful, <race> on all of Azeroth!

TOO BAD FOR YOU THAT I'M CHANGING THE TERMS OF OUR DEAL!

You're now my slave. Get below deck and take a turn shoveling coal. Next stop, Azshara!

Muahahahahahahahaha!

passages.title: Return of the Highborne?
passages.text:
The wax seal on these orders has been freshly broken. You can't read the carefully-penned night elven script, but a small hand-drawn map indicates the nearby ruins. Underneath the map, written in a different language entirely, are a series of runes penned in a metallic, shimmering ink.

Ag'tor will no doubt want to see this important piece of intelligence.

passages.title: Return of the Highborne?
passages.text: You found something on one of the bodies, you say? Give it here!

passages.title: Return of the Highborne?
passages.text:
<Ag'tor squints at the parchment, turning it in the light.>

No, I can't make sense of it either, but I don't like what I see. Are these arcane runes?

I'll need you to deliver this to an expert.

passages.title: Return of the Highborne?
passages.text: Our blood elven allies have been examining the ruins marked on this map, and can likely understand this mysterious script. Seek out the one called Malynea Skyreaver. She conducts her research from the Orgrimmar Rocketway Exchange just north of here - it's part of the new goblin transit system that snakes across this land. Quickly, now!

passages.title: Return of the Highborne?
passages.text: I trust this interruption is in regards to something important?

passages.title: Return of the Highborne?
passages.text:
What? Give that here, this instant! Ag'tor is correct, these are arcane runes. They're scouting out magical sites? Experimenting with the arcane arts? This is a marked departure from thousands of years of night elven history.

Hmph! The idea that they will achieve any competence in this field - even those who once counted themselves among the highborne - is absurd.
