passages.text: Now Veranus can finally rest in peace.

passages.title: Ignis the Furnace Master Must Die!
passages.text:
The great fire giant, Ignis the Furnace Master toils away inside of Ulduar's Colossal Forge. Under orders from Loken, Ignis creates weapons that are terrifying in their power.

The Council of Six has decreed that Ignis must die!

passages.title: Ignis the Furnace Master Must Die!
passages.text: I trust that you did not have to face too many of his iron construct assistants?

passages.title: XT-002 Deconstructor Must Die!
passages.text:
Yet another strange construct of Mimiron, the XT-002 Deconstructor actually thinks that it is the keeper's son. Do not be fooled by its feigned innocence. It is a deadly machine!

You will find the Deconstructor within Ulduar's Scrapyard. The Council of Six has decreed that XT-002 Deconstructor must die!

passages.title: XT-002 Deconstructor Must Die!
passages.text: The greatest weakness of Ulduar is its masters' blind faith in their inventions to protect it.

passages.title: Lord Jaraxxus Must Die!
passages.text:
Archmage Timear has foreseen a horrible event, which is about to transpire. A foolish gnome warlock is about to accidentally summon an Eredar lord of the Burning Legion into the middle of the Trial of the Crusader.

You must be there when it happens, <class>. If Lord Jaraxxus escapes, he will open a portal and the Burning Legion will spill forth into our world once more.

The Council of Six has decreed that Lord Jaraxxus must die!

passages.title: Lord Jaraxxus Must Die!
passages.text: All of Azeroth is fortunate that Timear foresaw the Eredar lord's arrival and that you were there in time to slay him.

passages.title: Lord Marrowgar Must Die!
passages.text:
Lord Marrowgar is the guardian of the Frozen Throne within the Spire Chamber. Pieced together by the Lich King from the bones of a thousand vanquished adventurers, Marrowgar wields the power of the throne itself.

Without the destruction of this bone wraith, there is no hope of taking Icecrown Citadel.

The Council of Six has decreed that Lord Marrowgar must die!

passages.title: Lord Marrowgar Must Die!
passages.text: The Frozen Throne is without its chief guardian thanks to you. Our attacks upon the Lich King's forces will be all the more successful now.

passages.title: Changing of the Gar'dul
passages.text:
When Bloodhilt arrives, I'd like to - ah - talk in private. Can you accompany me to make sure things stay on the level? This Bloodhilt is a, ah, he's a, he's a loose cannon.

<Gar'dul tries to compose himself.>

Meet me atop the northern tower and we'll talk with Bloodhilt together.

passages.title: Betrayal at Tempest's Reach
passages.text:
King Greymane has been taken prisoner by Lord Godfrey in Tempest's Reach!

He managed to convince two of the eastern lords to go with his plan. The fool seems to think he can strike a deal with the Forsaken by turning Greymane over to them.

Listen carefully, <name>. We need to resolve this with as little bloodshed as possible.

This potion will allow you to sneak in undetected. We need you to assassinate the traitorous lords before this gets out of hand!

passages.title: Betrayal at Tempest's Reach
passages.text: Careful, <name>.

passages.title: Betrayal at Tempest's Reach
passages.text: I wish it could've been avoided, <name>.  Let us ensure this is resolved without further bloodshed.

passages.title: Neither Human Nor Beast
passages.text:
It is time, <name>. This... alchemy that has kept the beast inside you at bay will not last for long.

The first cursed worgen were night elf druids like our new allies. They, however, abandoned the balance that the rest of their kind embraced and allowed the beast to take over their minds.

It is only fitting that their brethren be the ones that deliver us from the Curse. Go, <class>. Drink from the waters of Tal'doren and make peace with yourself.

passages.title: Neither Human Nor Beast
passages.text: It is always good to see you brother.

passages.title: Neither Human Nor Beast
passages.text: It is done then, <name>.  You are one of us now.

passages.title: The Purification of Quel'Delar
passages.text:
The Sunwell and the end of Quel'Delar's exile await, <name>.

You will find Lor'themar Theron, the regent of Quel'Thalas, and Grand Magister Rommath standing within. Be wary of them and do not allow them to entrap you in their political scheming.

Instead, remain focused on your task here. Speak to a Warden of the Sunwell to enter the Sunwell Plateau. Immerse the reformed Quel'Delar in the Sunwell to complete the restoration. Show the blade to Myralion Sunblaze at Quel'Delar's Rest once it is restored.

passages.title: The Purification of Quel'Delar
passages.text: You have returned from the Sunwell?

passages.title: The Purification of Quel'Delar
passages.text: Am I truly laying my eyes upon the weapon of Thalorien Dawnseeker? This is a wondrous day for the Sunreavers and for all sin'dorei!

passages.title: The Purification of Quel'Delar
passages.text:
I admit, I was skeptical that you had actually re-forged Quel'Delar and I did not expect Thalorien's spirit to reveal itself to you. You cannot understand what it means to my people that Quel'Delar has been recovered.

As promised, I will admit you to the Sunwell and you will find the leaders of Silvermoon within. Carry the sword to the chamber of the Sunwell and immerse it. Once the blade is restored, return with it to Caladis Brightspear at Quel'Delar's Rest.

passages.title: The Purification of Quel'Delar
passages.text: Tell me of what happened in the Sunwell, <name>.

passages.title: The Purification of Quel'Delar
passages.text: This is unbelievable, <name>. You've really done it! All of the quel'dorei have heard of Thalorien Dawnseeker and Quel'Delar, but no one ever thought the sword would be restored.

passages.title: The Purification of Quel'Delar
passages.text:
The Sunwell and the end of Quel'Delar's exile await, <name>.

You will find Lor'themar Theron, the regent of Quel'Thalas, and Grand Magister Rommath standing within. Be wary of them and do not allow them to entrap you in their political scheming.

Instead, remain focused on your task here. Immerse the reformed Quel'Delar in the Sunwell to complete the its restoration, then speak with Myralion Sunblaze at Quel'Delar's Rest. Speak to a Warden of the Sunwell when you are ready to enter the Sunwell Plateau.

passages.title: The Purification of Quel'Delar
passages.text: What happened during your visit to the Sunwell?

passages.title: The Purification of Quel'Delar
passages.text: Am I truly laying my eyes upon the weapon of Thalorien Dawnseeker? This is a wondrous day for the Sunreavers and for all sin'dorei!

passages.title: A Gift for the Emissary of Stormwind
passages.text:
Did you want to make a Lovely Charm Bracelet for the Emissary of Stormwind? I'm sure he'd be thrilled.

Do you already have a Lovely Charm Collector's Kit?

passages.title: A Gift for the Emissary of Stormwind
passages.text: Well met, <class>. Did you have something for me?

passages.title: A Gift for the Emissary of Stormwind
passages.text: My thanks for this Lovely Charm Bracelet.

The Sunwell and the end of Quel'Delar's exile await, <name>.

Instead, remain focused on your task here. Immerse the reformed Quel'Delar in the Sunwell to complete its restoration, then show it to Myralio Sunblaze at Quel'Delar's Rest. Speak to a Warden of the Sunwell when you are ready to enter the Sunwell Plateau.

passages.title: The Purification of Quel'Delar
passages.text: What news do you bring from the Sunwell?

passages.title: The Purification of Quel'Delar
passages.text: Am I truly laying my eyes upon the weapon of Thalorien Dawnseeker? This is a wondrous day for the Sunreavers and for all sin'dorei!

passages.title: The Nightmare Scar
passages.text:
This confirms it. The overgrowth here is not being caused by a mere overabundance of energy.

Do you understand? This is beyond what happened at the Wailing Caverns now. A rift into the Nightmare must have torn open in the middle of the very land we're standing on! And to think it's my fault...

I'm done picking at the edges of this wound. Go to the west, to the center of the overgrowth, and meet me again there. We will dive into the heart of this corruption and force it shut!

passages.title: The Nightmare Scar
passages.text: We must not allow the nightmare to spread further into our world!

passages.title: The Nightmare Scar
passages.text:
We've done it! The nightmare's connection to this place has been severed. The rest of the land is safe from this intrusion now, and in time, the abberations here will be subsumed by the balance of nature.

I cannot thank you enough, <name>. By helping to restore order here, you've let me make amends for my foolish actions.

passages.title: A Gift for a Lord of Ironforge
passages.text:
Did you want to make a Lovely Charm Bracelet for Muradin Bronzebeard? I'm sure he'd be thrilled.

Do you already have a Lovely Charm Collector's Kit?

passages.title: A Gift for a Lord of Ironforge
passages.text: Well met, <class>. Did you have something for me?

passages.title: A Gift for a Lord of Ironforge
passages.text: My thanks for this Lovely Charm Bracelet.

passages.title: Claim the Battle Scar
passages.text:
We have fought the Alliance to a standstill here, even as the land beneath our feet falls apart. To the east you will find the Battlescar, a wide swath of decimated terrain. It is little more than a line in the sand, but it must be OUR line.

In the center of the scar you will find a flag marker designating who controls it. Scout out the flag.

If it's not already ours, capture it for the Horde - it will swing the battle in our favor. Investigate the scar and kill anyone you find in there!

passages.title: Claim the Battle Scar
passages.text:
Excellent! You're my kind of <class>, <name>.

With your help, we will throw these invaders back into the sea.

passages.title: Parts-is-Parts
passages.text:
I've always wanted to try making an abomination. It looks simple enough, but you know how it is when you learn things from a book. There's no substitute for doing!

First, I'm going to need parts. Lots of parts. And you're going to get them for me.

No need to be picky: human, orc... it doesn't matter. Parts is parts.

Just be sure the corpses you harvest come from the Battlescar, so I know they're fresh.

<Calder presses a rusted, gore-covered bonesaw into your hands and smiles disarmingly.>

passages.title: Parts-is-Parts
passages.text: Did you get my parts? Let me see them!

passages.title: Parts-is-Parts
passages.text:
<Calder peers into the sack of extremities and licks his lips with a dry, black tongue.>

Oh my. This is exciting.

 Aren't you excited, <name>?

passages.title: Hearts-is-Hearts
passages.text:
These parts - so lovely! Muscle and sinew and fingers and toes ... I am SO hungry right now.

But work must come first. Once I stitch this pile of parts together I'm going to need a heart strong enough to pump sludge through this rat's nest of veins. I would use my own heart, but it's a shriveled up husk resembling a turnip.

No, I need some real power. Get me a kodo heart from one of those giant landquaker bulls to the south of the Battlescar.

passages.title: Hearts-is-Hearts
passages.text: You've gotta have heart, <name>. All you really need is heart.

passages.title: Hearts-is-Hearts
passages.text:
<Calder grasps the gigantic heart in both hands, squeezing it and listening to the valves slurp and squish.>

<His pale mask of a face splits open into an enormous, childlike grin.>

It is so very important to love one's work, wouldn't you agree, <name>?

passages.title: Smarts-is-Smarts
passages.text:
My monstrosity is taking shape! All that's left is to stuff his skull with something useful.

I'm talking about brains, <name>. And here I'm going to be picky. The abomification process causes significant brain damage so it's best to start with someone smart.

One of the Alliance officers should do nicely. Seek out one of the Captains on the far side of the Battlescar and try not to damage the goods while you kill him.

passages.title: Smarts-is-Smarts
passages.text: Brraaaaaaiiinnnnss...

passages.title: Smarts-is-Smarts
passages.text:
<Calder holds the brains in an outstretched hand while withdrawing a gore-caked multi-tool from his belt.>

Wonderful work! Now the secret here is to leave the reptilian nervous systems intact while removing the higher cognitive functions. We can't have our new friend developing a conscience or remembering he's Alliance...

<Calder digs and snips at the brain, removing large chunks.>

And... we're finished! How lovely.

passages.title: Saving the Young
passages.text:
I actually have somethin' really important dat I could use help with, if ya be willin', mon.

Our hatchlins' are bein' stolen by someone on da next island. At first I thought dey were just runnin' away or that nature be claimin' dem, but we are missin' more than a dozen of da little guys now.

Please head to Zalazane's Fall to da northwest and point da little hatchlins back dis way. Poor tings.

passages.title: Saving the Young
passages.text: Poor little tings.

passages.title: Saving the Young
passages.text: Thank ya so much! They can be vicious when provoked, but most of da time dey don't know betta.

passages.title: Young and Vicious
passages.text:
Ya be a good one, <name>.

Moraya was askin' for new raptors ta train. We shouldn't keep her waitin' any longa! I have a few other recruits bringin' some over as well, but I have a special one dat I've been promisin' Moraya for a while.

Swiftclaw be one of our fastest and bravest young raptors yet, but he can be a bit unruly. I'll lend ya da lasso, I just need ya to catch him somewhere on da island here and steer him over to da pens on da main isle. I doubt he'll be makin' it easy on ya though.

passages.title: Young and Vicious
passages.text: Did ya come back wit one of the raptors I sent ya for?

passages.title: Young and Vicious
passages.text:
Swiftclaw! Kijara was tellin' me about him and he sounded like he'd be a handful. I don't mind da challenge - it's da spirited ones like dat that be makin' da bravest and truest companions when real times of need be comin'.

Tank ya, hon. Ya've been very helpful.

passages.title: The Crone of the Kraul
passages.text:
The five of us have communed with the spirits, and found the source of the Quilboar's aggression. Charlga Razorflank leads them from within Razorfen Kraul. She holds the promise of Agamaggan's resurrection over their heads, whipping the tribes into frenzy to raze and pillage the land for her.

Please, <class>, put a stop to this. Without Charlga, the quilboar may not be saved, but they may at least be less dangerous.

passages.title: Flightmare
passages.text:
The Alliance has hired in Wildhammer mercenaries to control the skies over the Battlescar. I believe these same gryphon-riders were the ones to firebomb Taurajo during the attack.

I want our skies scoured clean.

The wildhammer dwarves fly low enough for a sharp-eyed <class> to hook them. Take this. Target their gryphons and dismount the riders - once grounded, show them no mercy.

passages.title: Flightmare
passages.text: The Wildhammer are fierce fighters, in the air or on the ground. How goes the battle?

passages.title: Flightmare
passages.text:
<Tomusa snorts as he takes back his hook.>

Vengeance feels hollow. Still. I could not allow them to go unpunished.

passages.title: The Butcher of Taurajo
passages.text:
This operative had orders to secure the roadways between the Alliance command and Fort Triumph. General Hawthorne is on the move.

<Bloodhilt crumples the documents in his fist.>

It's HIM, <name>! Hawthorne - I spit the name - he is the one who ordered the assault on Taurajo! Now we know when and where to strike him down. Quickly, follow the road north of the Battlescar and meet up with my assassin Karthog. CRUSH Hawthorne and string his body up along the road!

passages.title: The Butcher of Taurajo
passages.text:
<Upon hearing the news, Bloodhilt snorts. His eyes gleam. He tips his head back and bellows a wet, cackling laugher that echoes between the blackened walls of Desolation hold and reverberates throughout the hills beyond.>

So it is done! The Butcher of Taurajo is felled at last. Cut down in the streets like a dog. Fitting.

You have done well, <name>. You've sowed fear into our enemies, and soon we will reap the harvest!

passages.title: Crushing the Crown
passages.text:
This ledger is full of locations, and I need you to investigate and take action, pal. This has gone on long enough.

Here's an entry I want you to check out: it's right outside Orgrimmar's gates, to the west! That can't be good. Get out there and rough 'em up.

Oh, and if you see something big and dangerous enough that it needs destroying, toss this bomb at it.

passages.title: Crushing the Crown
passages.text: Good job, kid. You deserve a little somethin'. And hey, come back tomorrow if you get the time; I might have a job for ya.

passages.title: The Arts of a Warrior
passages.text:
As ya get bettah' at fightin', you'll start to find new tings that ya nevah knew you could do.

Wanna see? Go, train up some, and learn someting new.

'Den come back and ya can show me.

passages.title: The Arts of a Warrior
passages.text: Good work, mon! Dis stuff come easy to ya.

passages.title: Proving Pit
passages.text:
Ya done quite well for ya'self, <class>. I'm sure I could teach ya a trick or two here and dere, but I not be wastin' ya time on tiki targets no longer.

l put one last trial before ya den, mon. Head over to da provin' pit in the middle of dis area and fight a real baddy - one dat wants ta kill ya back. Just let the jailor by the pit know when ya ready.

passages.title: Proving Pit
passages.text: All trolls gotta prove demselves before we let them move past da training grounds.

passages.title: Proving Pit
passages.text: Ya handle yerself quite well. Ya gonna be quite powerful some day.

passages.text:
This ledger is full of locations, and I need you to investigate and take action, pal. This has gone on long enough.

Here's an entry I want you to check out: it's just outside Ambermill in Silverpine Forest. That can't be good. Get out there and rough 'em up.

Oh, and if you see something big and dangerous enough that it needs destroying, toss this bomb at it.

passages.title: Crushing the Crown
passages.text: Good job, kid. You deserve a little somethin'. And hey, come back tomorrow if you get the time; I might have a job for ya.

passages.title: Take Back What's Ours
passages.text:
Ever since the Forsaken invaded Gilneas, we've tried to keep the location of the Scythe of Elune secret. We moved it at night to one of many safe locations. The Dark Rangers got close, but never found it... until now.

They were last spotted at the Woods' End Cabin, west of here. Blow this horn when you find them and Tobias and his trackers will engage the Dark Rangers.

Only then will it be safe for you to venture inside the cabin and take back the scythe. Hurry, <name>. It must not reach Sylvanas.

passages.title: Take Back What's Ours
passages.text: Do you have the scythe, <name>?

passages.title: Take Back What's Ours
passages.text: I knew we could count on you.  You've done well, <name>.

Oh, and if you see something big and dangerous enough that it needs destroying, toss this bomb at it.

passages.text: Good job, kid. You deserve a little somethin'. And hey, come back tomorrow if you get the time; I might have a job for ya.

Oh, and if you see something big and dangerous enough that it needs destroying, toss this bomb at it.

passages.text: Good job, kid. You deserve a little somethin'. And hey, come back tomorrow if you get the time; I might have a job for ya.

passages.title: Silithissues
passages.text:
The silithid! They're bugs, <name>. Or something like bugs. They're not natural... and we built a fortress on the equivalent of an anthill.

Take this burning pitch. It'll set the buggers on fire and plug up their burrows at the same time. Be careful when you pour this stuff on there - the silithid will come out in swarms!

Look for silithid mounds around the exterior of Desolation Hold. They look like heaps of sand. Kill anything that crawls out.

passages.title: Silithissues
passages.text:
The Alliance is nothing. Swarms of those critter-crawlys?

<Crawgol shudders.>

passages.title: Silithissues
passages.text:
You're covered in hot tar and bug juice! Don't worry, friend. It'll come off.

Someday.

passages.title: Something Stinks
passages.text:
Get a load of these guys, would ya? Steamwheedle's been handling the business of holidays for years, and all of a sudden, these guys bust into the market. They're not Steamwheedle; the cartel hired me to get to the bottom of this. Something stinks here and it ain't just perfume.

Take this device I brought and go analyze the perfume clouds around the guards. I want to know what they're putting in that stuff. Things ain't natural.

passages.title: Something Stinks
passages.text: You analyze that reek yet, kid?

passages.title: Something Stinks
passages.text:
Hey, thanks, kid. Give it over, let's take a look.

<He takes the device from you and fiddles with it.>

Oh, that ain't good.

passages.title: Pilfering Perfume
passages.text:
I knew they were up to no good! There's some sort of mind-affecting chemical in here, but I can't get a handle on it with such a small sample. I need the real stuff.

Don't just go over there and buy it! I don't want you giving these scumbags one copper. Nah, you gotta get it from the source, discreet-like.

I'll disguise you as a package runner. I saw a stockpile guarded by their goons outside the gates. Go run by, and DON'T stop, or they'll make you! They'll toss you a crate. Bring it back here.

passages.title: Pilfering Perfume
passages.text: Did they toss ya a crate to deliver?

passages.title: Pilfering Perfume
passages.text:
You got it, huh? Good job, kid. Top notch. Let's see what we got here.

<He cracks open the crate and rummages around inside.>

passages.title: A Friendly Chat...
passages.text:
<Marion listens with horror as you tell her why you're trying to track down Snivel.>

You mean, he might've used some kind of chemical on me? Ew! I can't believe I fell for that fraud!

If he's finished all of his errands, he's on his way down to the docks to catch a ship to the South Seas! Whatever you do, <name>, you can't let him get away with this.

Hurry down to Stormwind Harbor before you miss him!

passages.title: A Friendly Chat...
passages.text: Did you find the guy, or did he crawl under a rock?

passages.title: A Friendly Chat...
passages.text: You got his ledger? Really? That's great, <name>. There's probably loads of good information in here.

passages.title: Crushing the Crown
passages.text:
This ledger is full of locations, and I need you to investigate and take action, pal. This has gone on long enough.

Here's an entry I want you to check out: it's northeast of Westbrook Garrison right outside in Elwynn! That can't be good. Get out there and rough 'em up.

Oh, and if you see something big and dangerous enough that it needs destroying, toss this bomb at it.

passages.title: Crushing the Crown
passages.text: Good job, kid. You deserve a little somethin'. And hey, come back tomorrow if you get the time; I might have a job for ya.

passages.title: Firestone Point
passages.text:
I've been on top of this silithid situation for almost a month, which makes me the local expert. Just last week the Earthen Ring was visiting, and wanted me to write down everything I know.

<Crawgol hands you a tattered book.>

I'm not much of a writer. Or a reader, for that matter. But this book is probably the most definitive thing ever written about this foe.

Deliver it to Tauna Skychaser down in Firestone Point. It's south of here, just west of the main road.

passages.title: Firestone Point
passages.text: Ah, do you bring news from up north?

passages.title: Firestone Point
passages.text:
Is this from Crawgol? Wonderful! Despite all the turmoil in the world, we can't turn our back on the silithid threat. It is important to have people like Crawgol studying our enemy closely and learning its secrets for the fight ahead!

<Tauna opens the book and glances over the first page. Her face falls.>

Oh. Well. I suppose it's something, at least.

passages.title: Cluster Cluck
passages.text:
Ridiculous! The greatest goblin mind of all time reduced to food detail? I made the Micro Mechachicken just for this reason and they let it get away!

<Hobart turns a deeper shade of green as his blood pressure rises.>

Do I look like I should be rounding up escaped cluckers? No, my friend, not I! Bamm most definitely, though he's too lazy.

Your station in life has recently taken a turn for the worse. You do it!

Take these remote control fireworks and attach them to the cluckers.

passages.title: Cluster Cluck
passages.text: Not enough cluckers, <name>. We'll all starve.

passages.title: Cluster Cluck
passages.text:
Success! Was there ever any doubt?

Greely, fire up the poultryizer!

passages.title: Push Them Out
passages.text:
The people are free, but the town is still occupied by the Forsaken. They're cut off from their main force, so if we're to drive them out, now's our chance.

Their leader, Executor Cornell, is known for his unbound ruthlessness. Also among them is Valnov the Mad, a so-called scientist who carries out inhuman experiments on villagers too old to work the mines.

Take care of them all.

passages.title: Push Them Out
passages.text: You're back, <name>.

passages.title: Push Them Out
passages.text: We have the people of Emberstone on our side now thanks to you.

passages.title: Flank the Forsaken
passages.text:
I thank you, <name>. We can't rest on our laurels, however.

We found out about a mining town, currently under Forsaken occupation. We sent some of my men, along with Crowley's daughter to the nearby livery stables to begin operations there. Liam should be joining them shortly.

I'll stay here and organize the final push for Gilneas City. Speak to Lord Hewell to secure a horse to get you there.

passages.title: Flank the Forsaken
passages.text: I am glad to have you here, <name>.  We're surrounded by Forsaken on all sides and can use all the help we can get.

passages.title: Knee-Deep
passages.text:
It's time to pack it in, <name>. Most of our people have made it through -- it's your turn now.

Take this torch, you're going to need it. The tunnel is full of nasty, knee-biting critters of the worst kind. Use it to keep them at bay.

Speak to Krennan on the other side.

passages.title: Knee-Deep
passages.text: You're here, <name>.  Most everyone made it through, but now we're stuck here... surrounded by our own... dead!

passages.title: They Have Allies, But So Do We
passages.text:
The night elves made good on their promise. They've brought ships and are ready to offer us sanctuary in their lands.

Unfortunately, the Forsaken's allies have arrived as well.

The orcs are advancing upon us while the Horde gunship prevents the transport ships from taking our people to safety.

The druids are holding the enemy back, but won't last long. Fortunately, the elven ships were carrying siege weapons. Take one of the glaive throwers and meet the enemy head on.

passages.title: They Have Allies, But So Do We
passages.text: You're back!

passages.title: They Have Allies, But So Do We
passages.text: It's almost over, <name>.  Only one obstacle remains between us and survival.

passages.title: A Weezil in the Henhouse
passages.text:
<Gann grasps you with a blood-caked hand.>

My wounds are great but I will not rest until the dwarves of Bael Modan pay for their crimes. <Wheeze> We smuggled a man inside their fortress during our last raid. A goblin saboteur: Weezil Slipshadow. 

Create a disruption at the gates - kill who you can - then slip inside the fortress of Bael'dun to the south and find Weezil.

That stronghold <cough> can only be destroyed from within, and Weezil can't do it alone.

passages.title: A Weezil in the Henhouse
passages.text:
Quiet, you big plodding brute! Keep your voice down.

If they spot us talking, pretend I'm just ordinary cheese.

passages.title: A Weezil in the Henhouse
passages.text: You do good work, <class>. That riot you caused at the fortress entrance has these dwarves running around with their heads cut off.

passages.title: The Fledgling Colossus
passages.text:
If you're here to help, then maybe you can help us with a lurking threat.

To the south lies the Slithering Scar, a quivering silithid outpost in the middle of the jungle. You can't miss it.

One of my scouts reports that the silithid are harboring a young colossus in their large central underground chamber, and once it is fully grown, they plan to unleash it upon Un'Goro!

This must not be allowed to pass, <name>. Find the colossus and kill it.

passages.title: The Fledgling Colossus
passages.text: You've completed a remarkable task, <name>.  You are truly worthy of commendation.  Thank you, and congratulations!

passages.title: The Shaper's Terrace
passages.text:
<As you look into the orb in front of you, you hear a voice.>

The crystal pylons have been activated. A sufficient number of crystals have been gathered. The prerequisites have been met. We are prepared for teleport to The Shaper's Terrace.

Speak to me when you are ready, <race>. We will consult with The Watcher.

passages.title: The Shaper's Terrace
passages.text:
I have been watching you, <name>.  Your arrival was not unforeseen.

In fact, your arrival here has been predetermined for some time now.

passages.title: Ever Watching From Above
passages.text:
When my master Khaz'Goroth shaped the world you call Azeroth, he designed Un'Goro Crater to be an area for experimentation. You might call it the Titans' petri dish.

If you seek further knowledge about the methods in which we observe the world, pull the four levers behind me and complete my tests.

passages.title: Ever Watching From Above
passages.text: You have not yet completed my gauntlet, <name>.

passages.title: Ever Watching From Above
passages.text: You have proven to be both wise and agile, young <name>.  You have my blessing to take your newfound knowledge and spread it as you continue on your journey.

passages.title: How to Make Meat Fresh Again
passages.text:
I don't believe we've met... I'm Nolen Tacker, Marshal Expeditions' new chief of the guards. I'm also their chef. There's actually more overlap than you'd think.

I've got a fun little task for you. Have you seen the spike pits around the perimeter of the camp? See if you can convince some of the nearby dinosaurs to walk into them. If you throw this rotten meat at them when they're not looking, it'll either make them hungry or angry. Either way is fine, as long as they follow you into the pit!

passages.title: How to Make Meat Fresh Again
passages.text: Throw the meat, then let the dinosaurs chase you into the pit.  Easy as that!

passages.title: How to Make Meat Fresh Again
passages.text: Excellent work, <name>.  Now we're a bit safer from dinosaur attacks... plus I've got all this fresh meat to serve to my men.

passages.title: Town Dwellers Were Made to be Saved
passages.text:
I've a feeling that we may find more than dragons here in this crater. My paladin's instinct tells me that there are townsfolk nearby that require our aid. Those in distress cannot be ignored.

Let us sally forth, Squire <name>! The people of Un'Goro require our aid!

passages.title: Town Dwellers Were Made to be Saved
passages.text:
Our duty is fulfilled.  Even so, it troubles me that today's damsels were less than gracious... only the fair-haired one by the lake managed to show us any gratitude for our chivalry.  Perhaps tomorrow's damsels will have thankfulness to match their beauty.

Now we must ride.  More adventures await!

passages.title: The Ballad of Maximillian
passages.text:
The time we have waited for is upon us, Squire <name>. Un'Goro's brood mother will perish at my hands. The gravity of our task weighs heavily on me, but with the power of the Light behind us, we are guaranteed to succeed.

Are you ready to depart?

passages.title: The Ballad of Maximillian
passages.text:
The day is saved!  Huzzah!  Today we learned that while armor can be replaced, valor has no price.

Because of your key involvement in this task, I hereby graduate you from squire to fledgling knight.  No longer do the chains of servitude bind you to me; you are free to serve other masters.

Go with honor, young hero!  For chivalry, the Light, and the beauty of Doloria!

passages.title: A Tale of Two Shovels
passages.text:
Hey wait a minute, this bone has pickax marks on it. These aren't yours, are they? No, I recognize this mark... this must be that blasted dwarf! Gah!

Let me step back for a minute and explain. There's another archaeologist south of here named Durrin Direshovel. He practices a reckless, devil-may-care brand of archaeology that offends even me.

A priceless fossil, ruined by sloppy pick-work. This is the last straw, Durrin!

<name>, go put an end to Direshovel and his negligent excavation.

passages.title: A Tale of Two Shovels
passages.text: Is the deed done?  Did you manage to salvage his notes?

passages.title: A Tale of Two Shovels
passages.text:
I knew it!  Durrin HAS been digging around here.  And he's been excavating what could be the archaeological find of the century!  Now I just have to find out where he's stashing the bones...

Thanks <name>.  You've been a great help.

passages.title: Repairing A-Me 01
passages.text:
<Suddenly, the robotic gorilla's eyes light up, and it begins to speak.>

"...operational capacity... less than 5%... accidentally... punctured oil reservoir..."

"...use coconut milk... rock... save A-Me 01..."

<A-Me closes her eyes.>

passages.title: Repairing A-Me 01
passages.text: <A-Me 01 has gone into power save mode.>

passages.title: Repairing A-Me 01
passages.text: You pour the coconut milk into what appears to be A-Me 01's oil reservoir.  You hear the sound of gears whirring and actuators firing.

passages.title: The Apes of Un'Goro
passages.text:
There's plenty of money to be had here in Un'Goro, you just need to know where to look!

Apes may be common here in Un'Goro, but they're much rarer up north. In Everlook, a gorilla hide fetches ten times what you'll get for it down here!

I'm not going to send you all the way up to Winterspring - that'd be irresponsible - but I could use your help actually obtaining some hides.

You'll find gorillas at Fungal Rock, to the northeast, near a waterfall. Don't forget to check inside the cave!

passages.title: The Apes of Un'Goro
passages.text: I never know what style is in vogue, so I'll want a few different colors.  Try to get hides from each different type of gorilla there.

passages.title: The Apes of Un'Goro
passages.text: Wow, 2 of each color!  You're certainly an overachiever, <name>.  My companions and I could use a <race> like you around here.  Ever consider a career in profiteering?

passages.title: The Mighty U'cha
passages.text:
Looking around, you see bits of red fur laying around this part of the cave. It appears to match the consistency of gorilla fur.

Based on your conversations with Gremix, you know that he would almost certainly be interested in a red gorilla hide, if you were to obtain one.

passages.title: The Mighty U'cha
passages.text: Red fur?  What're you waiting for!  Go back and get that red gorilla!  I'll pay you double!

passages.title: The Mighty U'cha
passages.text:
Wow, look at this one!  Not just the color, but the size of it... you could cover a tauren with this.

Here you go, <name>.  You've earned this.  Stick around, I'm sure we can find something else for you to do.

passages.title: The Bait for Lar'korwi
passages.text:
This will be the most difficult part because there is some complexity to the plan. Continue following the river to the north, and look for a bend in the river. It was here I saw Lar'korwi last. You will know you are in the right area because of all the bones from massive creatures that once wandered nearby.

Take the meat you recovered and place it there. Then, rub this mixture I created on the meat.

If both lures mingled together do not bring Lar'korwi to you, then I know nothing else that will.

passages.title: The Bait for Lar'korwi
passages.text: Do not let fear overpower you, <name>. Fear is the great betrayer... you must remain strong!

passages.title: The Bait for Lar'korwi
passages.text:
The Earth Mother be praised! You've done it! Fair play to you, <name>. You have proven to be a great hunter in your own right. Your spirit is strong. Your bravery unmatched. And your strength has been fortified. I bow down to your skills.

Only the greatest of my ancestors could have accomplished something so incredible. Congratulations.

passages.title: A Little Help From My Friends
passages.text:
Ugh... It's so hot...

I was exploring this area, when all of a sudden, the heat just became unbearable. I must be suffering from heat exhaustion.

Please, help me get back to my friend Spraggle at Marshal's Stand. I think I'm well enough to follow you there.

I am feeling a little out of it, so you can slap me if I'm feeling woozy. If I do happen to faint again, just splash some water on me from Spraggle's canteen. That should work, I hope...

passages.title: A Little Help From My Friends
passages.text: I've been so worried about Ringo...

passages.title: A Little Help From My Friends
passages.text:
Ringo's not in the best shape, <name>, but I am glad to have him back in one piece!

Thank you for finding him.

passages.title: Shizzle's Flyer
passages.text:
I'm making a flying machine!

I got stranded here, and I'm absolutely horrible at finding my way around. I'd take a gryphon or wind rider back to Gadgetzan, but those beasts just scare me to death.

So, will you help me? All I have left to build is the wings, and I was thinking that the webby scales from the pterrordax in the Screaming Reaches to the west would be perfect. There's no way I'm going to go up against one of those, but you look pretty tough. Why don't you give it a try?

passages.title: Shizzle's Flyer
passages.text: Every great vehicle needs a name... I was thinking I'd call it... Pwned!

passages.title: Shizzle's Flyer
passages.text:
Yes, these scales are perfect. I should be able to get this flyer off the ground with these scales for sure!

Thanks!

passages.title: Expedition Salvation
passages.text:
I'm Williden Marshal, and I lead a non-aligned expedition troupe. Now that our camp is more centrally located, it will be much more convenient for us to do many things... such as retrieving some long-forgotten supplies.

We've left some old supplies at deserted base camps both northeast and southwest of here. You look like you're capable enough - can you help us by getting them back?

passages.title: Volcanic Activity
passages.text:
Welcome. I'm Williden Marshal, and my sister and I run this expedition of explorers and scientists. You have a moment?

I don't like the look of those elementals on that volcano, <class>. We have too much equipment, too many notes... one crazed elemental could streak its way through our camp and do terrible, terrible damage.

Show them that their new neighbors aren't to be trifled with. And bring back the ash that they leave behind... we might as well do a little science while we're at it.

passages.title: Volcanic Activity
passages.text: Do you think the volcano is active?  I wonder why it didn't explode when the cataclysm hit.

passages.title: Volcanic Activity
passages.text: I hope that did the trick.  I'll take the ash... this may come in handy sometime down the line.

passages.title: Finding the Source
passages.text:
I created a thermometer to take readings of the temperatures at the volcano, and I'd like to find the hottest lava flows. It gives the measurements in degrees Kraklenheit!

Here, take it, and take readings of the temperatures at the ridge whenever you see a hot spot!

Hot spots usually take the form of a glowing, rocky pillar jutting out of the ground. You'll find them around the base of Fire Plume Ridge... one trip around the perimeter will likely suffice.

passages.title: Finding the Source
passages.text: I'd go there myself, but... I'm a little scared of the fire elementals there!

passages.title: Finding the Source
passages.text: These results are astounding!  My boss will be pleased.  Thank you, kind <race>!

passages.title: Sabotage!
passages.text:
These dwarven artillery shells have a built-in airburst timer. This is easy! Just sabotage one of the artillery shells in the loading bay and then hoist it up into the magazine. Boom, baby. BOOM!

You'll find the shells in one of two loading bays behind the main garage on this level. It's right around the corner.

Once you've rigged the artillery shell... Run! Run like the wind, <name>! Then report to Gann back at camp. I'll be right behind you.

passages.title: Sabotage!
passages.text: <Gann only opens his eyes after you prod him. His breathing is little more than a series of shallow gasps.>

passages.title: Sabotage!
passages.text:
Bael'dun? Destroyed?

<Wincing in pain, Gann twists his head to peer behind him, where plumes of smoke darken the skyline.>

<name>, my friend. You have avenged Taurajo and avenged the Tauren people. The invaders will not soon recover from that blow. Thank you.

passages.title: The Lich King's Last Stand
passages.text:
Shadowmourne; a newly forged weapon already steeped in this world's history, reborn into an unrivaled destiny.

With this weapon you bear a solemn responsibility, and the time to carry out that charge is at hand.

Take this weapon of myth and legend and march on the enemy. Avenge the countless heroes lost in his merciless campaign. Bring rest to their tortured souls.

Steel yourself, <class>, and guide Shadowmourne to fulfill the purpose of its creation.

passages.title: The Lich King's Last Stand
passages.text:
So, at last it is done.

May the people of Azeroth remember our deeds here forevermore. May the sacrifices of so many burn in their hearts eternally. May they never fail to risk mortal peril in the face of great evil.

passages.title: Unholy Infusion
passages.text:
Before your weapon can reach its full potential it must be endowed with its signature powers. First among them is unholiness.

You must seek out and defeat the one called Professor Putricide, but his death is not your only goal. You must use his resources against him.

Find a way to absorb his mutated slime. Use the foul substance to infuse your weapon with the power of the unholy. Only when this has been done shall I reveal your next task.

passages.title: Unholy Infusion
passages.text: Is it done, <race>?

passages.title: Unholy Infusion
passages.text:
Well done, <class>.

The completion of our work draws near.

passages.title: The Arts of a Mage
passages.text:
As ya' develop ya' powah, ya' gonna start to tink of new spells, new ways to use ya' arcane talents. 

Go now, grow ya' skills, and 'den come back an' show me what 'cha figure out.

passages.title: The Arts of a Mage
passages.text: Good work, mon! Dis stuff come easy to ya.

passages.title: Proving Pit
passages.text:
Ya done quite well for ya'self, <class>. I'm sure I could teach ya a trick or two here and dere, but I not be wastin' ya time on tiki targets no longer.

l put one last trial before ya den, mon. Head over to da provin' pit in the middle of dis area and fight a real baddy - one dat wants ta kill ya back. Just let the jailor by the pit know when ya ready.

passages.title: Proving Pit
passages.text: All trolls gotta prove demselves before we let them move past da training grounds.

passages.title: Proving Pit
passages.text: Ya handle yerself quite well. Ya gonna be quite powerful some day.

passages.title: Blood Infusion
passages.text:
Your weapon is ready to be endowed with the power of blood.

You must face Queen Lana'thel in battle and subject yourself to her Blood Mirror. This will cause Shadow's Edge to drink the blood of the nearest living being. That being would be you, <race>.

Once the blade has been thus awakened, allow the Queen's Frenzied Bloodthirst to take hold of you, feed the blade thrice to sate it, and then give the queen an ignominious death.

May her screams pierce the ears of the Lich King as he awaits his fate.

passages.title: Blood Infusion
passages.text:
Well done, <class>.

Shadowmourne is nearly within reach.

passages.title: Frost Infusion
passages.text:
Shadow's Edge is prepared to receive its final infusion of power.

Sindragosa, the enemy's own mount, must fall. But before she is brought down, you must sustain four of her frozen breath attacks without tasting death.

Without his dragon, nothing shall stand between you and the Lich King.

passages.title: Frost Infusion
passages.text: The axe has drunk its fill, <race>, and the forge is nearly ready for the creation of Shadowmourne...

passages.title: The Arts of a Shaman
passages.text:
As ya grow in powah, you begin ta discovah the voices of da ancestahs speakin' to ya, teachin' you dere secrets.

Tha first of 'dese is to focus tha power of da elements into yer weapon. It allows ya to unleash a quick, vicious attack on your enemies. Dis should be easy enough for ya to make a lot of use of it.

Try it out. Let me know when ya tink you have it down.

passages.title: The Arts of a Shaman
passages.text: Good work, mon! Dis stuff come easy to ya.

passages.title: Proving Pit
passages.text:
Ya done quite well for ya'self, <class>. I'm sure I could teach ya a trick or two here and dere, but I not be wastin' ya time on tiki targets no longer.

l put one last trial before ya den, mon. Head over to da provin' pit in the middle of dis area and fight a real baddy - one dat wants ta kill ya back. Just let the jailor by the pit know when ya ready.

passages.title: Proving Pit
passages.text: All trolls gotta prove demselves before we let them move past da training grounds.

passages.title: Proving Pit
passages.text: Ya handle yerself quite well. Ya gonna be quite powerful some day.

passages.title: The Arts of a Druid
passages.text:
As ya grow in powah, ya ability to call on nature gets strongah, too. Ya wanna see?

Go get some experience and show me what ya' learn.

passages.title: The Arts of a Druid
passages.text: Good work, mon! Dis stuff come easy to ya.

passages.title: Proving Pit
passages.text:
Ya done quite well for ya'self, <class>. I'm sure I could teach ya a trick or two here and dere, but I not be wastin' ya time on tiki targets no longer.

l put one last trial before ya den, mon. Head over to da provin' pit in the middle of dis area and fight a real baddy - one dat wants ta kill ya back. Just let the jailor by the pit know when ya ready.

passages.title: Proving Pit
passages.text: All trolls gotta prove demselves before we let them move past da training grounds.

passages.title: Proving Pit
passages.text: Ya handle yerself quite well. Ya gonna be quite powerful some day.

passages.title: The Arts of a Rogue
passages.text:
As ya fight ya enemies, ya will learn new tricks you use ta be even bettah'. 

There's one ya should be learnin' soon to let ya see dere weaknesses and set up for devastating combo attacks. After ya've struck a few blows to weaken ya foe, finish dem off with a vicious evisceration attack.

When ya learn it, try it out. Let me know when ya tink you have it down.

passages.title: The Arts of a Rogue
passages.text: Good work, mon! Dis stuff come easy to ya.

passages.title: Proving Pit
passages.text:
Ya done quite well for ya'self, <class>. I'm sure I could teach ya a trick or two here and dere, but I not be wastin' ya time on tiki targets no longer.

l put one last trial before ya den, mon. Head over to da provin' pit in the middle of dis area and fight a real baddy - one dat wants ta kill ya back. Just let the jailor by the pit know when ya ready.

passages.title: Proving Pit
passages.text: All trolls gotta prove demselves before we let them move past da training grounds.

passages.title: Proving Pit
passages.text: Ya handle yerself quite well. Ya gonna be quite powerful some day.

passages.title: Proving Pit
passages.text:
Ya done quite well for ya'self, <class>. I'm sure I could teach ya a trick or two here and dere, but I not be wastin' ya time on tiki targets no longer.

l put one last trial before ya den, mon. Head over to da provin' pit in the middle of dis area and fight a real baddy - one dat wants ta kill ya back. Just let the jailor by the pit know when ya ready.

passages.title: Proving Pit
passages.text: Ya handle yerself quite well. Ya gonna be quite powerful some day.

passages.title: Learnin' tha Word
passages.text:
As ya get more skill out there in tha' world, you'll start to discovah' new powahs.

Why dontcha go out an' go get yaself stronger, and come back when ya learn sometin' new. You can show me what ya learn.

passages.title: Learnin' tha Word
passages.text: Good work, mon! Dis stuff come easy to ya.

passages.text: Ya handle yerself quite well. Ya gonna be quite powerful some day.

passages.title: A Victory For The Silver Covenant
passages.text:
In spite of Queen Lana'thel's boasting, you have restored Quel'Delar, <name>. Long have we dreamt of reclaiming Quel'Delar.

The Silver Covenant, and indeed all quel'dorei owe you a debt of gratitude.

As a <class>, the sword seems to know you lack the training to wield it and hasn't bonded to you. Where, then, will its next master come from? Perhaps the Argent Crusade can find one. Go north to the Argent Tournament Grounds and present the sword to Justicar Mariel Trueheart on behalf of the Silver Covenant.

passages.title: A Victory For The Silver Covenant
passages.text: Is it true that you have restored Quel'Delar?

passages.title: A Victory For The Silver Covenant
passages.text:
That a weapon of such power has been redeemed from the clutches of evil is a great omen in these times, <name>. With Quel'Delar and staunch Silver Covenant allies at our side, the Lich King will have good reason to fear.

The crusade maintains an arsenal of exceptional weapons for our strongest allies. Allow me to offer you your choice from among them in return for entrusting us with the care of Quel'Delar.

passages.title: A Victory For The Silver Covenant
passages.text:
In spite of Queen Lana'thel's boasting, you have restored Quel'Delar, <name>. Long have we dreamt of reclaiming Quel'Delar.

The Silver Covenant, and indeed all quel'dorei owe you a debt of gratitude.

Vereesa Windrunner, the leader of the Silver Covenant, asked to see you after you returned from the Sunwell. Take Quel'Delar with you and go to Dalaran's Violet Citadel where she waits, <name>.

passages.title: A Victory For The Silver Covenant
passages.text: Is it true that you have restored Quel'Delar?

passages.title: A Victory For The Silver Covenant
passages.text:
This is nothing short of an amazing accomplishment, <name>. The day that Thalorien and Anasterian fell, the same day that Quel'Delar was lost, was one of the darkest of my life. To see Quel'Delar restored... it is beyond words.

Without a doubt, you are meant to be the true bearer of the blade. Quel'Delar's magic is already adapting the blade to your skills and your strengths.

passages.title: A Victory For The Sunreavers
passages.text:
At last, Quel'Delar is restored for the glory of the Sunreavers and the sin'dorei!

All of Silvermoon will celebrate you as a hero, <name>.

As a <class>, the sword seems to know you lack the training to wield it and hasn't bonded to you. Where, then, will its next master come from? No worthy sin'dorei has come forward. Let us seek the Argent Crusade's counsel. Go north to the Argent Tournament Grounds and present the sword to Justicar Mariel Trueheart on behalf of the Sunreavers.

passages.title: A Victory For The Sunreavers
passages.text: Is it true that you have restored Quel'Delar?

passages.title: A Victory For The Sunreavers
passages.text:
That a weapon of such power has been redeemed from the clutches of evil is a great omen in these times, <name>. With Quel'Delar and staunch Sunreaver allies at our side, the Lich King will have good reason to fear.

The crusade maintains an arsenal of exceptional weapons for our strongest allies. Allow me to offer you your choice from among them in return for entrusting us with the care of Quel'Delar.

passages.title: A Victory For The Sunreavers
passages.text:
At last, Quel'Delar is restored for the glory of the Sunreavers!

All the Horde will celebrate you as a hero, <name>.

As a <class>, the sword seems to know you lack the training to wield it and hasn't bonded to you. Where, then, will its next master come from? I will not conceal my disappointment; I had hoped it would be a worthy sin'dorei. Let us seek the Argent Crusade's counsel. Go north to the Argent Tournament Grounds and present the sword to Justicar Mariel Trueheart on behalf of the Sunreavers.

passages.title: A Victory For The Sunreavers
passages.text: Is it true that you have restored Quel'Delar?

passages.title: A Victory For The Sunreavers
passages.text:
That a weapon of such power has been redeemed from the clutches of evil is a great omen in these times, <name>. With Quel'Delar and staunch Sunreaver allies at our side, the Lich King will have good reason to fear.

The crusade maintains an arsenal of exceptional weapons for our strongest allies. Allow me to offer you your choice from among them in return for entrusting us with the care of Quel'Delar.

passages.title: A Victory For The Sunreavers
passages.text:
At last, Quel'Delar is restored for the glory of the Sunreavers and the sin'dorei! All of Silvermoon will proclaim you a hero, as will all of the Horde.

Archmage Aethas Sunreaver, the leader of the Sunreavers, asked to see you after you returned from the Sunwell. Travel to the Violet Citadel in Dalaran as soon as you can, <name> and bring Quel'Delar with you. The archmage wishes to congratulate you personally!

passages.title: A Victory For The Sunreavers
passages.text: Is it true that you have restored Quel'Delar?

passages.title: A Victory For The Sunreavers
passages.text:
Quel'Delar rises again, as we sin'dorei have risen from the ashes of defeat and betrayal. The heart and the weapon of Thalorien Dawnseeker are both with you, <name>.

I see the blade has already started adapting itself to your strengths, <name>. Hold your head high and always keep Quel'Delar at your side.

passages.title: A Victory For The Sunreavers
passages.text:
At last, Quel'Delar is restored for the glory of the Sunreavers and the Horde! This is a blessing for our efforts against the Lich King.

Archmage Aethas Sunreaver, the leader of the Sunreavers, asked to see you after you returned from the Sunwell. Travel to the Violet Citadel in Dalaran as soon as you can, <name> and bring Quel'Delar with you. The archmage wishes to congratulate you personally!

passages.title: A Victory For The Sunreavers
passages.text: Is it true that you have restored Quel'Delar?

passages.title: A Victory For The Sunreavers
passages.text:
Quel'Delar rises again, as the sin'dorei have risen from the ashes of defeat and betrayal. Yet, somehow, the weapon of Thalorien Dawnseeker has chosen to serve an outsider.

Be at ease, <name>. I do not mean to diminish your accomplishment, for you have done what none of my brothers could, although I do not know why. You are clearly meant to be its bearer; the blade is already adapting itself to your abilities. Wield Quel'Delar proudly against our common foes.

passages.title: Wrath of the Lich King
passages.text:
It's hard to believe that there is much hope of defeating Arthas upon the steps of his own throne. And who will take up the crown of Lich King if it comes to that?

Many questions remain, but you need to find Sylvanas and escape the Lich King while there's still time.

passages.title: Wrath of the Lich King
passages.text:
Yet again, vengeance slips through my grasp. It's hard to believe how much stronger he's gotten.

It was foolish of you to come for me, but it's good to know that there are still some champions of the Horde that aren't useless cowards.

The information Uther gave us may well be key to finally killing Arthas, though it is becoming more and more clear that the Horde will not be able to accomplish this on their own.

Go, <class>. I expect your prowess may be needed again very soon.

passages.title: An Ancient Enemy
passages.text:
Da Sea Witch is here, on top of dis very isle. We've been waitin' a long time for dis chance at revenge and ya will be havin' da privilege of seein' it through.

Meet with Vol'jin, up da ramp to da northeast. Let him know when you are ready ta join da battle.

passages.title: An Ancient Enemy
passages.text: I did not think we'd be afforded da opportunity to fight her again. She was foolish to be returnin'.

passages.title: An Ancient Enemy
passages.text:
Tha power d'at burst forth when tha Sea Witch died was immense. I can use d'is power ta enact a vision of places far away.

Observe, youngblood. I want ya ta be here when I make contact wit' Thrall, perhaps it will be grantin' ya insight as well.

passages.title: A Goblin in Shark's Clothing
passages.text:
Combining the remains of the Mechachicken with these shark parts, we've assembled the greatest fighting submersible of all time: the Mechashark X-Steam!

Hobart and I want you to pilot it, <name>. Go west to the water and activate the Mechashark X-Steam Controller.

You must kill The Hammer if we're to have any hope of exploiting the natural resources of the Dire Strait to their fullest extent. It's for the good of the cartel!

passages.title: A Goblin in Shark's Clothing
passages.text: That monstrously humongous shark is not dead yet! Do I have to do everything myself?

passages.title: A Goblin in Shark's Clothing
passages.text: Excellent work, my boy! The Town-In-A-Box is saved and the Bilgewater Cartel will be profitable once again thanks to my overwhelmingly unbelievable intellect and tinkering know-how.

passages.title: Hot On The Trail
passages.text:
I'd better start from the beginning. It was love at first sight, <name>. There was just something about that goblin from the moment I set eyes on him.

After a wonderful week together, Snivel said he had come into a lot of money and that he was going to take me on a long vacation to the South Seas! Can you believe it?

Anyway, he told me to pack while he ran some errands to the bank, the auction house, and the barber shop, but he never came back! I'm beginning to think he's nothing but a big liar!

passages.title: Hot On The Trail
passages.text:
All he talked about was leaving town with all his money? Then he really has abandoned me, hasn't he?

Oh, <name>, I was such a fool to fall for him, but how could I help myself? He was so irresistible!

passages.title: Hot On The Trail
passages.text:
I'd better start from the beginning. It was love at first sight, <name>. There was just something about that goblin from the moment I set eyes on him.

After a wonderful week together, Snivel said he had come into a lot of money and that he was going to take me on a long vacation to the South Seas! Can you believe it?

Anyway, he told me to pack while he ran some errands to the bank, the auction house, and the barber shop, but he never came back! I'm beginning to think he's nothing but a big liar!

passages.title: Hot On The Trail
passages.text:
All he talked about was leaving town with all his money? Then he really has abandoned me, hasn't he?

I can't believe I fell for such a horrible goblin! But he was so irresistible when we first met.

passages.title: Finding Stormclaw
passages.text:
Zen'Aliri been studyin' the ways of the druid, <race>. Hopefully one day, Zen'Aliri join the Druids of the Talon, and soar over this crater as a storm crow.

But for now, my mentor says I stay here and wait. So Zen'Aliri waits.

I know another druid who might be able to use your help. His name is Garl Stormclaw, and he's somewhere to the east of here, studying reagents. Maybe you go talk to him?

passages.title: Finding Stormclaw
passages.text: Zen'Aliri was wise to send you here.  I've hit a dead end in my studies.

passages.title: Invasion Imminent!
passages.text:
Your work here is done for now, but there's no rest for the wicked, eh?

You remember Megs Dreadshredder, our old marketing rep? She's taken some others over the hills to the southeast, just past the Raptor Rise. If you follow the path east out of town and follow it south at the fork, you can't miss her.

Apparently there's some trouble or other brewing with the snake-men at the ruins on the shore. Go see if you can't sort it all out, would you?

passages.title: Invasion Imminent!
passages.text: Boss, we gotta problem.

passages.title: Bilgewater Cartel Represent
passages.text:
Looks like the naga down there in the ruins are preparing to invade our Town-In-A-Box. I have lots of dead scouts here as proof.

I don't know about you, but I'm not about to let them try. Let's get the jump on them!

Could you lay the foundation for our new coastal holdings by replacing their banners with our own? That's some prime real estate down there!

passages.title: Bilgewater Cartel Represent
passages.text: There are still some naga banners down there that need to be 'sploded and replaced!

passages.title: Bilgewater Cartel Represent
passages.text:
I wish I could have seen the looks on their scaly faces when you blew up their banners and replaced them with our own.

On second thought, I don't want to be close enough to see their snarls.

passages.title: Breaking the Siege
passages.text:
Horde scouts hiding in the ruins up ahead ambushed my supply train. Only two of my bodyguards made it out of there alive. And me? I used to have hair!

The supplies I was delivering are scattered through the ruins up ahead. Gather them up and take them to Janice Mattingly at Honor's Stand. If they can't make it to Stonetalon, at least we can keep them out of Horde hands...

passages.title: Breaking the Siege
passages.text: What's the story out there?

passages.title: Breaking the Siege
passages.text:
What ... our supplies? These were meant for Stonetalon.

No matter, at the rate we're going, we need them more here. Honor's Stand has been cut off from the coast, <name>. Commander Singleton is at his wit's end.

passages.title: Surrender or Else!
passages.text:
<name>, you and Ace need to march those naga hatchlings down there and use them as leverage to convince the leader of the naga to surrender to us.

Ace knows where to go on the south side of the ruins... just follow him.

passages.title: Surrender or Else!
passages.text: What's wrong?

passages.title: Surrender or Else!
passages.text:
A faceless of the deep? What's that? That does NOT sound like a naga!

Well, you killed it, whatever it was. It doesn't matter now. We have other fish to fry....

passages.title: Deprogramming
passages.text:
We had hoped to place a man on the inside of the Cult of the Damned, to give us an inside angle on the Lich King's machinations, but we... underestimated the persuasive powers of Arthas and his dark minister, Lady Deathwhisper.

Our man, Darnavan, is one of them now.

If you plan on fighting your way through the Oratory ahead, please keep your eyes peeled for Darnavan. If you can bring him back to us alive, we can attempt to reverse the Cult's brainwashing.

passages.title: Respite for a Tormented Soul
passages.text:
Take this Life Crystal, and have your companions take one as well. It contains potent energies from the verdant Dragonshrine in Dragonblight, and it was my own secret to resisting the dark magics of this place for so long.

When you face Sindragosa, battle her until she is weakened, and then have your companions use these Crystals to coax out the essence that is dormant within her. If you then defeat her, you should be able to recover it and return it to Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.

passages.title: Residue Rendezvous
passages.text:
Professor Putricide has been holed up in his foul laboratory, experimenting and refining increasingly lethal strains of blight to be used against us. If only we could obtain pure samples of the toxins, our researchers could concoct an antidote that would save countless lives.

But there's a catch -- a proper sample will need to mix two active strains within a living host. Should you have the... misfortune... of becoming such a host, please return here immediately so that we can harvest you for study.

passages.title: Deprogramming
passages.text:
We had hoped to place a man on the inside of the Cult of the Damned, to give us an inside angle on the Lich King's machinations, but we... underestimated the persuasive powers of Arthas and his dark minister, Lady Deathwhisper.

Our man, Darnavan, is one of them now.

If you plan on fighting your way through the Oratory ahead, please keep your eyes peeled for Darnavan. If you can bring him back to us alive, we can attempt to reverse the Cult's brainwashing.

passages.title: Residue Rendezvous
passages.text:
Professor Putricide has been holed up in his foul laboratory, experimenting and refining increasingly lethal strains of blight to be used against us. If only we could obtain pure samples of the toxins, our researchers could concoct an antidote that would save countless lives.

If you happen to come across live specimens, please return here immediately so that we can harvest them for study.

passages.title: Respite for a Tormented Soul
passages.text:
Take this Life Crystal, and have your companions take one as well. It contains potent energies from the verdant Dragonshrine in Dragonblight, and it was my own secret to resisting the dark magics of this place for so long.

When you face Sindragosa, battle her until she is weakened, and then have your companions use these Crystals to coax out the essence that is dormant within her. If you then defeat her, you should be able to recover it and return it to Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.

passages.title: Get Back to Town
passages.text:
We were wrong. It wasn't the naga that were preparing to attack... it was the nearby Oomlot tribe.

<name>, you need to get back to the Town-In-A-Box. The pygmies are already attacking!

Here, take this. We bought it off of a pygmy who said it used to belong to some great leader of theirs. Someone whose name translates as Dark Tan Helmet.

It should fool them so that they don't attack you.

passages.title: Get Back to Town
passages.text:
<name>? We're saved!

Who am I kidding? We're all going to die!!!

passages.title: Going, Going, Guano!
passages.text:
As you can see, <name>, we're up to some very.... interesting experiments at the Royal Apothecary Society.

As the Master here, it is my job to oversee the most ambitious of our alchemical attempts. So much work and so little time!

You look well traveled for a <class>. Perhaps you can aid me.

I'm in need of a rare substance. It's foul material; it comes from a rare species of bats only found in the muck-hole known as Razorfen Kraul. Bring to me the guano from the Kraul Bats so we can begin our work...

passages.title: Blueleaf Tubers
passages.text:
Blueleaf tubers are a delicacy around the world! But they're rare, very rare. The only place to find them is here in the Barrens, deep in the earth, in Razorfen Kraul.

And even then, they're impossible to find unless you know just where to look! That's why I've trained these snufflenose gophers to find them for me. They have great noses and can smell a tuber from fifty paces away.

It won't be easy, but if you get me some tubers I'll pay you handsomely.

passages.title: The Hunt For Sylvanas
passages.text:
It's true then? Gilneas has lost her favorite son.

We will mourn when this is all over but not a day sooner.

We will not allow ourselves the luxury of grief while the enemy still breathes Gilnean air.

My father's men are ready to strike while we still have the Banshee Queen's trail. Just say the word if you're ready. Liam deserves swift vengeance.

passages.title: The Hunt For Sylvanas
passages.text: Did you find her, <name>?

passages.title: The Hunt For Sylvanas
passages.text: The Plague?  Something so heinous that not even the orcs condone its use?  I'd say this warrants notifying King Greymane.

passages.title: Rocket Rescue
passages.text:
Alright, <name>. We've done enough small jobs around here; it's time to seal the deal.

The ruins of Steamwheedle Port are still full of hapless Steamwheedle goblins, waiting to be rescued. Every single one of them is a potential future customer. They're firing on every boat that leaves port...so I say we take to the skies!

There's a hot air balloon just outside of town near the docks, we can use that. Go ahead and hop in, I'll catch up with you.

passages.title: Rocket Rescue
passages.text: What's with the premature bail-out? We gotta get back out there.

passages.title: Rocket Rescue
passages.text:
Isn't it nice when you can do a good deed, and see enormous future financial gains from it? It warms my little goblin heart. And my big goblin wallet.

You did great, kid. Gadgetzan's gonna be ours soon. Here's a little token of my appreciation.

passages.title: Empowerment
passages.text: Stand Clear, <class>, and steady yourself.

passages.title: Personal Property
passages.text:
You can detect no hinges or openings on this box. Were it not for the shifting of items inside, it could easily be mistaken for solid metal.

If anyone could know the method of its opening, it would be Highlord Mograine.

passages.title: Personal Property
passages.text:
<After tracing a complex pattern of runes on each of the box's surfaces, the outline of a lid appears and a click echoes through the chamber.>

Here you are, <race>.

passages.title: Mograine's Reunion
passages.text:
Impossible...

Father, is it you?!

You have done me a great service, hero. I offer you the reins of my faithful steed. Do with it as you please, but do not forget those that assisted you in this monumental feat.

passages.title: Slowing the Inevitable
passages.text:
As much as I want to exact swift and brutal revenge... I must honor my son's memory first. He cared for his people first and foremost.

The Undertaker's Pass goes underground below Northgate River. You must prevent the plague from being deployed while we evacuate our men, women and children to Aderic's Repose.

We captured one of the Forsaken's dreaded bombing bats. I want you to fly the infernal beast as best you can and unleash hell upon those who seek to bring the Plague to our people. Hurry!

passages.title: Slowing the Inevitable
passages.text: Is it done, <name>?

passages.title: Slowing the Inevitable
passages.text: You've done well, <name>.  Almost everybody managed to make it through.

passages.title: Serving A-Me 01
passages.text:
Greetings. I unit A-Me 01. You... <race>?

A-Me's mission to study the local gorillas was success. A-Me has gathered data that Karna needs.

A-Me 01 not returning, though. A-Me has new family now. Here, with the gorillas, A-Me stay.

<A-Me 01 detaches a small device from her hand and gives it to you.>

You bring data back to Karna. You tell her what happen.

passages.title: Serving A-Me 01
passages.text: Wh... what's this?

passages.title: Serving A-Me 01
passages.text:
She decided to stay?  Fascinating... I'll have to look over this data and find out why.

Thank you again, <name>. I really appreciate it.

passages.title: Dead Man's Chest
passages.text:
Look, babe, you should be able to see what's happening here pretty easily. There's pirates, there's goblins, the goblins are fighting the pirates. There's some sad little gnomes trying to fight the pirates too.

I'll make it nice and simple for you: we need to kill a lot of pirates. Go do that, 'kay? We don't want the gnomes killing more than us, after all.

passages.title: Dead Man's Chest
passages.text: I'm pleased to report that our brand recognition in this area has skyrocketed now that you've killed most of the people who didn't want us here.

passages.title: To The Ground!
passages.text:
I've conducted a thorough appraisal of the real estate here and, unfortunately, its market value is just far too low to be of any use. We're going to have to renovate.

Luckily for you, I've learned a few things about arson. Hopefully you have too! You're going to be throwing these perfectly safe bottles of flaming rum at those filthy ramshackle huts over there.

Try not to stand downwind.

passages.title: To The Ground!
passages.text:
Wonderful job. Have you ever thought about becoming a full-time arsonist? I know a few people, it's a nice gig.

Well, we'll chit-chat about that one later. More to do here!

passages.title: Repel Boarders!
passages.text:
<name>, the sea is our only lifeline, and right now most of my fleet is either steaming back to Theramore for repairs or rusting at the bottom of this bay. Only the Blackpool remains afloat to defend our harbor.

But she's just signaled that she's being boarded!

Speak to me when you're ready, I'll have one of our naval gryphons deposit you right on the deck. Slaughter the rageroar sea dogs who dare assault my precious ship and report to Captain Fisher for further orders.

passages.title: Repel Boarders!
passages.text: Blood! All over my freshly polished brass.

passages.title: Repel Boarders!
passages.text:
You make a hell of a marine, <name>.

We'll mop up the others. But it looks like the Horde fleet is disengaging - maybe to land more troops ashore?

Admiral Aubrey will know what to do. Talk to me when you're ready to fly back!

passages.title: Body And Soul
passages.text:
There are powerful and evil magics at work in this village. Yngwie, was tough. In fact, he was probably too tough.

If you were to drag his body down to the big blue bonfire and toss it in, you'd release his soul. Destroying it would deal with the Oomlot chieftain for good, and ensure that the attacks upon the Town-In-A-Box come to an end.

passages.title: Body And Soul
passages.text:
There are powerful and evil magics at work in this village, <name>. Yngwie, was tough. In fact, he was probably too tough.

If you were to drag his body over to the big blue bonfire and toss it in, you'd release his soul. Destroying it would deal with the Oomlot chieftain for good, and ensure that the attacks upon the Town-In-A-Box come to an end.

passages.title: Oomlot Dealt With
passages.text: <name>, you have to get back to the Town-In-A-Box and warn them about the goblin zombies up in the volcano's caldera!

passages.title: Oomlot Dealt With
passages.text: They turned some of our people into zombies? Tell me something I don't know....

passages.title: Up the Volcano
passages.text:
A whole bunch of our people headed up to the top of the volcano to mount a counter-offensive. There's something horrible brewing up there on the Lost Peak.

They're waiting for you before they make any moves against the pygmies. Those evil little things turned a lot of us into zombies!

<name>, save us!

passages.title: Up the Volcano
passages.text: My star player has arrived!

passages.title: Zombies vs. Super Booster Rocket Boots
passages.text:
Those zombies that got past us are nothing compared to the numbers waiting just through the pass. If we don't deal with them soon, the pygmy witch doctors are going to send all of them against the town, and even the cannons down there won't be able to handle that many!

I brought a couple of shredder boots along. Greely modded them and now they're Super Booster Rocket Boots!

Use the boots to incinerate the zombies in the Oostan villages to the east.

passages.title: Zombies vs. Super Booster Rocket Boots
passages.text: You still have a few <race> zombies to deal with, <name>. Look sharp, superstar!

passages.title: Zombies vs. Super Booster Rocket Boots
passages.text:
You did it! No more zombies to worry about. Let's pause a moment in silence for the stinky departed.

Okay, done.

passages.title: Lifting the Siege
passages.text:
We'll never be able to re-secure the fortress walls so long as Rageroar and his goons have access to artillery. I need you to fight your way across that chasm and take out his big guns.

Orcs season their heavy machinery with coal tar, which makes them flammable. Take my torch and burn any catapults you see north of Northwatch.

Then, torch those big blade-throwers in Rageroar's base camp! Those things have killed enough of our men.

passages.title: Lifting the Siege
passages.text: Burn it all, <class>. Burn it to cinders!

passages.title: Lifting the Siege
passages.text: Good! Without heavy equipment, the Horde will have to pull back to regroup. We've bought ourselves some time to re-secure the fortress. Well done!

passages.title: Captain Dreadbeard
passages.text:
Alright, babe, I've got something bigger for you to take on here.

We spotted the captain of the Southsea over on one of his boats to the south; that's to the south, and NOT the one we've been suicidally bum-rushing for the better part of several hours. He's sitting up there, smug and stoic, watching us war down here.

I'll spare you the "hostile takeover" jokes. Get on his ship and beat the tar out of him, and we're done here!

passages.title: Captain Dreadbeard
passages.text: I'm flattered that you'd rather stay here and flirt with me than go kill that pirate captain. So flattered that I might not fire you if you get going right now and do it already.

passages.title: Captain Dreadbeard
passages.text:
Sea giants? You think he was training them towards Gadgetzan on purpose?

Whatever, he's splitsville now. And Gadgetzan owes us big time! I can't wait to see the look on Marin's face.

Here's your cut, babe. You're moving up in the world.

passages.title: Rocket Boot Boost
passages.text:
You need to get those boots down into the caldera to Hobart Grapplehammer.

Now that they're infused with the leftover rockin' powder, they should have enough thrust to get you all the way there on one shot.

When you're ready, activate the boots. Don't worry, they're automatically set to land you safely.

I think.

passages.title: Rocket Boot Boost
passages.text: Well there you are!

passages.title: Rocket Boot Boost
passages.text:
There's no time to waste, boy!

What's wrong with the actuator on the left boot?!

passages.title: Just Trying to Kill Some Bugs
passages.text:
Now it's time for my plan to go into full effect. We've got the captured bug strapped up with as many explosives as it can carry, and with Soothfancy's mostly amazing mental powers, we're gonna drive that sucker straight down into the center of the underground hive.

And then...BOOM! No more bugs!

You get the personal honor of directin' the ugly thing. Go talk to Narain and get set up with your bug-pal.

passages.title: Just Trying to Kill Some Bugs
passages.text: I didn't hear no cave-ins, pal! Try again!

passages.title: Just Trying to Kill Some Bugs
passages.text:
Oh man, that was awesome! You should've seen the flames coming out of the hive!

Here's your reward, for entertaining me as much as for clearing the hive!

passages.title: Silencing Rageroar
passages.text:
I have encountered the Rageroar clan before, <name>. They are led not by an orc, but by a monster - a war-gorged fiend without a shred of decency or compassion. He and his lieutenants must be killed, not just to save Northwatch, but for the good of all of Azeroth.
