The men on those ships are all dressed in the garb we need.

passages.title: The Great Escape
passages.text: Were you able to find us some uniforms, <race>?

passages.title: The Great Escape
passages.text:
These are perfect, <class>.

Wish us luck!

passages.title: The Battle for Hillsbrad
passages.text:
The journal documents the last 62 days of Clerk Horrace Whitesteed's life. In it is written damning allegations against Warden Stillwater and his activities at the Sludge Fields.

You should show this to the warden. He will undoubtedly have an explanation for what is written in this journal.

passages.title: The Battle for Hillsbrad
passages.text: What's this?

passages.title: The Battle for Hillsbrad
passages.text:
<Warden Stillwater flips through the journal, reading under his breath.>

Ramblings of a mad man! Clearly he had been ingesting the mushrooms. It is good that you brought this to me, <name>. I will burn it myself!

passages.title: A Perfect Costume
passages.text:
Judging by your weight, build, and size, we're going to dress you as an orc. Their army is made mostly of orcs, so you'll fit right in.

Do you know much about tailoring? If not, then consider this your first lesson. My crafting table over there has all the necessary supplies on it.

Go ahead and grab whatever you think is necessary, then bring it here. Thelaron will fix you right up.

passages.title: A Perfect Costume
passages.text:
That's it?  That's your disguise?

I'm feeling less confident about our chances.  It was nice knowing you, kid.

passages.title: A Perfect Costume
passages.text:
Judging by your weight, build, and size, we're going to dress you as an ogre. The firegut ogres have always worked for the Blackrocks, so you'll fit right in.

Do you know much about tailoring? If not, then consider this your first lesson. My crafting table over there has all the necessary supplies on it.

Go ahead and grab whatever you think is necessary, then bring it here. Thelaron will fix you right up.

passages.title: A Perfect Costume
passages.text:
That's it?  That's your disguise?

I'm feeling less confident about our chances.  It was nice knowing you, kid.

passages.title: A Perfect Costume
passages.text:
Judging by your weight, build, and size, we're going to dress you as a goblin. The Blackrocks have been known to hire goblin mercenaries to fill their ranks, so you'll fit right in.

Do you know much about tailoring? If not, then consider this your first lesson. My crafting table over there has all the necessary supplies on it.

Go ahead and grab whatever you think is necessary, then bring it here. Thelaron will fix you right up.

passages.title: A Perfect Costume
passages.text:
That's it?  That's your disguise?

I'm feeling less confident about our chances.  It was nice knowing you, kid.

passages.title: A Perfect Costume
passages.text:
Judging by your weight, build, and size, we're going to dress you as a troll. The Smolderthorn trolls have always worked with the Blackrock orcs, so you'll fit right in.

Do you know much about tailoring? If not, then consider this your first lesson. My crafting table over there has all the necessary supplies on it.

Go ahead and grab whatever you think is necessary, then bring it here. Thelaron will fix you right up.

passages.title: A Perfect Costume
passages.text:
That's it?  That's your disguise?

I'm feeling less confident about our chances.  It was nice knowing you, kid.

passages.title: A Lost Lad
passages.text:
It was only yesterday that I sent him out to investigate the farm directly east of here, but it feels like an eternity has passed!

True perfection. The way his blond locks framed his perfect blood elf face... Such strength. I didn't want to send him away, but he insisted! How could I refuse him?

Alas, poor Johnny Awesome has not returned! I fear the worst, <name>. Find him!

passages.title: A Lost Lad
passages.text:
<Johnny is sobbing loudly.>

Tw... Twinkles!!!! Th... It killed her!

<Johnny continues to cry. Little snot bubbles form in his nostrils.>

passages.title: Hazzard Disposal
passages.text:
Winna's hooked tight into the source of the slime itself, at the very back of Bloodvenom Post to the west. She makes sure it keeps flowing, and it keeps her safe! But if you can get her attention...

Take the eartag and show it to Winna. If there's even a little, tiny bit of her left, maybe it'll get through. Maybe her regret for her poor lost kitty will come to the surface and she'll feel sorry just one more time, and come out of the slime!

And then maybe you can kill her and stop the slime. Yay!

passages.title: Hazzard Disposal
passages.text:
Hooray! The forest will be safer now!

You're such a hero, <name>! With everything you've done for me and Mr. Tauren and the trees and animals and flowers, you deserve a reward!

Yay!

passages.title: The Warden
passages.text:
We have almost finished clearing out the revolting prisoners in The Hole, but one last problem remains. The warden.

Warden Silva is their master and they will do anything for him. If we take him out, we take them all out. Finish him off and bring me back his keys. We can use those keys to explore deeper into the cellblock and possibly gain access to the water supply here on the island.

passages.title: The Warden
passages.text: Is the warden dead yet?

passages.title: The Warden
passages.text: Ahh, the wardens key's.  Another job well done, <name>.  These will come in very handy.

passages.title: Scrapped Golems
passages.text:
We keep golems here, as guards. The dwarves to our north also keep golems, but I'm not sure why.

Mainly just for killin', I suppose.

We could use some spare parts for our own golems, so here's what yer gonna do: kill theirs, then look for any parts that might've fallen on the ground. Salvage what ye can. Ye probably won't be able to salvage everything, so choose carefully.

passages.title: Scrapped Golems
passages.text: We build these golems ourselves, ye know.  A little mechanical work, a little elemental work... the results aren't half bad, if ye ask me.

passages.title: Scrapped Golems
passages.text: This is exactly what we needed.  I'll get the boys workin' on the next batch of golems right away.

passages.title: Rejoining the Forest
passages.text:
It is time to say goodbye now. You have raised me from a seedling, brief though it was, but now I must rejoin the forest.

Take me back to the hill you found me on. There I will set my roots, and grow in the shadow of the ancients that came before me.

passages.title: Nature and Nurture
passages.text:
The ancient protectors of Irontree Woods to the north have been dead for years, their bodies a grim symbol of the damage to these lands.

Every season, we take the water from this moonwell, and pour it on the ground before them, hoping it will nurture new life. If you'd like, you can deliver the water yourself.

It is an excellent opportunity for reflection. Take this vial and fill it at the moonwell, and pour it on the very top of the small hill between the three ancients.

passages.title: Do it for Twinkles
passages.text:
Warden Stillwater sent me out into the field to investigate the outbreak. When I arrived, Twinkles and I were charged by the lumbering monstrosity known as Verringtan. I was knocked off of Twinkles and immediately ran for my life. Twinkles, though, stayed behind and fought the beast off. Alas, she was defeated and then summarily planted in the soil as if she were some type of glorious star pony seedling.

She gave her life to defend me. Vengeance must be mine! If for nothing else, do it for Twinkles!

passages.title: Do it for Twinkles
passages.text: For Twinkles!

passages.title: Do it for Twinkles
passages.text: She may now ascend to the great horsey heaven in the stars. We will never forget you, Twinkles. NEVER!

passages.title: Food From Below
passages.text:
Supplies are running low here in camp, <name>. We have recently learned that the cellblock just southwest of here has a number of rations remaining from years of use. We need you to gather as many of those as you can and bring them back to camp.

One more thing, the entire cellblock is overrun with prisoners so be careful.

passages.title: Food From Below
passages.text: Were you able to recover the rations?  Reports mentioned that they could be found all over the place down there.

passages.title: Food From Below
passages.text: These rations will really help the troops out <name>.  Thank you for your help.

passages.title: Strategic Cuts
passages.text:
<Static> <name>... <name>, can you hear me? It's Troteman.

Listen, we've just received the final bit of intel for your next mission. There are three marks that we'd like you to take down. The first is Voodooist Timan, whom you'll find atop the Pillar of Ash. Worgmistress Othana is in the central worg pens. Finally, Gorlop is near the lava pools to the south.

You will find the scorpid barbs you harvested packed along with your belongings. Use the barbs on the marks when the time is right.

passages.title: Strategic Cuts
passages.text:
Not only did you pull off the executions, you made them all look like accidents!

You were the right <race> for this undercover work.  Good job, soldier.

passages.title: Last of Her Kind
passages.text:
Obsidia is one of the last mature dragons that can continue the black dragonflight bloodline. She must be killed.

If you succeed in killing her, you should inform Lirastrasza immediately of your victory. She's been fighting a long time to see this done.

Thank you for being our fang in these battles. You've proven a powerful ally.

passages.title: Last of Her Kind
passages.text:
You killed Obsidia within her own lair? Impressive, <race>. I'm sorry that I could not be there.

You're true to your word, and you most certainly have the bite to back your bellow. Thank you.

passages.title: Trouble at Southshore
passages.text:
Before my capture and imprisonment, I was stationed at Southshore. My primary job at the ruins was to take slime samples and make sure that the blight that we released was safely dissipating. Simple and easy if not for the worgen that would continuously harass us.

I need you to head to Southshore and find my apprentice, Serge Hinott. Make sure that he's ok and inform him that I will return once my work here has concluded.

You'll find the Ruins of Southshore to the southeast, near the coast.

passages.title: Trouble at Southshore
passages.text: The worgen situation hasn't gotten any better and Helcular is really creeping me out.

passages.title: The Kodocaller's Horn
passages.text:
Alright, I've got some actual, legitimate, important work for you. We've got to call the kodos in from the grazing lands to the south. General Thorg'izog says we'll be moving out into Redridge soon, and I won't be caught with my kodos down.

Use this horn near a kodo. It will return to the camp when it hears the call.

You'll want to watch out. Sometimes the kodos get a little feisty, so you need to knock them around a bit before they listen to you.

passages.title: Taking the Horn For Ourselves
passages.text:
<name>, it's Troteman. I want you to hold onto that horn. I'm sure we can improvise and find a way to work it into the plan.

I'm more than a little concerned about what Kaoshin said about attacking Redridge. We knew another attack was imminent, but our timetables were off by several days.

Return to me, with the horn. We will talk again here, in Chiselgrip. And try not to ruin that disguise. You're not done with your undercover work yet.

passages.title: Taking the Horn For Ourselves
passages.text: Welcome back, soldier.

passages.title: Taking the Horn For Ourselves
passages.text: I didn't count on obtaining an item like this.  I will change our plans accordingly.

passages.title: A Needle in a Hellhole
passages.text:
You and I can't take on an army, <name>. They'll overwhelm us. That's why we've got to stick to Troteman's plan.

The next part of the plan is going to require a bit of subtlety... something that I'm not terribly good at. That's where you come in.

Speak with Thelaron Direneedle, the tailor here in town. I've already given him the hides and mud that we've collected. He's going to need to size you.

That's right, <name>: you're going undercover.

passages.title: A Needle in a Hellhole
passages.text:
You need a disguise?  Well, you came to the right place, honey.

Let me take a look... mm-hmm.  I know exactly what we'll do.

passages.title: The Fall of Tichondrius
passages.text:
Yes, Illidan took the power of the Skull of Gul'dan for himself.

But did he flee with it into the night? Did he use it for his own glory? No... his very first action was to use his new power to assault the dreadlord Tichondrius!

Witness his triumph, <class>. Witness how Illidan reclaimed Felwood from the demons... and the thanks he was given.

passages.title: The Fall of Tichondrius
passages.text:
Do you see now? For doing what was needed to drive the demons from these lands, my master was banished.

Now these druids pick up the pieces, patting themselves on the back for scrubbing the remaining vestiges of the legion's forces.

But that is not why I killed them.

passages.title: Meet with Signilda Hardforge
passages.text: Signilda Hardforge sent a message for you. She wants you to join her at her at the Training Hall in Stormwind's Old Town as quickly as you can. It sounded important, <name>.

passages.title: Meet with Signilda Hardforge
passages.text: It's good to see you again, <name>. I wish I could say that I had happy news.

passages.title: Meet with Dalgrun Steelpine
passages.text: Dalgrun Steelpine sends word from Stormwind -- he wants to meet with you right away. He'll be waiting for you in the Training Hall in Stormwind's Old Town district.

passages.title: Meet with Dalgrun Steelpine
passages.text: I'll be brief, <name>. Our enemies are gathering and Stormwind needs our help.

passages.title: Meet with Veruca Darkstream
passages.text: Veruca Darkstream, one of the senior rogue trainers in Stormwind's SI:7, has sent word that he wants to speak with you. Head to Stormwind as soon as you can and look for her in the Training Hall south of Old Town.

passages.title: Meet with Veruca Darkstream
passages.text: Welcome, <name>. We have much to discuss.

passages.title: Meet with Frazzle Frostfingers
passages.text: I just received a message from Frazzle Frostfingers, the senior mage trainer in Stormwind. He's asking you to join him at the Training Hall in Stormwind as soon as you can travel there.

passages.title: Meet with Frazzle Frostfingers
passages.text: It's good to see you again, <name>. Stormwind has need of your skills.

passages.title: Navarax's Gambit
passages.text:
I have been preying on these demonic impostors for some time now, and I have finally gleaned the location of their leader. It is none other than Arch Druid Navarax, the leader of the Emerald Circle.

The demon shields himself with innocents. If I entered Whisperwind Grove to hunt him, I would be set upon by ignorant protectors... but you! You can catch him unaware.

Return to Whisperwind Grove. Climb the druid tower and you'll find Navarax at the top, in his room amidst the boughs.

passages.title: Navarax's Gambit
passages.text:
I find it hard to believe everything you say, but the body of that demon is grim proof.

I will order an investigation into the druids at Jadefire Run right away, and make sure my higher-ups know the demon hunter may be content to remain in exile.

passages.title: Trial by Magma
passages.text:
I suppose I'll make the most of this situation. These goblin mercenaries brought this enormous fire elemental to my stronghold as a "thank you" for hiring them. What am I going to do with an elemental here in the steppes? That's like bringing sand to the beach.

If you're looking for work, then prove yourself. Talk to this goblin here, and challenge his elemental to a fight. The victor earns my respect, and my time.

passages.title: Trial by Magma
passages.text: What's the matter, are you scared?

passages.title: Trial by Magma
passages.text: I had a feeling you'd be the one returning to me.  I like your style, soldier.

passages.title: Firing Squad
passages.text:
Come out back vizh me, <race>.

Zhere is somezhink I vould like you to see.

passages.title: Firing Squad
passages.text:
So, this Schnottz character is working with Deathwing!?

This is even more distressing than you think...

passages.title: Riding Shotgun!
passages.text:
Alright, <name>, I'm very close to learning how to activate the final obelisk.

Only a few pieces of information are missing and with any luck, we should be able to find them at the site.

The supplies are all packed up. Let me know when you're ready to go.

passages.title: I Am the Law and I Am the Lash
passages.text:
I've been looking for a good, strong soldier like you. I need someone to keep my troops in line.

Outside the stronghold, you will find orcs, ogres, and trolls preparing for the assault on Redridge. My sergeants keep them in line, but I'd like you to assist them.

Take this cudgel and discipline a few of my soldiers. I don't care if they're misbehaving or standing perfectly in line, I want them beaten. I want them focused, battle-hardened, and obedient.

Now go.

passages.title: I Am the Law and I Am the Lash
passages.text:
I have a feeling we'll be hearing about you and your exploits for a long time, soldier.  I look forward to fighting by your side in Redridge.

You are dismissed.

passages.title: Abuse of Power
passages.text:
<name>? Troteman here.

It sounds like you have earned Thorg'izog's trust, and he's assigned you to discipline duty. This is fortunate.

We need you to take out his sergeants. You'll find them on wolfback, outside of the Blackrock Stronghold in the Fields of Honor. Use that cudgel on them, several times, until they die. You'll have to act fast, because if they realize you're not one of them, they can unmask you. Strike quickly and ferociously, <name>.

Troteman out.

passages.title: Abuse of Power
passages.text:
Without those sergeants, Thorg'izog will be hard-pressed getting his troops ready for battle.

Already the dominoes are beginning to fall, <name>.

passages.title: Tear Them From the Sky!
passages.text:
Egah! They're here, <name>. They're here!

I had hoped to equip a whole army with my shoulder-mounted drake-droppers, but all I have is a single, extremely expensive and wholly untested prototype. Here, take it!

Shoot the Dragonmaw black drakes that are circling Thundermar, and drop them from the sky!

passages.title: Tear Them From the Sky!
passages.text:
You did it, <name>! Alliance ingenuity to the rescue.

Of course, I don't have anything to help you fight the dismounted riders now that they're on the ground. You're a <class>; improvise!

passages.title: Narkrall, The Drake-Tamer
passages.text:
There's one Dragonmaw among this lot, the one they call "Narkrall: The Drake-Tamer." I don't know where he gets his power over those beasts, but the black terror he rides is as nasty a brute as ever took the skies over the Highlands.

<name>, Narkrall is the fiend who took my father's life and left Thundermar in my hands.

I can't take him on alone, but I've seen what you're capable of, <class>. Maybe together we can end this.

Let me know when you're ready, and we'll fight Narkrall together!

passages.title: Narkrall, The Drake-Tamer
passages.text:
We did it, <name>! Narkrall Rakeclaw lies dead at my feet, and Thundermar has weathered a storm of drakes!

This wouldn't have been possible if it weren't for the help of the Alliance. I owe you a debt that I don't think can ever be repaid.

passages.title: Meet with Patrice Lancaster
passages.text: I just received a scroll from the Training Hall, <name>. Patrice Lancaster sends word that she wishes to speak with you. You should meet with her as soon as you can.

passages.title: Meet with Patrice Lancaster
passages.text: The Light has answered my prayers. At last, you have arrived.

passages.title: Enough Damage For One Day
passages.text:
We do not have any further strategic need for Thorg'izog or the Blackrock ground troops. We must continue to the next phase of the plan.

When you are finished at the stronghold, return to us here in Chiselgrip.

passages.title: Enough Damage For One Day
passages.text:
You alright?

Good.  You did a fine job out there, <name>.  Now pack up your things.  We're moving out of here.

passages.title: Meet with Mulric Boldrock
passages.text: Mulric Boldrock's messenger just reached me, <name>. He has an important matter he wishes to discuss with you and sends word that you should meet him at the Training Hall in the Old Town district in Stormwind as soon as you can make it there.

passages.title: Meet with Mulric Boldrock
passages.text: Welcome, <name>. We will need your skills in the continuing battle against Twilight's Hammer.

passages.title: Open Their Eyes
passages.text:
Before you go...

I've taken advantage of my "alone time" with Impsy here to learn some interesting facts about imps. Specifically, he ended up telling me the one thing that all imps fear most. Something they're absolutely terrified of.

I thought that sounded useful as well as interesting, so I've done some basic conjuring. This prism will project an image of... well, of what Impsy described.

Shadowlurk Ridge is still swarming with imps. Why don't you go test their reaction for me?

passages.title: Open Their Eyes
passages.text: Having fun?

passages.title: Open Their Eyes
passages.text:
I see... their eyes are open

<Delaris smiles with bemusement.>

Maybe I'll keep Impsy around after all. He's got a lot to teach me...

passages.title: Moonglade Calls
passages.text: I have received word that our brothers in Moonglade have requested your help, <name>. You should travel there and speak with Loganaar in Nighthaven. He will tell you all you need to know.

passages.title: Moonglade Calls
passages.text: It's good to see you again, <name>. I wish I could say that I had happy news.

passages.title: The Kirthaven Summit
passages.text:
After the licking we just gave 'em, the Dragonmaw assaults on Thundermar ought to stop. Maybe the Wildhammer do have a place in your Alliance - we Thundermars certainly owe you a debt.

Up in Kirthaven, our Grand Shaman Lachlan MacGraff has been trying to arrange a summit between the surviving Wildhammer family leaders. It's a tall order to get us all to work together, but I'm at least willing to give it a go.

Fly up to Kirthaven in the North and talk to Lachlan MacGraff. I'll meet you there!

passages.title: The Kirthaven Summit
passages.text:
Hello, <class>! Keegan Firebeard here has told me all about your heroics down south. Thank you for all of your efforts on behalf of the Wildhammer.

I see Colin Thundermar is right behind you. The summit is ready to begin! Please stay and let's see how things unfold...

passages.title: Journey to Orgrimmar
passages.text:
A messenger just asked me to pass along an invitation. It is from the priest trainer, Martin Goodchilde, at The Barracks in Orgrimmar.

He asks that you meet with him at your soonest convenience. The Barracks can be found within the Valley of Honor.

passages.title: Journey to Orgrimmar
passages.text: The Horde has need of your talents, <name>.

passages.title: A Delivery for Thorg'izog
passages.text:
General Thorg'izog is staying among the ogres in the Firegut Furnace, a cave on the western edge of Dreadmaul Rock. I'd like you to deliver this to him and the ogres.

Inside this package, you will find the worg cutlets you obtained, marinated in the fel slider cider that we took from the Altar of Storms.

I would avoid eating it if I were you.

Bring it to General Thorg'izog. He will make sure that his troops are fed and, with any luck, he will eat some himself.

passages.title: A Delivery for Thorg'izog
passages.text: What've you got there, soldier?

passages.title: A Delivery for Thorg'izog
passages.text:
Well would you look at that!  My favorite soldier comes through in the clutch!

I'll make sure to get this distributed among the ogres.

I'll see you in Redridge, soldier.  For the glory of the Blackrock!

passages.title: A Delivery for Neeralak
passages.text:
The warlocks of the Blackrock Clan often practice their magic in the Skull Warren, a cave on the eastern side of Dreadmaul Rock. Their leader, Xi'lun, is busy elsewhere, so the cave is currently being held by another of the big three: Dragon-Lord Neeralak. And Neeralak's expertise is in dragons, not in necromancy.

I've used the slumber sand on those flamekin you captured. Try to convince Neeralak that they're warlock imps, and not flamekin. When they wake up, they won't be happy.

passages.title: A Delivery for Neeralak
passages.text: What?

passages.title: A Delivery for Neeralak
passages.text:
What are these?  Oh, are these imps?

I'm pretty sure that imps don't just fall asleep in boxes!

I'll take your word for it, though.  I don't understand any of this warlock crap.  Leave them in the corner.

passages.title: A Delivery for Xi'lun
passages.text:
Intel tells us that High Warlock Xi'lun - the final member of the Big Three - is within the cave atop Dreadmaul Peak, preparing for his big moment.

He is waiting for a delivery: an Orb of Domination, with which he can perform a powerful summoning ritual. I want you to give him this:

<Troteman hands you a glass orb.>

This is the clear glass orb that you freed from the Altar of Storms. It is powerless. Give it to Xi'lun, and cross your fingers that he doesn't notice.

passages.title: A Delivery for Xi'lun
passages.text: I don't have time for games, fool.  Get out of my sight.

passages.title: A Delivery for Xi'lun
passages.text:
Pff!  You're late!  Do you know how long I've been waiting for Ner'gosh to deliver this orb?

<Xi'lun looks down at the orb, then up at you.>

There's something strange about this orb... it's too...

<Xi'lun trails off.>

Never mind, it must be my nerves talking.  Thank you for the delivery.  For blood and honor!

passages.title: Assault on Dreadmaul Rock
passages.text:
This is it, <name>. This is where it hits the fan. Where all the pieces come together.

Strap in, and come with me. We're going to go talk to Acride and call in that favor that he owes us. Then we'll stop this invasion of Redridge before it even starts.

passages.title: Assault on Dreadmaul Rock
passages.text: Now's our chance!  Crush them!  We won't get another opportunity like this!

passages.title: Assault on Dreadmaul Rock
passages.text:
Did you see them run?  They didn't know what was happening!  Beautiful!

Our job's almost done, <name>.  It's time to deliver the deathblow.

passages.title: The Spoils of War
passages.text:
We've toppled a giant today, <name>. While the Blackrock orcs still swarm in their spire, I doubt their plans will take them anywhere near Redridge anytime soon. You and Keeshan saw to that.

I'd say we were fairly resourceful here in Burning Steppes - those warlock supplies we collected certainly came in handy, as did the obsidian ash that we used to conceal our dragon.

There were, however, some collected items left over. Please, take your pick before you move on, beyond the steppes.

passages.title: The Spoils of War
passages.text: You peer inside, and find...

passages.title: Placing the Pawns
passages.text:
<name>. It sounds like you and Keeshan have finished with your tasks. I've also finished mine.

Return to Morgan's Vigil. I've prepared a few packages to deliver to the Big Three: Thorg'izog, Neeralak, and Xi'lun. You've already met General Thorg'izog. This will be your chance to meet the other two.

That is, before we kill them.

passages.title: Placing the Pawns
passages.text:
Good, you're back.

I hope you've still got that disguise.  You're going back undercover, <name>.

passages.title: Locked and Loaded
passages.text:
<name>, come in. Can you read me?

The battle is about to start. I hope you've delivered all of those packages.

I need you here in Morgan's Vigil, NOW.

passages.title: Locked and Loaded
passages.text:
<name>'s here!  We can get started.

This is our big moment, <name>.  I hope you brought your A game.

passages.title: Twilight Scheming
passages.text:
The influence of Twilight's Hammer reaches far and wide. They search ceaselessly for allies in their battle against us and they are recruiting the Dark Iron dwarves of Blackrock Depths to their cause.

Moira's grip on the Dark Irons is tenuous at best and more of her people fall away from her rule with each day. We must sabotage their recruitment efforts.

I want you to go into Domicile portion of Blackrock Depths and use this torch to burn the books that the Twilight's Hammer is distributing there.

passages.title: Twilight Scheming
passages.text: We cannot afford to allow the Dark Iron dwarves to ally with Twilight's Hammer.

passages.title: Twilight Scheming
passages.text: You have done your work well, <name>. While this will not stop Twilight's Hammer, it will help sow suspicion between them and the Dark Irons.

passages.title: It's Time to Oil Up
passages.text:
Three things come out of Irontree Clearing: lumber, oil, and exhausted workers. The first two are pretty much the cause of the third, but I like to be efficient about things where I can.

I've got our shredders working triple unpaid overtime, and there's really nowhere in the schedule for them to get maintenance.

Use this grappling hook to nab some of the extra oil cans floating around camp and use them to oil up the shredders, would you?

passages.title: It's Time to Oil Up
passages.text:
Efficiency in the workforce! Wonderful.

Maybe I should check on the goblins inside those shredders later.

passages.title: A Flare Fight
passages.text:
This operation's stayed pretty discreet so far, but the worgen over in Talonbranch Glade have it out for us. They've been trying everything they can to get us shut down.

Some of the workers have told me they've seen glimpses of worgen lurking around the clearing. Take these oversized megaflares. They're bright enough to show anything that gets anywhere near them.

Use the flares to look for prowling worgen, and make sure they don't leave here alive!

passages.title: A Flare Fight
passages.text:
Mangy curs think they can just waltz in here and ruin my finely-tuned operation. Hah!

I told you not to look directly at the flares, right? Oops.

passages.title: Turn It Off! Turn It Off!
passages.text:
It was those darn worgen! They blew right past me into the cavern.

They must've messed with the Master Control Pump! If that thing is left on too long, every pipe runnin' under our feet is gonna blow. You think the leaks now are bad? Just wait!

Listen, if you can reach the Master Control Pump all the way in the back of the cavern, you can shut it off and save us all!

passages.title: Turn It Off! Turn It Off!
passages.text:
You turn the largest handle you can find on the Master Control Pump, and the rattling noises in the nearby pipes stop.

This gives you a few moments to hear the sound of flames outside before a familiar voice cuts in through a tinny, craclikng speaker.

passages.title: The Breath of Cenarius
passages.text:
<name>, we have learned that a missing Cenarion artifact has surfaced in the hands of a Twilight's Hammer pyromancer. Pyromancer Loregrain has taken this artifact, the Breath of Cenarius, into Blackrock Depths and uses its power to open elemental gates.

We must act to keep Loregrain from summoning elementals to bolster the ranks of his Dark Iron allies. Recover the artifact from him and use its power to close the gates that Loregrain has been using.

passages.title: The Breath of Cenarius
passages.text: We cannot afford to allow the Dark Iron dwarves to ally with Twilight's Hammer.

passages.title: The Breath of Cenarius
passages.text: I'm heartened to have the Breath of Cenarius back where it belongs and I know the rest of the circle will be impressed by your efforts. You may have also set back the plans of the Twilight's Hammer clan a bit, too. Excellent work.

passages.title: Can You Smell What the Lok'tar is Cooking?
passages.text:
Shortly before you arrived an orc flew in upon a frost wyrm and demanded that I direct him to where the 'newbies were hanging out.' Uncertain as to the vernacular, I told him to fulfill his duty as a member of the Horde and deal with the worgen threat of the area. He grumbled something about 'what the lok'tar was cooking' and headed south to the docks.

Ordinarily I wouldn't care about whether or not an orc went missing, but I am genuinely curious about what the lok'tar might be cooking. Find out.

passages.title: Can You Smell What the Lok'tar is Cooking?
passages.text:
*GASP*

HELP!

DROWNING!

*GURGLE*

passages.title: *Gurgle* HELP! *Gurgle*
passages.text:
*GURGLE*

HELP!*GASP*

ORKUS IS DROWNING! HELP ME, QUEST GIVER <name>!

*GLUB*

Dwarf threw Orkus into the water! Must not die!

*GURGLE*

The shame would be too great.

passages.title: *Gurgle* HELP! *Gurgle*
passages.text:
<Orkus' face turns as red as his armor.>

I... uh... the human must have cast some type of mind-altering spell on Orkus. Orkus will explain.

passages.title: The Bachelor
passages.text:
We need to make this work, <name>. The answer is in the blood! Family bonds have kept these Wildhammer clans apart from one another. It'll take family bonds to glue 'em back together. It's a long shot, but we're going to have to play matchmaker!

I'll track down Colin Thundermar and talk with him. You're a smooth one - you should talk to Keegan Firebeard inside. He's sharp enough to understand a political marriage. Go find out if he fancies anyone!

passages.title: The Bachelor
passages.text:
What? Kurdran's talkin' marriage!? Didn't he just see me an' ol' Thunderface tearing each other new ones?

The only eligible Thundermar is Fanny. Now, I'll give you this, she's got the looks allright. All lumpy in the right places, if you hear me. But she's not got that somethun' somethun' a Firebeard looks for in a woman, right?

passages.title: Stormpike Rendezvous
passages.text:
I tracked down the decrepit necromancer, Helcular, in hopes of getting a lead on Alliance movement within Hillsbrad.

Helcular tasked me with finding and killing worgen. Ordinarily this would not be a problem for Orkus, but I had just eaten several helpings of Dirge's Kickin' Chimaerok chops, causing my bowels to cry out in anguish. That's when the trouble began and how I ended up in the water.

Hear Orkus out, <name>.

passages.title: Stormpike Rendezvous
passages.text: I will have my vengeance, but first we must heal Kasha.

passages.title: The Core of Kroshius
passages.text:
The most fearsome demon in Shatter Scar Vale is known as Kroshius. Though many have hunted him over the years, destruction has only made him stronger.

Time after time, warlocks have come to this forest and reanimated Kroshius. He now lurks in the southeast, surrounded by demonic fire, awaiting any who come to try and claim his power.

I will not have this corrupt cycle continue! Kill Kroshius, and bring his infernal core to me.

passages.title: The Core of Kroshius
passages.text: The core must be kept away from Shatter Scar Vale.

passages.title: The Core of Kroshius
passages.text: This foul chunk is what those warlocks sought year after year. I will protect it myself, or destroy it if possible, and ensure Kroshius never rises again.

passages.title: Shroud of the Makers
passages.text:
It is good to have friends, <class>! While kindness is its own reward, there can be tangible benefits too!

Some friends of mine recently intercepted a shipment of Schnottz's plunder and found something that should serve your needs nicely.

It's a piece of titan technology that renders the user nearly invisible. If you use it in the enemy camp, you might be able to rewire their explosives and make a mess of their operation.

Each charge has a limited duration, so don't stray too far from safety!

passages.title: Shroud of the Makers
passages.text:
Hah!

I heard it from here! I wish I could've been there to see it!

passages.title: My Sister, Fanny
passages.text:
Before you go, be sure to stop by the inn behind me. My sister Fanny is inside.

Refugees are pouring into Thundermar from all of the torched Wildhammer settlements around us, and I put Fanny in charge of 'em. She's tough as talons, that one. But she might need your help.

passages.title: My Sister, Fanny
passages.text: Me brother sent you? Good! I could use a <class>. Can ya hold yer own in a fight?

passages.title: Timbermaw Hold
passages.text:
Okay, I know this is a longshot, but I figure it never hurts to ask.

While I deal with the fallout of all the ridiculous nonsense that just went on here, I need you to go speak to some bears. The Timbermaw furbolg control the forests to the northeast, and they're not too fond of us.

I just need someone to give them the idea the Horde isn't all that bad. Head northeast up the road to Timbermaw Hold--don't go into Felpaw Village--and ask the furbolg outside if they have any favors they'd like done.

passages.title: Timbermaw Hold
passages.text:
We furbolg are not foolish, <name>. We will not yield Timbermaw Hold to any askers.

However, we are also in dire need of assistance. If you help us, we will grant you our favor and allow you passage.

passages.title: Weeding the Lawn
passages.text:
In a place like this, even something as simple as growing flowers and pulling weeds can require some heroic effort.

The orchid lashers that grow on all sides of the grove are a sign of healing. But they're not flawless; some of them do succumb to demonic corruption now and then.

I've found the best way to check is to just pull them up. If they're normal, they'll wander around a bit and reroot themselves. If they aren't... well, you'd better be ready for a fight!

passages.title: Weeding the Lawn
passages.text: Checking the lashers will really help me here.

passages.title: Weeding the Lawn
passages.text:
It's hard work, but it's so rewarding when you see them growing up big and strong.

When they're not covered with demonic thorns, that is!

passages.title: The Road to Purgation
passages.text:
The time of vengeance has come, <name>. Kasha can once more fly, thanks to you. She will take us to Purgation Isle so that we may confront the Stormpike dwarf general, Vanndar Stormpike, and his captain, Balinda Stonehearth. BOTH will pay for what they have done.

Are you ready? Orkus cannot do this alone.

passages.title: The Road to Purgation
passages.text: This place is dark... foreboding. It smells of piss and fur. There are definitely worgen here and very likely dwarves.

passages.title: Myzerian's Head
passages.text:
The head of one of Deathwing's most formidable black dragons is now in your possession.

While many in Azeroth would pay dearly for such an artifact, something tells you that it belongs in a museum for all to see and remember.

Harrison Jones is likely to have the proper connections.

Sullah would certainly be happy to deliver it to him.

passages.title: Myzerian's Head
passages.text:
You took down that dragon!?

Remarkable!

passages.title: Myzerian's Head
passages.text:
Quite an accomplishment, <name>.

I'll be certain that this gets to Harrison when his expedition here is concluded.

passages.title: Rescue at Glopgut's Hollow
passages.text:
Well speak of the devil in a blue dress. Fanny's gone and gotten herself kidnapped by ogres!

I don't trust the Thundermars to be able to mount a rescue on their own. I'll round up my gryphon riders and provide some air support.

I'm sure they can use an extra <class> down there, <name>. Grab your gear and look for Colin Thundermar in the Glopgut ogre camp. It's southwest of here, below the cliffs. Hurry now!

passages.title: Rescue at Glopgut's Hollow
passages.text:
Good to have you fighting at my side again, <name>!

And I see the Firebeards have come as well. I suppose they'll provide a distraction while me and my boys do the heavy lifting.

passages.title: Ogre Bashin'
passages.text:
Glopgut ogres! I'd say they was dumb as a sack of hammers, but I have more respect for me hammers than that.

We've fought off their raids for years, but if they're bold enough to steal one of our own, we're gonna have to learn them a lesson.

Help us smack around some Glopgut ogres! Kill their pounders, hurlers, or bashers either out here or - better - inside the cave. That'll show 'em.

passages.title: Ogre Bashin'
passages.text: Har! My men could learn a lot by watching you work. Well done.

passages.title: Enemy at our Roots
passages.text:
The goblins are already upon us!

We have tried everything in our power to warn the goblins to leave Irontree Clearing before we resorted to violence. As they turned a blind ear to us, we struck, and now rather than spare the forest they would lay down their lives for greed.

They will soon know the full extent of our fury! The battle rages just beyond our northern gate. Join our pack in glory and slay any goblin who dares come before us!

passages.title: Enemy at our Roots
passages.text: May their blood water our tree. You fight well, <name>.

passages.title: Burnout
passages.text:
Your pump sabotage has caused pipes to break all over camp. The goblins are in a panic over the geysers, and it's about to get worse.

Take the gathered explosives and use them to set the geysers aflame. We're going to do as much damage to the camp as we can, and keep that oil from being used to fuel shredders... or worse, Horde warships.

passages.title: Burnout
passages.text: Look at them run... the live ones, that is. Glorious.

passages.title: A Dangerous Alliance
passages.text:
SI:7's latest report about Twilight's Hammer and Dark Iron activity worries me, <name>. There's evidence that they are preparing a joint attack from within Blackrock Mountain. We'll be hard-pressed to turn back such a combined force, but if we act before they're ready to strike, we might be able to blunt the attack.

You must go into Blackrock Depths and capture the Twilight's Hammer attack plans from General Angerforge in the West Garrison. Do not hesitate to take out the elementals supporting his forces.

passages.title: A Dangerous Alliance
passages.text: We cannot afford to allow the Dark Iron dwarves to ally with Twilight's Hammer.

passages.title: A Dangerous Alliance
passages.text: I'll send these plans to the king and his strategists immediately. If the Dark Irons and their Twilight allies manage to recover and attack, our men will be ready for them. Well done, <name>.

passages.title: The Golem Lord's Creations
passages.text:
The latest SI:7 intelligence on Blackrock Depths is troubling, <name>. It appears Twilight's Hammer is working with the Dark Iron engineer, Argelmach, to create war golems powered by elementals. These golems could prove to be a devastating weapon if used against us.

You must prevent that from happening, <name>. Find the Manufactory in Blackrock Depths, capture the blueprints he's using to make those golems, and recover the elemental modules he's using to power them.

passages.title: The Golem Lord's Creations
passages.text: We cannot afford to allow those golems to be used against us.

passages.title: The Golem Lord's Creations
passages.text: I know a couple of engineers who will want to take a look at those plans. They won't be using these golems anytime soon. Good work, <name>.

passages.title: They Will Never Expect This...
passages.text:
They made a mistake by not killing me when they had the chance. Perhaps they thought Orkus would drown. HAH! Now they will pay the price for their carelessness.

You and I will tear this island apart, <name>. They will never expect this! Once all of their soldiers are dead we will confront the leaders. Be on the lookout for attack plans. If we can get our hands on their plans we will be able to put a stop to their whole invasion!

Let's go, <name>!

passages.title: They Will Never Expect This...
passages.text: We will kill them all!

passages.title: They Will Never Expect This...
passages.text:
Look upon the carnage, <name>. You and I make quite the team!

Now to find those plans and deal with their leaders.

passages.title: The Pyromancer's Grimoire
passages.text:
The power of the Dark Iron forces and their Twilight's Hammer allies is growing within Blackrock Mountain. Pyromancer Loregrain, a magus of renown, plays an important role in leading the Twilight's Hammer forces there. If we could get our hands on his grimoire, I might be able to devise counterspells and other ways of dampening their elemental magics.

You must descend into Blackrock Depths, locate the Shrine of Thaurissan, and capture the grimoire. Show Loregrain and his Twilight minions no mercy.

passages.title: The Pyromancer's Grimoire
passages.text: Have you managed to capture the pyromancer's grimoire?

passages.title: The Pyromancer's Grimoire
passages.text:
<The <class> trainer pages through the grimoire quickly.>

I've already seen a dozen spells I never knew existed. This will be most helpful, <name>.

passages.title: Stones of Binding
passages.text:
I have it on good authority that SI:7 is concerned about collaboration between Twilight's Hammer and the Dark Iron dwarves in Blackrock Depths. We can act on this information, prove our value to the Alliance, and gain something for ourselves at the same time.

The report mentions that the Twilight's Hammer followers have placed a number of elemental binding stones throughout Shadowforge City, the Domicile, the Shrine of Thaurissan, the West Garrison and the East Garrison. Find and capture those stones!

passages.title: Stones of Binding
passages.text: Have you managed to find those binding stones?

passages.title: Stones of Binding
passages.text: The binding stones you brought back are exceedingly powerful. It will likely take me years to learn all their secrets, but I'm certain they'll prove most useful. Thank you, <name>.

passages.title: Heroes of the Horde!
passages.text:
Now to find their battle plans and take out their leaders! Should we succeed there is an orc high warlord who served in the war in Silverpine that is now stationed at Tarren Mill - located in the heart of Hillsbrad. He will grant both of us commendations for this! We will be heroes of the Horde, <name>!

Onward! Together we will defeat the Alliance filth!

passages.title: Heroes of the Horde!
passages.text: <High Warlord Cromush looks somber.>

passages.title: Heroes of the Horde!
passages.text:
<High Warlord Cromush salutes.>

He will be honored as a hero of the Horde, just as he always hoped. What you and Orkus did will save hundreds of lives and ensure that our foothold in Hillsbrad is not lost.

passages.title: Slaves of the Firelord
passages.text:
Within the halls of Blackrock Depths, the Twilight's Hammer cult and the Dark Iron dwarves are gathering their forces. Backing up their legions are hordes of fire elementals bound to the service of the firelord, Ragnaros.

If we can free those elementals from their bonds, we can both weaken our enemies and honor the elements. Take this totem with you and use it on subdued fireguards. It will free their spirits from their bondage and restore them to their natural state.

passages.title: Slaves of the Firelord
passages.text: You have truly served both the Alliance and your calling as a <class>.

passages.title: Weapons of Darkness
passages.text:
Blackrock Depths has long been home to our enemies, but now SI:7 sends word that the Dark Irons and Twilight's Hammer are increasing their collaboration. Using the knowledge of the cult, the Dark Iron dwarves are imbuing their weapons with elemental powers. They've outfitted the Anvilrage legion with these fearsome new weapons.

I want you to go into Blackrock Depths and gather the weapons from the Anvilrage dwarves there and break them over the Black Anvil in the heart of Shadowforge City.

passages.title: Weapons of Darkness
passages.text: Thanks to your efforts, those weapons will never shed Alliance blood. Excellent work, <name>.

passages.title: The Dark Iron Army
passages.text:
Things are getting interesting in Blackrock Mountain, <name>. Our sources report that the Dark Iron dwarves have formed closer ties with Twilight's Hammer and both are preparing for a major offensive.

I've made the contents of the report known to key leaders in Stormwind and I want you to help deal with this emerging Dark Iron threat.

The rations for most of the Dark Iron army are kept in the East and West Garrison of Blackrock Depths. Take this poison and apply it to their grain reserves.

passages.title: The Dark Iron Army
passages.text: With any luck, the poison will take out a fair number of their frontline troops before they know what's happening. That should stall them for the near future. SI:7 is most pleased with your work.

passages.title: Something Brewed
passages.text:
It would be an insult to celebrate a Wildhammer wedding without drink. Kurdran himself called for a few kegs of rare Thunderbrew Lager to be sent ashore from Highbank, but the caravan can't get through the pass.

Follow the road east of here, around the south side of Thunderstrike Mountain, and catch up with the caravan. Look for a fellow named Hammelhand, and help him get the booze through the pass!

passages.title: Something Brewed
passages.text: Ahh, Russell the Bard is always raving about Thundermar Lager. I guess it doesn't have the kick of a good Wildhammer brew, but he goes on and on about the "body" or "flavor." I guess we'll find out, eh?

passages.title: Fourth and Goal
passages.text:
It's all up to you, kid. You demolished the Steamwheedle Sharks, so now all that's left to do is to kick the winning goal.

<The coach leans in close and whispers in your ear.>

Now, just between you and me, I think we should do this one right. I don't want you to just kick a goal... I want you to kick it so far it sails between the two smokestacks behind the goal!

I've modified the footbomb to give you the extra power that you'll need.

Now get out there and make me proud!

passages.title: Fourth and Goal
passages.text:
Uh... you did it, kid. You REALLY did it! We won the game and....

DID YOU SEE THAT DRAGON?!!!

passages.title: SEVEN! YUP!
passages.text:
We have to take action. Winky and Gor'tesh were fighting, so I planned this friendship ceremony to help the two of them make up. Everything was going well, until...

Well, you know the rest.

I even bought drinks!

Winky loves flameflies. He runs off to chase them most every night. I'm thinking maybe that's where he went.

You'll find flameflies to the west and north, wherever you find lava. Bring me seven of them, and hurry!

Gor'tesh might leave next!

passages.title: SEVEN! YUP!
passages.text: <Oralius grasps at the air, lifts his fist, and peers hopefully between his clenched fingers.>

passages.title: SEVEN! YUP!
passages.text:
You'll never guess what happened!  Winky came back!  No flameflies needed.

Can a dwarf get a celebratory belly rub?  Come on now!  RUBBA MAH BELLY!

passages.title: Done Nothing Wrong
passages.text:
The Blackrock orcs of the steppes serve a dark master - one who performs twisted experiments on living creatures to create his own menagerie of abominations. Many of his test subjects are as corrupted as their master, but others are completely innocent.

In the whelping downs to the south, they chain baby dragons to the ground, preparing them for such experiments. I will not stand for this. Break their fetters and return the hatchlings to me... to safety.

passages.title: Done Nothing Wrong
passages.text: I hope we weren't too late.

passages.title: Done Nothing Wrong
passages.text: I will see to it that these dragons are taken care of.

passages.title: Return to Ariok
passages.text:
Well I suppose I'm done with you here. I'll go shoo those other warlocks out when I build up the courage.

Here, don't forget those supplies.

passages.title: Return to Ariok
passages.text: It looks like you managed to deal with Gorzeeki.

passages.title: Return to Ariok
passages.text:
<Ariok looks through the crate.>

Good, good, good.  We can move on.  Our war takes us east, away from Blackrock Mountain... for now.

passages.title: Chiselgrip, the Heart of the Steppes
passages.text:
We're headed to Chiselgrip, right in the center of these steppes. We'll rendezvous with the Thorium Brotherhood there, as well as with my father.

Are you familiar with the Brotherhood? Those dark iron dwarves have helped me out more than once. We may need their help again.

We'll pass through Black Tooth Hovel on our way there. What do you say we kill a few of the Blackrock while we travel? I'm getting a little restless here in this camp.

passages.title: Chiselgrip, the Heart of the Steppes
passages.text:
You'll have to excuse me, but we're not taking visitors right now.  I'll ask you to leave Chiselgrip out the same door you came in.

Oh, Ariok... is that you?

passages.title: A Needle in a Hellhole
passages.text:
Lok'tar, <class>. My name is Eitrigg, of the Argent Crusade... formerly of the Warchief's Honor Guard. Before that, of the Blackrock orcs.

I trust my son has briefed you on our plan. He hasn't? That is probably for the better.

The next part of the plan is going to require a bit of subtlety. Speak with Thelaron Direneedle, the tailor here in town. I've already given him the hides and mud that you've collected. He's going to need to size you.

That's right, <race>: you're going undercover.

passages.title: A Needle in a Hellhole
passages.text:
You need a disguise?  Well, you came to the right place, honey.

Let me take a look... mm-hmm.  I know exactly what we'll do.

passages.title: A Perfect Costume
passages.text:
Judging by your weight, build, and size, we're going to dress you as an orc. Their army is made mostly of orcs, so you'll fit right in.

Do you know much about tailoring? If not, then consider this your first lesson. My crafting table over there has all the necessary supplies on it.

Go ahead and grab whatever you think is necessary, then bring it here. Thelaron will fix you right up.

passages.title: A Perfect Costume
passages.text:
That's it?  That's your disguise?  I'm feeling less confident about our chances.

But still confident.

passages.title: A Perfect Costume
passages.text:
Judging by your weight, build, and size, we're going to dress you as an ogre. The firegut ogres have always worked for the Blackrocks, so you'll fit right in.

Do you know much about tailoring? If not, then consider this your first lesson. My crafting table over there has all the necessary supplies on it.

Go ahead and grab whatever you think is necessary, then bring it here. Thelaron will fix you right up.

passages.title: A Perfect Costume
passages.text:
That's it?  That's your disguise?  I'm feeling less confident about our chances.

But still confident.

passages.title: A Perfect Costume
passages.text:
Judging by your weight, build, and size, we're going to dress you as a goblin. The Blackrocks have been known to hire goblin mercenaries to fill their ranks, so you'll fit right in.

Do you know much about tailoring? If not, then consider this your first lesson. My crafting table over there has all the necessary supplies on it.

Go ahead and grab whatever you think is necessary, then bring it here. Thelaron will fix you right up.

passages.title: A Perfect Costume
passages.text:
That's it?  That's your disguise?  I'm feeling less confident about our chances.

But still confident.

passages.title: A Perfect Costume
passages.text:
Judging by your weight, build, and size, we're going to dress you as a troll. The Smolderthorn trolls have always worked with the Blackrock orcs, so you'll fit right in.

Do you know much about tailoring? If not, then consider this your first lesson. My crafting table over there has all the necessary supplies on it.

Go ahead and grab whatever you think is necessary, then bring it here. Thelaron will fix you right up.

passages.title: A Perfect Costume
passages.text:
That's it?  That's your disguise?  I'm feeling less confident about our chances.

But still confident.

passages.title: Strategic Cuts
passages.text:
<You hear a buzzing in your ear.>

<name>? It's Eitrigg.

We've just received the final bit of information for your next mission. There are three marks that we'd like you to take down. The first is Voodooist Timan, whom you'll find atop the Pillar of Ash. Worgmistress Othana is in the central worg pens. Finally, Gorlop is near the lava pools to the south.

You will find the scorpid barbs you harvested packed along with your belongings. Use the barbs on the marks when the time is right.

passages.title: Strategic Cuts
passages.text:
Not only did you pull off the executions, you managed to make them all look like accidents.

You were the right <race> for this undercover work.  Good job, soldier.

passages.title: The Kodocaller's Horn
passages.text:
Alright, I've got some actual, legitimate, important work for you. We've got to call the kodos in from the grazing lands to the south. General Thorg'izog says we'll be moving out into Redridge soon, and I won't be caught with my kodos down.

Use this horn near a kodo. It will return to the camp when it hears the call.

You'll want to watch out. Sometimes the kodos get a little feisty, so you need to knock them around a bit before they listen to you.

passages.title: Taking the Horn For Ourselves
passages.text:
<name>, it's Eitrigg. I want you to hold onto that horn. I'm sure we can improvise and find a way to work it into the plan.

I'm more than a little concerned about what Kaoshin said about attacking Redridge. We knew an attack was imminent, but not this soon!

Return to me, with the horn. We will talk again here, in Chiselgrip. And try not to ruin that disguise. You're not done with your undercover work yet.

passages.title: Taking the Horn For Ourselves
passages.text: Welcome back, soldier.

passages.title: Taking the Horn For Ourselves
passages.text:
True, an attack on Redridge is an attack against the Alliance... but it is also an attack against innocents.

I won't stand for that.  Not as a Crusader.  Not as an orc.

It's time we taught the Blackrock clan - my old clan - that their raiding days are over.

passages.title: Trial by Magma
passages.text:
I suppose I'll make the most of this situation. These goblin mercenaries brought this enormous fire elemental to my stronghold as a "thank you" for hiring them. What am I going to do with an elemental here in the steppes? That's like bringing sand to the beach.

If you're looking for work, then prove yourself. Talk to this goblin here, and challenge his elemental to a fight. The victor earns my respect, and my time.

passages.title: Trial by Magma
passages.text: What's the matter, are you scared?

passages.title: Trial by Magma
passages.text: I had a feeling you'd be the one returning to me.  I like your style, soldier.

passages.title: I Am the Law and I Am the Lash
passages.text:
I've been looking for a good, strong soldier like you. I need someone to keep my troops in line.

Outside the stronghold, you will find orcs, ogres, and trolls preparing for the assault on Redridge. My sergeants keep them in line, but I'd like you to assist them.

Take this cudgel and discipline a few of my soldiers. I don't care if they're misbehaving or standing perfectly in line, I want them beaten. I want them focused, battle-hardened, and obedient.

Now go.

passages.title: I Am the Law and I Am the Lash
passages.text:
I have a feeling we'll be hearing about you and your exploits for a long time, soldier.  I look forward to fighting by your side in Redridge.

You are dismissed.

passages.title: Abuse of Power
passages.text:
<name>? Eitrigg here.

It sounds like you have earned Thorg'izog's trust, and he's assigned you to discipline duty. This is fortunate.

We need you to take out his sergeants. You'll find them on wolfback, outside of the Blackrock Stronghold in the Fields of Honor. Use that cudgel on them, several times, until they die. You'll have to act fast, because if they realize you're not one of them, they can unmask you. Strike quickly and ferociously, <name>.

passages.title: Abuse of Power
passages.text:
Without those sergeants, Thorg'izog will be hard-pressed getting his troops ready for battle.

Already the dominoes are beginning to fall, <name>.

passages.title: Enough Damage For One Day
passages.text:
We do not have any further strategic need for Thorg'izog or the Blackrock ground troops. We must continue to the next phase of the plan.

When you are finished at the stronghold, return to my son and me, here in Chiselgrip.

passages.title: Enough Damage For One Day
passages.text:
Are you alright?

Good.  You were strong out there, <name>.  Strong, and wise.

Now pack up your things.  We're moving out of here.

passages.title: Placing the Pawns
passages.text:
<You hear a buzzing in your ear.>

<name>. It sounds like you and Ariok have finished with your tasks. I've also finished mine.

Return to Flame Crest. I've prepared a few packages to deliver to the Big Three: Thorg'izog, Neeralak, and Xi'lun. You've already met General Thorg'izog. This will be your chance to meet the other two.

That is, before you kill them.

passages.title: Placing the Pawns
passages.text:
Good, you're back.

I hope you've still got that disguise.  You're going back undercover, <name>.

passages.title: A Delivery for Thorg'izog
passages.text:
General Thorg'izog is staying among the ogres in the Firegut Furnace, a cave on the western edge of Dreadmaul Rock. I'd like you to deliver this to him and the ogres.

Inside this package, you will find the worg cutlets you obtained, marinated in the fel slider cider that we took from the Altar of Storms.

I would avoid eating it if I were you.

Bring it to General Thorg'izog. He will make sure that his troops are fed and, with any luck, he will eat some himself.

passages.title: A Delivery for Thorg'izog
passages.text: What've you got there, soldier?

passages.title: A Delivery for Thorg'izog
passages.text:
Well would you look at that!  My favorite soldier comes through in the clutch!

I'll make sure to get this distributed among the ogres.

I'll see you in Redridge, soldier.  For the glory of the Blackrock!

passages.title: A Delivery for Neeralak
passages.text:
The warlocks of the Blackrock Clan often practice their magic in the Skull Warren, a cave on the eastern side of Dreadmaul Rock. Their leader, Xi'lun, is busy elsewhere, so the cave is currently being held by another of the Big Three: Dragon-Lord Neeralak. And Neeralak's expertise is in dragons, not in necromancy.

I've used the slumber sand on those flamekin you captured. Try to convince Neeralak that they're warlock imps, and not flamekin. When they wake up, they won't be happy.

passages.title: A Delivery for Neeralak
passages.text: What?

passages.title: A Delivery for Neeralak
passages.text:
What are these?  Oh, are these imps?

I'm pretty sure that imps don't just fall asleep in boxes!

I'll take your word for it, though.  I don't understand any of this warlock crap.  Leave them in the corner.

passages.title: A Delivery for Xi'lun
passages.text:
Intel tells us that High Warlock Xi'lun - the final member of the Big Three - is within the cave atop Dreadmaul Peak, preparing for his big moment.

He is waiting for a delivery: an Orb of Domination, with which he can perform a powerful summoning ritual. I want you to give him this:

<Eitrigg hands you a glass orb.>

This is the clear glass orb that you freed from the Altar of Storms. It is powerless. Give it to Xi'lun, and cross your fingers that he doesn't notice.

passages.title: A Delivery for Xi'lun
passages.text: I don't have time for games, fool.  Get out of my sight.

passages.title: A Delivery for Xi'lun
passages.text:
Pff!  You're late!  Do you know how long I've been waiting for Ner'gosh to deliver this orb?

<Xi'lun looks down at the orb, then up at you.>

There's something strange about this orb... it's too...

<Xi'lun trails off.>

Never mind, it must be my nerves talking.  Thank you for the delivery.  For blood and honor!

passages.title: Locked and Loaded
passages.text:
<name>, come in. Can you read me?

The battle is about to start. I hope you've delivered all of those packages.

I need you here in Flame Crest, NOW.

passages.title: Locked and Loaded
passages.text:
<name>'s here!  We can get started.

This is our big moment, <name>.  I hope you are prepared.

passages.title: Assault on Dreadmaul Rock
passages.text:
This is it, <name>. A sad day... but a day in which the Blackrock orcs will learn a powerful lesson. Today, our plan comes to fruition.

Come with me. We're going to go talk to Acride and call in that favor that he owes us. Then we'll stop this invasion of Redridge before it even starts.

passages.title: Assault on Dreadmaul Rock
passages.text: Now's our chance!  Crush them!  We won't get another opportunity like this!

passages.title: Assault on Dreadmaul Rock
passages.text:
<Eitrigg looks over the devastation below.>

Our job is almost done, <name>.  It's time to deliver the deathblow.

passages.title: The Spoils of War
passages.text:
While the Blackrock orcs still swarm in their spire, I doubt their plans will take them anywhere near the innocent people of Redridge anytime soon. You and Ariok saw to that.

I'd say we were fairly resourceful here in Burning Steppes - those warlock supplies we collected certainly came in handy, as did the obsidian ash that we used to conceal our dragon.

There were, however, some collected items left over. Please, take your pick before you move on, beyond the steppes.

passages.title: The Spoils of War
passages.text: You peer inside, and find...

passages.title: A Dangerous Alliance
passages.text:
The Shattered Hand believes that the Dark Iron dwarves and Twilight's Hammer are working together. There's evidence that they are preparing a joint attack from within Blackrock Mountain. We can't allow such a force to depart Blackrock Mountain.

You must go into Blackrock Depths and capture the Twilight's Hammer attack plans from General Angerforge in the West Garrison. Eliminate the elementals Twilight's Hammer has provided to support his forces.

passages.title: A Dangerous Alliance
passages.text: We cannot afford to allow the Dark Iron dwarves to ally with Twilight's Hammer.

passages.title: A Dangerous Alliance
passages.text: The warchief will be most interested in seeing these plans. You are a most loyal member of the Horde.

passages.title: The Pyromancer's Grimoire
passages.text:
The power of the Dark Iron forces and their Twilight's Hammer allies is growing within Blackrock Mountain. Pyromancer Loregrain is a powerful and influential magus in the Twilight's Hammer delegation. If we could get our hands on his grimoire, I could develop counters for Twilight's Hammer spells and curses.

You must descend into Blackrock Depths, locate the Shrine of Thaurissan, and capture the grimoire. Show Loregrain and his Twilight minions no mercy.

passages.title: The Pyromancer's Grimoire
passages.text: Have you managed to capture the pyromancer's grimoire?

passages.title: The Pyromancer's Grimoire
passages.text:
<Ureda looks through the grimoire with interest.>

There's a wealth of arcane knowledge in this book! We will learn much about our enemies and the arcane arts.

passages.title: Stones of Binding
passages.text:
The Shattered Hand has discovered increased collaboration between Twilight's Hammer and the Dark Iron dwarves in Blackrock Depths. We have an opportunity to strike at our enemies and empower ourselves, <name>.

Twilight's Hammer followers have placed a number of elemental binding stones throughout Shadowforge City, the Domicile, the Shrine of Thaurissan, the West Garrison and the East Garrison. Find and capture those stones!

passages.title: Stones of Binding
passages.text: Have you managed to find those binding stones?

passages.title: Stones of Binding
passages.text: The binding stones you brought back are exceedingly powerful. Not only have we dealt a blow to the Horde's enemies, but you have also discovered a fascinating source of power.

passages.title: Threat of the Winterfall
passages.text:
I came to Winterspring to investigate the Frostfire Hot Springs. I've noticed that the water seems to have... strange qualities. I haven't yet been able to discover the source, and to tell you the truth, I've had some difficulty lately, due to the Winterfall furbolg.

They seem to be drawn to the springs, just as I am. They have become extremely protective of the water, and won't let me come near the two larger springs to the north of here.

I'd like to continue my studies, so won't you help me?

passages.title: Threat of the Winterfall
passages.text:
Thanks so much, <name>! Now I can get back to work here.

Did you find anything of interest at the Winterfall camp?

passages.title: The Golem Lord's Creations
passages.text:
The Shattered Hand has discovered some disturbing information in Blackrock Depths. It appears Twilight's Hammer is working with the Dark Iron engineer, Argelmach, to create war golems powered by elementals. These golems could be a great advantage for our enemies.

It is your duty to prevent that from happening. Find the Manufactory in Blackrock Depths, capture the blueprints he's using to make those golems, and recover the elemental modules he's using to power them.

passages.title: The Golem Lord's Creations
passages.text: We cannot afford to allow those golems to be used against us.

passages.title: The Golem Lord's Creations
passages.text: Can you imagine what would happen if they got these models working and into the field? You've done a great service for the Horde, <name>.

passages.title: Winterfall Firewater
passages.text:
This vial that you picked up from the Winterfall furbolg is empty, but you can detect a few drops of a strange green liquid inside; it almost glows.

Is it something important?

Donova Snowden would probably be able to tell you more, since she has been camped by the hot springs in Winterspring for some time now.

passages.title: The Dark Iron Army
passages.text:
As a member of the Shattered Hand, you know that it is our job to watch the Horde's enemies. We have discovered that the Dark Iron dwarves and their new allies, Twilight's Hammer, are preparing to attack.

I'm sending you to help deal with this threat before the Dark Iron army marches. Take this poison and apply it to the soldiers' rations of grain in Blackrock Depths.

The rations for most of the Dark Iron army are kept in the East and West Garrison of Blackrock Depths.

passages.title: The Dark Iron Army
passages.text: The poison should decimate their ranks if they're slow in discovering the tainted rations. Even if it does not kill most of the troops, we will have delayed them significantly. Well done.

passages.title: Falling to Corruption
passages.text:
The aggression of the Winterfall furbolg has to have its source somewhere. I'd like to get to the bottom of it if I can!

I've seen the furbolg in the camps to the north brewing something in a cauldron. They seemed very protective of it... if whatever they're cooking up is what's causing this, I must examine it myself.

Find that cauldron if it's still there, and bring me back what's inside!

passages.title: Falling to Corruption
passages.text: Inside the cauldron bubbles a rotting, repulsive-smelling substance...

passages.title: Slaves of the Firelord
passages.text:
Within the halls of Blackrock Depths, the Twilight's Hammer cult and the Dark Iron dwarves are gathering their forces. Backing up their legions are hordes of fire elementals bound to the service of the firelord, Ragnaros.

If we can free those elementals from their bonds, we can both weaken our enemies and honor the elements. Take this totem with you and use it on subdued fireguards. It will free their spirits from their bondage and restore them to their natural state.

passages.title: Slaves of the Firelord
passages.text: Your actions honor the ancestors and the Horde, <name>.

passages.title: Weapons of Darkness
passages.text:
Blackrock Depths has long been home to our enemies, but now the Shattered Hand has discovered that the Dark Irons and Twilight's Hammer are increasing their collaboration. Using the cult's knowledge, the Dark Iron dwarves are imbuing their weapons with elemental powers. They've outfitted the Anvilrage legion with these fearsome new weapons.

I want you to go into Blackrock Depths and gather the weapons from the Anvilrage dwarves there and break them over the Black Anvil in the heart of Shadowforge City.

passages.title: Weapons of Darkness
passages.text: Without those weapons, the Dark Irons will never be a match for the Horde. You have served your brothers and sisters well this day, <name>.

passages.title: Winterfall Runners
passages.text:
Very interesting, <name>...

When this toxic substance is mixed with the water from the hot springs, it loses its toxicity, only retaining the ability to temporarily affect those that ingest it. This must be why the Winterfall protect the hot springs so fervently -- they need them to purify their firewater.

We need to stop this -- cut off contact between the Winterfall and the Deadwood. A group of runners walks the distance between their village and Felwood. Find and defeat them, and steal their shipment.

passages.title: Winterfall Runners
passages.text: We'll see what happens when the Winterfall don't get their firewater!

passages.title: Winterfall Runners
passages.text:
<Donova examines the contents of the crate.>

I wonder if consuming this substance makes the furbolg more aggressive. They do seem much larger...

passages.title: The Final Piece
passages.text:
The log you found on the high chief looks extensive, but after looking through a couple of the pages, you find that you cannot read the text. The markings are so crude and poorly-formed that you are not sure if anyone would be able to read them.

But perhaps Donova will be able to tell you what it says...

passages.title: The Final Piece
passages.text: Now, what's this, <name>?

passages.title: The Final Piece
passages.text: I wonder what all of this means... I can't make anything out...

passages.title: Weapons of Darkness
passages.text:
Blackrock Depths has long been home to our enemies, but now the Shattered Hand has discovered that the Dark Irons and Twilight's Hammer are increasing their collaboration. Using the cult's knowledge, the Dark Iron dwarves are imbuing their weapons with elemental powers. They've outfitted the Anvilrage legion with these fearsome new weapons.

I want you to go into Blackrock Depths and gather the weapons from the Anvilrage dwarves there and break them over the Black Anvil in the heart of Shadowforge City.

passages.title: Weapons of Darkness
passages.text: Your actions honor your brethren and the Horde, <name>.

passages.title: Twilight Scheming
passages.text:
The influence of Twilight's Hammer grows within Blackrock Depths. They have allied with the Dark Iron dwarves and seek to convince them to strike outside the mountain.

We must destroy the instruments of the Twilight's Hammer agitation. Their influence over the Dark Irons must be minimized.

I want you to go into Domicile portion of Blackrock Depths and use this torch to burn the books that the Twilight's Hammer is distributing there.

passages.title: Twilight Scheming
passages.text: This will not dissuade Twilight's Hammer, but perhaps it will increase the suspicion between them and the Dark Irons.

passages.title: Twilight Scheming
passages.text:
The influence of Twilight's Hammer grows within Blackrock Depths. They have allied with the Dark Iron dwarves and seek to convince them to strike outside the mountain.

We must destroy the instruments of the Twilight's Hammer agitation. Their influence over the Dark Irons must be minimized.

I want you to go into Domicile portion of Blackrock Depths and use this torch to burn the books that the Twilight's Hammer is distributing there.

passages.title: Twilight Scheming
passages.text: We can only hope your efforts will keep the two forces apart long enough for us to exploit their weakness.

passages.title: Twilight Scheming
passages.text:
The influence of Twilight's Hammer grows within Blackrock Depths. They have allied with the Dark Iron dwarves and seek to convince them to strike outside the mountain.

We must destroy the instruments of the Twilight's Hammer agitation. Their influence over the Dark Irons must be minimized.

I want you to go into Domicile portion of Blackrock Depths and use this torch to burn the books that the Twilight's Hammer is distributing there.

passages.title: Twilight Scheming
passages.text: We can only hope that the confusion and distrust you have created enables us to keep our enemies divided.

passages.title: Twilight Scheming
passages.text:
The influence of Twilight's Hammer grows within Blackrock Depths. They have allied with the Dark Iron dwarves and seek to convince them to strike outside the mountain.

We must destroy the instruments of the Twilight's Hammer agitation. Their influence over the Dark Irons must be minimized.

I want you to go into Domicile portion of Blackrock Depths and use this torch to burn the books that the Twilight's Hammer is distributing there.

passages.title: Twilight Scheming
passages.text: I shoulda asked you to mind control the cultists and truly tear our enemies apart. But what you did will work, <name>.

passages.title: Twilight Scheming
passages.text:
The influence of Twilight's Hammer grows within Blackrock Depths. They have allied with the Dark Iron dwarves and seek to convince them to strike outside the mountain.

We must destroy the instruments of the Twilight's Hammer agitation. Their influence over the Dark Irons must be minimized.

I want you to go into Domicile portion of Blackrock Depths and use this torch to burn the books that the Twilight's Hammer is distributing there.

passages.title: Twilight Scheming
passages.text: That's the way you do it when you don't have an army. And now, Twilight's Hammer won't, either.

passages.title: Hero's Call: Ashenvale!
passages.text:
By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Sentinel Shyela at Orendil's Retreat in northwestern Ashenvale.

The Horde's aggression in Ashenvale cannot be allowed to stand! Your help is needed to repel the invaders and restore the sacred forest. Head south through the Twilight Vale in Darkshore to reach the forest of Ashenvale.

For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Ashenvale!
passages.text: Have you come to help us fight back against the forces of the Horde? Every blade and spell will be needed!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Ashenvale!
passages.text:
All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Kadrak at the Mor'shan Rampart on the border between the Northern Barrens and Ashenvale. Aid in driving the night elves from the forest, so that we may claim its resources for our people!

To reach the Mor'shan Rampart, you must take the Gold Road north from Crossroads in the Northern Barrens.

Destiny calls!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Ashenvale!
passages.text: So you're the reinforcements? I suppose you'll do fine as long you can kill night elves.

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Northern Barrens!
passages.text:
All able-bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Kargal Battlescar at Far Watch Post in the Northern Barrens.
