Your help is needed to secure the Northern Barrens against the encroaching quilboars and centaurs.

To reach Far Watch Post, travel west across Durotar's Southfury Watershed and cross the bridge into the Northern Barrens.

Destiny calls!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Northern Barrens!
passages.text: You look competent with a weapon or a spellbook. We could use your help in driving back the quillboars in these parts.

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Azshara!
passages.text:
All able-bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Ag'tor Bloodfist at the Orgrimmar Rear Gate in Azshara.

Aid in driving back the encroaching Alliance forces and assist in securing Azshara for the glory of the Horde!

Depart Orgrimmar through its northern gate to reach the Orgrimmar Rear Gate in Azshara.

Destiny calls!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Azshara!
passages.text: We could sure use some help out here.

passages.title: Fire From the Sky
passages.text:
Sullah wasn't kidding. That hill is crawling with troopers!

Jump on and paint our targets for me.

Make every shot count, <name>! We need to be able to get up there.

passages.title: Fire From the Sky
passages.text:
Don't think twice, <name>.

These guys are rotten to the core.

passages.title: Fire From the Sky
passages.text:
Good work, <name>.

Now let's see if we can make our way up there before they're able to recover.

passages.title: The Bandit Warlord
passages.text:
Our law demands that those behind this attack face proper retribution.

The band of bandits' ringleader is a man known as Warlord Ihsenn.

You will find him in the far west of the desert. Make sure his transgressions do not go unpunished.

passages.title: The Bandit Warlord
passages.text: I thank you, <name>.  These savages must be punished for what they've done here.

passages.title: Hero's Call: Thousand Needles!
passages.text:
By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Caryssia Moonhunter at New Thalanaar at the border between Feralas and Thousand Needles.

The sentinels need your help to turn back the marauding Grimtotem raiders who dominate the area. To reach New Thalaanar, travel to eastern Feralas, near the border with Thousand Needles.

For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Thousand Needles!
passages.text: You've arrived just in time, <class>. We need your help to hold off the Grimtotem.

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Thousand Needles!
passages.text:
All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Nyse at Mudsprocket. Join the Horde forces fighting against the renegade Grimtotems who dominate the area.

Nyse will provide you with transportation to the front lines. She will be waiting for you at Mudsprocket's inn, tucked away in southern Dustwallow Marsh.

Destiny calls!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Thousand Needles!
passages.text: Oh good, you are here.

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Thousand Needles!
passages.text: The Horde forces in Thousand Needles desperately need your help.

passages.title: The Battle for Andorhal
passages.text:
I just got word, <lad/lass>. It doesn't sound good.

The city of Andorhal is in the middle of a three-way war between the Forsaken, the Alliance, and the Scourge. King Wrynn has rolled the dice and sent a death knight to lead the charge for his cause, but I'm sure he can use all the help he can get.

I hate to see you go, but they've asked for you by name, <name>. Speak with Guthrum Thunderfist outside. He'll put you on the first gryphon out to Andorhal.

passages.title: The Battle for Andorhal
passages.text: It's about time you arrived, <class>.

passages.title: March of the Stormpike
passages.text:
These plans you recovered weave an interesting tale, <name>. The Stormpike have been moving their armies from Alterac Valley into the "four fingers" of Hillsbrad for over a month. Somehow they have managed to secretly get their installations set up without our forces knowing. Had we not received these plans they would have marched on us in a week's time, annihilating everything in their path.

With these plans, though, we can turn the tables.

This is what we must do...

passages.title: March of the Stormpike
passages.text: The time to act is now. The Stormpike must be crushed!

passages.title: The Battle for Andorhal
passages.text:
I just received the most curious missive. Curious indeed...

The city of Andorhal is in the middle of a three-way war between the Forsaken, the Alliance, and the Scourge. It sounds like Sylvanas has made her move, and to make matters interesting, she's put Koltira Deathweaver, the death knight, in command.

They've asked for you by name, <name>. Speak with Kellen Kuhn, the bat handler. He'll put you on the first bat out to Andorhal.

passages.title: The Battle for Andorhal
passages.text: It's about time you arrived, <class>.

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Tanaris!
passages.text:
All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Megs Dreadshredder in Gadgetzan. Help the Horde and the Bilgewater Cartel establish a presence in Tanaris before the Alliance does!

You can reach Gadgetzan in Tanaris by traveling south to the shore from Fizzle and Pozzik's Speedbarge in southeastern Thousand Needles. Or, you can get a flight there from Doras in Orgrimmar.

Destiny calls!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Tanaris!
passages.text: It's about time!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Tanaris!
passages.text: I could use your help, <class>. That blasted gnome is trying to persuade the Steemwheedle Cartel to favor her side!

passages.title: To the Aid of the Thorium Brotherhood
passages.text:
Dark Iron dwarves may be scheming and mischievous... but they're not all enemies. I've spoken several times with the dwarves of the Thorium Brotherhood, and they've never been anything but helpful.

An acquaintance of mine, Jack Rockleg, came to town not long ago, asking if I could join him on an expedition of some sort. It sounded important.

I'm a little busy, but maybe you wouldn't mind going? Just travel west, on the road to Searing Gorge. You'll see him soon after leaving the Badlands.

passages.title: To the Aid of the Thorium Brotherhood
passages.text: Well whadda we have here?  You here to help?

passages.title: Pride of the Highborne
passages.text:
Ten thousand years ago...

The Highborne lived here in prosperity. We considered ourselves above the common ranks of the other night elves. With our every need met by magic and wealth, we led lives of indulgence and amusement. And greed...

The spirits you see here are overwhelmed with remorse and regret. Their anguish chains them here. If you wish to learn more of Kel'theril and Zin'malor, free them from their agony.

passages.title: Pride of the Highborne
passages.text: Death is not always a relief.

passages.title: Pride of the Highborne
passages.text:
The Crystal of Zin-Malor was stolen from a far-off temple without remorse. Its ability to control the arcane was too tempting, and when it was toyed with, its shattering cursed us all. Kel'theril suffered until the Sundering destroyed it for good.

The curse of Zin-Malor binds all who seek its power here. I was the first to fall to its temptation. Thousands of years later, our long lost descendants would be next...

passages.title: Mouton Flamestar
passages.text:
I get precious little time away from Searing Gorge these days. I've been meaning to visit a friend in Burning Steppes for the last several months, but haven't had the chance.

His name is Mouton Flamestar. While he's not a member of the Brotherhood, he's a trusted friend, and definitely trustworthy.

Will you send him my regards? You'll have to travel south, through the base of Blackrock Mountain. Just keep heading south... you'll find him.

Thank you.

passages.title: Mouton Flamestar
passages.text:
Oh, Oilfist sent you?  Hah!

Did he ever tell you how he got the name Oilfist?  You'll have to ask him about that one sometime.

passages.title: Mouton Flamestar
passages.text:
I get precious little time away from Searing Gorge these days. I've been meaning to visit a friend in Burning Steppes for the last several months, but haven't had the chance.

His name is Mouton Flamestar. While he's not a member of the Brotherhood, he's a trusted friend, and definitely trustworthy.

Will you send him my regards? You'll have to travel south, through the base of Blackrock Mountain. Just keep heading south... you'll find him.

Thank you.

passages.title: Mouton Flamestar
passages.text:
Oh, Oilfist sent you?  Hah!

Did he ever tell you how he got the name Oilfist?  You'll have to ask him about that one sometime.

passages.title: Pain of the Blood Elves
passages.text:
One year ago...

The legend of the Crystal of Zin-Malor reached Silvermoon, and I led a group of the finest warriors and scholars available to this land. We brought ample mana crystals, so none of us would be tempted to taste the crystal itself.

The crystal did not need our hunger to ruin us. Once in our possession, it warped all but me into wretched beasts.

The wretched souls still wander, seeking more lives to chain to this lake. Will you give them mercy... or flee to die on safer ground someday?

passages.title: Pain of the Blood Elves
passages.text: Do not loiter too long. There are few escapes from Kel'theril.

passages.title: Pain of the Blood Elves
passages.text:
The living farstrider who sent you here could not bear to see our fate. He ran... a wise decision.

If one now holds the Crystal of Zin-Malor again, it will spell the doom of all around them. It should never have been reassembled.

passages.title: Speak to Salfa
passages.text: The threat of corruption comes not only from the Deadwood furbolgs to the south, but also from the east and the Winterfall furbolgs of Winterspring. If you wish to further aid us, speak with Salfa on the other side of the Hold, by the Winterspring entrance. Follow the path to the left to reach it.

passages.title: Speak to Salfa
passages.text:
Greetings, <class> - I stand guard here as both a speaker for the Timbermaw here in Winterspring and as a defender of the tribe.

Our Winterfall brethren here in this frigid land have fallen under the same corruptive sway as the furbolg of Felwood.  If you've come here offering the Timbermaw furbolgs aid, then we are ready to accept such an offer.

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Un'Goro Crater!
passages.text:
All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report Williden Marshal at Marshal's Stand. You are to provide aid to the Marshal Expeditions' personnel as they uncover the secrets of Un'Goro Crater. The Horde may be able to find a use for the unique beasts and crystals populating the crater.

You can reach Un'Goro Crater by taking the road from western Tanaris down into the crater and toward Marshal's Stand. Or, you can get a flight there from Doras in Orgrimmar.

Destiny calls!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Un'Goro Crater!
passages.text: Are you here to help?

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Un'Goro Crater!
passages.text: Welcome, <class>. My scientists and explorers will be glad to have your help.

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Silithus!
passages.text:
All able-bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold. You are to aid our Cenarion allies in their battle to turn back Twilight's Hammer. Cho'Gall's minions must not be allowed to dominate Silithus!

You can reach Silithus by taking the northwestern road out of Un'Goro Crater. Or, you can get a flight there from Doras in Orgrimmar.

Destiny calls!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Silithus!
passages.text: You look like help.

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Silithus!
passages.text: Welcome to Cenarion Hold.

passages.title: Writings of the Void
passages.text:
The scrolls are vague and appear to be a piece of a much larger puzzle, but if you are not mistaken, they seem to reveal some of the steps on the path to becoming a demon hunter.

The dark oaths and rituals necessary for becoming a demon hunter are frowned on by most of the night elves, so this is likely something they would be very interested in keeping quiet.

Ranger Glynda Nal'Shea will know what to do with these scrolls.

passages.title: Writings of the Void
passages.text: How can I help you, <class>?

passages.title: Writings of the Void
passages.text:
Where did you find these?! You haven't shown them to anyone else, have you?

I apologize. You took me off guard. Telarius was a very powerful Demon Hunter, but he was slain during a confrontation with the warden, Maeiv, many years ago. You are fortunate that his ghost was only a shade of his former power. I wonder how many have found their way to him in those ruins.

I will see to it that these scrolls make their way to the high priestess immediately. Thank you, <name>.

passages.title: Scalding Signs
passages.text:
The cauldron looked like it contained concentrated material. If the Winterfall are diluting this stuff directly in the springs, contamination could build up over time... and then the dilution would be less and less effective.

The spring to the northeast has boiled over with elementals. I thought it was because of the cataclysm, but their appearance could be a reaction to this.

Could you check them for corruption? Hunt a few and bring me any bits of green foreign material they leave behind.

passages.title: Scalding Signs
passages.text: What did you find?

passages.title: Scalding Signs
passages.text: That's quite a bit of it... the Winterfall are slipping further and further. And now we'll have to worry about the other wildlife as well, in time.

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Stonetalon Mountains!
passages.text:
All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Blood Guard Aldo Rockrain at Silverwind Refuge in Ashenvale. The Horde forces in Stonetalon need your help to drive back the Alliance invaders and protect our people. The blood guard will direct you to the border of Stonetalon.

To reach Silverwind Refuge, travel into the heart of Ashenvale and join our forces by the lake.

Destiny calls!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Stonetalon Mountains!
passages.text: So you're to deploy to Stonetalon? Good, we'll need your abilities to defeat the Alliance there.

passages.title: Hero's Call: Stonetalon Mountains!
passages.text:
By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Huntress Jalin at Stardust Spire in Ashenvale.

The Horde's forces are poised to push into Stonetalon and they must be opposed! You can reach Stardust Spire by traveling to the southern part of Ashenvale Forest, near the border with Stonetalon.

For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Stonetalon Mountains!
passages.text: The Horde has bored a giant pass into the mountains, and we have few enough sentinels to spare. We have to find a way to stop them!

passages.title: Doin' De E'ko Magic
passages.text:
Mau'ari been makin' charms from da spirits of de wilds here for years now. Mau'ari just PLUCK de E'ko right outta de animals, and make charms for de kids, and de adventurers.

Ovah to de east, dere be a tall hill surrounded by de shardtooth bears. Up on de hill be Rimepelt, de oldest bear in de woods.

Mau'ari need dat bear for her magic. You bring me de bear's big ol' heart.

passages.title: Doin' De E'ko Magic
passages.text: You got de bear? Let's see de bear.

passages.title: Doin' De E'ko Magic
passages.text: Dis is nice, big heart! If you be interested, Mau'ari tell ya how I be gettin' de E'ko....

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Southern Barrens!
passages.text:
All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Nura Pathfinder at the High Road in the Southern Barrens. With the recent Alliance victories in the Barrens, our enemies are threatening to cut our supply lines and leave our warriors stranded. We must act!

To reach the High Road, travel east from Stonetalon Mountains. If necessary, you can get a flight there from Doras in Orgrimmar.

Destiny calls!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Southern Barrens!
passages.text: We must act quickly.

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Southern Barrens!
passages.text: You've no doubt seen what the Alliance has done to the Barrens, <class>. If we don't act, there may not be a Horde presence here much longer.

passages.title: Hero's Call: Southern Barrens!
passages.text:
By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Commander Walpole at Stonetalon Pass in the Southern Barrens.

Our brave soldiers have made tremendous gains in the Barrens, but they have paid a heavy price! Your efforts are needed to consolidate our gains. You can reach the Southern Barrens from the Stonetalon Mountains by traveling southeast through Greatwood Vale.

For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Southern Barrens!
passages.text: We face heavy Horde counterattacks daily, <class>. We need every pair of hands we can get to keep them at bay.

passages.title: Hero's Call: Southern Barrens!
passages.text:
By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Dockmaster Lewis near Northwatch Hold.

Our brave soldiers have made tremendous gains in the Barrens, but they have paid a heavy price! Your efforts are needed to consolidate our gains. You can reach the docks outside Northwatch Hold by taking a boat from Booty Bay to Ratchet and traveling south along the coast.

For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Southern Barrens!
passages.text: We're facing heavy resistance from the Horde, <class>. Any reinforcements are welcome.

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Dustwallow Marsh!
passages.text:
All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Krog at Brackenwall Village. The marsh is overrun with enemies of many kinds and the Alliance forces there are dangerously strong.

You can travel to Dustwallow Marsh by following the path from the eastern part of the Southern Barrens toward Brackenwall Village. Or, you can get a flight there from Doras in Orgrimmar.

Destiny calls!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Dustwallow Marsh!
passages.text: Aka'Magosh, <class>.

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Dustwallow Marsh!
passages.text: If we can get things straightened out here, we have a chance to strike at the Alliance while most of their forces are busy in the Barrens.

passages.title: Breaking the Hand
passages.text:
We must break the fingers of the Stormpike if we are to stop their incursion.

<Cromush hands you a small package.>

Within this package are four high-yield goblin explosives. You are to infiltrate each of the four fingers - Sofera's Naze, Corrahn's Dagger, the Headland and Gavin's Naze - and plant a goblin pocket-nuke at each.

Once you have done that - as well as all that Melisara asks of you - return to me.

passages.title: Breaking the Hand
passages.text: Have you planted the pocket-nukes?

passages.title: Breaking the Hand
passages.text: Once Melisara is through with you we will detonate the explosives!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Bloodmyst Isle!
passages.text:
By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Vorkhan the Elekk Herder at Kessel's Crossing.

The people of Bloodmyst need your help to deal with treacherous blood elves and dangerous creatures loose on the island. You can reach Kessel's Crossing on Bloodmyst Isle by taking the bridge north from Azuremyst Isle.

For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Bloodmyst Isle!
passages.text: So you're here to help? Well, there's plenty to do...

passages.title: Hero's Call: Redridge Mountains!
passages.text:
By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report Watch Captain Parker at Tower Watch in the Redridge Mountains.

Captain Parker's forces have come under attack from marauding gnolls and orcs. The people of Lakewood are in peril and your aid is needed to safeguard them. Travel east from the border of Elwynn Forest and into the Three Corners area of Redridge to reach Tower Watch.

For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Redridge Mountains!
passages.text:
Heard Westfall was in some deep doody.

<Parker doesn't even turn to face you.>

Well, we got our own set of problems here. See them gnolls out there? Looks like they're actin' up again. I don't like it. Don't like it one bit.

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Silverpine Forest!
passages.text:
All able-bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Grand Executor Mortuus at Forsaken High Command in Silverpine Forest.

Now, more than ever, your help is needed in routing the enemy infestation of the region and conquering the port of Gilneas!

To reach Forsaken High Command you must travel south through Tirisfal Glades and enter Silverpine Forest. From there, follow the road south until you reach Forsaken High Command.

 Destiny calls!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Silverpine Forest!
passages.text: Most excellent! A new recruit has arrived. There is much to do... much to do I say.

passages.title: The Bogpaddle Bullet
passages.text:
I've heard stories about a road to the Swamp of Sorrows. Mysterious tales of a meandering mountain pathway that completely bypasses Redridge and poops you right out into Bogpaddle!

If you run out of things to do, I suppose you'll have to leave. And we'll all be sad. When you do leave, talk to Sharon Boomgetter in the southeastern corner of the Steppes. She'll give you a ride.

<Oralius tilts his head, as if listening to something.>

Winky? WINKY! NO!

passages.title: The Bogpaddle Bullet
passages.text:
Time is money, <class>... and I've got plenty of each.

What can I do for you?

passages.title: The Bogpaddle Bullet
passages.text:
You're quite the <race>, aren't you? Look at you... you're all grown up already. And we only just met!

I know how it'll go... soon you'll run out of things to do here at Flame Crest. You'll promise to come back. But you never will.

Kibler's seen it all before.

When you do leave, talk to Sharon Boomgetter in the southeastern corner of the Steppes. She'll give you a ride on the bullet.

What? Oh, it's just a rocket. Perfectly safe.

passages.title: The Bogpaddle Bullet
passages.text:
Time is money, <class>... and I've got plenty of each.

What can I do for you?

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Hillsbrad Foothills!
passages.text:
All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to High Executor Darthalia at Southpoint Gate in Hillsbrad Foothills. The Forsaken war machine marches ever onward, securing Lordaeron for the Horde!

To reach Southpoint Gate you must follow the road south through Silverpine Forest and take the east fork leading into Hillsbrad Foothills.

Onward, <brother/sister>! Destiny calls!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Hillsbrad Foothills!
passages.text: I was wondering when reinforcements would show up. Suit up, <name>. It's time to dispense some justice!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Western Plaguelands!
passages.text:
All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Koltira Deathweaver at Andorhal.

The Alliance forces are advancing into the ruined city of Andorhal, seeking to claim it for themselves. We must counter them before they can gain a foothold there!

Cross the Bulwark at the eastern end of Tirisfal Glades and follow the roads southeast to Andorhal and meet up with our forces there.

Destiny calls!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Western Plaguelands!
passages.text: Is this all the warchief can spare? Don't worry, you'll be put to good use.

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Eastern Plaguelands!
passages.text:
All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Fiona on the east bank of the Thondroril River.

The Argent Crusade has reinforced its presence in the Plaguelands and it needs your help to consolidate its victories.

Cross the Thondroril River at the eastern border of the Western Plaguelands and look for Fiona on the far bank.

Destiny calls!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Eastern Plaguelands!
passages.text: Perhaps you can help, <class>.

passages.title: Hero's Call: Eastern Plaguelands!
passages.text:
By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Fiona on the east bank of the Thondroril River.

The Argent Crusade needs your help to win back the Eastern Plaguelands from the grasp of the Scourge.

To reach the Eastern Plaguelands, cross the Thondroril River from the Western Plaguelands and look for Fiona on the eastern bank.

For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Eastern Plaguelands!
passages.text: Perhaps you can help, <class>.

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Searing Gorge!
passages.text:
All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Jack Rockleg at Thorium Advance.

The Shattered Hand reports that the Dark Iron dwarves of the Searing Gorge seem to be preparing for something. Your duty is to learn all you can about their scheming and put a halt to it.

You can reach the Searing Gorge by following the road west from the Badlands.

Destiny calls!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Searing Gorge!
passages.text: We, too, are suspicious of the Dark Irons' recent activities.

passages.title: Hero's Call: Searing Gorge!
passages.text:
By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Jack Rockleg at Thorium Advance.

SI:7 reports that the Dark Iron dwarves of the Searing Gorge seem to be preparing to attack. Your duty is to learn all you can about their scheming and put a halt to it.

You can reach the Searing Gorge by following the road west from the Badlands.

For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Searing Gorge!
passages.text: We, too, are suspicious of the Dark Irons.

passages.title: Krazzworks
passages.text:
This new shredder design is tops, <name>. Tops! Next step is to protect my intellectual property. There are patents to file, traders to mark, ceases to desist. Oh, and the bribes!

Here, take this patent application to Captain Krazz at the Krazzworks. He survived the destruction of his zeppelin, so he's probably hungry for new business opportunities.

The Krazzworks is due north of here, atop a perfectly safe mountain peak. Go ahead, kid. Chop chop!

passages.title: Krazzworks
passages.text: I know you! You were on the Zeppelin with me on the way in.

passages.title: Krazzworks
passages.text:
What's this? The "<name>-o-matic:" a shredder with an integrated missile platform?

Bah! Already patented by Labor Captain Grabbit in Azshara. Worthless!

What I really need is a machine that knocks dwarves from the sky.

passages.title: Pool Pony Rescue
passages.text:
This jerk across from me is getting all of our people killed!

Brett "the Bummer" unpacked the Krazzworks in the wrong place and now it's highly unstable. The explosions from the instability are throwing our laborers off of the platforms and into the water below.

You don't mind flying down there and rescuing them with some pool ponies, <name>?

passages.title: Pool Pony Rescue
passages.text: Maybe you'd be willing to fly back down there and rescue a few more of our laborers?

passages.title: Pool Pony Rescue
passages.text: Thanks, <name>! Now if we could just get the Krazzworks stable so that our people would stop being thrown off of the platforms.

passages.title: Aid of the Frostwolf
passages.text:
I will study the Stormpike battle plans and prepare for an assault. I need you to go to Alterac Valley and enlist the aid of the Frostwolf Clan: the very clan of our former warchief, Thrall. They will help us battle the Stormpike dwarves! Together, we will crush the invaders and see them driven out of Lordaeron for good!

Go now, <name>. Alterac Valley is northeast of Tarren Mill. Find Voggah Deathgrip and tell him that the Horde requires the aid of the Frostwolf!

LOK'TAR!

passages.title: Aid of the Frostwolf
passages.text: You come from Tarren Mill? You reek of death...

passages.title: Reprisal
passages.text:
I happen to know some Alliance scum that have somethin' coming to them. And they have something that belongs to us. I've authorized an all out assault on Highbank.

Board the Skyshredder and join the assault. Patch will fill you in on the details as you arrive.

passages.title: Reprisal
passages.text: Good to have you, <name>. Ready to sew some chaos?

passages.title: Off The Wall
passages.text:
You look like a <man/girl> who likes some action. Get on one of those turrets and lay waste to their defenses on the wall.

Be quick about it, will you? Before we go up in a big ball of fire preferably.

passages.title: Off The Wall
passages.text: Marvels of modernized goblin destructivity, eh? I love these babies.

passages.title: Parting Packages
passages.text:
I'm sure Patch has some grand scheme in mind, but this wouldn't be an assault if we didn't leave some explosive presents behind.

Get down there and plant some of these explosives on the boat, in the keep entrance, and in one of those northern towers. That should be enough to leave them reeling.

We're heading down to the ground as well. Meet us at the eastern tower when you're through.

passages.title: Parting Packages
passages.text: Did you share the love?

passages.title: Parting Packages
passages.text:
Hahah! Wonderful show.

That should be a proper welcome to the highlands.

passages.title: Krazz Works!
passages.text:
That's it. We're all wrapped up. Let's ship out.

Newt's got some gyrocopters tethered at the top of the tower. Go meet up with her for a quick trip back to Krazzworks. We'll mop up here.

passages.title: Krazz Works!
passages.text: Tell me you came through? You always come through. Show me my beauty!

passages.title: Krazz Works!
passages.text:
Now that's what I wanted to see! I'll have this fleet back up in no time with this beauty.

You know just how I like it, <name>. I know just how you like it too - take this.

passages.title: Aiming High
passages.text:
Lookie here, <name>. I found the biggest gun in Highbank! We're gonna try a technique handed down ta me by my pappy, from his pappy, from his pappy, shortly before he got blowed up.

It's called the "<class>-shot."

You take a <race> <class>, and load <him/her> inta a gigantic cannon, and then ya - oh relax. This usually works.

Take these explosives, then wait here next ta me. As soon as that blimpy comes around I'll blast you onto tha deck. Plant the explosives in 'er belly and, oh I dunno, make it up as you go.

passages.title: Aiming High
passages.text: Ain't no problem a bomb can't solve.

passages.title: Aiming High
passages.text:
<Flintlocke wipes tears from his eyes.>

Oh, <name>. <name>!

That ... were beautiful.

passages.title: Kurdran's Waitin'
passages.text:
It looks like the attack stopped, <name>. Which is a shame, 'cuz we never got to use the <class>-rocket.

Anyways, Kurdran Wildhammer is up in the top of the keep an' I'm sure he'll be wantin' to gives ya a hero's welcome. Yeh earned it! Go talk to 'im!

I'll move on ahead and scout out the beach.

passages.title: Kurdran's Waitin'
passages.text:
The King himself sent you? Good to hear that Stormwind is secure.

I was expecting more in the way of troops, but word is that the Alliance fleet was ambushed by the Horde on the way here. They gave as good as they got, but the fleet is in shambles.

If we're to make any forward progress here in the Highlands, we're going to need the help of heroes like you.

passages.title: Infiltration
passages.text:
For your next mission I want you to travel west to the Headland and infiltrate the Stormpike training grounds. Though there are hundreds of Stormpike trainees there, one of my banshees will disguise you to look like one of the humans captured earlier, allowing you to walk freely among the enemy.

Enter the Headland and find the Stormpike instructors. Once found, coerce them into attacking you! When they attack, kill them. With their instructors dead, they will be unable to train more soldiers!

passages.title: Infiltration
passages.text:
<Melisara's voice pervades your thoughts.>

Perfectly handled. You could easily be a Deathstalker. And what could they have even done to you? You acted in self defense!

Now to deal with the final finger.

passages.title: The Shadow Grave
passages.text:
I'm pleased to see that you're up and walking around, <name>. You've held up nicely, especially after being dead for so long!

Others weren't as lucky. If you wouldn't mind, I need you to fetch my embalming fluid and some twine to stitch up these bodies. You'll find both in the Shadow Grave, the building just behind me.

Here, Darnell will join you. He knows the way.

passages.title: The Shadow Grave
passages.text: You will find the items within the Shadow Grave.  I believe I left them on my work table.

passages.title: The Shadow Grave
passages.text:
Exactly what I needed.  You'll be an asset to the Forsaken, <name>.

You know, word has it that you were quite the <class> in your previous life.  Perhaps I should assign you to a more exciting task.

passages.title: Harrison Jones and the Temple of Uldum
passages.text:
After all we've been through, it looks like everything's actually coming together!

We're just steps away from the coffer... I've researched the codes to reveal it... Schnottz thinks we're dead....

You know, we might just pull this off after all!

passages.title: Harrison Jones and the Temple of Uldum
passages.text:
Lucky fer you, this ol' dwarf's still got a few tricks up his sleeve!

Heehee! ...shoulda seen tha look on yer faces!

passages.title: Turning the Earth
passages.text:
Despite their corruption and madness, the Winterfall barely cling to their shamanic powers. It disturbs me to see the power of the elements used by them to harm my tribe and other innocents.

We will turn their totems against them! Take my own totem with you into Winterfall Village. Use its powers on the Winterfall's totems from afar, and the fury of the earth will be unleashed on all nearby!

Needless to say... keep a safe distance!

passages.title: Turning the Earth
passages.text: May the Winterfall never threaten the Timbermaw again. Thank you, <name>.

passages.title: Stormpike Apocalypse
passages.text:
Before we continue, let us have a moment of silence for our fallen brother, Orkus, for without him, we would have been destroyed by the Stormpike onslaught. This is for you, brother!

<Cromush takes a knee.>

Now, <name>, do not think that I forgot your part in all of this! That is why you get the honors of detonating the goblin pocket-nukes.

Are you ready? FOR THE HORDE!

passages.title: Stormpike Apocalypse
passages.text:
With the fingers destroyed and the hand shattered, the Stormpike will have no choice but to scurry back to their cave in Alterac Valley.

<Cromush spits.>

Warchief Hellscream will hear about your bravery, <name>.

And rest assured that he will know of the Frostwolf clan's treason!

passages.title: Eastpoint Tower
passages.text:
Our outpost in the southeast is having some problems. I don't have any details other than... well, let me just read from the latest letter:

"The orcs have grown petulant. Send help or I will have them beaten with reeds."

That's it. It was sent from our chief psylosopher, Nils Beerot. Yea, I have no idea what that means either. Could you please head to Eastpoint Tower and find out what he needs? I can't take any more of these cryptic letters!

Just head south and then follow the road east.

passages.title: Eastpoint Tower
passages.text:
That imbecile finally sent help, did he? These two orcs are a lost cause. They are stricken with something that I have termed "Durnholde Syndrome." They were both locked up for so long that they grew an affinity for their captors. Now they sit upon my couch with their big, iron balls and cry.

Hopefully you will prove to be more useful.

passages.title: Chop Chop
passages.text:
I deal in small timber plenty, but full trees? That's a novelty item. Kinda like those boulders.

Maybe you can do me another favor. Just west of town there's a grove of trees overlooking Lake Kel'theril. I don't know if it's the spooks there, or all that elf magic junk strewn around the place, but we've been getting treants and lashers wandering around there recently.

They're making it a real pain to chop wood over there, so why don't you chop some of them? Bring the wood from the treants back here.

passages.title: Chop Chop
passages.text: Show me the lumber.

passages.title: Chop Chop
passages.text: Not a bad haul. Maybe we should look into growin' those treants instead...

passages.title: Ice Delivery
passages.text:
Alright, one high-quality, pure grade Instant Ice Block!

I tried selling these to people for protection for a while. Y'know, like that trick you see mages pull? Couldn't figure out the whole "breathing" thing, though.

passages.title: Ice Delivery
passages.text: Ah, you're back!

passages.title: Ice Delivery
passages.text: Perfect. Now you'll see what really matters in a weapon... finesse.

passages.title: Ursius
passages.text:
I've heard it said that you are what you eat. I don't know if I believe that, but if it's true... I'd prefer to eat the strongest creature that I can find.

Ursius is the largest bear in Winterspring. He eats first when his pack of shardtooth brings down a chimaera or an owlbear. He claims the most comfortable cave in the shardtooth-held lands. And he has... considerable influence with the shardtooth females.

He is my kind of bear.

I want to eat him.

His cave is near the maulers. Good luck!

passages.title: Ursius
passages.text:
Ursius is... not delicious.  He tastes like a combination of pinecones and curdled milk, only... oilier.

Are you sure this is Ursius?  The big bear?  In the cave?

This is horrible.  It honestly tastes like his meat has been steeped in urine.

I don't feel like I'm getting any stronger.

Ugh.  It's really bad.  Do you want to try some?

passages.title: Shy-Rotam
passages.text:
In northern Winterspring, great cats assemble around a large landmark called Frostsaber Rock. The leader of these cats is known by the name Shy-Rotam. Defeating the matriarch of the frostsabers would grant you much respect in the eyes of your fellow <race>.

Go again to the harsh wilds, and once there, gather sacred meat from the frostsabers. Find the stone of Shy-Rotam, and place it there. Placing the meat of her kin before her will summon Shy-Rotam, in anger.

Be ready for her fury, and defeat her.

passages.title: A Special Surprise
passages.text:
We got here, tore the place apart, and headed toward the prison house. We weren't expecting what we found in there, <name>. Seems the Crusade's been real busy. That whole thing is full of Argent Dawn prisoners. Most of them were already dead by the time we arrived, but a few were still breathing.

I was about to go in there and execute the rest of them, but I think you should have the honors. In particular, there's a real feisty worgen in there that I think you'll take great pleasure in executing.

passages.title: A Special Surprise
passages.text: How does it feel?

passages.title: A Special Surprise
passages.text: Felt good, didn't it? You're not one of them anymore, <name>. You're Scourge. You're one of us. Forever...

passages.title: A Special Surprise
passages.text:
We got here, tore the place apart, and headed toward the prison house. We weren't expecting what we found in there, <name>. Seems the Crusade's been real busy. That whole thing is full of Argent Dawn prisoners. Most of them were already dead by the time we arrived, but a few were still breathing.

I was about to go in there and execute the rest of them, but I think you should have the honors. In particular, there's a real feisty goblin in there that I think you'll take great pleasure in executing.

passages.title: A Special Surprise
passages.text: How does it feel?

passages.title: A Special Surprise
passages.text: Felt good, didn't it? You're not one of them anymore, <name>. You're Scourge. You're one of us. Forever...

passages.title: Wild, Wild, Wildhammer Wedding
passages.text:
We are ready to begin, <name>!

But I have it on good authority that the Twilight's Hammer may try to disrupt the ceremony, so as to demoralize and destroy the Wildhammer. Things could get dangerous!

For this reason, I will be performing the ceremony myself, so that I can keep the bride and groom close to me. Sound like a plan? Good!

Since her father is dead and her brother the best man, Fanny has asked that you walk her down the aisle. What an honor! Talk to me when you're ready to begin.

passages.title: Wild, Wild, Wildhammer Wedding
passages.text: It's a nice day for a Wild wedding...

passages.title: Wild, Wild, Wildhammer Wedding
passages.text:
We did it, <name>! Fighting that ... thing side-by-side really brought all the Wildhammers together. The heads of the families are more united than I've ever seen them. Drink up, <name>, and celebrate!!

Of course, our work is only beginning. I'll rally our new Wildhammer reinforcements with the rest of the Alliance and prepare to storm the Twilight Bastion.

I'm sure we'll meet again soon.

passages.title: A Huge Problem
passages.text:
We finally capture this godforsaken rock and then we find out that there is a huge ettin roaming around, taking out our sentry patrols!

<name>, I need you to round up a few friends and take that ettin down. We can't have a beast like that roaming around, wreaking havoc.

Stay alert, reports from the front say that he is carrying a huge tree as a weapon, and he is not afraid to use it.

passages.title: A Huge Problem
passages.text: Did you find problim yet?  Pretty hard to miss that guy with how huge he is.

passages.title: A Huge Problem
passages.text: You actually killed him?!  I can't believe it!

passages.title: Swamp Bait
passages.text:
Supplies are never easy to find in a place like this, <class>. We have been scouting since we captured the island but things are not looking good.

Fortunately, we just received a scouting report that a swamp full of crocs is just west of our base camp here. The hides off those crocs will come in handy for our leatherworkers. Bring back as many as you can.

passages.title: Swamp Bait
passages.text: You cleared out that swamp yet?

passages.title: Swamp Bait
passages.text: Looks like you were able to get the croc hides that we needed.  Thanks <name>, your contributions will not go unnoticed.

passages.title: The Leftovers
passages.text:
We fought hard to capture this island, <race>. We cleared out most of the Alliance filth but I can still smell their foul stench in the air.

I need you to investigate the slagworks, warden's vigil and the ironclad garrison. Kill any Alliance that you find.

You know what they say, the only good Alliance is a dead Alliance!

passages.title: The Leftovers
passages.text: Gah, the smell of their weak bodies is sickening me.

passages.title: The Leftovers
passages.text: Those filthy alliance never stood a chance.  Nice work, <name>.

passages.title: Clearing the Depths
passages.text:
You are a sight for sore eyes, <name>. Now that we have claimed tol barad, the battle has just begun.

We discovered a cell block just east of here that we need you to clear out. Turns out that its chock full of ghosts that have been locked up down there for who knows how long.

Clear out as much as you can and report back to me when you are done.

passages.title: Clearing the Depths
passages.text: You made it back out alive?  You are a stronger man than I, <name>.

passages.title: The Imprisoned Archmage
passages.text:
We have been trying to clear out the Cursed Depths cellblock since we landed on Tol Barad. It seems that everytime we get close, that archmage shows up and pushes us back.

Now that we have claimed the island, it's time we take another shot. Head down there and bring me back his staff as proof that you have finished the job.

passages.title: The Imprisoned Archmage
passages.text: Have you been able to take out the Archmage?

passages.title: The Imprisoned Archmage
passages.text: Galus is dead?  Fantastic work <name>, now we can send down the cleanup crew and get that cellblock ready for new prisoners.

passages.title: Learning From The Past
passages.text:
Now that we finally have a hold on this wretched island, we can start to investigate how it got in this condition. Some of our troops have discovered journals around the entrance to Cursed Depths cellblock just east of here.

These journals are of particular interest to our elder scribes back at base camp. I need you to recover four of them and bring them back to me as fast as you can.

<name>, be careful down there, that place is crawling with undead.

passages.title: Learning From The Past
passages.text: Were you able to recover the journals?  Reports mentioned that they were sighted both in and out of the cells down there.

passages.title: Learning From The Past
passages.text: These journals are in excellent condition <name>.  We will begin deciphering them immediately.  Only time will tell what secrets they hold.

passages.title: D-Block
passages.text:
Have you heard of the D-Block yet <name>? It's one of the old cellblocks here on the island. Problem is, it's infested with demons. We planned on using it to lock up the leftover Alliance we found on the island, but that is not going to happen in its current state.

I need you to head down there and clear those demons out. Report back to me when you are done.

passages.title: D-Block
passages.text: D-Block is all clear?  Good work, <name>.  We will send down a crew to start cleaning up right away.

passages.title: Svarnos
passages.text:
Excellent work on the island capture, <class>. Now that we have claimed the island, we need to make these cellblocks useable for prisoners. D-Block has been especially hard to clear out. Unfortunately it has become overrun with demons of all sorts.

We have been able to thin out the demons but a large core hound has broken its way out of its cell and is wreaking havoc down there. I need you to kill him and bring back his collar.

passages.title: Svarnos
passages.text: Is the core hound dead?

passages.title: Svarnos
passages.text: Svarnos is finally dead?  Looks like we can finally get to work setting up that cellblock then.  Thank you <name>.

passages.title: Cursed Shackles
passages.text:
Have you been down in the D-Block yet, <name>? Every time we clear that infested cellblock out, the demons seem to return rather quickly. We learned that they regenerate from the cursed shackles scattered around the area. That's where you come in to the picture <name>.

I need you to retrieve as many of those shackles as you can and bring them back to me. We will destroy them immediately.

passages.title: Cursed Shackles
passages.text: Did you find many shackles?  Reports mentioned that they were all over the place down there.

passages.title: Cursed Shackles
passages.text: The shackles!  We will begin the process of destroying these shackles immediately <name>.  Thank you for your help.

passages.title: Hero's Call: Burning Steppes!
passages.text:
By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to John J. Keeshan at Flamestar Post.

Your aid is urgently needed to put an end to the Blackrock orc menace!

You can reach the Burning Steppes by traveling south from the Searing Gorge through Blackrock Mountain. Look for Flamestar Post on the far side of the mountain.

For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Burning Steppes!
passages.text: It's time for the Blackrock orcs to feel the full wrath of the Alliance. They will pay for what they've done.

passages.title: Prison Revolt
passages.text:
We have the island, now we need to put the resources here to work. We found an abandoned cellblock just southwest of here and we need you to go check it out <name>.

Reports have come back that it is overrun with prisoners that have been stuck down there for years. Do whatever you need to do to clear that place out. Report back to me when you are done.

passages.title: Prison Revolt
passages.text: You cleared that area out?  Looks like you might be more useful to us that we thought, <race>.

passages.title: The Warden
passages.text:
We have almost finished clearing out the revolting prisoners in the hole, but one last problem remains. The warden.

Warden Silva is their master and they will do anything for him. If we take him out, we take them all out. Finish him off and bring me back his keys. We can use those keys to explore deeper into the cellblock and possibly gain access to the water supply here on the island.

passages.title: The Warden
passages.text: Is the warden dead yet?

passages.title: The Warden
passages.text: Ahh, the wardens key's.  Another job well done, <name>.  These will come in very handy.

passages.title: Food From Below
passages.text:
Supplies are running low here in camp, <name>. We have recently learned that the cellblock just southwest of here has a number of rations remaining from years of use. We need you to gather as many of those as you can and bring them back to camp.

One more thing, the entire cellblock is overrun with prisoners so be careful.

passages.title: Food From Below
passages.text: Were you able to recover the rations?  Reports mentioned that they could be found all over the place down there.

passages.title: Food From Below
passages.text: These rations will really help the troops out <name>.  Thank you for your help.

passages.title: Captain P. Harris
passages.text:
The Cape of Lost Hope has been a sore in our side for weeks here on Tol Barad. Half of our supply ships end up on the rocks down there.

To make matters worse, it's been overrun by a gang of undead sailors. We have tried thinning the ranks, but they just seem to keep coming back. Our last resort is to try and take out the captain that they report to. You should be able to find him on a ship, just off the shoreline.

Oh, and I hope you are not too scared of sharks.

passages.title: Captain P. Harris
passages.text: You did it!  Maybe we can finally get some ships into port now.  Thank you <name>.

passages.title: Rattling Their Cages
passages.text:
We have been having issues with the undead down at the Cape of Lost Hope for a while now. Every time a new ship wrecks, they end up getting more undead to join their ranks.

Can you do us a favor and thin out the ranks up there? I know you won't be able to kill them all, but anything you can do will help at this point.

Keep an eye out for alliance, we have been getting reports of them ambushing the beach lately.

passages.title: Rattling Their Cages
passages.text: Nice work on the undead up there <name>.  We really appreciate the help.

passages.title: Boosting Morale
passages.text:
Morale is low these days, <name>. We make every effort we can to keep the troops in high spirits but we are running low on our main supply of morale booster... rum.

I have been getting reports from our infantry to the south that the shipwrecks on the Cape of Lost Hope still have a good supply of southsea rum in their wrecked hulls. Can you head up there and investigate?

Bring back any rum you can find.

passages.title: Boosting Morale
passages.text: Were you able to recover the rum?  I would try but I am deathly afraid of the water.  Not to mention that crazy shark.

passages.title: Boosting Morale
passages.text: This rum will really help us out, <name>.  They might not feel great in the morning but at least they will go to sleep happy.

passages.title: Shark Tank
passages.text:
I hate sharks. All of my troops hate sharks too. This is where you come in, <name>.

I need you to head up to the Cape of Lost Hope and take out a huge shark named Tank. Tank is not to be trifled with so I would bring a few friends if I were you.

passages.title: Shark Tank
passages.text: No way, you actually killed him?  We are having shark tacos tonight for sure!

passages.title: Claiming The Keep
passages.text:
Have you seen the keep on the north side of the island, <name>? That is where Keep Lord Farson runs his operation from.

Farson has a small group of dedicated followers and they have been giving us trouble since we got here. We sent a small group to investigate and they reported back on his exact position within the keep.

Can you finish him off for us?

passages.title: Claiming The Keep
passages.text: You killed him?  We have been trying to take that guy out for weeks!  We thank you, <name>.

passages.title: Thinning the Brood
passages.text:
We have been trying to get a foothold in The Darkwood for weeks now but that forest is infested with spiders. Do me a favor and see if you can thin them out enough for us to set up an attack.

Careful out there, I have heard reports of Alliance troops nearby earlier in the week.

passages.title: Thinning the Brood
passages.text: Nice work on those spiders <name>.  At this rate, we will be taking that forest in no time.

passages.title: A Sticky Task
passages.text:
Finding supplies on the island has been difficult, to say the least.

Fortunately, we have found a good supply of silk in The Darkwood, just north of here. The bad part of this story is that the silk comes from the glands on Broodmother spiders. I need you to gather 4 of these for me.

That should be just enough to finish up this last set of shirts.

passages.title: A Sticky Task
passages.text: Were you able to gather the sticky silk glands?

passages.title: A Sticky Task
passages.text: These glands will do nicely.  We are grateful for your help, <name>.

passages.title: Leave No Weapon Behind
passages.text:
Battle supplies are hard to come by on this rock. Every time we hold off another Alliance attack, it feels like we are fighting with sticks and stones.

Reports have come in that Keep Lord Farson on the north side of the island has a large stockpile of rifles that we could use. Can you head down there and check it out?

Be careful <name>, Farson's followers will do anything to protect him.

passages.title: Leave No Weapon Behind
passages.text: Any luck with those rifles?

passages.title: Leave No Weapon Behind
passages.text: Thanks for rounding these up for us, <name>.  Kind of hard to fight a battle without any guns.

passages.title: Not The Friendliest Town
passages.text:
Have you been up to Rustberg Village yet <name>? I would suggest you bring a sharpened blade if you are heading that direction.

The folks in that town look alright but something suspicious is going on in there. Reports have been coming in that they are picking off our soldiers left and right. We have had just about enough of that, so I need you to head down there and do a little cleaning house for us.

Take down as many as you can and report back when you are done.

passages.title: Not The Friendliest Town
passages.text: Did you find out what's up with that village?  Something seems off...

passages.title: Not The Friendliest Town
passages.text: Told you that village was full of wackos.  Nice job clearing it out <name>.

passages.title: Teach A Man To Fish.... Or Steal
passages.text:
Rustberg Village. That place is a curse and a blessing for us, <name>. I have no clue where bandits learned to fish as well as they do but I have no time to worry about that now.

I need you to head down there and steal as many of their fish reserves as possible. We have been living off scraps since we retook the island and this is our best chance at some solid food reserves.

Keep an eye out for stealthers up there, reports have told us they are prevalent inside the village walls.

passages.title: Teach A Man To Fish.... Or Steal
passages.text: Were you able to pull off the heist and get us some fish?

passages.title: Teach A Man To Fish.... Or Steal
passages.text: These fish will do nicely, <name>.  Keeping the troops fed and in good condition is our number one priority and you really came through for us here.

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Northern Stranglethorn!
passages.text:
All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Commander Aggro'gosh at Grom'gol Base Camp. The commander requires your aid to keep the supply routes open and free of interference from the local inhabitants and the troublesome Alliance.

To reach Grom'gol, you can take the zeppelin from Orgrimmar's eastern zeppelin tower or the one near Undercity.

Destiny calls!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Northern Stranglethorn!
passages.text: At last, the Warchief's reinforcements have arrived.

passages.title: The Forgotten
passages.text:
Many soldiers died on this island <name>. It is only fair that we pay our respects to them in any way that we can.

I need you to travel to Forgotten Hill, due west of here and release our brothers in arms' tortured souls away from this place. Do be careful over there, reports of undead have been ongoing in the area.

passages.title: The Forgotten
passages.text: Were you able to release our forgotten brothers in arms?

passages.title: The Forgotten
passages.text: May their souls rest in peace.

passages.title: Salvaging the Remains
passages.text:
Forgotten Hill has been overrun with zombies and ghouls ever since we reclaimed this wretched isle. We have tried to clear them out many times but they always seem to come back.

One of our lieutenants recommended taking the ghouls' bones when we kill them in hopes that they can't reincarnate overnight. Think you can help us out with this one?

passages.title: Salvaging the Remains
passages.text: Were you able to recover the femur bones?  Better for you to try than me.

passages.title: Salvaging the Remains
passages.text: I didn't think you would be able to do it, <name>.  You are just full of surprises aren't you?

passages.title: First Lieutenant Connor
passages.text:
The first time I heard about Lt. Connor, I was just a young recruit in Ragefire Chasm. None of us could believe he ended up here on Tol Barad. Sadly, he still roams these wretched islands, wreaking havoc on our troops morale.

I need you to put an end to his misery... and ours.

passages.title: First Lieutenant Connor
passages.text: Hey, you made it back alive!  Can't say you were the first one to try this task, but you are definitely the first one to make it back alive.

passages.title: Magnets, How Do They Work?
passages.text:
Getting useful machine parts out here on the island has been difficult, <name>. We have been trying to repair the broken siege engines here in camp but we keep running out of useful parts.

Our second regiment reported some wrecked out siege engines in a old battlefield to the west. Maybe we could find some parts over there?

You are going to have trouble finding anything in that old battlefield so take this magnetized scrap collector and put it to some good use.

passages.title: Magnets, How Do They Work?
passages.text: Did that magnet contraptaion actually work?

passages.title: Magnets, How Do They Work?
passages.text: These parts will really help us out, <name>!  Who would have thought you can find stuff this useful in all that old junk?

passages.title: Finish The Job
passages.text: We have been trying to collect useful scraps from the front all week. Every time we gather a batch to bring back to camp, we get assaulted by the restless soldiers in the area. Can you head over there and clear them out?

passages.title: Finish The Job
passages.text: Were you able to finish the job?

passages.title: Finish The Job
passages.text: It's about time someone took those guys out.

passages.title: Watch Out For Splinters!
passages.text:
Have you been over to the Wellson Shipyard yet, <name>? Best to stay away from there unless you have a good reason to venture in. Unfortunately, that is exactly what I need you to do.

You see, we have been short on supplies ever since we recaptured the island. That ghost ridden shipyard is overflowing with lumber but every time we send an escort to recover the lumber, they never make it back.

Can you help us out?

passages.title: Watch Out For Splinters!
passages.text: Did the ghosts scare you off?

passages.title: Watch Out For Splinters!
passages.text: I didn't think you would be able to do it, <name>.  You are just full of surprises aren't you?

passages.title: WANTED: Foreman Wellson
passages.text:
Foreman Wellson has been a pain in our side since we got here. His shipyard holds a large amount of supplies that would be extremely useful to us... if we could get to them.

He keeps a close watch over his minions and makes it very difficult for us to get a foothold on the shipyard. I need you to take out Wellson for good this time. Be careful <name>, we have been receiving reports of dirty Alliance all around the area.

passages.title: WANTED: Foreman Wellson
passages.text: Great work <name>.  I will report your efforts to our highest in command immediately.

passages.title: Ghostbuster
passages.text:
See that hill with the towers to the northeast? That's Largo's Overlook and it's not a fun place to set up camp next to. We have been dealing with those spirits and spectres ever since we setup camp.

Can you head up there and let them know we don't plan on leaving anytime soon? A few good kills on their ranks should put them in line.

Thanks for your help on this, <name>.

passages.title: Ghostbuster
passages.text: Great work, <name>!  We should not hear from the ghosts again anytime soon.

passages.title: Cannonball!
passages.text:
Largo and his minions have been stealing our supplies ever since we setup camp here. It's frustrating to say the least.

We have heard reports that he is stockpiling cannonballs in the towers overlooking the water up on his overlook. Can you head up there and try to recover some of them for us?

<name>, don't forget to keep a watch out for Alliance too.

passages.title: Cannonball!
passages.text: Did you find the cannonballs?

passages.title: Cannonball!
passages.text: Good job on the recovery effort <name>. These cannonballs should last us a while.

passages.title: Hero's Call: Northern Stranglethorn!
passages.text:
By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Lieutenant Doren at the Rebel Camp.

Years after Colonel Kurzen's treachery against Stormwind, the truth of what happened remains a mystery. Aid the survivors in learning what became of the colonel. Travel south from Duskwood and follow the road west after crossing into the jungle to reach the Rebel Camp.

For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Northern Stranglethorn!
passages.text: Welcome to our camp, <class>, such as it is.

passages.title: Taking the Overlook Back
passages.text:
There is only one way for us to take Largo's Overlook back.

I think you know what we need to do <name>. Largo is pretty paranoid these days so you should be able to find him on top of the tower, looking for his imaginary navy to finally arrive.

passages.title: Taking the Overlook Back
passages.text: Ha, we finally got Largo!  Nice one, <name>.

passages.title: Hero's Call: The Cape of Stranglethorn!
passages.text:
By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Bronwyn Hewstrike at the Explorers' League Digsite.

The Explorers' League expedition needs your help to safeguard its site and findings from marauding ogres. Travel south from Northern Stranglethorn Vale and follow the road to the Explorers' League Digsite.

For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

passages.title: Hero's Call: The Cape of Stranglethorn!
passages.text: It's good to see you here, <class>.

passages.title: Warchief's Command: The Cape of Stranglethorn!
passages.text:
All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Sassy Hardwrench at Hardwrench Hideaway. She requires your help to deal with the pirates and naga who have overrun the jungle.

Travel to Hardwrench Hideaway by heading south from Northern Stranglethorn and looking for the town southwest of the Gurubashi Arena.

Destiny calls!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: The Cape of Stranglethorn!
passages.text: Welcome to Hardwrench Hideaway!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Outland!
passages.text:
All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Lieutenant General Orion at the Stair of Destiny.

Your skills are needed to fight the Burning Legion's presence on the shattered remnants of Outland.

Go to the portal room in Orgrimmar's front gate and talk to the Thrallmar Mage to travel to the Blasted Lands, then walk through the Dark Portal to arrive at the Stair of Destiny.

Destiny calls!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Outland!
passages.text: Prepare yourself for battle. The Horde has need of you here.

passages.title: Spray it Forward
passages.text:
My fellow siblings are already further down in the den trying to deal with these bugs, and they're starting to get overwhelmed. I say it's time to gas the place.

Take these fumigators. Don't go setting them off yourself; it takes a highly trained professional, and proper timing. Just find my sisters and pass them out.

Remma should be positioned closest to the entrance. Head down the corridor and keep to your right once you go down the ramp.

passages.title: Spray it Forward
passages.text: We're bringing out the bug spray, eh? I guess it can't be helped.

passages.title: Spray it Again
passages.text:
I'm gonna start setting this up.

Next one goes to Marcy, further down the den. Head down this corridor here and look for her in the next main chamber.

passages.title: Spray it Again
passages.text: Wasn't expecting to see a stranger down here!

passages.title: Spray it Again
passages.text: Fumigators? From Rinno? Geez...

passages.title: Hero's Call: Outland!
passages.text:
By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Commander Duron in Hellfire Peninsula.

The expeditionary forces require your help to overcome the demonic armies of the Burning Legion! Talk to the Honor Hold Mage in the tall tower in the Mage District to travel to Blasted Lands, then walk through the Dark Portal to arrive at the Stair of Destiny.

For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Outland!
passages.text: The expedition needs your help, <class>.

passages.title: Hero's Call: Borean Tundra!
passages.text:
By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Recruitment Officer Blythe at Valiance Keep in Borean Tundra.

The Valiance Expedition needs your help to keep the forces of the Scourge under control and safeguard civilized lands! Make your way to the Stormwind Docks and take the ship north to Valiance Keep.

For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Borean Tundra!
passages.text: The expedition needs your help, <class>.

passages.title: Spray it One More Time
passages.text:
You'd think Rinno could have sent more than a single <race> down here to give us a hand! That freeloader...

I'm gonna set this up. Head north from this room through the corridor and look for Sana. She's probably gotten herself lost in the last chamber, so check the side passages once you get there.

passages.title: Spray it One More Time
passages.text: What're you doing here?

passages.title: Spray it One More Time
passages.text: Rinno sent you! And you brought... fumigators? Ugh!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Borean Tundra!
passages.text:
All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to the Warsong Recruitment Officer at Warsong Hold.

The Warsong Offensive needs your help to overcome the continued threat from the undead Scourge.

Take the zeppelin to Warsong Hold from Orgrimmar's western zeppelin tower and present yourself to the recruitment officer.

Destiny calls!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Borean Tundra!
passages.text: The Warsong Offensive could use more like you, <class>.

passages.title: Hero's Call: Twilight Highlands!
passages.text:
By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to the throne room in Stormwind Keep.

King Wrynn requires a trustworthy and proven hero for a mission of the utmost importance.

Stormwind Keep can be found in the eastern portion of Stormwind City.

Anyone willing may report to Grand Admiral Jes-Tereth for briefing. For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Twilight Highlands!
passages.text: We are pleased that you have answered our summons, <class>.

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Twilight Highlands!
passages.text:
All able-bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to High Overlord Saurfang in Grommash Hold.

High Overlord Saurfang requires your help to prepare for the glorious assault on the Twilight Highlands and our dual enemies, the Alliance and Twilight's Hammer.

Meet with him in Grommash Hold at the center of Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.

Destiny calls!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Twilight Highlands!
passages.text: Soon, the assault on the Twilight Highlands will begin, and I intend for you to be a part of it.

passages.title: Walk A Mile In Their Shoes
passages.text:
We have sent at least 3 different recon groups to investigate Farson Hold in the last few weeks. Sadly, not one of them has returned back with any info.

At this point, all we can hope is that they are being held alive as prisoners. I need you to infiltrate the keep and help get our soldiers back. This won't be easy <name>, but if anyone can help us, it's you.

passages.title: Walk A Mile In Their Shoes
passages.text: You saved our men!  No words can express our gratitude <name>.

passages.title: Priestess of the Moon
passages.text:
Perhaps you'd be willing to aid us in further pursuing the corruption haunting Shadowglen.

Dentaria Silverglade, Priestess of the Moon, has offered to aid us. You should find her between the two pools just north of our great tree. Circle around the tree to reach her and offer her any help that you can, young <class>.

passages.title: Priestess of the Moon
passages.text: It is good that you've come. It seems your training progresses quickly.

passages.title: The Woodland Protector
passages.text:
I must ask something more dangerous of you. Strange news has traveled to me through the whisperings of the forest spirits. The mysterious woodland protector, Tarindrella, has returned to Shadowglen again.

The dryad's presence has not been felt in the forests since before the blessing of Teldrassil. Something is surely amiss if she has journeyed back to this land.

Seek out Tarindrella in the Shadowthread cave to the north. It is dangerous, but we will be prepared with this antidote just in case.

passages.title: The Woodland Protector
passages.text: I see you found me, young <race>.  Dentaria was wise to have sent you.

passages.title: Precious Waters
passages.text:
Tenaron Stormgrip oversees all that happens in this glade. He presides at the top of Aldrassil.

If you look to your south, you will see the underside of the ramp that leads up to him. Ascend this ramp and complete your training.

It was wonderful to have met you, <name>. I swell with pride knowing that among young night elves, there are some so selfless and full of life as you are. You will do great things for our people. You will do great things for this world.

Until we meet again.

passages.title: Precious Waters
passages.text:
The moonwells hold the waters of the Well of Eternity, the ancient source of magic that has wrought so many horrors upon our world.

The druids take advantage of its properties, the Sentinels revere the wells as shrines to Elune, and now even the returning Highborne look to the wells longingly.

passages.title: Precious Waters
passages.text: So you have heard the first part of the aftermath of the Battle of Mount Hyjal. There is much more for you to learn and the task you have begun here will continue through the rest of your journey through Teldrassil and into Darnassus.

passages.title: Fire From the Sky
passages.text:
The remnants of Schnottz's organization persist here on the Maker's Ascent, making the region deadly to any who draw near.

There's plenty of ammunition, but without a good spotter, I'm just firing blind.

Hop in and give me a hand here. Those soldiers won't know what hit them!

passages.title: Fire From the Sky
passages.text: It's a target-rich environment, <class>.

passages.title: Fire From the Sky
passages.text: The enemy on Maker's Ascent remain a threat, but with your help we've dealt a serious blow to their numbers and their morale.

passages.title: Do My Eyes Deceive Me?
passages.text:
<Pip's helm explodes with the sound of a loud girlish scream.>

IT CAN'T BE! I... I was stuck inside one of those beasts for the better part of a month. Yes, literally stuck inside its stomach. If it weren't for my suit and the all-purpose helm I'd have died a fiery death! And look at that, it's had a litter of pups!

Y... You gotta stop that thing, <name>! We can't let it or its pups make it out of here alive!

passages.title: Do My Eyes Deceive Me?
passages.text:
<Finkle's helm crackles with static.>

Phew... That's one less thing I'll need to worry about if we ever make it out of this place.

passages.title: Ascendant Lord Obsidius
passages.text:
<Pip's helm buzzes.>

GOOD GOLLY! Look at this place! A... Are those Deathwing's claw marks on the ceiling?! And what's that creature in the center of the chamber?

I don't see Raz anywhere. Let's take care of this monster and find Raz!

passages.title: Ascendant Lord Obsidius
passages.text: <Pip's helm crackles with static.>

passages.title: Ascendant Lord Obsidius
passages.text: Poor Raz. He was the best friend a gnome ever had. At least we avenged his death and cleared out this hellish cavern!

passages.title: Shy-Rotam
passages.text:
Time for the big kill, pal! Shy-Rotam lurks in the north, the largest frostsaber of them all.

You should feel honored. There's no fiercer game for a hunter to match their skills against... and if you saw the cash I'm being offered by gourmands that want a piece of this fellow, your eyes would pop out!

Once you've got her, head on back to camp. Don't want to totally exhaust our frostsaber population in one day...

passages.title: Shy-Rotam
passages.text: Shy-Rotam's in the north. No food 'til you finish!

passages.title: Shy-Rotam
passages.text:
Amazing, kid. You're a cut above! I went through about five different contracted hunters trying to get that cat.

Well, we found two of them after the Captain got the corpse, but let's not dwell on that...

passages.title: Penetrating Their Defenses
passages.text:
Here we go, <name>!

Just beyond that door lies the control room.

I'll just run in, disable the reorigination mechanism, and then we all go home. Nice an' easy.

Ye see, <lad/lass>, it's this level of preparation that separates yer true archaeologist from yer average treasure hunter.

No sense in stirring up the beasties if ye don't have to. Just makes a mess a' things...

passages.title: Penetrating Their Defenses
passages.text: What is it, <name>?

passages.title: Penetrating Their Defenses
passages.text:
Well, I've got bad news and I've got...

No, scratch that. There only be bad news.

passages.title: Lawn of the Dead
passages.text: IT'S STILLWATER! HE'S ALMOST HERE! It's going to take everything that we've got to beat him! Let's do this!

passages.title: Lawn of the Dead
passages.text: I can't believe we defeated him, <name>! That was the toughest fight yet, but there are still hundreds of crazed zombies roaming around Hillsbrad. We'll need to stay alert.

passages.title: The Battle for Andorhal
passages.text:
We just received a gryphon from the plaguelands, bearing news. It doesn't sound good.

The city of Andorhal is in the middle of a three-way war between the Forsaken, the Alliance, and the Scourge. King Wrynn has rolled the dice and sent a death knight to lead the charge for his cause, but I'm sure he can use all the help he can get.

They specifically asked for an Alliance <class> to participate in some specialized missions. If you accept the charge, speak to me again and I will prepare a portal.

passages.title: The Battle for Andorhal
passages.text: It's about time you arrived, <class>.

passages.title: The Battle for Andorhal
passages.text:
We just received a windrider from the plaguelands, bearing news. It doesn't sound good.

The city of Andorhal is in the middle of a three-way war between the Forsaken, the Alliance, and the Scourge. It sounds like Sylvanas has made her move, and to make matters interesting, she's put Koltira Deathweaver, the death knight, in command.

They specifically asked for a Horde <class> to participate in some specialized missions. If you accept the charge, speak to me again and I will prepare a portal.

passages.title: The Battle for Andorhal
passages.text: It's about time you arrived, <class>.

passages.title: Doing it the Hard Way
passages.text:
Blast it all!

Someone's gone and corrupted the entire system! There be no way fer me ta access the main repository from this console.

We're gunna hafta do this the hard way, <lad/lass>. I hope you an' yer friends here are up to a fight.

There be four guardians on the upper level of this place. I won't be able ta utilize these discs 'til they be... uhh, offline, shall we say.

passages.title: Doing it the Hard Way
passages.text:
Arrite, then.

Let's deposit these discs and be done with this!

passages.title: Battle of Life and Death
passages.text:
Alexstrasza has been preparing this site for many years. Once Deathwing is lured into this circle, she will use the rejuvenating powers of its life energy to overwhelm and destroy him.

It is important that the five lifebinder stones that surround this circle remain uncorrupted during the fight. Deathwing will be concentrating solely on the Queen of Dragons herself; you may escape his notice. Kill any of his minions that try to corrupt the circle.

Talk to me when you are ready to begin!

passages.title: Battle of Life and Death
passages.text:
Alexstrasza and Deathwing have taken into the skies over Grim Batol! Her plan unravels - the Dragon Queen is outside the Circle of Life she prepared earlier. We'll need to support her with everything we've got.

Hurry! Climb aboard one of the Vermillion Vanguard behind me.

If we find any Twilight Drakes aiding Deathwing, we will need to kill them off. Mount up, quickly!

passages.title: Battle of Life and Death
passages.text:
Thanks to your quick action, the Dragon Queen still lives. She is being brought back to Wyrmrest to recover.

But the battle wasn't a complete failure. Deathwing was gravely wounded. I suspect he will go into hiding to recuperate. Alexstrasza has bought us time to strike!

passages.title: A Bird of Legend
passages.text:
Local legend tells of a mighty owl that circles the mountaintops like death on wings. They named her Deathwing.

Soon afterwards, they were told that that name was already taken. So they settled on a moniker that evoked a similar sense of horror and dread:
