Hell-Hoot.

Hell-Hoot can be found atop the mountain to the southwest of our smoking pit. Silence the infernal nocturnal... so we can eat her!

passages.title: A Bird of Legend
passages.text:
Hell-Hoot is slain, and her meat is just as succulent as you'd expect.

Today, we eat a legend.  Thank you, <name>.

passages.title: Waters of Elune
passages.text: After a few moments, you are able to use the keystone and reveal the secret of the water....

passages.title: Might of the Earthen
passages.text: Ah ha!  You knew you'd seen this level of craftsmanship before.  Now, with the final piece...

passages.title: Whispers of the Djinn
passages.text: It appears as if this particular brazier has trapped a minor djinn, and freeing him would certainly bring a reward.  Right?

passages.title: Tol'vir Hieroglyphics
passages.text: Using the keystone, you confirm the grave is from one of the original builders, and you learn important details of the mummification process.

passages.title: Map of the Architects
passages.text: Yes... 'X' marks the spot!  This is a detailed map of the dungeon, a valuable find indeed.

passages.title: Vengeance of the Wildhammer
passages.text: After comparing the two very closely, you are sure these are the remains of the Wildhammer.  The treachery committed against them fills your heart with anger.

passages.title: Dark Iron Contingency Plan
passages.text: Interesting!  It seems as if the Dark Iron dwarves had a strategic plan in the case of an elemental invasion.  As the elemental forces are ageless and unchanging, it seems as if these ancient techniques are still viable even today.

passages.title: Expert Opinion
passages.text:
<Anduin holds up the matching badges.>

The medallion we found on the farm is identical to the one in Samuelson's notes! It can't be a coincidence. I think Samuelson is up to something, but we need a smoking gun before we can accuse one of my father's most trusted guards.

There's only one person I trust to sort this all out: Mathias Shaw, the director of SI:7. Show him these badges and see what he thinks. Meanwhile, I'll go back to the keep and watch Samuelson like a hawk!

passages.title: Expert Opinion
passages.text: What's this you've brought me?

passages.title: Expert Opinion
passages.text:
Anduin has been investigating the Twilight's Hammer? Weren't you supposed to keep him OUT of trouble?

Hmmm. Let me see those badges you've discovered.

passages.title: Followers and Leaders
passages.text:
The documents detail the arrival of High Priestess Azil to the depths of the Stonecore.

Azil is described as a high-ranking member of the Twilight Council. Additionally, her entourage of over a hundred devout followers is preparing for an unholy ritual of unforeseen darkness.

Sounds like an event you need to put a stop to.

passages.title: Followers and Leaders
passages.text: You've returned, <name>.  What news do you bring?

passages.title: Followers and Leaders
passages.text:
A high priestess, you say?  And a member of the Twilight Council?

Excellent work.  I hope you find your rewards suitable.

passages.title: The Rear is Clear
passages.text:
Excellent work, <name>! The rear is now officially clear. We'll take care of the stragglers. I want you to go back to Marshal McBride, standing in front of Northshire Abbey, south of here, and let him know that the goblin situation is under control.

Farewell, <class>.

passages.title: The Rear is Clear
passages.text: With your help we have managed to secure the northern and western sectors of Northshire. We still have a rather large contingency of Blackrock orcs to the east and they've begun burning down the forest!

passages.title: The Rear is Clear
passages.text:
Excellent work, <name>! The rear is now officially clear. We'll take care of the stragglers. I want you to go back to Marshal McBride, standing in front of Northshire Abbey, south of here, and let him know that the goblin situation is under control.

Farewell, <class>.

passages.text: With your help we have managed to secure the northern and western sectors of Northshire. We still have a rather large contingency of Blackrock orcs to the east and they've begun burning down the forest!

passages.title: You Gotta Have Eggs
passages.text:
I don't have a very discerning palate, but even I can't stand the taste of those chimaeras that you'll find around here. Their eggs, however, are a different story.

Chimaera eggs are the richest, most buttery eggs you'll find this side of Orgrimmar. Way better than boring owl eggs, and not as sulfurous as those weird wildkin eggs.

I'll take as many of them as you can gather. Head northeast, and look for their nests in the snow.

passages.title: You Gotta Have Eggs
passages.text: Mmmm....

passages.title: You Gotta Have Eggs
passages.text:
Nice. Eggs.

These will go great with a little bear bacon.  Hey Francis, got any bear meat left over?

passages.title: Damn You, Frostilicus
passages.text:
The Frostmaul giants wouldn't have been a problem if it weren't for that damned Frostilicus. When the ground shook and the bridge broke, he and his fellow water elementals seeped out of the earth and took over the bottom of Frostwhisper Gorge, forcing the giants out.

Damn you, Frostilicus!

You would do me a great honor if you would send him back into the ground, <class>. You will find him to the south, at the bottom of the gorge.

passages.title: Damn You, Frostilicus
passages.text: Will this torment never end?

passages.title: Damn You, Frostilicus
passages.text:
If I survive my wounds, I will always remember your name, <class>.

Whenever the wind whistles through the trees, I will always hear your name.

Thank you.

passages.title: Twilight Shores
passages.text:
Right then, just hop in the seaplane behind me and I'll fly yeh to the Highlands.

We're to report to a feller named "Lieutenant Fawkes." I've promised the King we'd get there lickety-fast, so I took the liberty of ditchin' any excess weight. Like seatbelts. Parachutes. Maps. Stabilizers. Landing gear.

I never actually "land" these things anyways.

passages.title: Twilight Shores
passages.text: You two are the last thing I expected to see fall from the sky. Highbank is under attack!

passages.title: Rescue the Earthspeaker!
passages.text:
Good! You've brought allies.

You must hurry if we are to rescue Erunak.

Fight your way through Neptulon's halls. Find the shaman and free him from these worms... if he still lives.

Don't worry about them coming up from behind you. Nothing's making it past me!

passages.title: Rescue the Earthspeaker!
passages.text:
What is this? You... rescuing me?

<Erunak smiles at you.>

This will take some getting used to.

passages.title: Rescue the Earthspeaker!
passages.text:
Good! You've brought allies.

You must hurry if we are to rescue Erunak.

Go now. Fight your way through Neptulon's halls. Find the shaman and free him from these worms... if he still lives.

Don't worry about them coming up from behind you. I'll see that nothing makes it past me!

passages.title: Rescue the Earthspeaker!
passages.text: I thank you, my friend.

passages.title: Rescue the Earthspeaker!
passages.text:
What is this? You... rescuing me?

<Erunak smiles at you.>

This will take some getting used to.

passages.title: Sins of the Sea Witch
passages.text:
That vile worm has earned a thousand deaths!

It won't be easy. She and her minions are firmly entrenched in this place, but she's bound to be exhausted from her fight with Neptulon.

Now is the time to strike! We won't have another opportunity like this.

Run her through, <name>!

passages.title: Sins of the Sea Witch
passages.text:
Well done, <name>!

Know that without your aid, things would be far different here.

Not only would I be long dead, but the naga and their allies would have free reign over the sea.

The king himself shall hear of your heroism in this realm.

passages.title: Magic Prehistoric
passages.text: The owlbeasts' sacred caves are located to the east. Within several of these caves, you should find totems. I want you to approach these totems and gather whatever essence you can from them. The dreamcatcher should absorb this essence for use within Mazthoril.

passages.title: Magic Prehistoric
passages.text: What are you doing, <name>? We need that essence.

passages.title: Magic Prehistoric
passages.text: The dreamcatcher is charged.  We are nearly ready to retake Mazthoril.

passages.title: Winterwater
passages.text:
I don't want our gambit to fail, <name>. Such a failure would only draw attention to our efforts, giving Umbranse an opportunity to hone his defenses. No, we have to do this right the first time.

The Frostwhisper Gorge, to the south, provides us access to powerful ice elementals. The water within these elementals' hulls should amplify the power of your dreamcatcher, ensuring our efforts.

Obtain this water, <name>. Then return to our small camp.

passages.title: Winterwater
passages.text: Welcome back.

passages.title: Winterwater
passages.text:
<Haleh applies the water to your dreamcatcher.>

You've done well, <name>.

passages.title: Umbranse's Deliverance
passages.text:
Umbranse lurks in the back of Mazthoril. His time has come.

Unfortunately, I am unable to join you on this quest. While I'd love to get my hands on that snake, Mazthoril's magic would rip me apart in its current state. No, I need you to finish this for me.

When the deed is done, use this charm. It will return you safely to the egress.

passages.title: Umbranse's Deliverance
passages.text: You must finish this for me, <name>.

passages.title: Umbranse's Deliverance
passages.text: You have our thanks, <name>.

passages.title: Sins of the Sea Witch
passages.text:
Naz'jar! She's the one responsible for this mess.

She's in here somewhere, <name>. She must be exhausted after that fight with Neptulon.

Now is the time to strike! We won't have another opportunity like this.

I'll handle anything that tries to aid her from this direction.

Find her, <name>, and run her through!

passages.title: Sins of the Sea Witch
passages.text: Is it done, <name>?

passages.title: Sins of the Sea Witch
passages.text:
Hellscream shall know of your deeds here, <name>.

Without you, things here would be far worse.

Lok'tar ogar, my friend!

passages.title: Twilight Skies
passages.text:
I just got word from Orgrimmar that the Warchief wants us to move out. We wouldn't have been ready if it wasn't for your help!

The plan is for the air fleet to take off immediately, and for the navy to follow close behind. Hellscream will be accompanying the air fleet and specifically requested that you come along with us.

No time to delay! Go to the Southern Rocketway Terminus here in Azshara, and check in with Friz Groundspin. I'll bring the zeppelin around to pick you up.

passages.title: Twilight Skies
passages.text: Another <class> for the Highlands? Here, sign this indemnification waiver...

passages.title: The Prison Rooftop
passages.text:
I don't understand why the king wants to waste time saving his hide, but if you want to risk your life, then be my guest.

Crowley and his men are holed up upstairs, probably plotting against the king as we speak!

passages.title: The Prison Rooftop
passages.text:
Greymane's right.  These beasts do not give a damn about our politics.

Gilneas needs to stand together.

passages.title: Soften them Up
passages.text:
At last, reinforcements! I'm so glad you're here. We never imagined just how entrenched the Twilight's Hammer forces are. And there are so many!

Several of our drakes have been captured just inside the main hall. Please, break their bonds and free them.

Once free, together we can scourge these halls clean with flame. Just climb aboard a red drake and call out your targets. You will definitely want to cut down the enemy numbers before delving deeper into the ruins.

passages.title: Soften them Up
passages.text: This is great news, <name>! I'm glad our drakes were able to assist you. Thank you for rescuing them from the clutches of Twilight's Hammer.

passages.title: Kill the Courier
passages.text:
Thank you, <class>, for braving the horrors of this dark and terrible place.

The bowels of Grim Batol are the heart of Cho'gall's war machine. If we are to stop his machinations throughout the Highlands, we must learn all we can from these depths.

Seek out Drahga Shadowburner within. He is Cho'gall's runner, the link between here and the Bastion of Twilight. We must learn the secrets he carries.

passages.title: Kill the Courier
passages.text: What have you discovered, <class>?

passages.title: Kill the Courier
passages.text:
<Tooranu looks over the documents you discovered.>

It's all here, <name>. Details of how the cult is tearing up the Highlands, who they've sent, where they are, and what they plan to do. Invaluable.

I shall distribute this knowledge to the rest of the Earthen Ring at once. Thank you, friend.

passages.title: Closing a Dark Chapter
passages.text:
This terrible place was Alexstrasza's nightmare. During what mortals call the second war, she was chained in the depths below, her tormented offspring forced to serve the demon-corrupted Horde.

Alexstrasza may be free, but the beast known as Erudax still corrupts her offspring below.

<Baleflame's body tenses in anger.>

Destroy him, <class>. Crush him that we may end these horrors once and for all!

passages.title: Closing a Dark Chapter
passages.text: What of Erudax, <class>?

passages.title: Closing a Dark Chapter
passages.text:
So it is done.

Would that I could bring this entire mountain down upon itself, I would.

passages.title: Keeping the Dragonmaw at Bay
passages.text:
With your help we've thumped the Dragonmaw pretty hard, but still their daily attacks in the Thundermar outskirts persist. We need to keep up the pressure!

Wade back into the battle that's raging in the Thundermar ruins to the south and southwest. Kill Dragonmaw marauders and collect the insignias that their greatest warriors wear.

passages.title: Keeping the Dragonmaw at Bay
passages.text: How goes the fight, <class>?

passages.title: Keeping the Dragonmaw at Bay
passages.text: Aye, that's how it's done! With heroes like you taking care of business, I'm proud to be a part of the Alliance.

passages.title: Fight Like a Wildhammer
passages.text:
<Blundy upends his cup.>

I'm all outta ale, <name>!

Head out into the Thundermar Ruins and see if there's any left, before those grungy Dragonmaw get their mouths on it.

Feel free to have a few sips, yerself. A mug of ol' Thundermar's finest will fortify yer fightin' skills.

passages.title: Fight Like a Wildhammer
passages.text: Got sumthun'?

passages.title: Fight Like a Wildhammer
passages.text:
Oh aye, quite a haul!

This'll last me until... oh say probably tomorrow.

passages.title: Never Leave a Dinner Behind
passages.text:
Refugees are still pouring into Thundermar from the fighting, and I'm hungry! I mean them. The refugees, they're hungry.

Get me some food from the Thundermar Ruins! Scour the ruins to the south, east, and southwest for any stores that still remain. Especially them big hocks of ham. I love those! Er, the refugees do.

And see if you can find some of them little cocktail weenies.

passages.title: Never Leave a Dinner Behind
passages.text: Got some eats?

passages.title: Never Leave a Dinner Behind
passages.text: Oh hey, yer just in time! I was working up a huge appetite, workin' so hard to feed these hungry refugees. Yessir.

passages.title: Beer Run
passages.text:
After my sister's wedding, I developed a taste for that Thunderbrew Lager that Kurdran had imported from Dun Morogh. More is on the way, but our caravan keeps getting jumped by the Dragonmaw!

Head on up to the southeast side of Thunderstrike Mountain and catch up with the caravan. Look for a fellow named Hammelhand at the side of the road, and help him get the booze through the pass.

Just get it as far as Kirthaven, and we'll take it from there.

passages.title: Beer Run
passages.text: Go figure. Never thought I'd develop a taste for imported draft. Thanks, <name>!

passages.title: Nethergarde Needs You!
passages.text:
Nethergarde needs you, <class>! I have been sent here by Quartermaster Lungertz to head off Okrilla's nefarious lackeys and to recruit able-bodied heroes of the Alliance! Help us fight off the Horde!

If you are willing, take this portal in front of me to the Blasted Lands and speak with the quartermaster.

passages.title: Nethergarde Needs You!
passages.text: Silithus, not such a great place, eh? We get a lot of you from there...

passages.title: The View from Down Here
passages.text:
We need to halt the construction on this Frostmane village. If we let them get too entrenched, it will be more difficult to keep them from settling here permanently.

It's time to give those brutes a gnome's-eye view of the world! Take this gnomish viewpoint equalizer and use it on the Frostmane builders to bring them down to our level. They won't be able to lift their tools and construction will come to a standstill.

passages.title: The View from Down Here
passages.text: Did you show them what it's like to be a gnome?

passages.title: The View from Down Here
passages.text: Well done, <name>. That'll teach them not to mess with us in our home!

passages.title: Pebble
passages.text:
If you hadn't noticed, there's a very small elemental that has taken a liking to you. If you stay on the ground for even a few moments, I'm sure you'll spot him.

You seem to be quite adept at making friends down here. A good talent to have.

passages.title: Pebble
passages.text: <Pebble seems quite happy to meet you.>

passages.title: Return to the Lost City
passages.text:
We might've taken Neferset City, but the Neferset have a new seat of power.

Thanks to Siamat, the powerful djinn of the south wind, the Neferset have become considerably more dangerous.

We just learned that some of Nadun's ambushed reconnaissance party managed to secure the entrance to the Lost City.

Go find Captain Hadan and get whatever information you need to bring down Siamat and the Neferset scum.

passages.title: Return to the Lost City
passages.text:
Hail, <name>.  Nadun spoke highly of you.

Are you here to aid us?

passages.title: Crushing the Wildhammer
passages.text:
The Wildhammer grow bold with their new Alliance allies. They dare press across the river. Drive them back!

Seek out and crush the Wildhammer warbrands who fight in the riverbed and within the Thundermar Ruins along the north bank. The best among them carry insignias - gather them for me to prove your allegiance to the Dragonmaw cause.

passages.title: Crushing the Wildhammer
passages.text: Show me the insignias you've collected, <class>.

passages.title: Crushing the Wildhammer
passages.text: Look what we have here! A single Horde <class> can demolish the Wildhammer by the dozen. What hope do they have now?

passages.title: Total War
passages.text:
Some of the Wildhammer still cling to the hope of reclaiming the Thundermar Ruins to the north, across the river. Burn them out! Smash open kegs of Thundermar ale. That wicked brew is potent enough to explode when set aflame.

Don't ask me why.

And don't ask me how they drink the stuff.

passages.title: Total War
passages.text:
Yes, yes. Burn them out, as you would flush groundhogs from their holes...

Well done, <name>.

passages.title: Another Maw to Feed
passages.text:
<Griff's stomach growls.>

Still hungry. It's like ... every day, I'm hungry.

I hear there's more food stashed up in the Thundermar Ruins across the river to the north, where all the fighting is. Bring some to my mouth.

passages.title: Another Maw to Feed
passages.text: <Griff licks his lips.>

passages.title: Another Maw to Feed
passages.text:
<Griff greedily snatches the heap of food, enough to feed dozens of men.>

Great! This'll tide me over for ... hours!

passages.title: Hook 'em High
passages.text:
The Wildhammer can train war gryphons faster than we can subvert and control drakes. We can't let them continue to outnumber us!

Hunt gryphon riders flying over the river north of Bloodgulch. Take this hook and fling it at them as they fly by. Their momentum will hurl them from their mount, right to your feet. Kill the dismounted gryphon riders!

passages.title: Hook 'em High
passages.text:
You made that look easy, <name>.

Get the Wildhammer off of their mounts and they're nothing!

passages.title: To the Mor'shan Rampart
passages.text:
Kadrak at the Mor'shan Rampart to the north is calling for aid.

The rampart rests on the border between the Northern Barrens and Ashenvale. It is the front line in the fight against the Alliance.

We're driving the night elves out of the forest. We'll claim its resources for the Horde!

To get there, take the Gold Road north out of the Crossroads.

Destiny calls!

passages.title: To the Mor'shan Rampart
passages.text:
You're the reinforcements that Thork sent?

You'll do fine as long you can kill night elves. The forest is crawling with them.

passages.title: Back To The Orphanage
passages.text:
We had the best time with you, <name>. We wish you could be our <daddy/mama> now, but you have to take us back to Orphan Matron Aria in Dalaran.

Maybe you could come visit us again sometime? We loved meeting Winterfin hatchlings and getting to see the dragon queen. No one will believe us when we say we met a Great One!

We going to miss you, <name>. We promise to write letter sometime, oki?

passages.title: Back To The Orphanage
passages.text: It sounds like little Roo had a great time this week. I know he was getting awfully lonely in the orphanage and was eager to make some new friends. Thank you so much for agreeing to look after him.

passages.title: Back To The Orphanage
passages.text:
Know what? You not so bad after all, <name>. You take Kekek a lot of fun places. Kekek meet a lot of new friends and do things no other pup get to do.

You, and Hemet Nesingwary, and Snowfall Glade pups all new best friends. Maybe sometime you bring Kekek that green hills book? Kekek promise to write sometimes, too, tell you how things go. Maybe even be nice to big-tongue kids sometimes.

Kekek gotta go back to orphan-lady Aria now, back in purple human city.

passages.title: Back To The Orphanage
passages.text: Thank you for agreeing to care for Kekek this week. I know he can be a handful, but I think that with more individual attention and a few more friends, he'll do a lot better. No doubt he's going to be telling stories of his adventures with you for weeks.

passages.title: Victory in Tol Barad
passages.text: We fought hard to get a foothold on this ugly rock and there is no way we are going to let the Horde get in the way of our plans. Keeping control of Tol Barad is our first priority and we need your help, <name>. Fight your way to victory in Tol Barad and return to me word of your triumph.

passages.title: Victory in Tol Barad
passages.text: Were you victorious against the Horde?

passages.title: Victory in Tol Barad
passages.text: What's that smell?  Ah.....Smells like victory.  Your efforts in Tol Barad are a great triumph for the entire Alliance, your contributions will not be forgotten.

passages.title: Victory in Tol Barad
passages.text: Maintaining control of Tol Barad is the key to our strategic plans here in the Eastern Kingdoms, <race>. We must do whatever it takes to keep the Alliance off this island and that means we need your help. Fight with everything you have to win control of Tol Barad and bring me word of victory.

passages.title: Victory in Tol Barad
passages.text: Were you victorious against the Alliance?

passages.title: Victory in Tol Barad
passages.text: You bring word of victory, just as I expected!  Any triumph in Tol Barad is in turn a triumph for the Horde.  Have no doubt, your efforts here will be rewarded.

passages.title: Mr. Goldmine's Wild Ride
passages.text:
Okay, <name>, we need to get to the earth portal at the back of the cave.

I've "procured" a ride for us. Why walk when we can ride in style? I hope you don't mind mine carts.

Let me know when you're ready.

passages.title: Mr. Goldmine's Wild Ride
passages.text:
Oh no! My weapons and totems!

They're destroyed!!!

passages.title: Wasteland
passages.text:
This is Silithus, <class>... a harsh and brutal wasteland. Few know that an ancient war was waged here between the night elves and a malign, alien power. The evil was sealed, but now we suspect that forces work to stir this... unspeakable horror.

Seek out Layo Starstrike, one of my agents. I have sent him to the southeast to investigate the ruins of Southwind Village.

Give him this letter, and he will give you his trust accordingly.

passages.title: The Spirits of Southwind
passages.text:
To our southwest lies a tragic site - the ruins of Southwind Village. This is where our work should begin, <name>.

From what we've learned, this village was once a night elf base of operations for Silithus. It's long since overrun by the silithid hives that infest the wastes. I can only imagine the horror of the village's initial sundering...

The tortured spirits of fallen druids and sentinels wander the ruins aimlessly. Explore this locale, freeing the souls of these wretched beings as needed.

passages.title: Recalling
passages.text:
The glyphs illustrate an emissary of the Qiraji meeting with three silithid at the bones of a large dragon, and above them is a code... I know this code. I deciphered it when the gates of Ahn'Qiraj reopened.

But the Qiraji are long defeated... who is controlling the silithid with this? Take the Glyphs of Calling to the Bones of Grakkarond, south of Cenarion Hold. Use them there and see who shows up. They likely won't be friendly... be careful.

passages.title: Secretion and Subterfuge
passages.text:
I've seen no cultists wandering the surface of Hive'Ashi to the north. With any luck, we can make our preparations without being noticed.

One of the organs of the silithid is used to secrete a thick sludge that hardens in the air. This is used to build hives, and by some to lay eggs.

Bring me enough of these organs to cover someone twice your height, and do not venture far into the hives just yet.

passages.title: Riding in Plain Sight
passages.text:
We are prepared. Take this box. Upon opening it, you will be engulfed in silithid mucus and encased within a temporary egg. 

Use it near other eggs on the surface of Hive'Ashi, and the drones should carry you within the hive, unknown to their twilight guardians. The egg should break before you run out of air.

passages.title: Mysteries of the Twilight Hive
passages.text:
It's as we suspected... this hive is a hidden base of operations for the Twilight's Hammer cult. They have kept their increased activity a secret this way.

We must find what they are plotting. Search the hive for any clues to their plans, and make sure you leave enough of the lunatics dead to keep them from further scheming.

passages.title: Crushing the Crown
passages.text:
This ledger is full of locations, and I need you to investigate and take action, pal. This has gone on long enough.

Here's an entry I want you to check out: it looks like it's in the Uldum, just east of the Tomb of Khartut, close to the entrance from Tanaris. Get out there and rough 'em up.

Oh, and if you see something big and dangerous enough that it needs destroying, toss this bomb at it.

passages.title: Crushing the Crown
passages.text: Good job, kid. You deserve a little somethin'. And hey, come back tomorrow if you get the time; I might have a job for ya.

passages.title: Crushing the Crown
passages.text:
This ledger is full of locations, and I need you to investigate and take action, pal. This has gone on long enough.

Here's an entry I want you to check out: it looks like it's in Uldum, east of the Tomb of Khartut and near the entrance from Tanaris. Get out there and rough 'em up.

Oh, and if you see something big and dangerous enough that it needs destroying, toss this bomb at it.

passages.title: Crushing the Crown
passages.text: Good job, kid. You deserve a little somethin'. And hey, come back tomorrow if you get the time; I might have a job for ya.

passages.title: Miner's Fortune
passages.text:
Hey <race>, you interested in treasure? I knew that would get your attention.

Word from the river dock here is that one of the miners in the Venture Company's Boulder Lode mine just northeast of here discovered an emerald the size of your fist.

I know a few buyers who'd be interested in getting their hands on something like that, and I'd be willing to go half and half on its sale. You in?

passages.title: Miner's Fortune
passages.text: If only we knew which one of the miners had found the emerald, it'd be a walk in the park...

passages.title: Miner's Fortune
passages.text:
Look at the size of that thing! We're going to be rich! Let's see, according to the rates I've seen on gems going into Undermine, I should be able to figure out your cut - fifty percent, don't worry!

Now let's see... I think this should do about right. Pleasure doing business with you, <name>.

passages.title: Samophlange
passages.text:
The Venture Company have a small research facility west of here, just past the Sludge Fen. I don't know very much about what they're doing, but did manage to discover that they're experimenting with something called a "samophlange".

Now what the heck is a samophlange? Well, whatever it is, I want to examine it, so I need someone to go get it.

I obtained a copy of their control system operating manual, you should be able to figure out how to disengage the samophlange from it.

passages.title: Samophlange
passages.text: A variety of buttons, levers, and blinking lights are somewhat erratically arrayed on the face of the control console. A small gauge indicates that the apparatus is currently operating within optimal levels, and indicates that control valves one through three are currently open. There is a small keyhole set into the lower right side of the control panel.

passages.title: Samophlange
passages.text: The three control valves are currently opened. The various readings on the control panel lead you to presume that they must be shut off before the apparatus can be shut off.

passages.title: Samophlange
passages.text: Blinking lights on the control console indicate that the main control valves have not been closed off.

passages.title: Samophlange
passages.text: The lights indicating the three control valves dim as they are shut off. Green lights slowly fade into yellow, and the switch controlling the apparatus is now moveable, with the valves closed, it can be turned off.

passages.title: Samophlange
passages.text: Pulling open the face of the control console reveals a dense jumble of wires, tubing and other strange mechanical objects--most of which seem to serve no practical purpose. Pushing them aside and digging deeper into the console, you find the samophlange. A tug removes it from its housing.

passages.title: Samophlange
passages.text: Oh, you're back, <name>! Do you have the samophlange?

passages.title: Samophlange
passages.text:
This is... er... interesting... yes. A device this complex is best analyzed by a team of skilled engineers in a clean room, painstakingly reverse engineering each component in a controlled environment.

But who has that kind of time?

Let's just fire this thing up and see what it does...

passages.title: Wenikee Boltbucket
passages.text:
I think I really put my foot into that one - it looks like I might have knocked one of the load-bearing fluxors into the spokes of the deregulator gear. We can fix this, easy. I know an expert on triple-expansion piston drives who would love to get her hands on a samophlange. Take the broken samophlange to Wenikee Boltbucket, just south of Mor'shan Rampart, she'll patch 'er right up.

Hey, no need to walk - this gives me the perfect opportunity to test my personal people porter device!

passages.title: Wenikee Boltbucket
passages.text: I'm very busy with my work, <class>.  Unless you have something for me, it'd be best if you moved along...

passages.title: Wenikee Boltbucket
passages.text:
Oh, what's this? A samophlange, you say? What's a samophlange??

Ah... but look at the way it moves when you handle it.  And there's the sound of intricate gears inside. Oh my! I want to fix it and see what it does, don't you??

passages.title: Nugget Slugs
passages.text:
I want to fix this samophlange, but to do that I'm going to need some supplies. I ran out of seventeen-point-five gauge nugget slugs and I'm going to need a bunch of those for the work ahead.

Unfortunately, the closest place to get them is the Burning Blade farm to the southwest. The place will be heavily guarded, so be careful, but the samophlange just might be worth the risk. Search the tool buckets, then return to me when you've gathered enough nugget slugs.

passages.title: Nugget Slugs
passages.text: Do you have the nugget slugs, <name>?  I've been eyeing this Samophlange and I can't wait to tinker with it.

passages.title: Nugget Slugs
passages.text: Great, you got them!  Now I can get to work...

passages.title: Get Them While They're Young
passages.text:
I can teach you to ride a Winterspring frostsaber, but it takes time and dedication. For this to work, both saber and rider must be highly trained and both must share a bond of deep trust.

The cubs are only receptive to this training if they're introduced to their riders at a young age. Some of the cubs in the dens surrounding Frostsaber Rock are at the proper age to begin their training. If you help me gather the most promising of those cubs, I'll allow you to begin training with your own cub.

passages.title: Get Them While They're Young
passages.text: We must get the saber cubs while they're still young enough to bond with people. If they get too old, the cats will remain feral forever.

passages.title: Get Them While They're Young
passages.text:
These cubs are just the right age to begin their training. A few of them even have the proper traits to be trained as mounts. As promised, I'll select one of these cubs for you to train. This fellow here seems to have an affinity for you.

I'll train the more common, docile cubs for the market in Darnassus.

passages.title: They Grow Up So Fast
passages.text:
I think this little fellow will be a good match for you.

This cub is going to require a lot of attention to ensure that he grows up strong and healthy. You should check up on your cub at least once each day. Feeding and caring for your Winterspring cub is the best way to build a bond of trust with him.

As your cub grows, he will shed his old whiskers and grow new ones appropriate to his size. Once your cub has shed twenty whiskers, bring him back to me along with some materials for your saddle.

passages.title: They Grow Up So Fast
passages.text: How fares your young saber?

passages.title: They Grow Up So Fast
passages.text:
It looks like you've done an admirable job of raising your cub, <name>. Your saber has grown up to be strong, healthy, and loyal. Both of you are well-matched.

Your Winterspring frostsaber will respond to your call anytime you wish to ride together.

passages.title: A Cub's Cravings
passages.text:
Your Winterspring cub looks at you and licks its lips. The little cat must be hungry and it's up to you to find a suitable meal for your charge.

Rivern Frostwind mentioned keeping some shardtooth bear meat on hand for feeding his frostsaber cubs. Perhaps your cub would enjoy some fresh shardtooth meat of its own. Various kinds of shardtooth bears can be found all over Winterspring.

passages.title: A Cub's Cravings
passages.text: Your wintersaber cub looks at you as if to say, "Is that it?"

passages.title: A Cub's Cravings
passages.text: Your Winterspring cub looks happy, satisfied, and ready to curl up for a nap.

passages.title: 'Borrowing' From the Winterfall
passages.text:
Your cub looks at you expectantly. What could it want now?

The little cat licks its lips. It must be meal time again! As the cub's surrogate <father/mother> you're responsible for providing meat until it can hunt on its own.

But what if you let someone else do the hunting? The Winterfall furbolg of Winterspring usually have a lot of smoked meat on hand in both of their camps. Surely, they wouldn't miss a few pieces and your cub would get to try something new.

passages.title: 'Borrowing' From the Winterfall
passages.text: Your cub still looks hungry. What's the hold up?

passages.title: 'Borrowing' From the Winterfall
passages.text: Your cub looks satisfied for now.

passages.title: Hunting Practice
passages.text:
Your Winterspring cub paws playfully at your hands. Without any playmates, the cub has few chances to practice its hunting skills.

Perhaps you should take your cub hunting for the small arctic hares that burrow in the snow of northern Winterspring. Bring your cub close to the mounds of snow covering the hare burrows and wait for the cub's instincts to take over.

passages.title: Hunting Practice
passages.text: The cub looks at you, as if asking to continue the game.

passages.title: Hunting Practice
passages.text: Your Winterspring cub looks tired, content, and perhaps a bit more experienced.

passages.title: Hunting Practice
passages.text:
Your Winterspring cub paws playfully at your hands. Without any playmates, the cub has few chances to practice its hunting skills.

Perhaps you should take your cub hunting for the small arctic hares that burrow in the snow of northern Winterspring. Bring your cub close to the mounds of snow covering the hare burrows and wait for the cub's instincts to take over.

passages.title: Hunting Practice
passages.text: Your cub looks tired, content, and perhaps a bit more experienced.

passages.title: Cub's First Toy
passages.text:
The winterspring cub plays with a small tuft of fur from a large animal, batting the discarded hair about. While your cub looks like it's enjoying the new game, you wonder if it might get more enjoyment from a proper cat toy.

With a little bit of leather from a yeti pelt and some feathers from crazed moonkin, you could make a respectable toy. You'll need a hide from the yeti in the Ice Thistle Hills southeast of Everlook and feathers from the moonkin at the Hidden Grove or Owl Wing Thicket.

passages.title: Cub's First Toy
passages.text: The cub looks at you. What could you be planning?

passages.title: Cub's First Toy
passages.text: Your Wintersrping cub seems thrilled with its new toy, but there's no telling how well it will survive the cub's enthusiasm.

passages.title: Cub's First Toy
passages.text:
The Winterspring cub plays with a small tuft of fur from a large animal, batting the discarded hair about. While your cub looks like it's enjoying the new game, you wonder if it might get more enjoyment from a proper cat toy.

With a little bit of leather from a yeti pelt and some feathers from crazed moonkin, you could make a respectable toy. You'll need a hide from the yeti in the Ice Thistle Hills southeast of Everlook and feathers from the moonkin at the Hidden Grove or Owl Wing Thicket.

passages.title: Cub's First Toy
passages.text: Your Winterspring cub seems thrilled with its new toy, but there's no telling how well it will survive the cub's enthusiasm.

passages.title: A Cub's Cravings
passages.text:
Your Winterspring cub looks at you and licks its lips. The little cat must be hungry and it's up to you to find a suitable meal for your charge.

Rivern Frostwind mentioned keeping some shardtooth bear meat on hand for feeding his frostsaber cubs. Perhaps your cub would enjoy some fresh shardtooth meat of its own. Various kinds of shardtooth bears can be found all over Winterspring.

passages.title: A Cub's Cravings
passages.text: Your Winterspring cub looks happy, satisfied, and ready to curl up for a nap.

passages.title: 'Borrowing' From the Winterfall
passages.text:
Your cub looks at you expectantly. What could it want now?

The little cat licks its lips. It must be meal time again! As the cub's surrogate <father/mother> you're responsible for providing meat until it can hunt on its own.

But what if you let someone else do the hunting? The Winterfall furbolg of Winterspring usually have a lot of smoked meat on hand in both of their camps. Surely, they wouldn't miss a few pieces and your cub would get to try something new.

passages.title: 'Borrowing' From the Winterfall
passages.text: Your cub looks satisfied for now.

passages.title: Stink Bombs Away!
passages.text:
Greetings, <class>! I hope Hallow's End is treating you well. Bah, enough of the small talk... Let's get down to business. Undercity. They have employed Hags and foul magic to launch petty attacks on our town. Some may say, ignore the childish Horde. I say, let's show them!

Speak to my sister, Gertrude, and she will send you on your way to toss some stink bombs in Undercity.

passages.title: Stink Bombs Away!
passages.text: Bombs away, am I right?

passages.title: Stink Bombs Away!
passages.text:
That will show those foolish crones who the strongest is.

Take these treats and treat yourself to something nice, <class>.

passages.title: The Rear is Clear
passages.text:
Excellent work, <name>! The rear is now officially clear. We'll take care of the stragglers. I want you to go back to Marshal McBride, standing in front of Northshire Abbey, south of here, and let him know that the goblin situation is under control.

Farewell, <class>.

passages.title: The Rear is Clear
passages.text: With your help we have managed to secure the northern and western sectors of Northshire. We still have a rather large contingency of Blackrock orcs to the east and they've begun burning down the forest!

passages.title: Competition Schmompetition
passages.text:
I'm just a little guy, trying to set up my own independent business. Working hard toward the Azerothian dream, ya know?

Well soon as I set up shop, the Venture Co. next door decided they wanted me out. They've been harrassing me with threatening letters, using words like 'cease' and 'desist.' 

Worst of all, the schematics for my newest machine are missing, and I know those corporate pilferers stole them! Go to the Sludge Fen and knock out some of their employees. I know they're hiding my blueprints!

passages.title: Competition Schmompetition
passages.text: I can't believe they would stoop so low! Did you get my blueprints back?

passages.title: Competition Schmompetition
passages.text: Thanks for recovering my blueprints. Now my work on the Silver Bullet X-831 can continue.

passages.title: Sludge Beast!
passages.text:
Whatever is lurking around the Sludge Fen, it doesn't appear to be human. Judging from the remains around its tracks, it's also dangerous.

You decide to follow the tracks down to the bottom of the lake and look for the creature's resting place.

passages.title: Sludge Beast!
passages.text: You saw sludge being dumped straight into the lake? I wouldn't be surprised if the Sludge Beast were a product of the Venture Co.'s carelessness.

passages.title: Cruisin' the Chasm
passages.text:
One of my friends says that a steam tank mechanic in Westfall lets visitors use his choppers. My friend even got to ride one!

I've seen people ride by the orphanage in choppers. They're real loud and just about the fastest thing I've ever seen! I want to try one out!

Could we go to Sentinel Hill in Westfall and ride one of those choppers? Please? I promise to behave myself and we could see the crazy giant hole left when the world changed!

passages.title: Cruisin' the Chasm
passages.text: This is going to be the best week ever!

passages.title: Cruisin' the Chasm
passages.text: That was the best! I want to come back and do this again next year. When I grow up, I'm going to have a chopper, except I'm gonna make it myself, and take all my friends for a ride!

passages.title: The Short Way Home
passages.text:
Looks like your work here is done, <class>. You'd better head back to the Crossroads.

Luckily for you, my Silver Bullet X-831 prototype is finished, and she's ready for a test drive. Whaddaya say you do me one last favor and take her for a little spin?

One of my assistants will accompany you. Your sweet, sweet ride is waiting on the platform behind me. Just hop on when you're ready.

passages.title: The Short Way Home
passages.text: I thought you were a goner. Glad to see you're still in one piece.

passages.title: To Fort Livingston
passages.text:
Da first place we check gonna be da place most likely to be attacked first. You call it Fort Livingston.

Fort Livingston be surrounded by troll ruins... It make for an easy target.

Maybe we find da emissary dere. Hopefully it ain't too late.

passages.title: To Fort Livingston
passages.text:
Another Darkspear emissary passed through some time ago telling us to be on our guard.

He mentioned some other trolls may show up, but not in spirit form, and not escorted by a <race> <class>.

passages.title: Serpents and Poison
passages.text:
Because of the emissary's warning we were able to gather more adventurers to help defend. But we thought we were going to be fighting trolls.

Instead we found ourselves overwhelmed by serpents!

They seem to have come from everywhere. We are barely able to hold on, and I only suspect it's going to get worse.

Help us and eliminate the serpents and perhaps your troll friend here can use some magic to cure the poisoned.

passages.title: Serpents and Poison
passages.text: It doesn't look like there is an end to these serpents.

passages.title: Serpents and Poison
passages.text: Thanks for the help, <name>.  These serpents, there doesn't appear to be an end to them.

passages.title: The Biggest Diamond Ever!
passages.text:
I heard that Magni Bronzebeard, who used to be the king of Ironforge, turned into a giant diamond! Is that true? How does someone just turn into a diamond? Maybe you have to be a king and that's why no one's done it before.

Can we go see him? He should be in the part of Ironforge called Old Ironforge underneath the High Seat.

passages.title: The Biggest Diamond Ever!
passages.text: I've never met a king before.

passages.title: The Biggest Diamond Ever!
passages.text:
So King Magni turned into a diamond then had to go on a quest? That's neat.

I wish I could turn into a diamond, then no one could hurt me. I could even buy a castle for everyone in the orphanage!

passages.title: Malfurion Has Returned!
passages.text:
I heard that Malfurion Stormrage came back from the Emerald Dream. I don't know where that is, but it sounds like it's really far away.

Anyway, he's supposed to be at the top of the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus with the High Priestess. D'you think we could go meet him? He's got to be the most powerful druid in the history of Azeroth!

passages.title: Malfurion Has Returned!
passages.text: Do you think I could be a druid one day?

passages.title: Malfurion Has Returned!
passages.text: That was the best! Did you see when Malfurion cast those wings on me? The other orphans are going to be sorry they missed out on this trip!

passages.title: Mor'shan Caravan Delivery
passages.text:
You've managed to stir the Burning Blade's nest. Our scouts report that they are gathering for an attack.

You must complete the caravan's journey before they arrive. The supplies are packed, the kodos are rested, and I hope you don't mind but I made a few adjustments to your gun.

If you meet up with any resistance, shoot first and ask questions later.

Quickly! They come! Speak to me when you are ready to leave.

passages.title: Mor'shan Caravan Delivery
passages.text:
Some days we gain quarter, other days we are beaten back behind our walls. Every day, we bury more of our brothers and sisters.

<Kadrak pauses and takes a deep breath.>

Not only have the supplies you brought strengthened our troops, but your heroic deeds have inspired them as well. Thank you, <class>.

passages.title: Let's Go Fly a Kite
passages.text:
The other day, when some of us were out with the matron, I saw a gnome pushing a cart filled with toys. He had dolls, copper racers, leather balls, and some kites. I've always wanted to get a dragon kite and the matron said that if I saved all my money I could buy one, but that's going to be a long time.

I think the gnome's name was Craggle Wobbletop or something like that. If we can find him, could we get some kites and fly them together? I saw him walking around the canals outside the Trade District.

passages.title: Let's Go Fly a Kite
passages.text: I thought for sure I was going to have to save all my money for like a million years to get a kite!

passages.title: Let's Go Fly a Kite
passages.text: Thanks for the kite, <name>. Every time I fly it, I'll remember the day you gave it to me!

passages.title: Echoes of Nemesis
passages.text:
<Mylune's voice sings like a melody in your head.>

Remember that awful fire turtle, Nemesis, from the Firelands? He's dead now (yay!) but echoes of him keep trying to break through to Mount Hyjal.

Go to the shores of the Ashen Lake and speak with my friend Tooga. Let him know you're ready to fight an echo of Nemesis, and the turtles will draw him into this world. Then you can hit him! Hard!

Hide inside of Tooga's shell if he starts to erupt.

passages.title: Echoes of Nemesis
passages.text:
Hooray! It just goes to show you, when a turtle puts his mind to something -

<Mylune is distracted by a butterfly and never finishes her thought.>

passages.title: Rage Against the Flames
passages.text:
Of all of our tasks here in Hyjal, the most pressing is simple: destroy these invaders. The very nature of fire is that it is all-consuming. Lower your defense for just a moment and it will destroy everything in sight.

Kill any of the fiery invaders you find. Every enemy defeated purchases more time for Hyjal.

passages.title: Rage Against the Flames
passages.text:
Well-fought, <name>. Take a break from the flames for a while.

Hyjal will live to see another day, and when that day comes, I will need you alive.

passages.title: Rage Against the Flames
passages.text:
Of all of our tasks here in Hyjal, the most pressing is simple: destroy these invaders. The very nature of fire is that it is all-consuming. Lower your defense for just a moment and it will destroy everything in sight.

Kill any of the fiery invaders you find. Every enemy defeated purchases more time for Hyjal.

passages.title: Rage Against the Flames
passages.text:
Well-fought, <name>. Take a break from the flames for a while.

Hyjal will live to see another day, and when that day comes, I will need you alive.

passages.title: Wisp Away
passages.text:
The fire elementals are pouring out of portals on the far side of the Ashen Fields. We need someone to close them. Cut off some of their reinforcements.

Banishing these kinds of elemental magics is something our wisps are perfectly suited for. One will come with you. Lead it to a portal and keep it alive until it finishes.

passages.title: Wisp Away
passages.text: Well done, <class>. I'll have to make more use of your skills in the future.

passages.title: Ridin' the Rocketway
passages.text:
I heard that the goblins, built a crazy road in Azshara and it's just for rockets! Can you imagine? Ever since I heard about it, I've wanted to pay a visit. I asked Matron Battlewail about it and she said it's called the Rocketway!

She even told me they're working on a prototype rocket with two seats. D'you wanna go there and see if we can try it out? I bet the experimental rocket is near the Secret Lab at the south end of the Rocketway...

passages.title: Ridin' the Rocketway
passages.text: This is gonna be the best Children's Week ever!

passages.title: Ridin' the Rocketway
passages.text: That was great! I even learned how to control the rocket and everything! Did you see how I saved us? I'm gonna be a rocket pilot when I grow up!

passages.title: Call the Flock
passages.text:
Today, we have an opportunity to make another assault against one of Ragnaros' greater minions: Millagazor. However, we first need to get some assistance.

<Matoclaw holds up a large, silky feather.>

Use this artifact to invoke the power of Aviana. Once you have done so, travel northwest and gather some of her flock by calling out to them.

Once you have done so, we may proceed against Millagazor.

passages.title: Call the Flock
passages.text:
<Amidst the chirps, hoots, and frenzied caws of your fellow birds, you hear the voice of Matoclaw speaking to you from afar.>

Well done, <race>. Now that the flock is assembled, we strike.

passages.title: Wings Aflame
passages.text:
<Matoclaw's voice continues to echo within your head.>

Millagazor is a creature of flame, but in many ways, he is not unlike the birds of this land. As such, Aviana's artifacts may still have the power to summon him.

The fiery portal to the west is where you will find him. Use the quill near the portal's entrance, then prepare for a fierce battle.

passages.title: Wings Aflame
passages.text: Earth-Mother guide your path.

passages.title: Wings Aflame
passages.text: Well done, champion.

passages.title: Rage Against the Flames
passages.text:
Of all of our tasks here in Hyjal, the most pressing is simple: destroy these invaders. The very nature of fire is that it is all-consuming. Lower your defense for just a moment and it will destroy everything in sight.

Kill any of the fiery invaders you find. Every enemy defeated purchases more time for Hyjal.

passages.title: Rage Against the Flames
passages.text:
Well-fought, <name>. Take a break from the flames for a while.

Hyjal will live to see another day, and when that day comes, I will need you alive.

passages.title: A Shiny Reward
passages.text:
There is a stash of loot located in the statue on Janeiro's Point just northwest of Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.

Head to the statue and claim your prize, <class>.

passages.title: A Shiny Reward
passages.text: Loot at last!

passages.title: Egg-stinction
passages.text:
We have a real problem on our hands. Not only are the nearby spiders vicious and predatory, their numbers appear to be endless.

We need to stop the growth of their army. Cut their heads off in the egg, not on the battlefield.

The Cinderweb Spinners' eggs are laid among the stone pillars to the north. Collect 20 eggs and bring them back to me.

passages.title: Egg-stinction
passages.text: It appears the Cinderweb Spinners are the caretakers of Beth'tilac's brood.

passages.title: Egg-stinction
passages.text: Wonderful work, <class>. Let's hope those little spider bites aren't infectious.

passages.title: Those Bears Up There
passages.text:
Oh, raspberries! Just when we had saved the last bear cub from the treetops, the fires returned and scared them again!

I don't know if you know this, but baby bears are precious and soft.

Go to the Whistling Grove, far to the northwest. Climb the trees, grab the bear cubs, and chuck them - gently! - to the soft target in the center of the grove.

<Without warning, Mylune suddenly smashes you against her bosom and begins sobbing.>

Lil' b-b-b-baby bears! Save them, <name>!

passages.title: Those Bears Up There
passages.text:
<Mylune's thoughts echo in your mind, along with unwanted images of flowers and squirrels.>

Oh, you did it, <name>! The baby bears are so happy.

I'm beginning to think they've started doing this on purpose.

passages.title: Rage Against the Flames
passages.text:
Of all of our tasks here in Hyjal, the most pressing is simple: destroy these invaders. The very nature of fire is that it is all-consuming. Lower your defense for just a moment and it will destroy everything in sight.

Kill any of the fiery invaders you find. Every enemy defeated purchases more time for Hyjal.

passages.title: Rage Against the Flames
passages.text:
Well-fought, <name>. Take a break from the flames for a while.

Hyjal will live to see another day, and when that day comes, I will need you alive.

passages.title: Perfecting Your Howl
passages.text:
The wolf ancient, Lo'gosh - or, if you prefer, Goldrinn - has many weapons available to him, but always the most underestimated is his howl. Today, we will use this weapon to summon and defeat Lylagar, one of the lieutenants of flame that lurk within the Firelands.

Defeat any of the creatures of flame within the Regrowth, and then use the Fang of the Wolf while standing atop their corpse. Soon, your howl will echo across all of Kalimdor.

passages.title: Perfecting Your Howl
passages.text:
<Matoclaw's familiar voice enters your consciousness.>

Yes, <name>, you are ready. Now, we strike against Lylagar.

passages.title: The Banshee Queen
passages.text:
Lady Sylvanas is s'posed to be one of the best warriors in the Horde, maybe that's why she is warchief!

I've always wanted to meet her, <name>. Maybe an adventurer like you could get an audience with her! Would you take me to the Royal Quarter of the Undercity to meet Lady Sylvanas? It's a long way away and I bet the guards would never let me in by myself!

passages.title: The Banshee Queen
passages.text: She's just as fierce as I thought she'd be! But that ambassador sure got real mad when I started talking to Lady Sylvanas.

passages.title: Secondary Targets
passages.text:
The Gurubashi trolls have gathered their most powerful allies to rebuild Zul'Gurub and re-take Stranglethorn Vale.

Chief among them are two monstrous trolls: Kaulema the Mover and Mor'Lek the Dismantler, and a powerful soul-stealer called Mortaxx.

Though they are not the leaders of Zul'Gurub, defeating these powerful minions will aid us greatly preventing the rise of the Gurubashi.

passages.title: The Beasts Within
passages.text:
<Maywiki shuffles nervously.>

After the fall of Hakkar, the city of the Gurubashi fell into disrepair, and the jungle claimed most of Zul'Gurub for its own. Several powerful beasts now reside in the cracks and hollows of the ancient city.

We have seen the powers that the Gurubashi priests wield - they turn the very plantlife against us with their venomous concoctions. Please, heroes, dispose of these beasts, before they become mindless agents of Jin'Do and his minions!

passages.title: The Beasts Within
passages.text:
<Bloodslayer T'ara eyes you for a moment.>

After de fall of Hakkar, de city of de Gurubashi fell into disrepair, and de jungle claimed most of Zul'Gurub for its own. Some powerful beasts now be livin' in da cracks an' hollows of de ancient city. 

We seen de powers dem Gurubashi priests wield - dey turn de very plantlife against us wit' venomous concoctions. You tink you be strong? Dispose of dese beasts, before dey become mindless agents of Jin'do.

passages.title: The Beasts Within
passages.text: The very beasts of Zul'Gurub already turn against us.  You must hurry!

passages.title: The Beasts Within
passages.text:
<T'ara's tusks shift slightly.  Is she smiling?>

You done well.

We gonna rest easy tonight knowin' Jin'do an' Zanzil ain't gonna bind dem powerful beasts against us.

passages.title: Secondary Targets
passages.text:
Da Gurubashi trolls gathered dere most powerful allies ta rebuild Zul'Gurub an' re-take Stranglethorn Vale.

Chief among dem be two monstrous trolls: Kaulema da Mover an' Mor'Lek da Dismantler, an' a powerful soul-stealer called Mortaxx.

Dey don't be leaders of da Gurubashi, but killing dem powerful minions gonna help us prevent da rise of da Gurubashi.

passages.title: Secondary Targets
passages.text: The most powerful underlings of the Gurubashi must be dealt with!

passages.title: Secondary Targets
passages.text: Jin'do's empire crumbles around him like da ruins of dis forsaken city.

passages.title: The Fallen Chieftain
passages.text:
Matron Battlewail says that when Cairne Bloodhoof died, the Horde lost a 'voice of wisdom'. I don't know what that means, but I always wanted to meet him. Some of the other orphans even have his hoofprint.

Would you take me with you to Mulgore? Our tutor says tauren bring their dead to a place called Red Rocks to honor them. We should go there and see if we can find Cairne.

passages.title: The Fallen Chieftain
passages.text: I want to visit Mulgore more often.

passages.title: The Fallen Chieftain
passages.text: Someday, I'm going to be a great warrior, just like Cairne or the warchief. Everyone will remember my deeds, and the ancestors will welcome my spirit too!

passages.title: Vigilance on Wings
passages.text:
The agents of Twilight continue their assault within this pocket of the Firelands. We must not let our offensive fall! Take wing, and destroy as many of those lancers as you can!

Do not forget to pick up and equip your lance first.

passages.title: Vigilance on Wings
passages.text: Our vigilance must not fall. Especially not now, in this most trying of times!

passages.title: Vigilance on Wings
passages.text: Well done, <class>. I hope you don't forget about us here in the Hatchery.

passages.title: The Hex Lord's Fetish
passages.text:
Dis new warlord of da Amani, he be nothin' but an overgrown brute without da protection of a strong witch doctor and he has just dat.

Da new warlord's ally be Hex Lord Malacrass, da most feared witch doctor to walk among da Amani in decades. Without da hex lord's say-so, Daakara won't be submitting his people to da control of da Zandalari.

Defeat Hex Lord Malacrass, bring me his favorite fetish, and I be seein' that ya get a fittin' reward.

passages.title: The Hex Lord's Fetish
passages.text: Have ya eliminated Hex Lord Malacrass?

passages.title: The Hex Lord's Fetish
passages.text: So dis is da fetish of da mighty Malacrass? It be a good addition to my collection, <name>. And now, I believe, rewards be in order.

passages.title: Let's Go Fly a Kite
passages.text:
The other day, when some of us were out with the matron, I saw a goblin pushing a cart filled with toys. He had dolls, copper racers, leather balls, and some kites. I've always wanted to get a dragon kite and the matron said that if I saved all my money I could buy one, but that's going to be a long time.

I think the goblin's name was Blax Bottlerocket or something. If we can find him, could we get some kites and fly them together? I saw him pushing his cart around the Drag.

passages.title: Let's Go Fly a Kite
passages.text: I thought for sure I was going to have to save all my money for like a million years to get a kite!

passages.title: Let's Go Fly a Kite
passages.text: Thanks for the kite, <name>. Every time I fly it, I'll remember the day you gave it to me!

passages.title: The Wardens are Watching
passages.text:
We must tread carefully, <class>. Fandral's Druids of the Flame practice their fiery magic beyond the pillars to the north.

I need you to capture one of those druids alive for questioning. We must seize every opportunity to learn of their plans.

One of my wardens will accompany you. Follow her instructions if you wish to survive.

passages.title: The Wardens are Watching
passages.text: I am impressed, <class>. Your deeds will be remembered among the Shadow Wardens.

passages.title: Through a Glass, Darkly
passages.text:
<Tarecgosa listens as you explain your presence in Coldarra.>

Your tale rings true, <class>. Much has changed since the death of Malygos - little of it for the better.

I know of the device you carry, and I recognize Anachronos' magic in its creation. There is but one place in all of Coldarra that would allow this Timeless Eye to be used discreetly.

You will require my assistance if you hope to succeed. Speak with me again inside the Nexus and you shall have it.

passages.title: Through a Glass, Darkly
passages.text: Tell me, mortal, what did you see?

passages.title: Through a Glass, Darkly
passages.text:
This cannot be, <class>!

It must be some kind of trick!

passages.title: A Ritual of Flame
passages.text:
We appear to have everything under control. Our invasion portal to the Firelands will be opened momentarily, and the elementals have not put up much fight.

Assist our druids by dispatching the last few of these elementals. Then, once the gate has been opened, we can make our move.

passages.title: A Ritual of Flame
passages.text: Continue the fight, <name>. Only a short while longer now.

passages.title: A Ritual of Flame
passages.text: Leyara... she lives. I sense Fandral's hand at play here...

passages.title: Caught Unawares
passages.text:
Our invasion plan looks to have backfired. Several of our birds have already reported in, speaking of fires breaking out across the vales of central Hyjal.

Now, many of our druids are stranded out in the field, unprepared for such a large-scale attack. Thisalee was near Ashen Lake, and several others were out in the Regrowth, to the northeast.

Go, <name>! Find them, and make sure that they do not succumb to this backdraft!

passages.title: Caught Unawares
passages.text: There isn't time! Move!

passages.title: Caught Unawares
passages.text:
<name>! You're back!

They've pushed us back to the Sanctuary. We are vastly outnumbered. At this rate, the Guardians of Hyjal stand little chance of survival.

I'm glad you're here with us.

passages.title: Through the Gates of Hell
passages.text:
There will be time to mourn for Hamuul later. His is the first of many inevitable casualties in this war.... but our attack cannot wait, nor should the momentum we have gained over the last several days be wasted.

The portal atop Nordune Ridge is now open. Our reinforcements are prepared, and they await only my order to pass through the portal.

We will meet again on the other side of the portal. Once there, we shall ensure that our foothold is secure.

passages.title: Through the Gates of Hell
passages.text:
Very well done, <class>. We've managed to take a foothold in our enemy's realm without their notice. Our armies are moving through to establish a front as we speak.

We have a long, brutal war ahead of us. It is my hope that you'll be around to help us see it through.

passages.title: The Fate of Runetotem
passages.text:
I apologize for speaking curtly with you earlier. The loss of Hamuul was shocking to me, and difficult to cope with.

They brought in his body while you were away. He is alive, but - as you might imagine - he is very, very badly burned.

The scars are deep. He may not live.

I have arranged for some of our finest healers to attend to him. If it is not too much to ask, would you speak with Dorda'en Nightweaver? He and his fellow attendants may need your help.

passages.title: The Fate of Runetotem
passages.text:
Yes, Hamuul lives. You can visit him in the tent behind me, but please, be careful. He is in a fragile condition, and we are doing everything in our power just to keep him alive and comfortable.

Whoever did this to the Arch Druid showed no mercy. I hope that you are someday able to return the favor.

passages.title: The Warden's Charge
passages.text:
Captain Saynna Stormrunner is launching an attack against the Forlorn Spire. If you head to the northeast, you'll find her at the bottom of the ramp leading up towards that rise.

I've assigned her a large number of our men, but her chances of success would be greatly increased if you join her cause. It's your decision, <name>.

passages.title: Into the Fire
passages.text:
Skylord Omnuron and his druids are seeking to push through the Furnace to our northwest. They've been able to fly over the dangers, but they really need someone on the ground to help them secure the territory past the fire... someone like you.

If you want to aid the Druids of the Talon, wait for one of Omnuron's Windcallers to start pushing through the fire, stay close to him, and keep him safe from any attackers within the flames.

passages.title: Into the Fire
passages.text:
Glad to see the Skylord was finally able to get someone capable through without wings. Our flight has been of little use to us in these confined spaces and amidst the thermals beyond this ridge.

Looks like we'll have to resort to more conventional tactics. You game?

passages.title: Enduring the Heat
passages.text:
Shalis has gone with one of our druids to stop a Druid of the Flame that is performing a summoning ritual in the Igneous Depths, below us. They have been tasked with killing the druid, but I need you to stop the ritual.

You'll find the entrance to the cavern east of the Magma Springs. Once inside, you'll see 8 blue runes spread throughout the cavern. You can use these runes to protect you from the fiery creatures, but you need to stamp all of them out to end the ritual. You will need to be swift.

passages.title: Enduring the Heat
passages.text: You must destroy the runes! Hurry!

passages.title: Enduring the Heat
passages.text:
Well done!

They've been attempting to start rituals of this sort all over the Molten Front, but we've been able to thwart them every time so far. Hopefully you will be present in the future to help us keep up that trend.

passages.title: The Captive Scouts
passages.text:
After we arrived, I dispatched my scouts to learn more about da Zandalari presence here in Zul'Aman. Many returned with useful information, but four still be missin'. If we do not act quickly, da new warlord's lieutenants will offer dem as sacrifices in honor of da Zandalari emissaries.

Find my scouts, <name>, and free dem before da priests offer dem as sacrifices!

passages.title: The Captive Scouts
passages.text: I hadn't expected to see dem again, <name>. The information dey gathered will be da key to destroying Zandalari influence in Zul'Aman. Ya have my thanks and da thanks of my scouts.

passages.title: Serpents and Poison
passages.text:
Da warning helped, <name>.

We gathered more Headhunters to help defend. But Headhunters... Dey not used to hunting heads on serpents. So we soon be overwhelmed. Dese serpents, dey seem to come from everywhere. An' it probably only gonna get worse.

Help us and kill da serpents and have Bwemba use her mojo to cure da ones dat are sick from poison.

passages.title: Serpents and Poison
passages.text: Thanks for da help, <name>.  Dese serpents, dere don't seem to be an end to dem.

passages.title: Spirits Are With Us
passages.text:
Dere was something about da way da serpents attacked, <name>. Something unnatural... Even da poison had a hint of some bad mojo.

Dere be a shrine near here wit' a bonfire. We can use dat to perform a ritual.

Whatever be makin' dese serpents attack, dey probably still watchin' over dem.

Da only problem, <name>, is dat I only be here in spirit form. I need you to be my hands. I need you to go to da fire an' prepare it for me. Den I'll handle da rest.

passages.title: Spirits Are With Us
passages.text: Venoxis... Dis can't be good, <name>.

passages.title: Follow That Cat
passages.text: Well, that explains why Mauti seemed smaller... The real Mauti has run off with Grent Direhammer, but being the wise hunter that he is, he has fired flares off so you can track him. Find Direhammer before it's too late!

passages.title: Follow That Cat
passages.text: We be here... Da hunter, he be in da cave.  Da beast... Sometin' ain't right about her...

passages.title: Treating the Wounds
passages.text:
We have an ample supply of medical supplies here at the Sanctuary, but we mustn't lose sight of the fact that we are at war. Hamuul isn't the only person who has need of bandages.

The fiery behemoths that roam Sethria's Roost wear flame-resistant wrappings that will serve Hamuul as ably as any bandage. Bring me those wrappings, and I will prepare them for use on the Arch Druid.

passages.title: Treating the Wounds
passages.text: There are some who say that the sulfur in those wrappings has curative properties. Personally, I am unconvinced, but I am willing to endure the smell on the off-chance that it does.

passages.title: Treating the Wounds
passages.text:
Many thanks, <class>.

You do the war effort a favor. Burn victims have a notorious appetite for bandages, and Hamuul is no exception.

passages.title: A Shiny Reward
passages.text:
There is a stash of loot located in the statue on Janeiro's Point just northwest of Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.

Head to the statue and claim your prize, <class>.

passages.title: A Shiny Reward
passages.text: Loot at last!

passages.title: Embergris
passages.text:
The Crimson Lasher has developed some cracking blisters on its vines. Without treatment, this condition could be life threatening.

Luckily, the Charred Soldiers and Charred Vanquishers in the area produce a waxy substance known as Embergris, which should soothe the Lasher's pain.

Bring me some of this substance, and kill those nasty fire elementals while you're at it.

passages.title: Embergris
passages.text: The Lasher is growing quite quickly.

passages.title: Embergris
passages.text: It isn't very pleasant-smelling, but this should fix the Lasher right up.

passages.title: Zul'Aman Voodoo
passages.text: The tablet provides the final incantation to bind the voodoo pile's magic to you and your party!

passages.title: A Bitter Pill
passages.text:
As far as I'm concerned, there's no problem that can't be solved with bombs. And if a bomb doesn't solve your problem on the first try... use a bigger bomb.

So there's this big worm that's been eating people near the lava pools up north. Search for breath bubbles to find it. Attack it until it prepares to bite, then place this bomb down in front of it. Then sit back and watch the fireworks.

Hmm... there was one other thing I wanted to say... oh yeah! Don't get eaten.

passages.title: A Bitter Pill
passages.text: Ah knew Ricket's bombs'd come in handy. Twas just a matter ah findin' somethin' big enough to explode.

passages.title: Some Good Will Come
passages.text:
So much violence, so much death. Brothers have died, a mother has died, and now a panther cub will die if there is no one to take care of it.

Will you take a pause from the violence to help care for a panther cub?

passages.title: Bound for Warmer Weather
passages.text: We should be okay here for now, and they have need of you in the Firelands. You should go through the portal and help them out.

passages.title: How Hot
passages.text:
The fire hawks of Fireplume Peak can withstand incredible temperatures. While you'll often find them circling the skies above, they're also known to swim in molten lava.

Isn't that right, Anren?

We'd like to know just how hot that lava can get. Fireplume Peak has three large lava pools. Use this to measure the temperature of each.

passages.title: How Hot
passages.text:
These results will go a long way to help us understand the fire hawks, and - more importantly - Alysrazor, their new, fiery queen.

Tholo and I are thankful that you've been helping us out.

passages.title: Fandral's Methods
passages.text:
The Druids of the Flame... an order of druids that, up until a few weeks ago, Tholo and I had never even heard of. Now, under the leadership of Fandral Staghelm, they threaten our mission's success with their mastery of fire.

It would appear that they store some supplies in the Igneous Depths, to the northeast. Perhaps, if we can get some of those supplies, we will have more luck when we take the fight to Fandral.

passages.title: Fandral's Methods
passages.text: Trust me - whatever information we can gather here will go far to helping us understand the source of Fandral's powers.

passages.title: Fandral's Methods
passages.text:
Anren, look what <name> found! This is exactly what we needed!

It will take us some time to look through these supplies. For now, you have our thanks.

passages.title: The Flame Spider Queen
passages.text:
The Widow's Clutch, to the northeast, is named after Beth'tilac, the enormous queen of the flame spiders. Her webs and her poison are a nagging threat to our main offensive force.

We believe that if we study the flame spiders here on the Molten Front, we can use that information to find success against Beth'tilac. Use whatever methods you can to gather their venom and their web fluid, then return to my trusted friend Anren.

passages.title: The Flame Spider Queen
passages.text: Be careful with those fluids, <name>. We don't want them spilling anywhere.

passages.title: The Flame Spider Queen
passages.text: You are an asset to our cause, <name>. Tholo and I thank you.

passages.title: Alignment
passages.text:
The time of choosing has arrived, <name>.

While only members of the blue dragonflight may attend, Tarecgosa's binding makes your presence requisite.

I must ask that you take on her form and vote on her behalf.

Do not tarry. The moment of the eclipse draws near....

passages.title: Alignment
passages.text: It is done, <class>.

passages.title: Alignment
passages.text:
Arygos's machinations have been undone, thanks in great part to you, <class>.

As my first act as aspect of the blue dragonflight, your bond with Tarecgosa is now made stable.

The power that once sustained that bond I now infuse into your staff.

May the Runestaff of Nordrassil serve you well!

passages.title: Fire in the Skies
passages.text:
Look at that! It's incredible! Born less than two days ago and already full grown. Sadly, I suspect their life cycle is similarly short, so we'll have to take advantage of any time we have.

His training went remarkably well. I want you to be the one to take him out and unleash him on the bulk of the enemy forces gathered near Ragnaros' keep.

Show no mercy, <race>.

passages.title: Fire in the Skies
passages.text: Some of our most capable forces are poised to strike at Ragnaros himself. If these attacks go well, we may be able to give them the opportunity they need.

passages.title: Fire in the Skies
passages.text: I take it your assault was a success! Brilliant. This could be a key moment in opening up Ragnaros' defenses.

passages.title: The Bigger They Are
passages.text:
You're not going to take on fiery behemoths wearing THAT, are you? If you aren't wearing my obsidium crafted goods, you're going to burn right up! And even if you are, you can never have enough of the good stuff.

Look <brother/sister>, I can craft you the best armor that gold can buy, but I need pure, unsmelted Living Obsidium first.

The Obsidium Punishers on Fireplume Peak are literally made of the stuff. Go kill them and gather their pieces.

passages.title: The Bigger They Are
passages.text: Did you bring me the goods?

passages.title: The Bigger They Are
passages.text: This'll do. Nice work, <name>.

passages.title: Bye Bye Burdy
passages.text:
Staghelm's druids are putting up a fierce fight at Wildflame Point to the northeast.

The druids fly above us in fire crow form, then strike when we least expect it. Worst part is, they know exactly how to stay out of our reach!

We would be totally helpless, except Damek lent me his trusty harpoon. He says these weapons will fly straight and true even in this super dense air.

Take the dwarf's weapon and shoot some birds out of the sky!

passages.title: Bye Bye Burdy
passages.text: Those blasted burds are dead? Good riddance!

passages.title: A Smoke-Stained Locket
passages.text:
This locket has a few small leaf-shaped carvings etched into its face, but any other details have been rubbed away with time, or burned away with fire. It appears to be druidic in nature.

Most druids pass through Moonglade during their training. If anybody can help you decipher where this locket came from, it would be Rabine Saturna of Nighthaven.

passages.title: A Smoke-Stained Locket
passages.text: Yes, young <race>?

passages.title: A Smoke-Stained Locket
passages.text:
What have we here? A necklace? No, a locket...

Oh, my...

passages.title: Some Like It Hot
passages.text:
