passages.text: We cannot hope to re-take the clutches as long as those mines are still present is such quantities.

passages.title: Ordnance Disposal
passages.text: You weren't exposed to the pheromones were you? That could lead to... well, perhaps I shouldn't worry you with the details.

passages.title: Shackles of Manipulation
passages.text:
The Zan'thik employ a sizable force of... indentured labor.

Yaungol are bound in special shackles which enhance and prolong the effects of sonic manipulation. It is this technology that allows the Zan'thik manipulators to command such large quantities of thralls to endlessly toil for them in the quarries.

I would like to study these shackles.

passages.title: Shackles of Manipulation
passages.text: Surely this is something you can handle, is it not?

passages.title: Shackles of Manipulation
passages.text: Ingenious devices, really. I have a feeling they will prove useful.

passages.title: Meltdown
passages.text:
The venomsting scorpions on Zan'vess are fed sap from a young age, causing a fascinating mutation in which their natural armor plating becomes infused with amber. Effectively, it's organic kyparite, the same substance used in forging most of the empire's weapons and armor.

I think I've found a way to chemically break down kyparite, but it needs testing. Use these grenades on the Zan'thik venomstings and observe the results.

passages.title: Meltdown
passages.text:
The kyparite ignited, did it? Fascinating!

Not exactly what I was hoping for, but it's something.

passages.title: Specimen Request
passages.text:
Kyparite worms have shown extreme adaptations in order to mimic the environment around them. They can also grow to immense sizes at rates which are nearly unheard of for most creatures.

Their physiology could provide valuable insight into further mutations.

Bring me sample shards from the muck tunnelers in the shallows near Zan'vess.

passages.title: Specimen Request
passages.text: Do you have the specimens?

passages.title: Specimen Request
passages.text: Well look at that, you actually got it done. I half expected to be scooping your remains out of the muck with a jar.

passages.title: Fear Takes Root
passages.text:
The fallout from Shek'zeer's madness will continue long after her reign has ended. We will struggle to heal our lands for many years to come, and even then our efforts may prove fruitless.

A new species of sha-twisted flora has begun taking root near Zan'vess. Destroy any that you find, but beware - there is no telling what kind of sinister defenses it may have.

passages.title: Fear Takes Root
passages.text: This species is interesting, but the risks associated with keeping it around for study are too high.

passages.title: Quiet Now
passages.text:
On the southwestern corner of Zan'vess lie the Whispering Stones. Much like the towers here, they are critical in transmitting long-range sonic signals.

An adjunct of the Empress operates the stones, keeping her in communication with the Zan'thik forces. Disrupt the signal, then silence him.

passages.title: Quiet Now
passages.text:
It must drive her further into paranoia and madness, losing contact with Zan'vess.

Good. Let her suffer.

passages.title: A Witness to History
passages.text:
I will gather up the other Tauren pilgrims and we will travel into the Vale together.

Meet me at the Gate of the August Celestials at the southern edge of Kun-Lai Summit and speak with me there.

passages.title: A Witness to History
passages.text: You must be <name>.

passages.title: A Witness to History
passages.text:
Thank you for coming so quickly.

For thousands of years, the Golden Lotus has kept the Vale safe from those who would seek its power.

Unfortunately, that time is past, and we need your help.

passages.title: Unto Dust Thou Shalt Return
passages.text:
<You take the second anointed blade in hand and feel the power of both swords course through you.>

<There is but one thing left to do. As the mysterious, hooded woman explained, to put an end to the Scarlet Crusade, you must thrust both blades into the corpse of High Inquisitor Whitemane.>

passages.title: Unto Dust Thou Shalt Return
passages.text: <The deed is not yet done. There can be no end to the Scarlet Crusade while Whitemane can come back from the dead.>

passages.title: Unto Dust Thou Shalt Return
passages.text:
With Whitemane gone for good, the Scarlet Crusade is finished. It's just a matter of sweeping up the refuse.

Thank you, <name>. Not just for myself, but for everyone opposed to mindless hatred and bigotry.

And, thank you for these two new blades. Anointed anew in her blood, they should serve me well as I take the fight to Scholomance and deal with Darkmaster Gandling.

I bid you adieu for now.

passages.title: Unto Dust Thou Shalt Return
passages.text:
<You take the second anointed blade in hand and feel the power of both swords course through you.>

<There is but one thing left to do. As the mysterious, hooded woman explained, to put an end to the Scarlet Crusade, you must thrust both blades into the corpse of High Inquisitor Whitemane.>

passages.text: <The deed is not yet done. There can be no end to the Scarlet Crusade while Whitemane can come back from the dead.>

passages.text:
With Whitemane gone for good, the Scarlet Crusade is finished. It's just a matter of sweeping up the refuse.

Thank you, <name>. Not just for myself, but for everyone opposed to mindless hatred and bigotry.

And, thank you for these two new blades. Anointed anew in her blood, they should serve me well as I take the fight to Scholomance and deal with Darkmaster Gandling.

I bid you adieu for now.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Yan-zhu the Uncasked
passages.text:
<name>, I need you to assemble a hearty group and lead them into Stormstout Brewery. Activate the Challenger's Orb therein, and evaporate Yan-zhu the Uncasked.

Return to me when you've completed this challenge, and I shall reward you handsomely.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Yan-zhu the Uncasked
passages.text: You have my sincerest thanks, <name>. Without fine Stormstout brews to lighten the drudgery of the day, the world would be a dull place indeed.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Sha of Doubt
passages.text:
<name>, I need you to assemble a hearty group and lead them into the Temple of the Jade Serpent. Activate the Challenger's Orb therein, and vanquish the Sha of Doubt.

Return to me when you've completed this challenge, and I shall reward you handsomely.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Sha of Doubt
passages.text: You have my gratitude, <name>. You've displayed great valor today, and the speed at which you completed the challenge surely will impress your friends and intimidate your foes.

passages.title: To Be a Master
passages.text: There will come a day when you have mastered all that we have to teach you. When that day comes, it will be time for you to teach others in turn. When you have proven to yourself that you have mastered all the Ways, come back and speak with me.

passages.title: To Be a Master
passages.text: You have been a great student. Now you should share your knowledge with others. I hope you will speak with the Stock Master and take on an apprentice as soon as you can.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Sha of Hatred
passages.text:
<name>, I need you to assemble a tranquil group and lead them into the Shado-Pan Monastery. Activate the Challenger's Orb therein, and rescue Taran Zhu from the Sha of Hatred.

Return to me when you've completed this challenge, and I shall reward you handsomely.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Sha of Hatred
passages.text: Many blessings upon you, <name>. Driving hatred from this world so quickly deserves rich reward.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Xin the Weaponmaster
passages.text:
<name>, I need you to assemble a nimble group and lead them into Mogu'shan Palace. Activate the Challenger's Orb therein, and put an end to Xin the Weaponmaster.

Return to me when you've completed this challenge, and I shall reward you handsomely.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Xin the Weaponmaster
passages.text: Many thanks, <name>. Your martial prowess is second to none, and your alacrity is sure to strike fear in the hearts of your enemies.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Raigonn
passages.text:
<name>, I need you to assemble a cracking group and lead them into the Gate of the Setting Sun. Activate the Challenger's Orb therein and lay waste to Raigonn.

Return to me when you've completed this challenge, and I shall reward you handsomely.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Raigonn
passages.text: That was a blow well struck, <name>. I've never seen a <class> fell a giant with such speed.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Wing Leader Ner'onok
passages.text:
<name>, I need you to assemble an eagle-eyed group and lead them into the Siege of Niuzao Temple. Activate the Challenger's Orb and ground Wing Leader Ner'onok.

Return to me when you've completed this challenge, and I shall reward you handsomely.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Wing Leader Ner'onok
passages.text: <name>, that was amazing. Ner'onok is a master tactician, and you schooled him handily.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Durand
passages.text:
<name>, I need you to assemble a stout group and lead them into Scarlet Monastery. Activate the Challenger's Orb therein, and smite Durand with righteous fury.

Return to me when you've completed this challenge, and I shall reward you handsomely.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Durand
passages.text: <name>, you're a stalwart <class>. Your friends and guild mates will surely notice the speed and ferocity with which you conquered the Scarlet Monastery.

passages.title: The Perfect Feather
passages.text:
This beautifully pristine feather is unlike any you have seen before in the Valley.

There is one person who might be interested in seeing this feather.

passages.title: The Beginner's Brew
passages.text:
Can you keep a secret, <name>?

I've been trying my hand at brewing. All I've got is this old hand-made still, but it still works pretty good.

I've got an idea for a new brew, but I need some ingredients.

I'm awful shy around the townsfolk, but I've seen you making friends all around.

Would you be willing to ask the farmers for some ingredients for me?

passages.title: The Beginner's Brew
passages.text:
I don't know what it is. Maybe it's staring at that brewery day in and day out, but I just feel... like I want to brew the best beer in the Valley... no... all of Pandaria!

Oh, it's a silly dream, isn't it?

passages.title: The Beginner's Brew
passages.text:
You got them! This is wonderful, <name>!

I'll get started on the brew as soon as I can.

passages.title: Ella's Taste Test
passages.text:
Well, I finally got the brew made, but I won't know if it's any good unless some people taste it.

Would you take my brew and see what the folks in Halfhill think?

I... I couldn't face them myself.

passages.title: Ella's Taste Test
passages.text: Really? That's what they really said? Wow!

passages.title: A Thing of Beauty
passages.text:
We live in a world of magic.The few among us who are skilled can imbue this magic into the things we craft and give them power. Such things are valued.

Fewer still, however, are those among us who can create things that are cherished through the ages not because they are imbued with power, but because of their great beauty.

The Temple of the Jade Serpent has commissioned us for such a work, and I believe you are the worthiest among us. Will you accept the commission?

passages.title: A Thing of Beauty
passages.text: This is a grand project. It will take much time and effort, even from a craftsman such as you.

passages.title: A Thing of Beauty
passages.text: This... This is beyond my wildest expectations. This will be treasured and preserved for generations to come.

passages.title: Staves for Tian Monastery
passages.text:
It seems like the Tian Monsatery is training a lot of monks this year. We've received a huge commission for staves. And by huge, I mean HUGE.

Could you take on part of the commission? I'd very much appreciate it. You will receive the rewards for your portion, of course.

passages.title: Staves for Tian Monastery
passages.text: So many staves! How many monks do they have?!

passages.title: Staves for Tian Monastery
passages.text: Fine craftsmanship.  The monks will appreciate these.

passages.title: Set in Jade
passages.text: One of the greatest poets of our time is Master Kwang. He has composed a poem of great beauty, and a merchant in Halfhill would like to have these words inscribed in stone, to display proudly in her home. She has requested a scribe of great skill to take on this job. Will you accept the commission?

passages.title: Set in Jade
passages.text: How is it coming along?

passages.title: Set in Jade
passages.text: Beautiful. This will be cherished.

passages.title: Incarnadine Ink
passages.text:
The practice of caligraphy is an old custom in Pandaria. I am working on a piece about an ancient war, so I seek an ink that is suitable to the subject matter.

I have searched high and low for the right hue, but it eludes me. Can you think of a way to achieve the color I am seeking?

passages.title: Incarnadine Ink
passages.text: I cannot find the right color!

passages.title: Incarnadine Ink
passages.text: Where did you... How did you... This is perfect!

passages.title: Portrait of a Lady
passages.text: Many great pieces of art are results of great love. A merchant in Halfhill wishes to have a portrait made for his beloved, as a birthday present. Will you accept this commission?

passages.title: Portrait of a Lady
passages.text: It is a wonderful thing to see a man so in love.

passages.title: Portrait of a Lady
passages.text: A fine painting.

passages.title: A Tribute to the Dead
passages.text: All things must come to an end - even the life of a good man. A family in Kun Lai has commissioned a monument for their beloved patriarch who has passed on recently. Will you accept the commission?

passages.title: A Tribute to the Dead
passages.text: Respect for the dead is part of our traditions.

passages.title: A Tribute to the Dead
passages.text: A fine work to honor a fine man.

passages.title: The Finer Things
passages.text:
The Pandaria Treasure Society is interested in purchasing finely crafted goods from skilled jewelcrafters such as yourself. The items will be catalogued, and the most exceptional cuts stored in a secret vault, while the rest are sold to refresh our funds.

Our goal is to eventually create a unique collection for a special event.

passages.title: Kypa'rak's Core
passages.text: <As the ringworm tumbles apart, a massive chunk of organic kyparite falls from its core. Someone at Klaxxi'vess will want to see this.>

passages.title: Kypa'rak's Core
passages.text:
Interesting. You were wise to spot the importance of this, Wakener. Organic kyparite is highly valuable to us.

Here, a reward. In fair trade.

passages.title: The Matriarch's Maw
passages.text: <The enormous mandibles of the kunchong matriarch Karanosh should be of value to someone in Klaxxi'vess.>

passages.title: The Matriarch's Maw
passages.text:
I recognize those mandibles. Karanosh ate my brother, you know.

Of course, I have millions of brothers.

<Zikk cackles.>

passages.title: Assault on Zan'vess
passages.text:
The island settlement of Zan'vess is the last hope for the future of my kind. Although the mantid there are loyal to Shek'zeer, the kypari itself has been spared the sha corruption that has befallen the mainland.

Still, under imperial orders, the Zan'thik are draining sap at an unsustainable rate.

You have proven yourself a capable asset. The council wants you to lead an assault on the island. Disrupt their operations and keep the kypari healthy.

Speak with me when you are ready to begin.

passages.title: The Wrath of Shek'zeer
passages.text: The rest of the freed paragons are scattered around the Heart of Fear, fighting off the mantid swarm. They may need your help!

passages.title: The Wrath of Shek'zeer
passages.text: The siege is broken, for now.

passages.title: Shadow of the Empire
passages.text:
You only understand part of our order. You are an outsider, and have been treated as such.

It is no longer appropriate that we keep our secrets from you. There is something you should see.

passages.title: Shadow of the Empire
passages.text: There is something you should see.

passages.title: Shadow of the Empire
passages.text:
<Kil'ruk gives you a strange glance.>

The Klaxxi'va may never accept you fully. Their xenophobic minds are closed to the possibility of a useful <race>.

I, for one, have been proud to fight by your side, <class>. Your presence, and your assistance, do us great honor.

passages.title: A Source of Terrifying Power
passages.text: <The clutch-keepers seem to be using these blinding white crystals as magical foci. Peering inside, you see thick tendrils of black smoke swirling in the center. One of the workers at Klaxxi'vess may know more about this material and why it is so abundant in the wastes.>

passages.title: A Source of Terrifying Power
passages.text:
Do you have any idea what this is? It's amber!

But it is polluted with fear.

I would not expect an outsider like you to understand the consequences of this.

passages.title: The Cabbage Test
passages.text:
Grandpa always said that the bellweather of a true farmer lies in the quality of his cabbage. Any time a new farmer came into town, he'd buy a few heads of cabbage to see what they knew.

Now, I'm the new farmer, and this is my big chance to prove myself. Could you plant some cabbage for me?

passages.title: The Cabbage Test
passages.text: Good farmers grow good cabbage. Bad farmers, bad cabbage. Pretty simple.

passages.title: The Cabbage Test
passages.text: Wait until they try these cabbages. Then they'll know I'm the real deal.

passages.title: That Dangling Carrot
passages.text:
Grandpa always said, "Carrots ain't nothin but a welcomin' mat for virmen." I don't think I ever saw him grow a single carrot.

For once, I disagree with Grandpa. I like to live on the edge. Plus, I like to eat carrots.

I like to eat carrots on the edge.

Could you get some seeds and grow one for me?

passages.title: That Dangling Carrot
passages.text: I ain't afraid of no virmen.

passages.title: That Dangling Carrot
passages.text: I can't wait to get my paws on those carrots. Thank you, <name>. See you again tomorrow?

passages.title: Why Not Scallions?
passages.text:
I heard Haohan mentioning that he was going to plant scallions today. I'm not sure if today's the best day for scallions, but I'd like to hope that he knows what he's doing. He is the head of the Tillers' union, after all.

Could you plant a scallion for me?

passages.title: Why Not Scallions?
passages.text: I can already smell those scallions from over here. Can't wait to pick 'em and sell 'em tomorrow. Thanks!

passages.title: A Pumpkin-y Perfume
passages.text:
I heard a rumor around the market that Gina Mudclaw loves the smell of pumpkin blossoms. Maybe if I grow some pumpkins in my farm, she might come and visit a little more often.

Could you plant a pumpkin for me?

passages.title: A Pumpkin-y Perfume
passages.text:
And now, we play the waiting game...

Sorry, that sounded a little creepy. Forget I said that.

passages.title: Red Blossom Leeks, You Make the Croc-in' World Go Down
passages.text:
Grandpa once told me that the smell of leeks will keep crocolisks off of your property. He must have had a point... he always grew leeks, and I never saw a crocolisk anywhere NEAR his farm.

We're pretty far from the water... but I suppose you can never be too sure.

passages.title: Red Blossom Leeks, You Make the Croc-in' World Go Down
passages.text:
I'd like to see any crocolisks attack my farm now!

Ha HA!

passages.title: The Pink Turnip Challenge
passages.text:
Old Hillpaw bet me that my land couldn't grow a pink turnip.

I'll show him. My land will grow the biggest, pinkest turnip that old coot's ever seen!

passages.title: The Pink Turnip Challenge
passages.text: Old Hillpaw... what a maroon.

passages.title: The Pink Turnip Challenge
passages.text: Hah! That'll show Hillpaw.

passages.title: The White Turnip Treatment
passages.text:
Grandpa often told me to "Keep my drawers clean and my dirt cleaner." It sounds like a joke, but he makes a good point.

Vegetables tend to leave behind bits of root that can contaminate your soil... but a nice, big, white turnip will clean that gunk right up. Think you could plant a white turnip for me?

passages.title: The White Turnip Treatment
passages.text: Now keepin' your drawers clean, that's more of a personal thing. Grandpa made a good point there, too.

passages.title: The White Turnip Treatment
passages.text:
Look at that dirt. Practically sparkling.

Grandpa would be proud.

passages.title: The Warlord's Ashes
passages.text:
<Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver defeated Warlord Gurthan centuries ago, but the mogu beastmaster's spirit continues to haunt the ruins of his old stronghold.

Showing proof of your victory over this spirit may gain you favor in the eyes of the Klaxxi.>

passages.title: The Warlord's Ashes
passages.text:
Gurthan was a coward who trained beasts to do the fighting for him and, in the face of death, chose to suspend his spirit in that urn.

Now we can have the pleasure of killing him as many times as we like.

Well done.

passages.title: Better With Age
passages.text:
It is a crime to harvest the young trees, but a much bigger crime to waste the amber.

Young amber is not as strong, but the Klaxxi need it to continue the fight. We will bring them more and they will sing my praises!

Gather the young amber. We will store it until it is aged and can be consumed.

passages.title: Better With Age
passages.text: I would go with you to gather amber, but my talents are more useful here.

passages.title: Better With Age
passages.text:
Even this raw amber will be of use. We can't afford to be picky in times like these.

The Klaxxi'va will be glad I thought of this. I will tell them you helped!

passages.title: By the Sea, Nevermore
passages.text:
The Klaxxi'va have spoken to me, outsider. The paragon is hidden in the Briny Muck only, he is not so hidden anymore.

The lizard men surround him. He cannot fall into their scaley hands.

You will find him; you will awaken him. Do not return without him!

If you do this The Klaxxi will be pleased with us.

passages.title: By the Sea, Nevermore
passages.text:
What... what sort of creature are you?

How have you awoken me?

passages.title: Hisingen Blues
Beyond the Wall
passages.text:
We received word the Shado-Pan have begun a counter attack in to Townlong Steppes. It sounds like they are going after the root of the yaungol invasion.

The pandaren have not traveled in force in to Townlong for thousands of years. The Shado-Pan are strong and brave, but they are also proud and few. They will need help from heroes like yourself. Can you travel through the Gate of Winter's Blossom in the northwest? Find the Shado-Pan leaders and lend your help and experience?

passages.title: Beyond the Wall
passages.text: Welcome to Townlong Steppes. If you insist on wandering in to the darkest places of Pandaria then far be it from me to not put you to good use.

passages.title: Thinning The Pack
passages.text:
The past few seasons have been plentiful, and as a result, the wild tiger population on Windward Isle has exploded.

The savage creatures have hunted out all the nearby game, and are beginning to encroach upon the cloud serpent nests.

As a result, as the tigers thrive, the cloud serpents decline.

If we are not careful, the predatory cats could completely wipe them out.

We must thin the tigers' numbers, <race>.

passages.title: Thinning The Pack
passages.text: If we let nature take its course too often, we may lose great treasures.

passages.title: Thinning The Pack
passages.text: You have carried out the task to the letter, <name>.

passages.title: Needle Me Not
passages.text:
The Arboretum is our home, a safe haven where we raise young hatchlings and train our students.

Unfortunately, there are other, more dangerous creatures who wish to make this their home as well.

To the north, beyond the river, we have seen a great wasp feeding on the nectar blossoms.

This creature has already stung several of our students.

Use this honey to lure the wasp out of hiding. Then, destroy it before it harms anyone else.

passages.title: Needle Me Not
passages.text: The nectar attracts many unsavory creatures.

passages.title: Needle Me Not
passages.text: The poisonous wasp is dead? Good. Where so many other students failed, you have succeeded, <name>.

passages.title: A Tangled Web
passages.text:
We have had a disturbing report from the Anglers fishermen of Sri-La Village, <name>.

Many of their villagers are missing, taken by the spiders who live in The Widow's Wail, a cave along the coast to the north.

The victims are dragged into the dark depths, wrapped in cocoons, and left to become the spiders' next meal.

We believe that some of the people may still be alive. There is still time to save them! I need you to go and rescue as many villagers as you can find.

passages.title: A Tangled Web
passages.text: You have done a great deed today, <name>. This is the duty of the Order of the Cloud Serpent - to protect the people of The Jade Forest.

passages.title: Lingering Doubt
passages.text:
I heard that there has been some strange behavior down at The Widow's Wail to the north.

Hyacinth and I went to investigate, and I am certain that some presence of the sha has found its way into the cavern.

I created this device to measure sha energy levels.

If you are going that way, would you mind taking measurements of any sha disturbances?

The disturbances look like streams of white and black sha energy pouring from the ground.

passages.title: Lingering Doubt
passages.text:
Thank you for bringing me this report, <name>. Big Bao is quite right to be concerned.

The sha is a subtle and deadly enemy. We must work to expel their dark energy from this land.

passages.title: The Trainer's Challenge: Ningna Darkwheel
passages.text:
You show much promise, <name>. However, talent is worth little without discipline and humility.

Today, you will face Ningna Darkwheel. Her natural strength makes her one of our most talented students. 

If you hope to defeat her, you will need to act with the utmost control.

Speak to her in the training ring to begin the challenge. Good luck.

passages.title: The Trainer's Challenge: Ningna Darkwheel
passages.text: A fight against Ningna will quickly reveal one's strengths and weaknesses. Well done.

passages.title: The Trainer's Challenge: Suchi the Sweet
passages.text:
Today you will face Suchi the Sweet in the training ring. Despite her sweet exterior, she is a tough opponent.

She attacks swiftly and surely, but such potent attacks can become tiring over time.

If you hope to defeat her, you will need to concentrate your damage when she is weakened.

Speak to Suchi to begin the duel. Good luck.

passages.title: The Trainer's Challenge: Suchi the Sweet
passages.text: Your focus was excellent, <name>. Well done.

passages.title: The Trainer's Challenge: Qua-Ro Whitebrow
passages.text:
Qua-Ro Whitebrow is commonly considered the best student of the Order.

He seems quite without weakness. He is quick of intellect, strong of arm, hard-working, and talented.

When you face him in the training ring, you will be testing yourself against our best.

Speak to him to begin the duel. No matter the outcome, you will learn much from challenging him.

passages.title: The Trainer's Challenge: Qua-Ro Whitebrow
passages.text: Your skills are remarkable, <name>. When I see such promising students as yourself, I know that The Order will pass into good hands.

passages.title: Unleash Hell
passages.text:
I will NOT let the Horde gain a foothold on these shores before we do! If you're looking to jump into the fray, I've got a spare gyrocopter for you at the end of the runway. An attack run is already programmed in, all you have to do is concentrate on shooting.

Unleash hell upon these orcs!

passages.title: Unleash Hell
passages.text: What are you waiting for?! Scorch the ground beneath them!

passages.title: Unleash Hell
passages.text: A proper welcome for the Horde to this new land!

passages.title: Touching Ground
passages.text:
Their town is burning and their men are scattered and broken. I need every available man on the ground NOW to finish them off.

Grab one of the parachutes on the edge of the ship and get down there!

passages.title: Touching Ground
passages.text: Move it!

passages.title: Touching Ground
passages.text: 'Bout time you showed up, laddy! Let's do some damage!

passages.title: The Right Tool For The Job
passages.text:
I've scouted the area and found no leads on the prince or Admiral Taylor. We need to neutralize this base quickly and continue our search elsewhere.

Operations here are being led by an orc warlock; Ga'trul. He's barricaded the dock and is trying to escape through a demonic circle.

Put that flaregun to work again and blow those barricades! I'll cover your back and move in when you reach Ga'trul.

passages.title: The Right Tool For The Job
passages.text: We will complete our mission, but right now our priority is that warlock!

passages.title: The Right Tool For The Job
passages.text: We'll catch up with him again. I'm sure of it.

passages.title: Smoke Before Fire
passages.text:
Sully scouted the Horde establishment to the north, and he reports seeing a large pile of explosives, along with a small force of demolishers. That's not to mention the demons that their warlocks have summoned.

Luckily, we came prepared. We've got air support from the Skyfire. We just need to show our pilots where to strike.

<Rell hands you a smoke flare, and gives you a knowing nod.>

passages.title: Smoke Before Fire
passages.text:
What's that you've got, lad? Some kind o' flare?

Shoot, I coulda put together a better flare'n that in half a wink, if Rell had only asked.

passages.title: Smoke Before Fire
passages.text: Me lads up in the sky bring the heat, don't they? Ha ha ha!

passages.title: Unfair Trade
passages.text:
Though we have only just met, we have a common enemy: this group called the "Horde."

Several days ago, their leader made us a trade offer. When we refused, his servants abducted several of our cubs as bargaining chips.

We have called in the Shado-Pan to help, but they are in Kun-Lai Summit, a journey of several days. Can you come to our aid?

passages.title: Unfair Trade
passages.text: Those poor, wee little cubs. Go, help 'em out, <name>. Do what's right.

passages.title: Unfair Trade
passages.text:
Aye, I seen the wee ones, too. Busted a few out on m'way up here.

Ye've done good, lad. Those cubs might have some nasty nightmares, but they'll grow up some day, thanks to you.

passages.title: Onward and Inward
passages.text:
"Sha" energy, hm? Tread carefully, <name> - there's a hidden darkness to this continent.

We'll stay behind to mop up the rest of the Horde, but we need you to continue with the main mission: the rescue of Captain Taylor, and the retrieval of Prince Anduin.

Our aerial scouts think we've found the wreckage of the flagship near Paw'don Village. Go there and report to Admiral Rogers for instructions.

You are welcome to use my gyrocopter.

passages.title: Onward and Inward
passages.text: Excellent work, <class>. I can see why you came so highly recommended.

passages.title: Acts of Cruelty
passages.text:
I can hear the screams of the captured soldiers and villagers up on the Golden Stair. They're torturing them!

Please, please, you have to save them!

passages.title: Acts of Cruelty
passages.text: My heart rests a little easier knowing what you've done. Thank you, my dear.

passages.title: Striking First
passages.text:
The mogu are empowering some giant stone monstrosity up on the Golden Stair, with the sure intent of unleashing it upon us.

How about you go and let them know our opinion on the matter? Make sure the point strikes home.

passages.title: Striking First
passages.text: How went the diplomacy? I hope you didn't go easy on them.

passages.title: Paint it Red!
passages.text:
They shot out our engines and we floated here - HERE! Right in the firing line of the enemy!

You know what to do, <name>. Get below decks and man those guns!

Show these scum that they're in OUR line of fire!

passages.title: Paint it Red!
passages.text: What are you waiting for?! Get on those guns!

passages.title: Paint it Red!
passages.text:
Superior Horde firepower at its finest!

...and you did okay too I guess.

passages.title: You're Either With Us Or...
passages.text:
The assistance of the nearby village has now become a necessity, adventurer.

We will need to use the village to regroup and tend to our wounded.

Perhaps the villagers will join our cause after seeing the brutality unleashed by the alliance.

You will act as envoy for the Horde. Ensure the cooperation of their leader. Do not disappoint me!

passages.title: You're Either With Us Or...
passages.text:
Your fighting has brought about much destruction for our tiny village!

We have no interest in your war, but we will not turn your injured away.

passages.title: Seeking Zin'jun
passages.text:
Rivett claims to have seen Zin'jun abandon ship with the rest of the survivors. That means he's still out there somewhere.

We can't leave him behind. He could be injured or worse yet, captured!

Go track down Zin'jun and bring him back.

passages.title: Seeking Zin'jun
passages.text:
<Zin'Jun is grievously wounded, but senses that you're friendly.>

Monkey-tings! Everywhere dere be dese monkey-tings!

passages.title: Strongarm Tactics
passages.text:
Scouting reports from the Strongarm Airstrip are in, and I've underlined a few high-priority targets for you.

Two gnomish mechanics have been keeping Alliance gyrocopters in the air. Take out the mechanics, and the gyrocopters' numbers will dwindle.

A dwarven death knight wanders their perimeter. He's an adventurer like yourself - loosely allied and highly dangerous.

Finally, a name I recognize: Corporal Jackson Silver. He's a hero of the Alliance and a deadshot with a crossbow.

Good luck, <name>.

passages.title: Strongarm Tactics
passages.text: These aren't your normal kill targets, <name>. Be on guard.

passages.title: Strongarm Tactics
passages.text: Blood and thunder, <name>. Blood and thunder.

passages.title: Choppertunity
passages.text:
I spotted some shoulder-mounted rocket launchers on the way over here.

They mighta been fireworks. I dunno. I'm just going to assume that they were shoulder-mounted rocket launchers until I'm proven wrong.

Point is, in the arms of a skilled <class> like you, they could probably take down a chopper. If you find any lying around, try pointing them at those poorly-built gyrocopters.

passages.title: Choppertunity
passages.text: Any luck?

passages.title: Choppertunity
passages.text: I hope those ding-dongs enjoyed the party you threw for them!

passages.title: Unreliable Allies
passages.text:
We originally welcomed the Alliance as friends. Several of our villagers volunteered to help them build an airstrip. Only recently, however, did it become clear to us that they were building a war base, within shouting distance of our village.

What's worse - I fear that some villagers are being held against their will. If you find them, <class>, let them know that it is time to come home.

passages.title: Unreliable Allies
passages.text:
Although I can't understand why you chose to bring your war to our land, I can clearly see which side is more virtuous.

Thank you for your aid, <race>.

passages.title: Overthrone
passages.text:
The council is in harmony, wakener.

Our ritual will bring about the demise of the empress and allow us to secure the future of our great empire.

Behold the power of the Klaxxi!

passages.title: Overthrone
passages.text:
We are... undone, wakener.

Your efforts appear to have become imperative to our cause.

On behalf of the remaining council, I implore you to continue in your assistance.

passages.title: Test Quest
passages.text: This artifact has been restored to a remarkably excellent condition. Perhaps you will put it on display at the Seat of Knowledge, so that lorewalkers and archaeologists can study it.

passages.title: Remnants of Anger
passages.text: As you look upon the severed claw of the defeated Sha of Anger, you realize that Ban Bearheart, commander of the Shado-Pan in Townlong Steppes, would want to know of your victory.

passages.title: Remnants of Anger
passages.text:
<Ban looks at you with narrowed eyes.>

Something about you is... different. Changed.

passages.title: Remnants of Anger
passages.text:
<As you present the Claw to Ban, his eyes grow wide with the realization of what you have done.>

I see now what about you has changed.

You have done the impossible. The Shado-Pan shall record your name, and honor it as long as we stand watch over this land.

passages.title: A Present for Teacher
passages.text:
I'm all caught up with the other kids now, even though I started very late. Now I can join the regular classes!

I made you an apron to show you how much I appreciate all you've done for me. I hope you like it?

passages.title: A Present for Teacher
passages.text: Thank you so much.

passages.text: Welcome back <name>, the time has come for the next step of your training. Speak with Master Woo in the Training Grounds below us for your next lesson.

passages.title: Continue Your Training: Master Woo
passages.text: I hear from Master Woo that your training went well.  Come back again in the future to continue your training.

passages.text: Greetings, <name>. Welcome to the Peak of Serenity. It is here that we monks train and hone our skills in the martial arts. The time has come for you to begin your training. Speak with Master Cheng in the Training Grounds below us to begin.

passages.title: Battle Pet Tamers: Kalimdor
passages.text:
Now that you've had a real chance to hone your skills, you're ready to venture out into the world of pet battles in full.

There are five tamers throughout Kalimdor that I'd like you to defeat: Traitor Gluk in Feralas, Grazzle the Great in Dustwallow Marsh, Kela Grimtotem in Thousand Needles, Zoltan in Felwood, and Elena Flutterfly in Moonglade.

If you are able to best them, you will be ready to venture further.

passages.title: Battle Pet Tamers: Kalimdor
passages.text:
Now that you've had a real chance to hone your skills, you're ready to venture out into the world of pet battles in full.

There are five tamers throughout Kalimdor that I'd like you to defeat: Traitor Gluk in Feralas, Grazzle the Great in Dustwallow Marsh, Kela Grimtotem in Thousand Needles, Zoltan in Felwood, and Elena Flutterfly in Moonglade.

If you are able to best them, you will be ready to venture further.

passages.title: Battle Pet Trainers: Kalimdor
passages.text:
The same five trainers you defeated in Kalimdor have foolishly once more challenged you to battle.

Show them no mercy!

passages.title: Battle Pet Tamers: Eastern Kingdoms
passages.text:
Now that you've had a real chance to hone your skills, you're ready to venture out into the world of pet battles in full.

There are five tamers throughout the Eastern Kingdoms that I'd like you to defeat: David Kosse in The Hinterlands, Deiza Plaguehorn in Eastern Plaguelands, Kortas Darkhammer in Searing Gorge, Everessa in Swamp of Sorrows, and Kortas' brother, Durin Darkhammer, in Burning Steppes.

If you are able to best them, you will be ready to venture further.

passages.title: Battle Pet Tamers: Eastern Kingdoms
passages.text:
Now that you've had a real chance to hone your skills, you're ready to venture out into the world of pet battles in full.

There are five tamers throughout the Eastern Kingdoms that I'd like you to defeat: David Kosse in The Hinterlands, Deiza Plaguehorn in Eastern Plaguelands, Kortas Darkhammer in Searing Gorge, Everessa in Swamp of Sorrows, and Kortas' brother, Durin Darkhammer, in Burning Steppes..

If you are able to best them, you will be ready to venture further.

passages.title: Battle Pet Tamers: Northrend
passages.text:
Outland's finest have fallen to your skill, but Northrend now awaits you!

There are four tamers that you must now defeat: Beegle Blastfuse in Howling Fjord, Nearly Headless Jacob in Crystalsong Forest, Okrut Dragonwaste in Dragonblight, and Gutretch in Zul'Drak.

If you are able to best all of them, then Northrend's Grand Master will surely challenge you!

passages.title: Battle Pet Tamers: Northrend
passages.text:
Outland's finest have fallen to your skill, but Northrend now awaits you!

There are four tamers that you must now defeat: Beegle Blastfuse in Howling Fjord, Nearly Headless Jacob in Crystalsong Forest, Okrut Dragonwaste in Dragonblight, and Gutretch in Zul'Drak.

If you are able to best all of them, then Northrend's Grand Master will surely challenge you!

passages.title: Battle Pet Tamers: Pandaria
passages.text:
You must now face the toughest tamers in all of Azeroth, <name>. They make their home in Pandaria, training ground of the grand masters.

There are six grand masters left to defeat: Hyuna of the Shrines in The Jade Forest, Farmer Nishi in Valley of the Four Winds, Mo'ruk in Krasarang Wilds, Courageous Yon in Kun-Lai Summit, Seeker Zusshi in Townlong Steppes, and Wastewalker Shu in Dread Wastes.

If you think yourself ready, seek out these champions of the trade and prove yourself!

passages.title: The "Jinyu Princess" Irrigation System
passages.text:
<The back of the box features a caricature of a jinyu maiden surrounded by marketing copy.>

"Hey there, greenthumb. Are you pouting over parched pumpkins? Crying over crusty cabbage? Are your leeks lame and your melons melancholy?

Then it's time you brought home the Jinyu Princess! She'll wash over your garden like a sweet spring rain, dousing that drought with a deep draught of..."

<It goes on like this for six paragraphs.>

passages.title: The "Jinyu Princess" Irrigation System
passages.text:
A sprinkler system? For the farm? Thank you, <name>! We can use this instead of that old watering can.

The "Jinyu Princess" eh? What's up with that?

Alright, I don't even want to know. I'll get this installed right away!

passages.title: "Thunder King" Pest Repellers
passages.text:
<An imposing image of a mogu face dominates this box, casting its gaze downward at neatly ordered rows of bold text.>

"DO NOT LET WEAK, DISGUSTING INSECTS INFEST YOUR GLORIOUS CROPS. CONQUER THEM WITH THE MIGHT OF THE THUNDER KING AND PROTECT YOUR LEGACY."

<The rest of the space is dedicated to cartoon depictions of various insects crying out in lament or fleeing in terror.>

passages.title: "Thunder King" Pest Repellers
passages.text:
Pest repellers! You're a genius, <name>! We can finally stop using that ancient bug sprayer.

Aw yeah, Thunder King! That's what I'm talking about!

I'll get this installed right away - those bugs won't know what hit 'em!

passages.title: The "Earth-Slasher" Master Plow
passages.text:
<The box art depicts a pandaren farmer of impossible physique standing proudly astride a widening rift in the earth, a mighty plow in his grasp. Cubs wrestle playfully on his shoulders and dangle from his muscular arms.

At his side, a stoic female - of equally impossible physique - balances a massive, overflowing cornucopia gracefully on her head while kicking a virmen in the face.>

"The Earth-Slasher. Master the land. Master your life."

passages.title: The "Earth-Slasher" Master Plow
passages.text:
An Earth-Slasher master plow! I... I never thought I'd get to use one of these. Do you have any idea how much time this will save us?!

I heard if you push the Earth-Slasher through twenty yards of solid rock, you end up with a sandbox and a citation from the Shado-Pan for causing an earthquake scare!

This is going to be AWESOME.

passages.title: Test
passages.text:
All right friend, all of that farming was just for practice!

Are you ready to try the real thing?

Mei Mei Ironpaw over at the market is in need of some carrots for her stew. And you know who can grow those carrots? Us!

How about you show me what you've learned by planting, growing, and harvesting four beds of Juicycrunch Carrots?

passages.title: Squash Those Foul Odors
passages.text:
Grandpa always said, "A squash a week, and your tail won't reek."

<Yoon subtly sniffs the air.>

Yup. I think it's been about a week. Could you help me plant a Jade Squash?

passages.title: Squash Those Foul Odors
passages.text:
Well planted, <name>.

Now we play the waiting game...

passages.title: It's Melon Time
passages.text:
<Farmer Yoon looks up at the sky and sniffs the air.>

Hmm...

<He licks his paw and holds it up in the air, sticks a toenail into the soil, and then inspects the length of his shadow.>

Yup. It's melon time.

Could you grab some seeds and help me plant a Striped Melon?

passages.title: It's Melon Time
passages.text: Hurry up! Melon time doesn't last forever!

passages.title: It's Melon Time
passages.text: That was close. We almost missed melon time.

passages.title: Which Berries? Witchberries.
passages.text:
That young'un over there, Andi, is going to grow up to be a heck of a farmer some day. I can tell just by lookin' at him.

I think I'll plant him some witchberries. Kids love witchberries - it'll be a nice surprise.

passages.title: Which Berries? Witchberries.
passages.text:
Alright, witchberries! I can't wait!

But I'm gonna have to.

passages.title: Complete Your Training: The Final Test
passages.text: Welcome back, <name>. The time has come for you to complete the last step of your training. Head to the Training Grounds for your final test.

passages.title: Complete Your Training: The Final Test
passages.text: Complete your final test.

passages.title: Complete Your Training: The Final Test
passages.text: Well done, <name>.  Your training is now complete.  Feel free to return in the future to spar with the masters here to practice what you have learned.

passages.title: Learn and Grow VI: Gina's Vote
passages.text:
My business is doomed! You see all of the Ironpaws at their cooking stations?

Their tasty dishes draw many of the customers to this market, but they're all out of scallions!

It may not look like much, but the scallion is an essential cooking ingredient. Without it, foods are less savory, less flavorful, and less aromatic.

This is terrible. I'm not getting another scallion shipment for a week!

Wait a second. You're a farmer, aren't you? You think you could help me?

passages.title: Learn and Grow VI: Gina's Vote
passages.text: Don't overlook the scallion. It may be small and innocuous, but it creates truly marvelous flavors.

passages.title: Learn and Grow VI: Gina's Vote
passages.text: Well, I'll be! I've certainly seen larger scallions, but this will do quite nicely. You've just saved our hides, <name>!

passages.title: Mung-Mung's Vote III: The Great Carrot Caper
passages.text:
Mung-Mung don't care who steals carrots. Only care what Mr. Mudclaw does to poor Mung-Mung when he finds his crop is ruined!

<Mung-Mung rubs his chin thoughtfully.>

Wait! Mung-Mung have bright idea. You go and grow some juicycrunch carrots. Then, we take your carrots and pretend they are Mr. Mudclaw's.

Yes!

passages.title: Mung-Mung's Vote III: The Great Carrot Caper
passages.text: Virmens love carrots, but they hate turnips. I hate turnips, too.

passages.title: Mung-Mung's Vote III: The Great Carrot Caper
passages.text: Whoa, these carrots look crunchy and juicy, <name>! Mung-Mung did not know you had such a green thumb.

passages.title: Farmer Fung's Vote III: Crazy For Cabbage
passages.text:
<Farmer Fung is beaming with a radiant smile.>

Thanks to you, I got my precious yaks back! Unfortunately, I noticed that their time out in the wild left them rather gaunt.

They must be starving, but I don't feed my prize yaks just any regular old grass.

No sir, they eat only the leafiest green cabbages you can find here in the Valley.

My stores are a bit low. If you bring me some cabbages for my yaks, I will reward you handsomely.

passages.title: Farmer Fung's Vote III: Crazy For Cabbage
passages.text: I have pet nicknames for all of my yaks. There's Hairy, and Shaggy, and Fluffy, and Woolly, and...

passages.title: Farmer Fung's Vote III: Crazy For Cabbage
passages.text:
I was expecting cabbages, but not cabbages of this quality! Oh my!

A perfectly round head, large waxy leaves, a perfect gradient of emerald color...

<Farmer Fung takes a bite out of the cabbage.>

Mmm, and sweet, crisp flavor! These is a beautiful cabbage, <name>. My yaks will certainly be spoiled by this tasty treat.

passages.title: Nana's Vote II: The Sacred Springs
passages.text:
You caught me at a good time, <name>. I was just hankering to make a fresh batch of Witchberry Julep.

Have you ever heard of this wondrous brew?

Each sip takes ten years off your face! How do you think I still look so good?

Anyway, I need a special ingredient - thousand-year water - which can be collected from the mouth of the waterfall to the north.

I'm afraid the journey is too treacherous for an old matron like me, but if you can get your hands on a pitcher, I'll let you share my brew.

passages.title: Nana's Vote II: The Sacred Springs
passages.text: The water in this valley flows from the Vale of Eternal Blossoms to the north. It is said that these waters have wondrous, magical properties.

passages.title: Nana's Vote II: The Sacred Springs
passages.text: Found the falls, did you? Oh yes, I see you found the water. Wonderful!

passages.title: Nana's Vote III: Witchberry Julep
passages.text:
Now that we have the water, I can almost taste the icy cold witchberry julep!

Now, we just need to find ourselves some sweet witchberries.

My grandson's berries this season have been total slop, so I need to seek a decent harvest elsewhere.

Say, do you have any witchberries in the ground this year? How about you bring me some from your farm?

If your berries are up to the standard, we'll make ourselves a grand old batch of the old juice!

passages.title: Nana's Vote III: Witchberry Julep
passages.text: Hurry it up, will ya? I'm an old woman. I don't have all the time in the world, and I want one more taste of the sauce before I croak!

passages.title: Nana's Vote III: Witchberry Julep
passages.text:
<Nana Mudclaw scrutinizes a dark witchberry, then pops it into her mouth. Her face lights up.>

Lands alive! I haven't tasted such a sweet, juicy witchberry in years! Why, the only person who could grow berries like these was... Old Yoon, yer friend's grandpa.

<Nana Mudclaw blushes.>

Oh that man was such a scamp! I still remember the summer days when we were young, eating these berries by the bushel without a care in the world.

Thank you for reminding me of an old friend, <name>.

passages.title: Battle Pet Tamers: Pandaria
passages.text:
You must now face the toughest tamers in all of Azeroth, <name>. They make their home in Pandaria, training ground of the grand masters.

There are six grand masters left to defeat: Hyuna of the Shrines in The Jade Forest, Farmer Nishi in Valley of the Four Winds, Mo'ruk in Krasarang Wilds, Courageous Yon in Kun-Lai Summit, Seeker Zusshi in Townlong Steppes, and Wastewalker Shu in Dread Wastes.

If you think yourself ready, seek out these champions of the trade and prove yourself!

passages.title: The Peak of Serenity - Complete Your Training
passages.text: The time has come for you to return to the Peak of Serenity to complete your training. Use Zen Pilgrimage to return there and speak with Master Hight when you arrive.

passages.title: The Peak of Serenity - Complete Your Training
passages.text: Welcome back, <name>.  It is time for the final step of your training.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Sha of Doubt
passages.text:
<name>, I need you to assemble a hearty group and lead them into the Temple of the Jade Serpent. Activate the Challenger's Orb therein, and vanquish the Sha of Doubt.

Return to me when you've completed this challenge, and I shall reward you handsomely.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Sha of Doubt
passages.text: You have my gratitude, <name>. You've displayed great valor today, and the speed at which you completed the challenge surely will impress your friends and intimidate your foes.

passages.title: Nazgrim's Command
passages.text:
You have a comfortable base of operations, no Alliance around for miles, and a few Horde veterans by your side. It looks like it's time to start painting this continent red.

General Nazgrim should know where to start.

passages.title: Nazgrim's Command
passages.text:
We may have won the battle against the Alliance, but we won't get any further with this many jabbering monkeys on our perimeter.

The hozen are our next target.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Yan-zhu the Uncasked
passages.text:
<name>, I need you to assemble a hearty group and lead them into Stormstout Brewery. Activate the Challenger's Orb therein, and evaporate Yan-zhu the Uncasked.

Return to me when you've completed this challenge, and I shall reward you handsomely.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Yan-zhu the Uncasked
passages.text: You have my sincerest thanks, <name>. Without fine Stormstout brews to lighten the drudgery of the day, the world would be a dull place indeed.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Sha of Hatred
passages.text:
<name>, I need you to assemble a tranquil group and lead them into the Shado-Pan Monastery. Activate the Challenger's Orb therein, and rescue Taran Zhu from the Sha of Hatred.

Return to me when you've completed this challenge, and I shall reward you handsomely.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Sha of Hatred
passages.text: Many blessings upon you, <name>. Driving hatred from this world so quickly deserves rich reward.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Xin the Weaponmaster
passages.text:
<name>, I need you to assemble a nimble group and lead them into Mogu'shan Palace. Activate the Challenger's Orb therein, and put an end to Xin the Weaponmaster.

Return to me when you've completed this challenge, and I shall reward you handsomely.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Xin the Weaponmaster
passages.text: Many thanks, <name>. Your martial prowess is second to none, and your alacrity is sure to strike fear in the hearts of your enemies.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Raigonn
passages.text:
<name>, I need you to assemble a cracking group and lead them into the Gate of the Setting Sun. Activate the Challenger's Orb therein and lay waste to Raigonn.

Return to me when you've completed this challenge, and I shall reward you handsomely.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Raigonn
passages.text: That was a blow well struck, <name>. I've never seen a <class> fell a giant with such speed.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Wing Leader Ner'onok
passages.text:
<name>, I need you to assemble an eagle-eyed group and lead them into the Siege of Niuzao Temple. Activate the Challenger's Orb and ground Wing Leader Ner'onok.

Return to me when you've completed this challenge, and I shall reward you handsomely.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Wing Leader Ner'onok
passages.text: <name>, that was amazing. Ner'onok is a master tactician, and you schooled him handily.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Durand
passages.text:
<name>, I need you to assemble a stout group and lead them into Scarlet Monastery. Activate the Challenger's Orb therein, and smite Durand with righteous fury.

Return to me when you've completed this challenge, and I shall reward you handsomely.

passages.title: A Worthy Challenge: Durand
passages.text: <name>, you're a stalwart <class>. Your friends and guild mates will surely notice the speed and ferocity with which you conquered the Scarlet Monastery.

passages.title: Elder Charms of Good Fortune
passages.text: Greetings, <name>. I am privileged to offer you an excellent opportunity. Through the centuries, we've honed a method by which the very laws of chance themselves can be bent. With an Elder Charm of Good Fortune, valuable artifacts will find their way into your hands more frequently.

passages.title: Elder Charms of Good Fortune
passages.text: May these charms bring you great luck, <name>.

passages.title: Elder Charms of Good Fortune
passages.text: May the stars smile upon you, <name>.

passages.title: Elder Charms of Good Fortune
passages.text: Greetings, <name>. I am privileged to offer you an excellent opportunity. Through the centuries, we've honed a method by which the very laws of chance themselves can be bent. With an Elder Charm of Good Fortune, valuable artifacts will find their way into your hands more frequently.

passages.title: Elder Charms of Good Fortune
passages.text: May these charms bring you great luck, <name>.

passages.title: Elder Charms of Good Fortune
passages.text: May the stars smile upon you, <name>.

passages.title: His Name Was... Stormstout
passages.text:
An unusual pandaren came through town a few days back. He told a better tale than Pan, drank twice as much as Lee, and then beat me up in front of the bar. All while his little niece made fun of us.

It was awesome.

They said they were headed to the Valley of the Four Winds. You should meet him! Just... watch out for that right hook.

passages.title: His Name Was... Stormstout
passages.text:
Ha ha! You were sent by Bolo? The "Keg Mender," right? From the Drunken Hozen?

How is his eye healing? Is his friend still hung over?

Ahh... that was an enjoyable evening.

passages.title: They Call Him... Stormstout
passages.text:
Things were not always like this, <race>. Oh no, they were much, much worse. Not three weeks ago, we were under siege by saurok bandits. They stole our jade, befouled our food stores, and terrorized our cubs.

We needed a hero, and a hero arrived.

He drove back their forces, defeated their leader, and returned our stolen jade. All he asked in return was a serpent ride for his niece.

I was never able to thank him. If you are headed to the Valley of the Four Winds, would you relay our thanks?

passages.title: They Call Him... Stormstout
passages.text:
You come from the Temple of the Jade Serpent? Rain-Zhu sends his thanks?

Ai yah... really, that was nothing. I could have defeated that saurok without spilling my beer.

In fact, I believe I did.

passages.title: Got Silk?
passages.text:
Strange noises comin' from over at the Silken Fields.

Strange smells, too.

Almost makes you think that they could use a cash-strapped <class> to complete a few odd jobs for 'em. Make a few pieces of gold.

Or not.

passages.title: Got Silk?
passages.text: Greetings, <class>. Welcome to the Silken Fields.

passages.title: Flying Tiger Gourami
passages.text: You've caught a unique fish... with wings. Perhaps it deserves the expert opinion of Nat Pagle in Anglers Wharf.

passages.title: Domination Point
passages.text:
Now it is time to show this new land the true strength of the Horde.

Return to the beach and light the remaining signal fire. Our fleet is waiting.

passages.title: Domination Point
passages.text: <This fire will signal the full might of the Horde invasion fleet to land on this beach, beginning Garrosh's campaign in Pandaria.>

passages.title: Lion's Landing
passages.text:
For too long the Horde has been allowed to run rampant across Azeroth. I will not see these new lands conquered by some barbaric "warchief."

Are you ready to bring Alliance justice to the shores of Pandaria?

Let us return to the landing site. Use the flare launcher to bring in the fleet proper, and begin Operation: Shieldwall.

passages.title: Lion's Landing
passages.text: <Blue sails are barely visible on the horizon - the full might of the Alliance fleet, awaiting one final signal.>

passages.title: Taking Advantage
passages.text:
The fools in the Explorers' League have excavated an ancient mogu ruin to the northeast. And - of course - in their bumbling, they've disturbed the mogu spirits within.

We are going to take advantage of their ineptitude. Take this portal and meet with Kaelis Sunsoar, my contact within the ruins.

passages.title: Taking Advantage
passages.text: Ah, yes. Good. Help from Belloc. He never does like to get his hands dirty.

passages.title: Ogudei's Lieutenants
passages.text:
When we dug through to an ancient section of the mogu ruins, that's when all this nasty business went down - and that's where the two worst o' these ghosties emerged.

We need them gone, friend.

passages.title: Ogudei's Lieutenants
passages.text:
You did it! Good work! Really saved our bacon!

Here's to hoping those things don't come back...

passages.title: Good Luck, Have Fun
passages.text:
I've got some customers lined up that wanna collect some good old fashioned ears. But not any old ears. They only want the absolute waxiest ears money can buy! 

Guess they think they're lucky or something'.

Anyways, I need you to go get 'em for me. I don't want to hurt any animals, so you'll need to get 'em from the Alliance over at Lion's Landing.

Have fun - and remember, only bring me the waxiest!

passages.title: Good Luck, Have Fun
passages.text: Ears, <name>, I wanna see some ears!

passages.title: Good Luck, Have Fun
passages.text: Good and waxy, just like they asked for. Here's your share.

passages.title: We Require More Minerals!
passages.text:
Gnomes are excavating a stone quarry to the northeast.

They're building stuff with it!

<Zazzix rolls his eyes.>

They're too stupid to realize it's special mogu stone for creating animated statues. 

WE can mix with a little Goblin magic juice to make some real big explosions!

But the stuff is heavy. They've got some of their stupid bomb-bots there for excavating the stone. Blow 'em up near slabs and you'll get chunks small enough to carry. 

Or, just kill 'em and take it. Whatever works.

passages.title: We Require More Minerals!
passages.text: You got some stone? I wanna blow stuff up!

passages.title: We Require More Minerals!
passages.text:
Ha! YES! You got me some! I'm gonna make the best bomb EVER!

Man I love bombs! Love making them, love blowin' em up...

... and yeah, that IS how I got this eyepatch. What's it to ya?

passages.title: Sentry Wards
passages.text:
We've spotted heavy air support over their base, in the form of way too many dwarves on way too many griffons. Means we can't get any vision of the area from above.

A troll... friend of mine gave us a set of Sentry Wards, which we can use to spy on their base and get a vantage point on what's going on in there.

Bad news, friend - you're going to be the one going in there.

passages.title: Sentry Wards
passages.text: Good work, <name>. I've already been getting some useful information that should help make our next offensive even more devastating.

passages.title: Hard Counter
passages.text:
We've managed to get some Demolishers on the beach, but the stupid dwarves are also out there with their stupid mortar tubes, preventing the Demolishers from pushing forward and assaulting the keep itself!

Get out there, kill some dwarves, and blow up some mortar tubes.

passages.title: Hard Counter
passages.text:
Oh heck yeah! That'll show 'em that NOBODY blows stuff up like goblins blow stuff up!

Oh, and you did good work too.

passages.title: Runnin' On Empty
passages.text:
I've never seen this quality of oil! Problem is the oil needed a little extra refinin'.

I heard of this system where you use ocean water to speed up the process. I don't have time to waste down here, so I just threw the barrels into the bay.

Pretty good idea, I know. Problem is, I'm not sure how to pull it out of the bay...

Maybe someone of your expertise could help me out.

passages.title: Runnin' On Empty
passages.text: So he found a use for the bay after all? Waste not, want not I guess!

passages.title: Runnin' On Empty
passages.text: Oh, yuck! Why are these barrels wet?! Oh nevermind! At least you got here before they made me work. I can't think of anything more horrible!

passages.title: Stacked!
passages.text:
We just filled an order this morning. How could they possibly need more already?!

My team has been workin' double-time to get these trees chopped and processed.

Problem is we have an infestation of Lion's Landing troops down here. I already risked my neck once today, I'm not goin' back out there!

Goob will go with you and help you fill this order. He's not the brightest, but he can do the heavy liftin'.

passages.title: Stacked!
passages.text: Did you get that order filled?

passages.title: Stacked!
passages.text: It's about time you showed up with this lumber order! I was just about to come down there and get it myself.

passages.title: Don't Lose Your Head
passages.text:
My probes have detected three very dangerous targets in the courtyard of Domination Keep.

They have an ogre emissary, a Kor'kron officer, and an insane goblin bomb maker.

My siege-o-matics are not ready for one on one combat so it is up to you to eliminate the targets.

Good luck! Report back to me on the Skyfire when done.

passages.title: Don't Lose Your Head
passages.text: Great work! Sorry to put good soldiers in harms way but my Auto-Demolish-o-Tronic Mk 2 isn't functional yet.

passages.title: Resource Gathering
passages.text:
Oh, the poor peasants...

They are cowards, yes, of course. But they don't know how to fight, and they go out to collect lumber for our efforts... the Horde targets them... It's just awful all around!

But, we need that lumber if we're going to hold out. Go out and collect any they've dropped.

passages.title: Resource Gathering
passages.text: Did you gather the lumber yet?

passages.title: Resource Gathering
passages.text: Good work! With this, we'll be able to finish reinforcing the structure of the keep, which will help keep people safe. You've saved lives today!

passages.title: Tower Defense
passages.text:
The gnomes are running our quarry operation to the northwest. The stone there is especially tough - the gnomes tell me the mogu used it to fashion their constructs. 

I don't know. What I do know is that we use that stone to build our towers, and the Horde has dispatched the Bilgewater goblins to steal it from us.

Get out there and get some back. By the way - collateral damage may break up the stone slabs there. If so, pick that up, too.

passages.title: Tower Defense
passages.text: You brought us the stone yet?

passages.title: Tower Defense
passages.text: Alright! We'll get that stone mortared into the cracks in our walls faster than a Dwarf downs a pint.

passages.title: Siege Damage
passages.text:
The Horde got the bright idea to send Bilgewater goblins to attack our quarry.

They've been packing heavy explosives - heavy explosives that will react with the ammunition in their demolishers.

Kill the Bilgewater goblins until you find an explosive, plant it on one of the demolishers... and BOOM! Siege ended.

passages.title: Siege Damage
passages.text: We need you to take out those demolishers, soldier!

passages.title: Siege Damage
passages.text: You really showed them who owns this beach, <name>. Good work!

passages.title: Burn Out!
passages.text:
Those goblins are gettin' out of hand! First they level the forest and set up that abomination of a rig. Then, they start dumpin' their oil barrels into the bay!

We got to put a stop to this madness! At the very least we need ta set them back.

We need to take out their fuel supply! Maybe you'll even get to kill a few goblins in the process!

passages.title: Burn Out!
passages.text:
Wish I could've been there to watch their fuel burn! Probably put on quite the show.

You've done well, <name>!

passages.title: Necessary Breaks
passages.text:
It goes against me nature to break things on purpose, but in this case it's necessary.

That rig the goblins are usin' is held together by a wish an' some bubblegum. We need to exploit the situation a little more.

We have some saboteurs down there already, but we can use someone of your expertise to hurry the job along.

Get down there an' start breakin' and stealin' some valves!

passages.title: It's Only Right
passages.text:
This is barbaric warfare, <class>! We've lost so many trying to keep the Bilgewater operation from spreading any further.

Those fallen soldiers fought honorably and deserved to be given their last rights. At the very least we need to be able to notify their next of kin.

Perhaps you can collect their identification tags so we can honor them in some small way.

passages.title: It's Only Right
passages.text: Even warfare should have some courtesies.

passages.title: It's Only Right
passages.text: You have done these soldiers a great service, <name>. The only thing left to do is make sure they did not die in vain.

passages.title: Beastmaster's Hunt: The Crane
passages.text:
Along with the snare, you get some advice on crane hunting:

The greatest cranes of the Krasarang Wilds are not tempted by simple things like food. You will need to play on the creatures' emotions if you wish to draw them from their hiding places in the jungle.

Cranes abound on both the Cradle of Chi-ji and the Narsong Spires, both of which can be found east of here. Pluck those cranes' quills, then place them in a visible spot near the Crane Temple. Your quarry will come running to you.

passages.title: Beastmaster's Hunt: The Crane
passages.text: This is the spot, near the Crane Temple.

passages.title: Beastmaster's Hunt: The Crane
passages.text: You place the feathers in the dirt, then look off in the direction of the temple...

passages.title: Beastmaster's Hunt: The Crane
passages.text:
Along with the snare, you get some advice on crane hunting:

The greatest cranes of the Krasarang Wilds don't care about simple things like food. You need to play on the creatures' emotions if you want to draw them out of the jungle.

There's plenty of cranes on the Cradle of Chi-ji and on the Narsong Spires, both to the west of here. Pluck some of those cranes' quills, then put them in a visible spot near the Crane Temple. Your quarry will come running to you.

passages.title: Beastmaster's Hunt: The Crane
passages.text: This is the spot, near the Crane Temple.

passages.title: Beastmaster's Hunt: The Crane
passages.text: You place the feathers in the dirt, then look off in the direction of the temple...

passages.title: Ancient's Fall
passages.text: The crane has fallen.

passages.title: End of an Elder
passages.text: The tiger has fallen.

passages.title: A Colossal Victory
passages.text: The crab has fallen.

passages.title: A Colossal Victory
passages.text: Well fought, <name>.

passages.title: Ancient's Fall
passages.text: The crane has fallen.

passages.title: End of an Elder
passages.text: The tiger has fallen.

passages.title: A Colossal Victory
passages.text: The crab has fallen.

passages.title: A Colossal Victory
passages.text: Well fought, <name>.

passages.title: To Mogujia
passages.text:
Throm-ka, <class>. While we were busy defending our foothold here, Regent Lord Lor'themar Theron led a research expedition north into Kun-Lai Summit.

Unfortunately, it seems they have encountered trouble.

Warchief Garrosh Hellscream has already departed to lend his assistance, but he will require additional reinforcements.

Go northward into the mountains of Kun-Lai. Speak to Tak-Tak for transportation.

passages.title: To Mogujia
passages.text: Were you sent from Domination Point?

passages.title: To Mogujia
passages.text: Well met, <class>. We are an archaeological expedition, sent to excavate these ruins. We had no idea that this area was crawling with dangerous mogu.

passages.title: Bloodlines
passages.text:
We managed to fend off the mogu wardens and their dogs, but many of the blood elves from the scouting party were not as lucky.

Many of my people are trapped inside the ruins to the north. We are devising a solution to break them out, but I believe there may be a more straightforward approach.

Go to the ruins and kill the wardens guarding each prisoner. If my intuition is correct, this will free our comrades.

passages.title: Bloodlines
passages.text: These mogu are not to be underestimated.

passages.title: Bloodlines
passages.text: We blood elves have served the Horde faithfully. Lately, I wonder what we have to gain from Garrosh's leadership.

passages.title: To Mogujia
passages.text:
The Explorers' League sent an expedition north some days ago.

We haven't heard from them since, and I'd sleep better at night knowing our folks aren't in some sort of trouble.

Last I heard, Brann Bronzebeard was heading toward Mogujia in the Kun-Lai Summit.

Find him and report back with their status. Fennie over there can give you a ride if you need one.

passages.title: To Mogujia
passages.text: These artifacts must be several thousand years old. Have ye ever seen the like?

passages.title: Bad Blood
passages.text:
The Explorers' League is here to excavate the ruins, and it's my job to protect them.

When we arrived, we found this place crawling with blood elves. Apparently,the Horde are just as interested in the mogu as we are.

This gives quite an opportunity to thin our enemies' numbers, and steal their findings, too.

Slay any blood elves you find in the ruins, and bring back whatever they are digging up.

passages.title: Bad Blood
passages.text: What are those blood elves after?

passages.title: Bad Blood
passages.text: Well done, <class>. I knew that you could get the job done.

passages.title: One Magical, Flying Kingdom's Trash...
passages.text:
Before we enter into a business relationship, I am required by the terms of my rehabilitation program to inform you that I am a recovering potion addict.

There, now that THAT's out of the way, let's talk portals!

You see, the big portals in the cities - the ones running all day and night - leak tons of magical energy. It crystallizes around the edges and is generally regarded as trash.

But I noticed during my, uh... hiatus in the sewers of Dalaran, that these shards still had power.

Interested?

passages.title: One Magical, Flying Kingdom's Trash...
passages.text:
I knew you would be!

Here's the catch - the shards, in their current state, are unstable. But the soil in this valley is renowned for its magical properties! I am sure if you were to "plant" the shard, a very interesting reaction would take place.

It could stabilize, leaving you with a functioning portal! Or... it might tear open a magical rift that spits out transdimensional horrors!

My gut tells me it will be a little of both, but there's only one way to know for sure.

Here, take a sample!

passages.title: Krasarang Steampot
passages.text:
The Boss-Lady desires crabs!

Why are you looking at me like that? It's not uncommon for a classy person, such as her loveliness, to want crab for dinner. What did you think I meant?

There are some big crabs wandering around on Bilgewater Beach that should be suitable for her refined palate.

Bring Sezik the best crab meat you can find!

passages.title: Krasarang Steampot
passages.text: Boss-Lady wants a steampot does she? Well, maybe she should come down here and make it herself!

passages.title: Krasarang Steampot
passages.text:
This meat is disgusting! It's going to take every spice I have to cover that smell up.

Only the best for the Boss-Lady!

<Sezik grins and winks at you.>

passages.title: Grave Circumstances
passages.text:
The Court of Bones crawls with mogu forces. Endlessly do they perform their rituals of lightning and thunder.

If our mission to take this island is to succeed, then we cannot allow them to hold such a strategic position.

They must be eliminated.

passages.title: Grave Circumstances
passages.text: The mogu are powerful, but with cunning and tenacity, we can defeat them.

passages.title: Grave Circumstances
passages.text: Excellent. You have dealt the mogu a blow that they shall not easily forget.

passages.title: This Just Won't Do
passages.text:
The Zandalari here are very powerful, <class>. They should not be underestimated. We cannot afford to ignore them as a threat simply because they do not wield swords.

More arrive every day, and with them centuries of magic knowledge. This threat must be dealt with, and quickly.

Aid us in clearing this area, <class>. Perhaps we can even learn something from them in the process.

passages.title: This Just Won't Do
passages.text: Magic can be a great ally or your worst enemy. Let's not leave it to chance.

passages.title: This Just Won't Do
passages.text:
It's impressive how easily you were able to cut them down.

Perhaps, it's you they should not underestimate. Thank you for your assistance, <class>.

passages.title: Maximum Capacitor
passages.text:
The mines north of here are being used to extract Ghost Iron ore and energize it with lightning energy.

We need to destroy the drills they use to extract the ore. They are impervious to normal attack, but can be overloaded using the proper methods.

Oh - and while you're there, take out whoever is running the operation.

passages.title: Save Our Scouts!
passages.text:
The heavy mogu presence in the mines let us know it was a place of great importance - but we needed to gather more information on their activities there, so we sent agents into the mines to spy on them.

Unfortunately, many were captured, and we've found that some are being tortured in the mines. You have to go rescue them - nobody deserves what they are going through...

And, when you finish, kill whoever captured them. No mercy, adventurer!

passages.title: The Assault on Zeb'tula
passages.text:
Our scouting efforts along the coast have given us valuable intelligence about the island, <class>.

However, we will accomplish nothing if we do not advance forward onto the mainland.

I have assembled a team of our most elite aerial units to begin the attack.

I would like you to join the assault. A champion such as yourself could turn the battle in our favor at the critical moment.

When you are ready to begin the attack, speak to me.

passages.title: The Assault on Zeb'tula
passages.text: We must claim a better strategic position on the island itself.

passages.title: The Assault on Zeb'tula
passages.text:
Yes! You have done it, champion!

We will be as a tide that sweeps over this island, bringing with it a new destiny for our people. And you, hero, are at its forefront.

passages.title: Old Enemies
passages.text:
So Jaina and the Kirin Tor think they can push us out again? I will not stand by and allow them to repeat the events of Dalaran!

This time we fight back! This time we do the pushing...

Go to Violet Rise and slay any Kirin Tor agent you find.

passages.title: Old Enemies
passages.text:
So, Violet Rise runs red with the blood of our enemies? Well done, <name>.

This will be an ongoing battle I fear. We must continue to show our strength here.

passages.title: Bilgewater Infiltrators
passages.text:
There is nothing more unnerving than walking along, minding your own business, and hearing someone following you. I swear I hear it all over the place down here! We're being watched!

I have a feeling the entire beach is just crawling with spies!

I made some improvements to our infrared goggle tech to put an end to the sabotogery. That's right sabotogery! Now I just need you to try 'em out! Feel free to dispose of any spies you happen to catch.

passages.title: Bilgewater Infiltrators
