passages.text: How many spirits have you captured?

passages.title: Centuries in Sentries
passages.text:
This is very interesting, <class>. The crystal hums with the rage of its captive inhabitants. Even after the passage of time their devotion has not decreased.

I will need to study this further.

passages.title: The More You Know
passages.text:
This whole area is littered with Zandalari artifacts. I would be lying if I said studying them didn't interest me. I am fascinated by the significance of these objects to their rituals.

The more we understand our enemies, the better prepared we are to defeat them.

If I am to study them, I will need to see them up close. Bring me as many artifacts as you can find.

passages.title: The More You Know
passages.text: What have you brought me, <class>?

passages.title: The More You Know
passages.text: These are excellent finds! Studying them will take time, but there is much to be gained in understanding the Zandalari.

passages.title: Out of Enemy Hands
passages.text:
Magic is a frightening opponent when wielded by an experienced caster. A blade however, is terrifying in even the most inexperienced hands.

The Zandalari have some impressive weapons, made even more deadly by the magic they are enhanced with. We should relieve them of this advantage.

Steal as many of the weapons as you can find.

passages.title: Out of Enemy Hands
passages.text: What did you find out there? Anything that can be of use?

passages.title: Out of Enemy Hands
passages.text: Excellent work, <class>! These weapons are impressive. Now we have a few less things to worry about in the field of battle.

passages.title: All In the Family
passages.text:
Conqueror's Terrace is watched over by two brothers; Spiritbinder Tu'chek and Arcanital Rak'ul. They are powerful magic users and should not be underestimated.

Their power seems to stem from the ornate masks they wear; relics passed down from one generation to the next. Each owner imbuing it with their own magic before passing it on.

We must deal with the brothers and destroy their masks before they fall into the wrong hands.

passages.title: All In the Family
passages.text: Where are the masks?

passages.title: All In the Family
passages.text:
It's a shame really that these masks must be destroyed. I would have liked to study this ancient magic, but it is better that they be destroyed than become the tools of the Horde.

Good work, <class>.

passages.title: Even Giants Fall
passages.text:
The Zandalari worship the loa; animal spirits they often call to their aid. They may be trying to bind these spirits into a huge golem. The outcome would be disastrous.

I've sent ahead a scout to gather more information, but I think this task may require your expertise.

Stop that ritual at all costs!

passages.title: Even Giants Fall
passages.text: It's fortunate that you were able to intervene, <class>. Who knows what damage that golem would have caused had he not been stopped.

passages.title: Keep It Secret
passages.text:
The Zandalari here are a threat to our campaign, <class>.

Their use of magic is an abomination. They mix the power of arcane with the darkness of shadow with little care to consequence.

We cannot afford for them to find their full strength here or for the Horde to learn of their twisted magic.

Their numbers must be thinned. I will leave this task to you.

passages.title: Keep It Secret
passages.text: Well done, <class>. The more Zandalari we destroy, the less chance their magic will fall into Horde hands.

passages.title: Maximum Capacitor
passages.text:
The mines north of here are critical to the mogu supply line. They are using giant lightning enchanted drills to extract the ore.

If you can disrupt the drills, they'll be destroyed, greatly slowing their ability to make weapons.

Oh, also, kill whoever is in charge, will you?

passages.title: Forge Ahead!
passages.text:
The forge lies ahead of you, and with it the heart of the mogu's weaponsmithing ability.

And beyond that, the mogu gatekeeper, who holds the key to unlocking the gate to the next part of the city.

It's time to move out!

passages.title: Forge Ahead!
passages.text: Well?

passages.title: Forge Ahead!
passages.text: Good work. What you did today brings us one step closer to our ultimate goal.

passages.title: On Her Magic-ey Secret Service
passages.text:
Under orders from Jaina herself, some of our agents attempted to sneak past mogu lines to find out what was going on in the mines.

They were captured, and are being subjected to who-knows-what kind of awful tortures.

You must free them and kill whoever captured them. We don't leave anyone behind!

passages.title: Life Blood
passages.text:
Scouts unearthed this strange construct hidden within the Lightning Vein Mine. A secret weapon of the Thunder King no doubt.

Perhaps, there is a chance we can use this discovery to our benefit. If we can re-animate it, we can study it. More importantly, we can discover its weakness.

Go to the Throne of Thunder and use this crystal to capture whatever essence animates these constructs.

Return to me when the task is complete.

passages.title: Life Blood
passages.text: Were you successful in our endeavor?

passages.title: Life Blood
passages.text:
Excellent work, <class>. This is a dark magic indeed. We have much to learn here if we are to succeed.

Now, we have only to hope that we can reanimate this creature.

passages.title: Meet Me Upstairs
passages.text:
There's someone I'd like you to meet. Stormwind's own crown prince recently paid a visit to this humble inn. I've instructed my guards to defend him from any Horde aggression - I don't want to draw any undue attention to myself.

He and I have been discussing world events, such as the battle along the southern shores, his encounter with Garrosh, and the upcoming assault on the Thunder King.

Come! Let's talk upstairs...

passages.title: Meet Me Upstairs
passages.text:
<Wrathion introduces you both.>

Prince Anduin, this is <name>, possibly the most powerful <class> in Pandaria.

Oh - do you already know of each other? Interesting.

passages.title: I Need a Champion
passages.text:
You are a superb representative of your people, <race>. But I need someone special. I have big plans. And to enact them I will need a champion to carry my flame to the four corners of the world.

Are you the one?

Prove it to me on the Isle of Thunder! Lay waste to any mogu, Zandalari, or saurok that you find. Impress me!

passages.title: I Need a Champion
passages.text:
My Shado-Pan associates have spoken highly of your deeds. You have earned quite the name for yourself here in Pandaria!

It is settled. When the materials are ready, you will be my champion. You will be my instrument, my standard-bearer, my voice of change across this world.

We will do marvelous things together.

passages.title: The Thunder Forge
passages.text:
Everything is prepared, <name>, and I have selected you to be my champion.

Next, we must infiltrate the legendary Thunder Forge of Lei Shen himself! You and your faction will need to advance forward until the Thunder Forge is exposed, if it isn't already.

Once you have infiltrated the forge, meet me there. Be ready for a fight!

passages.title: The Thunder Forge
passages.text:
Behold! The Lightning Lance! A conduit that can channel and control the very same power that the Thunder King used to found an empire.

It is dormant... but you're about to change that. If you're worthy.

passages.title: Spirit of the Storm Lord
passages.text:
Our next objective is to temper this weapon with the blood of a demigod, one imbued with the Thunder King's powers.

My agents tell me that the mogu named Shan Bu is creating just such a creature, intended to guard the Thunder King's citadel.

Once your faction has fought your way to the front gates, attack Storm Lord Nalak and thrust this lance into his side. The creature will do everything in his power to stop you - stay alive long enough to siphon out the power of the Storm Lord!

passages.title: Spirit of the Storm Lord
passages.text: What of Storm Lord Nalak? And the lance? Details!

passages.title: Spirit of the Storm Lord
passages.text:
You've done it! The lance seethes with power and potential!

Oh my friend, you have earned a great reward...

passages.title: The Crown of Heaven
passages.text:
Do you recall Mason's Folly, the hilltop east of here where you and I met before?

I'm going to use the Lightning Lance to create something special, and I certainly can't do it in here.

Meet me atop Mason's Folly so that we may celebrate our victories together!

passages.title: The Crown of Heaven
passages.text:
The Crown of Heaven! Use this to augment any piece of headgear.

It will also act as a third eye - I will be able to follow your progress as we embark on the next stage of our journey.

passages.title: Echoes of the Titans
passages.text:
I'm beginning to see the bigger picture, now, and how the mogu relate to the Titans. But every answer brings with it more questions!

The only way to put this puzzle together is to find every scrap of Titan information we can scavenge from the Thunder King's palace. Destroy the Thunder King and his minions and collect as many Titan runestones as you can find!

passages.title: Echoes of the Titans
passages.text:
What have you discovered so far?

We need to gather all the information we can!

passages.title: Echoes of the Titans
passages.text:
Thanks to your work, <name>, we've reconstructed an ancient narrative. The mogu were once creatures of stone, enacting the will of the Titans. But then their master fell silent, and they succumbed to the curse of the flesh. Eventually Lei Shen came along, imprisoned the keeper Ra, and took his power. Ah, what an empire he built!

Armed with this knowledge, it's time to act...

passages.title: Heart of the Thunder King
passages.text:
The Thunder King. Dead for twelve thousand years, only to be brought back by Zandalari voice. No doubt Titan power preserved his vile corpse.

Titan power that's mine by right.

<name>! Bring me the heart of the Thunder King. I will have it, and once it is mine, none will ever be able to resurrect him again.

Bring it to me, <class>. Bring me his cold, dead heart!

passages.title: Heart of the Thunder King
passages.text: The Thunder King! What has become of him?

passages.title: Heart of the Thunder King
passages.text:
<Wrathion squeezes the black heart in his hand, his eyes burning brightly.>

You did it... you did it! The black heart of the Thunder King!

passages.title: A Reckoning
passages.text:
The Thunder King is dead, and his instruments of oppression are being picked over by the Alliance and Horde for their own ends.

We come now to the climax of the pandaren campaign. Hellscream's machinations have brought the Alliance down on his head - but even more importantly, he's fractured the unity of the Horde. As the Pandaren say: "The Wok is Hot." Something is about to give, and all of our work comes down to this.

I need time to plan. See me as soon as your faction is ready to make its move!

passages.title: Securing A Future
passages.text:
It is rumored that the Thunder King's power comes directly from a hidden source within his palace.

Even when he is defeated a new tyrant, Garrosh perhaps, could still use this magic to a terrible end.

That is unless we make the first move!

Take my staff into the Pinnacle of Storms. Once Lei Shen has been defeated place my staff in the center of his dais.

We will drain the rest of his power and make sure it stays in our hands.

passages.title: Securing A Future
passages.text: We will be unstoppable once Lei Shen's power has been fused with my staff.

passages.title: Securing A Future
passages.text:
You have just secured our advantage, <name>. Your work here will be remembered.

Garrosh will be made to pay for his actions!

passages.title: Subtle Encouragement
passages.text:
The saurok are vile, but we share an enemy: the mogu. And I'd rather send saurok to kill mogu than send my own men.

We've been collecting mogu weaponry. Bury these polearms into the skulls of the saurok. Feed our enemies' rivalry, and you may save Horde lives.

passages.title: Subtle Encouragement
passages.text: As much as it pains me to say it: try not to kill them all. We need some alive if we want to turn them against the mogu.

passages.title: Subtle Encouragement
passages.text: Masterfully done, <class>.

passages.title: Subtle Encouragement
passages.text:
The saurok are vile, but we share an enemy: the mogu. And I'd rather send saurok to kill mogu than send my own men.

We've been collecting mogu weaponry. Bury these polearms into the skulls of the saurok. Feed our enemies' rivalry, and you may save Alliance lives.

passages.title: Subtle Encouragement
passages.text: Masterfully done, <class>.

passages.title: Extended Shore Leave
passages.text:
The Zandalari have already begun repairing that warship, but we can keep it crippled with minimal effort.

Simply relieve the new captain of his post, and steal the ship's damage report from that workshop just outside the vault.

No captain. No repairs. No warship.

passages.title: Extended Shore Leave
passages.text: Each passing hour brings us closer to breaking the Thunder King.

passages.title: Extended Shore Leave
passages.text:
Casualties are down significantly with that warship out of commission, and we continue to press the siege on Lei Shen.

Fantastic work out there today, hero.

Please, take this - you have earned it.

passages.title: Raiding the Vault
passages.text:
The Swollen Vault is a repository for some of Lei Shen's nastiest weaponry and most prized trinkets - not surprisingly, these are often one and the same.

One artifact in particular, an amulet known as the Choker of Storms, could help us to understand his apparent mastery over lightning.

Break into the vault and slay the hoard-keeper. Take his key and use it to recover the amulet from a cache at the back of the vault.

passages.title: Raiding the Vault
passages.text: The Thunder King's strength is legendary. We need every advantage we can get if we want to defeat him.

passages.title: Raiding the Vault
passages.text:
What's this? A necklace? What are you trying to- ahh, I see... A relic from the Thunder King's vault! Fascinating... Powerful, too.

The Kirin Tor will keep it safe. In return, please accept this.

passages.title: Lightning Steel
passages.text: Your trained eyes can see that this metal ingot has some very strange properties. Perhaps there are clues to its nature somewhere around here?

passages.title: Lightning Steel
passages.text: While the language is incomprehensible, the diagrams in this book yield their knowledge to your skilled blacksmith's eye. It is clear that, by manipulating the properties of ghost iron, you can create a material of great power, perhaps powerful enough to recreate and increase the power of weapons long lost to the mists of time.

passages.title: Charged Moganite
passages.text:
We have been dispatching spies into the Sunreaver base of operations on a daily basis. Some had orders to recover charged moganite from the enemy and bring it here.

They have not returned, and I can confirm they have left the Sunreaver base.

Search the jungle between here and there and find any of the charged moganite that might have been lost in transit. Bring it to me and we will put it to good use.

passages.title: Charged Moganite
passages.text: Well done, champion. This artifact will be put to better use in our hands than in the hands of the Sunreavers.

passages.title: Tactical Mana Bombs
passages.text:
Ah, adventurer, just the <race> I was looking for. I have received another batch of tactical mana bombs that I need planted in key positions across Dawnseeker Promontory to the northwest.

Here, take these. It is time to give the Sunreavers a taste of their own medicine.

Plant one on the Sunreaver ships, another one on their scrying crystals, and the last on the bridge that connects to their forward base.

passages.title: Tactical Mana Bombs
passages.text: It pains me to resort to such weaponry, but the Sunreavers must be taught the price of their actions.

passages.title: Chief Engineer Jard's Journal
passages.text: What an unusual power source. Wonder how it works? And what it can be used to create?

passages.title: Spellbound
passages.text:
Grand Magister Rommath has something in his possession that I want.

He brought a very powerful tome with him. It would be better for our cause if it were no longer in Sunreaver hands.

Locate Rommath's book of incantations and bring it to me.

passages.title: Spellbound
passages.text: Did you find the tome?

passages.title: Spellbound
passages.text: Ah yes! This is it. You've done well, <race>.

passages.title: Breaking Down the Defenses
passages.text:
Even the strongest defense can still have a weakness, <class>. We just need to find the weakness in the Sunreaver's defense and then exploit it as much as possible.

Scouts have reported the use of perimeter wards around Dawnseeker Promontory. They're powerful, but not deadly.

Disabling them would allow us to keep closer watch on their activities.

passages.title: Breaking Down the Defenses
passages.text: Excellent work, <race>! I was able to get a few of my scouts behind their lines before the perimeter wards were repaired.

passages.title: Enough with the Bombs!
passages.text:
The Sunreavers have planted tactical mana bombs around our camp. These must be dismantled before they are detonated.

Look for them in areas of high importance such as our supplies. Make sure you find and disable them all. We cannot afford to lose any ground here.

passages.title: Enough with the Bombs!
passages.text: I'm grateful for your efforts here, <name>. We would have lost so much had you not disarmed those bombs in time.

passages.title: Captive Audience
passages.text:
The Sunreavers will stoop to even the lowest levels to get what they want, <name>.

I received reports earlier that several Kirin Tor have gone missing. I suspect the Sunreavers may have something to do with this.

Hopefully they have not been harmed, or my wrath will be swift and terrible. I trust you to bring them back in one piece, but please hurry.

passages.title: Captive Audience
passages.text: You have saved many today, <name>. I cannot imagine the horror of being frozen and helpless among so many enemies.

passages.title: Overpowered
passages.text:
The Sunreaver forces have grown more powerful recently. I suspect magic to be at play here, but I can't be certain.

I think it would be wise to investigate their camp to see if you can find the source of this extra power.

Once you find it, use this crystal to overload and destroy it.

passages.title: Overpowered
passages.text:
So they've constructed objects that infuse their forces with additional power? This will have to be watched closely.

Thank you for your efforts today.

passages.title: Deconstruction
passages.text:
Scouts are reporting a large number of constructs patrolling outside of Dawnseeker Promontory.

If left unchecked they will pose a considerable threat should the Sunreavers mount an attack.

The only answer is a preemptive strike. We'll destroy them before they can attack us!

passages.title: Deconstruction
passages.text: Good work, <class>. As long as we keep the construct numbers in check, we will ensure our success here.

passages.title: Champions of the Thunder King
passages.text:
This island is riddled with lurking threats from three powerful groups, waiting for the chance to pounce on us. Masters of lightning, ancient and powerful spirits, and primal Zandalari monstrosities.

If you can get your hands on some of the Shan'ze Ritual Stones scattered across the isle, you should be able to beckon these powerful opponents out of hiding and strike out at them.

Find and destroy members of each group to keep them destabilized, and I will make it worth your time.

passages.title: Champions of the Thunder King
passages.text: Against these ancient enemies, there is no rescourse.  We strike first, and they do not strike at all.

passages.title: Champions of the Thunder King
passages.text:
Yours skills as a <class> are unquestionable. You've aided the cause greatly this day. You have my thanks.

And now for that reward I promised you...

passages.title: Champions of the Thunder King
passages.text:
This island is riddled with lurking threats from three powerful groups, waiting for the chance to pounce on us. Masters of lightning, ancient and powerful spirits, and primal Zandalari monstrosities.

If you can get your hands on some of the Shan'ze Ritual Stones scattered across the isle, you should be able to beckon these powerful opponents out of hiding and strike out at them.

Find and destroy members of each group to keep them destabilized, and I will make it worth your time.

passages.title: Champions of the Thunder King
passages.text: Against these ancient enemies, there is no rescourse.  We strike first, and they do not strike at all.

passages.title: Champions of the Thunder King
passages.text:
Yours skills as a <class> are unquestionable. You've aided the cause greatly this day. You have my thanks.

And now for that reward I promised you...

passages.title: Work Order: Dominance Offensive II
passages.text:
Once your red blossom leeks are ready to be picked, you'll need only to package them for pick-up.

Just think; your red blossom leeks will be a part of your faction's efforts in Pandaria!

passages.title: Work Order: Dominance Offensive II
passages.text: The crate sits empty awaiting your crops.

passages.title: Work Order: Dominance Offensive II
passages.text: Throw the Red Blossom Leeks into the crate! A Dominance Offensive representative will be along shortly for pick-up.

passages.title: The Assault on Shaol'mara
passages.text:
Our scouting efforts along the coast have given us valuable intelligence about the island, <class>.

However, we will accomplish nothing if we do not advance forward onto the mainland.

I have assembled a team of our most elite aerial units to begin the attack.

I would like you to join the assault. A champion such as yourself could turn the battle in our favor at the critical moment.

When you are ready to begin the attack, speak to me.

passages.title: The Assault on Shaol'mara
passages.text: We must claim a better strategic position on the island itself.

passages.title: The Assault on Shaol'mara
passages.text:
Yes! You have done it, champion!

Now, the Thunder King will taste the full force of the Kirin Tor!

passages.title: Work Order: Operation: Shieldwall II
passages.text:
Once your witchberries are ready to be picked, you'll need only to package them for pick-up.

Just think; your witchberries will be a part of your faction's efforts in Pandaria!

passages.title: Work Order: Operation: Shieldwall II
passages.text: The crate sits empty awaiting your crops.

passages.title: Work Order: Operation: Shieldwall II
passages.text: Throw the Witchberries into the crate! An Operation: Shieldwall representative will be along shortly for pick-up.

passages.title: Work Order: Golden Lotus II
passages.text:
Well, hopefully these crops will be suitable!

Once your white turnips are ready to be picked, you'll need only to package them for pick-up.

passages.title: Work Order: Golden Lotus II
passages.text: The crate sits empty awaiting your crops.

passages.title: Work Order: Golden Lotus II
passages.text: Throw the White Turnips into the crate! A Golden Lotus representative will be along shortly for pick-up.

passages.title: Work Order: Shado-Pan II
passages.text:
Well, your work is done for the day! Now to wait for the harvest tomorrow.

Once your green cabbages are ready to be picked, you'll need only to package them for pick-up.

Only the finest cabbage will do for the Shado-Pan!

passages.title: Work Order: Shado-Pan II
passages.text: The crate sits empty awaiting your crops.

passages.title: Work Order: Shado-Pan II
passages.text: Gently place the Green Cabbages into the crate! A Shado-Pan representative will be along shortly for pick-up.

passages.title: Tear Down This Wall!
passages.text:
The time has come. Our forces are well-enough entrenched here that we can risk pressing forward, into the Thunder King's lair. Unfortunately, it doesn't look like he'll be opening that gate anytime soon.

I suppose we'll have to make a gate of our own then. Let me know when you're ready, <name>.

passages.title: Tear Down This Wall!
passages.text: Let's tear down this wall.

passages.title: Tear Down This Wall!
passages.text: With your help, we're one giant step closer to our goal.

passages.title: A Bold Idea
passages.text:
Zandalari warships plunder the seas around this island. They ferry in soldiers and war beasts from Zandalar to bolster Lei Shen's army.

If we can capture the palace shipyard, the Thunder King's supply line will be cut off, and your foothold here will be secure.

I have a plan to do just that, and it won't take an entire army.

passages.title: A Bold Idea
passages.text:
Well done. That warship won't be raining fire on us again any time soon.

Taran Zhu has informed me that the Shado-Pan will keep vigil over Stormsea Landing, freeing up Kirin Tor resources to press the siege elsewhere. Taoshi will be there. I am sure she will be glad to work with you again.

We are all grateful for your contributions, <name>. Thank you.

passages.title: Work Order: The August Celestials II
passages.text:
Once your striped melons are ready to be picked, you'll need only to package them for pick-up.

A trainee from the Cradle of Chi-Ji will be along shortly to collect their order.

passages.title: Work Order: The August Celestials II
passages.text: The crate sits empty awaiting your crops.

passages.title: Work Order: The August Celestials II
passages.text: Throw the Striped Melons into the crate! Now the August Celestials' order is ready to go!

passages.title: Work Order: The Klaxxi II
passages.text:
Once your mogu pumpkins are ready to be picked, you'll need only to package them for pick-up.

I wouldn't dilly-dally if I were you. The Klaxxi aren't known for their patience!

passages.title: Work Order: The Klaxxi II
passages.text: The crate sits empty awaiting your crops.

passages.title: Work Order: The Klaxxi II
passages.text: Throw the Mogu Pumpkins into the crate! A Klaxxi representative will be along shortly for pick-up.

passages.title: Extended Shore Leave
passages.text:
The Zandalari have already begun repairing that warship, but we can keep it crippled with minimal effort.

Simply relieve the new captain of his post, and steal the ship's damage report from that workshop just outside the vault.

No captain. No repairs. No warship.

passages.title: Extended Shore Leave
passages.text: Lei Shen will fall to our onslaught, and my people will find glory in his ruin.

passages.title: Extended Shore Leave
passages.text:
This so-called "Thunder King" is surrounded and cut off from his allies. No tyrant is strong enough to stand alone.

Your efforts have not gone unnoticed. Take this, with my thanks.

passages.title: Raiding the Vault
passages.text:
The Swollen Vault is a repository for some of Lei Shen's nastiest weaponry and most prized trinkets - not surprisingly, these are often one and the same.

One artifact in particular, an amulet known as the Choker of Storms, could help us to understand his apparent mastery over lightning.

Break into the vault and slay the hoard-keeper. Take his key and use it to recover the amulet from a cache at the back of the vault.

passages.title: Raiding the Vault
passages.text: You have good news, I hope.

passages.title: Raiding the Vault
passages.text:
Ah, I know a powerful artifact when I see one. You were wise to bring this here. I will see that Aethas examines it right away - perhaps we can put it to work in our favor.

In the meantime, take this in trade.

passages.title: Thunder Calls
passages.text:
The time to attack the Thunder King has come!

A small group of Sunreavers awaits you near the Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.

Report to Scout Captain Elsia for further instructions.

passages.title: Thunder Calls
passages.text: We must move quickly, <name>! The others have gone ahead of us, but I will brief you in the flight over.

passages.title: Thunder Calls
passages.text:
The time to attack the Thunder King has come!

A small group of Kirin Tor awaits you near the Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.

Report to Vereesa Windrunner for further instructions.

passages.title: Thunder Calls
passages.text: We must move quickly, <name>! The others have gone ahead of us, but I will brief you in the flight over.

passages.title: The Storm Gathers
passages.text:
There is no time to waste, <name>. Every moment we delay here gives Jaina and the Kirin Tor more of a hold on the Isle.

Lor'themar awaits us. Speak to me when you are ready to depart. I will escort you there myself.

passages.title: The Storm Gathers
passages.text: This isle holds many secrets my friend.

passages.title: The Storm Gathers
passages.text:
You have arrived just in time, <race>. It is crucial we gain control of these shores before the Kirin Tor.

There is much to explain.

passages.title: So You Want to Be a Blacksmith...
passages.text: While it is best to learn the properties of simpler metals and work your way up, it is possible to learn how to become a good blacksmith through mastering the various applications of ghost iron for common household objects. If you wish to take this path towards becoming a zen master blacksmith, I can teach you. Whichever way you choose, you will have my respect if you can show me that you can make a ghostly skeleton key.

passages.title: So You Want to Be a Blacksmith...
passages.text: How are your studies coming along?

passages.title: So You Want to Be a Blacksmith...
passages.text: Well done. You are ready to become a zen master blacksmith.

passages.title: No Fishing Pole Necessary!
passages.text:
You don't even need to equip a fishing pole in Pandaria!

The waters are TEEMING with fish. You'll catch one pretty much every time, as long as you are paying attention. Give it a go!

passages.title: No Fishing Pole Necessary!
passages.text: Catch 5 Golden Carp. Try it without a fishing pole!

passages.title: No Fishing Pole Necessary!
passages.text: Let me see...  Yes, these are nice. Good job! Here, have some more.

passages.title: Secrets in the Isle of Thunder
passages.text:
I do have one thing I would ask of you, <class>.

We've gotten our hands on a powerful ritual stone that the Shan'ze mogu use to beckon their allies into battle, but we need more than one to perform their rituals.

If you come upon three of these stones, bring them back to me. We can gather our forces and use these stones to beckon some of Lei Shen's most powerful servants directly into our traps.

passages.title: Secrets in the Isle of Thunder
passages.text: Have you found the stones I spoke of?

passages.title: Secrets in the Isle of Thunder
passages.text: Perfect. I will show you how to use these stones, and then you can spring the ambush.

passages.title: Setting the Trap
passages.text:
Take these 3 ritual stones to the location I have marked on your map. There, you will find a Shan'ze ritual object that you can use to beckon one of their powerful allies.

You will need capable friends at your side for this trap to work. Do not go alone, for these will be some of the Thunder King's most powerful servants.

When your enemy shows itself, show no mercy.

passages.title: Setting the Trap
passages.text: Did the ambush succeed?

passages.title: Setting the Trap
passages.text:
Very impressive.

Should you find more stones, you should continue this ruse. It is sure to be quite some time before they catch on to our ploy.

passages.title: Forge Ahead!
passages.text:
There's more you must do. 

Kill Itoka, master of the forge, and find a codex fragment from Fleshcrafter Hoku, gatekeeper of the Thunder King.

passages.title: Forge Ahead!
passages.text: Well?

passages.title: Forge Ahead!
passages.text: Good work. What you did today brings us one step closer to our ultimate goal.

passages.title: reuse me
passages.text:
There's more you must do. 

Kill Itoka, master of the forge, and find a codex fragment from Fleshcrafter Hoku, gatekeeper of the Thunder King.

passages.title: Forge Ahead!
passages.text:
There's more you must do. 

Kill Itoka, master of the forge, and find a codex fragment from Fleshcrafter Hoku, gatekeeper of the Thunder King.

passages.title: Forge Ahead!
passages.text: Well?

passages.title: Forge Ahead!
passages.text: Good work. What you did today brings us one step closer to our ultimate goal.

passages.title: So You Want to Be a Blacksmith...
passages.text: While it is best to learn the properties of simpler metals and work your way up, it is possible to learn how to become a good blacksmith through mastering the various applications of ghost iron for common household objects. If you wish to take this path towards becoming a zen master blacksmith, I can teach you. Whichever way you choose, you will have my respect if you can show me that you can make a ghostly skeleton key.

passages.title: So You Want to Be a Blacksmith...
passages.text: How are your studies coming along?

passages.title: So You Want to Be a Blacksmith...
passages.text: Well done. You are ready to become a zen master blacksmith.

passages.title: Leave Nothing Behind!
passages.text:
The Thunderlord clan has become a thorn in my side I will no longer tolerate.

Go east and leave none alive! Burn their supplies! Leave them nothing to cling to.

Converge on the Savage Crag to the east when it is done.

passages.title: Leave Nothing Behind!
passages.text: Hrmph. The burning smell of Thunderlord. This pleases me, <class>.

passages.title: To the Garrison
passages.text:
My father is avenged. The sons of the Iron Wolf are all slain.

Go to the garrison your people are constructing in the south. There, herald my return to my laggard brother.

The time has come for the "chieftain" to be reminded of what it means to be a Frostwolf.

passages.title: To the Garrison
passages.text:
Ga'nar is coming. Good. We need his forces if we are to press the advantage.

I can only hope his bloodlust has quelled enough for him to listen to reason.

passages.title: END OF PROTOTYPE! [Return to Durotan at Ogre Citadel]
passages.text:
Ah! The weapons of my father, Garad. Too long this beast has coveted them as trophies, memories of slaying our beloved chieftain. I thank you Outsider. Your help today has proven most useful indeed.

Now I must bring these artifacts before my brother. The time has come for he and I to have a proper discussion about leadership.

passages.title: Celestial Blessings
passages.text:
I would like to grant you my full array of draconic power, but sadly, it would tear your mortal frame apart. Still, it's not hopeless - I believe I can create a powerful vessel that you can use.

To craft it, I will need the blessings of the four August Celestials in Pandaria. Travel with me to the four temples and we will speak to each. To be worthy of their gifts, you must defeat one of their challenges.

They will not be easy - chose the one challenge best suited to your equipment and skills!

passages.title: Celestial Blessings
passages.text: We have the four blessings of the celestials, and you have proven yourself by completing one of their challenges! I knew I saw great potential in you.

passages.title: The King and the Council
passages.text:
I am glad you are here, <name>. I have been using my dream brew to experience events around the world, but the more I learn, the more confused I become.

For instance, King Wrynn has asked the dwarves of Ironforge for more troops, but they do not all support him.

I will tell you more, but I would also like to hear from your experience firsthand...

passages.title: The King and the Council
passages.text: It is not my place to make stories. I simply tell them.

passages.title: The King and the Council
passages.text:
So, King Wrynn and the Dark Iron dwarves saved the city, and the bitterly divided Council of Three Hammers gained a new unity under the Alliance banner. How interesting!

But what is happening within the Horde?

passages.title: The Warchief and the Darkness
passages.text: I see now how the Alliance king leads his people. But what is the Horde warchief up to? Just below us, a swarm of goblins are burrowing into the sacred vale on his orders. What does he hope to find there? We must find out!

passages.title: The Warchief and the Darkness
passages.text: It is not my place to make stories. I simply tell them.

passages.title: The Warchief and the Darkness
passages.text:
Whaaaat? The remains of an Old God are buried beneath Pandaria? No wonder the land is so haunted!

The warchief's pursuit of those dormant powers are fraying apart the very Horde he leads. His vision is narrow, but very, very dangerous. I must inform the Shado-Pan immediately.

passages.title: A Little Field Work
passages.text:
My dream brew can only tell me so much. Its visions are scattered in time and space. But it is clear that a showdown is brewing at the Horde capital of Orgrimmar.

You should go there, and see these events for yourself!

In my dream brew I see two brave Alliance spies alone in Durotar. I see "Amber" and "Sully"...

Perhaps you remember them? I think they need your help!

You'll find Amber and Sully in Kalimdor, near Skull Rock, at a place called the Dranosh'ar Blockade.

passages.title: A Little Field Work
passages.text:
<name>! I cannot tell you how relieved I am to have some backup!

King Wrynn himself sent us to gather intel on Garrosh's activities and Orgrimmar's defenses, but... things are looking grim.

We need your help.

passages.title: Gathering Intelligence
passages.text:
Garrosh continues building up his forces in Orgrimmar - this place is like a fortress!

King Wrynn won't want to risk an assault until we have as much information as possible.

Use Project C4T to navigate through the Blockade. Try to gather as much information as you can. Look for any high priority documents and any weakness we can take advantage of. Keep your ears open and your head down!

passages.title: Gathering Intelligence
passages.text: Did you find us anything useful?

passages.title: Gathering Intelligence
passages.text:
Let's see... the warchief is moving tons of supplies through the Barrens... And what's this about the Darkspear? The trolls are in open rebellion?! Garrosh certainly has his hands full.

I think I know how we can use this intel. It's a crazy idea, but it just might work...

passages.title: Path of the Last Emperor
passages.text:
In his time of uncertainty, the last emperor walked a lonely path up this mountain, until he had at last found his answers.

I am here to walk the same path, and it seems you have questions of your own to be answered. Perhaps you will join me, and we can both be satisfied?

Oh, but I am getting old, and this blizzard is proving too much for my bones. Could you climb ahead and anchor this rope? I can hoist myself along from there.

Together we shall walk the path of the last emperor.

passages.title: Path of the Last Emperor
passages.text:
We made it, <class>! Thank you so much. Please, help yourself to some of my old knick-knacks.

But... I am afraid I have not been completely honest with you...

passages.title: Re-Use Me
passages.text:
Ah, adventurer, just the <race> I was looking for. I have received another batch of tactical mana bombs that I need planted in key positions across Dawnseeker Promontory to the northwest.

Here, take these. It is time to give the Sunreavers a taste of their own medicine.

Plant one on the Sunreaver ships, another one on their scrying crystals, and the last on the bridge that connects to their forward base.

passages.title: Re-Use Me
passages.text:
Even the strongest defense can still have a weakness, <class>. We just need to find the weakness in the Sunreaver's defense and then exploit it as much as possible.

Scouts have reported the use of perimeter wards around Dawnseeker Promontory. They're powerful, but not deadly.

Disabling them would allow us to keep closer watch on their activities.

passages.title: Grandpa Grumplefloot
passages.text:
The challenge card I have for you today belongs to a grummle by the adorable name of Grandpa Grumplefloot. While the grummles aren't particularly well-known for their combat skills, they are remarkably lucky little creatures.

Perhaps it's their... what do they call them... their luckydos?

passages.title: Grandpa Grumplefloot
passages.text:
Great fighting out there! Even if he was just a little guy.

You've earned every bit of this.

passages.title: The Bear and the Lady Fair
passages.text:
The challenge card you've earned belongs to an unusual pair of characters. I'm not quite sure any further description would do them justice.

Maybe you should just purchase the challenge card and see for yourself.

passages.title: The Bear and the Lady Fair
passages.text: You sailed through the air so... so... majestically! Well done!

passages.title: Master Boom Boom
passages.text:
You have earned a card belonging to a bomb-throwing hozen named Master Boom Boom.

While hozen are naturally attracted to the destructive power of explosives, they seldom learn how to use them properly without blowing themselves up in the process. Master Boom Boom is the exception.

Good luck!

passages.title: Master Boom Boom
passages.text:
I'm not sure how to feel. I wanted you to win, but then again... I also kinda wanted to see you explode.

No hard feelings! I just like seeing explosions.

passages.title: Razorgrin
passages.text:
The challenge card you've earned today belongs to one of the most deadly creatures in the South Seas: Razorgrin. One bite from those teeth of his, and you're nothing but an unrecognizable pile of skin, blood, and entrails.

Have fun!

passages.title: Razorgrin
passages.text:
Congratulations!

Also, how embarrassing would it have been if you got eaten by a beached shark?

passages.title: Splat
passages.text:
You may already be familiar with Blat, one of our Rank 2 challengers here in the Brawler's Guild. The challenge card you've earned belongs to Splat, its older, nastier sister.

Try not to get yourself killed, <name>. And if you do, at least make it entertaining for the rest of us!

passages.title: Splat
passages.text: You left quite a mess behind you, but you did it. Well done, <race>!

passages.title: Mecha-Bruce
passages.text:
Everybody knows Bruce. Everybody loves Bruce! And eventually, everybody kills Bruce.

An orcish hunter with a knack for engineering thought that this was a shame, so he's found his own crocolisk and geared him up a bit.

The challenge card you've earned grants you the right to fight Mecha-Bruce. It's bound to be a bloodbath. The question is... will you be the chomper, or the chompee?

passages.title: Mecha-Bruce
passages.text:
Aww... poor Mecha-Bruce.

I'll give you your reward. But I don't have to be happy about it.

passages.title: Dippy and Doopy
passages.text:
Brawler's Guild vets will remember Dippy, the penguin. Dippy's not the most accomplished challenger in the Brawler's Guild, but he's no pushover, either!

Actually, come to think of it, he IS kind of a pushover...

Anyway! The card you've earned gives you the right to challenge Dippy alongside his older, huger brother, Doopy. They may both be pushovers, but that doesn't mean that one or both of them won't eventually murder you.

passages.title: Dippy and Doopy
passages.text: I never thought I'd say this, but successfully beating up a couple penguins is the sign of a true, tried-and-tested brawler. You've earned your reward.

passages.title: Blingtron 3000
passages.text:
The Blingtron line didn't really pick up until the 4000 series hit the vendor shelves. Few remember the Blingtron 3000, but it was a real engineering marvel in its own right!

The challenge card you've unlocked gives you the ability to fight Blingtron 3000 right here, in the Brawler's Guild.

Lucky you!

passages.title: Blingtron 3000
passages.text: You've got a real knack for beating up robots, <name>.

passages.title: Mingus Diggs
passages.text:
You've earned the right to challenge Mingus Diggs, the archaeologist!

Mingus isn't that tough, from what I hear... but the people in charge let him bring some of his excavated treasures with him into the brawling ring. Those are what you want to watch out for.

Come buy his card when you're ready!

passages.title: Mingus Diggs
passages.text:
You ran around that arena so quickly, I got dizzy for a moment.

Well done!

passages.title: The Blind Hero
passages.text:
The challenge card you've earned allows you to fight the Blind Hero, a mysterious warrior from a bygone age. Nobody surpasses his skill with a blade. Nobody.

Luckily, he can't see anything. Have fun!

passages.title: The Blind Hero
passages.text:
I would normally shame someone for fighting a blind person, but in this case, I have to commend you.

Brilliant brawling, <name>!

passages.title: Ro-Shambo
passages.text:
The challenge card you have unlocked will allow you to fight Ro-Shambo, an esoteric creature from parts unknown.

Watch out. I hear it's got a few tricks up its sleeve.

passages.title: Ro-Shambo
passages.text: You did well! Even if you did get a little lucky...

passages.title: Ty'thar
passages.text:
You've earned the right to purchase a challenge card, and that card belongs to a troll named Ty'thar.

Ty'thar has a very distinct fighting style, and as part of his agreement with the Brawler's Guild, you have to follow his rules:

 - Face-to-face fist fighting. No running around.

 - Three knockdowns wins the fight.

Good luck!

passages.title: Ty'thar
passages.text:
Look at you! You went into that arena and beat Ty'thar at his own game.

Here. You deserve this.

passages.title: Cloak of Virtue
passages.text:
We have what we need. I can create an item that will harness the power of the celestials and, with a little work, may also be able to contain some of my own.

Meet me atop Mason's Folly, east of the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair, where we've met before. You will be delighted with the results!

passages.title: Cloak of Virtue
passages.text:
I can custom-tailor the cloak to your preferred abilities. Choose wisely!

The cloak contains only a fraction of its potential power. I'm already hatching a plan to augment it...

passages.title: Battlefield: Barrens
passages.text:
Our work be far from finished, <name>. De flames of change burn, but dey can still be snuffed out.

Bring me more Kor'kron war supplies, and I'll reward ya well.

passages.title: Battlefield: Barrens
passages.text: How go the Barrens, <class>?

passages.title: Battlefield: Barrens
passages.text:
<Ki'ta Arrowtusk chuckles to himself.> I see you made a whole lotta Kor'kron heads roll for dese supplies.

Well mon, Vol'jin was right to commend you. Dese supplies will be lastin' us an entire week.

passages.title: Preparing to Strike
passages.text:
Events are in motion, <name>. We have one final task to complete before we are ready to move into the final act of my plan.

My agents tell me that King Wrynn has reassembled a naval fleet after his losses at Theramore, and Vol'jin is marching north across Durotar in open rebellion against the warchief.

Speak with me again as soon as they are ready to converge on the gates. We will bring this war to a glorious conclusion!

passages.title: Preparing to Strike
passages.text:
Are you ready for your next adventure, <class>?

Our campaign is nearing its conclusion...

passages.title: Battlefield: Barrens
passages.text: Our work be far from finished, <race>. If ya willin' ta put ya neck on the line for the Darkspear once more, I'll be sure ta see ya get a proper reward.

passages.title: Battlefield: Barrens
passages.text: How go tha Barrens, <race>?

passages.title: Battlefield: Barrens
passages.text:
<Ki'ta Arrowtusk chuckles to himself.> I see you made a whole lotta Kor'kron heads roll for dese supplies.

Well mon, Vol'jin was right to commend you. Dese supplies will be lastin' us an entire week.

passages.title: Heroic Deeds
passages.text:
My mind is spinning with boredom - I never get to leave this place!

You look like you've seen some adventures. If you can bring me a truly heroic story, I've got something special I'm sure you'll be interested in.

passages.title: Heroic Deeds
passages.text: Anything to tell me, <name>?

passages.title: Heroic Deeds
passages.text:
Congratulations, <name>, you did it!  Before I forget, here's the special surprise I promised -- I hope you like it.

Now tell me all about the adventure.  Did you face certain death?  Meet any friends?  I wish I had more friends like you.

passages.title: reuse me
passages.text:
There's more you must do. 

Kill Itoka, master of the forge, and find a codex fragment from Fleshcrafter Hoku, gatekeeper of the Thunder King.

passages.title: Work Order: Sunreaver Onslaught II
passages.text:
Once your scallions are ready to be picked, you'll need only to package them for pick-up.

Just think; your scallions will feed so many hungry soldiers on the front lines!

passages.title: Work Order: Sunreaver Onslaught II
passages.text: The crate sits empty awaiting your crops.

passages.title: Work Order: Sunreaver Onslaught II
passages.text: Throw the scallions into the crate! A Sunreaver Onslaught representative will be along shortly for pick-up.

passages.title: Work Order: Kirin Tor Offensive II
passages.text:
Once your juicycrunch carrots are ready to be picked, you'll need only to package them for pick-up.

Just think; your juicycrunch carrots will feed so many hungry soldiers on the front lines!

passages.title: Work Order: Kirin Tor Offensive II
passages.text: The crate sits empty awaiting your crops.

passages.title: Work Order: Kirin Tor Offensive II
passages.text: Throw the juicycrunch carrots into the crate! A Kirin Tor Offensive representative will be along shortly for pick-up.

passages.title: Rolo's Riddle
passages.text:
The final step, my treasure calls
Above the place where water falls
Beneath the shade on vantage high
No path to walk but air and sky.

passages.title: Rolo's Riddle
passages.text: <The ancient chest has not been disturbed for a long time.>

passages.title: Only the Winner
passages.text:
I am Gronnstalker Rokash, and I only serve the winning side.

I have heard of some of your deeds, commander, and seen the corpses left in the wake of you and your forces.

I have grown tired of my current clan. They are soft, weak, and losing.

I offer you this challenge: enter Colossal's Fall to the north and slay Sky-Singer Strag. Claim her totem as a trophy and I will hail you as my new chieftain.

passages.title: Only the Winner
passages.text: Strag always was a coward. She would hide behind her magic and position as a speaker for the dead.

passages.title: Only the Winner
passages.text:
Strag was the puppet of the Iron Wolf. She would do nothing unless ordered to by him.

This made us weak, changing us from a force to be feared to a target.

If this is what the Thunderlord have become then I will have no part of them.

passages.title: Enfilade
passages.text:
If we leave now, my clan's final assault on Grom'gar will be a disaster.

Though our warriors are unmatched in melee, the Thunderlords have new ranged weapons - our forces would be decimated as they cross the Icewind Drifts.

But WE are already here. We can overtake those weapons before they ever fire.

Blackrock orcs help our enemies forge these "cannons" in the workshops on the south side. If we use their own tools to sabotage the weapons, we leave Grom'gar wide open to a Frostwolf raid.

passages.title: Enfilade
passages.text: If we leave those cannons intact, my brothers and sisters will die. What more is there to say?

passages.title: Enfilade
passages.text: See how their machines fail them! There is no better weapon than pure orc muscle!

passages.title: Glyph of the Armsmaster
passages.text:
[TEMP TEXT] I understand - you need this scroll properly inscribed. I have the vellum, but a text like this deserves bold colors: colors which come at a cost. Standard inks will not do.

There are beasts here in the Vale... beasts of legend which carry the colors I need. I can show you where to find them.

passages.title: Into the Vale
passages.text:
Ah, I have been waiting for your arrival, traveler.

I wish we could meet in better times, but alas, I fear the situation in the Vale is quite dire.

But let us not speak of that now. Go visit Madam Vee Luo at the Shrine of Two Moons.

She should be able to settle you in.

passages.title: The Iron Wolf
passages.text:
My brother Ga'nar stands beside me.

Wor'gol, Stonefang, and your garrison hold strong.

Our clan is united, and the Thunderlord are already on the run. We are ready. The time has come to face this "Iron Wolf."

passages.title: The Iron Wolf
passages.text: Thank you for protecting my family, <name>.

passages.title: Of Fire and Thunder
passages.text:
The Iron Wolf... brought weapons...

<cough>

...weapons of fire and thunder.

Our warriors have never seen such weapons. We were not ready.

<wheeze> We must learn... to overcome...

passages.title: Catch and Carry
passages.text:
Oh my! Grandpa used to tell me stories of the famous Lin family noodle shop.

It is sad that the scroll has been warped, but I think we can work together to solve the riddle!

To start, we're going to need lots of grain to make noodles.

Head down to the granary and catch some grain with this sack. After you've caught some, drop it off at the wagon I've placed at the granary.

passages.title: Catch and Carry
passages.text:
Excellent work, <name>! With all this grain I think we're ready to start.

For now I think you should try making noodle soup. Try using this recipe I've written down for you. It'll make for excellent practice.

passages.title: Is That A Real Measurement?
passages.text:
Well done, <name>. I can see you're ready to continue exploring the mysteries of Lin's secret ingredient soup.

From what I can tell, Lin used Stormstout brew for his soup broth.

I think the next steps for you are to create a Noodle Cart of your own and to head to the Stormstout Brewery to collect some sloshes of brew.

passages.title: Is That A Real Measurement?
passages.text: I'm glad it's you and not me. I'm not much of a drinker, myself.

passages.title: Is That A Real Measurement?
passages.text:
Well done, <name>. With this we can make a truly unique soup broth.

I've managed to get some updated schematics for your noodle cart. With this broth, you're definitely going to want to upgrade your operation.

Next up: finding the secret ingredient of the Lin secret ingredient noodle soup!

passages.title: The Secret Ingredient Is...
passages.text:
The best way to go about doing this is through hands-on experience.

I've arranged for merchants, scholars, and farmers from all over Pandaria to come for a taste test of your soups. We'll get the best results if you can match them to the soups they prefer.

It's time to find the secret ingredient!

passages.title: The Secret Ingredient Is...
passages.text: <name>, we need to find the secret ingredient if we're to ever master the Lin family's noodle soup!

passages.title: The Secret Ingredient Is...
passages.text:
Well done, <name>. All those people came by to taste your noodle soup and YOU made them so happy!

Don't you see? The secret ingredient is in you!

Now go out there and make the world happy with this latest noodle cart!

passages.title: The Fate of Karabor
passages.text:
Threads of the future weave together, winding and unwinding, creating tapestries that change in form and color from one moment to the next.

I must have clarity. I must focus on the ONE strand that will become reality.

When you are ready to share in my vision, drink the elixir.

When the vision begins, be on your guard. The events of the vision are as deadly as anything we experience in this reality.

passages.title: The Fate of Karabor
passages.text: <The Prophet is deep in thought. He looks troubled.>

passages.title: The Fate of Karabor
passages.text: I have seen enough. Ner'zhul must be stopped.

passages.title: The Clarity Elixir
passages.text:
I see a thousand glimpses of the future, swimming in a chaotic blur.

It is possible to focus my energies to see the true eventuality - the future most likely to come to pass.

I will need an oracle stone to focus my power, and a special elixir to still my mind.

To make the elixir, I will need the following ingredients: wing dust from Swamplighters along the river, fresh hearts from a monstrously-sized hydra, and a rare star lily.

Meet me at Moonwillow Peak when this task is done.

passages.title: The Clarity Elixir
passages.text: Yes?

passages.title: The Clarity Elixir
passages.text:
My trust in you is well placed, young <class>.

This task would have been troublesome for many of my students, and yet you finished it with ease.

passages.title: The Dark that Blinds Us
passages.text:
After years of research, there is still so much I do not understand about the Shadowmoon.

To the southwest are stone monuments detailing the orcs' history.

I'm not able to get close enough to examine the stones, but perhaps you can.

If you could take a chalk rubbing of the words written on those stones, and I will reward you handsomely.

passages.title: The Dark that Blinds Us
passages.text: What did you find?

passages.title: The Dark that Blinds Us
passages.text:
Oh my, I see, I see! These writings will give me much insight into the Shadowmoon clan's culture.

Thank you, <name>.

passages.title: Going Undercover
passages.text:
Yrel leads my rangers on a search for the prisoners at the Shadowmoon village.

Their work is extremely dangerous, so I need you to carry out a contingency mission.

Sylene has mastered an illusion spell which will allow you to infiltrate Shaz'gul safely. Speak to her to disguise yourself.

Then, plant explosives at the quartermaster's depot, the main lodge, and the ritual altar.

In case anything goes wrong, set them off to create a distraction.

passages.title: Going Undercover
passages.text: You made it, <name>! Boy, am I glad to see you.

passages.title: Ancestor's Memory
passages.text:
I believe that you should know the price of the lives you take.

So before I will help you find Ner'zhul, you must understand why he joined the Iron Horde.

In a cave beneath this village is an artifact that we call the Ancestral Totem. On it is carved the names of every Shadowmoon clan member since its founding.

The opening of the cave lies directly south. I will meet you there.

passages.title: Ancestor's Memory
passages.text: You must understand a man's life before taking it.

passages.title: Ancestor's Memory
passages.text: We will find new traditions. My people will become something... new.

passages.title: On the Offensive
passages.text:
We cannot enter these gates, but you can, <class>.

Your mission is critical, and the Shadowmoon will kill you on sight. Do not hesitate to return the favor.

passages.title: On the Offensive
passages.text: The Shadowmoon are not simple opponents. Your fighting skill is truly comparable to none.

passages.title: Meet Me Back at the Inn
passages.text:
I'm certain you're eager to test out your new cloak. Let's put it to use.

Meet me back inside the inn! A new development has come to my attention that we'll want to take advantage of.

passages.title: Meet Me Back at the Inn
passages.text: Are you ready for your next adventure?

passages.title: A Timeless Discovery
passages.text:
Pandaria. Just when I think I've gotten its mysteries figured out, I discover something new.

It's called "The Timeless Isle." Once hidden in the mists, it appears and disappears seemingly of its own will. I've heard that time has no meaning there, that the sun neither rises nor sets.

We can take advantage of this anomaly, <name>! If I could time-lock your cloak, the power it could contain would be... immense.

Our path is clear. Fly southeast of the Jade Forest and meet me at the Timeless Isle!

passages.title: A Timeless Discovery
passages.text:
You're here! How long have I been waiting for you?

<Wrathion appears momentarily confused.>

I feel like I just arrived... but maybe I've been here for weeks... This island plays with one's head.

Kairoz has been trying to explain it to me, but sometimes I think bronze dragons speak in riddles.

passages.title: Secrets of the Timeless Isle
passages.text:
There is a currency minted only on this island - "timeless coins." They are immune to the island's temporal distortions... I would like to figure out why.

Gather some for me! Venture into the jungles of this forgotten paradise. Destroy the mysterious foes who lurk in this timeless place, discover hidden caches of treasure, and explore forgotten treasure hoards - whatever it takes. I will be waiting!

passages.title: Secrets of the Timeless Isle
passages.text:
<Wrathion tents his fingers together.>

My coins...?

passages.title: Secrets of the Timeless Isle
passages.text:
Wonderful, these are exactly what I need.

<Wrathion holds one of the coins up, admiring it in the glow of the unmoving sun.>

I will deconstruct their mysterious power, and use their timelessness to enhance your cloak. You will be most pleased with the result.

passages.title: The Emperor's Way
passages.text:
Recently, the August Celestials of Pandaria presented you with a challenge - and you triumphed.

But can you defeat them in combat? They are testing the mettle of all of Pandaria's heroes.

This challenge is not impossible, but you'll need to follow the advice of the last Pandaren Emperor and tackle it with unwavering inner strength. You'll also need a small army, so find a group of people you trust.

Defeat the four celestials here in the Celestial Court, and our journey is almost complete...

passages.title: The Emperor's Way
passages.text: An impressive display of martial skill, <class>! You have truly walked the path of the emperor, and demonstrated the very traits pandaren value most.

passages.title: A Pandaren Legend
passages.text:
I have learned so much in this timeless place, friend. Between the wisdom of the celestials and the curious power of these timeless artifacts, I know now how to safely augment your cloak with my own considerable power.

I need a sacred place to complete my final incantations. Quickly! Meet me in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms, within the Seat of Knowledge above the Mogu'shan Palace.

Today, your legend begins!

passages.title: A Pandaren Legend
passages.text:
Step forward, my champion.

This is your hour.

passages.title: Judgment of the Black Prince
passages.text:
Now. To the final stage of my plan. Time to fulfil your grand purpose.

Using your newfound powers, it is time to bring this war to its conclusion. Destroy Garrosh Hellscream. Your people demand it, and future generations will sing your praises as the harbinger for the glorious new world we shall build together.

I have no reward to offer you. I have already done everything in my power to ensure that you succeed. You are on your own.

End Hellscream's reign.

passages.title: Judgment of the Black Prince
passages.text: <Wrathion is FURIOUS. News of Hellscream's defeat and King Wrynn's gesture of peace must've already reached the black dragon's ears.>

passages.title: The Usurper
passages.text: This fragment of the heart of Y'shaarj lies completely inert. You should bring it to the remnants of the Golden Lotus as proof that Garrosh has been defeated.

passages.title: Ominous Portents
passages.text:
Now that Priestess Moonfang has created the blessed water, it is time to deal with the demon.

Take the water and the scripture of Elune.

Through the power of each, you will compel the demon to show us what the orcs are up to at Gul'var.

passages.title: Ominous Portents
passages.text: The demon must be put to the test if we're to find out what's happening at Gul'var.

passages.title: Ominous Portents
passages.text: Gul'dan is there! We must move quickly to capture him.

passages.title: To Catch a Shadow
passages.text:
Gul'dan is on the Shadow Rise just up the hill to the west. But, you must hurry, <name>. We know that he's about to leave for Talador and Frostfire Ridge.

The use of the soul trap is straightforward. Simply point and shoot to ensnare Gul'dan. The crystal will take care of the rest.

I'll see you back at Starfall Outpost when you have him.

Good luck.

passages.title: To Catch a Shadow
passages.text:
Unfortunate, but not surprising. At least we were able to defeat one of the inner council members.

All is not lost, <name>. We know what the Shadow Council is up to and where they're heading.

We'll regroup in Talador. Together, we'll put an end to Teron'gor and his plans for Auchindoun.

Did you hear that?

passages.title: The Celestial Tournament
passages.text:
The Timeless Isle is home to a special tournament created to test the leadership of its participants. Those who prove their worth are granted an opportunity to befriend an embodiment of virtue - the progeny of the celestials themselves.

Each time you win the tournament, I will honor you with a single ceremonial coin. When you have enough coins, speak with me again to further discuss your reward.

passages.title: The Celestial Tournament
passages.text: You must win the Celestial Tournament to receive your coin.

passages.title: The Celestial Tournament
passages.text: A true leader stands before me.  It is my honor to grant you this coin, <name>.

passages.title: Brute Beatdown
passages.text:
This Iron Horde has no honor.

Their leaders spit on us and laugh as we do their bidding.

Many of my brothers and sisters have died at their hands.

It is time to send these savages to an early grave.

passages.title: Time Keeper Kairoz
passages.text:
You have found your way to the Timeless Isle, <class>. The bronze dragonflight is keen to investigate the mysteries of this place, but the island is dangerous, and we will need your help.

Midway down this beach, you will find a paved path to the east.

It will lead you to the ancient Celestial Court. You will find Kairoz there, one of the Keepers of Time that we are working with.

Kairoz will answer any questions you might have. Be careful: The way may not be safe.

passages.title: Time Keeper Kairoz
passages.text:
Ah! Well met, <name>!

I was told you would be coming, but had not expected you so soon.

...or has it been a long while? It is difficult to tell, here.

So! Shall we begin?

passages.title: Time Keeper Kairoz
passages.text:
You have found your way to the Timeless Isle, <class>. The bronze dragonflight is keen to investigate the mysteries of this place, but the island is dangerous, and we will need your help.

Midway up this beach, you will find a paved path to the east.

It will lead you to the ancient Celestial Court. You will find Kairoz there, one of the Keepers of Time that we are working with.

Kairoz will answer any questions you might have. Be careful: The way may not be safe.

passages.title: Time Keeper Kairoz
passages.text:
Ah! Well met, <name>!

I was told you would be coming, but had not expected you so soon.

...or has it been a long while? It is difficult to tell, here.

So! Shall we begin?

passages.title: A Timeless Question
passages.text:
Destiny. Fate. Karma. Words like these imply that the timeways are unassailable.

Would that were the case. To this day, many of Azeroth's inhabitants yearn to change the past. Yet just as our experiences shape us, they also shape the world around us.

Consider how those threads have woven the fabric of today's reality. Cut enough threads, and causation inevitably fails, unraveling that fabric. Indeed, cutting even a single thread short can result in disaster, provided it is the right thread.

passages.title: A Timeless Question
passages.text: Let us speak, then, of events that have already come to pass.

passages.title: A Timeless Question
passages.text: This is the great burden of the Historian - should Azeroth's timeways come under attack, we must reconstruct history exactly as it happened, or the consequences could be dire. As we spread our stories and knowledge, so do we create a stronger future for us all.

passages.title: Time In Your Hands
passages.text:
Inhabitants of this strange island barter with a special currency, immune from the fickle fluctuations of time.

You would do well to gather as many of these "timeless coins" as possible! They can be found hidden away in small caches, or gathered from creatures all around the island. Larger, rarer creatures are a better source of coins - you may find it profitable to venture forth as part of a group.

Introduce yourself to Mistweavers Ai and Ku across the Celestial Court, and gather some coins for me.

passages.title: Time In Your Hands
passages.text: You're back already? It feels like we spoke only moments ago.

passages.title: Time In Your Hands
passages.text:
I believe you are getting the feel for this place! Yes, opportunities abound to gather up timeless treasures. Strange events happen all the time here - always keep your eyes open.

Speak to the mistweavers you met to spend your hard-earned currency. Meanwhile, I will continue my research.

Here is a taste of some of the treasures you can find here. More powerful items are available. You'll find that hidden caches in the more dangerous parts of the island can be... extremely rewarding. Good luck.

passages.title: A Flash of Bronze...
passages.text:
As you survey the devastation of the vale, a flash of bronze catches your eye. Unless you're mistaken, a tiny gnome is trying to catch your attention from the balcony above Mogu'shan Palace, just outside of the Seat of Knowledge.

You should see what she wants.

passages.title: A Flash of Bronze...
passages.text:
<The tiny gnome's eyes reflect the light with a copper sheen. She is not what she seems.>

<name>! I have been waiting for you. The bronze dragonflight has need of your services.

passages.title: A Flash of Bronze...
passages.text:
As you survey the devastation of the vale, a flash of bronze catches your eye. Unless you're mistaken, a tiny gnome is trying to catch your attention from the balcony above Mogu'shan Palace, just outside of the Seat of Knowledge.

You should see what she wants.

passages.title: A Flash of Bronze...
passages.text:
<The tiny gnome's eyes reflect the light with a copper sheen. She is not what she seems.>

<name>! I have been waiting for you. The bronze dragonflight has need of your services.

passages.title: Journey to the Timeless Isle
passages.text:
The bronze dragonflight has discovered a most unusual pandaren phenomenon, <class>. Emerging from the mists, far off the coast of the Jade Forest - an island that was lost in time!

It is a dangerous place, perhaps the most perilous in all of Pandaria. But we are determined to unravel its mysteries.

Here, take this timepiece. A single click will whisk you to the island. Get yourself established, and speak with Watcher Lara. She will guide you to our chief investigator.

passages.title: Journey to the Timeless Isle
passages.text: I see Chronormu has made good on her promise! You are right on time.

passages.title: Journey to the Timeless Isle
passages.text:
The bronze dragonflight has discovered a most unusual pandaren phenomenon, <class>. Emerging from the mists, far off the coast of the Jade Forest - an island that was lost in time!

It is a dangerous place, perhaps the most perilous in all of Pandaria. But we are determined to unravel its mysteries.

Here, take this timepiece. A single click will whisk you to the island. Get yourself established, and speak with Watcher Alundra. She will guide you to our chief investigator.

passages.title: Journey to the Timeless Isle
passages.text: I see Chronormu has made good on her promise! You are right on time.

passages.title: The Righteous March
passages.text:
The Iron Horde have overtaken Karabor. If we don't act now, we will lose the city.

Exarch Akama and the last of our forces are trapped within the city, but your garrison forces are still outside the temple, awaiting your orders.

Come and fly with me. We will meet your forces on the field. With the naaru by our side, we will make one last charge to retake the city!

passages.title: The Righteous March
passages.text: Now, to destroy these orcs once and for all.

passages.title: Game of Thorns
passages.text:
<Jarrod is clearly injured. He winces in pain as he begins to talk.>

My lead forest operator, Shelly... she is being held not far from here...

passages.title: Game of Thorns
passages.text: <Something is moving under all of these roots.>

passages.title: Two Birds, One Power Core
passages.text:
The power core is of the utmost importance, <name>. We need to locate it as quickly as possible. Those Iron Horde scum carted it away hours ago though. It could be anywhere!

I think we should start with the leadership here and work our way down. I'm sure we're bound to find some clues and we'll be setting them back at the same time.

passages.title: This One Is Just Right
passages.text:
I noticed the commanders carrying around what appeared to be journals. I have a feeling we'll get more than enough information from those, if we can get our hands on them anyway.

The journals are never far away from their owners so this could be tricky...

passages.title: Hints From The Past
passages.text:
There is much to learn of this place, yet it does not yield its secrets willingly.

Something you mentioned the last time that we spoke intrigues me. This Mistweaver Ai, she carries a time-worn journal, if I recall? This may be the answer to many of our questions, or it may simply raise more. I suppose that it all depends on the diligence of the explorer that put pen to paper in this preposterous place.

Obtain a time-worn journal and return to me with it. We shall delve into its mysteries together.

passages.title: Hints From The Past
passages.text: Ah, you have returned. Do you have the journal?

passages.title: Hints From The Past
passages.text:
Ah, you have it! Excellent!

A cursory glance indicates that my presumptions were not far-fetched. Though the pages are worn and waterlogged, most of the entries are still legible. It appears that our friend, explorer Harrington, was quite verbose in cataloguing the creatures and treasures he found on his journey through the island.

Well, are you simply going to stand there? This tome is a veritable trove of mysteries, and we have barely scratched the surface! Adventure awaits!

passages.title: Timeless Treasures
passages.text:
The journal indicates that treasures abound across the island, sometimes temptingly out of reach, and other times hidden in dark caves and hollows. What might have been secreted away here, many generations ago?

And perhaps more importantly, by whom?

Search the island for such treasures, and return to me with your findings. Be warned that all that glitters is not gold, yet the reverse is also true. Sometimes the simple hollowed-out stump is the best hiding place for one's valuables.

passages.title: Timeless Treasures
passages.text: Time flows oddly in this place, I cannot tell if I should be sleeping or eating my mid-day meal.

passages.title: Timeless Treasures
passages.text:
I am happy that you have discovered some riches for your efforts, though we are no closer to unraveling this mystery than before. Take solace in the knowledge that many such bounties are surely scattered throughout the island, eagerly awaiting your exploration skills and combat prowess.

Oh, one last thing, my young adventurer - do not forget to look to the skies now and again.

passages.title: Strong Enough To Survive
passages.text:
An island lost in time and yet it returns flourishing with life!

Where did this island travel to? Did it simply hop forward in time, or did it languish in the dark reaches of the Twisting Nether?

There is one thing for certain: the creatures that inhabit this place are far more than they seem. I sense a hidden power in them, forged by the eons. Seek out the champions of their species, duly marked by their power and prowess, and vanquish five such creatures.

In death, we may find the clues we seek.

passages.title: Strong Enough To Survive
passages.text: This journal really is fascinating, I wonder what happened to our dear explorer friend in the end.

passages.title: Strong Enough To Survive
passages.text:
An interesting story of combat and bravery, though I fear that we learned little from your endeavors save that you are quite the adventurer. It seems that we find ourselves at an impasse with each twist and turn of this tale. Time is a fickle mistress.

You may wish to spend some time honing your skills here, before the sun sets.

passages.title: The Essence of Time
passages.text:
It is about time that I revealed to you my purpose on this island.

The bronze dragonflight's powers have diminished greatly - we can now only catch furtive glimpses through time. It is... quite frustrating.

But we are not entirely without means. I hold in my hand the Vision of Time, an artifact of my own creation. The creatures of this isle have passed through time, and may carry with them some of its essence. With it, we will fill the hourglass, granting us a window into the timeways once more.

passages.title: The Essence of Time
passages.text: Have you found anything?

passages.title: The Essence of Time
passages.text:
Epoch stones are quite rare. The crystallized essence of time, they require a rapid passage through the ages to form. Their presence here indicates that the island may not exist in one time at all, but shift rapidly from timeway to timeway.

That is of little importance at the moment, though. There are important moments in time that require our attention. Give me a moment to grind the stone and add it to the Vision of Time hourglass.

passages.title: A Vision in Time
passages.text:
Look at how the Vision reacts! Astounding! Even now it shows shadows of timeways that flit around us constantly. Though not true sands of the Hourglass of Time, the finely-ground epoch stones certainly have a power all their own. Our first task is to use them to calibrate the Vision of Time.

Take the Vision of Time to a location where history is in the making: the Siege of Orgrimmar. Once there, turn the hourglass and see what happens.

passages.title: A Vision in Time
passages.text: Did you use the Vision of Time? What was the result?

passages.title: A Vision in Time
passages.text: How very intriguing. I will have to make some additional modifications, and perhaps locate a more proper catalyst. Thank you for performing this experiment, I trust that you did not experience any adverse effects? Should you feel up to the task, I may have use of your services again shortly.

passages.title: Empowering the Hourglass
passages.text:
The hourglass gives us glimpses into the streams of time we once walked as easily as a well-worn path.

Gather additional epoch stones, so that we may continue to use the power of the hourglass to delve into the mysteries of the timeways.

The future depends on it.

passages.title: Empowering the Hourglass
passages.text: Epoch stones are rare, crystallized temporal essence.

passages.title: Empowering the Hourglass
passages.text:
Give me a moment to grind the stones and add them to the hourglass, and we shall see what new events unfold.
