We'll have to find a way to power the gateway's activator. Like this last gateway, it runs on souls.

<Allari the Souleater grins as Sevis says this.>

passages.title: Enter the Illidari: Coilskar
passages.text:
Grim business, but we've all sacrificed just about everything to get to where we are.

We will do ANYTHING it takes to defeat the Burning Legion. Anything.

passages.title: Call of the Marksman
passages.text:
Time is of the essence! If Alleria and Thas'dorah are in Legion hands, it is only a matter of time until both are forfeit.

If you are ready, head to the Broken Shore to meet with Ranger-General Windrunner.

She has lent her personal hippogryph to fly you down to the surface.

passages.title: Call of the Marksman
passages.text:
The Farstriders have been interrogating captured demons.

One of the vile creatures claims to know the whereabouts of someone... crucial to our cause.

passages.title: A Desperate Journey
passages.text:
The city's entrances are under heavy guard. He must have another way.

Thanks to this wine I am strong enough to make the journey to him. I fear that I will not be able to defend or run if I come under attack.

You will accompany me, <race>. You and this Astoril are my only chance at surviving now. 

I remember when I was leaving the city that there were lamps guiding me here. We should be able to retrace our steps by following them.

passages.title: A Desperate Journey
passages.text: I was worried something had happened to you in the forest. I am glad that I was wrong.

passages.title: A Desperate Journey
passages.text:
Excellent. Your part here is done.

Rest assured knowing that you have done me a great service.

Here, take this payment. It is a small token for your service.

passages.title: Ulthalesh, the Deadwind Harvester
passages.text:
The book says the Dark Riders were last seen in a place called Manor Mistmantle. If friend can find these riders, then <he/she> can get Ulthalesh!

Calydus will wait here and await your return. Find Ulthalesh, friend!

passages.title: Ulthalesh, the Deadwind Harvester
passages.text: And just why should I help you, <class>?

passages.title: Ulthalesh, the Deadwind Harvester
passages.text:
I am left with little choice. I cannot face another Dark Rider ambush alone, and you are obviously formidable.

I will help you find the weapon you seek, but only if you will allow me to return the others in their possession to their rightful place.

Do we have a deal, <class>?

passages.title: REUSEME_40501
passages.text:
If Garona's intelligence is correct, Gul'dan will be inside this Iron Horde compound. With Garona's help, slip inside, gather any info you find, and learn what Gul'dan intends to do.

The guards are on high alert. Garona can "liquidate" individual guards for you, but she must not be seen! You will have to choose your targets carefully and pick your way through the bastion undetected. Don't let anyone sound the alarm.

If things get too hot, I'll teleport you to safety. At least... I'll try.

passages.title: The Battle for Broken Shore
passages.text:
Your warship awaits at the end of the dock, <name>. May your weapon bring you many kills today.

The Warchief has already made landfall, I will wager you will simply need to follow the trail of demon blood.

passages.title: The Battle for Broken Shore
passages.text: Glad to see you back on your feet, <name>. Many good soldiers who sailed for the Broken Shore were not so fortunate.

passages.title: To See the Past
passages.text:
I would like for you to experience firsthand what Huln Highmountain was able to accomplish in a single battle during the War of the Ancients.

To do so, I will need very specific ingredients. They are not too difficult to obtain--you can find all of them near Thunder Totem.

passages.title: To See the Past
passages.text: Earth, air, and water are all magics we have come to know well in our mountain.

passages.title: To See the Past
passages.text: Ah, these will be perfect for what is in store.

passages.title: Facet-nating Friends
passages.text:
Excuse me, <sir/madam>. Are you sure you're in the correct shop? We only deal in the finest of jewels here.

Ahh, I see... you're a fellow lapidary. Then perhaps we can work together.

Introduce yourself to my associates, so they're aware of who you are and what you may have to offer.

passages.title: Facet-nating Friends
passages.text: Get yourself acquainted and we'll discuss business.

passages.title: Facet-nating Friends
passages.text:
As for myself, I'm the proprietor of this establishment. If you have any questions concerning our shop, please direct them to me.

Now, onto business.

passages.title: Truly Outrageous
passages.text:
Ore prospecting is our primary method of gem acquisition. And while prospecting... you're bound to find small, unusable gem chips.

Many gem shops simply discard the small gem chips they find, but we here at Cartier & Co. let nothing go to waste.

passages.title: Truly Outrageous
passages.text: Try not to get any blood on them while you're out "adventuring".

passages.title: Truly Outrageous
passages.text:
<Tiffany looks over the gem chips.>

Yes, I suppose these will do.

Quite different from the ones I'm used to working with, but then again, we're not exactly in Northrend anymore.

Here's a design for one of the newer jewels with which I've been working. I call it a Versatile Skystone.

passages.title: Bruls Before Jewels
passages.text:
So, you wish to learn what Jabrul knows about jewels?

Well, Jabrul needs your help. Before we leave this place, Jabrul still needs harpy necklaces.

Keep those harpies off of Jabrul while he takes their necklaces and Jabrul will reward you with his knowledge.

passages.title: Bruls Before Jewels
passages.text:
It feels good to be out of there. As promised, Jabrul will share with you some of his knowledge.

What is it you're most interested in learning about?

passages.title: Aww Scrap!
passages.text:
It's a catastrophe! No, even worse, a conspiracy!

I heard the Legion was back again, and I thought to myself, "Hobart, now's your time to shine."

I made us enough guns to blow those demons back to the beginning of time!

But then we get here, and what happens? Everyone just happens to "find" all these ancient artifacts to fight the demons with!

Long story short, I have too many guns and need to get rid of 'em.

passages.title: Aww Scrap!
passages.text:
Now that's quite the haul of guns! I suppose these fell off the back of a gryphon, right?

<Filgo gives you a sly wink.>

passages.title: Socket to Me
passages.text:
You admire the contraption sitting on the counter. There's a button on it, but pressing it seems to warrant no response.

Tiffany tells you that it's an old toy box, but the crystal components are all broken.

If you were to find new ones, she could repair it and teach you how to make one for yourself.

passages.title: Socket to Me
passages.text: You're going to have to travel all over the world for these, I hope you're up to the challenge.

passages.title: Socket to Me
passages.text:
<Tiffany holds up the box and explains how she fixed it.>

Now if you ever need to make one for yourself, you should have no problem.

passages.title: Black Rook Hold: The Raven's Wisdom
passages.text:
<name>, I've been hearing a lot of talk about Black Rook Hold from our friend here, about a room which contains volumes of texts on just about every type of craft there is.

I'm willing to bet there's a book in there on jewelcrafting that could come in handy for us.

Go there and bring me back anything you find. I'll share a sweet new design I came up with you when you return.

passages.title: Black Rook Hold: The Raven's Wisdom
passages.text: A book, you'll find, is a design for the mind!

passages.title: Black Rook Hold: The Raven's Wisdom
passages.text:
<Timothy thumbs through the pages.>

What a rare find, <name>. Excellent work on finding this.

As promised, here's a new design I've been holding on to.

passages.title: Maw of Souls: Spiriting Away
passages.text:
What I'm about to ask you to do is no easy task, <name>.

I need you to die. But, you'll be able to come back of course! 

There's a ship, the Naglfar, that ferries souls from this world to the next. It's said that an ancient treasure called the Ring of the Fallen rests in the bowels of that ship.

You know me, <name>, and nothing catches my interest more than a sweet looking ring.

Find a way onto that boat and bring me back that ancient treasure.

passages.title: Maw of Souls: Spiriting Away
passages.text: The goddess that rules that world won't let you leave without a fight. Be careful in there, <name>.

passages.title: Maw of Souls: Spiriting Away
passages.text:
You found it?! And you made it back!

<name>, I came up with a line just for this occasion and just for you.

He laughs at death, he shrugs off the pain, but <name> comes back again and again!

passages.title: Halls of Valor: Jewel of the Heavens
passages.text:
Queens and kings wear the best rings! And I've heard that a certain king of gods has made his presence available.

In the Halls of Valor, the ruler Odyn has treasures unlike anyone in existence. If you happen to go there, try and... obtain, let's say, one of his rings for me.

I doubt he'll just hand it over, so you may have the fight of a lifetime in store.

passages.title: Halls of Valor: Jewel of the Heavens
passages.text: This will easily be the finest piece in my collection.

passages.title: Halls of Valor: Jewel of the Heavens
passages.text:
Now that's a ring! How amazing would it be to sit alongside the jewelcrafters of the heavens.

A find as grand as this deserves an equally grand reward. Here's one of my latest ring designs, I hope it servers you well, <name>.

passages.title: A Personal Touch
passages.text:
<name>, great to see you again. It feels like forever since last we spoke.

We've received some information about a group of jewelcrafting nightborne in Suramar that are doing fantastic things with necklaces. I'd like to take a look at some of their gems.

And their designs.

And... a new loupe might be nice, too. I hear the city inspectors carry them.

passages.title: A Personal Touch
passages.text:
Oh, how did I know about the nightborne gems? Well, that's a trade secret.

<Sminx gives you a quick wink.>

passages.title: A Personal Touch
passages.text:
The elves always make the best quality items. I'll hang onto these gems, if you don't mind.

This jewelry design, on the other hand... it'd be perfect for a jewelcrafting <class> like you!

passages.title: Following the Curse
passages.text:
Very well. I suppose an introduction is in order. I am Revil Kost, priest of the Light and a seeker of lost artifacts. I've dealt with the Dark Riders before, and have returned to rid this place of them.

The Riders are elusive, but I may have a clue to their whereabouts. In our previous confrontation, I was able to see a glimpse into their past. Granted blessed vision by the Cloak of Purity, I saw the Dark Riders for who they were before.

Come with me to Ariden's camp. I will explain on the way.

passages.title: Following the Curse
passages.text:
It's strange that the Dark Riders haven't followed us here, but I will take whatever boon I can get.

I believe the key to finding the Dark Riders is here somewhere. Let us begin our search.

passages.title: Demons Among Us
passages.text:
The king is wise to focus on the Legion's threat, <name>. Even now, the demons move against us.

The Illidari will aid the cause of the Alliance. We believe they have set their sights on key locations around Azeroth. In fact, they could already be in your midst!

I sense they are close...

passages.title: Demons Among Us
passages.text: I never suspected they had infiltrated my own throne room! Praise the Light you were here!

passages.title: Demons Among Us
passages.text:
This attack... even the battle on the Broken Shore... it's only the beginning of the Legion's campaign.

If we don't find a way to stop them, we're going to lose everything my father and the other leaders built.

We need the strength of the Illidari behind us.

passages.title: Disturbing the Past
passages.text:
This place is where the merchant, Ariden, set up camp while he was trying to ply his dubious wares to the sorcerer Medivh. It has remained strangely untouched for all this time, which leads me to believe it may still have a connection to its former owner.

Help me search the camp. Let's see if we can find something to lead us to the Dark Riders.

passages.title: Disturbing the Past
passages.text:
Otherwise an ordinary looking journal, this book hums with dark energy as you approach it.

A quick scan of the writing reveals this as the journal of Ariden, and chronicles his time in Deadwind Pass. Toward the end of the journal, the writing begins to change, and the tone becomes noticeably darker. It constantly refers to "the curse" and of the endless desire to possess things of great power.

One such entry catches your eye as you glance through.

passages.title: Keep Your Friends Close
passages.text:
The Legion is bold indeed to strike at the Horde's stronghold! You aided our defense, but now I have a more important task for you.

It seems the demon hunters will play a crucial part in this war... but I still don't trust them. You will be my envoy to the Illidari. Learn what they know. Study their techniques. If they betray us, we'll use their own knowledge against them.

Their camp lies atop the plateau in the city. Go. Nathanos and I will clean up this mess.

passages.title: Keep Your Friends Close
passages.text:
Ah, so you're the vaunted <class> I've heard about. Good.

We shall see if your reputation holds true.

passages.title: Demons Among Us
passages.text:
Look around. What do you see?

<Allari glares at something over your shoulder.>

The Legion has already infiltrated the Horde... even now, they are among you.

We must protect your Warchief.

When you are ready to see what lies beneath the veil, say the word.

passages.title: Demons Among Us
passages.text: The Illidari were right! Destroy the demons, <name>!

passages.title: Demons Among Us
passages.text:
It would seem the demon hunters' concerns were well-founded. To think the demons would dare worm their way into our city during this period of mourning!

This does not bode well for the rest of my kingdom.

passages.title: The Mark
passages.text:
Your blade is powerful, but it has not yet met its full potential. The all-powerful Odyn in the Halls of Valor can bestow upon you his strength.

In order to seek this blessing, you must bring him a worthy tribute. I know where you may obtain such a gift, but in order to retrieve it you must first receive the mark of the Valkyra.

Prove yourself worthy of our mark, champion, then you may enter the Vault of Eyir- the goddess will guide you from there.

passages.title: The Mark
passages.text: Greetings, champion. How go your trials?

passages.title: The Mark
passages.text:
<Ashildir nods knowingly.>

You are ready for the next step.

passages.title: The Fate of Deadwind
passages.text:
The journal mentions a "stronger pull" for the compass. If the spirits of this place are indeed tied to it, they may serve as the pull we need.

I've come upon several locations in the pass where restless spirits tend to appear. Perhaps if you show the spirits there the compass, they may be able to help point it in the right direction.

You seek these locations out. I'll continue on to Karazhan and see if I can find anything leading to the Dark Riders.

passages.title: The Fate of Deadwind
passages.text:
It looks like it worked, and the compass is pointing toward the river. 

Could it be..?

passages.title: Maw of Souls: Retrieving the Svalnguard
passages.text:
The Svalnguard was once Odyn's shield; it is said that it hid the Halls of Valor from the endless darkness below his realm.

Helya, who was cast from the shining halls long ago, stole The Svalnguard and keeps it on her accursed ship, the Naglfar.

You must board the Naglfar, defeat Helya, and retrieve The Svalnguard - it will make a worthy tribute for Odyn.

passages.title: Maw of Souls: Retrieving the Svalnguard
passages.text: Have you wrested the Svalnguard from Helya's clutches?

passages.title: Maw of Souls: Retrieving the Svalnguard
passages.text: There is one last task before you journey to the Halls, <name>.

passages.title: A Feast Fit for Odyn
passages.text:
It is customary in the Halls of Valor to feast after battle is finished. Presenting a truly glorious feast to Odyn from beasts worthy of his throne will show him your determination to earn his blessing.

Acquire flank meat from Thunderhoof in Stormheim, Spinesever's spine in Highmountain, and the finest cut of steak from Leytusk in Azsuna. They will make a feast worthy of the great battle to come.

passages.title: A Feast Fit for Odyn
passages.text: The beasts you hunt have taken the lives of many.

passages.title: A Feast Fit for Odyn
passages.text: My guards will prepare the feast. We must discuss your journey to the Halls.

passages.title: Halls of Valor: Odyn's Blessing
passages.text:
You are ready, <class>.

Travel to Odyn's shining halls and offer the feast on the altar just inside. Mighty Odyn will then set his gaze upon you - you must pass the ancient trials of the Valarjar under his watch.

Only then will you receive Odyn's blessing.

passages.title: Halls of Valor: Odyn's Blessing
passages.text: Few have sought Odyn's blessing and returned triumphant.

passages.title: Halls of Valor: Odyn's Blessing
passages.text: I can feel Odyn's power from here - the Legion's magic will no longer stop you.

passages.title: The Dark Riders
passages.text:
There's a sewer grate along the edge of the river leading to catacombs underneath Karazhan. I've never paid it much attention, but it could be where the spirits are directing us.

To think, the Dark Riders may have been under our noses this entire time! Come, let us see where this leads.

passages.title: The Dark Riders
passages.text: Did you find what you seek, <class>?

passages.title: The Dark Riders
passages.text:
Today was a great blow against the Dark Riders, and a victory for the people of Duskwood. 

They are in your debt, as am I.

passages.title: The Road to Fel
passages.text:
An early step to understanding how magic works is to understand and study materials made using that magic. That was how I made my breakthrough on warlock soul crystals, after all. 

The wyrmtongue minions in this pit hammer plates into their structures for support and maintenance. Those will be a good starting point. Fetch me some, my faithful assistant!

passages.title: The Road to Fel
passages.text: I can practically feel the buildings hum with power.

passages.title: The Road to Fel
passages.text: Excellent. By studying these materials I can better understand how they imbue magic into their machinery and architecture.

passages.title: Protect the Home Front
passages.text:
The Legion hasn't just invaded this city. Their evil is spreading across Azeroth, threatening the far corners of our world.

We must seek them out and stop them, everywhere their darkness touches.

We've dispatched scouts around the world to watch for Legion activity. As invasions arise, we'll mark the locations on your map.

Make them suffer, <name>!

passages.title: Protect the Home Front
passages.text: Find them! Stop them! Suffer well!

passages.title: Protect the Home Front
passages.text:
You've done it! You've broken an invasion!

If only that had ended our campaign. But the Legion will never relent until they are destroyed... or have destroyed us.

Don't let up! Fight off more of these wretched invasions, <name>. The wyrmtongue we're holding captive here will reward your efforts.

passages.title: Eye of Azshara: The Heart of Zin-Azshari
passages.text:
The naga in the Eye of Azshara summon terrible storms that ravage the coastline of Azsuna - storms far beyond the abilities of even their best sirens.

It can only be the Heart of Zin-Azshari.

Prior to the Sundering, Azshara's chosen used the Heart to greatly magnify their power - it is said to have been key in their dominance of the Well of Eternity.

If you can journey to their domain and retrieve it, <name>, we will put its power to far better use than those foul creatures.

passages.title: Eye of Azshara: The Heart of Zin-Azshari
passages.text: Have you retrieved the Heart?

passages.title: Eye of Azshara: The Heart of Zin-Azshari
passages.text: The Heart will require a great deal of work to properly hone the destructive energies within its depths, but I have faith that you will prevail.

passages.title: Neltharion's Lair: Presentation is Key
passages.text:
Odyn will demand a feast worthy of the ancient trials you must complete; a feast's merit begins not at the great beasts piled upon it, but at the dish used to serve it.

Deep beneath Highmountain lies the former lair of Neltharion - you may know the infernal drake better as Deathwing. You will find remnants of the adamantium plating used to hold his molten skin together in the deepest recesses of his lair.

They will form a fine dish for the feast.

passages.title: Neltharion's Lair: Presentation is Key
passages.text: Dare not serve Odyn a feast upon an improper dish. Such action will only earn his ire.

passages.title: Neltharion's Lair: Presentation is Key
passages.text: These will make a worthy vessel indeed.

passages.title: The Arcway: Rite of the Captain
passages.text:
Only a captain of the Guard may receive the power of our order - our ancient laws forbid otherwise.

You must complete the rite of the captain.

Traditionally, aspirants patrol the Arcway for three weeks without rest, the vast labyrinth putting their skills as a Guard to the test. Our laws must still be honored, but I believe there another way you may prove yourself.

Elisandre's advisor, Vandros, has recently descended into the Arcway's depths. Kill him, and take his Eon Winder.

passages.title: The Arcway: Rite of the Captain
passages.text: Have you completed the rites as asked?

passages.title: The Arcway: Rite of the Captain
passages.text: Well done. The Eon Winder will help us control the delicate magics at play within the Heart.

passages.title: Twisted Power
passages.text:
It is time we put our work to the test by infusing the most potent source of power I know of - fel magic.

Rarely, the Legion's minions will carry fragments of the greater portal stones used to usher in their eredar masters. If you gather enough to form a complete stone, you can use it in Faronaar to call forth the eredar lord Vizuul the Twisted at the Altar of End Times.

The bindings Vizuul wears to augment his power should push the Heart to its very limit.

passages.title: Twisted Power
passages.text: Do you have the bindings?

passages.title: Twisted Power
passages.text: Now, let's see what happens if we use the Heart to drain the power from them.

passages.title: One Small Step for Magic
passages.text:
It is time to embrace the future.

I have mastered every magic known to our kind. I will master this one.

By applying the principles of arcane magic it is fairly trivial to control the primitive fel energies within the material you have given me. I need to move to live prey next.

Let us start with a small summoning. Defeat the creature for me and watch how a true scholar works!

passages.title: One Small Step for Magic
passages.text: Ahh, this is a most interesting observation.

passages.title: One Small Step for Magic
passages.text:
Yes...

This power is... different. Brutal, blunt, powerful.

I can control it. I can master it!

passages.title: Blade in Twilight
passages.text:
I have been working with Moira Thaurissan to infiltrate the Twilight's Hammer cult. We've learned of an ancient and powerful Old God relic, a blade used at various points in history to wreak havoc.

Moira's double agent informs us a new leader is rising, and plans to cement his ascension using this weapon in an unholy ritual. You must find him, stop the ritual, and seize the artifact.

We will meet in Dalaran afterwards.

passages.title: Blade in Twilight
passages.text: Not too difficult a task, I hope!

passages.title: Blade in Twilight
passages.text:
You have demonstrated no small amount of skill in these sorts of tasks.

That is good, for we will require even more of you if we are to survive this conflict.

passages.title: The Sixth
passages.text:
Greetings, warlock. I speak on behalf of the Council of the Black Harvest.

With the Legion invasion upon us, it is painfully clear that our only hope is to grow stronger. The council plans to tap into the Twisting Nether and call forth more powerful demon allies. The ritual is ready, but we are short one number.

No doubt you have heard of the fate that befell Kanrethad Ebonlocke.

You will be his replacement. Do you accept?

passages.title: The Sixth
passages.text:
You have made the right decision.

Let us hope you live up to your reputation.

passages.title: Calling of the Council
passages.text:
<The arcane anomaly turns to address you, speaking in what is clearly Khadgar's voice.>

Though I am loathe to interrupt your fight against the Legion, I must request your help in a matter of... diplomacy. We face a grave threat, and we must be at our full strength to overcome it.

Some will not agree with this position.

Please join me outside the Violet Citadel in Dalaran. We have repositioned the city to defend the Eastern Kingdoms. You'll find it over Deadwind Pass, above Karazhan.

passages.title: Calling of the Council
passages.text:
Jaina's reaction was unfortunate, but not unexpected. She has endured so much...

Though it was Garrosh Hellscream who ordered the obliteration of Theramore, she blames all the Horde for her loss. I hope one day she can overcome that hatred.

Enough ruminating. We must prepare the Kirin Tor for war.

passages.title: The New Blood
passages.text:
It is time to begin the ritual, warlock. Be prepared, for the summoning we perform today will be more challenging than any you have known or seen before.

Are you ready?

passages.title: The New Blood
passages.text:
Calydus sorry we not save your friends, but maybe they survive if we hurry.

Jagganoth torture them, yes, but he likes to keep victims alive... mostly.

passages.title: The Heart of the Dreadscar
passages.text:
Friend has the artifact! Now Jagganoth does not stand a chance!

Quickly, you must go back to Dreadscar Rift! You may still be able to save your friends from Jagganoth's vengeance.

If you take the heart of the overlord, his army will be yours to command!

passages.title: The Heart of the Dreadscar
passages.text:
The cruel Jagganoth is defeated!

Friend is the new Overlord of the Dreadscar! 

This place will be friend's new home. With the Dreadscar under your control, you can come and go as you please!

passages.title: The Dead and the Damned
passages.text:
<A powerful mind again touches your thoughts.>

Gorelix the Fleshripper is a monstrous demon. The butcher of a thousand worlds, he has exterminated countless races with his axe, the Maw of the Damned.

A group of Ebon Blade was dispatched to slay him but they have gone missing. You will succeed where they failed.

You will not be alone in this, I've sent Baron Sliver ahead to assist you.

Go, obtain the Maw of the Damned and ensure that Gorelix is no more.

passages.title: The Dead and the Damned
passages.text: It is time to begin, <name>.

passages.title: The Dead and the Damned
passages.text:
That axe makes me feel uneasy, <name>. Its power is undeniable, but its very essence embodies the eternal hunger.

We will use it because we must do whatever it takes to win this war. Still, I'd be careful with that weapon if I were you.

passages.title: Shift Change
passages.text:
This is as good a chance as we are going to get to rescue Verene's daughter.

Here is how this is going to work. 

You are going to wait here for the guard to pass by on their way to their guard shift. Look for something to hide in.

<Silgryn marks a spot on your map.>

You will know the guard by their bright red armor.

Follow closely, but not so closely that you are seen. It may be necessary to kill the guard when you reach your destination.

The child's name is Korine. Good luck.

passages.title: Shift Change
passages.text: W-who are you?

passages.title: Shift Change
passages.text: I-I thought... they were gonna... *sniff*

passages.title: The Delicate Art of Telemancy
passages.text:
I hadn't the time to gather my instruments before fleeing the palace. I came here to salvage some equipment.

This old workshop is actually several rooms connected by teleporter pads.

Elisande's goons are already scouring the place looking for me, but from here I can alter the teleporter network and keep them moving in circles.

You go in. I'll monitor your position and ensure the teleporters work normally for you.

Find these two parts and bring them back!

passages.title: The Delicate Art of Telemancy
passages.text: Salvaging the equipment here is necessary if I am to develop a teleporter network for Thalyssra.

passages.title: The Delicate Art of Telemancy
passages.text: These are in rough shape, but they will suffice.

passages.title: Hiding in the Stacks
passages.text:
Magni's information was enlightening. It should prove handy to have a friend who has the ear of a titan.

It's time to head into Karazhan. Not that I need to remind you, but it can be a dangerous place. There are countless strata of spells woven throughout the tower, and the interactions of the forces within can be... unpredictable. Be on your guard.

I'll join you inside. I need a moment to... gather my thoughts. This place holds a lot of memories for me.

passages.title: Hiding in the Stacks
passages.text: Do you have something for me?

passages.title: Hiding in the Stacks
passages.text:
Not long after you left, the first wave of demons struck. We're holding them at bay... for now.

I'll keep this tome safe until we have a chance to study it.

Good work in there. I should like to delve into the libraries of Karazhan myself one day. At least... I think I would.

passages.title: Blackroot Idols
passages.text:
The Blackroot are lead by Chieftain Narla.
I fear that her mind has become twisted beyond reason.

I attempted to make peace with the Blackroot, but I quickly retreated when Drawzle Keen Eye let loose a volley of arrows. I was fortunate enough to escape unharmed.

This tribe is lost and Narla and Drawzle must be dispatched before the Blackroot spread like a blight. Return their weapons to me as proof of their demise.

passages.title: Vittles and Bits
passages.text:
I used to travel the world until I fell in with this lot of incompetent hunters. When I found them, they were practically starving to death.

I cooked one meal for them, and somehow became their camp cook.

If you're going out into the wild, bring me back some animal parts that I can cook up for this lot.

passages.title: A Foe of the Dark
passages.text:
I cannot believe the Dark Riders found us here. Long have they hunted the scythe to sate their lust for the artifacts of Azeroth. We thought we would be protected within the grove...

And now, Valorn is gone...

You must become the hunter, <name>. Seek the Dark Riders and recover the scythe. We last encountered them near Manor Mistmantle in Duskwood. Start your search there.

And <name>... bring justice to Valorn. The rider must pay.

passages.title: A Foe of the Dark
passages.text:
So I was correct, and the Scythe is your quarry.  Know that in order to retrieve it, we must do what no denizen of Duskwood has ever attempted.

We must hunt the Dark Riders.

I have been tracking them for some time since my encounter with them while hunting down the Wolf Cult.  They are a blight upon these lands, and they hold no right to the artifacts they hoard.

If we wish to recover this artifact, we will need to find their lair. Fortunately, I may just have the clue we need.

passages.title: The Smoldering Ember
passages.text: Cold to the touch when you first reach for it, this ember bursts into flame without warning and snuffs itself just as quickly. As the stone rests in your hand, visions of fire and of dragons dance through your mind, but you can hear conversation taking place in Orgrimmar and the familiar sight of circle portals bubbles to the top.

passages.title: The Smoldering Ember
passages.text:
Yes, another one of these pesky artifacts. The meddling in the timestreams has grown worse of late... or is it that it will grow worse?

<She sighs heavily.>

passages.title: The Smoldering Ember
passages.text: Cold to the touch when you first reach for it, this ember bursts into flame without warning and snuffs itself just as quickly. As the stone rests in your hand, visions of fire and of dragons dance through your mind, but you can hear the hustle and bustle of Stormwind and the familiar sight of circle portals bubbles to the top.

passages.title: The Smoldering Ember
passages.text:
Yes, another one of these pesky artifacts. The meddling in the timestreams has grown worse of late... or is it that it will grow worse?

<She sighs heavily.>

passages.title: Fate of the Queen's Reprisal
passages.text: <This is the kind of intelligence that should be shared. Perhaps someone at the Greyfang Enclave on Dalaran will know what to do with it.>

passages.title: Fate of the Queen's Reprisal
passages.text:
<The officer looks down at what you're offering him and his eyes light up.>

Do you know what you have here? You might have just delivered some of the most significant intel of the campaign.

I will see to it personally that this gets into Lord Greymane's hands.

passages.title: Following the Curse
passages.text:
In my previous confrontation with your foe, I was able to see a glimpse into their past. Granted blessed vision by the Cloak of Purity, I saw the Dark Riders for who they once were.

Come, we must go to Ariden's Camp in Deadwind Pass. I can explain its significance along the way.

passages.title: Following the Curse
passages.text:
It's strange that the Dark Riders haven't followed us here, but I will take whatever boon I can get.

I believe the key to finding the Dark Riders is here somewhere. Let us begin our search.

passages.title: Disturbing the Past
passages.text:
This place is where the merchant, Ariden, set up camp while he was trying to ply his dubious wares to the sorcerer Medivh. It has remained strangely untouched for all this time, which leads me to believe it may still have a connection to its former owner.

Help me search the camp. Let's see if we can find something to lead us to the Dark Riders.

passages.title: Disturbing the Past
passages.text:
Dark energy hums from the journal, which appears to be the writings of Ariden, and chronicles his time in Deadwind Pass. One entry in particular stands out:

"The Nightbane have become restless of late, and whispers are abound of the Scythe of Elune having left Darnassus. It must be coming nearer, for the worgen are constantly drawn to it. They will lead me to it.

Those cursed night elves think the weapon is safe in their care. They will soon find how wrong they are"

passages.title: Always the Last Thing
passages.text:
Well, I've worked out all the kinks. Added a few nuts and bolts, and fitted a new housing for the power core.

Problem is, none of the batteries I have here seem to work. I think we're gonna have to fashion somethin' new together.

I'm gonna need your help, <name>. Let's start by trying a charged gem from the jewelcrafting shop down the way.

passages.title: Always the Last Thing
passages.text: Hopefully it's not too much trouble finding a suitable power source.

passages.title: Always the Last Thing
passages.text:
We did it! That's one fully functional, killer-lookin' fel reaver.

Should it ever run out of power, here's the schematic for that battery I came up with.

Just pop a new one in it and you should be good to go.

By the way, whatcha think we should name it? I was thinking somethin' deadly, like "Reaves."

passages.title: Modular Modifications
passages.text:
Now that we got this baby running, let's give it some cool abilities.

When I was fixing Reaves up, I installed a module port onto his motherboard. This will allow us to upload anything we want.

I'll teach you one of my module designs and you install it on Reaves.

passages.title: Modular Modifications
passages.text: I have a lot of other ideas for things we can do, but I only wrote down a couple to start.

passages.title: Modular Modifications
passages.text:
Everything appears to be running as expected. Although to be honest, I half expected an explosion to go along with it.

Here's the other schematic I made for Reaves. It's based off the auto-hammer design I gave you earlier.

passages.title: The Shell, You Say?
passages.text:
I know ol' Hobart sent me down 'ere to acquire 'is precious murloc glass thingies, but I have designs of me own!

I've seen those murlocs carrying interesting lookin' shells that would go perfectly into me music box I've been workin on.

Ya lead the charge an'a I'll be right behind ya.

passages.title: The Shell, You Say?
passages.text: Jes let me finish up 'ere and I'll be right with yeh.

passages.title: The Shell, You Say?
passages.text:
Oh, yer finished! I swear I was jes' about ta join yeh, too.

Well, what's done is done. I s'pose I can share me design with yeh since yeh got all the shells fer me.

passages.title: Wibbly-Wobbly, Timey-Wimey
passages.text:
I gotta finish up 'ere, so why don'tcha take those trinkets back to Hobart fer me.

'Sides, I'ma thinkin' he likes ya more than me.

passages.title: Wibbly-Wobbly, Timey-Wimey
passages.text:
The pieces! Well it's about time.

<Hobart moves over to a machine and begins inserting the items you gave him.>

I take it Flintlocke made you deliver these? Well since you did the legwork, you can have a copy of my design.

It's a new type of wormhole generator. Specifically designed for getting around Dalaran in the blink of an eye!

passages.title: Fire and Forget
passages.text:
They say, "When life gives you lemons, make lemonade." Well, life gave me a butt-load of guns.

So I've been figuring out ways to turn these guns into useful tools.

My latest modification is a gun that shoots bandages! Imagine it, you're on the battlefield, you see your ally go down, you pull out your bandage gun, shoot him with it and bam, he's back in the fight!

I just need you to test it first and make sure it's safe.

passages.title: Fire and Forget
passages.text:
Good job on calibrating the power. Shame about those first few though...

I've adjusted the numbers on the schematic to the new specifications so you should be able to make the safe version.

passages.title: Here Comes the BOOM!
passages.text:
<name>, they stole all my fireworks, the little scamps.

You didn't see them? I was just on the verge of creating a new module for Reaves when these kids came in here and ran off with my fireworks.

I need them back if I'm going to finish what I'm working on. Can you go get them back for me?

passages.title: Here Comes the BOOM!
passages.text: If I ever get my hands on those kids...

passages.title: Here Comes the BOOM!
passages.text:
<Didi takes the fireworks from you and continues to work at her bench.>

There we go. All done!

Apply this to your bot, and you should be able to launch fireworks wherever you want! ALL explosions are beautiful in their own way... but fireworks really are something else.

passages.title: Going Out With a Bang
passages.text:
While I was, eh, testin' out this new flight pack fer Hobart, it sorta exploded an' sent me flyin' back over 'ere.

You can see all the pieces out there in tha water.

Now, I've got these boots 'ere that Hobart gave me to test out too, but they're not quite me size.

I figure we could kill two birds with one stone and 'ave ye test 'em out while pickin' up the broken bits of the pack.

Mind tha sharks while yer out there.

passages.title: Going Out With a Bang
passages.text:
Ah terrific! Nice work gettin' them parts back. I thought I was gonna have ta drain the bay by blowin' up Warden's Isle over there.

Them boots seemed ta suit yeh - here's the schematic fer 'em if yeh need another pair.

passages.title: Going to Waste
passages.text:
Me wee rogue friend Lowping were
gnome-napped by them dirty naga when we got 'ere. He's gone! They drug him right oft toward tha cove!

But 'ere's tha real issue. He 'ad a schematic on 'im fer one of me greatest inventions.

And by "on 'im," I mean I tattooed it to tha top o' his head. FOR SAFETY!

When ye find 'im, jes shave 'is head and make a quick copy o' tha design.

passages.title: Going to Waste
passages.text: Poor lad's probably bein' tortured as we speak. Curse them scaley beasts!

passages.title: Going to Waste
passages.text:
Oh aye, yeh get me schematic! Here, keep a copy fer yerself, in case yer lookin' for somethin' to tattoo somewheres.

It's a damn shame about Lowping. Yeh know, come ta think of it, maybe we shoulda rescued him. Ah! Multi-tasking were never my thing.

passages.title: Assault on Violet Hold: Cheating Death
passages.text:
Hobart was showing me a copy of a design you found, and it got me to thinking of a new module for Reaves.

Unfortunately I didn't have the materials required to test it.

Could you make me a couple Failure Detection Pylons?

I'll also need a plasmatic laser bolt. You should be able to find one in the Violet Hold.

passages.title: Assault on Violet Hold: Cheating Death
passages.text: Just rip the bolt off of one of the prison cells. I'm sure whatever's inside has long since died.

passages.title: Assault on Violet Hold: Cheating Death
passages.text:
<Didi takes the pylons and begins tinkering with them and starts writing some notes.>

Yea, that should do the trick!

One new and improved Reaves module schematic for you, <name>.

passages.title: Oil Rags to Riches
passages.text:
Didi will be very interested in reading the journal you found as well as examining the circuit design.

You should return to her as soon as you can.

passages.title: Oil Rags to Riches
passages.text:
That circuit design was exactly what I needed to finish the Blingtron module for Reaves.

Now to reap the rewards, <name>!

passages.title: Court of Stars: Revamping the Recoil
passages.text:
<name>, you'll be very excited to hear that I've been working on a newer, better version of those goggles that Flintlocke rigged up.

The ones I've designed have double the power, but unfortunately they also have double the recoil. I'm afraid if you use them, they'll break your neck.

But I found a solution. Deep inside Suramar City lies a magical mechanism that will reduce the recoil to practically nothing.

Recover that mechanism for me and we're in business!

passages.title: Court of Stars: Revamping the Recoil
passages.text: Those elves probably had no idea the quantum mechanical applications that mechanism has!

passages.title: Court of Stars: Revamping the Recoil
passages.text:
<Hobart takes the mechanism from you and begins tinkering with his design.>

Yes, I believe that's it. Good work, <name>.

As per usual I'll let you have a copy of my schematic for your personal gain.

passages.title: Fate of the Guard
passages.text:
<Thalrenus looks you over.>

You are not one of them.

The Nightborne came to our gates hours after the shield over Suramar fell. We thought them friends, despite our long separation.

We were wrong.

They poured into our stronghold and began the slaughter. We were unprepared. Though we fought, we were beaten.

The keep is lost. Our leaders have perished and their corpses lay in the streets.

Find them, give them their final rites.

While you search, look for survivors. Help them if you can.

passages.title: Fate of the Guard
passages.text: Are you here to fight the Nightborne?

passages.title: Fate of the Guard
passages.text: I thought the Moon Guard could endure anything...

passages.title: The Tears of Elune
passages.text: The Tear of Elune floats effortlessly, glistening in an ethereal pillar of moonlight.

passages.title: The Tears of Elune
passages.text: <Archmage Khadgar has set aside a space here for the Tears of Elune, as well as the rest of the Pillars of Creation.>

passages.title: The Burden Borne
passages.text:
Your assistance against the Dark Riders has proven a great service to the Light. Though our beliefs may separate us, I know that we share one goal.

You have allowed me to fill my purpose in returning these artifacts to their rightful owners, and for this I am thankful. As for the Scythe of Elune, I can think of no safer place than in your care. 

May it serve you well against the Legion, <name>.

passages.title: The Burden Borne
passages.text:
The Scythe of Elune!

I never thought I would see that weapon used without turning its wielder into a savage beast, but you've brought balance to its primal nature.

Elune has certainly guided your hand, <name>. You've accomplished what no <class> has done before!

passages.title: Shadow of the Defiler
passages.text:
Crimson energy swirls within this disturbing object, which seems to have slightly different contours each time your gaze returns to it.

Its power is utterly foreign, unlike anything you have seen in Draenor or during your battles with the Legion. Perhaps the keepers of Moonglade, back on Azeroth, might have some insight into its nature.

passages.title: Shadow of the Defiler
passages.text: I have heard of your deeds beyond the red portal, <name>. Two worlds owe you and your companions a great debt. What brings you to the Moonglade?

passages.title: Shadow of the Defiler
passages.text: Where... where did you find this?

passages.title: Jandvik's Last Hope
passages.text:
Commander Malt'his was conferring with a sea giant?

Without your help, this village will surely fall to the combined forces of the Sashj'tar and the sea giants.

<Toryl stands there quietly for a moment.>

Meet me in an underground cave out in Azuregale Bay.

I want to show you something that may turn the tide in this battle.

passages.title: Jandvik's Last Hope
passages.text: I do not know who you are, but I must thank you.

passages.title: Apocalypse
passages.text:
<The Lich King's chill voice fills your mind once again>

There is an ancient blade, lost in the echoes of time, that has the power to bring my vengeance upon the Legion. 

It is known as Apocalypse.

I've sensed the blade in the possession of the Dark Riders of Deadwind Pass. Their magic conceals them from my sight but they cannot hide from the scourge! They were last seen by my agents near a place called Manor Mistmantle.

Go there, <name>. Defeat the Dark Riders, and claim the blade!

passages.title: Apocalypse
passages.text: And just why should I help you, <class>?

passages.title: Apocalypse
passages.text:
I am left with little choice. I cannot face another Dark Rider ambush alone, and you are obviously formidable.

I will help you find your artifact, but only if you will allow me to return the others in their possession to their rightful place.

Do we have a deal, <class>?

passages.title: Following the Curse
passages.text:
Very well. I suppose an introduction is in order. I am Revil Kost, priest of the Light and a seeker of lost artifacts. I've dealt with the Dark Riders before, and have returned to rid this place of them.

The Riders are elusive, but I may have a clue to their whereabouts. In our previous confrontation, I was able to see a glimpse into their past. Granted blessed vision by the Cloak of Purity, I saw the Dark Riders for who they were before.

Come with me to Ariden's camp. I will explain on the way.

passages.title: Following the Curse
passages.text:
As much as your company pains me, you are proving to be a powerful ally. 

I believe the key to finding the Dark Riders is here somewhere. It is strange that the riders haven't followed us here, but we should make haste lest they change their mind.

passages.title: Disturbing the Past
passages.text:
This place is where the merchant, Ariden, set up camp while he was trying to ply his dubious wares to the sorcerer Medivh. 

It has remained strangely untouched for all this time, which leads me to believe it may still have a connection to its former owner.

Help me search the camp. Let's see if we can find something to lead us to the Dark Riders.

passages.title: Disturbing the Past
passages.text:
Dark energy hums from the journal, which appears to be the writings of Ariden, and chronicles his time in Deadwind Pass. One entry in particular stands out:

"I hear the whispers. They call me from the wet soil of shallow graves, hearkening me to my legacy. 

"But what legacy? The merchant I once was had no special bloodline...

"Nevertheless, I am drawn to it. The dread blade... the world-ender... Apocalypse."

passages.title: A Grisly Task
passages.text:
Wet soil? Shallow graves?

I think the journal is referring to the gravesites off of the lake near Karazhan. Nobody knows who is buried there, but they may be the key to finding the Dark Riders.

You can... speak to the dead, yes?

passages.title: A Grisly Task
passages.text:
The chill down my spine tells me that you must have met with success.

What did you find?

passages.title: The Dark Riders
passages.text:
The catacombs? I've never heard of such a place. Unless, he means...

There's a sewer grate along the edge of the river leading to a catacombs underneath Karazhan. I've never paid it much attention, but it could lead to the catacombs that the spirit spoke of. 

To think, the Dark Riders may have been under our noses this entire time! Come, let us see where this leads.

passages.title: The Dark Riders
passages.text: Didyou find what you seek, <class>?

passages.title: The Dark Riders
passages.text:
Today was a great blow against the Dark Riders, and a victory for the people of Duskwood. 

They are in your debt, as am I.

passages.title: The Call of Vengeance
passages.text:
I was wrong about you, death knight. Your assistance against the Dark Riders has proven a great service to the Light. Perhaps I should not be so quick to judge.

Nevertheless, you have allowed me to fill my purpose in returning these artifacts to their rightful owners. As for Apocalypse, I can think of no safer place than in your care. 

May it serve you well against the Legion, death knight.

passages.title: The Call of Vengeance
passages.text:
The champion of the Lich King returns, and with a mighty weapon to bear against our demon foes!

May the Burning Legion tremble at the sight of our forces!

passages.title: Special Delivery
passages.text:
Verene's child has gone missing. I can guess what happened, but I need to be sure.

Most guardsmen use couriers to relay delicate information. In this, magic is strictly the province of high ranking officials.

Take this blade. Do not touch the cutting edge. Use it to silently waylay the couriers and collect any correspondence they carry.

With any luck, the missives will tell us exactly where to find the girl.

We guards know everything, after all.

<Silgryn offers you a winning smile.>

passages.title: Special Delivery
passages.text: Were you successful?

passages.title: Special Delivery
passages.text: Fine work. I will read these over.

passages.title: Honoring Success
passages.text:
All has gone as planned. Your new blades are a testament to that.

We will demand a great deal of you in the weeks and months to come, as we must. But we would be remiss if we failed to take a moment to celebrate a job well done.

What do you say?

passages.title: Honoring Success
passages.text: It's kill or be killed.

passages.title: Honoring Success
passages.text: It seems you struck a nerve.

passages.title: Hunter to Hunter
passages.text:
Now that you wield Thas'dorah, it's time to learn more about the night elf who set you on this journey

I suggest returning to the Hunter's Reach shop where you met my courier. Whoever this Emmarel Shadewarden is, it seems she has some part to play in the war against the Legion.

passages.title: Hunter to Hunter
passages.text: There is much to do, noble <class>. But first, I suppose you'll want to learn a little more about who I am and why I have sought you out.

passages.title: On Eagle's Wings
passages.text:
Since ancient times, my order has stood vigil on these Broken Isles, watching for the Legion's return. Only a handful of us remain... but that changes today.

The artifact you hold is more than a weapon. It is a symbol that will unite hunters of all kingdoms and creeds.

I'm sure you have questions. Meet me at the Trueshot Lodge in Highmountain and see with your own eyes what awaits us. Snowfeather and I will make our own way there.

passages.title: On Eagle's Wings
passages.text:
I've observed your skills for some time, <name>. Watched you from a distance.

Wait, that sounds a little creepy. Sorry, my social skills are a tad rusty. Let me start again.

Our order has been on the lookout for hunters who could lead the Unseen Path into a new era. No one is more qualified for that role than you.

passages.title: Oath of Service
passages.text:
Assembled before you are many of our world's greatest archers, rangers, beast masters, and trappers, ready to fight the Legion as one.

It is time to take your first step in becoming a true leader of hunters.

We gather at the fire pit and take our oaths of service before the statue of Ohn'ahra. Touch the statue and kneel before it while I recite the oath, and the Unseen Path will be reborn!

passages.title: Oath of Service
passages.text: Ohn'ahra has blessed our order!

passages.title: Oath of Service
passages.text:
Ohn'ahra has not appeared to us since the order's founding!

This is surely a sign that with you guiding us, the Unseen Path will triumph over the Legion!

passages.title: Tactical Matters
passages.text:
Now that your artifact is ready, it's time to plan your first strike against the Legion.

Speak to Tactician Tinderfell, our expert on such matters.

passages.title: Tactical Matters
passages.text: Hail, Pathfinder! It will be my honor to aid you in the fight against the Legion.

passages.title: The Campaign Begins
passages.text:
The Legion believes we are still reeling from our loss on the Broken Shore.

Let's prove them wrong.

Our scouts have mapped out the Broken Isles, learning everything we can about each region for our imminent assault.

Choose where to strike first, and you will lead the Unseen Path's efforts personally.

passages.title: The Campaign Begins
passages.text: Excellent choice. The campaign against the Legion has begun!

passages.title: Dark Waters
passages.text: Come with me to the edge of Elune'ara. Its crystal waters can wash away even the darkest shroud to reveal the truth within.

passages.title: Dark Waters
passages.text: Yes, <race>?

passages.title: Dark Waters
passages.text: Malfurion departed in a great hurry, but he bade me give you this before you left. Thank you for all you have done for Azeroth, and for all that you will do in time to come.

passages.title: Take Them in Claw
passages.text:
We should have seen this coming. My sister is dead, my friends are wounded and we will likely die here.

I want revenge.

<Lyrea hands you a vial full of growing green liquid.>

We cannot beat them, but we can turn the Stronghold against them.

Wild hippogryphs are attracted to the scent in this bottle. Wild hippogryphs are also notoriously violent when the object of their attraction is not a hippogryph.

Use it to clear a path deeper into the stronghold.

passages.title: Take Them in Claw
passages.text: I thought I was alone here. Are you here to continue the fight?

passages.title: Take Them in Claw
passages.text: I heard screams, and I was gratified that they belonged to the Nightborne. Well done.

passages.title: Lay Waste, Lay Mines
passages.text:
They ransacked my library, <name>.

If they want our knowledge, we will give it to them. 

This piece of rune work will allow you to cast an ensnaring spell on the ground. When the Nightborne cross the threshold they will see the true might of the Moon Guard.

Teach them well!

passages.title: Lay Waste, Lay Mines
passages.text: How fares the education?

passages.title: Lay Waste, Lay Mines
passages.text: A lesson we all must one day learn. Never assume your enemy dead until you see their corpse. <Lothrius grins.>

passages.title: Precious Little Left
passages.text:
I have not been able to leave the safety of my guardians to search, but there are three tomes of great importance to me and mine. 

They contain secrets and cantrips that the Nightborne must NOT obtain. 

<Lothrius raises his hand to your forehead, cementing the names of three tomes into your mind> 

If we cannot best them, we must preserve all we can. Hurry, <name>.

passages.title: Precious Little Left
passages.text: Did you locate them?

passages.title: Precious Little Left
passages.text: Thank the Mother Moon... They survived!

passages.title: The Orchestrator of Our Demise
passages.text:
Conjurer Thalerian must be stopped.

He immediately sought out my father's private study when he arrived and he has not yet emerged. I worry that he may have found a very dangerous item.

It is called the Astromancer's Keystone. It is used to manipulate the stronghold's defenses.

Such magic was meant to protect the Moon Guard- used for any other purpose and it becomes unspeakably destructive.

Retrieve the Keystone. Slay Conjurer Thalerian to get it, if you must.

passages.title: The Orchestrator of Our Demise
passages.text: Is it done?

passages.title: The Orchestrator of Our Demise
passages.text: They had no right to this power. Thank you.

passages.title: Overwhelming Distraction
passages.text:
Do you see the Nightborne outside this room?

They hold us here, like mice in a cage. It is more convenient for them that we are pinned down while they search the Sanctum for my father's relics.

My companions and I can escape to higher ground with some help.

Take this crystal. While standing on a mana focusing rune, use it to overcharge a Conjurer.

Their summons will turn on them and create an opening.

Use it well, and we will meet you atop the stronghold when the way is clear.

passages.title: Overwhelming Distraction
passages.text: We were able to make it here safely, thanks to you.

passages.title: Last Stand of the Moon Guard
passages.text:
This is all that remains of the Moon Guard.

Take a good look.

We are but a shadow of our former selves, and we have the Nightborne to thank for our demise.

For now there is nothing more we can do. If we want to live, we must leave immediately.

Retribution can wait.

passages.title: Last Stand of the Moon Guard
passages.text: I called them here. I will see that they are taken care of after the horrors my people put them through.

passages.title: Demons Among Them
passages.text:
It is just as we suspected, <name>! The demons thought they could take us by surprise.

Quickly, to arms! Protect the Banshee Queen!

passages.title: Demons Among Them
passages.text: This is what we were born for.

passages.title: Demons Among Them
passages.text:
Your warning just saved us from what might have been a catastrophic loss. Now we can unleash our vengeance upon this Legion filth.

You now have my attention, <class>... and perhaps a bit of appreciation as well.

passages.title: The Dark Riders
passages.text:
The catacombs? I've never heard of such a place. Unless, he means...

There's a sewer grate along the edge of the river leading to a catacombs underneath Karazhan. I've never paid it much attention, but it could lead to the catacombs that the spirit spoke of. 

To think, the Dark Riders may have been under our noses this entire time! Come, let us see where this leads.

passages.title: The Dark Riders
passages.text: Did you find what you seek, <class>?

passages.title: The Dark Riders
passages.text:
Though I'll admit I may not have been able to do this alone, I will not forget the transgressions that happened today.

You have what you came for, <class>. I think it is time you were on your way.

passages.title: The Call of Vengeance
passages.text:
Our goals have been met, death knight, and it is time we part ways. I think I will be glad to see the last of you.

Go on, return to your dark masters. We are done here.

passages.title: The Call of Vengeance
passages.text:
The champion of the Lich King returns, and with a mighty weapon to bear against our demon foes!

May the Burning Legion tremble at the sight of our forces!

passages.title: A Good Recipe List
passages.text:
I've tried adventuring, and it isn't for me. Cooking is my one true passion: the heat of the stove, the sizzle of bacon... nothing beats it.

Let me help you, Master <name>. If you can bring me some recipes, I can work on improving them, here in Dalaran.

We'll make a great team. What do you say?

passages.title: A Good Recipe List
passages.text: We need more recipes before we can do any meaningful work in this kitchen.

passages.title: A Good Recipe List
passages.text:
You are truly amazing, Master <name>.

Now, let's get to work, shall we?

passages.title: Injection of Power
passages.text:
Power, eh? You bet! I got just the thing!

We've managed to get our hands on a rare venom from an uncharted island deep in the south seas. We captured as much of it as we could.

I had my boys build a device that can inject the venom into weapons, but just in small quantities for now until we've got a better handle on its effects.

Anywho, we got it locked up in a secure area just over there. You're free to use it, Shadow <name>... for a price, of course!

passages.title: Injection of Power
passages.text: It's like my momma used to say - if you've got the coin, we've got a deal.

passages.title: Injection of Power
passages.text:
Hey, don't even mention it, pal. I'm here for ya any time you need anything!

Seriously though, don't mention it. There are some folks that would do anything to get their hands on this stuff.

passages.title: The Emperor's Gift
passages.text:
Ah, Sheilun, the legendary staff wielded by our last emperor. If the Legion were to acquire this weapon, they could unleash untold horrors across the whole of the continent. They must be stopped!

If you want to get to the Terrace as fast as possible, you should hitch a ride directly to the mainland. Tak-Tak, a hozen kite-master, is skulking around west of the temple. Speak to him without delay.

passages.title: The Emperor's Gift
passages.text: The Terrace of Eternal Spring is a very sacred place for mainland Pandaren. I hope you were able to preserve it from corruption. Enough of Pandaria was destroyed when Garrosh Hellscream turned it into a battlefield.

passages.title: The Emperor's Gift
passages.text:
Incredible. The very staff the Emperor used to cloak Pandaria in mists all those ages ago!

Treat that staff well, <name>. It will save your life. And probably the lives of all your friends, as well...

passages.title: Hunter to Hunter
passages.text:
Now that Titanstrike is yours, ye should learn more about the night elf who set us on this journey.

She might well be back at the Hunter's Reach shop where you met her. Whoever this Emmarel Shadewarden is, I'd bet me beard she has some part to play in the war against the Legion!

Thanks again fer the fun, <name>. If ye ever have need of me, just call!

passages.title: Hunter to Hunter
passages.text: There is much to do, noble <class>. But first, I suppose you'll want to learn a little more about who I am and why I have sought you out.

passages.title: Actions on Azeroth
passages.text:
Let me show you the Command Map. Thanks to some draenei construction and naaru magic we now have a window into the Broken Isles! You can devise strategy, send your agents on missions, and choose our first area to operate in.

Take a look and let me know where we are going!

passages.title: Actions on Azeroth
passages.text: An excellent choice! We will do our best to support your efforts on the Broken Isles.

passages.title: Power Grid
passages.text:
This station has fallen into disrepair. The circuit is broken, and to mend it we must recharge the seals in the central chamber.

Both a high potency current and low potency current are needed for each seal. Direct the currents to point at the same seal, then engage the seal.

Me? I shall supervise. You are the help, after all.

passages.title: Power Grid
passages.text: I must admit I am impressed. You may actually be of some use to us.

passages.title: For the People
Testing the Waters
passages.text:
There is no place that the Sashj'tar can hide from you now, <name>.

They will not be expecting a direct attack in their waters. This is a perfect opportunity to cut down their commanders.

Meet me in Jandvik after you have slaughtered them.

passages.title: Testing the Waters
passages.text:
There are sea giants in the bay!?

You must tell Toryl about this grave news right away.

passages.title: The Dreadlord's Prize
passages.text:
Kathra'natir escaped my grasp, but I know what his next step will be.

He seeks an ancient relic called the Forge of the Guardian, used for centuries by the Council of Tirisfal to infuse their power into the Guardian. The forge was hidden away, its location known only to the Council themselves.

Now the dreadlord has this knowledge.

We must go to the Violet Hold. I only hope we are not too late.

passages.title: The Dreadlord's Prize
passages.text: We must hurry!

passages.title: The Dreadlord's Prize
passages.text:
In times past, the Council of Tirisfal called upon the Tirisgarde, the protectors of Dalaran, to do battle in the Guardian's absence.

It is clear now that the hall of the Tirisgarde must be rebuilt to face this new threat.

I need your help to accomplish this. First of all, you'll need to know how to get to this hall. I will show you.

passages.title: Stolen Knowledge
passages.text:
Morjirn, the head brewer of the Tideskorn clan, has the Storm Brew recipe.

I have never been strong enough to assault his fortress alone, but together with you, I think we can claim retribution for my fallen master. I would like nothing better than to pry the recipe from Morjirn's cold, dead fingers.

While we are there, we will sample his Storm Brew. I'd like to see if his brewing skills are even near my master's.

passages.title: Stolen Knowledge
passages.text: Do you have the recipe?

passages.title: Stolen Knowledge
passages.text:
The last time I saw these notes, I was still a young child.

I understand much of what is written here now.

It won't be easy to acquire everything here, but I believe we can do it, <name>.

passages.title: The Forge of Guardians
passages.text:
First and foremost, the Forge of the Guardian must be protected. With Kathra'natir's knowledge, it will no longer be safe in Violet Hold.

Together, we should be able to transport it to a safer place. From there, our true challenge can begin.

passages.title: The Hunter's Gaze
passages.text:
<name>, before you lies your nether crucible - more powerful than any we've crafted before.

The souls of the hundreds of slain demons in Mardum have provided us with enough power to directly observe the Legion on Azeroth.

What we have uncovered so far has been... unsettling. Gaze into the pool and see for yourself.

passages.title: The Hunter's Gaze
passages.text: The Legion threat is more dire than we thought.

passages.title: The Hunter's Gaze
passages.text: We must not underestimate the Legion - I fear they are even more powerful than we realize.

passages.title: A Mage's Weapon
passages.text:
It is decided, then.

The foundation of the Tirisgarde's strength lies in the ancient artifacts wielded by its champions. Your first task will be to retrieve one such artifact.

The master appendix of this library lists every artifact known to the Council of Tirisfal. There should be a few choices in there worth looking into.

I will leave it to you to choose which to pursue.

passages.title: A Mage's Weapon
passages.text:
This is a wise choice. 

It should serve you well in our hunt for Kathra'natir.

passages.title: Storm Brew
passages.text:
Grandmaster, the Legion is attacking the Wandering Isle!

We sent defenders up to the Ridge of Laughing Winds, but they can't hold for long.

Our only chance is to finish making the Storm Brew. Chen and Aegira have already gone up to the Chamber of Whispers, but they are under heavy attack as well.

Speak to Tak Tak and take a kite up to join them at once!

passages.title: Storm Brew
passages.text: I don't know about you, Grandmaster, but I think we should take a well-earned rest after all of this.

passages.title: Hatchlings of the Talon
passages.text:
Greetings, hatchling. Do you wish to soar amongst the clouds as my children do?

<Aviana chuckles - a clicking, crow-like noise.>

Very well, receive my blessing and we shall see how developed your wings are.

passages.title: Call of the Wilds
passages.text:
Beating the Legion requires us to strike quickly and unexpectedly.

We have discovered a Dreamway by which we can travel through the Emerald Dream itself. Though only a short walk through the Dream, it will allow us to cross vast distances on Azeroth and even access the ancient home of all druids, Val'sharah.

Malfurion is preparing the ritual to open the Dreamway. I need you to summon Zen'tabra and Naralex to his side.

Only by combining our efforts can we hope to succeed.

passages.title: Call of the Wilds
passages.text: This ritual must succeed, <name>.

passages.title: Call of the Wilds
passages.text: Good, soon the ritual will be ready to begin.

passages.title: The Great Akazamzarak
passages.text:
There is a goblin who is a master of portals and teleportation by the name of Akazamzarak. His talents have gone mostly unnoticed, however, since he mostly uses them for chicanery.

He is, what you would call, a street performer.

Fortunately for us, he is performing in the streets of Dalaran, grifting coins from the unenlightened masses.

Take this bag of gold. See if you can convince him to change vocations.

passages.title: The Great Akazamzarak
passages.text:
You could say you've got my attention, pal!

So you're looking to hire me on full-time, eh? Well if the future payoffs are anything like this, I'd say you've got yourself a deal.

passages.title: The Only Way to Travel
passages.text:
Portals? Teleportation? You bet I can help you out with that! I mean, how do you think I pull the rabbit out of...

...um, you didn't hear that.

Anyway, I can help you move your mages around, if the price is right. Heck I can even teach those combat mages a thing or two. Ever been on the receiving end of an exploding bunny? It ain't pretty!

For starters, let me whip up a portal to take us to this hall you're talking about.

passages.title: The Only Way to Travel
passages.text:
I understand he may be unconventional, but I think this goblin is exactly what we'll need to quickly get this new Tirisgarde up to snuff for the task at hand.

I've already sent word to many talented mages who can help. They await transportation to the Hall, where they can begin their new purpose.

Shall we?

passages.title: The Champion's Return
passages.text:
I can sense the power of the artifact you hold. It will do well against the Legion as it is, but we have the ability to unlock its power even further. 

You must return to the Hall of the Guardian. You can use the incantation I taught you before to pass through the runes.

passages.title: The Champion's Return
passages.text:
You learn quickly, <name>. 

I think Kathra'natir will rue the day he made you his enemy.

passages.title: The Hunt
passages.text:
You must lead this hunt, <name> - a small force will join you to ensure Varedis meets his end.

You must try to make it into Varedis' hold undetected; the less time you spend in Legion territory the better.

Meet at Krasus' Landing when you are prepared to leave.

passages.title: The Hunt
passages.text:
What of the others? Did they...?

I see. They gave their lives for a worthy cause - the Twinblades will change the tide of this war, mark my words.

passages.title: By Any Means
passages.text:
We need to find out Varedis' location from the eredar inside this prison - the kind warden and his men here are all that stand in our way.

We'll take them on together if need be - whatever it takes.

passages.title: By Any Means
passages.text: Well done.

passages.title: By Any Means
passages.text: Suramar? That is only a short flight from here.

passages.title: Fall of the King
passages.text:
All that remains is the Sea Giant King.

Place our banner upon his beach and draw him out of the sea. Once he has revealed himself, use the trident to wound him.

There is a derelict boat that washed up on the shore. Use that to quickly get to the king's island.

Gird your loins, <name>. This fight will not be easy.

passages.title: Feeding Shal'Aran
passages.text:
With leyline energy feeding in from Anora, this chamber can begin to awaken.

It will be a slow process, and we must take care to mask this activity from our enemies, a process which itself requires enormous effort and focus.

Furthermore, there is the conundrum of actually consuming the mana in this form. A stream too weak is not enough to provide sustenance - too powerful and it would vaporize us.

There is much work to be done yet. For now, let us examine the feed.

passages.title: Feeding Shal'Aran
passages.text: I will call upon you again, I am sure.

passages.title: Mglrgrs Of Our Grmlgrlr
passages.text:
Mlrg...mglrmlr...

Gmlrgmlr mglrml gmlrg! Mlrgrlgr!

<Mrgrglilgrl points at the trail of spiderwebs leading out of the ruin.>

passages.title: Mglrgrs Of Our Grmlgrlr
passages.text: Mlrgmlr rmlgml! Mrlmgrlg gmlrmlrg, grmlgmlr lmrglgr mlgmrlr. Mlgrmlgr grmlmgl, Mrgrlilgrl...

passages.title: Elegant Design
passages.text:
Amateur merchants complain about supply and demand. Masters create their own.

You have done well retrieving the last two pieces I requested, but they are baubles compared to this.

Your target is the Lady Anastae, and she has something very valuable of mine: A design for a masterwork gem cut. 

Go and get it from her by any means necessary, but take care. She is a master manipulator and will tell you all manner of lies.

passages.title: Elegant Design
passages.text: What do you want?

passages.title: Elegant Design
passages.text: Lespin shall pay for his crimes!

passages.title: The Other City of Mages
passages.text:
Akazamzarak should be back from Dalaran with a new recruit to the Tirisgarde.

They await your return at the Hall of the Guardian.

passages.title: The Dark Riders
passages.text:
There's a sewer grate along the edge of the river leading to catacombs underneath Karazhan. I've never paid it much attention, but it could be where the spirits are directing us.

To think, the Dark Riders may have been under our noses this entire time! Come, let us see where this leads.

passages.title: The Dark Riders
passages.text: Did you find what you seek, <class>?

passages.title: The Dark Riders
passages.text:
Though I'll admit I may not have been able to do this alone, I will not forget the transgressions that happened today.

You have what you came for, <class>. I think it is time you were on your way.

passages.title: Corrupted Studies
passages.text:
Stormheim is steeped with artifacts from tha War of the Ancients. Demon artifacts ta be exact.

I think these artifacts can clue us into some knowledge about their leader, Sargeras. I've already found some fragments to a titan disc, but need ta find the rest of 'em.

I need ya ta dig around Stormheim and see if ye can find any more fragments so we can reassemble the disc.

passages.title: Corrupted Studies
passages.text: With so many demon artifacts buried here, it's a wonder this place is as vibrant as it is.

passages.title: Corrupted Studies
passages.text:
<Brann takes the fragments and begins reassembling them.>

Well, ye definitely found more o' the Titan Disc, but ye found something else too.

Here, take a look at that!

passages.title: Earth to Earth
passages.text:
From the earth comes strength, and such strength can be imbued into weapons of power.

You have the look of one who seeks to know how to create such weapons.

There are creatures that still inhabit this dying planet who bear such strength. Bring me their cores and I shall trade you the knowledge you seek.

passages.title: Earth to Earth
passages.text: There are also those who use such cores for more than mere forging. Be weary of such beings.

passages.title: Earth to Earth
passages.text:
It would appear the earth trembled at YOUR power instead. Well done, champion.

As we agreed, here are your prizes in exchange for the cores.

passages.title: And Into the Fel Fire
passages.text:
I found something, <name>. Well, a couple of things actually.

First I found an ancient text talking about a demon who harnessed the power of the titan disc I've been searching for.

Then I found a device which supposedly is used to summon 'im! Only, it's missin' some pieces from what I can make out.

I'm sure if we survey around Azsuna some more, those missin' pieces are sure ta turn up.

passages.title: And Into the Fel Fire
passages.text: From what I can make out, I think there's only seven or eight parts we need...

passages.title: And Into the Fel Fire
passages.text: Aye, that's all of 'em, lad. I'll just fix this up and we'll see what happens...

passages.title: Dark Secrets
passages.text:
I fixed the key and am ready to open the chamber.

Meet me there when you have a chance and we'll discover what waits inside together!

passages.title: Dark Secrets
passages.text: I always love a good adventure!

passages.title: Dark Secrets
passages.text:
A piece of the titan disc and a jar of blood. Well it's no wonder the elves locked this place up nice'n tight.

I'll take me disc piece and you can do whatever ye want with that blood.

passages.title: The Purple Hills of Eredath
passages.text:
Now that we're re-supplied, we can get back ta work.

I found something here that I think ye'll be interested in. It's a page of a book talking about the world of Argus. But before the demons destroyed it.

Anyway, it's been me experience that if ye find one of something, there's sure ta be more of it around.

Keep lookin' around Val'sharah for more of these pages and bring what ye find back ta me. And take the page I found with ya so ye know what yer lookin' fer.

passages.title: The Purple Hills of Eredath
passages.text: I can't wait to read the rest of that story.

passages.title: The Purple Hills of Eredath
passages.text:
<Brann skims over the book you've compiled.>

So where's the last chapter?

passages.title: The Relic Renewed
passages.text: Very good, very good! Now that we have all the pieces, it's time to put this disc back together!

passages.title: The Relic Renewed
passages.text: Jes a moment, lad...

passages.title: The Relic Renewed
passages.text:
After all that time, and we're still missing one piece!

I swear the gods are workin' against me on me quest, <name>.

Oh well, back ta work! And here's a little somethin' for all the hard work ye've done fer me.

passages.title: A Beacon of Hope
passages.text:
I've marked the location of the artifact on your map. It's in a rather hostile location, so I'd like you to go there and find it.

When you've recovered it, bring it back to me so I can discern its power.

passages.title: A Beacon of Hope
passages.text: Perhaps we can use this artifact to turn the tide of this war in our favor.

passages.title: A Beacon of Hope
passages.text:
Let's see what you've found.
