<Tae'thelan studies the artifact for some time and lets out a sigh.>

Useless. It's nothing more than a star field generator. Probably from some academy before the war.

You can have it back, <name>. I have no use for it.

passages.title: Fit for an Elven Queen
passages.text:
The nightborne have dropped their shield allowing us to penetrate their city and learn their secrets.

One such secret I've discovered is a crown of immeasurable power.

I'd like you to find this crown and report back to me on what it does.

passages.title: Fit for an Elven Queen
passages.text:
You found it?

<Tae'thelan listens as you explain about the missing jewels.>

I see. So the crown was just a vessel and the jewels are the true source of power.

passages.title: Sifting Through the Rubble
passages.text:
Then I believe it's clear what we must do next. Find the jewels.

They're bound to be here somewhere in Suramar, so we better start looking.

I'll coordinate the search from here, while you and my assistants look for the jewels.

passages.title: Sifting Through the Rubble
passages.text: What's the status on the search for the jewels?

passages.title: Sifting Through the Rubble
passages.text:
<Tae'thelan takes the jewels from you and looks them over closely.>

There may have been power in them once, but it's been all but drained. These are just pretty jewels now.

Here, take them. Consider them payment for your services here.

passages.title: What Once Was Lost
passages.text:
That reminds me, I found a map to a chamber that may or may not hold something of value.

It doesn't seem to have any power associated with it, which is why I'm handing it over to you.

Here, take some more explosives. They may help speed up the process of finding it.

passages.title: What Once Was Lost
passages.text: <In the small chest, you find a chest with a raven's head etched into the lid.>

passages.title: Uncovering the Orb of Sciallax
passages.text:
We'll need to hurry before the nightborne realize what we're after.

I'm bringing the goblins along in case we run into any obstacles along the way.

I've marked the location of the entrance to the chamber the Orb resides in on your map.

Meet me there as soon as you're ready and we'll claim this artifact for our own.

passages.title: Uncovering the Orb of Sciallax
passages.text: Well?

passages.title: Uncovering the Orb of Sciallax
passages.text:
NO! How did we fail? We were so close.

The explosives were too powerful. Those damned goblins ruined everything!

Now only a handful of shards of what was once an object of unimaginable power remain.

Take whichever one you want, <name>. I'd like to keep the rest to study.

passages.title: The Keys to Success
passages.text:
I'd like you to take the mold to the blacksmith in Dalaran. Alard, I believe his name is.

Have him help you forge a new set of keys.

I found some writing on the back of the mold that may hold the answer to what these keys unlock. I'll stay here and try to translate the text.

passages.title: The Keys to Success
passages.text: The key is clearly tied to something here in Azsuna.

passages.title: The Keys to Success
passages.text:
This is not a true key, but rather a device to provide access to the Nar'thalas Academy.

The academy was once a great location of knowledge for night elves to learn the arcane magics, but has long since long been destroyed.

The key is useless junk. You can keep it.

passages.title: Crystal Eyes
passages.text:
I've delved into the caves here and have discovered many ancient writings.

The most interesting I've found are resonating crystals, where the drogbar have resided. Unfortunately, they aren't on very good terms with the tauren here and this has hindered my research.

I thought, should there be any trouble with the drogbar, that you'd be able to handle them.

I'd like you to continue my research and discover what you can about Huln.

passages.title: Crystal Eyes
passages.text:
<Lessah listens to your recounting of the stories you discovered.>

If what you've said is true then that means that the piece I'm looking for is the necklace that Huln once wore.

passages.title: Laying to Rest
passages.text:
If I was able to find a bone fragment in what appeared to be a random location, then that means Eche'ro's bones must be scattered around Highmountain.

We must find his remains and give him the proper burial he deserved.

Oh, I'm sorry, in case you weren't aware, Eche'ro was Huln Highmountain's mount and companion.

He deserves to be honored as Huln once was.

passages.title: Laying to Rest
passages.text: We must see to it that his remains are given the respect they deserve.

passages.title: Laying to Rest
passages.text:
What an honor, <name>. To think that Eche'ro's spirit will come to your aid should you need it... that is a great reward indeed.

And for me, to witness the majesty of Huln himself! I shall continue to study him, and the glorious legacy he left behind.

passages.title: You've Got to Be Kitten Me Right Meow
passages.text:
While you were dealing with the stray Owlkitten, I took a look around.

It seems these curious creatures have a habit of escaping their parents' watchful eyes - some are trapped across the road by a wandering Ettin. 

He appears to have been... ahem... eating them.

We can earn Yowlon's blessing by bringing his children home.

passages.title: You've Got to Be Kitten Me Right Meow
passages.text: Have you managed to rescue any?

passages.title: You've Got to Be Kitten Me Right Meow
passages.text: They look so happy to be home. Excellent work.

passages.title: Work Order: Leystone
passages.text: Many thanks, miner. This leystone shall not be wasted.

passages.title: Meet the High Tinker
passages.text:
I don't know if you'll remember Mekkatorque or not. Nevin tells me that memory loss is pretty common for a Gnomeregan survivor.

Mekkatorque, or more properly, the High Tinker Mekkatorque is the leader of all the gnomes. He has made a habit of meeting with every rescued survivor personally. You should introduce yourself to him. He'll be with his war council beneath the tent in the center of town.

passages.title: Meet the High Tinker
passages.text: It's good to meet you, <name>. You've probably heard others speaking of Operation: Gnomeregan. Let me tell you a bit about what happened and why we left the dwarven city of Ironforge.

passages.title: Into The Pit!
passages.text:
The felstalker pits?!

There's no time to waste, <name>!

 I canna' tell ye what the Burnin' Legion has planned for ol' Brambley, but it canna' be good!

Hurry! We've got to find him before the Burnin' Legion has their way with him!

passages.title: Into The Pit!
passages.text: We've got to get to the felstalker pits an' save Brambley!

passages.title: Into The Pit!
passages.text:
It canna' be true!

Brambley... my dear ol' friend! Why did ye have to go an' die?

passages.title: Work Order: Foxflower
passages.text: Many thanks, herbalist. This foxflower shall not be wasted.

passages.title: Apex Predator
passages.text:
I have good news and bad news, <race>.

The bad news is that they somehow managed to capture and train a Devilsaur.

The good news is that it doesn't seem to have a collar and is tame. I imagine it must think that one of the Nightborne in there is its master. Find the pack leader and take him out, and we will set quite a beast upon them.

passages.title: Apex Predator
passages.text: Did you find the alpha?

passages.title: Apex Predator
passages.text: I saw everything from out here. That was... messy.

passages.title: Work Order: Stonehide Leather
passages.text: Many thanks, skinner. This leather shall not be wasted.

passages.title: Work Order: Highmountain Salmon
passages.text: Many thanks, fisherman. This salmon shall not be wasted.

passages.title: Mangelrath
passages.text:
The demonic beast that stands before ye, must be the one that devoured ol' Brambley...

Just look at it, lying there with a full belly! I canna abide it any longer, <name>! We must slay the foul creature and avenge Brambley!

We've come this far already, <class>.

Are ye with me?!

passages.title: Mangelrath
passages.text: It's good to see a friendly face, I don't know how much longer I could have held out on my own!

passages.title: Ascending The Circle
passages.text:
Now, you are more powerful than ever! Truly, you are a druid without equal, <name>.

I sense that Malfurion has arrived. He will certainly want to know of your accomplishments, but first, please walk with me a moment.

passages.title: Ascending The Circle
passages.text: Yes?

passages.title: Ascending The Circle
passages.text:
Congratulations, Archdruid <name>.

We will be counting on you in the days ahead.

passages.title: Priority Delivery
passages.text:
An adventurer of another time has forgotten to loot something big... something that might cause them great emotional strain if not received quickly.

Your destination is Icecrown Citadel, your target the Lich King's corpse. Retrieve the missing item post-haste and deliver it to the stalwart adventurer - he should be somewhere at the Steam Pools in Feralas.

My assistant will open a portal to deliver you there. Just a moment!

passages.title: Priority Delivery
passages.text: Hold, peasant. What business have you with the illustrious Johnny Awesome?

passages.title: Priority Delivery
passages.text: You'd best carry a reason of a higher caliber than that to dare interrupt my time with these buxom beauties.

passages.title: Timing Is Everything
passages.text:
Can you feel it, <name>? The waters churn with approaching Sashj'tar.

You must strike now...

Leave me... Find a way to bombard the naga... with the kegs...

Protect... Jandvik...

passages.title: Timing Is Everything
passages.text: Fjolrik died in honor of Jandvik. We will remember his bravery.

passages.title: Dry Powder
passages.text:
<name>... I did not expect to see you down here.

The Sashj'tar are... rallying against Jandvik. I had a plan to... decimate them using these old powder kegs.

The naga proved more formidable to these old bones than I thought.

<Fjolrik coughs out some blood.>

We haven't much time... to prepare.

passages.title: Dry Powder
passages.text: Move quickly, <name>.

passages.title: Dry Powder
passages.text:
<Fjolrik looks at you weakly.>

You made it back in time...

passages.title: Necessary Preparations
passages.text:
G'Hanir is... is...

<Mylune wipes her eyes, sniffling.>

Corrupted! The Nightmare has risen from the depths of the dream. It all happened so fast...

I was able to secret the staff here through the dream before it fell fully. It rests for now... but I fear we don't have much time.

You must prepare to retrieve G'Hanir from the Dream. Draw water from the sacred moonwell on the northern edge of the grove and obtain an ancient's blessing.

Quickly - every moment is precious!

passages.title: Necessary Preparations
passages.text: Are you ready?

passages.title: Necessary Preparations
passages.text:
<Mylune's face brightens.>

Then there is still hope!

passages.title: Sunken Foes
passages.text:
The Tidemistress... is filling her ranks with hulking naga... and sea giants.

Jandvik cannot withstand... their combined might.

Slaughter them... before they reach its shores...

passages.title: Sunken Foes
passages.text: The Sashj'tar attacks are relentless.

passages.title: Sunken Foes
passages.text: The Sashj'tar forces are far greater than I imagined.

passages.title: Against Their Will
passages.text:
When the naga brought me down here, I saw many of my vrykul mining the sea floor. They had... squids... attached to their faces.

Whatever those things are, they must be controlling my kin and forcing them to work for the naga.

I do not know what will happen if you remove the squids, but I would rather my vrykul die than be slaves to the naga.

See me in Jandvik when the deed is done.

passages.title: Against Their Will
passages.text: I must express gratitude for the vrykul you have saved this day.

passages.title: Homeward Bounding
passages.text:
The first step to establishing a moonwell is to gain the blessings of the local wildlife. 

It is their good will that enables us to peacefully coexist, and a moonwell thrives on such energies. Combined with Elune's light, a moonwell can purify its surroundings for years.

To begin, we must find creatures willing to give their blessing. We can start with these owl-cat creatures.

They ran while you cleaned, but I saw one lingering just before the bridge. 

See if you can find where it lives!

passages.title: Homeward Bounding
passages.text: Did you bring the little one back with you?

passages.title: Homeward Bounding
passages.text: Well this is an interesting turn of events.

passages.title: Trouble Has Huge Feet
passages.text:
The Ettin's hide bears many shallow scratch marks and bite scars. It seems he had been terrorizing the local Owlcats for quite some time.

Mardranel Forestheart would be interested in this.

passages.title: Trouble Has Huge Feet
passages.text: Ahhhh... Well done, I am sure our furry friends here are very thankful for your efforts.

passages.title: Not Here, Not Now, Not Ever
passages.text:
I cannot, will not, accept what is happening here. My body resists me, but I will stop this.

<He looks at you.> You will stop this.

Here is a root of the corrupted World Tree Shaladrassil. It has somehow found its way out of the ground to this untouched place and already the Darkfiend satyrs are hard at work corrupting Suramar.

Stop them. Kill the satyrs, take their horns, drive their points through the totems.

Only then can we have any hope of reversing this.

passages.title: Not Here, Not Now, Not Ever
passages.text: Have you stalled their efforts, <race>?

passages.title: Not Here, Not Now, Not Ever
passages.text: I am relieved, though there remains more we must do.

passages.title: Estate Jewelry: Haute Claw-ture
passages.text:
An amateur merchant looks back on their previous work as a learning experience. A master knows that some things are better left forgotten.

I was... vain, centuries ago. Desperate to prove myself, I took on a bold commission.

Find him and bring... it... back. You will know what I am talking about when you see it.

He resides near the villa south of this courtyard.

passages.title: Estate Jewelry: Haute Claw-ture
passages.text: He was so passionate, so driven. I saw his vision, created it to his exact specifications. Beautiful filigree and enamel put to a fearsome weapon...

passages.title: Estate Jewelry: Haute Claw-ture
passages.text: By the Magistrix, I had forgotten how ugly that thing is. Impeccable workmanship, obviously. Just... ugh. I should melt the whole thing down.

passages.title: Prongs and Fangs
passages.text:
Now, <name>, do not mistake me- I am a druid. I understand that nature has a balance.

Predators must feed, and others will be hunted. I also understand that tampering with such balance has consequences.

That is why I have taken upon myself to walk this land and perform some... ah... calculations.

Slay only a small number of the wolves you find, and one alpha. That should reduce their number enough to allow the Sablehorn to thrive without disrupting the flow of things here.

passages.title: Prongs and Fangs
passages.text: Are you being gentle with your pruning?

passages.title: Prongs and Fangs
passages.text: In the end, they will all thrive- for with more Sablehorn, the wolves will eat better in the years to come.

passages.title: Moonwhisper Rescue
passages.text:
As a druid I understand that predation happens. Creatures that eat meat must acquire meat.

But this...

<Solendra gestures angrily toward a nearby petrified nightsaber.>

This is just sad. Free them, <race>. Take my blessing and free them from this needless torment.

passages.title: Moonwhisper Rescue
passages.text: Have you freed them, <race>?

passages.title: Moonwhisper Rescue
passages.text: I am much relieved, <name>.

passages.title: Eminent Grow-main
passages.text:
You have done very well, <race>. 

All that is left is to combine their blessings into the ritual bundle and imbue the Moonwell. Once that is done, Mayruna will add a little water from a purified Moonwell and this land will be protected so long as we inhabit it.

This is a momentous occasion, my friend. You bear witness to a sacred rite not often performed in the company of strangers.

I will let you do the honors- simply place the ritual bundle into the sacred waters and we will do the rest.

passages.title: Eminent Grow-main
passages.text: You witness history, <race>.

passages.title: Eminent Grow-main
passages.text: Your assistance made this all possible. Thank you.

passages.title: Stolen Thunder
passages.text:
Titanstrike is in the tomb of Warlord Volund somewhere on the isle of Shield's Rest. It's a dank, sloppy mess adrift in a sea of gloom.

Sounds lovely, eh?

I've been workin' with a vrykul guide named Prustaga. She'll help us break the wards keepin' the tomb sealed.

I know what you're thinkin'... vrykul are trouble. But she hasn't taken a swing at me just yet.

Huey'll take us down to the shore. Prustaga's probably found the tomb by now!

passages.title: Stolen Thunder
passages.text: It's a good thing you found my observation relay! It's been missing for at least a thousand years.

passages.title: Stolen Thunder
passages.text: You might feel a bit dizzy after going through that teleporter. The Broken Isles isn't exactly next door, after all.

passages.title: A New Threat
passages.text:
If you seek the Nexus, I would warn not to rush headlong. There are strange happenings in Coldarra, and it would be best to gather some information before proceeding.

During my last visit to the Dragonblight, I sensed unusual energies from the Azure Dragonshrine. Since this place was very closely tied to Malygos' plans during the Nexus Wars, whatever is present there may explain the current state of the Nexus.

I cannot accompany you, but this crystal can be used to communicate with me. Good luck.

passages.title: A New Threat
passages.text:
This appears to be a communication device commonly utilized by the ethereals.

Perhaps it could be the key to finding out who is behind the happenings at the Dragonshrine.

passages.title: Harnessing the Holy Fire
passages.text:
The energy from Light's Wrath lashes out from within the weakened Nexus Vault. We may be able to use this raw, chaotic energy to our advantage.

If we can harness this energy and feed it into the Surge Needles, it should cause a rather... destructive reaction.

passages.title: Work Order: Leystone Armguards
passages.text: Hail, blacksmith. I can take these armguards off of your hands. Your gift will be put to good use.

passages.title: Work Order: Leystone Boots
passages.text: Many thanks, blacksmith. These boots shall not be wasted.

passages.title: Work Order: Leystone Gauntlets
passages.text: The Kirin Tor thank you.

passages.title: Work Order: Warhide Mask
passages.text: Hail, leatherworker. I can take this mask off of your hands. Your gift will be put to good use.

passages.title: Work Order: Battlebound Armbands
passages.text: Many thanks, leatherworker. These armbands shall not be wasted.

passages.title: Work Order: Warhide Gloves
passages.text: The Kirin Tor thank you.

passages.title: Work Order: Silkweave Robe
passages.text: Many thanks, tailor. This robe shall not be wasted.

passages.title: Work Order: Silkweave Hood
passages.text: The Kirin Tor thank you.

passages.title: Work Order: Deep Amber Loop
passages.text: Hail, jewelcrafter. I can take this jewelry off of your hands. Your gift will be put to good use.

passages.title: Work Order: Skystone Pendant
passages.text: Many thanks, jewelcrafter. This jewelry shall not be wasted.

passages.title: Work Order: Azsunite Loop
passages.text: The Kirin Tor thank you.

passages.title: Work Order: Avalanche Elixirs
passages.text: Many thanks, alchemist. These elixirs shall not be wasted.

passages.title: Work Order: Ancient Rejuvenation Potions
passages.text: The Kirin Tor thank you.

passages.title: Vantus Rune Work Order: Dragons of Nightmare
passages.text: Hail, scribe. I can take these supplies off of your hands. Your gift will be put to good use.

passages.title: Vantus Rune Work Order: Ursoc
passages.text: Many thanks, scribe. These supplies shall not be wasted.

passages.title: Vantus Rune Work Order: Il'gynoth, The Heart of Corruption
passages.text: The Kirin Tor thank you.

passages.title: Work Order: Word of Strength
passages.text: Many thanks, enchanter. This enchantment shall not be wasted.

passages.title: Work Order: Word of Intellect
passages.text: The Kirin Tor thank you.

passages.title: Work Order: Pump-Action Bandage Gun
passages.text: Hail, engineer. I can take this device off of your hands. Your gift will be put to good use.

passages.title: Work Order: Auto-Hammer
passages.text: Many thanks, engineer. This auto-hammer shall not be wasted.

passages.title: Work Order: Failure Detection Pylon
passages.text: The Kirin Tor thank you.

passages.title: Cleansing the Mother Tree
passages.text:
We must save the Mother Tree at all costs.

I believe I know a way.

The world tree Nordrassil, atop Mount Hyjal, was born from an acorn of G'Hanir. We can use the sacred waters surrounding its roots to purify the corruption.

If we take the Dreamway to Mount Hyjal's summit we should have enough time to complete the cleansing ritual before G'Hanir falls completely to the darkness.

passages.title: Cleansing the Mother Tree
passages.text:
We all owe you a great deal for your heroism, <name>. I owe you a great deal.

I suspect this war is far from over.

passages.title: Breaking Down the Big Guns
passages.text:
You did well against that sea witch, but not well enough.

Her power far surpasses any creature that I have ever fought. To defeat her, we will need something formidable. Something that she will not expect...

<Toryl grins wryly.>

Something of their own design... 

Salvage as many parts from their harpoon launchers as you can carry and meet me back in Jandvik.

passages.title: Breaking Down the Big Guns
passages.text: The Tidemistress is a dangerous foe. We must be just as cunning to defeat her.

passages.title: Breaking Down the Big Guns
passages.text: You have all the parts that you will need... two in some cases.

passages.title: The Defense of Tian Monastery
passages.text:
Chen's recent report indicates that Tian Monastery is under attack!

<name>, they need your help. Go speak to Tak-Tak west of the main temple. He can get you there quickly.

passages.title: The Defense of Tian Monastery
passages.text: I did not expect the Grandmaster himself! Your strength will help us turn the tide. We cannot let these demons succeed!

passages.title: Storm, Earth, and Fire
passages.text:
Tian Monastery is in bad shape.

Felspreader imps are torching the grounds. Fel spikes radiate foul energy, corrupting the nearby earth. And fel magic has seeped into the monastery's ale barrels, tainting the brew.

Use your abilities to snuff the flames, shatter the spikes, and destroy the tainted barrels.

Sigh... hundreds of years of the finest ale... ruined.

I don't wish to hear any more of it. Just get it done.

passages.title: Storm, Earth, and Fire
passages.text: Is it done?

passages.title: Storm, Earth, and Fire
passages.text:
The grounds are safe, thanks to you... too bad we couldn't save any of that brew!

<The Monkey King heaves a great sigh.>

passages.title: Rebuilding the Order
passages.text:
On behalf of all the students and teachers here at Tian Monastery, thank you, Grandmaster <name>.

You have a difficult task ahead of you to rebuild our order, but we stand with you.

Let us head back to the Wandering Isle.

passages.title: Rebuilding the Order
passages.text: Our order's teachings will continue, thanks to you, Grandmaster.

passages.title: Tech It Up A Notch
passages.text:
There are many ways to commune with the elements. In their ingenuity, the goblins have found ways to imbue their mechanical devices with the energy of elemental spirits. I do not pretend to understand. But in our hour of need, we should not hesitate to embrace a diversity of options.

We are fortunate to have at our disposal the services of the one they call "Goldmine," whose unorthodox research may significantly augment our power. He waits nearby.

passages.title: Tech It Up A Notch
passages.text: What's it gonna be, boss?

passages.title: Tech It Up A Notch
passages.text: Excellent choice, Farseer. <class> from all over the world have much to learn from one another.

passages.title: Troops in the Field
passages.text: It is time for us to test the strength of your newly summoned Lesser Elementals. Look at the Scouting Map and send your champions and troops on a routine scouting mission.

passages.title: Troops in the Field
passages.text: How did it go?

passages.title: Troops in the Field
passages.text:
The scouting mission was more successful than we could have imagined, <name>. Your troops were able to rescue Journeyman Goldmine, a... most unusual little <class>.

In thanks, he has agreed to lend his skill to our cause.

passages.title: Kel'danath's Legacy
passages.text:
Kel'danath discovered something incredible - the power to subdue and even control the withered.

I will pick up where my old friend left off. We shall see to it that he did not die in vain. 

Perhaps in the end we can even find peace for the wretches who have been left to a fate worse than death.

I will need more subjects. Take Kel'danath's spellstone and use it to subdue more withered.

passages.title: Kel'danath's Legacy
passages.text: We will need more subjects if we are to continue Kel'danath's research.

passages.title: Kel'danath's Legacy
passages.text:
Fascinating.

Let us hope the spell holds.

passages.title: A Daring Rescue
passages.text:
The plan is a simple one, but it will require great effort on your part.

Kira and I will summon the demonic gateway, but you will have to enter alone and recover the missing council members.

passages.title: A Daring Rescue
passages.text: Kira and I can sustain the gateway, but you will need to enter the demon world alone.

passages.title: A Daring Rescue
passages.text:
Shinfel cannot be broken at the hands of Mephistroth. Armed with her power and knowledge, the dreadlord would be able to mount a devastating attack against Dreadscar Rift.

A ritual of summoning should be able to summon Shinfel to our side, but we'll need to create a powerful anchor.

passages.title: Soul Beacon
passages.text:
I have bound Shinfel's soul to her staff, allowing it to serve as an anchor in this world.

When we perform the ritual of summoning, it will act as a beacon, guiding Shinfel through the Twisting Nether and back to our world.

passages.title: Soul Beacon
passages.text: The council cannot be rebuilt without Shinfel.

passages.title: Soul Beacon
passages.text:
We may have Shinfel in our possession, but her mind remains in the hands of her demon captors.

What kind of ancient magic have they cursed her with? I've never seen anything like it.

passages.title: To The Hills
passages.text:
It is said that a fragment of Ursoc's spirit, his fury and rage, remained within the claws after his death. Only those who have attained mastery of discipline have any hope of wielding them without being overwhelmed by the bear lord's fury.

<Lea looks intently at you for a moment.>

But you are no novice, I can see that clearly.

Very well, draw water from the moonwell on the northern edge of the grove then come find me. I'll await your arrival within the broken stump of Vordrassil in Northrend.

passages.title: To The Hills
passages.text: Did you get the moonwell water? It is essential for our task!

passages.title: To The Hills
passages.text: Excellent! We will need this water to enter the Emerald Dream, but first we need to address the magical wards that protect the claws.

passages.title: Fallen Offerings
passages.text:
When the claws were sealed away, magical wards were placed to prevent anyone from reaching their location. Only the power of a demigod can give us passage through the wards, one such as Ursol, the brother of Ursoc.

Ursol is a reclusive guardian and requires an offering before he will appear to us.

like Ursoc, he was worshipped by the furbolg, but years of war have decimated their tribes and their shaman lay dead.

Search the bodies of the fallen for their offerings while I prepare the shrine.

passages.title: Fallen Offerings
passages.text: Did you get the offerings?

passages.title: Fallen Offerings
passages.text:
Yes, this should work!

I hate rummaging through the pockets of the dead but we need them more than they do.

Now, let's begin.

passages.title: Borrowed Time
passages.text:
Don't let the aroma deceive you, this concoction is mostly safe for consumption.

Whoever is afflicted should drink the entire contents of the vial, every last drop! If the elixir works, the effects should be immediate. If not, well... just tell them they drink at their own risk, alright?

Keep in mind, this will only weaken the curse, not cure it.

passages.title: Borrowed Time
passages.text: Shinfel's curse will kill her soon if we don't find a way to slow its progression.

passages.title: Borrowed Time
passages.text:
Killing a demon isn't always the answer. Sometimes, the solution is to control one, or two as the case may be.

If we can summon the sisters and bend their will to ours, it will deliver a devastating blow to Mephistroth's forces and rid Shinfel of her curse.

passages.title: Coercing a Confession
passages.text:
My location has to be kept secret, at least until I have proof of my innocence.

Thanks to the legacy of my family name, any time some miserable warlock summons demons they can't control, I get the blame.

The scene of my latest "crime" is a nearby cave, where unruly imps and other nasty demons are roaming free.

Find the lousy warlock who's responsible, and get him to write a confession.

passages.title: Coercing a Confession
passages.text:
This writing is a bit difficult to decipher, but I think all the pertinent information is included.

Armed with this confession, I should be able to prove my innocence and focus on more pressing matters.

passages.title: Summoning the Sisters
passages.text:
It would be best to conduct the summoning on the outskirts of Dreadscar Rift. If things do not go as planned, at least the aftermath will be contained to a small island of land that floats above our order.

Once the sisters have been summoned, use the Bloodstone to enslave them.

I'll let the others know it's time to begin.

passages.title: Summoning the Sisters
passages.text:
You did it, <name>. The demon twins are under your control.

I have not witnessed such power since the fall of Ragnaros.

passages.title: Selecting a Sixth
passages.text:
With the demon sisters under your control, you have managed to weaken Mephistroth's army and gain powerful allies for the council.

Our work is not done, however. Dreadscar Rift will remain a target as long as the Burning Legion remains.

If we wish to protect our new home, we must rebuild the council. Both Lulubelle and Kira have proven themselves worthy to join our ranks, though only one spot remains.

As First of the Black Harvest, the choice is yours.

passages.title: Selecting a Sixth
passages.text: The choice may not be easy, but it is yours to make.

passages.title: Selecting a Sixth
passages.text: And so the choice is made.

passages.title: Asking a Favor
passages.text:
Caria Felsoul was a bright student... and a Legion traitor.

In her treason she was bestowed the Aldrachi Warblades, the soul-rending blades of the Aldrachi's greatest champion - they say he only finally fell to Sargeras himself.

We sent a small force to find Caria, but we have not heard word since. Jace has a Legion communicator he believes we can use to reach them- we just need a power source.

Perhaps you could see if Khadgar has anything we could use? I'm afraid our allies are few.

passages.title: Asking a Favor
passages.text: It's good to see you again. If there's anything I can do to help you take the fight to the Legion, just let me know.

passages.title: Establishing a Connection
passages.text:
<Jace glances at the crystallized soul.>

Yes, that will do nicely. Release its energy to activate the communicator - it should already be configured to contact Allari and her forces.

If Caria is out there, we will find her, and we will make her suffer for her transgressions.

passages.title: Establishing a Connection
passages.text: This may be our only chance at revenge against Caria. Every moment is precious.

passages.title: Establishing a Connection
passages.text: Not good... not good at all.

passages.title: The Masks We Wear
passages.text:
Many nightborne had pinned their hopes on Thalyssra deposing the Grand Magistrix. Since she disappeared, dissenting voices have grown silent.

We must spread the word, discreetly, among the populace. Ly'leth Lunastre will be a perfect ally in this. She is a socialite with many connections, and she is no friend of the Legion.

Ly'leth hosts a masquerade party at her estate where rumors are traded like coin - and brandished like daggers.

Let us invite ourselves in.

passages.title: The Masks We Wear
passages.text: Pleased to make your acquaintance.

passages.title: The Masks We Wear
passages.text:
That mask suits you.

In Suramar, it can be quite advantageous to be someone else for a time...

passages.title: The Iron Fist
passages.text:
It's time to send a rescue operation to the Gates of Valor, <name>.

I will prepare our troops and send them at once. We will need a sizable army to take on the massive Legion force in Stormheim.

Grandmaster, go ahead whenever you are ready. I will send our forces to meet you in the field.

passages.title: The Iron Fist
passages.text:
They made you Grandmaster, eh? Well, I was busy anyway!

Anyway, I managed to escape from those fel-drinking dirt-kickers across the road, but our own are still in trouble.

Those Legion worms are goin' ta sacrifice the prisoners for their souls.

We've got ta help them!

passages.title: Quelling the Tide
passages.text:
<Sylara looks at you with determined eyes.>

Our friends are in danger. We will save them. Kill any Legion in the way.

passages.title: Quelling the Tide
passages.text: <Sylara nods at you.>

passages.title: Quelling the Tide
passages.text:
<Sylara bows deeply.>

Well fought.

passages.title: Brick By Brick
passages.text:
Da monks be free, and we put a thorn in dat eredar lady's side.

I'm back wit my friends, and lookin' forward to sleepin' in a bed tonight.

Let's go back ta da Wanderin' Isle. I've never been so excited ta see a turtle in my life.

passages.title: Brick By Brick
passages.text:
This is fantastic news, <name>!

Not only have you disrupted the Legion's plans, but you've saved the lives of numerous people.

In addition, you rescued three of the greatest monks we've trained in recent history.

The order is indebted to you once again.

passages.title: Allegiance of Flame
passages.text:
My rivals lay dead and there are none within the Firelands who dare oppose my rule!

As promised, I will unite with the other Elemental Lords in the defense of Azeroth. The armies of the Firelands will scorch the battlefield with the corpses of our enemies!

Go now, mortal. Tell your Earthen Ring that the Firelord himself stands with you!

passages.title: Allegiance of Flame
passages.text: What news do you bring from the Firelands?

passages.title: Allegiance of Flame
passages.text:
I did not think that I would live to see the day when the four great Elemental Lords would unite with the mortal races of Azeroth.

You have done what no other Farseer has done in the history of the Earthen Ring.

This is truly a day that will be remembered for generations!

passages.title: A Promise of Earth
passages.text:
Deepholm thanks you, shaman.

The Twilight's Hammer has always sought dominion over my kingdom, but this latest threat was far greater than their previous efforts.

For your service to the elements of earth, I will pledge my armies to the Earthen Ring in the defense of Azeroth.

I have no love for the mortal races, but this world is not the Burning Legion's to destroy.

Tell your Earthen Ring that Therazane the Stonemother stands with them!

passages.title: A Promise of Earth
passages.text:
It is good to see you safely back, Farseer. With Therazane's allegiance, we now have three of the Elemental Lords united to our cause.

However, one still remains...

passages.title: Oath of the Windlord
passages.text:
You have my thanks, mortal for bringing about my rebirth. However, thanks alone would not be honorable.

I know that the Earthen Ring seeks to save Azeroth from the Burning Legion.

I will pledge my sword, and the armies of Skywall to the aid of Azeroth.

When the time for battle arrives, and the Earthen Ring stands upon the battlefield against the Burning Legion, the Windlord shall stand with you.

passages.title: Oath of the Windlord
passages.text:
The Windlord has pledged to aid The Earthen Ring in the war against the Burning Legion?

This is fortuitous news indeed!

Still, there is little time for celebration, much remains to be accomplished.

passages.title: Report from Tian Monastery
passages.text:
We have heard from all our temples on Pandaria, except for one.

We dispatched a message by bird to Tian Monastery, but no answer has yet arrived. This silence is quite unusual.

Grandmaster, I recommend that we send our champion, Chen Stormstout, to scout the situation at once.

passages.title: Report from Tian Monastery
passages.text: What have you discovered?

passages.title: Report from Tian Monastery
passages.text: Your champion moved swiftly, <name>! This report clearly indicates that Tian Monastery is under attack!

passages.title: Amaranthine Hops
passages.text:
The hops for our brew must be a very specific, and they will also be hard to acquire.

Amaranthine Hops only grow in the realm known as the Emerald Dream, meaning we can only acquire this ingredient from a druid.

There is one such supplier from whom I receive this item, but she may ask for something in exchange.

passages.title: Amaranthine Hops
passages.text: Did you find Fleuris?

passages.title: Amaranthine Hops
passages.text: Mmmm, just smell those hops! This will be a good batch, I just know it.

passages.title: The Master's Legacy
passages.text:
You work for a murderer and a thief.

That design he wants? It is called the magistrix cut, and it was perfected by my husband. He was killed by Lespin for his secret.

I had him entombed in a small cave north of the city, for we could not make the trip to Tel'anor. Buried with him is a tome that contains the secrets of the design.

Retrieve the design and keep it out of his hands!

passages.title: The Master's Legacy
passages.text: Where is the master?

passages.title: The Master's Legacy
passages.text:
Well well, looks like that old fool finally met his match?

It looks like the Promenade is in need of a new jeweler, and I think I have learned all I could from my former master.

Here is something for your efforts.

passages.title: The Dreamer Returns
passages.text:
Arch Druid Greathoof will be expecting word on the success of our mission, but I'm afraid I must ask you to return alone.

I can't rest knowing that Xavius has Lord Ursoc in his clutches. Just the thought of it makes me shake with rage! I'll find where he has been taken if I have to search every corner of Azeroth!

Our paths will cross again, <name>. Be sure of it.

passages.title: The Dreamer Returns
passages.text:
So, Xavius is behind this. A thousand deaths isn't enough of a punishment for that defiler!

But, you have returned with the claws, that is not an accomplishment that even I could have performed.

You are truly the hero we need to face the Legion.

passages.title: The Shadows Reveal
passages.text:
The Fangs of the Devourer are wielded by Akaari Shadowgore, one of Kil'Jaeden's personal assassins. Every attempt on her life ends the same... she's gone before we even arrive.

<Valeera scrawls a few lines on a piece of paper, then hands it to you.>

But not this time. We've been working with these contacts to find Akaari so we can finally take the Fangs for our own purposes.

Go to each contact and tell them "The shadows reveal." See what they know.

passages.title: The Shadows Reveal
passages.text: Hmm?

passages.title: The Shadows Reveal
passages.text:
<Valeera glances in your direction.>

Any luck?

passages.title: Cry More Thunder!
passages.text:
You have proven yourself an ally of the Thorignir and we will lend you our strength. I would ask one last favor of our new champion, though. 

The dragon who guided you to me awaits his vengeance against the vrykul. Together I wish for you to show these Drekirjar what it means to cross the Thorignir. Their toll must be paid in blood.

Speak to Vethir when you are ready.

passages.title: The Vindicator's Plea
passages.text:
I've obtained a request from Vindicator Boros in Dalaran asking for our help.

He has recovered a soldier who escaped from the Legion! He was injured and his wounds are resisting every healing treatment available to them. Normally this would fall to an acolyte to handle, but the soldier mentioned T'uure in his delirium! I thought the holy gem was lost!

You are strong with the Light, perhaps you can succeed where they can't?

If you need it, Brother Larry can provide you with a flight to Dalaran.

passages.title: The Vindicator's Plea
passages.text: Thank you for arriving in such haste, Brother.

passages.title: Out of the Darkness
passages.text:
Alora and I were were able to escape through one of the Legion's portals back to Azeroth but that's about as far as our luck got us.

The portal put us on a small isle somewhere to the west of the Broken Shore. They saw us quickly and we made a run for the protection of the water. As I attempted to leap to safety, I was wounded. But Alora... she tripped and I watched them drag her back.

Rescue her, please! I'll mark where the camp is on your map, just don't let her go through that ordeal again.

passages.title: Out of the Darkness
passages.text:
I felt my soul being ripped from my body. If you hadn't come when you did... I don't even want to think about it!

Is there anything I can do to repay you? I owe you my life after all.

<You mention to her Barrem's story.>

Barrem still lives too? Oh thank the light! Yes, I'll gladly tell you everything I know.

passages.title: Blood of My Blood
passages.text:
As my darling <brother/sister> has demonstrated, Elisande's decision to bring down the shield has sown unrest among the nightborne.

Loyalists and demons march together in the streets. Fear and distrust grip our hearts. Family turns against family.

I will help Thalyssra stir a new rebellion, but first we must deal with Anarys.

I do not wish to spill the blood of my blood - only to help <him/her> see reason.

Anarys is likely brooding over our father's memorial. Bring <him/her> to me alive.

passages.title: Blood of My Blood
passages.text: Anarys could halt our efforts before they begin.

passages.title: Blood of My Blood
passages.text: Thank you. Now our work can begin.

passages.title: Salvation From On High
passages.text:
I was serving aboard the airship that crashed on the way to the Broken Shore. I must have blacked out as the next thing I remember was being jolted awake. I was on a broken land and above me stood a man'ari carrying a staff of darkened crystal. There is no mistaking it, that staff was T'uure!

All my life I've heard stories about how T'uure flowed with the healing power of the light. Somehow the crystal has been darkened by Man'ari. We must get it back and restore it to its pure form!

passages.title: Salvation From On High
passages.text:
You seek a demon with a staff of crystal? The Eredar that calls itself Lady Calindris has one that matches your description perfectly.

She's MY prey though! I've been chasing her minion all over the isles and I'm not about to let this opportunity pass.

I could use someone to watch my back though. If you help me out I'd be willing to let you take this staff you seek. I don't care about her equipment, it's her soul that I'm after.

Well, what do you say?

passages.title: A New Threat
passages.text:
If you seek the Nexus, be wary. There are strange happenings in Coldarra, and it would be best to understand them before proceeding.

During my last visit to Dragonblight, I sensed unusual energies from the Azure Dragonshrine. Since this place was integral to Malygos' plans during the Nexus War, whatever is there may explain the current state of the Nexus.

Here, take this image crystal. I must remain in Dalaran on Kirin Tor business, so we will speak through it. Good luck.

passages.title: A New Threat
passages.text: The communication device is inactive.

passages.title: A New Threat
passages.text:
This appears to be a communication device commonly utilized by the ethereals.

Perhaps it could be the key to finding out who is behind the happenings at the Dragonshrine.

passages.title: Harnessing the Arcane
passages.text:
The energy from Aluneth lashes out from within the weakened Nexus Vault. We may be able to use this raw, chaotic energy to our advantage.

If we can harness this energy and feed it into the Surge Needles, it should cause a rather... destructive reaction.

passages.title: The Nexus Vault
passages.text:
If the Ethereum managed to capture Azuregos, then they are more powerful than I imagined. 

We have not always seen eye to eye, Azuregos and I, but he is still my kin. Since you seek to put an end to the ethereals and claim Aluneth, I ask that you also free my brother from their grip.

With the Surge Needles destroyed, the shield has dissipated. The Nexus awaits, <name>.

passages.title: The Nexus Vault
passages.text:
You have my gratitude for saving Azuregos, <name>. I can rest easy knowing that the Nexus is under his care.

As for you, I can see you're full of surprises. Never in my time have I seen a <class> who can control the chaotic energies of Aluneth. 

Thank you for what you have done for me and my kind today. You are truly the hero we need to face the Legion.

passages.title: Grip of Nightmare
passages.text:
Most of the druids were able to escape, but the shrine is still swarming with enemies.

The shrine's leader, Sylendra Gladesong, stayed behind to recover Malorne's Idol. We must go back and help her.

passages.title: Grip of Nightmare
passages.text:
The satyr have never been this bold, or powerful. They took us completely by surprise, and our magic could not withstand their attacks. Without you, I would not have survived.

I have only one purpose now - to recover that idol.

passages.title: Idol of the Wilds
passages.text:
We were able to wrest a confession out of this one. We know that their leader took the idol into Moonclaw Vale, but he could be hiding anywhere.

Surely one of these satyrs will know where it was taken.

Get the information out of these satyrs, even if it's the last thing they do.

passages.title: Idol of the Wilds
passages.text: Did you recover the Idol of the Wilds?

passages.title: Idol of the Wilds
passages.text:
The Idol... so relieved am I to see it in your hands, <name>.

We will keep it here at the Dreamgrove for safekeeping.

passages.title: The Way to Nordrassil
passages.text:
The time has come for us to use the Idol of the Wilds and commune with Malorne.

The ritual will require a great deal of power, so we have decided to convene at Nordrassil and draw upon the World Tree's essence.

There is no time to waste. The fastest path will be through the Emerald Dreamway. Go ahead, and we will follow.

passages.title: The Way to Nordrassil
passages.text: Something isn't right here, <name>. This isn't the Dream. Could Xavius' creatures have invaded our sanctuary? How did they get past our protective wards?

passages.title: A New Beginning
passages.text:
If Malorne is in danger, then things are even worse than I feared. It truly is up to us now.

We have very little time left. Let us reconvene in the Dreamgrove at once.

passages.title: A New Beginning
passages.text:
Thank you for all of your heroic efforts, great <class>. Without your help, we could not have recovered the Idol and spoken to Malorne himself.

Now that we know he is trapped in the Nightmare, we can devise a plan.

passages.title: The Demi-God's Return
passages.text:
<Malorne's voice echoes in your mind.>

Mortal you may be, but your valor is worthy of the ancient gods.

Nature's spirit lives in you - vibrant, wild, and ferocious. I witness in you the essence of nature's spark - the WILL to survive.

Our triumph here will be spoken of for ages to come, <name>.

Return to the waking world through this portal. We will speak again when we return to the Dreamgrove.

passages.title: The Demi-God's Return
passages.text: Nature's cycle is beautiful, but it can be frail. We must preserve its balance.

passages.title: The Demi-God's Return
passages.text:
<name>, we elders of the Dreamgrove have spoken and all agree. We would like to see you take leadership of the Dreamgrove.

Today, we grant you the title of Arch <class> of the Dreamgrove, a nomination of the highest honor in our order.

With it, you now carry the responsibility of our order: to protect the wilds! Lead well, <name>.

passages.title: Return of the Light
passages.text:
Excellent!

There is a gateway further down this pathway and like most Legion constructs it is powered by souls.

I think the death of that Inquisitor should be just enough to activate it and open the way back to where it came from.

Let's go see where the path takes us, shall we?

passages.title: Return of the Light
passages.text:
It is T'uure! I had thought it was lost to us forever!

When I last saw this staff we were escaping from a small world called Niskara. The Legion came upon us unawares, we were only able to escape thanks to a few brave Vindicators who remained behind with T'uure to stall their attack.

I did not think it could be done, but you were able to recover T'uure. You truly walk in the light, <name>. You have my respect, and my thanks.

passages.title: Searching the Archives
passages.text:
The Black Harvest archives contain an immeasurable amount of magical knowledge that has been collected from various sources over time. 

It's reasonable to think that somewhere among the countless scrolls that we'll find something to aid us in our mission to rescue the remaining council members. 

The search may be exhausting, but it is necessary if we plan to rebuild and face the Burning Legion.

passages.title: Searching the Archives
passages.text: Have the archives been searched yet?

passages.title: Searching the Archives
passages.text:
Our search of the archives recovered a tome that details the process of creating a demonic gateway. It has the power to access any demon world, assuming we know where to direct it.

We could use such a gateway to locate and retrieve the remaining council members.

passages.title: Black Rook Hold: An Unclaimed Soul
passages.text:
In order to create the anchor, we'll need to link something of Shinfel's to an unclaimed soul.

The soul will act like a beacon, guiding Shinfel through the Twisting Nether, and back to Dreadscar Rift.

Shinfel's staff should provide us with the link we need, but the soul will be a bit harder to find. 

Dwelling within Black Rook hold is an amalgam of souls, some lost and forgotten. Killing this monstrosity should provide us with the soul we need.

passages.title: Black Rook Hold: An Unclaimed Soul
passages.text: Have you recovered the soul yet?

passages.title: Black Rook Hold: An Unclaimed Soul
passages.text:
You never disappoint, <name>.

This otherwise forgotten soul will now serve a greater purpose.

passages.title: One Who's Worthy
passages.text:
If we wish to successfully summon the sisters, we'll need the help of a warlock who is skilled in summoning greater demons.

We cannot afford to lose another council member due to inexperience. 

The Broken Isles are swarming with new blood, all hoping to make a name for themselves in this time of chaos. 

Hopefully among them we can find one worthy of this council.

passages.title: One Who's Worthy
passages.text:
Our scouting efforts have hopefully paid off. I have a lead on a <class> who might possess the skills we need to perform the summoning ritual.

We should follow up as soon as possible.

passages.title: Dark Whispers
passages.text:
Felsoul Hold is not far away, but it is well defended. Very tough to get in the normal way, but Calydus can help you sneak in!

There is a portal that my kind use to haul in treasures, with it you can get in and find the skull!

passages.title: Dark Whispers
passages.text:
Friend was able to get the skull?

Yes, Calydus senses it! Keep its gaze turned away from Calydus, friend. I gladly work for you without compulsion.

passages.title: Building Our Troops
passages.text:
Archmage Omniara is a very powerful arcanist and her skills will be quite an asset to our order.

She is capable of summoning multiple Water Elementals at the same time! Fortunately, she has agreed to share her knowledge with us.

Speak to her now, and recruit her elementals.

passages.title: Building Our Troops
passages.text: How did the training go?

passages.title: Building Our Troops
passages.text: Well done. These troops will be invaluable in our fight against the Burning Legion. Deploy them on missions, just as you would with our champions.

passages.title: Ritual Reagents
passages.text:
The Skull of the Man'ari, oh good choice! It's very powerful and it's held by an even more powerful Dreadlord!

There is a weakness, the skull has a will of its own! If we can commune with the skull we might be able to convince it to serve you instead!

We will need reagents from the floating city before we can perform the ritual to commune with it. Dust from a fresh grave, dark oil, and a powerful alcohol catalyst.

Oh, and blood! I sense a beast whose blood should be perfect.

passages.title: Ritual Reagents
passages.text: Did you obtain everything, friend?

passages.title: Ritual Reagents
passages.text: Very good! Now, we're ready to begin.

passages.title: The Pendant of Starlight
passages.text:
To finish my work here, I will need a magical item called the Pendant of Starlight.

For centuries, the Archdruids of the Dreamgrove passed the pendant down from one guardian to the next. But one day, a naga siren used deception to take it!

This pendant stores a great amount of arcane power... power I can use to heal the grove.

Get it back, and I will be very grateful!

passages.title: The Pendant of Starlight
passages.text: Was there much killing?

passages.title: The Pendant of Starlight
passages.text: Yes, this is it... the pendant of the keepers! Hooray! Vengeance is so fun!

passages.title: Unexpected Visitors
passages.text: Brace yourself, <name>. I am detecting a strange magic forming in the chamber. Something is projecting itself in.

passages.title: Unexpected Visitors
passages.text: Caria and Varedis Felsoul are like a bad copper piece that keeps coming back.

passages.title: Unexpected Visitors
passages.text:
The two of them are puppets of Kil'jaeden and a bane on our existence. I am glad that you have their warglaives.

They will be that much easier to kill when we invade their world.

I wonder, do you have a moment to discuss a rather urgent issue?

passages.title: Rise, Champions
passages.text:
The Uncrowned work behind the scenes, pulling strings here, snipping others there. It's a matter of making the right choices at the right time in the most elegant manner possible.

We have all decided that you need to recruit some Shadows to send out on our most important missions. People that you can trust, or at least that you can trust to get the job done.

Might I suggest that you start with Garona and Vanessa? It should prove interesting if nothing else considering recent events.

passages.title: Rise, Champions
passages.text:
So, I guess I'll be hangin' out with Vanessa here a lot? Don't you worry 'bout nothin'.

She and I are gonna be besties.

Say, you gotta moment?

passages.title: A More Wretched Hive of Scum and Villainy
passages.text:
Word on the street is that you're lookin' to recruit some more, shall we say, unsavory types?

I know just the woman! No, not me... though, I could prolly do it. But not as well as Lonika Stillblade.

Yeah, that Lonika. The one who founded the 'School of Roguery' in Shattrath City.

So, let's send Vanessa there out to Outland and have her make Lonika an offer she can't refuse. Or, you know, give her a legit job and a nicer location for her rogue academy.

passages.title: A More Wretched Hive of Scum and Villainy
passages.text: So, what'd Lonika say?

passages.title: A More Wretched Hive of Scum and Villainy
passages.text:
Gold! The rogues, thieves, and cutthroats are gonna start rollin' in.

<Nikki looks over at Vanessa and says in a whisper.>

Maybe we'll even get some unemployed Defias to sign up. Too soon?

passages.title: Recruiting The Troops
passages.text:
Our champions acquired the talents of Summoner Morn, a powerful shaman.

He is known for his strong affinity with earth, and is a valuable addition to our Order. He is already beginning to requisition Lesser Elementals to our cause.

Speak to him now and train a Lesser Elemental.

passages.title: Recruiting The Troops
passages.text: How did the training go?

passages.title: Recruiting The Troops
passages.text: Excellent. These troops will be invaluable in our defense of the Broken Isles. Deploy them on missions, just as you would with our champions.

passages.title: Looking into the Darkness
passages.text:
Friend now is ready to perform the ritual!

Remember, friend, the skull must be convinced that it is in its best interest to be in your possession. If we must force the skull into your servitude, it would be far weaker.

passages.title: Looking into the Darkness
passages.text: The ritual circle is ready, friend.

passages.title: Looking into the Darkness
passages.text:
Yes, Felsoul Hold! Calydus knows where that is!

Calydus can make a path that connects to one of the portals there!

passages.title: Rise, Champions
passages.text:
We are still recovering from the attack at the Peak of Serenity.

To help us rebuild the order, we should enlist the greatest champions of our class to fight by our side.

I know that the two Stormstouts, Chen and Li Li, would eagerly pledge to join the cause. Speak to them and recruit them as champions, then speak to Master Hsu.

passages.title: Rise, Champions
passages.text:
Chen and Li Li are two of the greatest monks in recent history.

As long as they stay out of trouble, they will be great representatives of our order.

passages.title: Stolen Honor
passages.text:
Safeguarding the Gjallarhorn was my duty, <race>. I will do what is right, but first I must ask for your aid.

My family was disavowed by the mystics of our time and this grave was ransacked.

I cannot find peace while my family heirlooms are in the hands of the servants of the false God-King.

Return them to me and I will aid you in finding the Gjallarhorn!

passages.title: Stolen Honor
passages.text: Do you bring back my family's heirlooms, <race>?

passages.title: Stolen Honor
passages.text: Odyn truly guides your hand, <name>.

passages.title: Revenge, Served Cold
passages.text:
My village was razed by a drogbar tribe who worships the very beast you seek. No one was spared.

Help me avenge my people and I will aid you in your quest to find Jorhuttam.

passages.title: Revenge, Served Cold
passages.text: You return.

passages.title: Revenge, Served Cold
passages.text: You have my thanks, <name>.

passages.title: Jorhuttam
passages.text:
You upheld your end of your promise. I will do the same.

Take these drogbar drums. Then bang on them to call upon Jorhuttam to feast.

Find the Great Worm's feeding mound and use the drums to lure her out.

passages.title: Jorhuttam
passages.text: The Gjallerhorn, <name>.  Is it finally in your possession?

passages.title: Jorhuttam
passages.text: It is done! The armies of Ulduar are bound by oath to join us now that we're in possession of the Gjallerhorn!

passages.title: Eye of Azshara: The Tidestone of Golganneth
passages.text: <Now that you have defeated Queen Azshara's Wrath and have the Tidestone in hand, it is time to place it in the Portrait Room of the Chamber of the Guardian in lower Dalaran.>

passages.title: Eye of Azshara: The Tidestone of Golganneth
passages.text: <Archmage Khadgar has set aside a space here for the Tidestone of Golganneth, as well as the rest of the Pillars of Creation.>

passages.title: Empyrean Society Report
passages.text:
I find it hard to believe that Archmage Vargoth would be involved with such a malevolent group! There must be a good explanation for why he's been here... 

Regardless, we had best return to the Hall of the Guardian and inform Meryl about what we've uncovered here.

passages.title: Empyrean Society Report
passages.text: Ravandwyr speaks very highly of how you dealt with the Empyrean Society, <name>.

passages.title: Moonshade Holdout
passages.text: <Tampering with the relic has drawn the attention of some hideous creatures from beneath Falanaar.>

passages.title: Moonshade Holdout
passages.text: Do you have any idea what you have done?!

passages.title: Highmountain Tribes
passages.text: Assist the Tauren of Highmountain by completing 4 world quests.

passages.title: Highmountain Tribes
passages.text: The Highmountain tribes thank you.

passages.title: Fate of the Queen's Reprisal
passages.text: <This is the kind of intelligence that should be shared. Perhaps someone at the Windrunner's Sanctuary on Dalaran will know what to do with it.>

passages.title: Fate of the Queen's Reprisal
passages.text:
<The advisor looks down at what you're offering her and then looks around nervously, straining to give you a rictus grin. She continues in hushed tones.>

Do you know what you have here? You have kept the Alliance from getting their grubby little hands on some rather delicate information.

I will see to it personally that this is safely filed away.

passages.title: Their Dying Breaths
passages.text:
I have precious little time. As we speak, my troops are defending against an onslaught of withered elves.

These four whelplings are near death. Their lives are of the utmost importance to our flight, as they may be some of the last whelplings Senegos can rear.

Some cracked ley crystals should bring them back to their senses.

passages.title: Their Dying Breaths
passages.text: Oh no...

passages.title: Their Dying Breaths
passages.text:
Of course they would attack now.

Those withered devils couldn't have chosen a more effective time to strike. My brood already suffers.

passages.title: Arkethrax
passages.text:
Within the Ingress is a demon who must die.

Arkethrax is a creature of cunning evil. If left unchecked he will be able to use the Ingress as a staging point for targeted assaults that will decimate our forces.

I, for one, have no intention of underestimating this opponent and shall join you on the battlefield when you are ready to fight him.

passages.title: Arkethrax
passages.text: With Arkethrax and his minions dealt with it should help prevent them from flanking Illidari Stand. Well done.

passages.title: Study Hall: Combat Research
passages.text:
What's this? A new, confused student, desperately trying to win the favor of the headmistress, wandering the halls without anything to do?

Perfect! I need help with my research.

I'm writing a paper on combat. Grab me some books from the shelf over there.

passages.title: Study Hall: Combat Research
passages.text: I agree. Research can be grueling work.

passages.title: Study Hall: Combat Research
passages.text: My hand is beginning to tire from taking so many notes. I think it's time we took a break.

passages.title: The Brother's Trail
passages.text:
We must reclaim the Silver Hand before those with evil intent can seize it. To free it from its wards, we need relics called the Sparks of Tyr. I have one, as does my brother, Galford.

He journeyed to Northrend to seek aid from the Tyr's homeland, but has not returned.

I must ask you to find him, and his Spark.

passages.title: The Brother's Trail
passages.text: Any news on my brother? Or the Spark of Tyr?

passages.title: The Brother's Trail
passages.text:
A terrible loss. You have the Spark he held, though, and I have another.

We must press on. I will mourn Galford another day.

passages.title: Growing Power
passages.text: It appears you & your weapon are both growing in strength. Return to me at the Heart of Azeroth. I have more to show you.

passages.title: Bite of the Beast
passages.text:
I will not leave my post without Cora.

A group of mages have her caged up like a beast, threatening to put her down.

They claim she's responsible for the death of one of their own, but I refuse to believe that. Cora is a loyal and obedient companion; she would never attack without my command.

I tracked the demon that was truly responsible to this location, but it put up quite a fight before getting away. My injuries prevented me from giving chase, but I am sure that beast has left a bloody trail.

passages.title: Bite of the Beast
passages.text: I will not go anywhere until Cora is at my side.

passages.title: Bite of the Beast
passages.text: Thank you for securing Cora's release. She's still a bit skittish, but I think she'll recover in time.

passages.title: Unseen Protection
passages.text:
We will not let the city of Dalaran fall.

If the Legion is planning an attack, the Unseen Path will be there to stop it.

Our scouts' most recent reports list a few other areas that sound like they could really use our help, whether they realize it or not.

As soon as you're able, send your hunters to take care of the threats.

passages.title: Unseen Protection
passages.text: Whether they know it or not, the people of Azeroth have the Unseen Path to thank for their safety.

passages.title: Signaling Trouble
passages.text:
Long ago, we gave select leaders special flares that were only to be used in times of great need.

Upon seeing the flare, the leader of the Unseen Path is supposed to head to the southern watchtower to meet with whomever lit it.

I don't know who we'll face once we reach the tower, but we must move quickly.

passages.title: Signaling Trouble
passages.text:
I fear that the Burning Legion is planning to invade Dalaran.

I've dispatched members of the Kirin Tor to spy on various demon strongholds, with hopes that they can uncover any plots involving the city.

In the meantime, Dalaran could benefit from the protection of the Unseen Path. I know its citizens will be safe with the Unseen Path watching over them.

passages.title: Requesting Reinforcements
passages.text:
Many powerful factions have pledged their loyalty to the Unseen Path. It's time that we call on them to help us defeat Hakkar and his demon hounds.

Send your champions into the field to track down these leaders and let them know we require their help.

passages.title: Requesting Reinforcements
passages.text: Our allies have all gathered here at the lodge and are waiting to be updated on the situation.

passages.title: Informing Our Allies
passages.text:
Leaders from some of the greatest military factions are here, ready and willing to help.

They're currently waiting to speak with you directly, hoping to provide insight on how they can help.

With any luck, we can pull our resources and find a way to take Hakkar down.

passages.title: Informing Our Allies
passages.text: We cannot hope to defeat Hakkar without the help of our allies.

passages.title: Informing Our Allies
passages.text: With the faction leader's help and your leadership, Hakkar doesn't stand a chance.

passages.title: To Tame the Beast
passages.text:
Deep in the heart of Faronaar are dens that are overrun with felhounds. If Hakkar is breeding those beasts, that is the place he would do it.

The bait I've crafted is potent. Once you apply it, you'll draw the attention of nearby hounds, so only use it when you're close to the dens.

Once the demon has taken the bait, get it into a weakened state to make trapping easier.

Good luck, <name>. I hope you return in one piece.

passages.title: To Tame the Beast
passages.text: Be careful not to kill the felhound when trapping it. I need the subject alive to perform my tests.

passages.title: To Tame the Beast
passages.text: The Houndmaster has done some interesting things with this breed of felhound.

passages.title: The Nature of the Beast
passages.text:
By nature, this demon is immune to magic, but it has also been bred to be resistant to physical attacks. It's covered in scales unlike anything I've ever seen; layered and thick. I doubt that most metals will be able to pierce the demon's armor-like hide.

Unless your entire army has weapons like yours, I suggest fighting those beasts with something that will exploit their weakness.

passages.title: The Nature of the Beast
passages.text:
This is unsettling news. If our weapons won't work against Hakkar's minions, how are we going to defeat him?

We should call in our allies and see what they can do to help.

passages.title: Going Down, Going Up
passages.text:
Now that we have the necessary worm guts, I was able to fashion them into a special sort of rope.

It will allow you to descend from the bridge into the chasm below and recover some of my possessions that were stolen and thrown in by the Deeprock.

passages.title: Going Down, Going Up
passages.text: I have never been particularly fond of heights.

passages.title: Going Down, Going Up
passages.text:
I can't believe it! I hoped it would work, but I couldn't be sure.

You recovered heirlooms passed down by my family for many generations.

I thought them lost forever.

passages.title: The Shrine of Ashamane
passages.text:
The mighty Ancient, Ashamane, fell in battle against the Burning Legion ten thousand years ago. To honor her sacrifice, a group of devoted druids called the Ashen forged Ashamane's fangs into powerful daggers.

Take my signet and present it to their leader, Delandros Shimmermoon. He will know that you have my blessing.

Our flight master, Danise Stargazer, can see you to the shrine.

passages.title: The Shrine of Ashamane
passages.text:
Rensar sent you? As much as I'd like to help, whatever you need is going to have to wait. As you can see, we have bigger problems.

Actually, we could really use your help. If you could lend us your aid then I'll do all that I can to help you with whatever it is you're here for.

Would this be acceptable?

passages.title: Memories of Ebonchill
passages.text:
Is that Ebonchill you've got there? Alodi's old staff? My my my... <Cough>

In the days of the first guardian, all the members of the Council of Tirisfal granted their powers to the young mage in the hopes that he could overcome the Legion. <Wheeze> None of them are alive today... but that staff of yours remembers.

Search the streets of Dalaran below for reflections of the former council members. Their memories may empower you as they once did Alodi. Seek them out and speak with one!

passages.title: Memories of Ebonchill
passages.text: Seek out the memories of the former Council members. None are here in the upper floors of the tower, and none would be in the sewers. <Cough> Check the public squares, the inns, the lower floors of the tower, the streets... A sharp eye is your ally.

passages.title: Memories of Ebonchill
passages.text:
Ah, your eyes gleam with newfound knowledge, <name>.

That staff of yours has seen the passing of many mortal lifetimes.  It can teach you a great many things, if you're willing to listen.

As for its memories... they may be unreliable. You may find a different reflection haunts the streets of Dalaran each day. I leave it to you to find them all.

passages.title: The Emerald Nightmare: The Emerald Nightmare
passages.text:
The Lord of Nightmare, Xavius, is still out there. Cenarius is still in grave danger, deep within the Rift of Aln.

Summon your greatest allies, <name>. If we are to stare into the face of the Nightmare, we had best be ready.

Once you are ready, enter the Emerald Nightmare and defeat all the horrors you find there.

passages.title: The Emerald Nightmare: The Emerald Nightmare
passages.text: Never has the Nightmare spilled into our world. It is our duty to find the root of this evil, and destroy it.

passages.title: The Emerald Nightmare: The Emerald Nightmare
passages.text:
Finally, we are triumphant, <name>! With Xavius's defeat, the Nightmare's presence will slowly recede from the Emerald Dream.

The tranquil realm of the sleepers is safe once again. Our druids will work on its restoration and recovery.

Thank you, Archdruid <name>. Azeroth will see many more serene days and tranquil nights because of you.

passages.title: Prepare To Be Assimilated
passages.text:
The Empyrean Society is a dangerous cult. They claim to study all magic regardless of its source, but in reality they focus mostly on the forbidden. They will welcome you to their enclave if you bring them a magical artifact.

The Hatecoil naga have found the perfect gifts - a Pearl of Arcane Wisdom and scrolls from the depths beneath the Nar'thalas Academy. You will have to convince them to part with a few.

I will meet you on the road just north of the Empyrean Enclave.

passages.title: Prepare To Be Assimilated
passages.text: Have you found the Pearl and scrolls?

passages.title: Prepare To Be Assimilated
passages.text: Good. Now we should be able to enter the Empyrean Society enclave and have a look around.

passages.title: Seeds of Renewal
passages.text:
The Fangs of Ashamane are in danger, <name>. For ten thousand years a powerful magic ward has protected them from any would-be thieves, but the ward has weakened over time and is in danger of failing. My three most trusted Ashen have the Tel'andu seeds we need to perform the ritual of renewal, but the woods are now crawling with demons and I fear they have fallen.

No matter what, we cannot allow the Legion to obtain the Fangs! Go and find the Tel'andu seeds, we must hurry before the ward can be broken!

passages.title: Seeds of Renewal
passages.text: Have the Tel'andu seeds?

passages.title: Seeds of Renewal
passages.text:
Thank you, <name>.

My heart weeps for those who we've lost this day. The Legion will pay for this, I swear it!

passages.title: Nithogg's Tribute
passages.text:
It looks like the ravenbears have started gathering materials for some sort of tribute, but the storm drakes are keeping them from finishing what they started. 

From the looks of it, they're gathering fully intact stag horns and long tail feathers from the greatstags and eagles nearby. 

It shouldn't take too long to gather the rest of what they need.

passages.title: Nithogg's Tribute
passages.text: Ca-caw?

passages.title: Nithogg's Tribute
passages.text:
Caw! Caw! 

<The ravenbear chieftain flaps his wings excitedly when he sees the reagents you've brought.>

passages.title: Finding Ebonchill
passages.text:
Ebonchill bears a lineage of powerful wielders dating back to its maker, Alodi. He passed it on to his favorite apprentice and so on until... the archmage Arrexis, I believe.

Arrexis disappeared sometime around the First War. I know nothing of his fate, but the answer may well be somewhere in this library.

Start by looking around here. Whatever you find should lead us to Ebonchill.

passages.title: Finding Ebonchill
passages.text: Have we found what we need yet?

passages.title: Finding Ebonchill
passages.text:
From the texts you found, it is clear that Ebonchill is in the hands of Balaadur. There is no way he would not claim such a powerful staff.

That is a problem, but not an impossible one. All we need to do is get access to Balaadur.

passages.title: The Hammer of Khaz'goroth
passages.text: <Now that you have defeated Dargrul the Underking and have the Hammer of Khaz'goroth in hand, it is time to place it in Aegwynn's Gallery in the lower chambers of Dalaran.>

passages.title: The Hammer of Khaz'goroth
passages.text: <Archmage Khadgar has set aside a space here for the Hammer of Khaz'goroth, as well as the rest of the Pillars of Creation.>

passages.title: Alodi's Gems
passages.text:
Arrexis had a cadre of apprentices and subordinates to help him with the ritual, something you are currently lacking.

In older times, when magic was less understood and spells required vast amounts of mana to cast, we stored mana in gems for use in complex spells.

Lucky for us, I still have a few powerful Mana Gems in my vault, along with some other useful items. You merely need to go to the Bank of Dalaran and gain access.

passages.title: Alodi's Gems
passages.text: You found everything in my vault? I hope the defenses weren't a bother.

passages.title: Alodi's Gems
passages.text:
Excellent! Honestly, I'm surprised you mages no longer use Mana Gems. I found them terribly useful.

At any rate, these will make up for the lack of additional mages.

passages.title: The Deadwind Site
passages.text:
Your research spoke of an experimental site out near Karazhan. I hope there are still materials on this ritual that will aid us there.

You will need to find the site and bring back anything that will help us recreate the ritual. I will dig deeper here as well.

passages.title: The Deadwind Site
passages.text: I trust you were successful?

passages.title: The Deadwind Site
passages.text:
This is better than I hoped. A working ward prototype and the ritual notes as well!

I'm beginning to believe this is possible!

passages.title: Daio the Decrepit
passages.text:
That text lists someone named Daio as being instrumental to the demonic ritual. They can't possibly mean Daio the Decrepit!

I never knew he was Kirin Tor. I only know him as an elderly warlock who trains young recruits in the infernal arts. This would certainly explain his change of occupation.

He most likely holds key information for this to work. Though retired, I believe he is still out in the Tainted Scar in the Blasted Lands. You should seek him out.

passages.title: Daio the Decrepit
passages.text: Well, what did Daio have to say?

passages.title: Daio the Decrepit
passages.text:
Our order suffered a great loss that day. It is a shame we chose to hide it instead of study it.

You have another critical element to the ritual, and we are one step closer.

passages.title: Put It All on Red
passages.text:
All right, I've got one last beasty to send you after. He's a bit far out, but trust me, it'll be worth it. This one I put a huge wager on!

Along the eastern coast swims a great shark the locals call Steelscale. They say his hide is near impenetrable.

But you're gonna prove them wrong, aren't ya chum? Bring me his fin, and those tauren will have to fork over a princely sum.

passages.title: Put It All on Red
passages.text: Hmm...

passages.title: Put It All on Red
passages.text:
<A note from the goblins is left behind, along with an old magnifying glass>

I wish I coulda been there to see the look on your face, but Raz and I got bigger fish to fry!

Thanks for the trophies and meat. I'm sure they'll fetch a nice sum on the black market, along with all the goodies we got from those stupid tauren! I'm sure they won't be needing them any more!

So long sucker!

passages.title: Thalyssra's Abode
passages.text:
While you were busy in the city I reached a roadblock in my withered research.
