I feel I am close to overcoming this barrier, but I'm afraid I cannot do so without some more advanced tools.

I hid among my possessions an item called an Arcane Amplifier. It does precisely what its name entails.

It is more than likely that the Magistrix ordered my estate dismantled. If the Amplifier remains, it will be in fragments.

Recover the whole, if you can.

passages.title: Thalyssra's Abode
passages.text: Did you find it?

passages.title: Thalyssra's Abode
passages.text: How lucky we are that it could be recovered... thank you.

passages.title: Finishing the Job
passages.text:
Garona set out to assassinate the leaders of a Legion cult some time ago. We haven't heard from her since.

To make matters worse, she took the Kingslayers with her. She knows they bring out the worst in her!

Your best bet to find Garona is by continuing her work. Our intel points to a warlock by the name of Caden Shadowgaze inducting new recruits at the Altar of Storms in Blasted Lands. See if he has anything useful in his pockets.

Once he's dead, I mean.

passages.title: No Sanctuary
passages.text:
We have one other lead that may prove useful. Goes by Felcaller Whitley, another of the cult's elite. He's eluded our agents at every turn.

Our latest reconnaissance report puts him somewhere in the village of Raven Hill in Duskwood. He's sure to have information vital to your search.

You know what to do.

passages.title: Codebreaker
passages.text:
<The coded message you obtained is protected by powerful magic, rendering it indecipherable by conventional means.>

<If you use the cipher you took from Felcaller Whitley you might be able to crack the code, leading you ever closer to both the cult's base of operations and Garona.>

passages.title: Immortal Soul
passages.text:
Illidan's immortal demon soul is lost somewhere in the vastness of the Twisting Nether. Contacting him risks much, the Nether is full of creatures of unimaginable power and appetites. But, it must be done if we are to move forward.

The ritual can be performed using the nether crucible. Make the blood offering, <name>.

passages.title: Immortal Soul
passages.text: All that is left is to make the blood offering. Then, we will see what the future holds for the Illidari.

passages.title: Immortal Soul
passages.text: We must prepare. There is much to do.

passages.title: Ritual of Doom
passages.text:
Your research has granted you access to a very powerful ritual, one that will require the aid of a few friends if you wish to successfully summon a demon.

The ritual needs to be performed at the summoning platform above. 

Keep in mind, this sort of power always comes at a price. Not all who participate in the summoning will survive, so be prepared.

passages.title: Ritual of Doom
passages.text: You can begin the ritual on the summoning platform above.

passages.title: Ritual of Doom
passages.text:
So I take it things went well then?

A ritual of that magnitude requires a bit of recovery time. You cannot expect to perform it more than once a day.

passages.title: A Terrible Loss
passages.text:
I would say I am surprised by this terrible turn of events, but nothing surprises me of late. It is dark times when even the most upstanding of us can fall... 

We had best inform Archmage Khadgar of Vargoth's betrayal.

passages.title: A Terrible Loss
passages.text: The loss of Archmage Vargoth from our order is terrible to hear, <name>. These are indeed dark times.

passages.title: Making Contact
passages.text:
Now that we have recruited champions for our order, we can use the Scouting Map to complete vital assignments across the Broken Isles.

Over the years our scouts have kept a close eye on hunters that might one day be added to our ranks. One such hunter, Lenara, was on her way to Trueshot Lodge when she was attacked.

I suggest that we send Loren Stormhoof on a mission to rescue her. He may be uniquely suited to this task.

passages.title: Making Contact
passages.text: How is the mission proceeding?

passages.title: Making Contact
passages.text: Good, your champions were successful with their mission! We may be seeing some new faces around here soon.

passages.title: Recruiting The Troops
passages.text:
Our champions acquired the talents of Recruiter Lenara, an extraordinary archer.

She can hit the smallest of targets at extended ranges. Her arrows never miss.

Speak to her now and train a squad of archers.

passages.title: Recruiting The Troops
passages.text: How did the training go?

passages.title: Recruiting The Troops
passages.text: Excellent. These troops will be invaluable in our defense of the Broken Isles. Deploy them on missions, just as you would with our champions.

passages.title: Troops in the Field
passages.text: It's time to send our newly trained archers out into the field. Look at the Scouting Map and send your champions and troops on a routine scouting mission.

passages.title: Troops in the Field
passages.text: How did it go?

passages.title: Troops in the Field
passages.text:
The scouting mission was more successful than we could have imagined, <name>. Your troops were able to rescue Survivalist Bahn, a cunning strategist.

In thanks, he has agreed to lend his skill to our cause.

passages.title: Tech It Up A Notch
passages.text:
We are very fortunate to have come across Survivalist Bahn. He spent his younger years living off the land in Pandaria, relying on the native flora and fauna to survive.

His firsthand experience with building from limited resources could really help shape Trueshot Lodge into something great.

Speak to him now and see what he can do for us.

passages.title: Tech It Up A Notch
passages.text: Have you spoken with Survivalist Bahn yet?

passages.title: Tech It Up A Notch
passages.text: Excellent choice, <name>. Survivalist Bahn has made the lodge his home, so just speak to him when you want to make upgrades.

passages.title: Cloak and Dagger
passages.text:
<The cultists seem to have a base of operations in Darkshire. At least Althea Ebonlocke is a member, but it is likely that the entire Night Watch has been compromised.>

<The best course of action for now is to retrieve the dark implements for their ritual and make an attempt on Althea's life. Garona will have to wait.>

passages.title: Sister Lilith
passages.text:
We will need more allies on our side before we can be effective, Archdruid. A skilled dryad by the name of Sister Lilith is on her way to the Dreamgrove, but we've received word that she may be in trouble.

Send Zen'tabra to her aid.

passages.title: Sister Lilith
passages.text: Do not delay. Sister Lilith is in trouble.

passages.title: Sister Lilith
passages.text: Excellent, <name>. Zen'tabra has done well.

passages.title: A Glade Defense
passages.text:
We have a new mission that needs our attention, Archdruid. Deep in the forests of Val'sharah, a small druidic outpost known as Shal'doren Grove is under attack by satyrs.

Send our champions to deal with this threat at once, <name>. We cannot allow these satyr incursions to grow unchecked!

passages.title: A Glade Defense
passages.text: The satyrs are growing bolder with every day.

passages.title: A Glade Defense
passages.text: Not only was the mission a success, but our champions recovered an inscribed leaf of ancient knowledge. These may be of great interest to Leafbeard the Storied, the Ancient of Lore who resides to the north.

passages.title: Branching Out
passages.text:
Leafbeard is known as the Storied for good reason.

It is said that he remembers tales from before the Sundering. After examining the inscribed leaf that our champions recovered, he may be able to provide new knowledge and improvements for the grove.

Go take it to him now.

passages.title: Branching Out
passages.text: It is said that Leafbeard never forgets anything.

passages.title: Branching Out
passages.text: Well done! I see that Leafbeard's advice has already been useful.

passages.title: Moozy's Reunion
passages.text:
You will never know how thankful we are to you, <race>. Because of you, Moozy and my husband are safe. I won't let either of them out of my sight!

I am sorry to ask one last favor of you, but do you think you could find my mother and bring her here so she can see that her grandchild is safe?

Her name is Ethel, and her home is on the northern bluff of Thunder Totem.

passages.title: Moozy's Reunion
passages.text: Thank you for your kindness. Truly.

passages.title: Moozy's Reunion
passages.text: Your kindness will not be forgotten. You are a friend to my family, <name>.

passages.title: Mountainstrider Round-Up
passages.text:
Stranger! You are the one I have heard of?

When the kerfuffle with the drogbar happened, some of the young moose ran off!

I can't chase them down or the others might wander off as well.

Could you bring them back here?

passages.title: Mountainstrider Round-Up
passages.text: The moose are already broken. Just hop in the saddle and you can bring them here to me!

passages.title: Mountainstrider Round-Up
passages.text: Thank you, friend to Highmountain.

passages.title: Tech It Up A Notch
passages.text:
We are very fortunate to have come across Archivist Melinda. She is somewhat of an anomaly, as not many from her race choose our path. What makes her even more unique is her meticulous study of our craft. Her knowledge will be unsurpassed.

Speak to her now and seek her council. With her help, we can surely strengthen the council.

passages.title: Tech It Up A Notch
passages.text: Archivist Melinda's skills will allow us to make certain upgrades to Dreadscar Rift.

passages.title: Tech It Up A Notch
passages.text: Excellent choice, <name>. Archivist Melinda will remain within Dreadscar Rift, so just speak to her when you want to upgrade more of the class hall.

passages.title: Troops in the Field
passages.text: It's time to send our newly trained imps out into the field. Look at the Dreadscar Battle Plans and send your champions and troops on a routine scouting mission.

passages.title: Troops in the Field
passages.text: How did it go?

passages.title: Troops in the Field
passages.text:
The scouting mission was more successful than we could have imagined, <name>. Your troops were able to rescue Archivist Melinda, a brilliant strategist.

In thanks, she has agreed to lend her skill to our cause.

passages.title: Information at Any Cost
passages.text:
Now that you've found other warlocks that are willing to aid your cause, we can use the Dreadscar Battle Plans to complete vital assignments across the Broken Isles.

If we wish to rebuild the council, we must start by locating its missing members.

Let us send Ritssyn and Calydus to interrogate the Burning Legion's minions. They might have information that will help us locate the missing council members.

passages.title: Information at Any Cost
passages.text: How is the mission proceeding?

passages.title: Information at Any Cost
passages.text: Ritssyn and Calydus were successful in getting information, though we don't know how reliable it is, considering how it was obtained.

passages.title: Recruiting the Troops
passages.text:
Captain Stahlstrom has arrived. It would be advisable to speak to him and see that the valarjar are armed and ready for battle.

We'll need more than your two champions if we're to win a full-fledged war against the Legion.

passages.title: Recruiting the Troops
passages.text: What can I do for you, <name>?

passages.title: Recruiting the Troops
passages.text: We are well underway. Before long you will command an army to be reckoned with.

passages.title: Troops in the Field
passages.text:
Our enemies' transgressions have gone unchecked for long enough. Now that we have troops to back your champions, you would do well to send them to deal with them.

One of our own has been taken prisoner by Odyn's sworn nemesis, Helya. If your forces manage to bring back Einar the Runecaster alive he can aid us in using powerful runes to advance the power of your armies.

passages.title: Troops in the Field
passages.text: I greet you.

passages.title: Troops in the Field
passages.text: Excellent! With the runecaster's powers your armies will be even stronger!

passages.title: Ceremonial Drums
passages.text:
Those foolish calves!

They've made off with our ceremonial drums again, treating them as toys... as... common drums!

Can you help me find them? They must be scattered to all corners of Thunder Totem by now, discarded as soon as the fun dries up.

passages.title: Ceremonial Drums
passages.text: Can you feel the beat?

passages.title: Ceremonial Drums
passages.text: Nice! Got 'em! Feel free to play the drums, but leave them down here, will you? You're alright by me, <name>.

passages.title: The Mystery of Dreyrgrot
passages.text:
Well met, good chap!

I was on my way to study the local murlocs when I stumbled upon these most peculiar ruins. Those pirates over yonder arrived first, and it appears they've unleashed some ancient evil.

I would be remiss to let such an evil run rampant, but we should learn more of it before we proceed, lest we end up like those chaps.

I spied the crew bringing back some tablets from the ruins. If you can bring them to me, I may be able to decipher the nature of this evil.

passages.title: The Mystery of Dreyrgrot
passages.text: How goes the hunt for knowledge?

passages.title: The Mystery of Dreyrgrot
passages.text:
Excellent! Luckily I brought a copy of the vrykul cipher that the League procured from Northrend.

I'll get to work on this straightforth! Let us hope the dialects are not too dissimilar.

passages.title: A Stone of Blood
passages.text:
Unfortunately, we may have another problem. That mist seeping out of the ruins has affected the looting pirates. It's driven them quite mad.

Only one of them seems to be unaffected - a captainly fellow with a very fine hat. He wears a large ruby amulet, which I believe protects him from the mist. You'll need it if you are to enter the tomb.

He may not give it up willingly.

passages.title: A Stone of Blood
passages.text: We will need the amulet's protection to proceed.

passages.title: A Stone of Blood
passages.text:
You have the amulet! Most excellent!

Of course, that probably won't help you with the pirates that are already mad as hatters, but small victories, eh chap?

passages.title: Break the Bonds
passages.text:
The Bonespeaker mystics used these heirlooms to tie my soul to this world.

Under their curse, my soul could not enter the Halls of Valor. Find the soul pyre in Haustvald and throw my belongings into the flames.

The fire that bound my soul through their foul magic will be the same fire that undoes this bond!

passages.title: Break the Bonds
passages.text: Is it done yet, CONCUSSED?

passages.title: Break the Bonds
passages.text: I can feel it. My soul is my own again!

passages.title: Darkheart Thicket: Nightmare Oak
passages.text:
Blacksmith Kyriel is no stranger to the Farstriders. He has forged countless arrows for us in the past, using his knowledge of unique materials to help build better, stronger ammo.

He's efficient and gifted, making the most of scarce materials.

Using a single branch from a corrupted ancient, he can craft thousands of arrows.

passages.title: Darkheart Thicket: Nightmare Oak
passages.text: Have you recovered the oak yet?

passages.title: Darkheart Thicket: Nightmare Oak
passages.text: A little bit of oak can go a long way when making ammo.

passages.title: In Defense of Dalaran
passages.text:
We have everything we need to set the trap for Hakkar.

Archmage Khadgar will summon a portal to the Violet Hold. Once inside, he will begin to channel his essence into the arcane vessel at your command.

Our allies will be armed with the weapons you brought them, ready to fight when Hakkar takes the bait.

passages.title: In Defense of Dalaran
passages.text: You have no idea how relieved I am to see you!

passages.title: Vault of the Wardens: Matters of the Heart
passages.text:
I have made considerable progress with the Bloodstone, thanks in part to your extensive testing.

The stone feeds on blood to grow in power, but its ability to control a demon comes from consuming a corrupted heart; the more powerful, the better.

Within the Vault of the Wardens you'll find someone with such a heart.

passages.title: Vault of the Wardens: Matters of the Heart
passages.text: The Bloodstone will grow in power after consuming Cordana's heart.

passages.title: Vault of the Wardens: Matters of the Heart
passages.text: Once this heart is devoured, the Bloodstone will be strong enough to control the eredar sisters.

passages.title: Rise, Champions
passages.text:
The matron mother, Lady S'theno, and I have been watching you and the rest of the Illidari. We have something of an outsider's perspective on things, which gives us a degree of objectivity. We have come to a unanimous recommendation: in order to keep the Illidari from splintering, you must begin to recruit champions.

These exalted few will aid in projecting your power beyond the confines of the Fel Hammer.

Our unanimous recommendations for the first two are Altruis and Asha.

passages.title: Rise, Champions
passages.text: You have selected your first two champions. There are great things ahead of us, <name>.

passages.title: Rise, Champions
passages.text:
The matron mother, Lady S'theno, and I have been watching you and the rest of the Illidari. We have something of an outsider's perspective on things, which gives us a degree of objectivity. We have come to a unanimous recommendation: in order to keep the Illidari from splintering, you must begin to recruit champions.

These exalted few will aid in projecting your power beyond the confines of the Fel Hammer.

Our unanimous recommendations for the first two are Kayn and Asha.

passages.title: Rise, Champions
passages.text: You have selected your first two champions. There are great things ahead of us, <name>.

passages.title: Growing Power
passages.text:
I see you have grown in strength. With it, some of the untapped potential within your weapon is released.

Come back to the Hall of the Guardian when you are done with your adventures, and I will show you more.

passages.title: Things Gaardoun Needs
passages.text:
Battlelord Gaardoun has offered to recruit more broken warriors for the cause. He just needs a few things first. He said something about the right tool for the job, or something like that.

Time to put your new champions to the test. I'm sure it will be a grueling mission.

passages.title: Things Gaardoun Needs
passages.text: Did they come back already with whatever it is that Gaardoun needs?

passages.title: Things Gaardoun Needs
passages.text:
Well, at least we're going to have some fresh faces around here. If a broken's face can ever be called fresh, that is.

<Kor'vas smirks.>

passages.title: Black Rook Hold: Into Black Rook Hold
passages.text:
This thing is ancient. Just turning the pages risks them disintegrating in my hands.

Here, I have found it. An entry about the Raven's Eye.

<Valeera traces her finger from left to right above the page. A look of discovery comes over her features, which is quickly replaced by a frown.>

It says here that the last person to have possession of the eye was Lord Ravencrest himself. You are going to have to go into Black Rook Hold and take it from him.

passages.title: Black Rook Hold: Into Black Rook Hold
passages.text: <name>, were you successful? Do you have the Raven's Eye?

passages.title: Black Rook Hold: Into Black Rook Hold
passages.text: We have it. Finally, we will be able to crack SI:7's coded letter.

passages.title: Broken Warriors
passages.text:
It's important that we increase our numbers. Trust me, I know these things. Battlelord Gaardoun and his Ashtongue warriors are our best bet to quickly accomplish such a task.

You should speak with him and let him know just what kind of broken you want trained.

passages.title: Broken Warriors
passages.text: How are the new Ashtongue troops coming along?

passages.title: Broken Warriors
passages.text: Outstanding. These new Ashtongue will give you the flexibility you need to position troops wherever you see fit.

passages.title: Deciphering the Letter
passages.text:
We have the Raven's Eye. Use it, <name>. Decipher the SI:7 letter.

We must know what secrets it contains!

passages.title: Deciphering the Letter
passages.text: Why do you hesitate? Decipher the note.

passages.title: Deciphering the Letter
passages.text:
I must admit, I was not expecting that. Mathias Shaw taken prisoner by the Legion.

That, at least, explains all of the strange actions SI:7 has been taking lately. They have a dreadlord in charge of them.

passages.title: Loramus, Is That You?
passages.text:
Belath Dawnblade has given us a strange scouting report from the Felblaze Ingress in Azsuna. The dreadlord, Razelikh the Defiler has returned to the world. That's not the odd part, though.

Strangely, he's sometimes going around killing the other demons and calling himself, Loramus!

Last we knew, our demon hunter brother, Loramus Thalipedes sacrificed himself to defeat Razelikh, whom he'd been possessed by.

Your champions and Ashtongue warriors need to go to Azsuna and find out what is going on.

passages.title: Loramus, Is That You?
passages.text: Odd. That is all I have to say about the situation.

passages.title: Loramus, Is That You?
passages.text:
They've returned with him. It's Loramus, alright. But, he's trapped within the body of the dreadlord, Razelikh the Defiler!

Until we can make sure he doesn't pose a danger, I've ordered him kept in one of our demon traps, below.

passages.title: Demonic Improvements
passages.text:
Having Loramus back will work greatly to our advantage, despite the fact that he's trapped inside Razelikh's body... and also that the demon sometimes takes control.

Still, he was one of our most powerful demon hunters. And now, he also has the knowledge of a dreadlord at his disposal.

I think we should have him share his knowledge and wisdom with us to improve our odds in this war.

passages.title: Demonic Improvements
passages.text: What did Loramus the Dreadlord have to say?

passages.title: Demonic Improvements
passages.text:
That sounds like good news. He is already contributing to the cause and we are that much stronger for his help.

Still, he is not fully in control of Razelikh. I think it best that we leave him in that trap until we can find him a new body. Don't you?

And, if he proves to be too much of a problem, we can take 'other' measures.

passages.title: Throwing SI:7 Off the Trail
passages.text:
SI:7 is dogging our heels at every turn. We must make certain that they do not catch wind of what we are up to.

To that end, I have some suggestions for you in the form of missions. Send your champions, assign your forces, it matters little to me. The important thing is that we keep them out of Val'sharah and away from Black Rook Hold.

At least until we can decipher that damned letter.

passages.title: Throwing SI:7 Off the Trail
passages.text:
Surprisingly nice bit of work there. What I am hearing from our scouts is that the diversions are working perfectly.

As an added bonus, some of my suspicions about a particular item, which will prove useful in deciphering the SI:7 letter, have come to light in Stormheim.

passages.title: Back from the Dead
passages.text:
<Olothil sighs.>

My sister tries my patience sometimes.

No matter. I've identified a few locations that our parents might be. I shall search in this area with Kallistia. You've already helped us so much... would you help us look to the east?

You can use my scrying orb to see the locations that our ritual has uncovered.

passages.title: Back from the Dead
passages.text: Thank you for your aid, <class>.

passages.title: Back from the Dead
passages.text:
After over ten thousand years... to see mother and father again...

<The elven mage is at a loss for words.>

Thank you, <name>. Thank you.

passages.title: A Personal Request
passages.text:
If you have a moment, Deathlord... there is a personal matter I would like to speak with you about.

Some time ago, a brother of the Ebon Blade was imprisoned beneath the ruins of Lordaeron by the Dark Lady.

Sylvanas has refused all attempts to negotiate his release. Now, our world faces destruction and the time for diplomacy has passed.

Koltira Deathweaver cannot fight the Burning Legion in chains.

So we will break them.

passages.title: A Personal Request
passages.text: The time has come to release Koltira Deathweaver from captivity.

passages.title: A Personal Request
passages.text: Sylvanas will not be pleased with our actions, but we have more to worry about than offending the Dark Lady.

passages.title: Eye of Azshara: Cleansing the Dreamway
passages.text:
Brightwing has lots of friends. I like friends!

But you know who isn't Brightwing's friend? Scary monsters from the nightmare!

They hurt Brightwing's allies, and they made the grove all yucky!

This place needs to be cleansed, but I'm all out of magic.

Can you bring Brightwing some purified water to help? You'll have to go far, far away... to the Eye of Azshara where the naga live.

passages.title: Eye of Azshara: Cleansing the Dreamway
passages.text: Poor, poor flowers...

passages.title: Eye of Azshara: Cleansing the Dreamway
passages.text: Oh! Clean water, so pure and magical! Thank you, hero!

passages.title: Deadlier Warglaives
passages.text:
Loramus has researched a way to make our warglaives even deadlier, especially against demons.

If he's to be trusted, he says that all he needs is an amount of Obliterum. Normally, the substance is used to improve the protection of armor, but Loramus insists he can use it for our warglaives.

I am certain we will all benefit from their increased deadliness on the battlefield.

passages.title: Deadlier Warglaives
passages.text: Have you obtained the Obliterum?

passages.title: Deadlier Warglaives
passages.text:
That stuff's hard to get and expensive. Impressive! I can't wait to see the results.

Ready for the next big task? No rest for the wicked.

passages.title: A Very Special Kind of Fuel
passages.text:
All Legion constructs, including the Fel Hammer, are powered by souls. If we are going to take the command center to Niskara, we are going to need some very powerful souls, indeed!

You are a very creative person, <name>. I am certain that you will find a way to get what we need from the right sorts of creatures.

passages.title: A Very Special Kind of Fuel
passages.text: <name>, do you have what Allari asked you to harvest for fuel?

passages.title: A Very Special Kind of Fuel
passages.text:
Of course. Like all Legion constructs, the Fel Hammer is powered by souls. You have collected some of the most powerful souls around.

They should be enough to take us anywhere you want to go.

passages.title: Into the Oculus
passages.text:
I fear Kathra'natir is behind the attack on Meryl. We have little time to act. 

I suspect Archmage Vargoth's involvement is no coincidence. While it greatly pains me to destroy an archmage of his caliber and worse, someone I once called friend, we cannot permit his betrayal to stand unpunished. 

It is time to follow him into the Oculus.

passages.title: Into the Oculus
passages.text: You have done the unimaginable, <name>.We are all in your debt. I am proud to henceforth name you Archmage <name>!

passages.title: The Battle for Broken Shore
passages.text:
This is your vessel, <name>. She's a fine ship; been through many a campaign. Speak with the ship's captain when you're ready to depart.

Good luck out there. We've received few reports about what's happening at the Broken Shore, but I'd wager King Varian has matters well in hand.

passages.title: The Battle for Broken Shore
passages.text:
Ah, <name>, you're up! I'm relieved you made it out of that bloodbath alive. We lost so many good women and men down there...

Damn the Horde for serving us up to the Legion!

passages.title: Where the Wildkin Are
passages.text:
Owlbeasts are often charged with protecting places of importance to Elune. But if her influence over them wanes or is cut off, the creatures can become dangerous.

These wildkin, unfortunately, must be dealt with. The recent disturbances in Val'sharah have driven these creatures to madness.

Once an individual is lost, there is only one way to address the problem.

I cannot bring myself to kill one of Elune's creations, but I know what must be done.

passages.title: Where the Wildkin Are
passages.text: I wish it did not have to come to this, truly.

passages.title: Jump-Capable
passages.text:
While it is true that the Fel Hammer is powered, sadly, its jump engines are non-functional. If we are going to invade a demon world, we're going to have to make the command center jump-capable.

We need some replacement parts.

Luckily for us, the Legion brought a couple of command centers and soul engines along with them to the Broken Isles. You will find them at Faronaar in Azsuna, and at Felsoul Hold in Suramar.

passages.title: Jump-Capable
passages.text: It's vile the way this thing operates. The whole thing is powered by souls... you do NOT want to know what happens to them.

passages.title: Jump-Capable
passages.text:
These will do nicely. We couldn't have asked for better.

Tell me, were the demons angry when you stole their precious parts?

passages.title: The Wanderer's Companion
passages.text:
Fu Zan... a wise choice. If the legends are true, its powers will be essential to our cause.

We believe that the staff possessed by the Monkey King could be fabled Fu Zan, yet no one has seen him with the weapon for over a year.

the Monkey King was last spotted at Tian Monastery. Be prepared for anything! He is known for being... less than forthcoming with his answers.

Tak-Tak, a hozen kite-master, is skulking around west of the temple. Speak to him without delay.

passages.title: The Wanderer's Companion
passages.text:
You seek my staff? You make me laugh!
You say you want my help and time?
Okay then, wikket, hear this rhyme:

Three new riddles will I ask,
Three true answers are your task.
Prove you're smart, show you're worth it.
Answer the King and we'll unearth it!

passages.title: The Trial at the Temple
passages.text:
My staff was strong and mighty without peer, but since I not its master, in time it would soon disappear.

The staff was a gift from the Jade Serpent, Yu'lon, but for only a single task. With my work finished, to her again it has passed.

Yu'lon be the staff's keeper, holding it for those who are blessed. To her we now go now, to announce your request.

passages.title: The Trial at the Temple
passages.text: I knew you'd succeed, <name>. I'm honored to be at your service.

passages.title: The Riddle of the Barrel
passages.text:
My weapon is great when in a fight,
It's even handy when you sit for a bite.

My favorite flask I've tied on it, hanging from a cord,
The brews within are some of the best that I've ever scored.

If you truly seek my weapon then bring me something nice to put into my belly,
A powerful brew is what I want, something strong and smelly.

passages.title: The Riddle of the Barrel
passages.text: Ah, it returns. Has the wikkit brought what I'm looking for?

passages.title: The Riddle of the Barrel
passages.text: Them greenies were really curious about this smelly brew. It's powerful and smelly, I wonder if it's delicious too?

passages.title: The Riddle of the Land
passages.text:
My weapon is strong but not for attacking, 
Protecting the weak is what it's enacting.

In the valley are people who till the land from dawn to night,
The fruits of their labor, you must show me tonight.

Sacks of grain are what I require,
Not just any will do, only those kissed by a fire.

Bring me what I seek.

passages.title: The Riddle of the Land
passages.text: Ah, it returns. Has the wikkit brought what I'm looking for?

passages.title: The Riddle of the Land
passages.text:
For this grain, the wikkets work real hard. They toil and struggle so they do not starve.

With these bags safe from the greenies, we should do the right thing and give them back.

Okay, maybe we take a bit for ourselves, probably just one sack.

passages.title: The Riddle of Purity
passages.text:
Do you seek my weapon? Then you better answer my question.

 "I seek something curvy and bendy but with no spine,

 It rushes and rushes leaving chaos behind.

 Sometimes it brings life, sometimes it brings death:

 A little is good, but a lot steals your breath.

 It's as common as dirt, but this part's obscure:

 This stuff comes from a pool that's known to be pure."

Bring me what I seek.

passages.title: The Riddle of Purity
passages.text: Ah, it returns. Has the wikkit brought what I'm looking for?

passages.title: The Riddle of Purity
passages.text:
This splashie spirit core holds far more water than you might think. Enough to fill a big bowl or a small sink!

I bet we can find some good use for it, like squeezing it out to make ookin' excellent slerp!

passages.title: Seeking Guidance
passages.text:
Highlord Tirion may be gone, but the Ashbringer is still out there somewhere. Its power would devastate the Legion. We must find it!

I wish it were as simple as returning to where Tirion fell. It could be anywhere on that infernal landscape by now.

I believe an old friend can help us find the blade. I ask that you place your faith in me and journey to Uther's tomb in the Plaguelands. We will seek answers there.

passages.title: Seeking Guidance
passages.text: These brave watchers require our aid. The Light may well ignore our prayers if we choose not to help our brethren.

passages.title: Two Worthies
passages.text:
As our forces grow, and our reach extends ever outward, you have need of more trusted companions to handle the most important of missions.

The time has come for you to elevate two worthies into the ranks of your champions. 

It's my opinion that you should consider recruiting Belath and Malevolence. They have both proven themselves indispensable.

passages.title: Two Worthies
passages.text:
You now have six champions, all of the Illidari and its forces, as well as a growing army of troops, all willing to make the ultimate sacrifice to bring down the Burning Legion.

Time to prepare for the endgame.

passages.title: To Be Prepared
passages.text:
Allies from across Azeroth have come to Stormwind to support our efforts against the Burning Legion.

Before you ship out, you should pay them a visit. Every bit of preparation helps!

passages.title: To Be Prepared
passages.text: The Light protects those who protect themselves!

passages.title: To Be Prepared
passages.text:
It's good to see you've prepared yourself. You never know what you'll be facing out there.

We've commissioned these rings for high-ranking members of the Alliance. May this one protect you in the battle to come.

passages.title: Deal With It Personally
passages.text:
The way I see it, the Wardens owe us for all of those years we were imprisoned. Unfortunately, their new leader, Sira Moonwarden doesn't agree with my assessment.

Even though your champions have already dealt with several of their escaped bounties, she wants more. In fact, as a sign of good faith, she's asking that you deal with it personally.

You'll have to extinguish the flames of the kobold candles to summon forth the Devouring Darkness. The other two should be more straightforward.

passages.title: Deal With It Personally
passages.text:
How go your efforts to convince the Wardens to tell us where the Sargerite Keystone is located?

If she doesn't tell us soon, I think we should consider other options where Sira Moonwarden is concerned.

passages.title: Deal With It Personally
passages.text:
The Wardens should have cooperated with us much sooner than this. Still, we now know that we need to go find the Warden, Malace Shade, in Stormheim. She was the one entrusted with safeguarding the Sargerite Keystone.

That information, combined with some scouting I did on my own, will point you in the right direction.

We'll have the Keystone before you know it, <name>.

passages.title: The Invasion of Niskara
passages.text:
Everything is in place. All systems are operational and we have plenty of fuel. The Fel Hammer's jump engines are ready.

Caria and Varedis know that you are coming for them. Belath's intelligence indicates that they have retreated to the demon prison world of Niskara.

It's time to begin the invasion and finish this once and for all.

passages.title: The Invasion of Niskara
passages.text:
Finally, our plan of taking the fight directly to the demons is coming to fruition.

You are making it all happen, <name>.

passages.title: The Invasion of Niskara
passages.text:
We've won the day! Caria and Varedis are no more, and we've sent a clear message to the Burning Legion that they are vulnerable, even on their own worlds.

It's about time that we celebrated, but first...

passages.title: We Meet at Light's Hope
passages.text:
We must put Highlord Tirion to rest.

There is but one place suitable for a paladin of his caliber... Light's Hope Sanctum, a secret bastion of the Light hidden beneath our chapel.

Paladins the world over will join us for the ceremony. I know Tirion would want you there most of all.

passages.title: We Meet at Light's Hope
passages.text:
It is fitting that you are here.

Time and again, you have fought to save our world. Now, I fear I must ask you to undertake an even greater act of service.

passages.title: We Meet at Light's Hope
passages.text:
Before we march on the Broken Isles, <name>, we must put Highlord Tirion to rest.

There is but one place suitable for a paladin of his caliber... Light's Hope Sanctum, a secret bastion of the Light hidden beneath our chapel here.

Paladins the world have gathered below for the ceremony. They await your arrival to begin the ceremony.

passages.title: We Meet at Light's Hope
passages.text:
It is fitting that you are here.

Time and again, you have fought to save our world. Now, I fear I must ask you to undertake an even greater act of service.

passages.title: Return to the Broken Shore
passages.text:
If I'm to assist in this war, I need firsthand information. I will fly to the Broken Shore and see the battlefield for myself.

Your record as a proven commander is unquestioned, and you were there. I could use your insight.

Will you accompany me to the Broken Shore? I don't anticipate engaging the enemy, but that close to the Fel Storm, one can never be sure.

passages.title: Return to the Broken Shore
passages.text: Welcome to the Halls of Valor, hero. Normally one must die to gain entrance, but times have changed.

passages.title: The Zealot Rises
passages.text:
Sometimes the line between hero and villain is nothing more than perception. As High Inquisitor, Sally Whitemane saw herself as a champion of humanity in the war against the scourge. Yet under her leadership the Scarlet Crusade slew the living along with the undead.

Death can bring a silent peace to the soul, but not for Sally Whitemane. Her death is one of regret and unrest.

We will offer her the chance to atone for her crimes. The price will be high, but I have little doubt she will pay it.

passages.title: The Zealot Rises
passages.text:
I have heard that the battle at Scarlet Monastery was a success, thanks to you.

Initiate Whitemane has already begun her training as a <class>. She shows much promise, and I have no doubt she will make a formidable horseman.

passages.title: How It's Made: Arcwine
passages.text:
<Margaux speaks in a hushed tone.>

While we walk through the Vineyard, we may find time to exchange information.

Try not to look alarmed at what you see, hm?

<Margaux flashes a vacant, forced smile.>

Shall we press on?

passages.title: How It's Made: Arcwine
passages.text: Welcome, enjoying your tour?

passages.title: A Big Score
passages.text:
I'm not rich in anything but information, but maybe that can be of use to someone with your skills. You helped me, now you can help yourself.

The Magistrix receives a daily shipment of arcwine, which travels to the palace with a heavy escort. I can share the location, provided you leave me a cut of the goods.

One of my men has infiltrated the group and will hold up the delivery long enough for you to strike.

passages.title: A Big Score
passages.text: Where's my cut?

passages.title: A Big Score
passages.text: Pleasure doing business with you.

passages.title: The Blood Matriarch
passages.text:
I am but the first of many; you must find the holiest of paladins to champion our order.

There is one other I believe deserves such an honor - Lady Liadrin, Matriarch of the Blood Knights.

Go speak to her now.

passages.title: The Blood Matriarch
passages.text: Excellent. Both Lord Tyrosus and Lady Liadrin will serve proudly.

passages.title: Recruiting the Troops
passages.text:
Commander Ansela is a grizzled war veteran and seasoned teacher. Many of our most valiant knights once trained under her.

Go speak to her now, and recruit a squad of Squires.

passages.title: Recruiting the Troops
passages.text: Additional troops will be very useful for the missions ahead.

passages.title: Recruiting the Troops
passages.text: Good. These squires will fight well.

passages.title: Wrath and Justice
passages.text:
A new mission requires our attention, Highlord <name>. Hearthglen has come under attack by a small demon army.

No doubt, they are testing our strength... and our patience.

Strength we have in bounds, but my tolerance wears thin. I suggest we send our champions and troops to deal with this threat.

passages.title: Wrath and Justice
passages.text: We will show the enemy who they are dealing with.

passages.title: Wrath and Justice
passages.text: Our mission was a success! Not only did we defeat the enemy, but we recruited Alamande Graythorn, a noted scholar from the Hearthglen archives.

passages.title: Tech It Up a Notch
passages.text:
Alamande Graythorn is well known among scholars of the Light.

He has long since retired from battle, but his mind is sharp as ever. I wouldn't be surprised if he could take a bout or two in a duel, either.

Speak to him and see if he has any knowledge to share regarding the improvement of our order hall.

passages.title: Tech It Up a Notch
passages.text: Did you learn anything?

passages.title: Tech It Up a Notch
passages.text: Excellent. I knew Sir Graythorn would come through.

passages.title: Meeting of the Silver Hand
passages.text:
The Light's Heart will be safe within our order's walls, but it bears dark tidings.

We should gather the leaders of our order for a council.

Go and speak to Lady Liadrin, Vindicator Boros, Justicar Julia Celeste, Arator the Redeemer, and Aponi Brightmane. We should seek their wisdom for the days ahead.

passages.title: Meeting of the Silver Hand
passages.text: Have you gathered the council?

passages.title: Meeting of the Silver Hand
passages.text: Thank you for gathering everyone together.

passages.title: Securing the Way
passages.text:
I was able to make contact with our forces on Mardum - they secured the Fel Hammer after our departure all those years ago and have held it ever since!

Malevolence has utilized the ship's warp systems to transport the bulk of our forces aboard, but doing so greatly taxes what little power remains.

I believe there to be a better way.

Your glaives carry a piece of the power of Kil'jaeden - you should be able to use them to open a permanent gateway to the Fel Hammer.

passages.title: Securing the Way
passages.text: Soon our forces will flow freely between the here and the Fel Hammer.

passages.title: Securing the Way
passages.text: I look forward to joining the rest of our forces.

passages.title: Grassroots Effort
passages.text:
When I arrived at my home, the front door was barred by magical roots.

I was able to remove them, but few of my tribe possess the necessary ability to do so themselves.

Take my staff. Its powers will easily disentangle the obstructing roots.

passages.title: Grassroots Effort
passages.text: My old bones need more rest than I would care to admit.

passages.title: Grassroots Effort
passages.text: The grell trapped our young within the huts. They are no longer at risk, thanks to your generous efforts.

passages.title: Communication Orbs
passages.text:
We have important work at hand, Highlord.

Spread out across the legion camp are orbs that are vital to the Legion's planning and strategy.

Destroying them will severely damage their efforts. I will go with you, Highlord, to see this through.

passages.title: Communication Orbs
passages.text: Without a means of communicating, our enemy will be crippled.

passages.title: Communication Orbs
passages.text: No... we underestimated the enemy.

passages.title: The Codex of Command
passages.text:
Boros is in serious trouble.

The fel lord, Jarvox, guards the pit to the west. Boros is trapped in there, too.

We need to defeat Jarvox, take the Codex of Command that he carries, and rescue Vindicator Boros.

I am with you, Highlord!

passages.title: The Codex of Command
passages.text: Highlord, you have returned.

passages.title: The Codex of Command
passages.text:
Our mission to Faronaar was successful, no thanks to me.

I let my anger get out of control, and I would have paid for it dearly were it not for you.

Thank you, Highlord.

passages.title: The Invasion of Niskara
passages.text:
Everything is in place. All systems are operational and we have plenty of fuel. The Fel Hammer's jump engines are ready.

Caria and Varedis know that you are coming for them. Belath's intelligence indicates that they have retreated to the demon prison world of Niskara.

It's time to begin the invasion and finish this once and for all.

passages.title: The Invasion of Niskara
passages.text:
Finally, Illidan's plan of taking the fight directly to the demons is coming to fruition.

You are making it all happen, <name>.

passages.title: The Invasion of Niskara
passages.text:
We have won the day! Caria and Varedis are no more, and we have sent a clear message to the Burning Legion that they are vulnerable, even on their own worlds.

It is about time that we celebrated, but first...

passages.title: What the Stonemother Knows
passages.text:
We must split up. I am still badly wounded from my encounter with Geth'xun, and I don't want to appear weak before the Stonemother. This task falls to you.

Travel to Therazane's Throne and speak to Therazane herself. Find out if she has seen the Doomhammer.

Help her if she asks. She is dangerous and mercurial, but this is her realm, and without her aid we will find nothing.

passages.title: What the Stonemother Knows
passages.text:
You there! What is this nonsense falling into my domain? Green fire raining from the Maelstrom! Are you surface dwellers behind this?

<You explain everything to the Stonemother.>

A missing artifact, hm? I have not seen it, but I know where to start. You help the Stonemother, yes, and she will help you.

passages.title: Stone Drake Rescue
passages.text:
When that demon of yours fell into my realm he must have done something to the troggs. They were never a threat to my beloved stone drakes before.

Now they're loose all over the Pale Roost, subduing drakes on the ground. Put a stop to this insult at once, and free those drakes! They may be of use to us later.

passages.title: Stone Drake Rescue
passages.text: What of my precious little drakes, hm?

passages.title: Stone Drake Rescue
passages.text: Very very good, <class>. The cavern is once more filled with their delightful wails.

passages.title: Needlerock Beatdown
passages.text:
The troggs saw where your hammer fell, and I expect those cowards told the Legion where to find it. Hmph!

The leader of the stone troggs since the Cataclysm has been "Borlock," a thick-headed little dirt-grubber who's about to get what's coming to him. Find him at Needlerock Spire and beat the information out of him.

Take Aeosera with you. Her and her brood have their own score to settle with those belligerent little beasts.

passages.title: Needlerock Beatdown
passages.text: Oh I so love to see Aeosera in action.

passages.title: Needlerock Beatdown
passages.text:
Oh ho ho ho! I heard the cavern shake from here, <name>! It's good to rattle some stones and remind everyone who's the boss down here, I must say.

Now about that hammer of yours. Your companions have come up empty, but I think you know where to go next, hm?

passages.title: Journey to the East
passages.text:
My riddles you've solved but your job is not complete.

Come, meet me at the Jade Serpent Temple for the answers you seek.

passages.title: Journey to the East
passages.text: Ah, there the wikket is. Now, we see how well you can brew!

passages.title: Three Is a Lucky Number
passages.text:
Ari is much more than she appears, you know. She was once one of the most powerful archmagi on Azeroth and a member of the Council of Tirisfal. Unfortunately her mind was badly damaged and she has not left the Hall of the Guardian since.

She must like you very much to have given you a gift. If you bring her something special in return, I suspect she will surprise you. She prefers things in threes.

passages.title: Three Is a Lucky Number
passages.text: Have you found anything special for Ari yet?

passages.title: Three Is a Lucky Number
passages.text: These are wonderful! I couldn't keep them for myself, of course. But... Can you hear the bees humming in the honey brew? They sing so sweetly... Oh! What a lovely idea! Thank you, little friends.

passages.title: The Highlord's Command
passages.text:
Well said, Highlord. The Legion is not one individual enemy - it is a massive beast with many heads.

To defeat them, we will need to stay vigilant on all fronts.

Let us send our champions to deal with the Legion incursions as they come.

passages.title: The Highlord's Command
passages.text: Well done. That should halt the Legion attacks for a while.

passages.title: The Diamond King
passages.text:
Me brother Magni, once King o' Ironforge, got changed into a diamond statue by a titan ritual. He's stood frozen in the belly o' the city fer years.

But I just got word that he's up and around... sayin' he knows somethin' 'bout how to beat the Legion!

Look, <name>, I dunno if Magni's crazy, or if that's even really him. But if there's even a chance he kin help us...

I'm told he muttered the name Ulduar. That's where I'm headed! I'd be obliged if you an' Khadgar were ta join me.

passages.title: The Diamond King
passages.text:
Magni's information was crucial to our efforts against the Legion. And it was good to see him again.

Now to find that tome about the Pillars of Creation...

passages.title: Controlling the Elements
passages.text:
Come closer, <race>.

Ragnaros in the Firelands, Al'Akir in his Throne of the Four Winds, and Neptulon in Throne of the Tides. They have been thorns in my hide since the world was new.

Prove to me your strength over the weaker elements, and I shall teach you how to display your power for all to see.

passages.title: Controlling the Elements
passages.text: Prove your mastery over magic and the elements, <race>.

passages.title: Controlling the Elements
passages.text: Now the other elements will truly fear you.

passages.title: The Fate of Hodir
passages.text:
It is time, <name>. Go to Azsuna and use the captured gateway to travel to Niskara and find Hodir.

The Legion will regret they set foot on Azeroth!

passages.title: The Fate of Hodir
passages.text: You've returned, <name>. What news do you bring?

passages.title: The Fate of Hodir
passages.text:
I thank you, <name>. Without your help, one of Azeroth's mightiest guardians would have fallen into the hands of the Legion.

You have proven you are capable of leading my armies and defeating the Legion in their own territory.

passages.title: Mistral Essence
passages.text:
To restore the Maelstrom Pillar, we will need to infuse it with the essence of air.

A large quantity of Mistral Essence will be required to do this.

Mistral Essence can be found on many of the elementals in Vortex Pinnacle.

If you can return to me with a ready supply of elemental essence, I will be able to continue my restoration work on the Maelstrom Pillar.

passages.title: Mistral Essence
passages.text: Were you able to collect the necessary amount?

passages.title: Mistral Essence
passages.text: Excellent. You have exactly the right amount of Mistral Essence necessary to restore the pillar!

passages.title: Eye of Azshara: The Scepter of Storms
passages.text:
The element of air can be difficult to contain. We will need a way to magically anchor it to the pillar.

Air, no matter how capricious, cannot resist a good storm.

In the Eye of Azshara, the naga sorceress known as Lady Hatecoil possesses a powerful relic known as the Scepter of Storms.

Retrieve the scepter, and we will use it to bind the elements of air to the Maelstrom Pillar.

passages.title: Eye of Azshara: The Scepter of Storms
passages.text: I hope it was easy to convince Lady Hatecoil to part with her scepter.

passages.title: Eye of Azshara: The Scepter of Storms
passages.text: Yes, this is it! With this, I will be able to bind the element of air nicely. And, maybe do some impressive tricks at future festivities.

passages.title: Ma'haat the Indomitable
passages.text:
In order to imbue the Maelstrom Pillar with the essence of earth, we will need one of the rarest fossils found on Azeroth - an egg.

The Egg of Gaiath is no ordinary egg; it contains the remnants of an unborn earthen primal, perfectly preserved in stone. There may be a means by which to revive it, but more on that later.

First, we must find that egg!

The Earthen Ring has heard of an ancient being who possesses such an item, but he will require payment in blood!

passages.title: Ma'haat the Indomitable
passages.text:
<Ma'haat the Indomitable speaks with a low, rumbling voice>

What... do you ask... of the earth?

passages.title: Neltharion's Lair: The Earthen Amulet
passages.text:
That you were even able to acquire the Egg of Gaiath is an incredible feat in itself, but the next step may well be impossible. Still... it is our only hope.

For the ritual to work, we will need to awaken the latent elemental energy resting inside of this egg.

There is an item that just may have the ability to do this - a relic known as the Earthen Amulet, rumored to have been created by Loken himself.

It was lost many ages ago, and has fallen into the hands of Dargrul the Underking.

passages.title: Neltharion's Lair: The Earthen Amulet
passages.text: Neltharion collected many valuable relics. The Earthen Amulet was one of them.

passages.title: Neltharion's Lair: The Earthen Amulet
passages.text: Yes, this is exactly what we need! I can get to work at once!

passages.title: A Taste For Blood
passages.text:
<Ma'haat the Indomitable guzzles the Blood of Sargeras down his throat as he speaks.>

Yesh... thish ish... just what I wanted. The egg ish... yoursh!

passages.title: The School of Roguery
passages.text:
Great! Sounds like she's already settled in. That's good, cuz we already need some fresh meat for the grinder.

You should mosey over an' see if she's got any thieves just lying around takin' up space.

passages.title: The School of Roguery
passages.text: How's the new 'school' comin' along?

passages.title: The School of Roguery
passages.text:
I saw. Not the healthiest-lookin' bunch, but I'm sure they'll do in a pinch.

Regardless, they'll be out with Vanessa and Garona, so what could go wrong?

passages.title: An Ample Stockpile
passages.text:
I have gone through our stockpile several times and no matter how I try to cut corners, we come up short.

A lack of food and medicine will halt our war efforts... that is simply the reality.

We desperately need food or bandages. If you know how to acquire any such items, you can bring them to me.

passages.title: An Ample Stockpile
passages.text: Wonderful, yes yes! These supplies will fill our storehouse for weeks to come. Thank you so much, Grandmaster.

passages.title: Further Training
passages.text:
You may be the Grandmaster, but mastery must be maintained through discipline.

To achieve perfect harmony, you must continue your training.

I would like to see your form in practice, <name>. Go out and use your Crackling Jade Lightning, Roll, and Blackout Kick or Blackout Strike. Through discipline, we find greatness.

passages.title: Further Training
passages.text: To achieve mastery, we must hone ourselves tirelessly.

passages.title: Further Training
passages.text: Very impressive indeed, <name>. I had no doubt that your form is still top notch.

passages.title: Ulduar's Oath
passages.text:
I was once leader of all of the titanforged keepers of Azeroth. We were charged by the Titans themselves to protect the world.

Once I gave up on the post of Prime Designate, I gave up any measure of influence over the other keepers. Not even my own son, Thorim, is bound to heed my commands.

The Gjallarhorn comes from a time before our falling out, however. A time of an ancient oath of honor.

Let us invoke that oath -- I am certain Thorim will answer the call.

passages.title: Ulduar's Oath
passages.text: What news do you bring from Ulduar?

passages.title: Ulduar's Oath
passages.text: I thank you, <name>.  That Hodir is gone is unfortunate, but things could have gone much worse and thanks to you Ulduar did not fall to the Legion today.

passages.title: Finding the Scepter
passages.text:
Very powerful, but difficult to acquire. Scepter is in the hands of Gul'dan. We must find out his plans, get close.

Calydus know Gul'dan planning major operation. He has sent out a call to arms to all Shadow Council to help with big ritual. One such group at Caer Darrow, talking to the necromancers there.

You should go, find out about plan.

passages.title: Finding the Scepter
passages.text: This gets complicated, but Calydus have idea!

passages.title: Finding the Scepter
passages.text:
Gul'dan says any of power may join. What if friend joined? Then when close take the Scepter and run!

Yes! Could work but must work hard to earn trust. Gul'dan still needs Eye. Friend should help with that, earn more respect.

passages.title: Under the Crooked Tree
passages.text:
My three sisters from that tree hung,
The crimes accused there was not one,
The youngest sister did escape,
As the noose looped around their nape,
Old Ravencrest is the one to blame,
This curse for you to lift our shame.

passages.title: Under the Crooked Tree
passages.text:
Steel your heart and drink deep,

Return my sister back to sleep.

passages.title: Under the Crooked Tree
passages.text:
My dear sister laid to rest,
A tortured hero proves their best,
Today I do lift this curse,
And offer you a token, a small purse,
My other sisters are still gone,
There comes a day to right their wrong...

passages.title: The Kirin Tor of Dalaran
passages.text: Assist the Kirin Tor of Dalaran by completing 3 world quests.

passages.title: The Kirin Tor of Dalaran
passages.text: The kirin tor thank you.

passages.title: The Missing Vessel
passages.text:
So long as Hakkar roams free, no mage will be safe.

Millificent Manastorm created a vessel that siphons the essence of a mage, binding their magic to the object. It was created to be a weapon, but we can use it as bait.

If I channel my essence into the vessel, it will become an object of pure magic.

Upon capture, Millificent shattered the vessel, allowing it to fall into the hands of our enemies.

Find the pieces and return them to me. Together we can set a trap Hakkar won't be able to resist!

passages.title: The Missing Vessel
passages.text: Have you found the missing pieces yet?

passages.title: The Missing Vessel
passages.text: I am relieved that this weapon of destruction is no longer in the hands of our enemies.

passages.title: I Am the Slayer!
passages.text: <name>, we have all gathered here to honor you for your leadership, successes, and sacrifices.

passages.title: I Am the Slayer!
passages.text: The Illidari and the Servants of Illidan are at your disposal.

passages.title: I Am the Slayer!
passages.text:
Your leadership has provided us with victory after victory. We gladly serve and will sacrifice everything in your name.

All hail, Slayer <name>!

passages.title: Maw of Souls: Ancient Vrykul Legends
passages.text:
Our diversionary tactics in Stormheim uncovered intel on something I thought only a myth.

There is a legend about a magical jewel the vrykul created long before the time of man. The jewel was said to be able to...

<Valeera stops herself from continuing while looking around and eyeing you wryly.>

I do not want to talk about it just yet. Not until we have proof.

Unfortunately, the only way we are going to get that proof is in the Maw of Souls on the Naglfar... the ship of the dead.

passages.title: Maw of Souls: Ancient Vrykul Legends
passages.text: Did you find proof?

passages.title: Maw of Souls: Ancient Vrykul Legends
passages.text:
The legend was true! I was right about my suspicions. I had heard about Ravencrest's almost perfect espionage team during the War of the Ancients. Now we know how they got their information.

The others will not believe it when we tell them. Of course, we could keep it to ourselves.

<Valeera considers for a weighty moment.>

No. That is how the foolish and greedy lose their heads. We will spread the risk around to everyone.

passages.title: Ritual Ruination
passages.text:
Time for main event, friend! Gul'dan wants to begin his big ritual, cause end times for this world. Calydus confident getting the Scepter will stop that plan.

Take this bat to Tomb of Sargeras, find ritual, steal Scepter. Oh... and get out!

Calydus will help when he can! Good luck, friend!

passages.title: Ritual Ruination
passages.text:
Calydus not believe that worked! Ritual messed up, Shadow Council wiped out, and we not dead!

Oh, and you have Scepter! Big win for friend!

passages.title: Growing Power
passages.text: It appears ye and yer weapon are both growin' in strength. Return to me at Netherlight Temple. I have more to show ye.

passages.title: Tech It Up A Notch
passages.text:
Archivist Zubashi has been doing a great deal of research on the necropolis we call Acherus.

Through his studies on the necropolis, he has located a number of potential improvements that can greatly increase the power of the Ebon Hold.

Speak with Archivist Zubashi now and he will show you what improvements can be made.

passages.title: Tech It Up A Notch
passages.text: Greetings, Deathlord. I have been studyin' da true nature of da necropolis. You going to be pleased wit' da results I assure you!

passages.title: Tech It Up A Notch
passages.text: That was an excellent choice, Deathlord. Feel free to speak to Zubashi whenever you require further upgrades.

passages.title: Troops in the Field
passages.text: It's time to send our newly trained acolytes out into the field. Look at the Command Map and send your champions and troops on a routine scouting mission.

passages.title: Troops in the Field
passages.text: How did it go?

passages.title: Troops in the Field
passages.text:
The scouting mission was more successful than we could have imagined, <name>.

Your troops were able to rescue Archon Torias, a skilled researcher whose knowledge extends far beyond light and shadow.

In thanks, he has agreed to lend his expertise to our cause.

passages.title: Tech It Up A Notch
passages.text:
We are very fortunate to have come across Archon Torias.

His knowledge will be invaluable as we improve our defenders and fortify Netherlight Temple.

passages.title: Tech It Up A Notch
passages.text: Have you had a chance to speak with Archon Torias yet?

passages.title: Tech It Up A Notch
passages.text: Excellent choice, <name>. Archon Torias will continue to conduct his research in Netherlight Temple. Speak to him when you want to make additional upgrades.

passages.title: Time to Rumble!
passages.text: Welcome to the Black Rook Rumble! Many combatants have entered to prove their might in the Black Rook Arena, and now it is your time.

passages.title: Court of Stars: Beware the Fury of a Patient Elf
passages.text:
An opportunity presents itself, <name>.

Ly'leth has arranged to grant you entry into a ball at the Court of Stars. I do not know what we may gain from this venture, but there is one task I must set for you.

Advisor Melandrus once called himself my ally. He and I planned Elisande's downfall, but when the moment came I found myself betrayed.

The wound his dagger inflicted still aches. I cannot enter Suramar to take my revenge, but you can.

Give him a traitor's death, and bring me his spellstone.

passages.title: Court of Stars: Beware the Fury of a Patient Elf
passages.text: Is it done?

passages.title: Court of Stars: Beware the Fury of a Patient Elf
passages.text:
<Thalyssra clutches the spellstone tightly for a moment.>

He brought this upon himself.

I cannot linger in the past. Elisande is weaker without him, and we are one step closer to righting the wrongs inflicted upon the shal'dorei.

passages.title: Time to Collect
passages.text:
Hey there, pal. My sources around here say you had a run-in with the Sixtrigger brothers. I'd imagine you're not very happy with them?

Let's just say we're not exactly friends either.

So I'll tell you what. How about I let you in on some intel about their current location? Maybe they might have an unfortunate accident, you follow?

Oh, and bring some friends. They're not exactly the easiest of targets.

passages.title: Time to Collect
passages.text: This seems to be where the Sixtrigger brothers keep their most prized spoils.

passages.title: Time to Collect
passages.text:
With the Sixtrigger brothers ended, you're finally able to collect your payment for services rendered.

You rummage through their most prized possessions and take your pick.

passages.title: Survival Skills
passages.text:
The life of a hunter should never be dull. Living in the wild you never know what will happen next, but you survive on skill and instinct.

Show me you have the basic survival skills to live off the land.

passages.title: Survival Skills
passages.text:
You need to eat to survive in the wild.

Boar meat makes an excellent meal when cooked over an open flame. It should not be eaten raw, however.

There are many berries that grow in this region. Some are edible, while others cause minor sickness when ingested. You can often tell which are safe to eat by their smell. A sweet aroma often indicates the berry is unsafe to eat.

The best firewood can be obtained from dying trees. They are easily identified by their fading, purple leaves.

passages.title: Survival Skills
passages.text: You built your campfire with ease, and put a perfect sear on that steak. I'm impressed... and hungry.

passages.title: The Codex of Ra
passages.text:
The Thunder King conquered Pandaria using power stolen from the Titan Keeper Ra, known as "Ra-den" in the mogu tongue. If you truly seek to wield the relics of the Highkeeper, seek out his ancient edicts among the ruins in the heart of the mogu empire: The Edict of Stone, The Edict of Fire, and the Edict of the Storm.

These pieces of the codex are scattered amongst the Guo-Lai Halls in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms, one in each wing.

passages.title: The Codex of Ra
passages.text:
I've been asking around. The pandaren locals are terrified of this place. It's been haunted since the end of Hellscream's Pandaren Campaign.

Did you find an offering for the White Tiger?

passages.title: The Codex of Ra
passages.text:
That tiger is serious about this, isn't he?

While you were here, others came to the Temple of the White Tiger to present their offerings to him. It looks like we're going to have some competition.

passages.title: Uniting the Isles
passages.text: There are a great number of factions here on the Broken Isles. We must unite them if we want to stand a chance against the Legion. Prove your worth to them and report back to me.

passages.title: Uniting the Isles
passages.text: Any luck uniting the factions?

passages.title: Uniting the Isles
passages.text: Excellent work, <name>. We still have a long road ahead of us to rid this world of the Legion, but this brings us one step closer.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text:
Grand Master, you have saved our order from the brink of destruction.

Your deeds have shown us that with effort and determination we can overcome any challenge. In light of your example, we have doubled our efforts and developed a technique that will awaken your weapon to its true potential.

Please, stand before the Forge of the Roaring Mountain and raise your weapon high.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: We honor you, Grandmaster.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: May the new powers of your weapon aid you in the times ahead.

passages.title: A New Invention
passages.text: I have been experimenting with technology that allows you to alter the structure of beasts, specifically with how they look.

passages.title: A New Invention
passages.text: This is my most magnificent invention I have made. In the last 10 minutes.

passages.title: A New Invention
passages.text: Here you go, <name>. Take care of Hati and the Titanstrike and be safe in your adventures.

passages.title: Relieving the Front Lines
passages.text:
Many within our order have been on the front lines of battle for too long, aiding those who are attempting to thwart the Legion's invasion.

It is time we send in some relief, allowing our allies some much needed rest.

passages.title: Relieving the Front Lines
passages.text: Hopefully our priests have a chance to rest before heading back into battle.

passages.title: An Ample Supply
passages.text:
Durin' our attempt to flee da murlocs, Yalia and I dropped da supplies we planned to deliver to da demon hunters in Faronaar.

Inside each a those crates were vials a salve dat took us countless days and resources to craft. If we don' get those supplies back, I fear our allies on da front lines will suffer.

passages.title: An Ample Supply
passages.text: Do ya have our supplies?

passages.title: An Ample Supply
passages.text: There's no tellin' how many lives ya saved by recoverin' these vials.

passages.title: Halls of Valor: The Light Within
passages.text:
We cannot ignore the Prophet's vision, <name>. To do so would mean that everything we know and hold dear will be lost to the Legion.

We must focus on what we know, and that is that the Light must walk among us.

Within the Halls of Valor you will find an ascending val'kyr by the name of Hyrja. Recover a spark of her Light and release it within our temple.

passages.title: Halls of Valor: The Light Within
passages.text:
<Saa'ra's soothing voice fills your mind.>

Your gift of Light is a welcome one, <class>.

passages.title: Eye of Azshara: Looking Through the Lens
passages.text:
We have what we need to create Velen's elixir, but in order for others to be able to witness his vision, we'll need to find something that can be used to project images from the mind.

A lens from the nearby naga should work well, but I don't think they're going to be too eager to give it up.

passages.title: Eye of Azshara: Looking Through the Lens
passages.text: Gazing through the lens of a powerful naga will allow you to witness my vision.

passages.title: Eye of Azshara: Looking Through the Lens
passages.text:
You've returned, and just in time it would seem.

Yalia and Zabra have just finished crafting the elixir. This lens will allow you to see what I see when the vision begins.

passages.title: Velen's Vision
passages.text:
I have everything I need to bring forth a vision, but the question remains: are you ready to witness it? Even the smallest glimpse into the future can weigh heavy on your soul.

Once I ingest the elixir, the vision will come quickly. Gazing into the Lens of the Tides will allow you to see what I see.

Let me know when you are ready to begin.

passages.title: Velen's Vision
passages.text: Even the smallest glimpse into the future can leave a heavy weight on your mind.

passages.title: Velen's Vision
passages.text:
We will not let this demon determine our fate. You have the power to change our future.

I have seen the path to salvation, and you will lead us there.

I must retire for now. The weight of this vision has taken its toll on my mind and body.

passages.title: Infiltrating Our Enemies
passages.text:
With the Light at our side, we should focus our efforts on figuring out who among our enemies could be a potential ally.

Any of your champions should be capable of infiltrating enemy ranks, giving us a better understanding of how to approach this.

Even so, it is a delicate task. Proceed with caution.

passages.title: Infiltrating Our Enemies
passages.text:
Your efforts have provided us with the information we need to move forward.

It's been discovered that there are a few defectors among the Scarlet Onslaught.

passages.title: Onslaught Envoy
passages.text:
A few defectors have been discovered among the Scarlet Onslaught in Northrend.

I know it's difficult to think that any within their ranks could be useful to our cause, but we must make an attempt.

The prophecy says an old enemy will become an ally, so it's worth it to investigate and see if these defectors can be brought to the Light.

passages.title: Onslaught Envoy
passages.text: Why are you here? Why bother saving me? I was prepared to die. I should pay for the terrible things I've done...

passages.title: Scarlet Redemption
passages.text:
The Light shines upon me, <name>! For the first time in my life, I feel it!

I was without hope, ready to die for the things I had done in the name of the Scarlet Crusade, but then you appeared! You are my chance at redemption. 

Please, let me prove to you that I am worthy of a second chance. Let me slay those I used to be loyal to!

passages.title: Scarlet Redemption
passages.text: I will prove myself worthy of being redeemed.

passages.title: Scarlet Redemption
passages.text: The Light truly shines upon me, <name>. Your presence has proven that.

passages.title: Into the Void
passages.text:
This is without a doubt Natalie's writing. The entry was scrawled in haste, but the message is clear: The spell within this journal will lead us to Natalie's spirit, but it needs to be incanted at a shadow altar within the catacombs.

Odessa and I have a duty to watch over Natalie's body, but with your considerable power, you should be able to perform the spell with ease.

passages.title: Into the Void
passages.text:
The lure of the Void is strong. There were times I thought I would be lost there forever.

Thank you for freeing me, <name>.

passages.title: Crossing Legion Lines
passages.text:
I've received word from the Highlord that a group of paladins and priests were captured after a battle broke out at Felblaze Ingress. Your priestess, Delas Moonfang, was among those captured.

They've been taken through the demon portal and into the Legion stronghold of Niskara.

We will need the assistance of the Conclave if we have any hope of recovering them.

passages.title: Crossing Legion Lines
passages.text: I've never been so happy to see you, <class>.

passages.title: Crossing Legion Lines
passages.text: Thank the Light, <class>. I didn't want to give up hope.

passages.title: Allies of the Light
passages.text:
Both Arator and Delas are still somewhere on this forsaken rock, as well as many of our other allies.

We cannot leave them, <name>.

passages.title: Allies of the Light
passages.text: I already heard of your heroism from Delas Moonfang. Thanks to you, many lives were saved.

passages.title: The Mind of the Enemy
passages.text:
The demon jailors spoke of an upcoming invasion. Their army is gathering for something big, and it worries me greatly.

Let us find whatever information we can about their plans.

passages.title: The Mind of the Enemy
passages.text: The intelligence you have gathered is further proof that the prophecy cannot be ignored. The Legion's attack is imminent, and we will not survive without the paladins as our allies under the Light.

passages.title: United As One
passages.text:
You and Delas have had dealings with the paladins before, maybe it's possible they will grant you an audience with their war council. 

Head to the Sanctum of Light and ask the paladins to help us defend Netherlight Temple from Balnazzar's attack.

passages.title: United As One
passages.text: Now is not the time for interruptions, <name>. The council needs to determine its course of action.

passages.title: United As One
passages.text: We will help defend Netherlight Temple and lay a trap for Balnazzar.

passages.title: A Light in the Darkness
passages.text:
The Burning Legion has begun their attack!

I will remain here and prepare the temple's defenses. You must meet our allies in Dalaran and let them know that the battle has begun!

Make haste, <name>. I do not know how long we will be able to keep Balnazzar at bay.

passages.title: A Light in the Darkness
passages.text: The paladins have always been our allies and friends. Now, we stand united against a common cause.

passages.title: A Light in the Darkness
passages.text: You fought well, High <class>.

passages.title: High Priest of Netherlight
passages.text:
You have fulfilled the prophecy, but more than that, you have united the priests of Azeroth.

We should take a moment to recognize all that you have accomplished.

passages.title: High Priest of Netherlight
passages.text: We rejoice in your triumph!

passages.title: High Priest of Netherlight
passages.text: You are a leader worthy of our praise, High <class>.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text:
I'm pleased to report that the improvements to the Soul Forge are complete!

When you are ready, we shall use it to unlock the true potential of your weapon!

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: Suffer well, Deathlord.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: May the new powers of your weapon serve you well.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text:
<class>t, in our short time together you have done much to aid the Circle.

We are inspired by your determination and have developed a new technique that will bind the power of your weapon with the Emerald Dream itself!

Everything is prepared. When you are ready we shall begin.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: We honor you, Archdruid.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: With this new power, the Legion will fall!

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text:
I'm pleased to report that the improvements to the Forge are complete!

When you are ready, we shall use it to unlock the true potential of your weapon!

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: We honor you, Slayer.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: May the new powers of your weapons serve you well.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text:
<class>t, our research into the Felblood Altar has proven useful. We've developed a ritual that should unleash the full powers of your artifact weapon!

Say the word, and we shall begin the ritual at once!

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: We honor you, Netherlord.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: With this new power, nothing shall stop us!

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text:
<class>t, in our short time together you have done much for our order.
