Through your words and deeds we've been inspired to redouble our efforts and I'm proud to report that we've discovered a new technique that may be of use to you.

If you have a moment, <class>t, I would be pleased to show you the fruit of our research.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: We honor you, Archmage.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: May this power aid you in the times ahead.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text:
Farseer, since you have joined us you have done much to aid the Earthen Ring.

Your efforts have not gone unnoticed. The spirits have watched all that you have done and are pleased. They also have shown me a technique that will unleash the true power of your weapon!

The ritual is ready. When you are prepared we can begin.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: We honor you, Farseer.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: May this power aid you in the times ahead.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text:
<class>t, in our short time together you have done much to aid the Conclave. Now, with the work upon the Altar of Light and Shadow complete, it is time that we aid you. We have discovered a method to awaken the full power of your weapon!

Please, step before the altar and raise your weapon high.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: All hail the, High <class>!

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: May the new powers of your weapon serve you well.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text:
I'm pleased to say that the improvements to the crucible are complete!

When you are prepared, we shall use it to unlock the true potential of your weapons!

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: Well done, Shadowblade.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: May your new weapons serve you well.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text:
I'm pleased to say that the improvements to the Altar of the Eternal Hunt are complete!

When you are ready, we shall use it to unlock the full potential of your weapon!

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: Well done, Huntmaster.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: May the new powers of your weapon serve you well.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text:
<class>t, you've brought together the Silver Hand like no <class>t has done before. You've shown us that with determination and faith in the holy light we can overcome any challenge.

Following in your example our workmen have toiled hard to improve the Altar of Ancient Kings, allowing it to unlock the true potential of your weapon.

Their work is now complete! Step forward when you are ready and we shall begin.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: Well done, Highlord.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: May this blessed power aid you in the times ahead.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text:
I've been watching you, <name>.

Time and again you've led the Valarjar to war with your weapon held high! Time and again the halls of Valhalas have thundered with the cheers of your victory!

Now that the enhancements to the forge have been completed, it is time that your weapon's true potential be unleashed! Meet with me at the forge, hero.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: I honor you, Battlelord.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: May your new weapon serve you well.

passages.title: Where In the World is Mathias?
passages.text:
Master Mathias Shaw is the leader of the Alliance intelligence organization known as SI:7. And apparently, he is now a dreadlord.

Or rather, a very clever dreadlord has taken his place while he is being held captive somewhere.

It is imperative that we reveal this imposter to the new king of Stormwind. If we fail to do so, then the Alliance will surely be eaten alive from within and the Burning Legion will win this war for a certainty.

passages.title: Where In the World is Mathias?
passages.text:
Well, now we know that our SI:7 friend is being held at Felsoul Hold in Suramar. Not sure why we didn't check there first.

I trust that you already have a general plan for how to retrieve him? I know that I do. Perhaps we can put our heads together.

passages.title: The World is Not Enough
passages.text:
Now that we have pruned the garden, it is time to dig up the rotting tree stump in the middle.

Put another way, we need to make sure to keep the forces of chaos from overwhelming the Broken Isles. Certainly others are helping in this endeavor.

However, I am sure the target you select to eliminate will be the wisest from the standpoint of the Uncrowned.

passages.title: The World is Not Enough
passages.text: And have you dug up that tree stump yet, <name>?

passages.title: The World is Not Enough
passages.text: A wise choice of targets indeed. The Uncrowned are fortunate to count you amongst our ranks, Mister <name>.

passages.title: A Burning Distraction
passages.text:
We're going to need a distraction if we are to rescue Mathias Shaw from where he's being held captive in Felsoul Hold.

A big one.

Explosives placed in a few key locations should do nicely. Noggenfogger is playing nice and has donated some bombs to the cause. He might be trying to smooth over relations due to his earlier extortion.

I can have someone go ahead and mark the best locations. You want to do the honors?

passages.title: A Burning Distraction
passages.text: As soon as you set all of the explosives and push the button, we will proceed.

passages.title: A Burning Distraction
passages.text: That was a big distraction!

passages.title: Assault on Violet Hold: The Fel Lexicon
passages.text:
I have been studying the language of the demons, but it has been difficult to get my hands on written material.

I have heard rumor of a book called the Fel Lexicon, written by an ancient scholar who spoke both eredun and draenei. If I could just get my hands on that book, I could learn so much!

I heard that this book might be in the hands of a powerful prisoner inside the Violet Hold.

Bring me this book, and my work here will go much faster.

passages.title: Assault on Violet Hold: The Fel Lexicon
passages.text: I am fairly adept in twelve different languages, and I hope to add more to the list.

passages.title: Assault on Violet Hold: The Fel Lexicon
passages.text: Yes, I believe this is it! Just look at it, <name>. I will put this knowledge to good use.

passages.title: Blood of Our Enemy
passages.text:
I have seen demonic artifacts before, <name>.

Legion sigils will only reveal themselves in the presence of demon blood.

I sense that time is of the essence. Bring me a large quantity of demon blood, so that I may translate the book as soon as you retrieve it.

passages.title: Blood of Our Enemy
passages.text: The last time, I tried to use a living demon. It ended rather poorly... for the demon.

passages.title: Blood of Our Enemy
passages.text: Yes, this will do nicely.

passages.title: To Felblaze Ingress
passages.text:
I have sobering news, Highlord.

We have had no word from Chieftain Aponi Brightmane, young Arator, or priestess Delas Moonfang since they departed for Felblaze Ingress.

We need to know what happened to them.

We fear the worst.

passages.title: To Felblaze Ingress
passages.text: <The book is written in Aponi's hand. What happened here?>

passages.title: Allies of the Light
passages.text:
Both Arator and Delas are still somewhere on this forsaken rock, as well as many of our other allies.

We cannot leave them, <name>.

passages.title: Allies of the Light
passages.text: I already heard of your heroism from Aponi Brightmane, Highlord. Thanks to you, many lives were saved.

passages.title: The Power Within
passages.text:
My apologies for the unannounced intrusion, <name>. Do you have a moment?

The power within your weapon has grown exponentially as you have fought the Legion, but I cannot help but wonder if there is something... more... hidden away within. Perhaps even a new form entirely!

The very thought demands we find out for sure.

The ancient blue dragon in Azsuna known as Senegos lays dying and is key to our journey. You must aid him - I will meet you in his domain as soon as I am able.

passages.title: The Power Within
passages.text:
Senegos has generously offered us his assistance in the journey ahead.

A truly kind soul.

passages.title: The Power Within
passages.text:
Do you have a moment, Conjurer?

The power within your weapon has grown exponentially as you have fought the Legion, but I cannot help but wonder if there is something... more... hidden away within. Perhaps even a new form entirely!

The very thought demands we find out for sure.

The ancient blue dragon in Azsuna known as Senegos lays dying and is key to our journey. You must aid him - I will meet you in his domain as soon as I am able.

passages.title: The Power Within
passages.text:
Senegos has generously offered us his assistance in the journey ahead.

A truly kind soul.

passages.title: Black Rook Hold: Greater Power
passages.text:
The raw power of the runestones will allow Hymdall to temporarily open a tear into demonic worlds, but it's not enough.

The Legion hides its presence in far away worlds with dark magic. Bring a greater runestone so that Hymdall can hone in on our enemies across the cosmos.

passages.title: Black Rook Hold: Greater Power
passages.text: Do you bring the runestone we require, <name>?

passages.title: Black Rook Hold: Greater Power
passages.text: It is done. Let us prepare the Valarjar for glorious battle!

passages.title: The Captive Spymaster
passages.text:
We must move swiftly while the distraction is working. Mathias Shaw is being held in the lower levels of the Halls of the Eclipse directly to the south.

Quickly, <name>, we must go!

passages.title: The Captive Spymaster
passages.text: Hurry, <name>. We must get him out of here before the demons raise the alarm.

passages.title: Darkheart Thicket: Fallen Power
passages.text:
Once we have the proper implements we can use the Heart to infuse great power into your artifact. We need only a source.

Deep within the Darkheart Thicket lies the ancient Oakheart, once a great and mighty protector of Shaladrassil. He has regrettably fallen to the nightmare like so many of his kin.

As the darkness within him has taken root, an essence of the corruption has manifested. I ask that you recover the essence so that we may draw from its power, and put noble Oakheart to rest.

passages.title: Darkheart Thicket: Fallen Power
passages.text: You have the essence?

passages.title: Darkheart Thicket: Fallen Power
passages.text:
The ancient is at peace once more.

May his sacrifice not be in vain.

passages.title: Lucid Strength
passages.text:
We have everything we need, <name>.

Once you are ready, raise your artifact and channel its energy upon the Heart of Zin-Azshari to safely absorb the power stored within the nightmare essence.

I will use the blood you provided to make sure the ritual stays safely contained.

passages.title: Lucid Strength
passages.text: This is but the first step in unlocking the true potential hidden away deep within your artifact, but it is an exciting milestone nonetheless.

passages.title: Lucid Strength
passages.text: Well done! Everything went as planned.

passages.title: The Emerald Nightmare: In Nightmares
passages.text:
We must do what we can to ensure that the Nightmare never again festers within the Emerald Dream.

The aberration known as Il'gynoth lies at the heart of the corruption - a living, writhing manifestation of the horrors you will encounter at every turn of your journey.

I ask that you ensure its destruction, along with the Nightmare Lord himself... Xavius.

Once the deeds have been done, bring a small piece of each to me. We can study them to figure out just how the Nightmare grew so quickly.

passages.title: The Emerald Nightmare: In Nightmares
passages.text: Is the deed done?

passages.title: The Emerald Nightmare: In Nightmares
passages.text:
That is... far more than we needed.

Thank you, <name>.

passages.title: The Emerald Nightmare: Essence of Power
passages.text:
Now that we have a better understanding on the Heart's capabilities, it is time we tap into its true potential.

In the Emerald Nightmare you will find creatures that should not be; monsters that defy all that the Dream stands for.

All that the green flight itself stands for.

Each of these fiends carry within them corrupted essence, as Oakheart did, but far more potent. Gather all that you can, and we will turn their corruption against them.

passages.title: The Emerald Nightmare: Essence of Power
passages.text: The task before you is not simple, but I have faith in your abilities.

passages.title: The Emerald Nightmare: Essence of Power
passages.text:
Your bravery rivals that of my own kind.

Well done.

passages.title: Essential Consumption
passages.text:
As before, <name>, once you are ready raise your artifact and channel its energy upon the Heart of Zin-Azshari and we will unleash the power of the essence you gathered.

Do not worry - we still have enough of the blood you gathered to ensure the ritual remains stable.

passages.title: Essential Consumption
passages.text: After all you have done for my flight, this is but a small favor in return.

passages.title: Essential Consumption
passages.text: That is all I can do for you, little one. If you seek more power, you must look elsewhere.

passages.title: Court of Stars: Literary Perfection
passages.text:
Out of all the books, why that one?! Oh, Mother Moon, I am but a trusting fool.

I apologize, you have no idea what I'm going on about.

I lent my first edition copy of "Wards, Sigils, and the Nightborne Way" to a dear friend - well, former friend, I should say - just before the betrayal.

As fate would have it, there is an incantation in that book that I will need for my part of the ritual.

Please retrieve it if you can, but be careful - it is quite valuable!

passages.title: Court of Stars: Literary Perfection
passages.text: Did you find it? Oh, please tell me you found it!

passages.title: Court of Stars: Literary Perfection
passages.text: That's the one! Oh, thank you, <name>. Thank you!

passages.title: Vault of the Wardens: Borrowing Without Asking
passages.text:
The elusive Wardens run an immense secret prison facility deep underneath the mountains of Azsuna housing all manner of terrible creatures.

Perhaps... 'used to run' is more accurate.

This presents us with a unique opportunity. The wardens used powerful containment crystals to encase each prisoner in their cell. If any of them still remain intact, we could use one to safely contain the Heart's power.

They certainly won't be needing them.

passages.title: Vault of the Wardens: Borrowing Without Asking
passages.text: Any luck?

passages.title: Vault of the Wardens: Borrowing Without Asking
passages.text: Excellent. This will work quite well.

passages.title: A True Test
passages.text:
Vizuul's runebindings are more potent than I had anticipated. Not a bad thing - more power is certainly welcome - but there's certainly more potential for catastrophe if the spell matrix somehow becomes unstable.

We should be able to safely contain the fel energy within the containment field using the eon winder you recovered... but keep an eye open just in case.

passages.title: A True Test
passages.text: I'm sure we'll be able to keep everything stable.

passages.title: A True Test
passages.text: I'm... so sorry, <name>. I was so sure that would work...

passages.title: Saving the Guard
passages.text:
The Moon Guard were once among the most powerful sorcerers on Azeroth. Most assumed their ranks demolished after the War of the Ancients, but it seems they have managed to survive in their ancient stronghold in Suramar!

I believe they could be valuable allies in our quest if they still oppose the Legion.

<name>, if you can save what remains of the Guard, I will work to convince the Council of Six to lend us additional aid.

passages.title: Saving the Guard
passages.text: It seems we have gained new allies. Let us figure out a plan of action.

passages.title: The Nighthold: Delusions of Grandeur
passages.text:
Grand Magistrix Elisande and her cohorts have lost their minds - they truly believe that allying themselves with the Legion will end in anything but their own demise!

They are too far gone to save, I'm afraid, but they still have powerful items that we can use to help us infuse the Heart of Zin-Azshari with their power.

In your assault on the Nighthold, ensure you recover the mad construct Trilliax's power core, as well as the spellbook of the Grand Magistrix herself.

Good luck.

passages.title: The Nighthold: Delusions of Grandeur
passages.text: I ask more of you than I wish, but there is no other way.

passages.title: The Nighthold: Delusions of Grandeur
passages.text:
<Thalrenus' eyes widen at the sight of the Millenia Tome.>

If Elisande has seen reason... perhaps there is still hope for the Guard after all.

passages.title: The Nighthold: Into the Nighthold
passages.text:
Our work is very nearly complete. Now that the Heart can safely absorb power from fel magic, we need the strongest sources of it that we can get our hands on.

Gul'dan has called the nightborne's elite back to the Nighthold to aid him. The storm of fel energy above the palace has seeped into the very fabric of their being, even making its way into the crystallized pieces of the Nightwell that many carry with them.

Those shards are exactly what we need, <name>. Save as many as you can in your assault.

passages.title: The Nighthold: Into the Nighthold
passages.text: How many Nightshards were you able to retrieve?

passages.title: The Nighthold: Into the Nighthold
passages.text:
<Kalec sifts through the pile of Nightshards.>

Yes, these are perfect! There's just one more thing we need.

passages.title: The Nighthold: Darkness Calls
passages.text:
Before we perform the ritual there is one last thing I must ask of you, <name>.

You must finally bring Gul'dan to justice.

No more of his lies, his deceits, or his trickery. None of it can save him now.

Take one of his conjured eyes when you're done. Using his power for good will be a fitting end.

passages.title: The Nighthold: Darkness Calls
passages.text: Is the deed done?

passages.title: The Nighthold: Darkness Calls
passages.text: Let us not waste another moment.

passages.title: Balance of Power
passages.text:
At long last, it is time to reap the fruits of your labors.

Lothrius tells of a place deep in the former Moonguard Stronghold used to infuse new Guards with immense power. It will be the perfect place to tap into and augment the power of the Nightshards you gathered.

Gather your effects and meet me there when you are ready, and we will use the Heart to finally reveal the great power within your artifact.

passages.title: Balance of Power
passages.text: This is a truly momentous occasion.

passages.title: Balance of Power
passages.text:
Your artifact's new form is even more fantastic than I imagined.

Please, take what remains of the Heart as a token of my gratitude for such a marvelous adventure - there is still a fair bit of power left inside it.

passages.title: The Mind of the Enemy
passages.text:
The demon jailors spoke of an upcoming invasion. Their army is gathering for something big, and it worries me greatly.

Let us find whatever information we can about their plans.

passages.title: The Mind of the Enemy
passages.text:
The Legion has plans to attack the priests' center of command? It is critical that you discovered this information in time, Highlord.

It makes sense that the Legion would target Prophet Velen and his followers. We cannot allow Balnazzar to succeed.

passages.title: United As One
passages.text:
I am glad you returned safely, Highlord. Delas Moonfang has also arrived with representatives of the Conclave.

The priests have come to discuss Netherlight Temple, their seat of power, hidden deep within the Twisting Nether.

As you have both discovered, the Legion has been searching for them for quite some time, and now... they have found them.

The Silver Hand has agreed to hear their words. Would you join them now, Highlord?

passages.title: United As One
passages.text: Delas has come on behalf of the Conclave.

passages.title: United As One
passages.text:
I believe you have chosen well, Highlord. We will help defend Netherlight Temple and lay a trap for Balnazzar.

The priests of the Conclave are formidable allies. With our combined strength, we may just have a chance against Balnazzar.

passages.title: Giving It All We've Got
passages.text:
The arcan'dor is drawing incredible amounts of energy.

Even with the leyline feed at full capacity, we may not have the power.

Let us first ensure that all potential leyline conduits connecting to Shal'Aran are active.

Then I can attempt to amplify the output and hopefully satisfy this insufferable plant.

passages.title: Giving It All We've Got
passages.text: We must activate all of the leyline feeds in Suramar before attempting the spell.

passages.title: Giving It All We've Got
passages.text: We must take drastic measures.

passages.title: Flow Control
passages.text:
If all goes as planned, the manastorm will cause the leyline to flare up, sending a great surge of energy through the arcway.

In order for the surge to reach Shal'Aran, we must seal off any outlets along the way. If we miss even one, the mission fails - and hundreds of people will be vaporized by the energy blow off.

Thalyssra had better be sure about this tree.

passages.title: Flow Control
passages.text: If my map of the arcways is accurate, that should be all of the outlets we need to worry about.

passages.title: Bring Home the Beacon
passages.text:
The conduit we need is in the Arcway, and security in the Arcway has doubled since your last visit.

Our only reasonable option is to teleport your strike team directly in. 

This is a long-range teleport to a non-anchored destination. In other words, it will be hard.

Take this beacon and survey the commons in Suramar City, then return the beacon to me so I can analyze the results. 

This will help me teleport you as close as possible to the conduit!

passages.title: Bring Home the Beacon
passages.text:
Imagine firing an arrow at the sky in hopes of hitting an acorn at the far end of the forest.

This teleport will be a little harder, but I think I can do it.

passages.title: Bring Home the Beacon
passages.text: Excellent. With this, the chances of me teleporting you all to the bottom of the sea are much lower!

passages.title: All In
passages.text:
It is time to put our plan into action.

Oculeth will send you, Arluin and myself into the Arcway, where we shall trigger a manastorm in the Nightflow Conduit.

Valtrois will stay here and prepare Shal'Aran for a massive jolt of arcane power - hopefully enough to satisfy the arcan'dor.

adventurer... We have a saying... "To lead is to stand alone." It means only those who bear the weight of leadership can truly appreciate it.

Thank you for standing beside me. In truth, I do not feel alone.

passages.title: All In
passages.text: Behold. The redemption of the Nightfallen.

passages.title: Arcan'dor, Gift of the Ancient Magi
passages.text:
Thousands of years ago, as the Quel'dorei were just beginning to unravel the mysteries of the arcane, a small enclave of druids met with the first of the elven magi.

In the pale moonlight, they formed an order that would seek to bring the arcane into balance - using nature itself as a vessel. Thus the arcan'dor were created.

My masters who belonged to this order have long since faded away. Yet their legacy remains.

Their gift will mend the spirit of the shal'dorei. Let them eat, and be made whole.

passages.title: Arcan'dor, Gift of the Ancient Magi
passages.text: The shal'dorei must eat the fruit of the arcan'dor. It is the only way to free them.

passages.title: Arcan'dor, Gift of the Ancient Magi
passages.text: At last... we are free.

passages.title: Capturing the Gateway
passages.text:
The time has come to make our move against the Legion.

The Legion has multiple portals across the Broken Isles.

Should your armies succeed in securing one while it's still active, Hymdall can use the runestones you gathered to direct it to whatever hellish world Hodir is trapped in.

passages.title: Capturing the Gateway
passages.text:
The Valarjar have captured the Legion's gateway at Felblaze Ingress.

The time has come to deliver a decisive blow to the enemy. We shall not wait for them to strike here!

passages.title: Preparing For War
passages.text:
We would do well to bolster our own forces before calling upon our allies to join us in the final conflict against the Legion.

There still remains much to do in the Broken Isles and victories there will give us the momentum we need to crush the enemy.

passages.title: Preparing For War
passages.text: Any news, <name>?

passages.title: Preparing For War
passages.text: You and your armies have accomplished much. Odyn chose his commander well.

passages.title: Leyline Feed: Ley Station Aethenar
passages.text:
<This leyline appears to be damaged and needs repair.

Several large chunks of the main column are missing and arcane energy is crackling in the gaps.

The elementals nearby seem to pick up debris and absorb it into their bodies as they move around. Maybe they have the missing pieces...>

passages.title: Leyline Feed: Ley Station Aethenar
passages.text: <The leyline feed crackles as wild energy escapes the gaps in the column.>

passages.title: Leyline Feed: Ley Station Aethenar
passages.text: <As you insert the fragments back into the pillar the arcane energy begins repairing the cracks. You infuse the feed with ancient mana and the structure stirs to life.>

passages.title: To Honor the Fallen
passages.text:
Souls are not the only plunder Helya craves, and the kvaldir are ever eager to please.

Among their spoils are the venerable blades of fallen heroes who dared stand against Helya's minions. These blades belong in a place of honor, not among their wretched kind.

Reclaim the blades, for the honor of the Tideskorn!

passages.title: To Honor the Fallen
passages.text: Do you have the blades?

passages.title: To Honor the Fallen
passages.text:
I will see that these blades are returned where they belong.

The dead smile upon you, outsider.

passages.title: Maw of Souls: Piercing the Mists
passages.text:
In a time before memory, the Naglfar was the prize of Helya's fleet. It would seem that it has lived on to serve her once more.

Now, the dread ship sails the sea of souls, and cuts through the mist unseen by the living. The kvaldir must have a way to summon her, and this is what you must seek.

Find her berth and board the Naglfar. Put an end to the dread ship, and the souls of the Tideskorn may be redeemed.

passages.title: Maw of Souls: Piercing the Mists
passages.text: Is it done?

passages.title: Maw of Souls: Piercing the Mists
passages.text:
With the dread ship sundered, the souls of the dead will know their judgement. 

Odyn will have his champions, and the Tideskorn will have their honor.

passages.title: Maw of Souls: Ymiron's Broken Blade
passages.text:
You hold King Ymiron's blade and realize what a fierce combatant he would make, were he to fight on your side.

Perhaps Odyn could be persuaded to force the vrykul King's spirit to fight alongside your army.

passages.title: Maw of Souls: Ymiron's Broken Blade
passages.text: Very well then.  Let it be done!

passages.title: Needs of the Many
passages.text:
[THIS IS A TEMPORARY QUEST TO GET YOU TO DALARAN IN THE BROKEN ISLES.]

Please take this portal to Dalaran in the Broken Isles and begin your artifact quest!

passages.title: Secrets of the Axes
passages.text:
Battlelord, I have a request. Find me inspiration! An axe whose form has seen a truly astounding amount of battle, wielded by one of the world's most powerful warriors. Both weapon and owner forged together in the crucible of war.

Find this hero and their weapon, and convince them to come here.

passages.title: Secrets of the Axes
passages.text: You've found them?

passages.title: Secrets of the Axes
passages.text:
Thank you, Battlelord. The Valarjar will be even better equipped once I've made my adjustments.

It has also inspired me to think of your weapon. The Blade Breaker. In my mind's eye the axe is called that.

passages.title: Wavespeaker's Trail
passages.text:
The shaman we seek is Wavespeaker Adelee. Her research brought her down to these ancient ruins, where she reported naga armies amassing prior to the Legion invasion.

The last I had heard, she had located Sharas'dal, the Scepter of Tides - and then she went silent.

<name>, Search for clues to her whereabouts among the lower level of the ruins. Beware the naga patrols!

passages.title: Wavespeaker's Trail
passages.text: How goes the search?

passages.title: Wavespeaker's Trail
passages.text:
<You report your findings to Erunak, who listens distractedly while flipping through the journal you located.>

So... the naga have conscripted sea giants to their cause? This is disturbing.

Adelee's journal confirms my fears. The naga have infiltrated the Abyssal Maw once again, and this time they have a powerful weapon with them: Sharas'dal. Our task is clear.

passages.title: The Fourth Horseman
passages.text:
The Lich King demands too much! Tirion Fordring deserves more than a life of anguish and undeath!

Know this, Deathlord... I will obey your will, but there will be no redemption for what we are about to do.

The Silver Hand will never hand Tirion to us. The path to the Fourth Horseman will be soaked in righteous blood!

Blood that will stain our hands forever.

Your will be done, Deathlord. I will begin the preparations to invade Light's Hope. If this is what it takes to save our world, so be it!

passages.title: The Fourth Horseman
passages.text:
I see now what I did not see before. My destiny was written long ago.

This burden has always been mine to bear.

passages.title: Walking in Shadows
passages.text:
If we are to infuse the shard's power into the Ashbringer we will need help. We cannot wield such dark magic; however, I know who can...

The Knights of the Ebon Blade.

I will commission a flight for you to Acherus at once and meet you there - find Aludane Whitecloud in Dalaran when you are ready.

passages.title: Walking in Shadows
passages.text: Darion owes us this much after all his kind have done.

passages.title: Walking in Shadows
passages.text: It is done. I hope you're right about this, Highlord.

passages.title: Warriors of Light
passages.text: We have gathered to celebrate our victory over the Burning Legion this day. Highlord, please join us.

passages.title: Warriors of Light
passages.text: We rejoice in our triumph!

passages.title: Warriors of Light
passages.text: Thank you for leading us to victory. All hail, Highlord <name>!

passages.title: A Light in the Darkness
passages.text:
Highlord, thank goodness you've arrived! The invasion of Netherlight Temple has begun.

Our forces are already waiting on the other side of the portal.

Join them, and we will close the trap around Lord Balnazzar.

passages.title: A Light in the Darkness
passages.text: The priests have always been our allies and friends. Now, we stand united against a common cause.

passages.title: A Light in the Darkness
passages.text: Victory is ours, Highlord.

passages.title: Softening the Target
passages.text:
The Archdruid's end draws near. His memory will live on in the hearts of all who knew him.

Elothir's desperate efforts revealed that Malfurion is being held in Shala'nir, amidst the roots of Shaladrassil.

My love. So near, yet so far....

Shala'nir is infested with Nightmare creatures. To rush in would be suicide.

I subdued one of Xavius' creatures. Use it against him, <name> and clear us a path.

passages.title: Softening the Target
passages.text: Have you managed to thin their numbers?

passages.title: Softening the Target
passages.text: This place remains deadly, but we can now press forward.

passages.title: Nobundo's Last Stand
passages.text:
The Exodar shook from the force of the Legion's arrival. Before we could react, demons were running rampant through the halls, slaughtering everything in their path. If it were not for the Prophet, we would have all perished in the initial assault.

I was charged with evacuating the Crystal Hall, which is when my Broken and I were separated from the main force.

We fell back into the collapsed hall to make our last stand.

With your aid, we may survive this invasion.

passages.title: Nobundo's Last Stand
passages.text: The Legion must fall!

passages.title: Nobundo's Last Stand
passages.text:
You have my thanks, and the gratitude of the Broken, hero. Many would have considered us an acceptable loss, yet you have shown us great compassion and kindness. An act that I - we - will not soon forget.

Now we will return to the Vault of Lights and assist Velen as best we can.

passages.title: Aiding the Conclave
passages.text:
The priests of the Conclave are formidable allies. With our combined strength, we may just have a chance to slay the dreadlord, forever.

Let Alonsus Faol know that we will be by your side and ready to fight when you need us.

passages.title: Aiding the Conclave
passages.text:
With the paladins on our side, united under the Light, the prophecy is fulfilled.

We must now prepare. Balnazzar will attack, and we need to be ready.

passages.title: The Battle for Broken Shore
passages.text:
The third fleet has shipped out ahead of us, <name>. This gryphon will bring you to them.

Good luck out there. It's clear the Legion isn't going to make this easy, but let's hope King Varian has matters well in hand.

passages.title: The Battle for Broken Shore
passages.text:
Ah, <name>, you're up! I'm relieved you made it out of that bloodbath alive. We lost so many good women and men down there...

Damn the Horde for serving us up to the Legion!

passages.title: Hidden History
passages.text:
I will need more research material if I'm to keep improving on our current records.

If I am to get started, I need a series of ancient tomes to begin my research. They may be hard to procure. I'll give you my notes to help you find them.

passages.title: Hidden History
passages.text:
It may sound strange, but in order to do more research I will need, uh, more research material.

If I am to get started, I need a series of ancient tomes to begin my research. They may be hard to procure. I'll give you my notes to help you find them.

passages.title: Hidden History
passages.text:
I will need to increase our overall knowledge levels before I can research the artifact further.

Before I can get started, I need a series of ancient tomes to begin my research. They may be hard to procure. I'll give you my notes to help you find them.

passages.title: Hidden History
passages.text:
You have a weapon both ancient and powerful. And yet, we barely understand it.

If we truly want to unlock all of its potential, we need to learn more about it. I can help with that.

Before I can get started though, I need a series of ancient tomes. They may be hard to procure. I asked one of the scouts to seek them out, here are her notes.

passages.title: Hidden History
passages.text:
We definitely have plans to improve our research methods. 

Before I can get started though, I need a series of ancient tomes to begin my research. They may be hard to procure. I had one of the initiates attempt to find them. Here are her notes.

passages.title: Hidden History
passages.text:
I have some ideas on how we can improve our research methods.

Before I can get started though, I need a series of ancient tomes to begin my research. They may be hard to procure. I put one of the researchers on digging up where they might be. Here are her notes.

passages.title: Hidden History
passages.text:
More research? Absolutely!

Before I can get started though, I need a series of ancient tomes to begin my research. They may be hard to procure. I'll give you my notes to help you find them.

passages.title: Hidden History
passages.text:
I think I can help you, I mean all of us, out.

Before I can get started though, I need some books. Some important ones. They may be hard to pinch. I'll give you my notes to help you find them.

passages.title: Hidden History
passages.text: I know of a few books that will give me the right place to start. They may be hard to get your hands on, but they'll be worth it. I'll give you my notes to help you find them.

passages.title: Hidden History
passages.text: Before I can get started though, I need a series of ancient tomes to begin my research. They may be hard to procure. I'll give you my notes to help you find them.

passages.title: Hidden History
passages.text:
You wield ancient steel, strengthened by magics we barely understand.

If you truly want to unlock the potential of your weapons, you need to know more of how they were forged, and of the battles they've fought in. I can help with this.

Your races use books to store their histories, and I will need some of these to piece together the legend of your steel. I asked one of your followers to look into their locations for me. Here are her notes.

passages.title: Sealing Fate: Order Resources
passages.text: Feeling safe, stranger?

passages.title: Sealing Fate: Stashed Order Resources
passages.text: Feeling safe, stranger?

passages.title: Sealing Fate: Extraneous Order Resources
passages.text: Feeling safe, stranger?

passages.title: Sealing Fate: Gold
passages.text: A simple exchange with complex results.  That's the art of doing business.

passages.title: Sealing Fate: Piles of Gold
passages.text: A simple exchange with complex results.  That's the art of doing business.

passages.title: Sealing Fate: Immense Fortune of Gold
passages.text: A simple exchange with complex results.  That's the art of doing business.

passages.title: Focusing Our Efforts
passages.text:
The Nightfallen in Suramar were once a part of the Nightborne, but have been exiled by their former brethren and cut off from the Nightwell.

I believe they could be valuable allies in our quest if you can turn them to our side. I know only that they have gone into hiding somewhere in Suramar.

Afterward, seek out the Moon Guard in the northern reaches of Suramar. They, too, could be valuable allies in our cause... if they still oppose the Legion as they once did many years ago.

passages.title: Focusing Our Efforts
passages.text: Let us speak with Thalrenus and discuss our plan of action.

passages.title: The Protectors
passages.text:
To fully unlock the powers of the Idol, we will need four manifestations of the wilds - an essence of ferocity, essence of regrowth, essence of balance, and essence of tenacity.

To find these essences, we must consult the protectors of the forest.

Go to the Emerald Dreamway and call upon the powers of the ancient druidic stones. The protectors will only show themselves to those who can prove their connection to the wilds.

passages.title: The Protectors
passages.text: Did you sense the protectors of the wilds? Their presence is ever with us.

passages.title: Bringer of the Light
passages.text:
Turalyon lives! For ages I had thought that my old friend had perished on some desolate Legion world. But to know that he yet lives and is in danger is too much to bear.

We must hurry, <name>. We must uncover the object's sacred purpose.

The prophet of whom Turalyon spoke of is undoubtedly the leader of the draenei, Velen. Take the object and journey to the Exodar. It is there that you will find Prophet Velen.

I will open a portal for you now. Take my beacon and use it when you are ready to return.

passages.title: Bringer of the Light
passages.text: Have you discovered anything about the object?

passages.title: Bringer of the Light
passages.text:
Kil'jaeden took the child from Velen, let Velen believe that the boy had been killed, then raised the child as an agent of the Burning Legion with the express purpose of murdering his own father? That bastard waited 13,000 years to exact vengeance upon Velen for defying Sargeras and the Legion? The Deceiver indeed...

For Velen to have to experience such tragedy after what he and his people have already been through is heartbreaking. Such a thing would test anyone's faith.

passages.title: They Have A Pitlord
passages.text:
The Feltotem are not the first to embrace the temptations of the Burning Legion. And they will not be the last.

But in their arrogance, they have conjured a pit lord.

Will you join us in battle against this beast? The power of your artifact and skill could prove invaluable against such a creature.

passages.title: They Have A Pitlord
passages.text: The other demons we will contend with in time. But that pit lord, it was a creature of great evil and beyond our devices to defeat on our own. Your skills were appreciated.

passages.title: Neltharion's Lair: Essence of Tenacity
passages.text:
Greetings, Archdruid. I hear that you seek the essence of tenacity.

There is none more unyielding and unbreakable than a creature of stone.

In Neltharion's Lair is a monster known as Rokmora. Slay him, and draw from him the essence that you need.

passages.title: Neltharion's Lair: Essence of Tenacity
passages.text: Stand firm, <class>.

passages.title: Neltharion's Lair: Essence of Tenacity
passages.text: Thank you, Archdruid.

passages.title: Halls of Valor: Essence of Ferocity
passages.text:
To find the essence of ferocity, you must seek a creature who has slain thousands, and is revered by even the gods.

I speak of none other than the wolf, Fenryr, whom you can find hunting in the eternal forests of the Halls of Valor.

passages.title: Halls of Valor: Essence of Ferocity
passages.text: It takes a ferocious beast to take down another ferocious beast.

passages.title: Halls of Valor: Essence of Ferocity
passages.text: Excellent, Arch <class>.

passages.title: Darkheart Thicket: Essence of Regrowth
passages.text:
My child, I can think of only one place to capture the essence of regrowth.

Deep within Darkheart Thicket is Oakheart, a loyal ancient defender of the grove. He has recently fallen to the Nightmare's corruption, but deep within his heart, he still fights.

Gather the essence of this great tree, so that his everliving soul may be used to fuel new life.

passages.title: Darkheart Thicket: Essence of Regrowth
passages.text: My heart aches for those fallen to the Nightmare.

passages.title: Darkheart Thicket: Essence of Regrowth
passages.text: I am sad to hear of Oakheart's demise, but his soul will live on.

passages.title: The Grimoire of the First Necrolyte
passages.text:
This ancient tome appears to be the spellbook of Sataiel, the first necrolyte.

Within its pages of curses and cantrips, you discover instructions for a ritual that Sataiel was concocting to empower Ulthalesh, the Deadwind Harvester. She calls this ritual, "The Rite of the Executioner."

The site was chosen and prepared, but Sataiel met her unfortunate end before she could proceed. Perhaps you can pick up where she left off?

First, you'll need some skulls.

passages.title: The Grimoire of the First Necrolyte
passages.text: There's just enough room on the altar for the bounty of skulls you've collected.

passages.title: The Grimoire of the First Necrolyte
passages.text:
The altar is coated with hundreds of years of dust, but the candles somehow still glow in the distance.

This must be the site for the ritual.

passages.title: Protect the Home Front
passages.text:
The Legion hasn't just invaded this city. Their evil is spreading across Azeroth, threatening the far corners of our world.

We must seek them out and stop them, everywhere their darkness touches.

We've dispatched scouts around the world to watch for Legion activity. As invasions arise, we'll mark the locations on your map.

Make them suffer, <name>!

passages.title: Protect the Home Front
passages.text: Find them! Stop them! Suffer well!

passages.title: Protect the Home Front
passages.text:
You've done it! You've broken an invasion!

If only that had ended our campaign. But the Legion will never relent until they are destroyed... or have destroyed us.

Don't let up! Fight off more of these wretched invasions, <name>. The wyrmtongue we're holding captive here will reward your efforts.

passages.title: Supply Dropped
passages.text:
These supplies for the Earthen Ring have not been processed yet. It looks like someone has been rummaging through them and looting whatever can be carried. You have reasons to suspect the Grimtotem tribe, on account of the fact that one of their champions is nearby, visibly pilfering your stuff.

Challenge the Grimtotem to secure your resources!

passages.title: Supply Dropped
passages.text: <The Grimtotem Champion snorts derisively at you.>

passages.title: Supply Dropped
passages.text:
Very well, I yield - I yield!

Curse you, <class>, and that weapon of yours. Without it the Grimtotem would've been victorious.

Take your lousy supplies. But we will be back!

passages.title: Illidari Allies
passages.text:
At first I was unsure whether it was wise to allow the Illidari inside the city. But they may have just saved all our lives.

I gave the demon hunters leave to establish a temporary camp in the Mage Quarter. I'd like you to be my personal envoy to them. Thank the Illidari for their assistance and see how they can aid our cause.

Just... keep your eyes open. They have harnessed a terrible power, and we must be ready should they be consumed by the darkness within.

passages.title: Illidari Allies
passages.text:
I see by the blood spatters that Jace revealed the demons to you. I trust the young king is safe.

We have more work ahead of us, <class>. Much more.

passages.title: A Growing Crisis
passages.text:
The Arcan'dor is failing.

This energy was once bound in its boughs and fueled its growth. There was balance, between life and arcane.

Now that energy is breaking free. When the heart can no longer hold it, this tree will kill every living thing in this hall.

I have seen this happen before and I must find a way to stop it from happening again. 

We must go to the tree that came before. Its bones can guide us.

Meet me at the temple of Fal'adora. We will descend together.

passages.title: A Growing Crisis
passages.text: I must find a way...

passages.title: The Rite of the Executioner
Dark Secrets and Shady Deals
passages.text:
Whatever Amber Kearnen knew, Mathias Shaw didn't want it gettin' out...

Aye, this be dirty business indeed, hiring th' Red Blade at such a price... just to hunt down and kill one of their own!

Ye best get back to th' Hall 'o Shadows, and let Lord Ravenholdt know what we found here in Citrine Bay.

Whatever SI:7 be up to, it be goin' deeper than we first imagined...

passages.title: Dark Secrets and Shady Deals
passages.text:
SI:7 made a secret deal with The Red Blade to hunt down Amber Kearnen?

It seems that Master Mathias Shaw was willing to pay any cost to have her dealt with...

passages.title: In the Blink of an Eye
passages.text:
The Broken Isles is our destination, <name>.

The spell that will blink Dalaran to its new location is not a simple one. It will take this Council's full energy and attention.

As Jaina is... absent, Kalecgos of the blue dragonflight has offered us his aid.

The Legion will make every attempt to stop us, but we will not falter. It is time to begin!

passages.title: In the Blink of an Eye
passages.text:
Ah, <name>, it's good to see you on your feet! The members of the Council of Six are recuperating from their ordeal.

The intensity of the teleportation spell can be disorienting. It seems you lost consciousness for a time, but at least you didn't awaken to find yourself stuck in a wall!

Dalaran has been relocated to the Broken Isles. From here, we will spearhead the effort to acquire the Pillars of Creation and drive the Legion from Azeroth once and for all!

passages.title: The Might of Dalaran
passages.text:
In times of great need, the mages of Dalaran can focus their power into one pure, destructive form. This is such a time.

On request, these mages will channel that power into a focusing crystal, which we will impart to you. Use it to unleash that power, completing a quest of great value.

passages.title: The Might of Dalaran
passages.text: Channel the power of Dalaran into the focusing crystal, then unleash it to complete a World Quest.

passages.title: The Might of Dalaran
passages.text: Well done, though that certainly takes all of our efforts.  It will be some time before we can do that again.

passages.title: One More Thing...
passages.text:
Well done, Slayer. You are truly now the leader of the Illidari. But there's one more thing.

Meet me down at the forge.

passages.title: One More Thing...
passages.text: Excellent. You're going to like this.

passages.title: Unleashing our Wrath
passages.text:
In times of great need, we can rally our mightiest forces into one pure, destructive form. This is such a time.

On request, these we will channel our power into an item, which we will impart to you. Use it to unleash that power, completing a quest of great value.

passages.title: Unleashing our Wrath
passages.text: Channel the power of the Frost Wyrm, then unleash it to complete a World Quest.

passages.title: Unleashing our Wrath
passages.text: Well done, though that certainly takes all of our efforts.

passages.title: Champion of the Light
passages.text:
<name>, your strength and leadership inspires awe in all of us!

The Silver Hand is prepared to furnish you with a full set of armor to aid in the fight against the Burning Legion. Continue expanding your influence across the Broken Isles, and we may yet achieve victory.

passages.title: Champion of the Light
passages.text: We stand with you, <name>.

passages.title: Gazing Into Oblivion
passages.text:
<name>, your wisdom and leadership inspires awe in all of us!

The Council of the Black Harvest is prepared to furnish you with a full set of armor to aid in the fight against the Burning Legion. Continue expanding your influence across the Broken Isles, and we may yet achieve victory.

passages.title: Gazing Into Oblivion
passages.text: The Council admires your power, <name>.

passages.title: The Emerald Nightmare: Piercing the Veil
passages.text: The darkness of the Nightmare is like a heavy shroud, warping reality and altering the perception of all living things. As areas of the Dream are cleansed, Xavius's hold weakens, and the way to the heart of the Nightmare will be revealed. But there might be a more direct way... my teacher once spoke of a pure power that could illuminate the darkness of the Nightmare, and allow all paths to become clear. But alas, Cenarius is lost....

passages.title: The Emerald Nightmare: Piercing the Veil
passages.text: If only Cenarius were with us, we could confront Xavius at once.

passages.title: The Emerald Nightmare: Piercing the Veil
passages.text: Incredible... where did you find these? With these Essences, I will be able to open the way directly to the heart of the Nightmare. Let us make haste!

passages.text: If only Cenarius were with us, we could confront Xavius at once.

passages.title: The Emerald Nightmare: Piercing the Veil
passages.text: Incredible... where did you find these? With these Essences, I will be able to open the way directly to the heart of the Nightmare. Let us make haste!

passages.title: Vault of the Wardens: A Masterpiece of Flesh
passages.text:
Ah, Deathlord! What a pleasant surprise! It is not often that you visit my workshop of blood and flesh.

Actually, I have something quite special to show you. I have been developing a new type of abomination that mixes the flesh of demons with that of humans.

My first prototype, Rottgut, is nearly complete! However I am still missing some of the more difficult-to-find body items.

The prisoners in the Vault of the Wardens should make fine donors for the parts I require.

passages.title: Vault of the Wardens: A Masterpiece of Flesh
passages.text: Have you retrieved the parts?

passages.title: Vault of the Wardens: A Masterpiece of Flesh
passages.text:
Yes, these parts shall do nicely!

Now go on and introduce yourself to Rottgut! I'm sure the two of you will get along... infamously!

passages.title: Assault on Violet Hold: Purple Pain
passages.text:
Again! It happened again!

Sure, it's the Legion that staged the prison breakout this time, but I *told* them it was a bad idea to keep some of the most dangerous beings on Azeroth in a prison inside our city!

We can talk about relocating later, I suppose. Right now, we've got some... pacification to tend to.

Can you help?

passages.title: Assault on Violet Hold: Purple Pain
passages.text: Oh, no. Don't tell me something ELSE has gone wrong?!

passages.title: Assault on Violet Hold: Purple Pain
passages.text:
Whew. That's a SECOND invasion dealt with. Well done.

Now, who do I talk to about getting this place shut down?

passages.title: Aggra's Guidance
passages.text:
<class>t, have you met the shaman Aggra? Born of a shattered world, she learned the ways of the elements among the Mag'har orcs of Outland. On the eve of the Cataclysm she took it upon herself to complete Thrall's shamanistic training. Our younger initiates are fortunate to have her among us to guide them.

If you wish to seek out a second artifact, Aggra can assist you. She is training new recruits above us on the Storm's Eye Overlook.

passages.title: Aggra's Guidance
passages.text: I have been waiting for you, Farseer.

passages.title: The Red Axe
passages.text:
Broxigar the Red is cornered on the bridge. I am not sure he would ever admit that he needs our help, but I feel it only proper to lend him our aid.

If you wish to assist our ally, I would be humbled to accompany you in this endeavor.

passages.title: The Red Axe
passages.text: Our allies are strong, but our enemy is Legion!

passages.title: The Red Axe
passages.text: A wise warrior welcomes all allies. You fight with the strength of an orc.

passages.title: Hunter of Night
passages.text:
A glorious battle indeed!

If I am correct, we can expect something a bit more deadly at any moment.

The Legion often uses fodder such as these to prepare the way for a more worthy foe.

My axe is sharp and ready.

passages.title: Hunter of Night
passages.text: Are you sure you are a night elf? You wage battle with the ferocity of an orc!

passages.title: Hunter of Night
passages.text: The spirits honor us with a day of glorious combat! You have my well-earned respect, Illidan Stormrage. I will gladly follow you into any battle.

passages.title: Ravencrest's Legacy
passages.text:
Years later, as the War of the Ancients raged on and the Burning Legion's grip upon this world took hold, Illidan would meet a military leader known as Kur'talos Ravencrest. He too would see the potential within Illidan, eventually promoting him to captain of the Moon Guard: a powerful group of night elf sorcerers.

We must experience this memory in Black Rook Hold, located on the western shores of Val'sharah.

passages.title: Ravencrest's Legacy
passages.text: Without Light, the darkness cannot exist.

passages.title: Ravencrest's Legacy
passages.text:
The line between good and evil is thin, and resides in a place where intention means little.

Illidan wondered how those around him could be so blind to the threat of the Burning Legion. Fate is not without a sense of irony.

passages.title: Destiny Unfulfilled
passages.text:
Hardly recognizable from the golden eyed child of prophecy, and living as an outcast on the fringes of a shattered world, his motivation remained unchanged. His assaults on the Legion and his attempts to end their march were his only focus.

Yet, in a strange twist of fate, it was not the Burning Legion who came for him in the end.

We must travel to Outland to experience Illidan's last memory.

passages.title: Destiny Unfulfilled
passages.text: When the vessel is prepared, we will seek out his soul.

passages.title: Destiny Unfulfilled
passages.text:
I wept when I touched your consciousness in the Great Dark, mortal. For I saw his fall, and I saw you, your shadow casting a dark pall over his body. I felt hatred in your heart as it corrupted your mind.

It was not Light's Heart, but you, that needed preparation. Now you know truth. Are you prepared to do what must be done to save your world and all others?

When the time is right, I will call upon you to begin the hunt for Illidan's soul.

His rebirth will be the story of your redemption.

passages.title: Destiny Unfulfilled
passages.text:
Hardly recognizable from the golden eyed child of prophecy, and living as an outcast on the fringes of a shattered world, his motivation remained unchanged. His assaults on the Legion and his attempts to end their march were his only focus.

Yet, in a strange twist of fate, it was not the Burning Legion who came for him in the end.

We must travel to Outland to experience Illidan's last memory.

passages.title: Destiny Unfulfilled
passages.text: When the vessel is prepared, we will seek out his soul.

passages.title: Destiny Unfulfilled
passages.text:
In the end, the denizens of Azeroth and Outland came to exact their vengeance upon Illidan. Though you did not strike a blow against him, you were complicit in his fall.

I showed you Illidan's life so that you would understand why he fought and made the choices that he made. Yours was the vessel that needed preparation.

If the hatred and doubt in your heart has subsided, take your place at the side of the Light. Soon I will call upon you as we begin the hunt for Illidan's soul.

passages.title: Destiny Unfulfilled
passages.text:
Hardly recognizable from the golden eyed child of prophecy, and living as an outcast on the fringes of a shattered world, his motivation remained unchanged. His assaults on the Legion and his attempts to end their march were his only focus.

Yet, in a strange twist of fate, it was not the Burning Legion who came for him in the end.

We must travel to Outland to experience Illidan's last memory.

passages.title: Destiny Unfulfilled
passages.text: When the vessel is prepared, we will seek out his soul.

passages.title: Destiny Unfulfilled
passages.text:
Forgive me, noble soul. I mislead you. Light's Heart was not the vessel that required preparation, it was yours.

You, who sacrificed everything for your world, and served your master dutifully until the end. These memories will serve to strengthen your resolve. Look to them when the dark temptation surrounds you and let them grant you the strength to resist and rise against the corrupters.

We will save Illidan and once more you will battle at the side of your master for the fate of all worlds.

passages.title: Author! Author!
passages.text:
We've reviewed the tome recovered from Karazhan. Though we found references to the Pillars of Creation, one piece of crucial information was omitted from the book... where to find the artifacts.

Fortunately, we have access to an expert on the subject.

The author, Alodi, was the first Guardian of Tirisfal. His spirit is forever bound to the Forge of the Guardian, which has been hidden in our safekeeping. I think the time has come to call him forth.

passages.title: Author! Author!
passages.text: Alodi's knowledge of the Pillars of Creation is crucial to our campaign against the Legion.

passages.title: Author! Author!
passages.text:
We may not have the exact location of the Pillars of Creation, but at least we know where to start. We'll explore every corner of the Broken Isles until they're recovered.

The Legion's attack is intensifying. We must prepare to move Dalaran to the Broken Isles!

passages.title: The Battle for Broken Shore
passages.text:
This wind rider will take you to Broken Shore, <name>. May your weapon bring you many kills today.

The Warchief has already made landfall, I will wager you will simply need to follow the trail of demon blood.

passages.title: The Battle for Broken Shore
passages.text: Glad to see you back on your feet, <name>. Many good soldiers who sailed for the Broken Shore were not so fortunate.

passages.title: Crushing the Crown
passages.text:
This ledger is full of locations, and I need you to investigate and take action, pal. This has gone on long enough.

Here's an entry I want you to check out: it's just south of Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest. That can't be good. Get out there and rough 'em up.

Oh, and if you see something big and dangerous enough that it needs destroying, toss this bomb at it.

passages.title: Crushing the Crown
passages.text: Good job, kid. You deserve a little somethin'. And hey, come back tomorrow if you get the time; I might have a job for ya.

passages.text:
