Here's an entry I want you to check out: it's just south of Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest. That can't be good. Get out there and rough 'em up.

Oh, and if you see something big and dangerous enough that it needs destroying, toss this bomb at it.

passages.title: Crushing the Crown
passages.text: Good job, kid. You deserve a little somethin'. And hey, come back tomorrow if you get the time; I might have a job for ya.

passages.title: Follow the Recipe
passages.text: This seems to be part of a recipe for whatever concoction the Crown Chemical Company is cooking up. The other parts must be nearby.

passages.title: Follow the Recipe
passages.text: Aha! With this we can start on an antidote for this awful mixture. Thank you for bringing this to me.

passages.title: Follow the Recipe
passages.text: This seems to be part of a recipe for whatever concoction the Crown Chemical Company is cooking up. The other parts must be nearby.

passages.title: Follow the Recipe
passages.text: Aha! With this we can start on an antidote for this awful mixture. Thank you for bringing this to me.

passages.title: Building an Army
passages.text:
We must keep our eyes on the future. There will come a time when we will need an army.

We've proven that the withered are not completely beyond redemption. They can be taught, and molded.

I want you to be their combat trainer, <name>. Come with me. We can use the nearby ruins as an arena to hone their abilities.

passages.title: In the Blink of an Eye
passages.text:
<The entity speaks with the familiar voice of Archmage Khadgar.>

Azeroth needs you, <name>!

After scouring Ulduar and Karazhan for answers, we know the key to defeating the Legion: five ancient artifacts called the Pillars of Creation.

To find them, Dalaran must be moved to the Broken Isles. As our leader Jaina is... absent, Kalecgos of the blue dragonflight has offered the Kirin Tor his aid.

The Legion is assaulting our current position over Deadwind Pass. Hurry!

passages.title: In the Blink of an Eye
passages.text:
Ah, <name>, it's good to see you on your feet! The members of the Council of Six are recuperating from their ordeal.

The intensity of the teleportation spell can be disorienting. It seems you lost consciousness for a time, but at least you didn't awaken to find yourself stuck in a wall!

Dalaran has been relocated to the Broken Isles. From here, we will spearhead the effort to acquire the Pillars of Creation and drive the Legion from Azeroth once and for all!

passages.title: Holding the Lines
passages.text:
Karazhan sits upon a confluence of ley lines. It's why this location was chosen for the tower in the first place... a fact that has not escaped the Legion's notice.

If the demons are tapping into these lines of power, they must need their energy for something particularly menacing. You must cut off their access to the ley lines if we're to have a chance of retaking the tower, <name>.

passages.title: Holding the Lines
passages.text: The Legion's hold wanes. Our time to strike grows nearer.

passages.title: Corruption Runs Deep
passages.text:
Everything the Legion touches is marred by fingerprints of their corruption. If I can study the traces of magic they leave behind, perhaps I can discern their plans for Karazhan.

This vial is specially reinforced to contain fel magic. If you bring me the essences of corrupted soil and water from near their portals, I believe we'll be closer to unraveling their scheme.

passages.title: Corruption Runs Deep
passages.text: What have we here?

passages.title: Corruption Runs Deep
passages.text: Every bit contains an essence of sorts - one we can study to learn things about the magic wielder and ways to manipulate their magic for... other purposes.

passages.title: Reclaiming the Ramparts
passages.text:
With the ley lines protected we must move to secure the tower's perimeter.

Around the tower are several locations where corruption continues to run rampant. Seek out these locations and secure them with these wards.

With the progress we've made so far, bolstering our defenses should keep the remaining Legion's forces at bay just long enough for us to discover who's behind their efforts.

passages.title: Reclaiming the Ramparts
passages.text: Has the tower been secured?

passages.title: Reclaiming the Ramparts
passages.text: You've bought us precious time.

passages.title: Thought Collection
passages.text:
While I examine these samples further, I ask that you seek out one of our patrols in the structure to the north. It appears they've captured one of the demons.

Go, interrogate it. Find out anything you can. And hurry! I'm afraid time is no longer an ally.

passages.title: Thought Collection
passages.text: Has it been handled, <name>?

passages.title: Thought Collection
passages.text: This information is just what we needed.

passages.title: A Thirst For Blood
passages.text:
At last, I have enough Blood of Sargeras to fuel my creations! You will see, Deathlord, what my genius is truly capable of creating...

Now, I must ask that you leave me to my work... there is much to do, and we have little time to waste!

passages.title: Helya's Conquest
passages.text:
If Helya is making an advance on the Broken Isles, we will need to answer in turn.

Go to Tideskorn Harbor and scout her forces. We will see if Helya is foolish enough to begin her campaign against me.

passages.title: Helya's Conquest
passages.text: What is Helya planning?

passages.title: Helya's Conquest
passages.text: She has forced my hand...

passages.title: More Like Me
passages.text:
Greetings, Outlander.

I am Victoire. I served Elisande while she maintained peace in the city. I fought beside demons and worse for the greater good.

The massacre at the Waning Crescent made it clear that she no longer serves the Nightborne. She serves only herself.

There are others who feel as I do. They simply need proof that there is another way.

The Dusk Lily is not unknown to us- try showing it to those now guarding Astravar Harbor. They have seen the worst of Elisande's cruelty.

passages.title: More Like Me
passages.text: Did you find more like me?

passages.title: More Like Me
passages.text:
Hopefully more will follow their example.

Thank you for showing them another way to serve the Nightborne.

passages.title: Missing Persons
passages.text:
Our new friend brings us some disturbing information.

She claims to have seen a large number of citizens dragged from Starcaller Retreat in chains. Their destination appears to be Astravar Harbor.

Those taken to the harbor have yet to return, however. Worse yet, the area is now overrun with demons.

I need you to find out where these people went. Infiltrate the harbor and gather any information you can.

Start with the Legion filth- their corpses may point us in the right direction.

passages.title: Missing Persons
passages.text: Have you learned where the captives have been taken?

passages.title: Missing Persons
passages.text: <Silgryn stares grimly at the communicator.>

passages.title: Hostage Situation
passages.text:
Our own people, sacrificed to the Legion!

We need to intercept a transport if we intend to put an end to this trade. I'm afraid this does mean you will be playing the part of a captive, my friend.

Before voicing your concerns, try to have a little faith.

We will follow behind in one of Deline's boats and break you out once we know where they are going.

Go to the harbor and find a group of captives. Stand among them. Allow yourself to be taken.

We will not be far.

passages.title: Hostage Situation
passages.text: Please try to trust me. We will allow no harm to come to you.

passages.title: Hostage Situation
passages.text: Thank you for taking this risk. Let us put an end to this now!

passages.title: Trial of Valor: Odyn's Favor
passages.text:
The time to deal with that treacherous witch has come. I suspect you may be the one to deal the final blow, but I must be certain.

See me in the Halls of Valor and we will test the strength of your will.

passages.title: Trial of Valor: Odyn's Favor
passages.text: Now a greater task awaits you.

passages.title: The Power of Corruption
passages.text:
The time has come at last.

Deep within the cavernous underbelly of Karazhan lies a long-forgotten chamber. Based on what you learned from our demon friend, I believe this is where its mistress dwells.

This demon's master must come from the highest ranks of the Burning Legion. This does not bode well for Karazhan.

We need to secure Deadwind Pass, <name>.

You must find this demon and destroy it.

passages.title: The Power of Corruption
passages.text: The threat must be removed.

passages.title: The Power of Corruption
passages.text:
Our worst fears have been proven true, <name>. The Legion's presence is deeply rooted in the tower.

The time has come. We must take back Karazhan!

passages.title: Fragments of the Past
passages.text:
Though your primary objective is to liberate the tower from the Legion's hold, I have... another request.

Karazhan is a place where magic and history intertwine. Moments of the past have been known to take physical form, and these forms can possess great power.

As you journey through Karazhan, watch for places where memories coalesce. These fragments could provide valuable insight into what's really going on inside that tower.

passages.title: Fragments of the Past
passages.text: Have you recovered the fragments?

passages.title: Fragments of the Past
passages.text:
For so long the secrets of the tower have remained hidden... I feel as if I have learned more about my former master.

I am greatful we were able to see this journey through together, <name>.

passages.title: Return to Karazhan: In the Eye of the Beholder
passages.text:
The Legion's intentions are clear. They intend to harness the tower's magical energy to communicate with other Legion worlds!

I'm afraid we haven't much time, <name>. You must ascend the tower and destroy this monstrosity before it is too late!

passages.title: Return to Karazhan: In the Eye of the Beholder
passages.text: The tower must be restored.

passages.title: Return to Karazhan: In the Eye of the Beholder
passages.text:
Your efforts today will not be forgotten, <name>.

Though the Legion's presence has left its mark on the Karazhan we once knew, I am certain the fate of the tower will not disappoint.

passages.title: Gates of the Nighthold
passages.text:
Our combined armies are arrayed in front of the palace, ready to strike! I cannot believe the time has come.

Your allied commanders are already there and we will join you. Make your way to Astravar Harbor and speak with Khadgar. He is coordinating the attack, or at least I think he is.

See you there... and thanks for everything.

passages.title: Gates of the Nighthold
passages.text: Well, that was... unexpected.

passages.title: Gates of the Nighthold
passages.text: Thank you for saving me. It seems we underestimated Elisande's power.

passages.title: Ready for Battle
passages.text:
Thanks to your efforts and a lot of effort on the part of our new army, the Nightfallen are prepared for battle.

What is more, we have managed to evacuate nearly all of the civilians between here and Astravar Harbor.

I have drafted plans that can lead our combined forces through the city and take the harbor.

Can you deliver these plans to Vereesa, Tyrande and Liadrin?

passages.title: Ready for Battle
passages.text: So many different types of elves. Each of us changed in some way by the magic we wield. It is very, enlightening.

passages.title: Ready for Battle
passages.text: Well, with these plans and a little luck, we might be able to get through this with far less collateral damage than I would have expected.

passages.title: Tavernkeeper's Fate
passages.text:
I have finished unraveling Ly'leth's message.

I want you to come with me to her estate. It is long past time I returned to the city.

passages.title: Tavernkeeper's Fate
passages.text: Dire news like this cannot wait.

passages.title: Tavernkeeper's Fate
passages.text: We need to take action immediately!

passages.title: Stranglethorn Fishing Extravaganza
passages.text: You'd better hurry up and hand over the fish if you want to win!

passages.title: Away From Prying Eyes
passages.text:
Wars are not won solely with armies charging bravely across the battlefield, <class>t.

Sometimes, it is the actions of individuals that matter most, fighting battles few ever hear about. That is why - 

<Khadgar furrows his brow slightly.>

We should really discuss this somewhere a tad more private. Let's move up to the Purple Parlor, shall we?

passages.title: Away From Prying Eyes
passages.text: We should discuss this matter further in the Purple Parlor just above us.

passages.title: Away From Prying Eyes
passages.text:
Don't worry, she'll be alright.

Whatever demon did this to her didn't hang around long enough to finish the job.

passages.title: The Bonemother
passages.text:
It's time to call the mother, the true reason we came. She is strong, her sheer will and strength allowing her to face this peak in order to watch over the remains of her brood. While the Thorignir is a grand sight, I like my dragons a little more bony. She must die first.

Remember the pyre where we met? She is its guardian, as the spirit was at the peak. If we light it, she will come.

passages.title: The Bonemother
passages.text: That was quite the entrance, Deathlord.

passages.title: Against Magatha's Will
passages.text: Well? What are you waiting for? Hand over the Doomstone.

passages.title: Against Magatha's Will
passages.text:
The Doomstone! I thought it legend, but here it is before me

Can you feel its power radiating? We must only use it in times of utmost need; its power has a heavy price.

You were right not to give it to Magatha. It could do much harm in her hands.

I trust you to keep it safe while we prepare an appropriate home for it.

passages.title: The Seal's Power
passages.text:
The Nightwell is so overloaded that they could not spare anything for this seal. Instead, they are borrowing power from the ley lines.

I have traced one of their power sources to Kel'balor. We should head there immediately so I can determine how best to disable this barrier.

Yes of course I said "we." Surely you do not expect me to go without my bodyguard, do you?

I shall meet you there!

passages.title: The Seal's Power
passages.text: Have you and Valtrois learned anything about the barrier?

passages.title: The Seal's Power
passages.text:
Valtrois told me everything. She is hard at work on a plan for bringing down that barrier.

I am afraid all we can do for now is wait. Thank you for your help.

passages.title: Nullified
passages.text:
The magus in charge of the defenses here is powerful. Perhaps too strong, even for the both of us.

Fortunately, the sin'dorei know a thing or two about magic. The mage's barrier is strong, but we are clever.

He has somehow channeled enough energy into his staff to power another set of defense portals, but he has left it out of his sight. Bring me the staff and an energy source from one of those constructs. I should be able to create just the thing we need to take that shield out.

passages.title: Nullified
passages.text: It is really child's play when you consider the magical weaves. I can see the flaws with just a few minutes of study.

passages.title: Nullified
passages.text: Excellent work. The weapon will provide the proper housing, and the magical signatures on the core will let me bypass...

passages.title: Trolling Them
passages.text:
My army is disciplined, and they will follow my order not to engage the Sin'dorei in combat unless I give the command.

However, it is with some level of shame that I must admit both armies have been attempting to harass the other with pranks, littering our respective camps with insults.

Please, adventurer, we need someone both armies respect to collect these items before fighting breaks out.

passages.title: Trolling Them
passages.text: We elves are long lived, but not as long lived as our prejudices it would seem.

passages.title: Trolling Them
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. Hopefully, since our forces saw you performing this task they will come to their senses and stop this harassment.

passages.title: Trolling Them
passages.text:
My army is disciplined, and they will follow my order not to engage the kaldorei in combat unless I give the command.

However, it is with some level of shame that I must admit both armies have been attempting to harass the other with pranks, littering our respective camps with insults.

Please, adventurer, we need someone both armies respect to collect these items before fighting breaks out.

passages.title: Trolling Them
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. Hopefully, since our forces saw you performing this task they will come to their senses and stop this harassment.

passages.title: Clearing the Air
passages.text:
Ancient weapons require ancient offerings to regain the knowledge on how to construct them.

If you wish to learn how weapons forged from air are crafted, then you must first battle with beings born from it.

Bring me their cores and I will gift you the knowledge you seek.

passages.title: Clearing the Air
passages.text: Be mindful of their attacks, for with air, you never know it's there until you feel it move across your skin.

passages.title: Clearing the Air
passages.text:
I smell the air about you and see that you have returned triumphant.

Here is the knowledge that you seek.

passages.title: Trial of Valor: Odyn's Judgment
passages.text: You've proven worthy to challenge Helya. Now with my blessing, the power to defeat her is yours.

passages.title: Trial of Valor: Odyn's Judgment
passages.text: It is done. Helya's reign comes to an end and now we move forward. You have done a great thing today, champion. Consider yourself counted among those in the Halls of Valor.

passages.title: Talon Terror
passages.text:
I just received word that the Shrine of Aviana is under attack by the Burning Legion! While the Druids of the Talon here are taking their time planning and strategizing their defense, our brothers and sisters are being slaughtered where they stand.

I cannot stand idly by while my home shrine is in danger. Please, come with me to save my people.

passages.title: Talon Terror
passages.text: It took all my willpower not to jump into the fray without backup. Let's go!

passages.title: Attack on the Roost
passages.text:
Skylord Shadegrove has been leading the defense of the shrine, but I think he's starting to lose hope. Clearly he needs some more firepower behind him!

Let's take out these demons and fend off the attack. They'll never see it coming!

passages.title: Attack on the Roost
passages.text: I love the feeling of my knife in a demon's back!

passages.title: Attack on the Roost
passages.text: Ha! Take that, demon scum!

passages.title: Uncovering Orders
passages.text:
It would seem secret orders have been parceled out by the Legion's masters. If they're determined to conceal their plan from us, it must pose a dire threat.

We know high-ranking demons and their allies are mobilizing in places of power. Odds are good that they have received similar crystals.

Perhaps you can find one intact, or at least gather enough fragments that we can reassemble one and determine the Legion's target.

passages.title: Uncovering Orders
passages.text: We need to get to the bottom of what the Legion is planning.

passages.title: Uncovering Orders
passages.text:
Well done! That couldn't have been easy.

This should be enough fragments. Let's have a look.

passages.title: Professionally Good Looking
passages.text:
The archmage has recently locked himself away in his tower. If you wish to enter, you'll need help from some of his apprentices. I'm afraid you won't get it dressed like that.

Xylem has a thing for... outfits, and his apprentices use them to show rank. If you wish his apprentices to help you, you'll need to appear their superior. Such is their desire to impress the archmage, many of his apprentices will battle each other for the best pieces.

I think you know where this is going.

passages.title: Professionally Good Looking
passages.text: Feeling stylish?

passages.title: Professionally Good Looking
passages.text:
Yes, I think that will do.

The apprentices outside the tower should think you outrank them now, so you should be able to get some information out of them. You'll need it to bypass the barrier.

passages.title: Order of Incantations
passages.text:
The barrier shielding the tower can only be opened by activating the imbued gems in the correct order. The order is only known to Xylem and his inner circle of apprentices. No others have yet been able to decipher the code, and mistakes are met with deadly consequences.

The aspiring apprentices spend a lot of their time around the tower. Some may have seen or heard something that might point to a solution.

Let us hope, for your sake, their information proves valuable.

passages.title: Inside the Winter Storm
passages.text:
There, it looks like there's a good spot to launch to right across from here. This path should take you all the way to the top.

According to my intel, your dragons should be up there. Let's just hope that they're still in a state to help you.

passages.title: Closing the Eye
passages.text:
We have received reports from the apprentices at Xylem's Tower that they've been able to use the remant of Xylem's portal to pinpoint his location.

We have orders from the Council of Six to open a portal directly to him, though whatever magic he's channeling on the other end is powerful enough to allow us to only keep it open for a brief window.

The apprentice, Joanna asked I give you this message before you proceed. Speak to me when you're ready.

passages.title: Closing the Eye
passages.text:
I apologize for my actions, <class>. I was a fool to tap into the power of the grimoire, and that folly could have cost Azeroth dearly. 

I thank you not only for purging and defeating the shadowy evil that had hold of me, but also for sparing my life.

Myself, as well as all of Azeroth, are in your debt.

passages.title: Worth Its Weight in Steel
passages.text:
Listen, ye seem like one who may be interested in getting a copy of those axe plans.

Could probably make a pretty penny at the auction house on it. But I can't just hand 'em over to ya, <lad/lass>. Not fer free.

That axe blade ye brought me, I could use more of those. Good steel in those blades. Don't worry, <lad/lass>, I just need a few...

What do ye say?

passages.title: Worth Its Weight in Steel
passages.text: You see, I've got a shipment ta fill and it's been slim pickin' round these parts for good metal. Those blades are just what I'm lookin' for.

passages.title: Worth Its Weight in Steel
passages.text:
Oh ho! Look at all that STEEL!

I'll have this shipment finished by the end o' the week. Well done, lad! Well done!

An' as I promised, here are those plans for the hew.

passages.title: Deadmines: Sea'in Red
passages.text: Arr, finally! I been stuck up here f'years with naught company but me own thoughts. Tis good to clap me eyes on another swashbuckling soul. Are ye up for a plot of revenge and skullduggery? These meddlin' Defias thugs murdered me and me crew years ago before they took over this cave. I propose a series of counter-murders to bring about balance! Bring me proof ye've dealt with enough of the thieves to clog a bilge pump!

passages.title: Deadmines: Sea'in Red
passages.text: Revenge is worth waitin' for. Not that I have much in the way of choice.

passages.title: Deadmines: Sea'in Red
passages.text: Ha ha ha! I hope those rotten thugs rot in whatever pit of misery spawned them.

passages.title: Inside the Winter Storm
passages.text:
There, it looks like there's a good spot to launch to right across from here. This path should take you all the way to the top.

According to my intel, your dragons should be up there. Let's just hope that they're still in a state to help you.

passages.title: Blackrock Depths: Jewel of the Depths
passages.text:
Welcome to Everlook. Could I interest you in a new weapon of sorts?

You know, I'm not just into selling weapons of mass dismemberment here at the shop. I like rare jewels as well.

Perhaps you and I can come to an arrangement of sorts in procuring a jewel I've had my eye on getting for quite some time. I have some great blacksmithing plans here you might be interested in, you know, in trade for your services.

Now, onto the details...

passages.title: Blackrock Depths: Jewel of the Depths
passages.text: This ain't no easy task. It's why the jewel's so rare, you see?

passages.title: Blackrock Depths: Jewel of the Depths
passages.text:
Whoa, now that's a RUBY! I'd only ever seen one other of its kind in the world and now I have one.

I tell ya, this is gonna make me stinkin' rich!

But uh, onto your payment. Here are those plans I was mentioning.

passages.title: I'll Just Leave This Here
passages.text:
Valtrois has a plan for the Sanctum's energy barrier.

Several key Arcway locations throughout Suramar harness the power necessary for it. These Energy Disruptors she made will remotely break the links simultaneously on activation, causing the barrier to fall.

Take these devices and install them at the leylines, then return here for the surprise assault on the Sanctum.

passages.title: I'll Just Leave This Here
passages.text: The preparations are nearly complete. Oculeth will be ready to teleport us soon.

passages.title: Teamwork Lesson: Ursoc
passages.text: <Your snowfeather hatchling continues to fight with other pets when threatened. It must learn to remain calm under pressure, even when facing great beasts. Showing it an epic example of teamwork against a great beast might help.>

passages.title: Teamwork Lesson: Ursoc
passages.text: <Your snowfeather hatchling looks to you for guidance.>

passages.title: Teamwork Lesson: Ursoc
passages.text: <The hatchling positively beams at you in pride for defeating such a frightening foe. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

passages.title: Teamwork Lesson: Xavius
passages.text: <Your sharptalon hatchling has taken to hiding in your pack when you approach very powerful creatures in the world. It must learn to remain calm under pressure, even when facing the darkest of nightmares. Showing it an epic example of teamwork against a fearsome foe might help.>

passages.title: Teamwork Lesson: Xavius
passages.text: <Your sharptalon hatchling looks to you for guidance.>

passages.title: Teamwork Lesson: Xavius
passages.text: <The hatchling looks at you timidly. It appears to be a little afraid of your power. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

passages.title: Expending Fel Energy
passages.text:
Soon Kanrethad's banishment will fade, and he will return to our world. 

We must keep him, and his power, out of the Legion's hands at any cost.

If my old friend is still in there somewhere, perhaps we can bring him back.

The crystals you recovered feed on fel energy. We can use the ravenous crystals to siphon away the magic that consumes Kanrethad.

But first, their power must be depleted. To do so, you will need to harness the power of the crystals and use their energy to kill demons.

passages.title: Expending Fel Energy
passages.text: Have the crystals been depleted?

passages.title: Expending Fel Energy
passages.text:
Thank you, Netherlord. I will keep these crystals safe until they are needed.

When we find Kanrethad, we will be ready.

passages.title: The Fel-Etched Bone
passages.text:
<The bone is covered in intricate runes, etched directly into the surface in what can only be powerful fel magic.>

<Surely someone among the Kirin Tor in Dalaran would be interested in this.>

passages.title: The Inferno Stone
passages.text:
<While just another bit of fel debris to the untrained eye, you recognize this stone as one of the catalysts used to accelerate the regeneration of the Legion's strongest warriors in the nether.>

<What it is doing in Azeroth is uncertain. Perhaps the Kirin Tor in Dalaran could help you learn more?>

passages.title: The Call of Battle
passages.text:
These demons have no honor! Rather than meet us in glorious, open-battle; they hide behind their barricades and siege weapons.

The Valarjar have come for the glory of battle and we will not be turned away by cowardly tactics!

Destroy their cannons and bring down their barriers, so that our valiant Valarjar may face them in the true spirit of battle! When the dust of battle clears, the corpses of demons shall litter the ground... and the Valarjar will stand triumphant!

passages.title: The Locket of Eldre'Thalas
passages.text:
<Carefully prying open the locket, you find a portrait of Queen Azshara made entirely of precious stones.>

<Highborne possessions like this are rare - to find one so pristine in the hands of the Legion is deeply troubling.>

<You know the Kirin Tor in Dalaran may be able to tell you more.>

passages.title: The Glowing Bloodthistle Petal
passages.text:
<It is exceedingly rare to find bloodthistle outside of Blood Elf lands, especially a petal as fresh as this one.>

<Perhaps the Legion merely claimed it off of a fallen combatant, but that seems far too convenient an explanation.>

<You figure the Kirin Tor in Dalaran would likely be interested in this.>

passages.title: The Vial of Ancient Mana
passages.text:
<Upon closer inspection, this vial appears to be filled with moonwell water, well-known for its potent arcane properties.>

<Interestingly, it does not seem to have been tainted by its previous owner. Though that should be comforting, it only broods suspicion as to its origin.>

<Someone among the Kirin Tor in Dalaran would definitely be interested in this.>

passages.title: A Taste of Their Own Medicine
passages.text:
I been at dis camp for some time now, an' I know for a fact dat dose materials can be found right here in Un'Goro.

Time ta give da creatures here some payback. Take from dem just like dey took from me! At least, you could do dat for me, right bruddah?

I'll just wait here for ya to return wit' all da stuff.

passages.title: A Taste of Their Own Medicine
passages.text: Thieving worms gonna get what dey deserve!

passages.title: A Taste of Their Own Medicine
passages.text:
Oh mon, I wish I could'a seen da look on their faces when you pummled dem!

Now dat we have all da materials, we just need to put it together.

passages.title: Resisting Arrest
passages.text:
Your findings do not disappoint, <name>.

Make your way to the soul engine and use our newly acquired weapons to dismantle the power source.

passages.title: Resisting Arrest
passages.text: There is much to be done.

passages.title: Resisting Arrest
passages.text: Oculeth will be quite pleased with your findings. As you know, he's been working diligently on a new device for the withered.

passages.title: Felborne No More
passages.text:
The Felborne have begun to expand their grasp beyond the city's reach. A camp to the east in the Crimson Thicket is of a particular interest to us. Their outpost leader, Valthis Ama'ran, serves Andaris directly.

Now is the time to put our withered training and Oculeth's device to the test. We cannot allow them to advance any further, <name>.

Head for the camp and use the orb to sever the head of the beast. The time has come to begin our advance.

passages.title: Felborne No More
passages.text: Has the threat been removed?

passages.title: Felborne No More
passages.text: Our efforts have proven quite successful. I believe we are just about ready to make our stand.

passages.title: Survey the City
passages.text:
Never a dull moment! Well... perhaps this is not entirely true.

I'm afraid I must ask you once more to return to the city to gather information. But this is not just any information - this is information extraction!

I require specific coordinates to allow me to focus my teleportations with extreme accuracy. It will, unfortunately, take a bit of time to dig through the information once retrieved, but no matter. We have plenty else to do in the meantime.

passages.title: Survey the City
passages.text: Let's hope this is survey is our last. I grow quite tired watching you run around all day.

passages.title: Survey the City
passages.text:
I will begin analyzing this data at once.

For now, let us turn our attention to more... <Oculeth touches his fingertips together in succession.>

...interesting technological advances.

passages.title: Experimental Instability
passages.text:
In order to advance our studies I must ask you to recover a few particular items from my long-forgotten chambers.

I assure you it is... mostly safe there, aside from a few unstable elements.

Make your way to my workshop and locate the teleporter. I'll disable its cloaking device when you arrive.

passages.title: Experimental Instability
passages.text: Scavenging going well? Not too dangerous I hope.

passages.title: Experimental Instability
passages.text: Wonderful! Now the fun begins. You should speak with Thalyssra, I believe she is ready for more... testing.

passages.title: Trial of Valor: The Lost Army
passages.text:
While Helya's defeat is your primary objective, I require more of your aid. Helya has gained the ability to steal and corrupt the souls of my Valarjar. Her minions hold these souls, corrupting them. I am certain Helya herself hordes the greatest Valarjar souls to herself. You must recover these lost souls, then return them to me.

Do this and I will reward you with blessed guard from the hall's armory.

passages.title: Trial of Valor: The Lost Army
passages.text: Bring me the souls of my lost Valarjar. Only then will I reward you with the blessed armor you desire.

passages.title: Trial of Valor: The Lost Army
passages.text: With these souls returned to the Halls of Valor my forces return to their former strength. As promised, the bounty is yours.

passages.title: We Ride!
passages.text: The time has come, Deathlord! Our scouts have marked a large amassing of demons not far from here. Lead us to victory, and show these demons the power of undeath!

passages.title: We Ride!
passages.text:
Now we have proven the might of the Ebon Blade to the Legion. The ability to take down so many demons without fear of death... that is the power that we hold. We shall see many more demons fall to our blades, and we shall strike them down for Azeroth.

Suffer well.

passages.title: Dabbling in the Demonic
passages.text:
Levia must have used these runes to aid her ritual. Even if she is as powerful as Modera says, she was a novice in demonic magic, so the runes must have helped stabilize the portal.

I'll need you to find out what runes need to be activated to recreate her ritual. There are several books on runic magic in this room, which she no doubt studied for her ritual.

Once you have activated the runes, I will complete the spell.

passages.title: Dabbling in the Demonic
passages.text: Quit fooling around and help me with this ritual!

passages.title: Dabbling in the Demonic
passages.text:
I'm pleasantly surprised, <class>. Without your quick thinking, your mage friend would be lost to Agatha.

The portal is stabilized, and should lead to the mage's location.

passages.title: Moonfang Family Relics
passages.text:
As promised, here is the crescent key that will open my family's lockboxes, though nothing of value remains.

I trust whatever you find you'll deliver to Delas? Our ancestor's things, whatever their worth, should remain in our family.

passages.title: Moonfang Family Relics
passages.text:
I know the name Nerus. He's a distant relative of mine, but why would he hold on to fel trinkets?

The answer to that question might be found within this scroll, but it appears to be blank.

passages.title: Oath Breaker
passages.text:
Many years ago I made a pact with a man I thought not to be unlike myself. His promise of protection seemed too good to be true, but it was a deal I was desperate to make.

It wasn't until I had signed in blood that the dreadlord Zorak revealed himself.

As long as he lives, my ancestors will remain bound to the Burning Legion, allowing our enemies to amass an army of unwilling soldiers.

Head to the Broken Shore and slay Oathbinder Zorak. His death will break the hold he has over my ancestors.

passages.title: Oath Breaker
passages.text: With Zorak dead, my ancestor's spirits can finally be free of their curse.

passages.title: Soul Prism of the Illidari
passages.text:
Alas, I will not burden you with the location of the master's soul just yet, <name>. First we must craft a soul prism powerful enough to hold the master's boundless chaotic energies.

To do this I require lingering soul fragments from powerful beings found across this world. Bring me enough and I will craft a soul prism capable of holding the soul of the master - at least long enough to transfer into the naaru.

passages.title: Soul Prism of the Illidari
passages.text:
The Soul Prism of the Illidari is ready for use.

Illidan's soul was plucked from the Nether - stolen - and taken to the underworld. A place known as Helheim.

passages.title: Trial of Valor: The Once and Future Lord of Shadows
passages.text:
While tracking the master's physical body proved challenging, we were able to locate it in the Nighthold of Suramar. Our intelligence reports that Gul'dan is making final preparations to the Nightwell in order to use its power to usher the soul of Sargeras into Illidan's body.

The only way to stop that from happening is to put Illidan's own immortal soul back.

Take the Soul Prism of the Illidari and venture to Helheim. Defeat Helya and use the prism on Illidan's soul! Return it to Light's Heart.

passages.title: Trial of Valor: The Once and Future Lord of Shadows
passages.text: <Light's Heart illuminates brightly and seemingly consumes the Soul Prism.>

passages.title: Message from the Shadows
passages.text:
I know my brother has been misguided in the past, but I fear that he may have fallen in with an unthinkable evil. He recently began meeting in secret with a dark cult, hidden amongst the people of Dalaran.

I travelled here to try to convince him of the error in his ways, but he would not be shaken from his course. Now, he has disappeared. 

When I last saw him, Raest was staying in a room upstairs. I was unable to find any clues there, but you might fare better.

passages.title: Message from the Shadows
passages.text: Have you found something?

passages.title: Message from the Shadows
passages.text:
A letter? From one of the cultists? 

That could be the lead we need!

passages.title: Secrets in the Underbelly
passages.text:
So my brother has gone off to perform some ritual with these cultists? That explains why he left, but still not to where...

Wait! This letter mentions some of these "Nethersworn" cultists seeking reagents in the Underbelly. Perhaps we still may be able to find them if we hurry!

passages.title: Secrets in the Underbelly
passages.text: Any leads, <name>?

passages.title: Secrets in the Underbelly
passages.text: Well, this definitely says... something.

passages.title: The Wisdom of the Council
passages.text:
I'm sorry, <name>, but I can't make heads nor tails of this. Riddles have never exactly been my strength.

We should take this cultist's writings to the archmage. Perhaps he could shed some light on this.

passages.title: The Wisdom of the Council
passages.text:
What's this, a cultist's manifesto?  

So Raest has really gone down a dark path, hasn't he?

passages.title: Runes of Rending
passages.text:
My brother and his cultists are engaged in some kind of ritual at the far end of the cave. I tried to intervene, but my brother has left magical wards to block the way.

If you can find a way past them, we may be able to stop him in time!

passages.title: Runes of Rending
passages.text: We must not hesitate!

passages.title: Runes of Rending
passages.text:
We're too late, the rift has closed!

We'll have to find another way to get to him.

passages.title: Making Preparations
passages.text:
Deathlord, we have uncovered an heirloom of great significance and power. Rimefang's harness has appeared in Icecrown Citadel. We must obtain it, rather than let it fall into the hands of others.

I assume you'd like to retrieve the harness personally? We've sent one of our own, Minerva Ravensorrow, ahead to scout. You've met her before, yes? She has impressed us greatly, and we believe she can become quite powerful under your tutelage.

I will open a death gate for you. It is best you meet her there.

passages.title: Making Preparations
passages.text: Deathlord! The vrykul have the harness!

passages.title: Return to Karazhan: Rebooting the Cleaner
passages.text:
The Guardian Medivh created the Curator to watch over Karazhan, but I fear the unit is behaving erratically. Prolonged periods of operation may have caused a malfunction.

Please go up to the Menagerie and disable the Curator. Also, search the area for a box of spare motivator crystals and return to me.

Even with my basic knowledge I should be able to replace its motivator, and we can enlist the Curator's help in cleaning up the tower.

passages.title: Return to Karazhan: Rebooting the Cleaner
passages.text: Did you find the box of spares?

passages.title: Return to Karazhan: Rebooting the Cleaner
passages.text:
The box is empty? Drat!

I may be a mage, but I'll never be able to copy Medivh's motivator crystal enchantment!

passages.title: Return to Karazhan: New Shoes
passages.text:
Thus far my Karazhan cleanup project hasn't exactly been a rousing success. Time to try something new.

New, as in new shoes... horseshoes, that is! A box of horseshoes was left outside the tower. It's a problem finding a delivery person willing to set foot inside... mortality rates being what they are.

If you would, grab the crate and take it to Koren in the stables. Just be careful passing Attumen. The huntsman doesn't take kindly to outsiders.

passages.title: Return to Karazhan: New Shoes
passages.text: How did it go?

passages.title: Return to Karazhan: New Shoes
passages.text:
Oh dear. My fault entirely!

I should have ensured the horseshoes were in good shape before having you deliver them.

The humidity out here is a real killer!

passages.title: Return to Karazhan: High Stress Hiatus
passages.text:
The new plays in the opera house have been well received by everyone... except cast members of the older shows. Egos are bruised and tensions are running high!

Romulo and Julianne are ready to poison each other.

Tinhead is rusting with tears over his lack of adoration.

Little Red's cape was stolen by a disgruntled understudy, who ran off to play chess of all things.

Actors, am I right? We need them ready to perform in case the audience demands a revival. Please, help me calm their nerves!

passages.title: Return to Karazhan: High Stress Hiatus
passages.text: How did it go?

passages.title: Return to Karazhan: High Stress Hiatus
passages.text:
I can't believe you found what we needed!

Uh, not that I doubt you, it's just... well, this is the first time one of my projects has actually worked out.

Anyway, I think delivering these items to the actors will ease tensions for a while.

This is a momentous day!

passages.title: Operation: Portals
passages.text: This is a serious invasion, but nothing a Slayer like you can't handle. Time to put those weapons to work!

passages.title: Operation: Portals
passages.text: That was surprisingly easy...

passages.title: Defense of the Fel Hammer
passages.text: We need to get back to the Fel Hammer ASAP!

passages.title: Defense of the Fel Hammer
passages.text:
That was quite a hit you took...

Frankly, I'm amazed that the Fel Hammer didn't self destruct when we fired her weapons. We are lucky to be alive.

passages.title: Administering Aid
passages.text:
Unfortunately, it would seem many of your allies have already taken to fighting on these fel corrupted shores. 

They will never be able to gain the upper hand in battle while so many are suffering from the contagion. 

Take the counteragent and use it to administer aid to your allies. 

Roland and I will handle the injuries here.

passages.title: Administering Aid
passages.text: Your allies have you to thank for their lives.

passages.title: Sampling the Source
passages.text:
My companion has fallen terribly ill, as you can see. 

He must have caught whatever these taurens had. Their entire camp has been wiped out!

It appears to be fel in origin, and impervious to all known treatments. 

I've been working tirelessly to find a cure, but I don't think Roland here has much time left. 

I could use an extra hand. Some samples from the source should speed things up. 

Just be sure to avoid direct contact with the contagion. Levitate should be helpful.

passages.title: Sampling the Source
passages.text: Do you have the samples I've requested?

passages.title: Sampling the Source
passages.text: I hope you handled these samples with care, <name>. I wouldn't forgive myself if I was responsible for getting the High <class> sick.

passages.title: Mischievous Sprites
passages.text:
It's a little-known secret that the dust sprites use for their various tricks has restorative properties.

Some within the alchemy community balk at this claim, but they only refute it because they've never been able to get their hands on the rare ingredient.

Sprites often shroud themselves in illusions to avoid detection.

The nearby goats have a curious shimmer about them that suggests they may be sprites in disguise.

Dispel whatever magic surrounds them to reveal their true form.

passages.title: Mischievous Sprites
passages.text: Have you acquired the Shimmering Dust I so desperately need?

passages.title: Mischievous Sprites
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. I thought those goats seemed a little strange.

passages.title: Shambling Specimens
passages.text:
This fel contagion appears to have three stages.

The first is marked by a persistent, phlegmy cough.

The second shows the skin turning a sickly shade of green.

The third involves a complete transformation where the victim turns into a mindless corpse. It is within this stage that I believe the most information about the sickness can be gathered.

I have a contraption that can safely store the specimens, but they will need to be shackled before they can be collected.

passages.title: Shambling Specimens
passages.text: While there is no hope of curing those who have reached stage III, at least they will be able to provide crucial information about how the contagion works.

passages.title: Crafting a Cure
passages.text:
I used what you gathered for me to craft what I hope will be a reliable cure. The only thing that's missing is some powerful magic, which I hope you'll be able to provide.

The concoction is there on my alchemy table.

Please hurry, <name>. Roland grows weaker by the minute.

passages.title: Crafting a Cure
passages.text: I will do whatever it takes to find a cure for this contagion.

passages.title: Crafting a Cure
passages.text: Brilliant work, <name>. For a moment I thought I'd need to find a new companion.

passages.title: Safekeeping
passages.text:
It would seem that a delicate balance of holy and shadow magic is the key to curing this contagion. Obviously the remedy will need a bit of work to reduce undesired side effects, like dying.

In the meantime, take the counteragent back to Netherlight Temple and keep it safe. I will work diligently on discovering the source of this contagion.

passages.title: Safekeeping
passages.text: What do we have here?

passages.title: Safekeeping
passages.text: This cure could not have come at a better time.

passages.title: Countering the Contagion
passages.text:
I have tracked the source of the contagion to these very shores. The Burning Legion are using fel spreaders to pump out infectious fel creep, causing anyone who comes into contact with it to become sick.

Take out Ozzuk the Corrupter and his fel spreaders so that the contagion can be contained.

passages.title: Countering the Contagion
passages.text:
I believe our combined efforts have effectively eradicated the fel contagion from Azeroth.

Well done, <name>.

passages.title: Touch of a Titan
passages.text:
Oh my! You've managed to acquire an item of legend to carry on your adventures. I've long theorized that such items draw their power directly from the titans, and this may prove to be a chance to test such speculation!

It is said that the Nightwell draws power from the Eye of Aman'Thul, and after centuries in close proximity I believe that titan's power now dwells within the inhabitants of the Nighthold. Bring me remnants of this energy, and I will empower your equipment.

passages.title: Touch of a Titan
passages.text: Aman'Thul has likely been slain for countless aeons, yet his power lingers. How is this possible?

passages.title: Touch of a Titan
passages.text: Marvelous! It is such a joy to work with such magnificent craftsmanship. Please, come see me again should you find another such masterpiece.

passages.title: Dispersion of the Discs
passages.text:
These discs are radiating with power! It must be their proximity to one another. We must take them from here should they resonate further and cause a catastrophe in these sacred halls.

I'll send them to the one place I know where we can reign their energies in, preventing any sort of explosion. I'm speaking of the Eye of Eternity.

There we will be able to safely finish what Antonidas was unable to complete. Speak with me again when you're ready to leave.

passages.title: Dispersion of the Discs
passages.text:
To say you've earned your archmage status would be an understatement. Your success today proves that you were born one.

Now mount your new vessel and ride against the Legion with all the might of your knowledge.

passages.title: Treasure Master Iks'reeged
passages.text: <TEMP> Board the ship then kill fel bats.

passages.title: The Nighthold: Talisman of the Shal'dorei
passages.text: When the Nighthold was built, my people forged a talisman that allowed access to these halls. With the talisman's power, one could traverse the palace unhindered, taking the fight directly to the magistrix. Using fragments of the Nightwell's power, we could locate the talisman and end this foolish war...

passages.title: The Nighthold: Talisman of the Shal'dorei
passages.text: Without the talisman we must fight through the city proper.

passages.title: The Nighthold: Talisman of the Shal'dorei
passages.text: The power these fragments hold will allow me to call the talisman to us. Well done!

passages.title: The Nighthold: Talisman of the Shal'dorei
passages.text: When the Nighthold was built, my people forged a talisman that allowed access to these halls. With the talisman's power, one could traverse the palace unhindered, taking the fight directly to the magistrix. Using fragments of the Nightwell's power, we could locate the talisman and end this foolish war...

passages.title: The Nighthold: Talisman of the Shal'dorei
passages.text: Without the talisman we must fight through the city proper.

passages.title: The Nighthold: Talisman of the Shal'dorei
passages.text: The power these fragments hold will allow me to call the talisman to us. Well done!

passages.title: The Nighthold: Talisman of the Shal'dorei
passages.text: When the Nighthold was built, my people forged a talisman that allowed access to these halls. With the talisman's power, one could traverse the palace unhindered, taking the fight directly to the magistrix. Using fragments of the Nightwell's power, we could locate the talisman and end this foolish war...

passages.title: The Nighthold: Talisman of the Shal'dorei
passages.text: Without the talisman we must fight through the city proper.

passages.title: The Nighthold: Talisman of the Shal'dorei
passages.text: The power these fragments hold will allow me to call the talisman to us. Well done!

passages.title: The Storm's Fury
passages.text:
No longer do we have time to prepare, the moment of action is upon us!

Come with me, little one. With you guiding my aim we shall cleanse this isle by thunder and lightning!

passages.title: The Storm's Fury
passages.text: Today will not be your end, hero. The Legion threatens the Gates of Valor and without the power you wield they will surely fall.

passages.title: Gathering Information
passages.text:
The Legion has sent one demon after another to try to break into the Kirin Tor vaults in the city, but we don't know what they're after.

Looks like they finally made it in.

We need to find out what was taken, and quickly, before they get a chance to put whatever it is to use.

Probe any survivors for information - I'll use my spectral sight to make sure there aren't still any straggling demons lurking about.

passages.title: Gathering Information
passages.text: We can't risk another attack until we get to the bottom of this.

passages.title: Gathering Information
passages.text:
No... no, no, no, no!

Not good. Not good at all.

passages.title: Between Worlds
passages.text:
Kruul boasts damnation, but his power has not yet fully manifested. His minions have taken his heart to hasten his rebirth in the nether.

We do not have much time.

Go to the place of Kruul's fall at the Stair of Destiny in desolate Outland, where the link to his soul is strongest. There you must pry open the way to his realm.

I must prepare for the battle to come. Good luck, champion.

passages.title: Between Worlds
passages.text: Lord Illidan led us into glorious battle against Kruul long ago. Now you must do the same.

passages.title: Between Worlds
passages.text: We must strike before Kruul reaches his full strength, but we're going to need help.

passages.title: The Highlord's Return
passages.text:
I have a missive for you from Kor'vas, as well as instructions for getting you there.

I can teleport you to them to begin the fight, but you will need some Nethershards to force your way into the Twisting Nether.

When you have enough, speak with me and you can begin.

passages.title: The Highlord's Return
passages.text:
Kruul will never again threaten our world, or any other.

Prophet Velen sends his thanks, Archdruid.

passages.title: The Nighthold: Lord of the Shadow Council
passages.text:
As we speak, Gul'dan is using the Nightwell's power to pull Sargeras into our world.

Gather your companions and fight your way to the top of The Nighthold.

I will prepare Light's Heart and join you when the time is right.

Together, we will put an end to Gul'dan once and for all.

passages.title: The Nighthold: Lord of the Shadow Council
passages.text: A fitting end.

passages.title: The Nighthold: The Eye of Aman'Thul
passages.text:
The battle is won, but the war is far from over.

In order to stem the tide of demons flooding into Azeroth, we must use the Pillars of Creation to seal the Tomb of Sargeras.

<Khadgar peers down at the Eye of Aman'Thul.>

That... might be difficult to carry.

Perhaps I can use the power of the Eye itself to teleport it to Dalaran. I suppose there is only one way to find out!

passages.title: The Nighthold: The Eye of Aman'Thul
passages.text: With the Eye of Aman'Thul in our possession, we are one step closer to sealing the portal.

passages.title: Wailing Critters
passages.text:
I'm glad you're here, <name>.

Tiny wails have been heard in the caverns for some time since Naralex was awakened. At first, we suspected that some deviate critters had survived. Upon further investigation, we found them to be growing and multiplying beyond our wildest expectations. The corpse of Verdan the Everliving may have something to do with it, we're not sure. That's why we're sending you in.

I've also seen suspicious footprints leading into the caverns recently. We may not be alone, be careful.

passages.title: Wailing Critters
passages.text: Have you completed your investigation the Wailing Caverns?

passages.title: Wailing Critters
passages.text: Yes, I saw the shadowy character as well, he ran right past me. Probably a tauren, but we can't be sure. Keep a look out for him, something tells me we're just beginning to unravel this mystery.

passages.title: Grovebound
passages.text:
Now THAT was some good stuff right there. Now that we've taken out the commander, the druids and the ancients should be safe for a while. Revenge was an added bonus.

We should get back to Rensar and tell him what we accomplished.

passages.title: Grovebound
passages.text:
We have asked a lot of you over the last few months, <name>. You not only rose to our expectations, but surpassed them. By killing Katith'rax, you have stopped the attacks against our ancients.

You deserve the position of Archdruid of the Dreamgrove. I am honored to be your colleague, and expect us to do much for the world. Together.

passages.title: A Brewing Situation
passages.text:
Greetings, Grandmaster. I'm an expert at producing tricky brews, and Almai and I have been working with Stormstout Brewery to craft Storm Brew for the order. 

In fact, we have already begun production!

That calls for a party, don't you think? We brought enough of my prized Celebration Brew for everyone!

passages.title: A Brewing Situation
passages.text: Whew. Celebration brew is..*hic* shtronger than I remembered it to be. *urp*

passages.title: A Brewing Situation
passages.text: Whew. Celebration brew is..*hic* shtronger than I remembered it to be. *urp*

passages.title: The God-Queen's Fury
passages.text:
<class>t, the Kirin Tor have found a way to get you into the Halls of Valor to pursue the God-King's heir. Archmage Khadgar has asked me to stress upon you the importance of stopping Sigryn, as the prophecies hint that she may still be the key to uniting the Tideskorn against the Legion.

It will require an incredible amount of energy to teleport you directly to the Halls, so be sure that you are prepared. It may be some time before we can send you again.

Speak to me when you are ready to proceed.

passages.title: The God-Queen's Fury
passages.text:
I... thank you for coming for me. I hope you can forgive me for what I've done.

I will return to Eyir. I only hope she can grant me her forgiveness as well...

passages.title: The Befouled Barrows
passages.text:
You were taking too long, so I took the liberty to scout out the barrows in advance. The Legion has set up portals, pulling more and more demons through them by the second. We need to shut them down so we can save Goldrinn!

I'm not sure my usual methods are going to do much to take them down, but I think you can do it! I think some nice vine-work is in order.

passages.title: The Befouled Barrows
passages.text: If we call up some vines to close the portals, then the Legion can't come through.

passages.title: The Befouled Barrows
passages.text: Now the demons can't call reinforcements. That was great!

passages.title: Soothing Wounds
passages.text:
<D'Bynn's injuries prevent him from moving.>

Perhaps you can forage something nearby that will soothe the manasaber's wounds?

passages.title: Soothing Wounds
passages.text: <D'Bynn gently nuzzles your hand.>

passages.title: The Shrouded Coin
passages.text: A swirling mist envelops the coin and it begins to float above your hand. The mist briefly parts to reveal a shiny new coin, yet in the next instant the coin appears worn from years of exchange. As the coin settles back in to your hand, visions of jungles and mist shrouded peaks waft into your mind, and through the vision you recognize the four Celestials gathered in the courtyard of an island.

passages.title: The Shrouded Coin
passages.text:
Coins are interesting items. They travel far and wide across the lands, yet this one seems to also travel through time.

The fact that you found this coin where you did is both an omen and a blessing.

passages.title: A Bit of Espionage
passages.text:
With the gunpowder in tow, it's time to move on to our next plan. Meet us on the Broken Shore. 

You can get a flight directly to our next location from Krasus' Landing. We will meet you there, <class>t.

passages.title: A Bit of Espionage
passages.text: Good, you're here. Let's get to work.

passages.title: Holding Our Ground
passages.text:
Though we anticipated a strong Legion presence, our attacks on their camps have angered their forces even further than anticipated. Our forces rally on both land and in the skies above Thunder Totem in an attempt to regain our footing.

Do what you can to reduce their forces. Once we've secured Thunder Totem we'll begin our plan for a final attack.

passages.title: Holding Our Ground
passages.text:
We must remember our allies who have fallen on this day and in their honor, continue our fight.

The time is upon us, <name>. Our riders are ready. Let us show the Burning Legion the true strength of Highmountain.

passages.title: Fel Ingredients
passages.text:
Our scouts have located a Felskorn encampment within the Garrison of the Fel. We will need as many samples of fel poison as we can find if we are to concoct a cure for our stricken monks.

Take samples of anything that looks remotely useful!

passages.title: Fel Ingredients
passages.text: Did you find any samples we can use?

passages.title: Fel Ingredients
passages.text: Let's hope that's enough to brew a cure for our dying monks!

passages.title: Shield Amplification
passages.text:
It will not hurt to reinforce the Nightborne Soulstone's shield just a bit more, and to do that we must infuse it with energy. 

Ryanna has assured me that fel essence will work beautifully for our needs. Yes - this method IS rather distasteful. However as the sin'dorei well know, desperate times call for desperate measures.

It is as simple as this: we have an urgent need for magical energy, and our enemies possess it in abundance. 

Do what must be done.

passages.title: Shield Amplification
passages.text: Good. The Soulstone's shields should be sufficiently strengthened now.

passages.title: Feltotem's Fall
passages.text:
Our Highmountain contact, Navarrogg, reports that Tugar Bloodtotem has finally resurfaced.

He's sent a message crystal along with some instructions for me.

I can teleport you to Navarrogg and he will take you to Tugar's location, but there is one problem.

Navarrogg requires additional magical power to fend off Tugar's fel magicks. You will need some Nethershards before you go.

passages.title: Feltotem's Fall
passages.text: Thunder Totem and countless lives are saved. One more crisis down in this war against the Legion.

passages.title: Avocation of Antonidas
passages.text:
Archmage, I've found something you may be interested in. An old journal of the late Archmage, Antonidas. In it, he speaks of a project he was working on that I think we may be able to finish.

It was a sort of flying disc that could attune itself to the rider's magical attunement.

But I need your help tracking down the pieces. From what I could gather, he gave them to trusted friends and allies through the years. Perhaps you could persuade them to give us the pieces.

passages.title: Kvaldir on Call
passages.text:
You empowered Helya's Horn in Helheim, and now is the time to use it. I have located three Legion portals we should eliminate. 

Seek out the vrykul shipwreck on Felrage Strand. Call the kvaldir and have them do what they do best: destroy!

passages.title: Kvaldir on Call
passages.text: Did the kvaldir answer your call, <name>?

passages.title: Kvaldir on Call
passages.text: Well done, <name>. The kvaldir will be useful tools in the battles to come.

passages.title: Uniting the Isles
passages.text: There are a great number of factions here on the Broken Isles. We must unite them if we want to stand a chance against the Legion. Prove your worth to them and report back to me.

passages.title: Uniting the Isles
passages.text: Excellent work, <name>. We still have a long road ahead of us to rid this world of the Legion, but this brings us one step closer.

passages.title: Coreforged Sigil of Skaldrenox
passages.text: The sigils of the Abyssal High Council are crafted from the distilled essence of the element of their holder. This sigil was forged in flame.

passages.title: Coreforged Sigil of Skaldrenox
passages.text: What news from the battlefield, <race>?

passages.title: Coreforged Sigil of Skaldrenox
passages.text: This is an impressive find indeed. The Abyssal High Council do not part with their sigils easily.

passages.title: Glimmering Sigil of Whirlaxis
passages.text: The sigils of the Abyssal High Council are crafted from the distilled essence of the element of their holder. This sigil was carved with biting winds.

passages.title: Glimmering Sigil of Whirlaxis
passages.text: You've returned from battle, <race>. Any trophies to share?

passages.title: Glimmering Sigil of Whirlaxis
passages.text: To wrest a sigil from one of the Abyssal High Council is a feat worthy of praise. For the Horde!

passages.title: Diamondine Sigil of Kazum
passages.text: The sigils of the Abyssal High Council are crafted from the distilled essence of the element of their holder. This sigil was carved from stone, then fused into a faultless diamond.

passages.title: Diamondine Sigil of Kazum
passages.text: A diamond ring? Why... why are you bringing this to me?

passages.title: Diamondine Sigil of Kazum
passages.text:
Ah, a sigil. From the Abyssal High Council, no less!

<Warlord Gorchuk wipes a bead of sweat from his brow.>

I... I had assumed that it was... that you were... oh, never mind.

For the Horde!

passages.text:
Ah, a sigil. From the Abyssal High Council, no less!

<Field Marshal Snowfall wipes a bead of sweat from his brow.>

I... I had assumed that it was... that you were... oh, never mind.

For the Alliance!

passages.title: Tidal Sigil of Skwol
passages.text: The sigils of the Abyssal High Council are crafted from the distilled essence of the element of their holder. This sigil was crafted from coral and smoothed by the tides.

passages.title: Tidal Sigil of Skwol
passages.text: What have we here?

passages.title: Tidal Sigil of Skwol
passages.text:
A sigil from the Abyssal High Council? You've outdone yourself today, <race>.

For the Alliance!

passages.title: Demonic Disruption
passages.text:
While scouting on the Broken Shore, we have stumbled upon something quite unsettling.

The Legion is attempting to harness the powers of Azeroth's elements. What is more, they are succeeding.

We must stop them at all costs. I can open a portal for you to meet Therazane at the Garrison of the Fel. She will update you on the situation.

passages.title: Demonic Disruption
passages.text: The Legion is forcing Azeroth to bend to its will. We cannot allow this any longer!

passages.title: Elemental Cores
passages.text:
The eredar here are abusing the power of all of Azeroth's elements, forcing them to their command using their fel magics. They succeed to do this through curiosities the Legion has developed, cores of power that correspond to each element.

Do not allow the Legion to continue abusing our world. Kill them and take the sources of their power.

passages.title: Elemental Cores
passages.text: Nobody should force the elements to bend to their will. Show the Legion that their understanding is flawed.

passages.title: Elemental Cores
passages.text: It seems the Doomstone is pulsating with energy.

passages.title: Stirring in the Shadows
passages.text:
We must now purify the barding by both material and immaterial means. For the material, we need to travel to Stratholme.

When it thrived, before the plague, it produced holy water capable of cleansing even the darkest of magics. There still may be caches of it lying untouched there that we can use.

Then it's just a matter of imbuing enough holy power into the barding to make sure it overcomes the will of Rivendare's mount, Shadowmane.

Travel to the service gate of Stratholme when you're ready.

passages.title: Stirring in the Shadows
passages.text: Your mount is within our reach, Highlord. I only pray Stratholme still has an ample supply of holy water.

passages.title: Stirring in the Shadows
passages.text:
That was quite the encounter, wouldn't you say Highlord <name>? Reminds me of my glory days.

Nevertheless we'll be keeping a more watchful eye on Stratholme from now on. But that's not important right now.

We should move on to the ceremony and have you claim your prize!

passages.title: The Sunken Vault
passages.text:
'Ello, High Priest. The Speaker has just been telling us of a calling of sorts, coming from deep in the core of Azeroth.

The voice is telling 'im there's a lost Titan vault out there, near the Maelstrom. We dun know what's inside, but he's got tha feelin' it's got somethin' ta do with the Light, and you!

Brann's got a vessel waitin' for ye, off the coast of Azsuna. Of course, I'll be accompanying ye as well, for cataloguing purposes. Can't go and let a chance like this go to waste!

passages.title: The Sunken Vault
passages.text: Ta be one o' tha first to step foot in a lost Titan vault, it gives me tha chills!

passages.title: The Sunken Vault
passages.text: Tis our greatest honor ta present ye with this steed, High <class>. An' thank ye for leading us, ye are truly blessed by the Light, an' so are all of us for havin' ye.

passages.title: Presence of Power
passages.text:
The demons appear to be harnessing an ancient power within the Temple itself. They've managed to twist and corrupt these sacred grounds with fel magic.

We must remove the demonic presence before we press our final advance.

passages.title: Presence of Power
passages.text: Can you feel the immense energy?

passages.title: Presence of Power
passages.text: Our fight doesn't end here, <name>.

passages.title: Avocation of Antonidas
passages.text:
Archmage, I've found something you may be interested in. An old journal of the late Archmage, Antonidas. In it, he speaks of a project he was working on that I think we may be able to finish.

It was a sort of flying disc that could attune itself to the rider's magical attunement.

But I need your help tracking down the pieces. From what I could gather, he gave them to trusted friends and allies through the years. Perhaps you could persuade them to give us the pieces.

passages.title: Assault on Val'sharah
passages.text: The Legion's moves across our lands. Find their forces and remove the threat before it is too late!

passages.title: Assault on Val'sharah
passages.text: Have we gained ground?

passages.title: Assault on Val'sharah
passages.text: We must continue our fight.

passages.title: Where Art Thou, My Sweet
passages.text: What poor fate! Here we are with the jewelry to buy my beloved's freedom, and she has disappeared! We must inquire of the patrons of this fine establishment. Perhaps they know what befell her.

passages.title: Where Art Thou, My Sweet
passages.text: Well, she has been taken, but we shall never rest. Join me as my Follower, lead my troops, perform missions for me! Together we will find her!

passages.title: Jorach's Calling
passages.text: And with that, the first phase of the plan is complete. It's best we return to Jorach and bring him the news.

passages.title: Jorach's Calling
passages.text: Welcome back, Shadowblade. I assume you've retrieved the gunpowder?

passages.title: Assault on Azsuna
passages.text:
The demons strike at the heart of our existence, posing a threat to all who inhabit our lands.

Remove the threat before it is too late.

passages.title: Assault on Azsuna
passages.text: I'm afraid our fight has only brought us so far. We must press our attack before the Legion advances beyond their stronghold within the Temple of a Thousand Lights!

passages.title: Assault on Stormheim
passages.text:
The eternal foe of our world, the Burning Legion, dare to attack the land of Stormheim!

Champion, now is your call to valor! Find the forces of the Legion and eradicate them!

passages.title: Assault on Stormheim
passages.text:
Just beyond these cliffs, the forces of the Legion are gathering for their assault. For every moment that passes their number grows.

We must strike soon before we are overwhelmed!

passages.title: Assault on Highmountain
passages.text:
In my years I have seen disturbances and threats come and go, but never before have I seen such brazen disregard for life. 

The demons may scorch our lands and cause suffering amongst our kin, but we must not stand idly by while they threaten what we have fought so hard to create.

Rise to the occasion, <name>. The time has come to stand against the Burning Legion!

passages.title: Assault on Highmountain
passages.text: My apologies, <name>. I hope Aviash and I did not offend you. One cannot be too careful during times like these.

passages.title: A Gift From the Six
passages.text:
<name>, without you some of the Legion's strongest agents would still be roaming Azeroth, threatening to undermine all that we've accomplished in this war.

Such a deed merits more than mere recognition.

If you would accept it, we would like to formally reward your heroism in the face of such darkness with a portion of our power.

passages.title: A Gift From the Six
passages.text: Are you ready?

passages.title: A Gift From the Six
passages.text: We hope the increased power to your weapon will prove useful on the Broken Shore and beyond.

passages.title: Burning Within
passages.text:
The first piece he spoke of was that of fire. He imbued it while investigating the entrance to the Molten Core.

However, the power surging through it was too great to control, so he asked Khadgar to take it to Karazhan and see if there were any books on the subject of controlling fire.

Perhaps you should speak with Khadgar and find out what became of the disc.

passages.title: Burning Within
passages.text: Was Khadgar able to remember what he did with the piece?

passages.title: Burning Within
passages.text: You've recovered it! And it is as Antonidas wrote, still surging with great fire magic!

passages.title: Chilled to the Core
passages.text:
The next piece Antonidas made was imbued with frost magic. He wrote about a ritual to channel frost energy into the disc with his fellow Archmage, Cedric, but their combined strengths forced too much energy into the disc.

If I recall, Cedric is helping oversee the reconstruction of Dalaran near the crater where Dalaran once resided.

Hopefully he knows where to find the disc.

passages.title: Chilled to the Core
passages.text: After the devastation that befell Dalaran's original home, who knows where that disc may be.

passages.title: Chilled to the Core
passages.text:
Ogres took it? Those beasts will grab anything they can I suppose.

Regardless, it's excellent you were able to find it.

passages.title: Close to Home
passages.text:
The third piece of the disc was infused with Antonidas' own arcane magic. He did this at the height of his power, but like the other two discs, was unable to finish his work on it.

He wrote that he gave the piece to Archmage Celindra...

Isn't she the portal trainer here in Dalaran? She must know where the piece is!

Quickly, go speak with her.

passages.title: Close to Home
passages.text: Did she have it?

passages.title: Close to Home
passages.text: To think it was right here in Dalaran the whole time.

If you would accept it, we would like to formally reward your heroism in the face of such darkness with a portion of our power.
