passages.title: Ancestors and Enemies
passages.text:
I want nothing more than to prove myself by joining our offensive on the Broken Shore, but I'm beginning to doubt my worthiness.

You see, I found my family's sigil among the demonic runes I've been deciphering. Why the Moonfang crest would be known to the Legion is a mystery to me, but I trust you'll be able to find what connection lies between my ancestors and my enemies.

What's left of their village can be found in Val'sharah.

passages.title: Ancestors and Enemies
passages.text: What business do you have here? Have you come to scavenge what the harpies left behind?

passages.title: Crystal Containment
passages.text:
Kanrethad will be safe in my care, but something must be done about these crystals that hold his fel magic.

If any should break, the energy inside would find its way back to our friend. I shouldn't need to tell you how devastating it would be if that were to happen.

I will gather the crystals and meet you back at Dreadscar Rift.

passages.title: Crystal Containment
passages.text:
The crystals will be safe here, with each of the council members watching over them.

Kanrethad is still recovering, but is well enough to speak.

passages.title: End of the Risen Threat
passages.text:
Commander Shadowsong sends word that he is prepared to face the late Lord Erdris. I have a letter from him for you.

I'm prepared to teleport you to his location, but there's a snag.

In order to combat the worst of the fel corruption, you will need to use some Nethershards on the way in. Make sure you have some before speaking with me.

passages.title: End of the Risen Threat
passages.text: Another crisis averted! Your effectiveness is without compare.

passages.title: An Impossible Foe
passages.text:
<name>! We have just received word from the Council of Six. They have found Agatha!

Modera asked that she be able to brief you through this image crystal. 

Good luck!

passages.title: An Impossible Foe
passages.text:
News has reached me of Agatha's demise, as well as her plot to infiltrate the Kirin Tor. If it weren't for your swift action, I fear the damage her sayaad could've done would be irreparable. 

My mages are working to hunt down any of Agatha's remaining allies, but the real victory today belongs to you, <name>.

The Kirin Tor thanks you.

passages.title: Preparations Underway
passages.text:
As you may or may not recall, I once helped young paladins obtain their first armored mount.

It was a tedious task that involved months of obtaining materials and sending them all over Azeroth.

Thankfully, times have changed and we now have most of those materials at hand. That being said, I wish to help you obtain a new mount, something worthy of your title as Highlord.

In order for us to begin, I only require that you obtain a barding for us. Something strong, thick, and heavy.

passages.title: Preparations Underway
passages.text: How goes the search for the barding? Find anything suitable yet?

passages.title: Preparations Underway
passages.text:
<Grayson examines the barding.>

This is... well, a good start, Highlord. But I think it will have to be strengthened a bit.

passages.title: Leather to Legendary
passages.text:
Let's begin, shall we? I mean, I'll be doing all the work, but you get to watch!

<Alard grins a wide smile at you and begins working.>

passages.title: Leather to Legendary
passages.text: How'd it go? Was Alard able to upgrade the barding?

passages.title: Leather to Legendary
passages.text:
<Grayson examines the barding.>

This is perfect. Exactly what I expected from Alard. Now that we have everything together, there is but one task left.

passages.title: Aid on the Front Lines
passages.text:
When we settled here, that Hold was just a quiet creepy place that we avoided. Then the elves came back from the dead. With your help we thought it was mostly handled. But now it feels like an army is attacking us!

We could use more healing at our defense lines. More undead arrive and we have less and less protectors each wave. Any aid to our wounded would be welcomed!

passages.title: Aid on the Front Lines
passages.text: We can't take anymore losses.

passages.title: Aid on the Front Lines
passages.text: You've saved many lives this day, <class>. Bradensbrook thanks you.

passages.title: Source of the Corruption
passages.text:
There was something wrong with those three, they had a fel taint about them that was... unsettling. I believe they were somehow woken later than the other risen. Curse the Legion and their meddling!

The reinforcements are streaming out of Black Rook Hold from Heroes' Rest. We must make our way there and see if we can stop the source of these new troops.

passages.title: Source of the Corruption
passages.text: We must end this corruption.

passages.title: Source of the Corruption
passages.text: The attacks on Bradensbrook should relent for now. We must still deal with Lord Erdris, and soon.

passages.title: Thwarting the Twins
passages.text:
I have news from Archmage Karlain! The Kirin Tor have found Raest Magespear and can open up a portal to his location!

If you are ready to face him, I can have the mages here open the portal into the Twisting Nether.

passages.title: Thwarting the Twins
passages.text:
So Raest has fallen, and in his hubris has taken his brother with him. I mourn for them both, but his brother most of all.  

Karam Magespear was truly a beacon of the Light. I only hope that the stories of his sacrifices live throughout the ages. 

You have done well, <name>.

passages.title: A Conduit No More
passages.text:
One final task remains to sever the Burning Legion's connection to other worlds.

I'll provide you transportation to get you close to the source of power, but you must deliver the final blow to the conduit.

passages.title: A Conduit No More
passages.text: With the conduit destroyed, now may be our only chance.

passages.title: The Trial of Rage
passages.text:
I wish to extend to you a prestigious invitation.

Every year I hold a trial for my finest warrior to prove that I command the strongest in this land. I have chosen you to be my champion in this trial.

Should you succeed in completing the trial, I have a prize that will be worthy of your accomplishments awaiting you at the end.

Take what time you need to prepare yourself. Come back and speak with me when you're ready to begin.

passages.title: The Trial of Rage
passages.text: I have no doubt that you will be victorious in this trial. I look forward to watching it.

passages.title: The Trial of Rage
passages.text:
That was truly a grand exposition of <class> skill. I was truly impressed at how you handled Asrea. She will be missed.

But now on to a grander event. The prize which you so rightfully deserve.

passages.title: If You Build It
passages.text:
If we wish to achieve a sustained connection to Xoroth, we'll need a particularly resilient portal. Unfortunately, we can't just summon this one up from the ground.

I will need you to gather the requisite materials. Once we have them, I will have the mo'arg begin construction at once. 

Here's the list of what you'll need.

passages.title: If You Build It
passages.text: Have you the necessary materials?

passages.title: If You Build It
passages.text:
Excellent. This Unbending Potion should shore up the Felslate enough to hold the portal's structure, and these Chaotic Spinel crystals should focus the portal's magic nicely.

I will set the mo'arg to work posthaste.

passages.title: Fel to the Core
passages.text:
While it has become relatively easy for a warlock to open a brief window into the realms of the Legion, a sustained portal requires significantly more power.

For this, we will need a power source brimming with fel energy. 

I know that the commanders of the Legion use powerful fel cores to control their warships. If you can defeat the commander of one of these ships, you should be able to take their core.

passages.title: Fel to the Core
passages.text: Do you have the core?

passages.title: Fel to the Core
passages.text:
I sensed the fel energy emanating from the core the moment you entered Dreadscar Rift. 

I think this will suit our needs.

passages.title: Give Me Fuel, Give Me Fire
passages.text:
A powerful core will not alone be able to power the portal. Like any powerful engine, it will require fuel - though an engine of fel energy must burn life force to thrive.

We will need blood potent in magical energy to keep our fel core running and sustain our connection to Xoroth. Fortunately, I have experience in these matters, and I know just the place where we can get some.

You'll need a jar or something.

passages.title: Give Me Fuel, Give Me Fire
passages.text: Have you bled the owlkin dry?

passages.title: Give Me Fuel, Give Me Fire
passages.text:
That's... quite a bit of blood. I am impressed, <name>.

I really should just start stockpiling this stuff. It has so many uses!

passages.title: The Minions of Hel'nurath
passages.text:
The dreadlord Hel'nurath gifts his lieutenants with calling stones to call and bind the dreadsteeds of Xoroth to their service. I believe one such stone will help us draw out the Wrathsteed. 

Some Xorothian cultists have been spotted helping the Legion's efforts on the Broken Shore. It would be safe to assume their leader has one of Hel'nurath's stones.

Your succubus should be able to entice the truth out of the cultists. Find one who knows of their leader's whereabouts.

passages.title: The Dreadlord's Calling
passages.text: According to the cultist, the leader you seek should be in her tower overseeing the operations in the Dark Stockades.

passages.title: The Dreadlord's Calling
passages.text: I trust you found the stone?

passages.title: The Dreadlord's Calling
passages.text:
Long have I waited to get my hands on one of the dreadlord's calling stones.  Were it not for our current task, we could outfit an army with dreadsteeds.

However, this will serve a greater purpose. With the lure of this stone, Arax'ath will not be able to restrain the Wrathsteed. So long as we can keep the portal open long enough, it will come.

passages.title: The Wrathsteed of Xoroth
passages.text:
The time has come and the preparations have been made. When you are ready, we will tear a hole into Xoroth, and force the Arax'ath and the Wrathsteed out of hiding.

Follow me to the summoning platform. From there we will initiate the ritual.

Prepare yourself, <name>. This will not be an easy undertaking.

passages.title: The Wrathsteed of Xoroth
passages.text:
The Wrathsteed is prepared for your binding, Netherlord. It will not be easy to enslave, its will is strong.

I have to say, I'm a bit jealous. Never before have I seen such a ferocious beast, our disciples have it barely held in check.

passages.title: Cathedral of Eternal Night: Altar of the Aegis
passages.text:
Champion, we are ready to assault the Tomb of Sargeras.

I studied the writings of Aegwynn, the Guardian who defeated the Dark Titan's avatar. She said that if her wards were compromised, a failsafe could be triggered by placing the Aegis of Aggramar upon an altar in the Cathedral of Eternal Night.

You are the hero who acquired the Pillars of Creation, <name>. Gather your allies and enter the Cathedral. Be warned: Mephistroth will use all his power to stop you from placing the Aegis. You must prevail!

passages.title: Cathedral of Eternal Night: Altar of the Aegis
passages.text: There is little time. Mephistroth must be defeated, and the Cathedral of the Eternal Night secured.

passages.title: Cathedral of Eternal Night: Altar of the Aegis
passages.text:
Mephistroth is dead and the Cathedral is secured, but the lower reaches of the Tomb remain in the hands of the Legion.

This is not the outcome we wanted, but this fight is far from over, <name>.

Do not relent. Give the Legion no quarter, no place to hide. When we are ready, we will take the Tomb and drive them from Azeroth!

passages.title: Begin Construction
passages.text:
We've got the supplies. Now someone needs to decide what to do with 'em.

Hmm. Looks like it's your call, being the <class>t and all!

Time to pick a building to focus on.

passages.title: Begin Construction
passages.text:
Oi! Which building should we work on?

I've got deadlines to meet, mate!

passages.title: Begin Construction
passages.text:
Good on ya, mate! Not that there's a bad choice to be made, of course, but it's important to keep a positive attitude when surrounded by an infinite number of demons looking to kill ya.

As you gather additional supplies, come on back and I'll see they get assigned to the fortification of your choice.

Phew! That was a mouthful, right? I'd say it's time for a pint.

passages.title: Strike Them Down
passages.text:
The Felstorm continues to rain demon scum upon these shores. Kil'jaeden believes his army infinite, his resources inexhaustible.

We will show him how wrong he is.

Cut a swath of retribution through their ranks, <class>t. Strike down demon after demon, until your weapons are bathed in their blood. And when they cry out for mercy, send them screaming back into the Nether.

passages.title: Strike Them Down
passages.text:
Did they plead for their lives?

Did they whimper as they bled away to nothingness?

passages.title: Strike Them Down
passages.text:
I have spent a lifetime hunting the wicked and making them pay for their crimes. When I strike a demon down, I feel a measure of justice has been served.

You have been an instrument of retribution this day, Huntmaster. Had you walked a different path, you might have made a worthy Warden.

passages.title: Defending Broken Isles
passages.text:
In our zeal to reclaim the Broken Shore from the Legion, we cannot allow the rest of this land to fall into the demons' foul grip.

Kil'jaeden has dispatched his forces across the Broken Isles, threatening the homelands of the allies you have made. You must answer their call in this hour of need.

Turn back these demon assaults with haste, <class>t. The Armies of Legionfall will see that the Broken Shore remains secured.

passages.title: Defending Broken Isles
passages.text:
A fine victory, Archdruid.

But do not grow complacent! Fight back against the Legion wherever they strike.

passages.title: Self-Fulfilling Prophecy
passages.text:
In my life, I have witnessed many visions. Some filled me with hope... others, with despair.

Victory over Kil'jaeden lies within our grasp. I have foreseen it. But visions only show us where our path might lead. They require effort to become reality.

That effort falls upon your shoulders, <name>. You have done much, but more is needed. Fight on the battlefields of the Broken Shore and forge a destiny free from the Legion's grasp!

passages.title: Self-Fulfilling Prophecy
passages.text: How go your efforts on the warfront?

passages.title: Self-Fulfilling Prophecy
passages.text:
Step by step, we march closer to victory. We must not relent!

Only through courage and persistence will we stop the insidious evil that threatens the soul of this world.

passages.title: Championing Our Cause
passages.text:
Important work has been done by your order, <class>t. Your champions have succeeded time and again in undermining the Legion's invasion.

As we make preparations for our assault on the Tomb of Sargeras, we need to keep the demons off balance. By pressuring them at every turn, we will expose vulnerabilities that can be exploited to our advantage.

Send out your order's champions, <name>. Their missions are vital to the success of our campaign... especially as our confrontation with Kil'jaeden draws closer.

passages.title: Championing Our Cause
passages.text:
Excellent work, Huntmaster! When this war is finally won, I believe I owe you and your order champions a banquet to honor your heroism.

Say, that sounds like something that Odyn fellow would say. Not that I've met him myself, of course...

passages.title: Take Out the Head...
passages.text:
The Broken Shore swims with Legion filth, each demon deserving of a swift and merciless end.

But some are more insidious than the rest. Powerful combatants rallying others to their perfidious cause.

Strike down these demon champions and you will fill the hearts of their kin with fear and doubt. Break the Legion's spirit and we will break its back.

passages.title: Take Out the Head...
passages.text: Are they dead yet?

passages.title: Take Out the Head...
passages.text:
We must take every opportunity to shatter the will of Kil'jaeden's army.

When they see their mightiest champions crumble to dust, they will realize that the vaunted Legion is doomed to fall.

passages.title: Shard Times
passages.text:
As you have surely noticed, a slain demon leaves behind Nethershards, solidified residual energy from the Twisting Nether. I require a significant quantity of them for an experiment I'm conducting... $1oa shards, to be precise.

Why are you looking at me like that? We've had this conversation before. I did the math.

I need exactly $1oa shards. Fewer would be inadequate. More would be absurd.

Don't question my methods. Go!

passages.title: Shard Times
passages.text: Do you have the shards? I hope you kept an accurate count. If you counted wrong, I simply can't be held responsible for the consequences.

passages.title: Shard Times
passages.text:
It has been pointed out to me that I can, on occasion, get a bit carried away.

This... <clears throat> might possibly have been one of those times.

A single Nethershard will suffice for my purposes. I'm certain you can put the rest to good use.

Let's not speak of this again.

passages.title: Intolerable Infestation
passages.text:
While we purge Legion filth from the Broken Shore, the fiends maintain their hold on nearby lands. Their presence can no longer be tolerated.

The fetid strongholds of Faronaar and Felsoul Hold infest Azsuna and Suramar. Choose an attack point and cut a swath through their insidious ranks.

Return to me with demon blood on your hands, then we can resume our campaign to drive Kil'jaeden from the Tomb.

passages.title: Intolerable Infestation
passages.text: Have you laid waste to the demon strongholds?

passages.title: Intolerable Infestation
passages.text:
Thinning the ranks of demons in locations like Faronaar and Felsoul Hold cuts the legs out from under the Legion.

Kil'jaeden will fall!

passages.title: Pillars of Creation
passages.text:
Our campaign on the Broken Shore has reached a turning point. The Armies of Legionfall stand ready to breach the Tomb of Sargeras and seal the Legion's gateway to our world.

The time to strike is now, <name>.

The Aegis of Aggramar has been secured in the Cathedral. The echo of Magna Aegwynn said that the other Pillars of Creation are needed to seal the tomb. It is fitting that you have the honor of locking those ancient relics in place and closing down the Felstorm once and for all.

passages.title: Pillars of Creation
passages.text: The Legion's invasion must be ended.

passages.title: Pillars of Creation
passages.text:
The Pillars of Creation are in place. The Tomb of Sargeras is sealed, and Aegwynn's echo is at rest.

<Khadgar gestures toward the sky.>

Unfortunately, we do not have that luxury.

Though you won a great victory this day, there is no time for revelry. The final battle awaits us. Make ready.

passages.title: The Calm After the Storm
passages.text:
You have saved the elements from the Legion's control, and for that we thank you. However, it came at a great cost to both your health and your fellow shaman. Many came back to us wounded, dragged along by their fellow shaman.

We have seen the havoc the Doomstone can wreak. It does not belong in the hands of any being, mortal or otherwise. While you were asleep, the elemental lords and I discussed its fate.

Bring it to Neptulon. He will explain.

passages.title: The Calm After the Storm
passages.text: We must watch over the Doomstone. Its power is too great.

passages.title: The Calm After the Storm
passages.text:
You have witnessed the destruction the Doomstone can wreak firsthand. You are a trusted warden of Azeroth, but even in your hands the power caused chaos and panic amongst your people. Imagine it in the control of someone with ill intent...

We cannot let that happen.

We discussed what to do with this artifact at length while we waited for you to awaken. We considered giving it a new home in one of the elemental planes, but each one provided its own danger.

There is no safer place for it than here.

passages.title: Meld Into the Shadows
passages.text: We should meet back up with the rest of the council and tell them of what we have achieved this day. At your leisure, return to us. We shall be waiting.

passages.title: Meld Into the Shadows
passages.text:
We've been discussing your recent success, <name>. We walk the shadows, and that often goes taken for granted. But without us, the Armies of Legionfall would have a great many more powerful demons to deal with.

We do not need the fame. We reap the rewards.

passages.title: Legionfall Supplies
passages.text:
If we don't build up some respectable fortifications, we'll lose our foothold on the Broken Shore.

That ain't gonna happen on my watch, mate!

We started construction on three key structures: the Mage Tower, the Nether Disruptor, and the Command Center. Each will play a key role in helping us pound the tar out of the Burning Legion.

To make progress, we need Legionfall War Supplies... and I mean lots of 'em! You bring 'em to me, and I'll handle distribution. Got it?

passages.title: Legionfall Supplies
passages.text: Crikey! Did you bring me Legionfall War Supplies?

passages.title: Legionfall Supplies
passages.text:
That's what I'm talkin' about, mate!

Oi! Time to get to work.

passages.title: Defense of Aviana
passages.text:
The situation is dire. The Legion is attacking the Shrine of Aviana in Hyjal, AGAIN! They must be after something specific, but I'm not sure what.

Us Druids of the Talon are skilled scouts and infiltrators, but are lacking in... durability. They won't be able to hold out for long! We must go to help!

passages.title: Defense of Aviana
passages.text: What are you waiting for?! Get to the Shrine of Aviana in Hyjal!

passages.title: Defense of Aviana
passages.text: The Legion will pay for what we've lost today. We escaped with as many of us as we could, but too many died in vain, trying to protect the Shrine and the Idol of Aviana, which was lost anyway, thanks to that demon scum, Shadegrove.

passages.title: You Can't Take the Sky from Me
passages.text:
The Shrine of Aviana has fallen to the demons, and the Idol of Aviana has been stolen.

That idol acts as a link between the Druids of the Talon and the powers of flight granted to us by Aviana.

The Druids of the Talon have decided to rebuild a new shrine in a more secure location: here in the Dreamgrove.

Meanwhile, I'm going to get our idol back. Meet me in Azsuna, near where we've tracked Infazzar to, if you want to help.

passages.title: You Can't Take the Sky from Me
passages.text: <Place the Corrupted Idol of Aviana on the pedestal.>

passages.title: You Can't Take the Sky from Me
passages.text: You place the Corrupted Idol of Aviana on the pedestal.

passages.title: Jorach's Calling
passages.text: And with that, the first phase of my machination is complete. Let's return to Jorach and tell him it is time to continue.

passages.title: Jorach's Calling
passages.text: Welcome back, Shadowblade. I assume you've retrieved the gunpowder?

passages.title: Bargaining with Shadows
passages.text:
From the clues you've been able to piece together, it appears that Levia was looking to conduct a ritual in the libraries beneath Dalaran - most likely to summon this "Agatha" she has become so infatuated with. I'm afraid this is a little out of my area of expertise, so I'm going to have to call in a favor.

I'll send for assistance from the Council of the Black Harvest. One of their warlocks will meet you in the Chamber of the Guardian to assist with your investigation.

I hope we're not too late.

passages.title: Bargaining with Shadows
passages.text:
You are lucky that Modera contacted me for assistance. 

Agatha is beyond you, <class>. She is beyond any of us.

passages.title: To Fel and Back
passages.text:
Mardum has its fair share of secrets, one of which we found not too long after we took control of the Fel Hammer. It's a breeding ground of sorts, festering with fel bats.

We've been capturing the pups and trying to train them up for our efforts against the Legion.

But the other day, we caught an even greater prize, something worthy of your position, Slayer.

Speak with Kyra and she'll provide you a ride to the ledge.

passages.title: To Fel and Back
passages.text:
Never would I have thought an adult fel bat could be tamed, but your efforts seemed to have prove otherwise. This is a promising revelation for us.

But for now, let all see what you have accomplished.

passages.title: Night of the Wilds
passages.text:
<The letter is written in a flowing, golden script. You can practically hear Odyn's booming voice speak the words as you read it.>

The Night of the Wilds is upon us. 

Tonight, we will feast in honor of the beasts of legend, and they will rise once more in the Fields of the Eternal Hunt.

One among us will set out into the fields to put their spirits to rest once more. 

My herald awaits you, hunter, if you will join us.

passages.title: Night of the Wilds
passages.text:
<An empty saddle sits here, as if it is waiting for your new companion.

You feel a warm kinship with the beast as you recall your meeting. You know what you must do to call the Wolfhawk. You put your fingers to your lips...>

passages.title: The Trial of Ban-Lu
passages.text:
Ah, the ripples I feel in the water are strong! The droplet does not fall far from our location.

Ban-Lu is quite close. 

<Ryuli closes his eyes and releases the lilies into the water. They drift slowly to the east.>

He waits for you now, at the bottom of the waterfall to the east.

passages.title: The Trial of Ban-Lu
passages.text: It will be my honor to carry you on the ceremonial path from this shrine to the temple, as I have done for the Grandmasters before you.

passages.title: Tomb Raidering
passages.text: I said to myself over and over, "Don't go near the citadel. Don't go near the citadel." But what did I do? I went to the citadel. Almost had my hands on that sweet treasure chest before I got chased off by a bunch of crazy demons. I made it out of there with just my helmet and my life!

passages.title: Tomb Raidering
passages.text: I'm always lookin' for more treasure!

passages.title: Tomb Raidering
passages.text:
Did you bother to read the label on this potion? I'm going to assume, no. You may find some sucker who will pay you for it.

Better luck next time kid.

passages.title: The Motherlode
passages.text:
Pst... Come 'ere! I just got a tip about a cave on this island that is a treasure trove of loot! This could be my biggest score yet.

Problem is, I uhh... sprained my ankle. Yeah, I would be right there with you battling those demons to get this treasure, but I shouldn't be putting any weight on this leg of mine. Shucks.

How about you go check on this cave and report back to me. I'll mark your map where the cave entrance is. I've been told it's pretty hidden, so you've got to look around.

passages.title: The Motherlode
passages.text: You find anything?

passages.title: The Motherlode
passages.text: Looks like we hit the motherlode! Now all we need is a key... Huh. Why don't you go work on getting some keys for these chests and I'll hang out with goofy-nose here.

passages.title: The Wisp and the Sea
passages.text:
Queen Azshara and her handmaidens are the subjects of many a tragic tale. Her power and her hubris lead her badly astray but, even so, her handmaidens are loyal to her to this day. There is power in such a thing.

The Wrath of Azshara is an abomination but, truthfully, it is actually one of her handmaidens who willingly gave her life to protect her queen. Few know this. The Ancient Wisp knows this truth and if you take it to battle the Wrath of Azshara, you may find the handmaiden's gloves. Restore them.

passages.title: The Wisp and the Sea
passages.text: You need to battle the Wrath of Azshara and find and restore a pair of handmaiden's gloves.

passages.title: The Wisp and the Sea
passages.text: These gloves have an air of sadness about them, do they not? Regardless, thank you for restoring them and bringing them here.

passages.title: The Owl and the Dreadlord
passages.text:
The demon Mephistroth is one of the most powerful of the Nathrezim--the dreadlords. I can see in your eyes that you know what I am going to ask you to do. But it is for your own good! You can't keep wandering the lands looking like you do. 

Most recently, Mephistroth has been dispatched by the Legion to the Cathedral of Eternal Night. No doubt, he will be wearing some legplates that I believe contain Wardenscale. Take them, shine them up, and bring them to me.

passages.title: The Owl and the Dreadlord
passages.text: Have you defeated Mephistroth and added some shine to his legplates?

passages.title: The Owl and the Dreadlord
passages.text: Those legplates are rather large! I'm surprised you survived that encounter--and you've refinished them beautifully!

passages.title: The Owl and the Observer
passages.text:
I've researched some foul creatures in my time but Viz'aduum the Watcher may top the list. I mean, he is a giant, disgusting, dangerous eyeball! 

Currently he haunts Karazhan--do you know the place? In Medivh's time, much of our common knowledge was stored there. Alas, the time has passed... 

I digress. Viz'aduum is in possession of armor from the First War--bracers to be specific--and they are incredibly valuable. It pains me but take them, repair them, and then we must use their wardenscale.

passages.title: The Owl and the Observer
passages.text: Have you killed that horrible beast and brought me the Bracers of the First War?

passages.title: The Owl and the Observer
passages.text:
These bracers have legends of their own--too bad we need to sacrifice them to build a proper reputation for you but we all must suffer for fashion. 

I would also like to personally thank you for killing Viz'aduum. It just shouldn't... exist. I mean... well you know what I mean.

passages.title: The Godfighter
passages.text:
The Godfighter championed the mortals against what he saw as oppression and abuse by immortal beings. The legends say the gods feared him but he did fall in time. 

My research shows that the gods he fought were the gods of Stormheim. Odyn, in particular. The Godfighter's shield took so much damage from lightning bolts that it became lightningsteel. After the Godfighter died, Odyn took the shield and melted it down as a trophy. Get that lightningsteel from him and forge a hammer from it.

passages.title: The Godfighter
passages.text: Have you taken the white lightningsteel from Odyn and forged it into a hammer?

passages.title: The Godfighter
passages.text: What a remarkable metal! I feel like it tingles just to hold it. Incredible!

passages.title: The Dragonhunter
passages.text:
The Dragonhunter lived in a time before history was written and her tale was passed down orally to us. 

It seems that dragons tormented her people and after her village temple was destroyed, she rallied the local tribes, became a queen and killed all of the dragons. She was then banished for some reason and wandered until her death, alone. What proves the story is a piece of draconic slag from left over from a metal idol in her birth village. Dargul the Underking has it now. Forge a hammer from it.

passages.title: The Dragonhunter
passages.text: Did you find the draconic slag from the Dragonhunter's birth village temple? When you do, forge a hammer from it.

passages.title: The Dragonhunter
passages.text:
It is a powerful magic that kept the draconic slag hot so many years later. Is it the will of the Dragonhunter? Was dragon fire even more dangerous in ancient times?  Or was it actually the dragon Neltharion, whom you know as Deathwing, whom she fought back then? 

I wonder if I shall ever find out. 

Well done! The hammer is extraordinary.

passages.title: Hammer of Forgotten Heroes
passages.text:
<name>, this is exciting, I have to admit. I've put everything you've gathered into this chest of supplies and the only place with the power and magic to handle the creation of the final hammer is the Firmament Stone. I believe that blacksmiths of your rarified skills will know it? 

I realize that there are dwarf stereotypes out there about smithing but I really don't care for all of the banging and heat. Suppose that is why I followed the scholarly path. Good luck to you!

passages.title: Hammer of Forgotten Heroes
passages.text: Be sure to take the chest of supplies I've given you to the Firmament Stone and forge the final hammer. Bring it back to me for inspection when you have done so.

passages.title: Hammer of Forgotten Heroes
passages.text:
The Hammer is possibly the most perfect item you have ever forged. With this, you will create armor of such style and taste that you will become a figure of legends. 

I'm proud of you, <name>. I'm so happy you will finally start to look good.

passages.title: Frozen Memories
passages.text:
Close your eyes, Deathlord. Can't you feel his presence already?

<The Lich King's icy presence is inside your mind in an instant.>

Stand in the rune circle atop Acherus, Deathlord.

I will show you what I have seen.

<The presence fades.>

passages.title: Down the Rabbit Hole
passages.text:
Alright, bub. I'm gonna need you to go in there and find out what's going wrong. I'd go in myself, but... well, it's complicated.

Anyway, we got no time to lose! Just jump in the hat and find out what's goin on.

I'll be ready to pull you out once you've got everything handled.

passages.title: Down the Rabbit Hole
passages.text: Don't just stand there, get in the hat and help the poor bunnies!

passages.title: Down the Rabbit Hole
passages.text:
I can't believe a wolf got in my pocket dimension! That's the last time I order a crate of rabbits from Moonbrook!

I owe you a solid, bud. Here, take my spare hat. Just don't go trying to muscle in on my Dalaran business, got it?

passages.title: Champion: The Great Akazamzarak
passages.text:
You know, you're a useful <fella/dame> to have around, <name>. 

Tell ya what, I think I'll accompany you on your adventures. Seems to be good gold in it, and I think it'll be a good way to scout out some new business opportunities around the Broken Isles.

What do you say?

passages.title: Armies of Legionfall
passages.text:
Thanks to your leadership, the <class> order has grown even mightier than I had dared hope. Alongside champions of the other orders, we now have a fighting force capable of driving the Burning Legion from our world.

It's time to end this invasion! Using the Pillars of Creation, we will dissipate the Felstorm and seal the Tomb of Sargeras.

passages.title: Armies of Legionfall
passages.text: Our forces are assembled. We are ready to begin.

passages.title: Assault on Broken Shore
passages.text:
It has been a long and costly war, <name>. It is time we put an end to it.

We will drive the Burning Legion from their seat of power and close their gateway into Azeroth. Our first step is to gain a foothold on the Broken Shore.

Divided, the Alliance and Horde faced defeat. But united as the Armies of Legionfall, we will claim victory!

passages.title: Assault on Broken Shore
passages.text:
Mephistroth is on the run, and we have a foothold here at Deliverance Point.

A good start, I'd say, though we still have much to do.

passages.title: The Broken Shore: Investigating the Legion
passages.text:
While we focus efforts on the Broken Shore, we must be careful to guard against other threats. We have been getting disturbing reports on the Legion starting or supporting indirect threats to Azeroth.

While you are on the Broken Shore, please keep an eye out for strange objects or intelligence that could give us a clue as to what and where these threats are.

I know it is not a lot to go on, we will do our best from here as well.

passages.title: The Broken Shore: Investigating the Legion
passages.text: Found something?

passages.title: The Broken Shore: Investigating the Legion
passages.text: This scroll, fascinating... this confirms our concerns about indirect Legion threats. We must return to Dalaran, <name>!

passages.title: Relieved of Their Valuables
passages.text:
Not all demons on this shore stomp around in the open. Some slink about in the shadows, finding more subtle ways to advance the Legion's cause.

I have been observing the behavior of smaller demons, these wyrmtongues. They seem to spend considerable time acquiring objects of power. We cannot allow them to use these items against us.

The wyrmtongues stash their goods in chests spread around the Broken Shore. I suggest you relieve them of their ill-gotten gain.

passages.title: Relieved of Their Valuables
passages.text: Have you found the wyrmtongue caches?

passages.title: Relieved of Their Valuables
passages.text:
Fine work. It's important to keep powerful treasures out of demon hands.

There are more ways to undermine the Legion's agenda than simply killing demons... although there's a lot to be said for good old-fashioned violence.

passages.title: The Mage Tower
passages.text:
Well done <name>. In testament to the efforts of all forces fighting here, we have come together to complete the construction of the Mage Tower.

All that remains is for you to inspect our work, and complete the construction.

passages.title: The Mage Tower
passages.text: Inspect the <class> Tower, and complete its construction.

passages.title: The Mage Tower
passages.text: Our grand efforts have resulted in a boon which all can leverage in the coming days.

passages.title: The Command Center
passages.text:
Well done <name>. In testament to the efforts of all forces fighting here, we have come together to complete the construction of the Command Center.

All that remains is for you to inspect our work, and complete the construction.

passages.title: The Command Center
passages.text: Inspect the Command Center, and complete its construction.

passages.title: The Command Center
passages.text: Our grand efforts have resulted in a boon which all can leverage in the coming days.

passages.title: The Nether Disruptor
passages.text:
Well done <name>. In testament to the efforts of all forces fighting here, we have come together to complete the construction of the Nether Disruptor.

All that remains is for you to inspect our work, and complete the construction.

passages.title: The Nether Disruptor
passages.text: Inspect the Nether Disruptor, and complete its construction.

passages.title: The Nether Disruptor
passages.text: Our grand efforts have resulted in a boon which all can leverage in the coming days.

passages.title: Gathering of the Storms
passages.text:
Thunderaan has asked me to send you to the Throne of the Four Winds to assist him with a situation.

Speak with me again when you're ready to leave, Farseer.

passages.title: Gathering of the Storms
passages.text: I'm sure the Windlord's problem won't be too difficult for you to assist with.

passages.title: Gathering of the Storms
passages.text:
Now that the council is reunited, the plane of air shall flow as one again!

I believe Windlord Thunderaan has a reward waiting for you.

passages.title: The Deceiver's Downfall
passages.text:
Once he was as a brother to me. Then he bartered the soul of my world for his own power. Hounded my people across the stars. Twisted my son into a monster.

Now he has come to oversee the final assault on Azeroth. To end this world as he has countless others.

Kil'jaeden.

We must ensure he does not escape our grasp this time, <name>. Storm the tomb. Break the Legion's hold. End the Deceiver's reign.

passages.title: The Deceiver's Downfall
passages.text: Give no quarter. The Deceiver must fall.

passages.title: The Deceiver's Downfall
passages.text:
When we faced the Deceiver, millennia of rage flooded my heart. Hatred took hold, blinding me to every thought but revenge.

Thankfully the Light helped me see that the future must not be defined by vengeance, but by hope. Your courage showed me that as well, <name>.

In those last moments of Kil'jaeden's life, I had to let go of the past. Not only for my own sake, but for the memory of my son.

My spirit and mind are clear and focused. Now we take the fight to Sargeras himself. Now we end the Legion.

passages.title: Delivering Lost Knowledge
passages.text:
The very nature of this ancient night elf tome causes the book to seek out knowledge. This could prove to be a serious boon to your efforts to research your artifact weapon.

I'd wager the scholars in your order hall would find it of great use, possibly unlocking new avenues of empowerment.

I suggest you take it to them immediately. We need every advantage possible against the Legion!

passages.title: Delivering Lost Knowledge
passages.text:
What have you brought today, Deathlord?

<Illanna examines the ancient tome.>

This book... it changes everything!

passages.title: To the Forge It Goes...
passages.text: This cloak is too tattered to be usable, but can be obliterated at the Obliterum Forge in Dalaran.

passages.title: To the Forge It Goes...
passages.text: Visit the forge recently?

passages.title: To the Forge It Goes...
passages.text: If you find any other unwanted spoils of war, obliterate them at the forge and I can help you find something more desirable.

passages.title: Rendezvous
passages.text:
There is much to be done before this nightmare can end, but we need to regroup before we draw more attention from the Legion.

I managed to retain a signal crystal during the crash used to call transport beacons from the Xenedar.

With luck, we should be able to use it to establish a link between here and your forces as well.

passages.title: Rendezvous
passages.text: We must establish a link to your vessel before we can press on.

passages.title: Rendezvous
passages.text: Lothraxion is an old friend, and a noble warrior. We are fortunate to have him among us.

passages.title: Defenseless and Afraid
passages.text:
This is the battle that raged while I awaited the Genedar. So many ran to join me, but Kil'jaeden inspired still more to stand in their way.

My people were slaughtered without mercy.

To cover our retreat I ordered for this arena's defenses to be activated. It is clear that they were unable.

To turn the tide in this battle, to give these spirits rest, we must do what they could not. Find a way to activate the pylons.

passages.title: Defenseless and Afraid
passages.text: I will hold this position. The spirits may be only echoes of their former selves, but they do not know that.

passages.title: Defenseless and Afraid
passages.text: The tide is turning. We must press forward.

passages.title: Meld Into the Shadows
passages.text: We should meet back up with the rest of the council and tell them of what we have achieved this day. At your leisure, return to us. We shall be waiting.

passages.title: Meld Into the Shadows
passages.text:
We've been discussing your recent success, <name>. We walk the shadows, and that often goes taken for granted. But without us, the Armies of Legionfall would have a great many more powerful demons to deal with.

We do not need the fame. We reap the rewards.

passages.title: Aalgen Point
passages.text:
You wanna hold territory on this chunder puddle of an island, right? Right. That means linkin' up with camps on the outskirts, mate. 

I know this bloke called Heidirk. Scrappy fella, loves to get into the thick of it. Headed out to the eastern coast with those drakes of his.

Have a look for him. Remind him he owes me a pint or two!

passages.title: Aalgen Point
passages.text:
Chambers sent you? He can down a tankard with the best of 'em, I'll give him that. But if he says I owe him anything, he's a liar!

Don't you worry, my drakes and I will hold the point here. But more of this shore will need to be secured before your campaign can find victory.

passages.title: Vengeance Point
passages.text:
On my way here, I ran across a squad of demon hunters headed northwest to Vengeance Point. You can bet the Legion will try to stop them from establishing a forward position.

I spoke to an elf named Izal Whitemoon. Not the friendliest sort, but I'm sure she'd be grateful if you lent the Illidari a hand... whether she admits it or not.

passages.title: Vengeance Point
passages.text: This siege is disabling my bats from their scouting duties.

passages.title: Vengeance Point
passages.text:
The Illidari don't waste time on congratulations. There is more to do, and you're the one to do it.

Get a move on.

passages.title: The Word of Zul
passages.text:
I have a mundane task for you. Our esteemed Prophet Zul has words to distribute to very specific individuals in de port. 

And he requested you be de one to deliver dem.

Don't ask me why he didn't just have you deliver these when you were here de first time. De prophet is notorious for not sharing all of his visions.

passages.title: The Word of Zul
passages.text: Have you finished all of your deliveries?

passages.title: The Word of Zul
passages.text: Ah, you are a competent errand-<race> after all. Perhaps you could be trusted with more important tasks. Like trash removal.

passages.title: Deterrent
passages.text:
General Jakra'zet had orders to ensure dis place had protection. Guard protection. I see none of dat.

Jakra'zet is a stubborn general, and one I have had my eye on for a while now.

Regardless, we must remind dese lesser tribes who rules dis city with a message dey will understand.

I charge you with collecting heads.

Enter Tal'farrak and Tal'aman, and collect a quota of heads.

passages.title: Deterrent
passages.text: Troll politics are more like a blood sport.

passages.title: Deterrent
passages.text: When visitors do not understand de language of your laws, it becomes necessary to explain your laws in a language dey do understand.

passages.title: The Shadow of the Sentinax
passages.text:
This device appears to be used to relay messages to the large demon ship up above. Unfortunately, it is cracked and unresponsive.

Perhaps someone at Deliverance Point will know more about these beacons.

passages.title: The Shadow of the Sentinax
passages.text: The Legion uses these beacons to communicate with their fleet up above. If we were to find more of these...

passages.title: To the Forge It Goes...
passages.text: This cloak is too tattered to be usable, but can be obliterated at the Obliterum Forge in Dalaran.

passages.title: To the Forge It Goes...
passages.text: Visit the forge recently, have we?

passages.title: To the Forge It Goes...
passages.text: If you find any other unwanted spoils of war, obliterate them at the forge and I can help you find something more desirable.

passages.title: Delivering Lost Knowledge
passages.text:
The very nature of this ancient night elf tome causes the book to seek out knowledge. This could prove to be a serious boon to your efforts to research your artifact weapon.

I'd wager the scholars in your order hall would find it of great use, possibly unlocking new avenues of empowerment.

I suggest you take it to them immediately. We need every advantage possible against the Legion!

passages.title: Delivering Lost Knowledge
passages.text:
What have you brought today, Grandmaster?

<Cho examines the ancient tome.>

This book... it changes everything!

passages.title: Get Your Bearings
passages.text:
I think a proper introduction is in order!

My name is Taelia, member of the Proudmoore Guard and squire of Sir Cyrus Crestfall.

<Taelia salutes firmly.>

Cyrus asked me and Flynn to break you out of that Ashvane prison and get you settled in here at the market, but he neglected to mention that you're with the Alliance.

I must say, it's an honor.

Let's get you up to speed.

passages.title: Get Your Bearings
passages.text: I'll bring you to Cyrus after a brief tour of the market.

passages.title: Get Your Bearings
passages.text: Ready to meet the Harbormaster himself?

passages.title: The Mysterious Missive
passages.text:
<On the body, you find a missive emblazoned with the seal of the Army of the Light. 

If the messenger was killed to prevent the letter's delivery, its contents must be of great import.>

passages.title: The Mysterious Missive
passages.text:
Our fight goes on, champion. Argus must fall.

What is that you've found?

passages.title: The Mysterious Missive
passages.text:
You've found one of our scouting reports? It was overdue, and I feared it had been intercepted by the enemy.

<The captain looks over the letter.>

Yes, this is what I've been expecting. The Legion is planning something and this is the breakthrough we've been looking for!

passages.title: Imprisoned Inquisitor
passages.text:
This report states that the Legion seeks to free an imprisoned Legion inquisitor called Raalgar, a demon from here on Argus who cannot be killed because of a secret magic he alone possesses. 

Because of his immortality, he is held in the Arcatraz in Tempest Keep.

The Light Mother told us of that naaru stronghold, but I've never set eyes upon it myself, <name>. Turalyon mentioned the Vindicaar has some connection to Tempest Keep. Perhaps your ship's engineer knows more.

passages.title: Imprisoned Inquisitor
passages.text:
High Inquisitor Raalgar? A fearsome creature but he has been held securely in the Arcatraz at Tempest Keep for a very long time. 

If the Legion plans to free him then they must know that he is particularly dangerous to us.

passages.title: Foiling the Legion's Jailbreak
passages.text:
High Inquisitor Raalgar has some connection to the fel here on Argus that makes him unkillable. Long ago, the naaru imprisoned him on the Arcatraz. 

When the forces of Kael'thas Sunstrider attacked the citadel, we were forced to flee on the Exodar.

Some Legion prisoners escaped the Arcatraz when last the Legion invaded Azeroth, but Raalgar did not. Stop them from freeing him and I will study the source of his immortality so it can be broken. 

I can get you close. The rest is up to you.

passages.title: Foiling the Legion's Jailbreak
passages.text: We must stop High Inquisitor Raalgar!

passages.title: Foiling the Legion's Jailbreak
passages.text:
You did your best, <name>, but the demons won this round.

It won't take Raalgar long to gather his power to attack us. But I have learned the source of his immortality while you were gone!

passages.title: Champions of Legionfall
passages.text:
The battle to reclaim the Broken Shore is straining our resources. We cannot afford to relent, lest the Legion undo all that we have accomplished.

The members of your order have given much, but more is needed.

Rally your champions and do what you must to bolster their ranks. There may be untapped power in this land that will turn the tide of war in our favor.

passages.title: Champions of Legionfall
passages.text:
Another powerful ally recruited to our cause!

You have bolstered our strength against the Legion once more, <name>.

passages.title: The Pulsing Madness
passages.text:
This broken still retains some of his sanity, though not all of it.

I can sense some Void influence nearby, but it is isolated to small pockets. Dispelling these manifestations should help our friend here clear his mind.

Perhaps we can use the prayer fragments you found, as they still contain some Light energy.

I will try and make sense of his chattering in the meantime. Maybe we can learn something about what is happening here.

passages.title: The Pulsing Madness
passages.text: I can feel the Void's influence retreating. Perhaps now we can find out what happened here.

passages.title: The Smoking Gun
passages.text:
The Ashvane Company doesn't know it yet, but throwing you into Tol Dagor was the biggest mistake they've ever made.

That new powder we swiped could be the key to bringing them down.

First, how about we give everyone a little demonstration of just how powerful this stuff is?

<Flynn loads a pinch of the glittering powder into his pistol.>

Go ahead, take a shot at that barrel over there.

passages.title: The Smoking Gun
passages.text:
Don't worry, it won't hurt anyone.

I think.

passages.title: The Smoking Gun
passages.text: Adds a kick, don't it?

passages.title: Long Overdue
passages.text:
I have learned much. High Inquisitor Raalgar has moved to a base near the Legion citadel across the mountains. This is where he keeps the Fel Heart of Argus, the source of his immortality, and it is powered by wells leading directly to the core of Argus. 

He is preparing to attack so you will strike first. Mark the location of the wells and I will rain holy fire upon them with the Vindicaar's guns. With that connection to the fel on Argus broken, Raalgar can be killed and the Fel Heart retrieved.

passages.title: Long Overdue
passages.text: Have you dealt with High Inquisitor Raalgar yet?

passages.title: Long Overdue
passages.text: You are a true hero, <name>. Even though the demons freed Raalgar and thought him immortal, he was no match for you! Perhaps the Fel Heart will be of use to you. It is now available in the Matrix Core.

passages.title: Sanctum of the Sages
passages.text:
Sounds like you'll be working with us for awhile.

Cyrus will charter a naval transport between here and Stormwind, but I expect you'll want something a bit faster for day to day use.

Head back upstairs and take a left when you get outside. You'll find an old study where the Tidesages used to conduct their magic rituals.

Surely your Alliance mages have already sensed its power.

Inform them they may open their portals there. The harbor guards will keep the room secure.

passages.title: Sanctum of the Sages
passages.text: The Tidesages abandoned that place months ago when they pulled back to their monasteries. We still don't know why.

passages.title: Sanctum of the Sages
passages.text:
All set?

Good timing. I have your briefing ready.

passages.title: Throwing Shade
passages.text:
That was Locus-Walker. He taught me all that I know about the Void, and he still has more to teach me.

If he is here, then the ethereals' presence only intrigues me further. I had thought him the only one of his kind, but now that I have seen another tangling with the Void...

Come, we must play his game if we want to learn what he knows. He appears to have gone toward the Umbra Hollows to the north.

passages.title: Throwing Shade
passages.text: Move quickly, or we may lose him.

passages.title: Throwing Shade
passages.text: <Alleria seems momentarily speechless.>

passages.title: A Vessel Made Ready
passages.text:
After some consideration, I have decided to allow Alleria another opportunity to pursue her destiny.

I suppose you want to know what that means, mortal.

<Locus-Walker laughs.>

Meet us deep in the Shadowguard camp ahead- my brethren are preparing a summons that will provide adequate energy for Windrunner to begin again.

Witness what happens when you harness the Void's power.

passages.title: A Vessel Made Ready
passages.text: I see the path clearly, <name>.

passages.title: A Vessel Made Ready
passages.text:
<Alleria takes the heart in her hands.>

This is the next step, <name>. Thank you for bringing me to this point.

passages.title: A Beacon in the Dark
passages.text:
That was... an intense experience.

<Alleria rubs her forehead.>

It is difficult to focus. I need you to return to Velen. Give him this.

<She places something cold and dense in your palm.>

I feel as though he should have it, though I am not sure why.

Tell him all that we have learned. I am sure Romuul will have been watching our progress. With any luck, a beacon is already headed our way.

passages.title: A Beacon in the Dark
passages.text: What is this? Such darkness...

passages.title: A Beacon in the Dark
passages.text:
What is it you bring, <name>?

Intriguing...

passages.title: Soulbound
passages.text:
Ya did well with me tasks. I be thinkin' ya show promise. Ya might be worthy of a deal.

Very well, I pledge ta lend ya me powers ta use against ya foes. In exchange, ya be sendin' one million souls ta Bwonsamdi! No need ta look shocked, ya be plenty capable of doing dis.

Come, meet with me at da Court of Spirits. Dere, we will finalize our agreement.

passages.title: Soulbound
passages.text:
Dese blood trolls and their "god" G'huun, dey be far more of a threat than I realized. Da ritual ta seal da pact between ya and I be incomplete, but considerin' da circumstances, I tink we can skip da formalities.

As long as da price be paid, ya can count on Bwonsamdi's aid.

passages.title: The Originals
passages.text:
Long ago, great terrors walked our lands, and drove even the smallest to flights of heroism.

I speak, of course, about Lord Kazzak, Azuregos, and the Dragons of Nightmare.

Legends have it that so sought after were their treasures, that armies would camp overnight to hunt them down.

We have felt disturbances in the timeways, coincidentally located where these giants once roamed. 

Would you mind investigating for us? Strange things happen during this time of year.

passages.title: The Originals
passages.text: They're just memories, right?

passages.title: The Originals
passages.text: Let us use this moment to reflect upon the past, lest we forget the lessons it teaches us, and doom ourselves to repeat it once more.

passages.title: The Originals
passages.text:
Long ago, great terrors walked our lands, and drove even the smallest to flights of heroism.

I speak, of course, about Lord Kazzak, Azuregos, and the Dragons of Nightmare.

Legends have it that so sought after were their treasures, that armies would camp overnight to hunt them down.

The dragons have felt disturbances in the timeways, coincidentally located where these giants once roamed. 

They have tasked me with finding champions to investigate.

passages.title: The Originals
passages.text: They're just memories, right?

passages.title: The Originals
passages.text: Let us use this moment to reflect upon the past, lest we forget the lessons it teaches us, and doom ourselves to repeat it once more.

passages.title: Chop, Chop!
passages.text:
Throm-ka, <name>.

I'm always looking for someone who thinks they can swing an axe with the best of them.

If you can remove that sapling without much trouble, I'm sure we can find a better use for your skills.

passages.title: Chop, Chop!
passages.text: Hmm?

passages.title: Chop, Chop!
passages.text: Just the kind of strength we need around here.

passages.title: The Vindicaar Matrix Core
passages.text:
Much has happened on Argus that concerns me but none moreso than Xe'ra's fate. I wonder sometimes if we are doing the right thing? 

But we must carry on. I can rig the Matrix Core that powers the Vindicaar to allow you to call on the power of our guns when you have need of them on the planet. 

Go to the Matrix Core in the room at the heart of our ship. Once linked, whatever powers the core has installed now and in the future will be at your disposal.

passages.title: The Vindicaar Matrix Core
passages.text: Have you linked Light's Judgment into the Vindicaar Matrix Core?

passages.title: The Vindicaar Matrix Core
passages.text:
Light's Judgment will now fire on your command when you use the Matrix Uplink. 

Perhaps you will find more objects that we can link into the Matrix on your travels. I have routed enough energy to that part of the Core to handle anything that you can link into it. 

Go well, my friend.

passages.title: Moonkin Monitoring
passages.text: <Makkaw motions for you to observe the other moonkin in the area.>

passages.title: Moonkin Monitoring
passages.text: <Makkaw seems very pleased about what you have learned.>

passages.title: Interact - Doodad & Creature Test [DO NOT LOCALIZE]
passages.text: Please complete this quest in order to testing the Interact - Doodad & Interact - Creature quest objective types.

passages.title: The Ashvane Trading Company
passages.text:
So, Ashvane's goons are walking around with a new powder that can blow a galleon clean in half and the military has no idea.

We need to find out how much of this powder they have and where it's going.

An old buddy of mine works the ferry down by the Ashvane Foundry. He may know something about this.

You can take the ferry from Tradewinds Market to Eastpoint Station. Once you get there, look for a man named Cagney. Tell him I sent you. He owes me a favor.

passages.title: The Ashvane Trading Company
passages.text: Eh? What do you want?

passages.title: Labor Dispute
passages.text:
The Ashvane Company has been workin' their people so hard they even tried to strike! 

The company brought in a bunch of goons to break it up and get everyone back to work. 

Heard they even shot a couple guys who tried to walk off the job.

What say you give 'em a taste of their own brutality while you're in there?

passages.title: Labor Dispute
passages.text: Nobody likes livin' under the thumb of company men like that - they ain't gonna be missed.

passages.title: Dirty Work for Dirty Drinks
passages.text:
Guests gotta earn their keep at de Goldtusk Inn. What say you help me clear out some scorpids at one of our off-site excursion locations? De delightful Dead Man's Pass!

Normally, you'd need to purchase our Warlord Package to be allowed access, but I'll make an exception dis time.

I'll even throw in our Scorpid King Package. Unlimited scorpid blood drinks all day, every day!

Dere's one catch: we're out of scorpid blood. Bring some back and I'll whip up a batch of drinks for us.

passages.title: Dirty Work for Dirty Drinks
passages.text: My scorpid blood drinks are famous in de Goldtusk Gang!

passages.title: Dirty Work for Dirty Drinks
passages.text:
I'll hold onto dis blood until we can get back to de inn to make de drinks.

Don't worry, I won't let you miss out on dem. I know you're excited to try my famous scorpid blood drinks!

passages.title: The Great Cranium Caper
passages.text:
Sandfury thugs attacked de inn after you left and kidnapped de whole Goldtusk Gang!

We gotta get dem back.

Man'zul was usually de brains behind our thefts back in Zuldazar, but I'll try to come up with a plan to get dem outta dis mess.

<Rhan'ka thinks for awhile.>

I got it! You rescue 'em all!

passages.title: The Great Cranium Caper
passages.text: We nothin' without our gang.

passages.title: The Great Cranium Caper
passages.text: Ya one of us now, <name>.

passages.title: Disturbance Detected: Black Temple
passages.text:
<name>, right on time, as always.

Good news first, because they're happening at the same time for me anyway. Thanks to the various timewarped objects past and future you discovered, we've figured out how to detect when a new one turns up. 

The bad news is, we know our technique works because something has changed in the Black Temple, and it's wreaking havoc across the timescape! We need you to ensure the fateful raid turns out exactly like it did before, and to remove the source of this disturbance.

passages.title: Disturbance Detected: Black Temple
passages.text: Be extra careful the raid on the temple turns out exactly like it did before.  One extra flap of dragonfly wings, and you might end up killing Illidan for real!  Then imagine the mess we'd be in!

passages.title: Disturbance Detected: Black Temple
passages.text:
What's this, <name>?

These are the plans for the raid on Mardum, were we too late?

What's strange, is the new plan seems better than the original!  It's unlikely this is the Legion's doing, Illidan surely would have detected any fel manipulation.  So if not the Legion, who is behind this?

passages.title: Rewind
passages.text:
Now we know when the attack happens, and vaguely where it's coming from. Progress! All we need to do now is to find out more details and stop that attack!

Let me know when you're ready to try again.

passages.title: Rewind
passages.text: I sure hope we don't cause a paradox!

passages.title: Rewind
passages.text:
I guess we have plenty of leads to follow up on.

Wow, whoever wants to kill me really thought this through!

passages.title: The Many Advantages of Being a Time Dragon
passages.text:
Well, unfortunately for... whomever is fixated on blasting me into oblivion, I am a fairly skilled master of the timeways! We have the advantage of trying that again, and again, and again, until I'm not dead anymore.

We're going to need a little more than a few seconds to stop this attack. How does four hours sound?

passages.title: The Many Advantages of Being a Time Dragon
passages.text: Fifteen minutes isn't a whole lot of time. We're going to have to move quickly.

passages.title: Intercepting the Legion's Plans
passages.text:
Our scout Skara writes in the missive that she learned of a major Legion initiative. She was after two encoded orders held by Legion troops near us to get the details and this must be when she was killed. The Legion splits their messages into encoded parts so that we cannot read them. 

Skara also writes that her partner Brae, a codebreaker, was slain trying to reach our lines with a code book that we will need to translate the Legion's orders. It is vital you find the orders and that code book!

passages.title: Intercepting the Legion's Plans
passages.text: Have you found the orders and the code book?

passages.title: Intercepting the Legion's Plans
passages.text:
Skara and Brae gave their lives to get us this information and the codebook. Their sacrifice will not be forgotten.

Now, let us decipher the orders and see what the Legion is up to.

passages.title: Headhunter Jo
passages.text:
He said he's hunting you. I'm not the prey, I'm the bait!

Behind ye!

passages.title: Headhunter Jo
passages.text: He's a sly one!

passages.title: Headhunter Jo
passages.text: Ye have my thanks, <class>. I'll be on the look out for ye in the future.

passages.title: Righteous Fury
passages.text:
The devastators bombarding our forces prevent us from advancing any further. I can only protect us from their blasts for so long.

Champion, you must pierce their lines and remove the barriers protecting the devastators.

If you can destroy the anchors that maintain the shields, I can cleanse them from afar.

passages.title: Righteous Fury
passages.text: Unless the anchors are destroyed, the devastators cannot be touched.

passages.title: Righteous Fury
passages.text: We may yet stand a chance.

passages.title: Shine Bright Like a Diamond
passages.text: Oh, I be sorry. Dat lamp look like it could use some shinin'. I happen to have just da ting.

passages.title: Shine Bright Like a Diamond
passages.text: I'm sure dis will all be worth it.

passages.title: Shine Bright Like a Diamond
passages.text: Ooh, ooh, lemme see!

passages.title: Pilfering and Fencing
passages.text:
Our ships are sunk. Our A.M.O.D.'s gone. We've lost a LOT on this mission... and the Bilgewater Cartel don't offer insurance. The debt collectors will be all over us! We gotta make up for these losses. 

The beach is swarmin' with naga tryin' to collect artifacts from the ruins. How 'bout we grab some of that treasure and make back our money? I'm sure we could find a buyer willing to take 'em off our hands. 

We'll split the proceeds 80/20. Sounds fair to me.

passages.title: Pilfering and Fencing
passages.text: Got anything for me?

passages.title: Pilfering and Fencing
passages.text: Nice haul! This should keep the cartel off our backs.

passages.title: Field Evaluation
passages.text:
We got the A.M.O.D. back together. It's a fine piece of equipment, but we're gonna have to give it a tune up. We don't want to end up digging shrapnel out of our rears.

Lucky for us, there are a few naga camps remaining along with the giant that broke the gun in the first place. They'll be great for target practice.

We'll deploy the A.M.O.D. just outside the building here. After we deploy, go man it. I'll have you fire a few rounds while I tune its gun.

Everything'll be fine... unless it isn't.

passages.title: Field Evaluation
passages.text:
Great job! The A.M.O.D. needs a few more tweaks but it'll be nothing we can't handle.

Oh, and hey... good shooting!

passages.title: High Fash-Djinn
passages.text: With my newly empowered lamp, I sense further, more valuable trinkets in the pockets of these elves and demons. Fetch them for me!

passages.title: High Fash-Djinn
passages.text: Well, well, well. You continue to amuse and amaze, mortal.

passages.title: High Fash-Djinn
passages.text: You've done it! My lamp has never shone brighter. I shall continue to grant you coins, but I shall have to find new uses for the magic you provide.

passages.title: The Last Witch Doctor of Krag'wa
passages.text:
I am Krag'wa, the once mighty. Curse the blood trolls and their dark god! They have slain my worshippers until only Zentimo remained, and now even he is gone.

I want revenge on the blood trolls, but first I must honor the last of my witch doctors. As I have no others, I must request you perform the ritual.

Then we can talk of revenge.

passages.title: The Last Witch Doctor of Krag'wa
passages.text: Zentimo must be honored.

passages.title: The Last Witch Doctor of Krag'wa
passages.text:
Your ritual was done well.

With your help, I will not be fed to the blood trolls' god. It is I who will do the eating!

passages.title: Seat of the Triumvirate: The Crest of Knowledge
passages.text:
We have all that we need now, <name>.

Alleria Windrunner awaits your arrival at the Seat of the Triumvirate.

Do not go alone, my friend. You will need allies to recover the Crest of Knowledge... and endure what L'ura has become.

I will prepare the Vindicaar and await your return. Light be with you in that dark place.

passages.title: Seat of the Triumvirate: The Crest of Knowledge
passages.text: It is a heavy burden I have placed upon you, <name>. I have faith you will not fail.

passages.title: Seat of the Triumvirate: The Crest of Knowledge
passages.text:
It is done. My heart mourns the loss of L'ura, but at least you brought her peace.

Once the Crown is in place, the Vindicaar will stand against the Legion's vile assault. Antorus will fall!

passages.title: Fallen Idols
passages.text:
De blood trolls seek to weaken Krag'wa and take his power. Dey steal his idols of power to crack open and feed their magic.

Salvage what idols you can. Dey will be needed to make Krag'wa strong. Strong enough to fight dem off once and for all.

passages.title: Fallen Idols
passages.text: My idols?

passages.title: Fallen Idols
passages.text:
My totems! So many taken, so many broken. I know you saved what you could. It will not be enough.

Too much of their once great power has been drained.

passages.title: Gatekeeper's Challenge: Cunning
passages.text:
Archimonde expected greatness from his pupils. Only the most imaginative minds, the most adroit of intellects, could ever truly fathom the deepest reaches of our magic.

I doubt you can relate.

The path to the left will take you to a set of three statues. Use them to collect a Mark of Cunning.

To preserve the integrity of this trial, I will not be able to provide hints. If you do, by some miracle, happen to succeed, I will formally recognize your... brilliance.

passages.title: Gatekeeper's Challenge: Cunning
passages.text: Display the Mark of Cunning or leave me alone.

passages.title: Gatekeeper's Challenge: Cunning
passages.text:
Oh. You were successful.

Surprising.

passages.title: Gatekeeper's Challenge: Mastery
passages.text:
Archimonde was an individual consumed by the pursuit of power. Only those who could match his lust would fare well under his tutelage.

You will fight what remains of Archimonde's greatest pupils. These three once held such power in their own disciplines that the Conservatory remembers them now.

Their echoes will try to kill you.

Best all three with all your limbs intact and I will recognize your strength.

passages.title: Gatekeeper's Challenge: Mastery
passages.text: I must admit, I am impressed.

passages.title: Krag'wa the Terrible
passages.text:
Your previous attack has angered the blood trolls. They now send an army to take everything. They are too late! I am Krag'wa! I will not be eaten, I do the eating!

Meet me at the edge of Razorjaw River. You will bear witness to my power, and I will bear witness to yours.

passages.title: Krag'wa the Terrible
passages.text: Do you now see my power?

passages.title: Krag'wa the Terrible
passages.text:
The savages flee at the sight of Krag'wa! This pleases me! 

But, they will come back in larger numbers soon unless their dark god is stopped. As long as you oppose them, I will grant you my boon.

When the day of reckoning comes, you will have my aid.

passages.title: Hunt for King K'tal
passages.text:
Hunters! Dis challenge be for de King of de Preserves.

King K'tal is a mighty predator, smart and fast. Gold and honor await de hunter who brings me de head of de King.

passages.title: Hunt for King K'tal
passages.text: Good hunting.

passages.title: Hunt for King K'tal
passages.text: Impressive. De King has been dethroned.

passages.title: Tomb of Sargeras: Aegwynn's Path
passages.text: As we sealed the tomb, I entrusted the final piece of Sargeras' prison to the Maiden of Vigilance. If you had it you could move freely throughout the tomb, but I know not what became of the keeper and fear the worst.

passages.title: Tomb of Sargeras: Aegwynn's Path
passages.text: Without the power of the seal we cannot bypass my wards.

passages.title: Tomb of Sargeras: Aegwynn's Path
passages.text: With the remnants of this seal, we can dispel the wards and enter my sanctum.

passages.title: Tomb of Sargeras: Aegwynn's Path
passages.text: As we sealed the tomb, I entrusted the final piece of Sargeras' prison to the Maiden of Vigilance. If you had it you could move freely throughout the tomb, but I know not what became of the keeper and fear the worst.

passages.title: Tomb of Sargeras: Aegwynn's Path
passages.text: Without the power of the seal we cannot bypass my wards.

passages.title: Tomb of Sargeras: Aegwynn's Path
passages.text: With the remnants of this seal, we can dispel the wards and enter my sanctum.

passages.title: Tomb of Sargeras: Aegwynn's Path
passages.text: As we sealed the tomb, I entrusted the final piece of Sargeras' prison to the Maiden of Vigilance. If you had it you could move freely throughout the tomb, but I know not what became of the keeper and fear the worst.

passages.title: Tomb of Sargeras: Aegwynn's Path
passages.text: Without the power of the seal we cannot bypass my wards.

passages.title: Tomb of Sargeras: Aegwynn's Path
passages.text: With the remnants of this seal, we can dispel the wards and enter my sanctum.

passages.title: Ancient Tortollan Remedies
passages.text:
Ah, yes, the situation is urgent. We must act quickly, but not hastily.

There is a way to save Rastakhan, but it will require three very specific ingredients. Listen well, young one.

The first, foam bubbling from the mouth of a crab. The older, the better.

The second, the spine of a puffer fish. Venomous!

The third, a brutosaur scale.

Why? These are the secrets of my people, <name>. Longevity is cultivated like the rarest of flowers... carefully, and with much practice.

passages.title: Ancient Tortollan Remedies
passages.text: The quality of the healing depends very much on the quality of the ingredients.

passages.title: Ancient Tortollan Remedies
passages.text: They are satisfactory. I will explain in due time what they are for.

passages.title: The Will of the Loa
passages.text:
Jol's remedy healed Rastakhan's flesh. But his spirit is still lost. Dere is only one thing stopping him now.

Death.

He is walking in Bwonsamdi's shadow. For most, dere would be nothing to be done. But... he is bound to another loa. A loa who gives life to his faithful.

You must call on Rezan, loa of kings, and ask him to claim back Rastakhan's soul.

Up de path, you will find my tent. Place dis idol and wait dere. If we are lucky, he will aid us.

If not... It was nice knowing you.

passages.title: The Will of the Loa
passages.text:
<Rastakhan smiles grimly at you.>

You look like you have seen a loa. I know de feeling. Rezan will have words for me when I see him again.

passages.title: Zul's Mutiny
passages.text:
A ship such as Rastakhan's Might does not readily sail without her crew.

Dat means de Zandalari aboard have succumbed to Zul's machinations and have betrayed their king as surely as he has.

Board my ship. Kill those who think to rise against their king. We will take no prisoners.

De punishment for de crime of mutiny is death!

passages.title: Zul's Mutiny
passages.text: Have you answered dem, <name>?

passages.title: Zul's Mutiny
passages.text: Your hands are bloody. Good. Mutiny has no other price.

passages.title: Lightly Roasted
passages.text:
Can you hear me, <name>? Good.

Light's Judgment has been installed on the Vindicaar. We should be able to harness its power immediately.

We can use it both to clear the rubble blocking the Xenedar as well as destroy our enemies.

As with any new piece of technology, we should test it out. Thoroughly. I trust you have plenty of targets down there.

passages.title: Lightly Roasted
passages.text: Excellent. The path is clear.

passages.title: Sealing Fate: Marks of Honor
passages.text: A simple exchange with complex results.  That's the art of doing business.

passages.title: Flanking Maneuvers
passages.text:
I will take command of Fareeya's lieutenants and we will escort Velen to the Crest of Knowledge. His mission must not fail.

We face an old foe-- one the Army of the Light has encountered on numerous occasions. Talgath will try to block us in and prevent our retreat.

You must not let that happen. Find out how he is bringing in his forces and cut them off. All we need is time to get in and get out.

We are counting on you.

passages.title: Flanking Maneuvers
passages.text: <Velen stares at the shattered statue before him and says nothing.>

passages.title: Wrath of the High Exarch
passages.text:
Where the Legion is concerned, violence is always the answer.

<Turalyon hefts his blade with a grim expression.>

They are between us and Velen. Nothing will stop them from finding him unless we act. Now is not the time to hold back.

Together we will sow chaos among their ranks.

passages.title: Wrath of the High Exarch
passages.text:
If I have learned anything about the Legion, it is that we have no other option but to fight back.

It was a pleasure to have you at my side.

passages.title: Sealing Fate: Additional Marks of Honor
passages.text: A simple exchange with complex results.  That's the art of doing business.

passages.title: Sealing Fate: Piles of Marks of Honor
passages.text: A simple exchange with complex results.  That's the art of doing business.

passages.title: Dead Men Tell No Tales
passages.text:
I'm an employee of the Ashvane Company. We're number one in the Azerite trade. 

When I took this job, no one told me it would be a one-way trip!

I'd do just about anything to escape these dunes, including working with you.

Maybe we can help each other out?

I'd be willing to part with the code to the captain's lockbox, if you're willing to help me escape this wretched desert.
