passages.title: Antorus, the Burning Throne: The Heart of Argus
passages.text:
With these sigils, the Vindicaar can bypass the Burning Throne's defenses.

The time has come to press our advantage and end this war.

passages.title: Jungo, Herald of G'huun
passages.text:
Dis is it, <name>. De blood magic is weakened enough dat we can actually hurt de herald of G'huun.

It is going to take all of us fighting dis thing to stop it. We will meet you inside of Torga. 

We cannot lose here. If de blood trolls control Torga's blood, den dere will be no way for us to stop dem.

passages.title: Jungo, Herald of G'huun
passages.text:
It is done, <name>. De blood trolls no longer have de blood of Torga as a resource to fuel their army.

I know we were hoping to have Torga's aid, but at least we stopped de blood trolls.

We must find Rokhan and de others, along with Krag'wa, if he is still alive.

Eh? It looks like Lashk wants something...

passages.title: An Army's Arsenal
passages.text:
It's my job to scout out the ruins to identify threats and figure out the best way in.

Two storehouses contain the majority of the valuable weaponry in the ruins.

Unfortunately, they're guarded by specters, powerful Zandalari spirits bound to this place.

I... we need those weapons. Take out the specters so I... we can get to them.

passages.title: An Army's Arsenal
passages.text:
You and I make a good team, <name>.

Have a little extra reward, on me.

passages.title: Spirits' Belongings
passages.text:
You are no Zandalari, but your spirit burns with a passion I have not seen in many years.

I am de wavebinder. It is through me dat de loa bless our ships. I will not see my home tainted by dese talking rocks.

Gather my bijous, my grimoire, and some of our fallen I set aside for just such an occasion.

De brutes think dey have won. Dey will answer to Bwonsamdi soon enough.

passages.title: Spirits' Belongings
passages.text: You have my things?

passages.title: Spirits' Belongings
passages.text:
You have done well. My friends on de Other Side are pleased.

Now for de fun part.

passages.title: My Favorite Things
passages.text:
It's tough out here.

Pirates. Deadly monsters. 

Hungry Sam's seemingly endless battle with indigestion.

Nothing sets the nerves at ease like an old keepsake. Somethin' to remind you of home. Somethin' to keep you going.

Ask around the camp. Find out what folks might have lost out there in the tideways. If you can bring any of it back, it'd be a mighty kind gesture.

Me? Oh... I had a locket... 

Never mind, it's too small, you'd never find it. It's nothing. Don't worry about it.

passages.title: My Favorite Things
passages.text:
We've all lost something in the tides.

Some more than others.

passages.title: My Favorite Things
passages.text:
I didn't think you'd actually find all this stuff!

We don't have much, but here's a little something for your troubles.

passages.title: Many More Intact Demon Eyes
passages.text: These shall keep me busy for a while... Take this, for your loyalty.

passages.title: And Justice For All
passages.text:
Thank you for helping to redeem me in the eyes of my people, <class>. I am in your debt, and I will be sure to let my father know.

In the mean time, I think we should find out what this Heartsbane Coven is, and what they are doing in our lands. I hope the marshal will be able to enlighten us.

First thing's first, though. Care to undo these ropes? They're starting to chafe.

passages.title: And Justice For All
passages.text: Shall we?

passages.title: And Justice For All
passages.text:
This situation is much worse than I had thought. The coven has taken House Waycrest?! This will not stand!

Wait... you mentioned that they were drawing their power from an ancient ruin?

I think I might have an idea.

passages.title: Morgrum's Survey
passages.text:
Oi. Since yer hands are already dirty, what do ye say we make a deal?

To give it to ye straight, there's a relic here called the Breath of Xibala. I don't know who Xibala is or why the Alliance wants its breath, but there's a hefty sum of gold in it fer me if we deliver.

That means there's somethin' in it for you, too, if ye get my meanin'.

I started a survey with me equipment but haven't got me results yet. Go on out into the ruins an' give the boxes you see a little kick to hurry things along.

passages.title: Morgrum's Survey
passages.text: I'll be countin' me own gold if ye don't want to lend a hand.

passages.title: Morgrum's Survey
passages.text:
Don't ask questions ye don't want the answer to, <name>.

But ye did well, an' now I got what I need to track down the Breath.

passages.title: Perfect Tidings
passages.text:
Your timing is most convenient, <class>.

Our team had a check-in planned for this place, two days past. None have yet returned. 

I did not want to be brash and send word to the city too soon. However, I cannot leave this place empty, nor can I abandon young Koba. 

Take this scroll. See who, or what, you can find. Bring back those you can.

passages.title: Perfect Tidings
passages.text: Well met, neighbor! Batu must have faced such a conundrum when we did not return.

passages.title: A Special Stone
passages.text:
Tidemistress Nazesh is right up this hill, <name>. 

There is something there. Something Azshara wants very badly.

The naga must not succeed. If you can get a little piece of that stone, though, bring it back for us.

Take this scroll with you, it will help you in your fight.

It is time we push her forces, back into the waves for good.

passages.title: A Special Stone
passages.text: What have you found?

passages.title: A Special Stone
passages.text:
Well fought, adventurer. Well fought, indeed! 

Whatever this stone is those naga were after, they did not get it this day!

passages.title: Algae Shakes
passages.text:
Now that I have properly developed my tonic, it is of utmost importance that we dispense it amongst the ill at once.

Please, take this tankard and distribute the remedy to the sick. I will try to calm the rest.

passages.title: Algae Shakes
passages.text: In all my days, I have never seen such an illness. We must find the source!

passages.title: Invasion Onslaught
passages.text: We must not yield even a single world to the Legion. Continue our Invasion Point offensive and crush the Legion beneath your heel.

passages.title: Invasion Onslaught
passages.text: The offensive continues.

passages.title: Invasion Onslaught
passages.text: The Legion's defeat is at hand.

passages.title: The Bears and the Bees
passages.text:
Hey, while you're out, would you grab some honey for me and the boys?

Plenty of hives out in the woods, but I'd be careful if you don't want to dirty your delicate house cat hands. Bears out here tend to get pretty vicious when they smell honey.

passages.title: The Bears and the Bees
passages.text: Bears giving you trouble?

passages.title: The Bears and the Bees
passages.text: You got more on your shirt than you got in the bottles! I'd ask you to shower, but frankly none of us have done that in weeks.

passages.title: The Big Job
passages.text:
So the Irontide Raiders are bringing the various outlaw crews together for a big job using weapons provided by the Ashvane Company.

Something tells me they're not going fishing.

We should see if members of the smaller crews are carrying any notes or orders. I trust you can handle it?

I need to lay low and catch up with Venrik. If anyone else were to recognize me, the odds of them offering a friendly drink are precisely zero.

passages.title: The Big Job
passages.text: Find anything?

passages.title: The Big Job
passages.text:
I--I'll try to make sense of these.

You've gotta help Flynn!

passages.title: Missing Treasure!
passages.text:
Which one o' you scurvy dogs dug up me treasure?!

Was it you, Ned? I know you was in the Dead Man's Tale when I were talkin' about it!

Or maybe it was ol' Nance Barmy, huh? Yer the one what fed me all them drinks in the first place!

Oh and don't think I forgot about you, Nub Nub! I ain't trust a hozen as far as I can throw 'em... which I guess is PRETTY FAR, but-- 

<Several lines are scratched out here.>

Someone stole me damn treasure!

<Signed with an X.>

passages.title: The King's Gambit
passages.text:
Atal'Dazar is the tomb of kings. MY kings. My greatest followers.

I will taste Zul's flesh before this day is done.

Come, adventurer, keep up. Our prey has neither the strength nor the numbers to block this entrance. Let us crush this heretic.

passages.title: The King's Gambit
passages.text: He... he's gone...

passages.title: Blood Troll on the Outside
passages.text:
One of our scouts, Jo'chunga, has infiltrated de blood trolls, but we have not heard back from him.

I need your help to find Jo'chunga and see what he has discovered about de blood trolls.

If you are going to find him, you need to sneak in by looking like one of de blood troll women. Dey are de ones with de most freedom to move around. I have a ritual that can change you.

Help me set up de ritual to make you look like a blood troll.

passages.title: Blood Troll on the Outside
passages.text: Eh? What do you need?

passages.title: Blood Troll on the Outside
passages.text: De ritual is done, and you are ready.

passages.title: Inventory Deficit
passages.text:
My employees say we're under attack. They say our workers are falling to beasts and men made of wood.

I say we're losing precious inventory!

Do you know how many company-issued axes must be getting dropped out there? That's a waste of my hard-earned money!

I'm going to need you to get those back for me.

passages.title: Inventory Deficit
passages.text: I spend my own money to get these workers the supplies they need and they just go ahead and lose them! How much more generous must I be?

passages.title: Inventory Deficit
passages.text: Perhaps the cost of the axes should come out of their paychecks from now on!

passages.title: The Beauty of Marketing
passages.text:
While us Fizzbrackets may not be goblins, we still know a business opportunity when we see one! The resort staff is getting trained, the place is getting cleaned up, now all we need is some quality marketing!

<Wulferd holds up a familiar looking box.>

Behold! The wondrous Gnomish engineering feat that is the S.E.L.F.I.E. Camera! Now, if only there was a generous <race> willing to capture the radiance of this place.

Make sure you look like you're enjoying yourself out there!

passages.title: The Beauty of Marketing
passages.text: If your smile isn't at least half of the picture, I don't want to see it!

passages.title: The Beauty of Marketing
passages.text: These are perfect, you look dashing! Now I need to figure out how to get these out to our target customers.

passages.title: Down by the Riverside
passages.text:
We have de aid of Krag'wa and de Gob Squad. We must get back to Zul'jan and begin our plan to stop de blood trolls.

We have one problem. De Gob Squad are unable to move their mech fast enough in de jungle. We must take it by boat.

De two of us will ride with dem and ensure de blood trolls do not destroy de mech.

I will run ahead and get de boat ready near de riverbank. Meet us dere.

passages.title: Down by the Riverside
passages.text: We made it, <name>. Now comes de hard part. Are you ready?

passages.title: Digging Through the Past
passages.text:
Let's see, Jane Hudson probably still has her book on ancient runes and carvings. And I believe Tal'ana has a few scrolls he picked up from Ulduar.

OH! And Toopa found what appeared to be some type of codex the last time he ventured out. I remember seeing the runes on it and they bear a striking resemblance to the ones in this book.

If you could convince them to uh... lend us those items for a bit, I believe I just might be able to create a translation for you. I won't even charge you for it!

passages.title: Digging Through the Past
passages.text: How goes the translation?

passages.title: Digging Through the Past
passages.text:
Was she able to translate it?

<You hand the book over to Samuel and he begins to read it.>

This is incredible. This earthen was able to create jewels with light at special shrines he built. I mean, he mentions building several of them all over the world but...

<Samuel pulls out a few maps and begins scanning them.>

passages.title: The Shrine of the Eventide
passages.text:
There are two more shrines here on Kul Tiras.

I believe this next one resides within Drustvar, near the Bleak Hills Mine, southeast of Corlain.

Here are the notes on that shrine. Should it also need mending, I'm positive your skills with jewels can meet the challenge of repairing it.

passages.title: The Shrine of the Eventide
passages.text: <Inspecting the shrine, you realize that several of the gems embedded on its surface are cracked and need to be replaced.>

passages.title: The Shrine of Storms
passages.text:
Yes, I believe there are a few here in Kul Tiras. You should visit them, <name>, investigate them. See if what this book says is true.

This particular shrine he mentions sounds like it may reside near Brennadam, in Stormsong Valley.

It should be fairly easy to find. If my calculations are correct, it should be just north of that town.

Here are the notes on that one. And I've marked its location for you on your map. Good luck, <name>.

passages.title: The Shrine of Storms
passages.text:
<Upon your investigation you discover that the shrine has a couple locations where jewels appeared to have been located, but no longer exist.

Additionally, the center jewel appears to have several cracks in it as well.>

passages.title: REUSE ME
passages.text:
I've been to Zandalar before. Crazy place, full of dinosaurs and other unspeakable beasts. However one of the shrine's locations the journal speaks of sounds like a place they call Vol'dun.

It's a foreboding desert, full of canyons, with a great pyramid in the center.

If my calculations are correct though, the shrine ought to be around this area. I'll mark it for you on your map.

And let's hope it's still in one piece.

passages.title: REUSE ME
passages.text:
This next shrine might be a bit difficult to get to. It resides in Zandalar, the heart of the troll empire.

Well, maybe not the main city itself, but close to it. Actually...

<Samuel checks a map he has laid out.>

Ah, it's not too far from (POI). I've heard there's been some strife there between the Horde and Alliance. Perhaps there's a camp there you can work out of.

Here are you notes for the shrine and the location for it should be marked on your map.

passages.title: REUSE ME
passages.text:
The last shrine resides in Nazmir, a swamp infested with deadly creatures and home of the blood trolls.

Luckily an ally of mine gave me a rather detailed map of that region and if my calculations are correct...

<Samuel looks quickly back and forth between the journal and his map and finally stops his finger on the map.>

It should be right there. Take note of its location and here are the notes for that shrine. Good luck, <name>.

passages.title: Sun-Speckled Dunes
passages.text:
<Looking at your notes, the earthen mentions coming across dunes sprinkled with orange gems. He said it reminded him of the soft sunlight in this area.

Checking your notes, it appears that these dunes were located south of your current location.>

passages.title: Sun-Speckled Dunes
passages.text: <These gems have a very strong structure. Time, in addition to the winds, must have also taken its toll on them.>

passages.title: Sun-Speckled Dunes
passages.text:
<You carefully remove the old, weathered gems from the shrine and replace your polished gems in their place.

As you place the final gem, a similar pulse of energy radiates from the shrine as the light in the area seems to draw into it. A strange glow now emanating from the shrine leads you to believe it is once again active.>

passages.title: Digging Through the Past
passages.text:
Let's see, Examiner Alerinda has a book on ancient runes and carvings. I think Koatini has a few scrolls he brought with him from Ulduar.

OH! And Chronicler Shoopa found a codex de last time he ventured out. I remember seeing de runes on it and dey look a lot like de ones in dis book.

Maybe you can convince dem to lend us dose books for a bit, and I think I can create a translation for you.

passages.title: Digging Through the Past
passages.text: How is de translation going?

passages.title: Digging Through the Past
passages.text:
Was he able to translate it? 

<You hand the book over to Seshuli and she begins to read it.>

Dis is incredible. Dis earthen was able to create jewels with de light. And dose shrines he's built, I mean, he mentions building several of dem but...

<Seshuli pulls out a few maps and begins scaninng them.>

passages.title: The Shrine of the Sands
passages.text:
Dere are two more shrines here on Zandalar. Dis next one resides within Vol'dun, near Bonetrail Gulch.

Hopefully de Faithless haven't defiled de shrine.

Here are de notes on dat location. Should dat shrine also need fixing, I think your skills with jewels will probably be enough to fix it.

passages.title: The Shrine of the Sands
passages.text: <Surveying the shrine, you believe that the sandy winds in this area have worn down the embedded gems, producing odd shapes and cracks in some.>

passages.title: The Shrine of the Dawning
passages.text:
Yea, I believe there are a few here on Zandalar. You should find dem, <name>, investigate dem. See if what dis book says is true.

Dis particular shrine sounds like it might be in Nazmir. If my calculations are correct, it should be just south of Torga's Rest.

Dat loa was a mighty one. It is truly sad dat it is no longer with us.

Here are de notes on dat one. And I've marked its location for you on your map. Loa be with you, <name>.

passages.title: The Shrine of the Dawning
passages.text:
<Upon inspection of the shrine, you notice something... familiar.

The cut of the gems looks like a primitive or simple version of the way you've learned to cut rubellites.>

passages.title: REUSE ME
REUSE ME
REUSE ME
REUSE ME
For Kul Tiras!
passages.text:
Listen, I'll be frank with you; we're not at full strength here. Many of our soldiers recently left for Boralus on new orders.

It's like they knew just when to hit us...

But we're going to hit back! Every able-bodied man and woman in town has stepped up to mount a defense.

Take this battle standard and remind them what they're fighting for!

passages.title: For Kul Tiras!
passages.text: It fills my heart with pride to hear that battlecry ring out across the field.

passages.title: Hands Off My Booty!
passages.text:
We are dealing with lawless, no-account thugs. As soon as they gained ground, they started looting! Looting right in the middle of a battle!

Well I, for one, am not giving up our booty that easily.

Get up to the top of Vigil Hill and man the main cannon. Rain hellfire down on those blaggards!

Dismissed!

passages.title: Hands Off My Booty!
passages.text: What are you waiting for? Get up there and man that cannon!

passages.title: Hands Off My Booty!
passages.text:
They destroyed the main gun?!

Then it's time to advance on foot!

passages.title: Righteous Retribution
passages.text:
Cyrus taught me how to deal with thugs, bullies, and scum like pirates.

When they hit us, we hit back twice as hard.

<Taelia's hand finds the haft of her hammer and grips it tight.>

It's time to hit back.

passages.title: Righteous Retribution
passages.text: Those cowards only understand strength. Show them you're not an easy victim and they turn tail and run.

passages.title: Bombs, Away
passages.text:
By the sea's foamy beard, what a blast!

They've brought goblins, and if there's one thing I know about goblins it's that they like to blow things up.

I saw a few of them carrying large bombs, and I presume that they are going to blow up the town. I would like to keep the town, so how about you head out there and steal as many of those explosives as you can find? After that, let's blow up their demolishers and stop this infernal bombardment!

passages.title: Bombs, Away
passages.text: Don't forget to check inside the buildings too!

passages.title: Bombs, Away
passages.text: These look particularly nasty. I'm glad they aren't blowing up in our faces.

passages.title: Dousing the Flames
passages.text:
The Horde have set fire to my town, <class>. I will make them pay for this.

Stormsong Valley is the breadbasket of Kul Tiras, and our people need to be fed. The first thing we must do is damage control.

Grab some buckets and help put those fires out!

passages.title: Dousing the Flames
passages.text: Bombs, fire, Horde. Our town will endure it all.

passages.title: Heavy Artillery
passages.text:
Bad news, friend. They're bringing in serious firepower now.

We've spotted a tank on the northern hill by the windmill. They can reach the other side of the town from there. We can't let them set it up.

What do you say to giving them a taste of their own medicine? If you can take out their commander, you'd have a fancy new tank all to yourself. Imagine the mayhem you could unleash on their invasion!

passages.title: Heavy Artillery
passages.text: If that cannon can reach Brennadam, it can reach those zeppelins!

passages.title: Heavy Artillery
passages.text: Those were some explosions! I'm just glad they were directed at the Horde and not us.

passages.title: For the Alliance
passages.text:
The Army of the Light was founded with one purpose: to defeat the Legion. Though we have achieved that goal, a new duty lies before us.

Azeroth is a world beset by enemies. Use your training to battle the darkness and uphold the ideals of the Alliance.

Go to Stormwind. Seek the king's ambassador at the embassy, then set out to spread the Light's justice across the land.

Pheta thones gamera, <name>.

passages.title: For the Alliance
passages.text:
What have we here? One of the famed Lightforged draenei! Welcome, welcome.

Thank you for your service against the Legion, <name>. Truly an inspiration!

passages.title: For the Horde
passages.text:
A new age dawns upon Highmountain, <name>.

After centuries apart, the bond with our kin from Kalimdor has been reforged. And in the fight to save our land, we found new friends among the people of the Horde.

To show the strength we bring to our allies, brave tauren like you must heed the call of adventure.

You have been invited to Orgrimmar. Meet with the ambassador at the warchief's embassy, then begin your journey across Azeroth.

Earthmother be with you, <name>.

passages.title: For the Horde
passages.text:
Are you the new one? I'm supposed to welcome you. Here, take this letter.

<Blackguard lets out an exasperated sigh.>

passages.title: Catch Me if You Can
passages.text:
Alright, de time has come for you to face Zulajin yourself!

Jin'Tiki's fetish has de power of some ancient fire in it now. You will ride my raptor here to lure Zulajin into de tar pits.

After dat... you will use de fetish to light de tar pits on fire! Dat should be enough to kill Zulajin.

...and if not, well, den you will have to improvise. Good luck!

passages.title: Catch Me if You Can
passages.text: I knew you'd take care of Zulajin, no problem! I guess it is time for me to say goodbye to de jungle once and for all...

passages.title: Means to an End
passages.text:
In our haste to journey here I did not think to bring my ritual implements we tidesages use to augment our power.

To be honest, I had never expected them necessary on what should have been a peaceful sojourn.

Addington does not have his, either. I am sure the militia took him from his home before he had the chance to react.

That means his implements should still be in the yard somewhere. We must find them before my power is of much real use.

passages.title: Means to an End
passages.text: We must find a full set of ritual implements. I fear we will have need of them.

passages.title: Means to an End
passages.text: Those initiates were nowhere near ready to wield our sacred implements. They are far better served in our hands.

passages.title: Changing of the Guard
passages.text:
I have no doubt that you're a quite capable <class>, mainlander, but we will need some help if we want to make it to Waycrest Manor in one piece. A small group would be ideal; strong enough to face the coven's threats, but small enough to remain largely unnoticed.

<Reade produces a bundle of letters.>

I have written new orders to some of my finest soldiers to join your Order of Embers. They will report to you and the lady Waycrest. Please deliver these to them, so they can be prepared to move out.

passages.title: Changing of the Guard
passages.text: You will need to gather your recruits before we venture forth.

passages.title: Changing of the Guard
passages.text:
It is with reluctance that I hand command of these men over to you, but it must be done.

I hope you lead them well.

passages.title: Sharp Thinking
passages.text:
I have reason to believe that the coven has already infiltrated Arom's Stand. There are many unfamiliar faces here, with the refugees from Corlain, and we know they can use their magic to appear like one of us.

This needle is fashioned of solid silver. If the witches are indeed vulnerable to silver, then a prick from this may be enough to break their spell. 

The refugees may not be keen on being prodded, but they must understand that this is for the good of the town... and perhaps all of Drustvar.

passages.title: Sharp Thinking
passages.text: I really hope this works...

passages.title: Sharp Thinking
passages.text:
It worked?! I knew we were on the right track!

It's too bad we don't have a stockpile of silver weapons lying around, but I think I know how we can deal with that.

passages.title: Burning Crusade: To Outland!
passages.text:
The Burning Legion - an uncountably vast army of demons - has assaulted Outland, the tattered homeworld of the orcs. Adventurers of the Horde are needed to protect what remains of Outland from utter annihilation at the hands of this demonic invasion.

Travel to the Blasted Lands, and pass through the Dark Portal.

passages.title: To Northrend!
passages.text:
The Lich King stirs in the north.

An undead army follows his command, marching across Northrend and spreading blight wherever they tread.

We need you to stop them, <name>.

passages.title: Disaster at Mount Hyjal
passages.text:
Our brothers in the Cenarion Circle report that Deathwing's minions have launched a destructive offensive against the world tree and threaten to burn it to the ground!

You can speak with Cenarion Emissary Blackhoof to gain entry into Moonglade. He is in the tauren district in the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar.

passages.title: Disaster at Mount Hyjal
passages.text: We knew the Horde would send help and not a moment too soon!

passages.title: Burning Crusade: To Outland!
passages.text:
The Burning Legion - an uncountably vast army of demons - has assaulted Outland, the tattered homeworld of the draenei. Adventurers of the Alliance are needed to protect what remains of Outland from utter annihilation at the hands of this demonic invasion.

Travel to the Blasted Lands, and pass through the Dark Portal.

passages.title: Wrath of the Lich King: To Northrend!
passages.text:
The Lich King stirs in the north.

An undead army follows his command, marching across Northrend and spreading blight wherever they tread.

We need you to stop them, <name>.

passages.title: Sacrificial Writes
passages.text:
<As you peer inside the tome, you find a verse appear, glowing bright red.>

"For blood to bond, one strikes a deal,
A sacrifce which will appeal.
Seek out the lame, and never yield,
For in return, you shall be healed."

<As you finish reading the verse, you notice that a scroll has appeared in your hand.

Written across the top it's titled, "Writ of Sacrifice". Various runes, unknown to you, appear on the rest of the scroll. Yet, there's no explanation as to what to do with the scroll...>

passages.title: Sacrificial Writes
passages.text:
I see you've completed the trial.

<Kronah takes the writ from your hand and places it on the tome. It slowly begins to meld with the tome, and in a burst of light it vanishes.>

You have done well and are now imprinted for all time with the Contract of Sacrifce.

Now, onto more important matters. What do you think of murloc brain soup? I find it delightful and would love a guest to accompany me for a serving of it.

passages.title: Penning In Protection
passages.text:
<As you open the book, you turn each page and see portraits of champions standing alongside a large beast.

Eventually you come to a blank portrait, and touch the page. Runes begin to appear in an ancient language, and quickly translate into words you can read.>

"The creature within, a guardian of men,
A mixture of blood
and of bone inked with pen.
The blood from the scribe,
the bone from the land,
Milled to perfection,
and signed by the hand."

passages.title: Penning In Protection
passages.text:
You would think with all the blood you have to give up for these trials, that you would be white as a ghost at the end of them.

Or maybe just passed out for a week.

passages.title: Penning In Protection
passages.text:
You've been accepted, it appears.

<Veriss motions to the book. You glance over and see an image of yourself posed alongside a great beast. Your signature glistening at the top of the page.>

You may now invoke the Contract of the Bloodguard.

Be mindful of the guardian's life though. If it gets too low, it may look at you as potential fuel.

passages.title: A Test of Quills
passages.text:
The recipe you're after, young one, is that of the Sanguine Feather Quill of Lana'thel. I...

<Miju motions to a pile of stuff.>

Am the only other person I know of who has one... err... somewhere. But be warned, this trial may be your undoing!

I shall have to invoke all four contracts against you. You must defeat each of the creatures, and from each one learn the rune needed to carve into your quill.

Once you've learned all four runes, your trial shall be completed.

passages.title: A Test of Quills
passages.text:
Well done, young scribe. Well done, indeed!

You have the knowledge now. It's up in there.

<Miju tries to poke you in the head but you back away just in time.>

You're quick, probably how you succeeded in the trial. And now I present you with the final knowledge you need to craft your quill.

Ok, goodbye.

passages.title: For the Horde
passages.text:
After ages standing alone, we are once again poised to become part of something greater. Our alliance with the Horde affords us a fresh start, a unique chance that must not be squandered.

Go to Orgrimmar. From there, you will set out on a journey across Azeroth. Fight to defend this land, and claim a place for the shal'dorei within it.

Show the world who we are, <class>. Bring honor to the Horde, for in so doing, you will bring honor to Suramar.

passages.title: For the Horde
passages.text:
Are you the new one? I'm supposed to welcome you. Here, take this letter.

<Blackguard lets out an exasperated sigh.>

passages.title: Bone Procession
passages.text:
Undead entities influenced by corruption surround nearby structure. Impossible to approach. Plan required.

Calculating.

Plan achieved. Large creatures designated reanimated monstrosities focal gathering point of corruption.

Take titan weapon forged from plating recovered. Use it to weaken monstrosities and collect bones.

Will run process to destroy bones, prevent creation of further monstrosities.

passages.title: Bone Procession
passages.text: Insert reanimated monstrosity bones to continue.

passages.title: Bone Procession
passages.text: Destruction of bones will begin.

passages.title: Summons to Orgrimmar
passages.text:
The Warchief has requested that you return to Orgrimmar as soon as possible. There is an urgent matter that requires your attention.

I will fill you in on the details as soon as you arrive.

You will find me near the entrance of Grommash Hold. The Dark Lady has plans for you, <name>. I would not keep her waiting...

passages.title: Summons to Orgrimmar
passages.text: About time you arrived, <name>. The very future of the Horde may depend on what I am about to tell you...

passages.title: Containment Procedure
passages.text:
Scans indicate structure has become inoperable. No possibility for repair.

Titan Keeper Hezrel's database fully restored. Believe solution may be within data.

Require time to scan data, find solution to contain Old God corruption.

Stand by while Titan Keeper Hezrel scans databanks for solution.

passages.title: Containment Procedure
passages.text: Please stand by.

passages.title: Containment Procedure
passages.text: New protocol initiated. Defeat of blood trolls critical priority.

passages.title: Return to Gloom Hollow
passages.text:
Old God G'huun behind destruction of this seal. Commanding blood trolls to destroy final one within Zuldazar.

Titan Keeper Hezrel must aid in destruction of blood trolls. Cannot allow Zuldazar seal to be destroyed and G'huun to be freed.

Must leave interior of Atul'nazman. Meet Titan Keeper Hezrel outside of temple, will help return to Gloom Hollow.

When task is complete, Titan Keeper Herzrel must establish contact with other keeper within G'huun containment chamber.

passages.title: Return to Gloom Hollow
passages.text: We have everything we need to go after de blood trolls. We need to get moving.

passages.title: Archaeological Efficiency
passages.text:
Suppose I owe the lass her bones if I'm tae be monopolizin' yer time. And I will be.

Go on out into the ruins an' use this here stone to call one of my rumbly elemental friends. They'll blast away any dirt 'tween you an' the fossils.

We could go about this the ol' fashion way, but do you really want to spend all day digging? Course ye don't.

Acadia will see that a little efficiency gets everyone what they want.

passages.title: Archaeological Efficiency
passages.text:
<Acadia eyes Morgrum sourly.>

I don't think he cares one lick about our expedition, <name>.

passages.title: Archaeological Efficiency
passages.text:
<Acadia stares at the fragments, dismayed.>

I'll just... clean these up... See what we can salvage.

Thanks?

passages.title: For the Light!
passages.text:
The Lightforged Draenei will be happy to join the Alliance.

Our cause is now yours, <name>.

Let us return to Stormwind. Captain Fareeya will speak with our people.

passages.title: For the Light!
passages.text: The stories of the Lightforged echo throughout the streets of Stormwind. An army of elite soldiers dedicated to fighting the Legion... they will be one of our strongest allies.

passages.title: Boom goes the Bomb
passages.text:
Just look at 'em... those blood trolls are holed up pretty good down there in that fortress of theirs. Multiple defensive lines, lots of equipment, they got everything.

They're completely unprepared for us! I almost feel sorry for 'em!

Let's start off by showing 'em what we think of their cute attempts at making barricades. Here, take these smoke grenades and put a signal right on top of them. We'll see how well they hold up to high explosives!

passages.title: Boom goes the Bomb
passages.text: Good job! Now we can move deeper into dis den of evil.

passages.title: A Message of Blood and Fire
passages.text:
Look at what I be findin' here. Dis one had a magic wand in his hand.

<Rokhan shuts his eyes for a moment.>

Mmmmm... it be warm. Mojo of fire be within. Perfect!

Take dis ting an' give 'em a taste of their own firepower.

Burn da whole village down!

passages.title: A Message of Blood and Fire
passages.text: Good job, mon. Justice be served.

passages.title: Casting the First Stone
passages.text:
Hey dere <name>, gimme a hand with dis, would ya?

<Kumali motions you over to her.>

I got dis recipe dat I've been trying to remember de rest of, but I'm having de hardest time coming up with de right ingredients.

Ya see, my partner ran off with de other half of de recipe on account of a disagreement we had. But dis stone, it's a treasure like no other.

Grab some vials and start mixing dese ingredients together. Let's see if dey are de right ones.

passages.title: Casting the First Stone
passages.text: I will never ask for de other half of de recipe back from dat... dat... imbecile. I'll figure it out, ya see.

passages.title: Casting the First Stone
passages.text: Okay, <name>, let's see if dis works.

passages.title: Ocular Extracts
passages.text:
So dere's a creature in dese lands whose eyes are perfect for alchemical recipes.

Dey might just be de thing we need to finish dis project. Although, I don't remember seeing dem on de full recipe list de last time I saw it, ya see... But my memory isn't quite what it used to be.

Gah! I'm rambling too much. Get me some eyes, will ya, <name>?

passages.title: Ocular Extracts
passages.text: Make sure to gather de eyes after de creature is dead, otherwise dey make de most horrible sound when ya try to take dem out.

passages.title: Ocular Extracts
passages.text: Very good. Dese should be plenty!

passages.title: Changing the Scenery
passages.text:
Or maybe de problem is dat we don't need regular reagents. Maybe we need something dat only comes from being transmuted.

Anything's worth a shot at dis point. Here is a recipe my old partner left behind.

He used to go out to de Slough and change de shrubs into bubbles, ya see.

Why, you might ask? 'Cause he loved transmuting everything. Part of de reason we never saw eye to eye.

Anyways, bring me back some of dose bubbles and we'll see if we can use dem to make dis stone.

passages.title: Changing the Scenery
passages.text: I've seen him using dem in lots of his projects, so there has to be some alchemical qualities to dem.

passages.title: Changing the Scenery
passages.text: Dese bubbles seem...odd. But den again so is Zukashi.

passages.title: A Stone's Throw
passages.text:
Now dis ingredient you might have some fun getting, little mixah. I'm gonna give you dese stones. They're able to turn things into other things.

Dose blood trolls, de ones giving de rest of us a bad name? Dey drink de weirdest things and it taints their bodies.

I need their blood to finish my work here, but without de taint. Dese stones will turn dem into weaker creatures. Although, sometimes de stones turn dem into other things...

Be careful with dem.

passages.title: A Stone's Throw
passages.text: Ya never know what you'll get with transmuting things until ya try. Ain't dat right?

passages.title: A Stone's Throw
passages.text:
How'd ya like dem stones? Pretty fun, ya?

And dis is plenty of blood. Good job, little mixah.

passages.title: Casting the First Stone
passages.text:
Would you mind helping me out with something, <name>?

<Elric motions you over to him.>

You see, I have this recipe that, well, I only have half of currently. I've been trying to remember the other half but just can't seem to recall it.

My EX-partner tore the recipe and ran off with the other half over a disagreement we were having. But the stone it makes is invaluable.

How about you grab some vials and start mixing the ingredients on this list. Perhaps together we can figure this out.

passages.title: Casting the First Stone
passages.text: I wouldn't dare ask for the other half back, not after what Quintin said to me. I'll get this mystery figured out, you'll see.

passages.title: Casting the First Stone
passages.text: Let's give it a try, shall we?

passages.title: A Recipe For the Ages
passages.text:
Yo, <name>, over here! You've look like you've been hammering away for a while. I can smell the flux on ya!

<Grix gives you a wide grin.>

Listen, I've got a recipe for the most amazing blacksmith hammer you've ever laid your eyes on. And I'd be willing to let it go for a bit of ore.

Revlis ore to be exact. It's a little rare, but you can find plenty of it over in Gol Koval in Drustvar. The elementals there are practically made of it.

Bring me back a haul of it, and the recipe's yours!

passages.title: A Recipe For the Ages
passages.text: This recipe is probably worth a thousand, no TEN thousand gold! Blacksmiths all over will be envious of you, you'll see.

passages.title: A Recipe For the Ages
passages.text:
Yea, yea! That's the stuff!

Here's your recipe, have fun with it.

passages.title: Changing the Scenery
passages.text:
The stone this recipe becomes is a transmutation stone. What if the missing reagents to make it come from something that's gone through the transmutation process?

I'm willing to try anything at this point. Here's an old recipe my ex-partner devised.

He used to go out to Stormsong Valley, just south of the Highland Flats and change the shrubs there into bubbles.

Bring back some of those bubbles and we'll see if they're what we've been missing.

passages.title: Changing the Scenery
passages.text: I've seen him use those globes in some of his projects in the past, so there is clearly some alchemical properties to them.

passages.title: Changing the Scenery
passages.text: These bubbles seem...odd. But then again so is Quintin.

passages.title: A Stone's Throw
passages.text:
You may enjoy getting this next reagent for me. I have some special stones that have transmutative qualities, especially on living things. It's not too unlike the one you're trying to make.

The witches that plague these lands are imbued with magic. As is their blood.

I need their blood to finish my latest project, but in an altered form. These stones should turn them into weaker creatures. Although, sometimes the opposite occurs...

I'd recommend handling them with care.

passages.title: A Stone's Throw
passages.text: You never truly know what a transmutation will yield until you try it. Wouldn't you agree, apprentice?

passages.title: A Stone's Throw
passages.text:
How did you find the stones? Fun, aren't they?

Oh, and this is plenty of blood. Well done.

passages.title: A Weather Eye
passages.text:
It would be wise to get a lay of the land before we put together a plan of action. 

Inquisitor Notley is an expert falconer, and a reliable scout. He utilizes an ancient relic to see through the eyes of his falcon, allowing him to survey great distances. 

Unfortunately, Notley was injured during the fighting. Nothing serious, but it's left him unable to concentrate enough to control his falcon.

Perhaps you could help?

passages.title: A Weather Eye
passages.text: What news do you bring?

passages.title: A Weather Eye
passages.text:
It is good to know that there are still some left to save in Corlain. 

We should focus our attention on them until we can devise a plan to bypass that barrier.

I'll make sure to get this whistle back to Notley. Thank you, <class>.

passages.title: Setting the Mood
passages.text:
De voodoo love incense and romantic meal are ready, <name>. Take dem and place dem at de feet of Maka'fon. 

Quickly, if you could. Dat smell is... overwhelmingly, horribly, disgusting. 

Could you move any faster? 

Away. 

From us.

For de sake of de brutosaurs, of course.

passages.title: Setting the Mood
passages.text: Best get dese stinking things over to Maka'fon soon, <name>. I guarantee it will get her in de mood.

passages.title: Setting the Mood
passages.text:
I am an expert on love and all of my previous mates can attest to dat. I have misread de reason for Maka'fon's mood. 

De razorwings ate her last clutch of eggs and she will make no more until she feels safe and avenged.

passages.title: They Say It's a Delicacy
passages.text:
A romantic meal is de way to set up an evening for love. Dis is true for us, so why not for Maka'fon? Bring her something rare and pleasing to her palate. 

Diemetrodons near de water eat hard seed pods and partially digest them. With a little voodoo, something magical can happen to de pods. It may be disgusting to you and I, but de brutosaurs consider it a rare delicacy. Such is life. 

Dere are plenty of diemetradons, so some must die dat de brutosaurs might live. Such is de purpose of death.

passages.title: They Say It's a Delicacy
passages.text: De pods we need become edible only in de belly of de diemetradons. Watch your fingers in dere... de scales are sharp.

passages.title: They Say It's a Delicacy
passages.text: De pods may be unpleasant to us, but de brutosaurs like dem just fine.

passages.title: All Wrapped Up
passages.text:
While I was able to get out of the mine, some of my friends weren't so lucky. I saw those spiders wrap them up in their webs... probably to save them for a snack.

It was terrible, but all I could do was run.

Will you help them?

passages.title: All Wrapped Up
passages.text:
You saved them!

You're certainly a hero in my book!

passages.title: Mating Season Halftime
passages.text:
Cala and I have both failed. Voodoo and science did not work. I am at a loss.

I hope dat you can help us find a better path forward. De brutosaurs deserve a chance! 

Please spend a little time with both of us. Perhaps you can find de way dat we cannot.

passages.title: Mating Season Halftime
passages.text: Please strategize with both Cala and myself to find a new plan to help de brutosaurs.

passages.title: Mating Season Halftime
passages.text: Thank you, <name>, for your help. Dis is de best of both worlds and de brutosaurs may benefit from it.

passages.title: An Improvised Arsenal
passages.text:
I don't know much about blacksmithing, but I'm pretty sure this won't be enough silver to outfit all of the Inquisitors. We will need to find another way to use this.

Let us hope that Ballaster can come up with something... creative.

passages.title: An Improvised Arsenal
passages.text: What can ol' Angus do fer ye?

passages.title: An Improvised Arsenal
passages.text:
Ah, she's a beaut'! Back in the navy we used te stuff our muskets with scraps when we ran outta bullets. 

This'll do the damage ye need, te be sure!

passages.title: Give it a Little Juice
passages.text:
Well, I admit that I feel a little better about this. If Witch Doctor Jangalar's voodoo can make Ben'jin react correctly, as the science says he should, then what do we have to lose? 

Bless my formula or hex it or whatever they call it with Jangalar's voodoo cauldron.

passages.title: Give it a Little Juice
passages.text: Will voodoo make it smell funny? Nevermind, idle musings.

passages.title: Give it a Little Juice
passages.text:
The consistency is the same... does it seem a little carbonated to you now? 

Can't wait to see if this works better than the original formula which, I feel like I need to say, SHOULD have worked fine.

passages.title: An Ear to the Ground
passages.text:
The next reagent ya need comes from the bellies of worms that burrow through this realm.

While ya can find plenty o' worms all over, there's a certain type you'll need ta find. They're rarely seen above ground, but there are ways of coaxing 'em out.

Namely making enough racket to piss 'em off! Ha ha! When ya see 'em rumblin' around beneath ya, use this thumper to draw 'em out.

Deliver a killin' blow and get that metal from their wee bellies!

passages.title: An Ear to the Ground
passages.text:
It's been a while since I went worm huntin'.

We used ta jump up and down ta rile them up before we made tha thumpers.

passages.title: An Ear to the Ground
passages.text:
Now ya can't say ya didn't have fun throwin' those thumpers around, am I right?! Ha ha!

Good haul you brought in, too. Should be plenty ta work with.

passages.title: A Recipe For the Ages
passages.text:
Say, ya look like you been swingin' da hammah around quite a bit, <brudda/sista>. I can smell da flux on ya!

<Zak'aal gives you a wide grin.>

Listen, I've got a recipe for da most amazin' blacksmit hammah ya ever be layin' ya eyes on. And I'd be willing ta let it go for a bit of ore.

Revlis ore ta be exact. It be a little rare, but ya can find some of it over at Atal'Gral. Da naga dere use it ta make deir weapons.

Bring me back a haul of it, and da recipe be yours!

passages.title: A Recipe For the Ages
passages.text: Dis recipe probably be wort a tousand, no TEN tousand gold! Blacksmits all over will be envious of ya, brudda.

passages.title: A Recipe For the Ages
passages.text:
Yea, yea! Dat's da stuff!

Here be da recipe, have fun wit it.

passages.title: The Head of Her Enemy
passages.text:
You have done a wonderful thing, <name>. With de destruction of Gloomtail, Maka'fon is no longer bothered by de presence of de razorwings. It seems dat Gloomtail destroyed her eggs some time ago. 

Take Gloomtail's head to Maka'fon as proof dat he is gone. When she finds de scent of Ben'jin on it, she will once again seek a worthy mate. 

When Ben'jin senses dat, he will approach and nature will take over.

passages.title: The Head of Her Enemy
passages.text: Take Gloomtail's head and offer it to Maka'fon. Let us see what happens next.

passages.title: The Head of Her Enemy
passages.text: Dis is a wonderful moment and I feel hopeful dat dis species of brutosaur will survive and thrive here in de jungle.

passages.title: Disturbance Detected: Ulduar
passages.text:
You're late. Don't you remember the last time we had to deal with the tampering that allowed Yogg-Saron to escape from his prison underneath Ulduar? You were late then too. You should really try to be more punctual.

Well, get going! Old gods! Keepers! Titan stuff! Get this one checked off your list so we can move on. We've got times and places to be.

<Vormu gestures impatiently for you to leave.>

passages.title: Disturbance Detected: Ulduar
passages.text: Exactly the same number of dwarves must be roasted as last time. Medium rare, of course - well done would be insanity.

passages.title: Disturbance Detected: Ulduar
passages.text: Well this is worrisome. The Titan locks holding Yogg-Saron in place seem to have been artificially aged - these should have held for at least another forty millennia. The only ones with such power are dead.. aren't they? Or perhaps... no, that doesn't make any sense at all.

passages.title: Matrons of the Crimsonwood
passages.text:
The witches in charge, the matrons...

<Ashton shudders for a moment then composes himself.>

The matrons are the ones leading the Grand Rite. They are fearsome but not invulnerable. Removing some of them from the equation will bolster our chances of stopping this. 

Take this potion. It will be able to weaken the matrons so you might have a better chance of dispatching them.

passages.title: Matrons of the Crimsonwood
passages.text: Did you kill them?

passages.title: Matrons of the Crimsonwood
passages.text:
The potion worked even better than anticipated! It is heartening to know my time spent in the witches'... care has yielded positive results.

Losing some of their leadership will certainly set them back.

passages.title: Big Hunter Mon
passages.text:
In these valleys, the Mon be kepin' beasts alive only to serve as sport. For his entertainment.

The lives of others not be so cheap. Even the smallest creature can cause a whole lotta trouble. The Mon gonna be learnin' to respect that.

I think this be a good time to teach this Big Hunter Mon a lesson, don't you? Be you my faithful messenger?

passages.title: Big Hunter Mon
passages.text: You taken my present to that big hunter mon yet, richmon?

passages.title: Big Hunter Mon
passages.text: Haha! Well done, richmon. It gonna take that Big Hunter Mon weeks to get de smell outta his ammo stores. Not to mention his feet. You have earned my favor.

passages.title: Grant Me Revenge
passages.text:
I don't care who you pledge allegiance to, <race>. I need Hogger dead!

He--and the other cretins in this Light-forsaken place--have slain my men. The Alliance and the Horde may not see eyes-to-eye, but you must know that murdering my people in cold blood cannot stand.

passages.title: Grant Me Revenge
passages.text: Is it done? Is Hogger dead?

passages.title: Grant Me Revenge
passages.text:
The uprising quelled, the elements calmed, and Hogger slain... I cannot thank you enough, <name>. My people have been avenged.

Thank you.

passages.title: Miner Operation
passages.text:
The mine is in real trouble. We've been excavating for a short while, but never seen anything like this. Azerite doesn't just get up and walk around.

If we are going to take the mine back, we're going to need more help. We'll need an engineer and an explosives expert. I have two in mind, sisters actually, but they are caught behind the river in all the chaos.

Locate the sisters and they'll help you with the next phase of the plan.

passages.title: Miner Operation
passages.text: Good. We're all here.

passages.title: Summons to Stormwind
passages.text:
King Wrynn has requested that you return to Stormwind as soon as possible. There is an urgent matter that requires your attention.

I will fill you in on the details as soon as you arrive.

You will find me at Lion's Rest. Be swift... our window of opportunity may already be closing!

passages.title: Summons to Stormwind
passages.text: At last you have arrived, <name>. The very future of the Alliance may depend on what I am about to tell you...

passages.title: The Great Hat Robbery
passages.text:
Along this road the merchants ride. Taking dere wares from one place to another and lining them own pockets. 

One Big Mon named Tik'su be the worst of all. He charge arms and legs outright and it even take trolls some time to regrow them parts.

His biggest pride? His hat. 

Go be my messenger, Rich-mon. Scare his burdened beast and knock off Tik'su. Then bring me his hat.

passages.title: The Great Hat Robbery
passages.text: You had a chat with Tik'su about his hat yet, richmon?

passages.title: The Great Hat Robbery
passages.text: Haha! Well done, richmon. You bruised Tik'su's pride and his backside. He gonna be hurtin' for a while. You have earned my favor.

passages.title: Your Problem Now
passages.text:
Hm. This egg does not belong to one of my brood, and I have no broodlings that need another sibling.

<Pa'ku might be smiling or snarling. She is showing an awful lot of teeth.>

You will care for this little one. And you had better hurry.

It will hatch very soon.

Oh, and a little advice. If you want the little one to like you, you had better be the first thing it sees upon hatching.

passages.title: Your Problem Now
passages.text:
<The tiny Pterrordax stares adoringly at you.>

Skreeeee.

passages.title: Taking the Loa Road
passages.text:
This road not be traveled much anymore. Except by those that serve the blood Loa. They be fools.

I be wantin' my fun from those fools. Go to the spot I be markin' for you and plant this cursed coin. The silly blood trolls be seein' it and give us a laugh when they try to pick it up.

Just be makin' sure that no other creature see you. Or else it be a quick trip back to the arms of Jani.

passages.title: Taking the Loa Road
passages.text: You taken that cursed coin to the pranking-place yet, richmon?

passages.title: Taking the Loa Road
passages.text: Haha! Well done, richmon. It gonna take those idiots forever to be gettin' outta this mess. You have earned my favor.

passages.title: Witchrending
passages.text:
A blunderbuss? I'd have to say, I wasn't quite expecting that.

Nonetheless, now that we have a weapon, we have an advantage. I think it's time we take the fight directly to the coven.

Marshal Reade informed me that several of their Matrons have been spotted throughout Corlain. Let's show them what happens to an enemy of House Waycrest.

passages.title: Witchrending
passages.text:
Let us hope this sends a message to the coven.  As long as we have weapons to fight them, we will persevere.

Speaking of weapons, I believe our blacksmith has an idea on how to take down that barrier. You should have a word with him.

passages.title: Remembering the Fallen
passages.text:
<This villager died clutching a brooch with what looks like a family crest. It looks like several villagers didn't survive the coven's occupation of Corlain.

It might be possible to identify the fallen by the keepsakes they carried. The survivors would likely be grateful to learn the fate of their loved ones.>

passages.title: Remembering the Fallen
passages.text: What's this?

passages.title: Remembering the Fallen
passages.text:
I don't know what to say. That you would risk your life to bring these items to me speaks greatly of your character, mainlander.

I will make sure these keepsakes make it to the friends and families of the fallen, as well as news of their fate. On their behalf, I thank you for your compassion.

passages.title: Reeking Refuge
passages.text:
Oh good, maybe you can make sense of this.

I was just carving through a swath of the coven's lackeys when I stumbled across this field. Something here has knocked these guys completely out of commission!

I can't seem to find the source, but maybe you'll have better luck. I'm more used to hitting things than investigating them.

passages.title: Reeking Refuge
passages.text: You don't look like you're in league with the coven, so what are you doin' in Corlain?

passages.title: Potent Protection
passages.text:
Here ya go, I got them onions bundled up nicely for ya.

Give my regards to Miss Waycrest, will ya? Her allies are welcome on my farm anytime.

passages.title: Potent Protection
passages.text:
The coven is vulnerable to onions!?  I remember my nan used to tell stories about them warding off evil, but I never thought to take it literally!

This is quite the discovery!

passages.title: Barrier Buster
passages.text:
Oy, <name>! I think I might have a solution te that pesky barrier keepin ye out of Corlain proper! 

I took the silver we had left 'ere an' doctored up one o' these cannonballs. The walls surroundin' Corlain are festooned with defensive cannons. Get one pointed at the gate, ye can send this beauty right into the barrier!

Ye'll need a hefty pinch of powder te get this thing movin', though - it's a bit on the heavy side. Ye can likely find some in the camp outside the walls.

passages.title: Barrier Buster
passages.text: I don't think these guys will be needin' this cannon anymore.

passages.title: Barrier Buster
passages.text:
Quite a bit of powder ya got there.

Careful ya don't take the whole wall down.

passages.title: Hexed Hatchlings
passages.text:
I've found where those evil witches have been tainting our falcons! You see those charms? 

<Notley motions toward the high perches and roofs nearby.>

They're using those to infect our flock with their evil magic as they hatch. I think Winston can get up there to take out the charms, but someone will need to direct him.

I'm not quite healed up enough to take on a whole camp of falconers. Can you help?

passages.title: Hexed Hatchlings
passages.text: Have you taken care of the charms?

passages.title: Hexed Hatchlings
passages.text:
The charms are broken? That's a relief!

We may just be able to save our flock after all.

passages.title: Break On Through
passages.text:
Cannon's ready, boss.

Care to do the honors?

passages.title: Break On Through
passages.text:
Ballaster's plan worked! He is certainly a resourceful blacksmith.

Come, Inquisitor. Waycrest Manor is just ahead!

passages.title: He's Gone Mad!
passages.text:
Ol' Wildtusk has withstood years of attacks by young hunters that are overeager and underskilled.

None could take him.

His wounds have finally done him in. He just won't go down. Find that crazy riverbeast bull, and help him let go of his mortal shell.

passages.title: He's Gone Mad!
passages.text:
Thank you for helping him on his way.

Dat Wildtusk, he has been watching dese hills for years long past. Some beast will have big shoes to fill!

passages.title: Stick It To 'Em!
passages.text:
We have been able to stop the Grand Rite but the witches will try again unless we act.

We have to destroy them. Utterly.

<Cleardawn smiles.>

How kind of them to give us the means.

You've helped us get this far, <name>. You control the Demolisher. Destroy everything you see! 

Once we've finished we can signal for help out of here!

passages.title: Stick It To 'Em!
passages.text:
The plans for the Grand Rite are ruined and their rutial sites are in shambles. Master Ashton will be safe here in Arom's stand and we can finally send reinforcements to Falconhurst by gryphon.

In all, a job well done! Thank you for your vital help.

passages.title: The Fall of Emperor Korthek
passages.text:
Korthek finally approaches.

It's been many years since I've faced him in battle. When he first rose to power, I failed my people. I will not falter again.

I am prepared to do what must be done. What I should have done long ago.

We must kill Korthek and take his key to prevent him, Jakra'zet, or anyone else from ever resurrecting Mythrax.

When you are prepared, we will face him together.

passages.title: The Fall of Emperor Korthek
passages.text: Do not waste time mourning my old friend now. His foolish crusade has left us a larger problem that demands our full, immediate attention.

passages.title: Champions of Azeroth
passages.text: Assist Magni by completing 4 Azerite world quests.

passages.title: Champions of Azeroth
passages.text: Return to me when you have finished aiding Azeroth, <name>.

passages.title: Champions of Azeroth
passages.text: Azeroth and myself thank you.

passages.title: Message from the Management
passages.text:
<This letter from Priscilla Ashvane to her employees appears to be posted all over the foundry.

It sounds like Cagney's information was accurate, Ashvane is working their people around the clock.

Priscilla mentions a Forgemaster Farthing and a Taskmaster Williams. They may have more information about her plans.>

passages.title: Message from the Management
passages.text: Find anything useful in there?

passages.title: Message from the Management
passages.text:
Most folks workin' for the Ashvane Trading Company don't know how rotten they are, or don't have any other choice.

The sooner we take down Priscilla the better.

passages.title: Proudmoore Admiralty
passages.text: Assist the Proudmoore Admiralty by completing 4 world quests.

passages.title: Proudmoore Admiralty
passages.text: Return to me when you have finished aiding the Proudmoore Admiralty, <name>.

passages.title: Proudmoore Admiralty
passages.text: Good work!

passages.title: Storm's Wake
passages.text: Assist Storm's Wake by completing 4 world quests.

passages.title: Storm's Wake
passages.text: Return to me when you have finished aiding Storm's Wake, <name>.

passages.title: Storm's Wake
passages.text: The tides spoke of your triumphs. Thank you.

passages.title: Talanji's Expedition
passages.text: Assist Talanji's Expedition by completing 4 world quests.

passages.title: Talanji's Expedition
passages.text: Return ta me when you have finished aiding Talanji's Expedition, <name>.

passages.title: Talanji's Expedition
passages.text: I thank you in da name of da princess.

passages.title: Alliance War Effort
passages.text: Assist the Alliance by completing 4 world quests on Zandalar or occupied warfront zones.

passages.title: Alliance War Effort
passages.text: Return to me when you have finished aiding the Alliance, <name>.

passages.title: Alliance War Effort
passages.text: For the Alliance!

passages.title: Horde War Effort
passages.text: Assist the Horde by completing 4 world quests on Kul Tiras or occupied warfront zones.

passages.title: Horde War Effort
passages.text: Return to me when you have finished aiding the Horde, <name>.

passages.title: Horde War Effort
passages.text: For the Horde!

passages.title: Battlefield Scavenging
passages.text:
The battle rages on, but our inventory suffers.

Scavenge the camps for supplies. I'll make use of what you find.

passages.title: A Question of Quillpower
passages.text:
I can't believe you managed to kill that thing. You're quite impressive, you know that?

Either way, we should be getting back to Roz with our report. We're stuck in the middle of the kraul, surrounded by angry quilboar. But I have a plan!

Some of the boars seem reasonable enough. I gave them a bit of my rations and they've been following me around. I bet we can use them to hitch a ride out of this place. You in?

passages.title: A Question of Quillpower
passages.text: Calvin has briefed me, but I am eager to hear your report.

passages.title: Any Ammo Will Do
passages.text:
I'll have some men move some cannons down to the sea wall in preparation of whatever ritual is going on down in that delta.

We could use some extra ammo before we spread ourselves too thin though. Luckily, those naga harpoons work well enough with our mortars. Take down those lances and bring back any harpoons that you find.

passages.title: Any Ammo Will Do
passages.text: We can use the naga's weapons against them!

passages.title: Any Ammo Will Do
passages.text: Great work! Let's hope these harpoons can fire from our cannons.

passages.title: Defeat Jakra'zet
passages.text:
Jakra'zet is summoning Mythrax the Unraveler!

We cannot allow the ritual to continue. Jakra'zet must be stopped before it's too late!

Lead the way, <name>. We'll be right behind you.

Let's go!

passages.title: Defeat Jakra'zet
passages.text: It's a miracle we survived...

passages.title: Relics of Sethraliss
passages.text:
It may surprise you to learn that the Faithless hoard ancient relics of Sethraliss. I assure you that they do not do so out of reverence or respect, as is proper.

Korthek's brood is driven only by greed and an insatiable lust for power. They rip whatever magic they can from the relics, even if it means destroying them in the process.

Rescue the ancient artifacts of Sethraliss in the Sacred Sands nearby. We will honor and preserve them in the Sanctuary of the Devoted.

passages.title: Relics of Sethraliss
passages.text: Do you have the artifacts?

passages.title: Relics of Sethraliss
passages.text:
Incredible! I remember when some of these were first found...

You've done all followers of Sethraliss a kindness this day, <name>.

passages.title: To Have Loved and Lost
passages.text:
I have a favor to ask you of a... personal nature.

Whitegrove Chapel lies to the north, just past the town of Corlain. Someone... important to me rests in the graveyard on its grounds.

I've been unable to visit his grave for some time, and I would like to pay my respects. If you come upon Whitegrove Chapel, could you lay these flowers next to his headstone?

Just look for the most recent grave there...

passages.title: To Have Loved and Lost
passages.text:
Lucy sent you? I am relieved to hear she yet lives. 

My name is Alexander Treadward. I am... well, I was Lucy's fiance.

passages.title: Painful Memories
passages.text:
A terrible thing happened in this place, and it has doomed me to an eternity of walking these grounds.

All I remember is that Lucille and I were to be wed, but instead I met my end.

If you have an ounce of sympathy in your heart, then I beg you to help me. Find out what happened that night, so I might leave here.

I know my strongest memories are tied to the ring I bore for Lucy that day. Find it among my bones, and maybe it will lead you to the answer.

passages.title: Painful Memories
passages.text:
Welcome, kind sir!

The ceremony should begin as soon as the good Lord Waycrest arrives.

passages.title: Hot Pursuit
passages.text: Priscilla's escaping on horseback! Grab one of our chargers and chase her down!

passages.title: Hot Pursuit
passages.text:
I don't know how anyone could survive a fall like that.

Still, we should be careful not to let our guard down.

passages.title: Ptrust Fall
passages.text:
I just want you to know how unusual this is for Pa'ku. She prefers to teach on the fly.

What? It's true.

This method might work. Sometimes when young pterrordax are not eager to fly, their mother will drag them from the nest and hold them in her claws until they are comfortable enough to spread their wings.

Seeing as this little one has no mother, you will use the kite to act as one.

Pa'ku has placed a trail for you to follow.

Go and glide carefully- you may frighten your pterrordax more!

passages.title: Ptrust Fall
passages.text:
<Pa'ku eyes your hatchling sourly.>

Are you sure we can't just throw him next time?

passages.title: Saurid Surprise
passages.text:
Da sands of Vol'dun be full of harsh creatures, but none so harsh as dey dat da Zandalari send.

One of dese criminals be right here in da Scorched Sands. His name be Sezahjin, and he be da former chef ta da king. Did he tell ya dat he be famous for a dish called "Saurid Surprise?" Guess what da main ingredient be.

He be fallin' far, but not far enough for Jani. It be time ta take his pride.

Just be makin' sure dat da creatures of da sand not be seein' ya.

passages.title: Saurid Surprise
passages.text: Ya taken dat accursed chef's hat yet, richmon?

passages.title: Saurid Surprise
passages.text: Haha! Well done, richmon. No doubt he gonna find another hat eventually, but you took da one he be wearin' when he cook up his Saurid Surprise. Ya have earned me favor.

passages.title: The Heart's Power
passages.text:
The world's soul grows stronger, <name>, but there's still trouble out there. Azerite surges from her wounds, and all sides fight tae claim its might.

Ye have proven yerself tae be Azeroth's champion. And thanks tae all ye have done, I sense a great power stirrin' in that amulet ye wear.

Azeroth calls tae us. She wants me tae help ye unlock even greater strength in her Heart. Are ye ready?

passages.title: The Heart's Power
passages.text: Hold still, champion, while I empower the Heart of Azeroth.

passages.title: The Heart's Power
passages.text:
Can ye feel it, <name>? The Heart of Azeroth grows stronger!

I believe we can unlock even more o' that amulet's potential.

You keep on absorbin' all the Azerite ye find, and I'll search for some way tae bring this madness tae an end.

passages.title: An Ancient Curse
passages.text:
<The harsh conditions of Nazmir have not been kind to the stone tablet.

Most of the inscriptions have been worn away but you are able to make out a picture that shows a chest surrounded by glyphs. Above the chest you noticed what appears to be a large floating skull.

Below the images you find a single word "Aiji".

The ruins ahead seem foreboding, and you may want to bring some friends to help you.
With their help, perhaps you can find the secret of this "Aiji" and its treasure within.>

passages.title: Out With the Old Boss
passages.text:
Right so I talked to some people. You talked to some people. No one likes the Irontide. They're cutting in to profits and scaring off good, honest scoundrel- er customers! 

We take out the guy in charge and we'll be able to run the rest outta town! So a little change of management is in order.

I'm not usually one for stabbin' people, I'm a lover not a fighter, but I can pay. You do this for me and I'll make sure you're welcome here whenever ya want? Sound good?

passages.title: Out With the Old Boss
passages.text:
Great! I'm the Boss of the Cove now and what I say goes.

Since you've been a pal, I'll let you stop in whenever you like. Remember to bring gold.

passages.title: Work Order: Riverbud
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, herbalist. We needed this riverbud badly.
