passages.title: Work Order: Tidespray Linen
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, tailor. We needed this tidespray linen badly.

passages.title: Work Order: Deep Sea Satin
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, tailor. We needed this deep sea satin badly.

passages.title: Seeking More Knowledge
passages.text:
It pains me to admit that I don't know everything about plants. I've taught you everything I know about Anchor Weed, but I think I know where you could look to learn more. Unfortunately, it's in Waycrest Manor, and that whole area's been crawling with monsters as of late.

If you find yourself inside that manor, keep an eye out for a book called, "The Treatise on Anchor Weed". Its author spent decades studying that forsaken weed.

passages.title: Seeking More Knowledge
passages.text: Have you retrieved the book?

passages.title: Seeking More Knowledge
passages.text:
Outstanding! And it's in such good condition, too! Now let's see if there's anything in here that could be of help for you.

<Several moments pass as Declan mutters to himself excitedly>

Ah ha! Here ya go! The seed pods open when the plant is disturbed, but if the first cut is at the base, that drains a reservoir of water that is used to open and close the pods.  So, start at the bottom, working your way up, and you should get a better harvest.

passages.title: Supplies Needed: Deep Sea Satin
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, <class>. We needed this deep sea satin badly.

passages.title: Raiding Their Stores
passages.text:
We're low on food supplies.

Hit up Newstead and bring us whatever you can find.

passages.title: WANTED: Ten'gor and Nol'ixwan
passages.text:
To any hunters worthy of the challenge: 

Find and defeat the dueling giant direhorn and devilsaur, named Nol'ixwan and Ten'gor. 

Their never-ending battle has disrupted travel throughout Zuldazar. 

Glory for any that succeed!

passages.title: WANTED: Ten'gor and Nol'ixwan
passages.text: Do you think you are de greatest hunter in all of Zandalar?

passages.title: WANTED: Ten'gor and Nol'ixwan
passages.text: Those two have been fighting for supremacy as long as can be remembered. They will not be bothering de jungles of Zandalar anymore.

passages.title: Be A Dear
passages.text:
As you can plainly see by the rocks falling from the sky, we are under siege by those terrible ettins!

If you could be obliged to lend us a hand, I'd be most grateful. We can't possibly hope to defeat them unless we properly prepare you first.

Could you be a dear and fetch a few things for me from around the Hamlet? Some water, a sack of flour, and a bundle of logs should help.

I've already sent my grandson, Charles, off to fetch a few other items. I've not seen him for quite a while though.

passages.title: Be A Dear
passages.text: Did you have any trouble dear?

passages.title: Be A Dear
passages.text: Thank you so much. I wish Charles was half as studious as you.

passages.title: Deep Sea Venture
passages.text:
As mighty as Ai'twen is, this Venture Company is still a threat to him. I need you to watch over Ai'twen and Toki as you continue your great adventure. 

Eliminate the Venture Company Seawrenches that lurk the waters you travel to.

passages.title: Deep Sea Venture
passages.text: Hurry to it, Ai'twen's saftey is important.

passages.title: Deep Sea Venture
passages.text: You've struck a mighty blow against these Venture Company thugs, and kept Ai'twen safe.

passages.title: Response Required
passages.text:
Time is short and more creatures will die without your help. The Venture Company prepares a huge digging machine to tear the reef apart and destroy this cave. They've assigned a special operative to be sure the job is done right.

You must act now, adventurer. Take out the operative in charge of the camp; this should buy us some time.

passages.title: Response Required
passages.text: You've bought us valuable time with your heroic actions.

passages.title: Profit and Reconnaissance
passages.text:
This was supposed to be a covert operation. Unfortunately, our Trade Prince insisted on coming along... with the loudest, most conspicuous vehicle the Horde has ever conceived.

At least you're here with me, <name>.

Let's get going, then. We know next to nothing about the Drustvar territory. It's time to do some recon.

passages.title: Profit and Reconnaissance
passages.text: Let's get this over with.

passages.title: Profit and Reconnaissance
passages.text:
I'm getting a bad feeling about these woods.

Wait a minute... what is THAT!?

passages.title: WANTED: Anchorface
passages.text:
Kill the blasted shark that ate me legs! And me crew! And me boat - even the anchor!

He's been swimming around in the sea, looking for his next meal. Kill 'im.

I've left a reward with Cesi Loosecannon if you do.

<The poster is signed 'Captain Slagbolt'>

passages.title: WANTED: Anchorface
passages.text: Oh, did you kill that shark that almost got Ole Slaggy?

passages.title: WANTED: Anchorface
passages.text: Nicely done! Here's the reward Slagbolt left. When he comes in to port next he'll be glad to see that shark gone.

passages.title: Zuldazar Foothold
passages.text:
King Wrynn passed along orders to dispatch our finest to establish a foothold in Zandalar. That means you.

Fortunately, we have a few choices as to where we can set up camp.

Stick around. I'll go over the battle plan.

passages.title: Zuldazar Foothold
passages.text: Backups from Kul Tiras? Perfect. I was just about to finish another execution.

passages.title: Learn From the Best
passages.text:
You want to learn how these bees are so good at harvesting pollen, but if you show up, they'll start swarming you.

What you've got is a problem that can be solved with a little alchemy. I just so happen to have this potion that, once drunk, will turn the imbiber into a plant.

Here's the deal: you go out and drink the potion, and you'll see firsthand how the bees do what they do. After the potion wears off, you tell me what happened.

Oh, and don't ask why I have that potion on me.

passages.title: Learn From the Best
passages.text:
Fascinating!  It sounds like they used their bodies to block the mouth of the flower and beat their wings to stir up the pollen.

With the pollen being trapped inside the flower, it has no where to go but to get stuck on the bee.

Hmm, next time you've got a siren sting, try placing your hand over most of the mouth of the flower and gently blowing into it.  That might replicate what the bees were doing.

passages.title: Sealed Fate
passages.text:
Three wards ahead threaten to block our entry into the Shrine. We call them the Tidemother's Wrath, Radiance, and Pride.

Legends say the wards were gifts from the sea itself. They once protected our flagships against even the fiercest storms. Ever since we settled here they have instead kept the Shrine of the Storm safe.

It seems Lord Stormsong has turned their power against us. I can feel their energy radiating out even from here, protecting his forces from our magic.

We must destroy them.

passages.title: Sealed Fate
passages.text: So long as the wards hold, we will be no match for Lord Stormsong's power.

passages.title: Sealed Fate
passages.text: I can feel the wards' power waning even now. This is our chance to strike.

passages.title: Cleaning Bills
passages.text:
The Venture Company contaminates our pristine waters with toxic oil. 

My people are strong and will endure this until the time is right to strike back. The creatures with soft skins cannot wait. We must act now and save them from this danger.

Collect and scrub clean any oily sandbill pipers you see. Quickly, before it's too late!

passages.title: Cleaning Bills
passages.text: These smallest of victories are the foundation for the Venture Companies defeat.

passages.title: Daughter of the Sea
passages.text:
They're not letting us any closer to the keep. We'll have to walk from here.

Returning to Boralus has stirred feelings I thought I'd left behind. Memories smoothed away by the years like stones in the tide.

It all feels raw again.

I do not know how this will end--only that we must try.

passages.title: Daughter of the Sea
passages.text: Hope you had a nice nap. You're gonna need your strength.

passages.title: Swimming Lessons
passages.text:
For millennia we have roamed Azeroth's depths, yet never has a land walker journeyed with us. In order to help us, you must learn to travel the waters as we do.

The three scrolls of the sea shall grant you the energies to travel and survive underwater as we do.

Bring me the Scrolls of Harmonious Fins, Endless Tides and Graceful Breaths.

passages.title: Swimming Lessons
passages.text: You must collect the Scroll of Harmonious Fins, Endless Tides and Graceful Breaths.

passages.title: Swimming Lessons
passages.text: These will do nicely.  Just as we are, you shall now be one with the sea.

passages.title: Don't Play with Matches
passages.text:
These Venture Co. thugs set flame to the very oils they harvest. They hope to drive us from this land.

Their plan has a flaw. If a great wave extinguished every torch, their oil could not be lit. You can be our great wave!

Extinguish all the flames here, and we shall be victorious this day.

passages.title: Don't Play with Matches
passages.text: Get to work, the battle is not won yet!

passages.title: Don't Play with Matches
passages.text: The war has just begun, but it was a great first victory!

passages.title: WANTED: Sister Lilias
passages.text:
The Waycrest Guard seeks an able-bodied soldier to eliminate a threat in Corlain.

A witch by the name of Sister Lilias is wanted for the torture and killing of many of our townsfolk. Her end would prove a boon to all of Drustvar.

Present her head to claim your reward.

passages.title: WANTED: Sister Lilias
passages.text: Inquisitor?

passages.title: WANTED: Sister Lilias
passages.text:
Ah, the witch is dead. Good.

Here's your reward, as promised. Keep up the good work, Inquisitor.

passages.title: WANTED: Raging Earthguard
passages.text:
Be careful when traveling toward Anglepoint!

An immense creature of the earth has spawned on one of the hills, threatening all who go near.

Any adventurers who take down this earthen guardian shall be rewarded greatly.

passages.title: WANTED: Raging Earthguard
passages.text: You defeated the revenant! Bully! Well done as always, my friend!

passages.title: Can't Teach on an Empty Stomach
passages.text:
I would love to teach you, but it's so hard for me to concentrate right now. I haven't eaten anything all day, so it's all I can think about.

However, if a helpful adventurer were to fish up some lane snapper from the ocean just behind me, I would owe them a something in return. Perhaps something valuable, such as advice in regards to effectively picking the notorious winter's kiss.

If you don't feel like fishing, you could just buy some on the auction house, I don't mind.

passages.title: Can't Teach on an Empty Stomach
passages.text: Oh, do you have something for me?

passages.title: Can't Teach on an Empty Stomach
passages.text:
You brought me fresh fish? What a wonderful surprise! Now I can focus on teaching an eager pupil.

The important thing to know when trying to pick winter's kiss is that any exposure to heat before it is harvested can cause the flower to wilt.

To prevent that from happening, bury your hands in the snow right before you harvest it. By reducing the temperature of your hands before touching the plant, you can usually get a couple extra petals without issue.

Good luck!

passages.title: Battle Victorious
passages.text:
We have everything necessary to strike a blow against this Venture Company. 

Our plan is sound, we are well prepared and we have the element of surprise.

We shall ride atop Ai'twen and reign chaos upon them with their very own weapons.

passages.title: Battle Victorious
passages.text: The Venture Companies defeat is at hand.  Let's get to it!

passages.title: Battle Victorious
passages.text: This victory will be discussed for millennium to come.  The Venture Co. is a resilient foe though, I am sure we will meet them again!

passages.title: Up In Your Drill
passages.text:
<The drill on the front of the machine is in good condition.>

<This seems like the perfect type of work hazard.>

passages.title: Giving Back to Nature
passages.text:
Perform one additional task, and I will give you the knowledge you seek. The seeds you have are strong, but they need time until they are ready to grow. 

However, one must always be prepared in the desert. This sapling is mature enough to live on its own, but it is frail. It needs the dry desert winds to build static so it may bite, but until it does, it is as helpless as grass.

Plant it in the desert sands, near the fallen beast south of the Brine Basin, and protect it until it can defend itself.

passages.title: Giving Back to Nature
passages.text: Have you planted the sapling yet? Has it taken root?

passages.title: Giving Back to Nature
passages.text:
Your efforts have been instrumental in maintaining the balance in this land.

Now I shall reward you with the knowledge you sought... But first, when you approach the flower, what do you do?

<Patu nods as you explain your current knowledge of harvesting akunda's bite>

Hmmm... It seems that you do not know  the value of this plant's leaves. The bulb discharges on touch, which will kill the leaves if they are still attached. Harvest the leaves first and your yield shall be greater.

passages.title: I Like Turtles
passages.text:
Excellent work, adventurer.

Present the offering to Ai'twen.

He will accept it and come to our aid.

passages.title: I Like Turtles
passages.text: We are patient.  When you are ready.

passages.title: I Like Turtles
passages.text: An excellent offering.  Let us watch now, and see if this will suffice.

passages.title: Learn From the Best
passages.text:
You want to learn how these wasps are so good at harvesting pollen, but dey will defend their territory once you set foot inside it. Dis would be a problem, but I think I have a solution.

Take dis potion and go to Vol'dun, to de Prickly Grove, and drink it to turn into a plant.

Here's the deal: you go out and drink the potion, you'll see firsthand how the wasps do what they do. After the potion wears off, you tell me what happened.

passages.title: Learn From the Best
passages.text:
It is good dat you experience dat first hand. It sounds like dey used their wings to stir up de pollen.  With dem being so close to de flower, de pollen had no where to go but to get stuck on the wasp.

Hmm, next time you've got a Swarma' Sting, try placing your hand over most of the mouth of the flower and gently blowing into it.  That might replicate what the wasps were doing.

passages.title: Seeking More Knowledge
passages.text:
One of de most sacred plants on dis island is anchor weed. Legend says dat it was a gift from de Loa and it can do anything from regrow limbs to granting immortality.

If you are looking for facts as to what it can do or how to harvest it, you will need to go elsewhere. 

The spirits tell me dat dere is a book, dat contains de information you seek. Look for it deep within the Waycrest Manor.

Dey ask dat in exchange for dis knowledge, you kill whatever is causing a rift in de spirit world.

passages.title: Seeking More Knowledge
passages.text: Have you retrieved de book?

passages.title: Seeking More Knowledge
passages.text:
Dis thing is in terrible condition. Did it have dis much blood on it when you found it?

<Several moments pass as Jahden flips through the pages>

Hmm... It is hard to tell from dese pictures, but it looks like de seed pods open when the plant is disturbed.

However, if de first cut is at de base, dat drains a reservoir of water dat is used to open and close de pods.  So, start at the bottom, working your way up, and you should get a better harvest.

passages.title: For the Horde
passages.text:
The Mag'har face a new future, <class>.

Draenor has fallen. We cannot know if we will ever set eyes upon our homeland again. But this is not the time to wallow in past sorrows.

Destiny is ours to decide. Orgrimmar is our home now, and we must make our mark upon this land!

Show our allies in the Horde what it means to be Mag'har. Meet with the ambassador at the warchief's embassy, then go forth and claim victories across Azeroth.

Strength and honor, <name>!

passages.title: For the Horde
passages.text:
Are you the new one? I'm supposed to welcome you. Here, take this letter.

<Blackguard lets out an exasperated sigh.>

passages.title: Fer the Alliance
passages.text:
The mountain will always be home, but there's a whole world o' adventure up there on the surface. Ye look like just the sort o' <class> to find it.

Fer a long time, the Dark Irons stood apart from the other kingdoms. The time has come tae show 'em that we fight fer Azeroth, too.

There's an ambassador in Stormwind waitin' tae speak tae ye. He can help guide ye along on yer journey.

The Alliance needs our strength, adventurer. Get out there and show 'em the might o' the mountain!

passages.title: Fer the Alliance
passages.text: Ah, there you are, <name>! We've been inspecting--err--expecting you!

passages.title: Searching for Answers
passages.text:
There's a saying Cyrus always said when I was a kid: "The best face is a friendly one." It's really helped me get to know the visitors from all over the world that come through Boralus.

Let's ask some of the people in charge around here and see if they know anything about the fleet. Maybe it's just a matter of asking nicely!

passages.title: Searching for Answers
passages.text: I figure, worst case is we make a few friends!

passages.title: Searching for Answers
passages.text: No luck just yet, but I think we're making progress.

passages.title: Archived Knowledge
passages.text:
It seems like this Brother Alen we keep hearing about might have some answers. 

At least, I sure hope so. Everyone here seems a bit... evasive.

I think I saw some archivists heading into the southern cloister. If we follow them, I bet we'll find Alen too.

passages.title: Archived Knowledge
passages.text: This place is way bigger than it looks!

passages.title: Archived Knowledge
passages.text: I'd rather not stick around to see if he's right.

passages.title: Cultural Significance
passages.text:
I have noticed dat your skill with harvesting plants has improved, but I have also noticed dat you just treat each flower and leaf as a commodity. De flora of dese islands have a rich history, with a deep cultural significance to us.

Go down to the Port of Zandalar, and ask some of the men and women what a sea stalk means to them. Learn from us, and l will make it worth your while.

passages.title: Cultural Significance
passages.text:
De sea stalk has a unique magical property dat allows de stalk to provide de flower water, even if de flower is cut off.

Sailors will give their loved ones a flower and keep de stalk on themselves, so if dey fall over board, de salt water kills de flower. What you hold is more dan a stick, it is a family member's life.

As for your lesson, unlike most other magic plants, de best material to harvest for magical essence is de stem, not de leaves or flower.

passages.title: Gathering Mementos
passages.text:
I have a task dat I can not really trust to anyone else, and I feel you could handle it with de reverence it deserves.

An old friend came to me today, bringing a wilted sea stalk flower with her. Her husband was on a ship off the coast of Nazmir. I am unsure if de ship went down because of de naga, de Alliance, or a squall, but she said she did not want revenge. Only closure.

If you could go get her something to remember him by, I will tell you everything I know about sea stalks.

passages.title: Gathering Mementos
passages.text: Have you had a chance to search de wreckage?

passages.title: Gathering Mementos
passages.text:
I can not thank you enough for dis.

Death seems to always haunt dis land, but it is somewhat lessened by de thought dat we can still hold on to de memories of those departed.

As for your lesson, de last bit of advice I can give you is simple. To help you get de most of each sea stalk, instead of cutting the stem off from de plant, carefully pull it out of de sand and tear off de roots.

passages.title: Zalazane Returns
passages.text:
<name>, I have never needed your help as much as I do this day. My home be under attack.

I only just heard myself. Master Gadrin be callin' for aid. Zalazane, an old enemy of da Darkspear, has returned to da Echo Isles and has brought with him an army of da dead.

Zalazane be a traitor who has slain many Darkspear and defiled their souls. Will you come with me to defeat him? We can take da ship dat departs da Port of Zandalar.

passages.title: Zalazane Returns
passages.text: You... you brought da Zandalari with you?

passages.title: Broken Bargain
passages.text:
These mindless undead just keep coming. They be far stronger than they were the last time Zalazane walked this world.

Please, help us drive these undead back.

passages.title: Broken Bargain
passages.text: The dead should stay dead.

passages.title: Atal'Dazar: Ashes of a Warchief
passages.text:
I have learned much of de Darkspear lately. Truth is, I have quietly admired dem since I was a little girl, hearin' of Vol'jin's defiance of Zul's reckless call to action.

Vol'jin was Warchief of the Horde, chieftain of de Darkspear, and more troll den most can claim to be.

His ashes should be honored in a place of kings and queens.

Take de ashes to Atal'Dazar with my blessing and honor your former Warchief as he deserves.

passages.title: Atal'Dazar: Ashes of a Warchief
passages.text: What you doin' my friend?

passages.title: Atal'Dazar: Ashes of a Warchief
passages.text: You and I need be talkin'.

passages.title: You Owe Me a Spirit
passages.text:
Ya not leaving that here.

Ol' Vol'jin not be dancin' in my house. I not be seein' his spirit for a long time.

Its absence has broken de bonds dat held Zalazane in my control.

So... I want you to lift dat heavy urn, and bring it to my necropolis.

Vol'jin and I gonna have a face to face on my ground.

passages.title: You Owe Me a Spirit
passages.text: I have waited some time for dis. Long overdue hee hee... wait a moment.

passages.title: The Lost Spirit
passages.text:
It high time you an' I had a talk about ol' Vol'jin's missin' spirit. 

Dis goes beyond simple bargains and rights of passage. Spirits don' just go missin'.

You gotta few friends dat are gonna help ya track Vol'jin's spirit down. Dem who was friends to him in life should have da strength to find him in death. And if not, Talanji gonna help ya. 

Go to Talanji's ship in da Port of Zandalar. It be dat banged up ship ya came in on. You gonna do a little seance.

passages.title: The Lost Spirit
passages.text:
I am here because Master Gadrin and Rokhan asked for my aid and it is my gratitude for their deeds and yours that makes me willing to do this.

NOT because Bwonsamdi insisted.

If he can't keep track of his own spirits that is a "him" problem, not a "me" problem.

passages.title: Justice for the Fallen
passages.text:
Justice for da sons and daughters of lost loa. Justice for da heart of Zandalar. G'huun must be slain, and a symbol of his death displayed to those who need see it most.

Take me glaive, drive it into da corpse of dat beast, and let Talanji show it to her people.

Let peace be started in da hearts of da Zandalari.

passages.title: Justice for the Fallen
passages.text: Madness and darkness be movin' on da other side. Da pain of so many be mighty.

passages.title: Justice for the Fallen
passages.text:
Dis been a foe that threatened da trolls for many generations. We may not have always known his name, but we felt his curse.

Today, you won da justice for thousands of generations of trolls.

passages.title: The True Leader of Zandalar
passages.text: Now, take me glaive and walk with Talanji. Let her present your victory to her people. Let da trolls know justice, and the strength of a leader.

passages.title: The True Leader of Zandalar
passages.text:
Talanji is da true ruler of Zandalar, even if she be doubting it. With guidance, she will eclipse her father's reign.

For now, ya have me thanks.

passages.title: Explosive Situation
passages.text:
<This crate has fallen into the water. It contains bombs built to take out large mechanical devices.>

<If we had more of them, we could destroy the Venture Company's Reef Breaker.>

passages.title: Explosive Situation
passages.text: You'll need more of these bombs if we want to destroy the Reef Breaker.

passages.title: Explosive Situation
passages.text:
Many battles are won by those who take the initiative and exploit an opportunity. You have spotted an excellent opportunity.  

Now you should exploit it!

passages.title: Breaker Bad
passages.text:
The combined fire power of all the bombs you have collected should be able to destroy the Venture Companies Reef Breaker.

It's time to act and protect the reef and this sacred cave.

passages.title: Breaker Bad
passages.text: You have done us a great service.

passages.title: Ritualistic Preparations
passages.text:
Hey! I just got a request for a shipment of storm silver. Wanna help? 

As you know, storm silver is lightweight and resists corrosion. What you may not know is that we use it throughout our ships. It's so light our marines and pirates use it for armor because they can swim in it!

However, any parts that go onto a ship have to be blessed by a tidesage, or it'll be cursed to a watery doom!

Harvest a bucketful of ore, smelt it, and get it blessed for me, and I will teach you how to mine it easier.

passages.title: Ritualistic Preparations
passages.text: Did you get the storm silver? Don't forget that it needs to be blessed.

passages.title: Ritualistic Preparations
passages.text:
Good work! These look great!

These bars will be used as part of our next warship.

Now then, you scratched my back, and I will scratch yours. Storm silver is very brittle naturally. When you mine it, use several small swings instead of one big one. That'll keep the metal from being chipped away.

passages.title: Lost But Not Forgotten
passages.text:
Hey, <name>, would you be interested in getting back a personal possession?

Dere is a raptor in Xibala dat took an ancient and valuable artifact from my people. My attempts to negotiate with de beast have not gone well, resulting mostly in mutual screaming and biting.

Find de raptor Bonescreamer, kill it, and bring me de lost artifact.

In return, I will show you how to skin dese beasts of de land more effectively.

passages.title: Lost But Not Forgotten
passages.text:
Have you slain de beast yet?

<Rana chuckles as she smiles slyly.>

passages.title: Lost But Not Forgotten
passages.text:
Ah ha! Would you look at dat! I thought I would never see you again!

<Rana snuggles the small stuffed raptor happily.>

What is with dat face? I told the truth.

I lost it when I was a child, so that is practically a lifetime ago, it has tremendous sentimental value to me, and I am one of my people.

But, you did do as I had asked, so I will teach you a little something.

<Rana joyfully explains some of the more elusive techniques to harvesting leather.>

passages.title: Making Ourselves at Home
passages.text:
Log cabins will do in a pinch, but... if we're going to be spending any time here, we might as well make ourselves comfortable.

The roughnecks left us no shortage of lumber and food supplies, but we'll need canvas and chains to set up some proper Forsaken tents and banners. Bridgeport sounds rather lootable, doesn't it?

passages.title: Making Ourselves at Home
passages.text: With a name like Bridgeport, I have to assume that the town has plenty of supplies in transit, ready for looting.

passages.title: Making Ourselves at Home
passages.text: I'll have the rangers start working with these right away.

passages.title: Gunpowder Research
passages.text: I suppose that, before we steal all the Kul Tirans' violently explosive gunpowder and use it against them, we should learn how they make the stuff.

passages.title: Gunpowder Research
passages.text: Let's see the paperwork.

passages.title: Gunpowder Research
passages.text:
<Lilian quickly looks over the documents and nods.>

I suppose that someone in the Horde will find this information useful.

Probably goblins.

passages.title: The Bridgeport Ride
passages.text:
Pay attention, <name>, because this isn't going to be our standard assassination mission.

You and I are going to take this horse through Bridgeport and... cause a scene. I want every single guard on our tail, along with that Captain Stone character. Once we've rounded them up, it's over to those explosives, and...

<Lilian's eyes grow wide with delight.>

Boom.

passages.title: The Bridgeport Ride
passages.text: I heard the blast from up here. I think I may have even gotten a piece of guard on my cloak.

passages.title: Mojambo
passages.text:
Mojambo and his gang are attacking!

We must defend de arena. Mojambo must be defeated! De outcasts will take care of his gang. Mojambo is all yours...

Bring Tongo's head with you and use it to challenge Mojambo to a duel. His pride is too great to resist such a challenge!

passages.title: Mojambo
passages.text: Mojambo must be defeated!

passages.title: Mojambo
passages.text: At last dis war be over and we can live in peace. I do not know how to thank you for all you've done.

passages.title: Rastakhan's Might
passages.text:
Do you see de ship out in de bay, <name>?

Dat is my flagship, Rastakhan's Might. It is not here under my orders.

We will deal with de Prophet Zul in good time. For now, those who took my vessel must pay.

You are to bring me de head of Windcaller Ula'jan. De ship does not move without him, and it will not be moving again once he is dead!

passages.title: Rastakhan's Might
passages.text: Without de windcaller, my ship cannot be used to challenge my rule.

passages.title: Rastakhan's Might
passages.text: I will display dis behind my throne as a reminder. No one double-crosses Rastakhan and lives to speak of it.

passages.title: Having a Blast
passages.text:
We're going to really hit 'em where it hurts, adventurer.

They're carting tons of black powder right out of that mine. This could end very badly for all of us if we don't do something.

The mines are relatively undefended, I bet you can get in and wipe out their workers before they realize what's happening.

Keep an eye out for some explosives, if we can use their own tools against them, even better!

passages.title: Having a Blast
passages.text: They won't stand a chance!

passages.title: Having a Blast
passages.text: Sheesh... with all those explosions, I expect there's no one even left alive in that mine.

passages.title: Eye for an Eye
passages.text:
This is it, adventurer. Now is the time to strike. 

Take this shredder and destroy their stronghold. Burn everything to the ground!

Show no mercy. They certainly didn't offer any to all of the innocent civilians they slaughtered in Brennadam!

passages.title: Eye for an Eye
passages.text: Make them pay for what they've done to us.

passages.title: Eye for an Eye
passages.text: I can't believe you actually pulled that off. We may actually stand a fighting chance now!

passages.title: Get Shredded
passages.text:
I was scouting ahead while you were wreaking havoc in the mine.

Spotted a hulking, armored shredder in their lumber yard. Bet we could do some real damage with that thing! 

I tried to start it up, but looks like it might be out of juice. Maybe they forgot to charge it?

See if you can grab a fresh power core from one of the other shredders nearby.

passages.title: Get Shredded
passages.text: <Energized Core required.>

passages.title: Get Shredded
passages.text: <As the key clicks into place and the new core activates, a low hum begins emitting from the shredder. It accelerates into a high pitched whirring as the instrument panels light up all over the cockpit.>

passages.title: A Stroll Through a Cemetery
passages.text:
Our next stop is in Drustvar.

There, along with some help, we shall identify and extract the body of a Kul Tiran war hero.

With his aid, we will learn much of the Kul Tiran fleet. Enough to break it with ease.

We shall meet you outside Barrowknoll Cemetery.

Do try not to waste time, would you?

passages.title: A Stroll Through a Cemetery
passages.text:
Ah <name>. You're here.

You remember Captain Stone, don't you? I think you shall find her quite a bit more... agreeable now.

passages.title: Commander and Captain
passages.text:
This brings me no joy, <name>, but I will do what I must to make sure my family is happy and safe.

I would prefer we avoid violence, but if we must... there are two targets. Their leaders. Captain Malia and Commander Augustine.

Their loss should force the two groups to retreat from the area. 

Also, Augustine confiscated a book of mine. Recover it and my powers are yours, for however long I have left.

passages.title: Commander and Captain
passages.text: I don't need the details of what happened down there. Just the book.

passages.title: Commander and Captain
passages.text: I won't dwell on the grim task you've done. But I will show you just what this dying man is capable of, now that I have my book.

passages.title: Zelling's Potential
passages.text:
<cough> My body won't last much longer, but Miss Voss insists I display what my powers truly are.

I can instill within you a <cough> <wheeze> magical font that will absorb void essence from slain creatures.

When the font is full, you can unleash devastating wind magic.

Go to <cough> Port Fogtide. There you will find those tainted by the Void.

Slay them, fill the font, and you will <wheeze> see my magic at work.

passages.title: Zelling's Potential
passages.text: Is this <cough> enough for you?

passages.title: Zelling's Potential
passages.text: We all <cough> saw the magic from here. Miss Voss believes the time has come.

passages.title: The Mine Sweeper
passages.text: <One of the goblin flamethrowers. Unfortunately the tank has been cracked. It would be a good idea to bring it back to Felecia, she might have something to fix it up.>

passages.title: The Mine Sweeper
passages.text: A flamethrower!? This could be quite useful, but why couldn't you find one in better shape?

passages.title: Island Expedition
passages.text:
We better be quick if we're gonna get to de island before de Alliance.

You ready?

passages.title: Island Expedition
passages.text: Ready when you are.

passages.title: Island Expedition
passages.text: Nice work, <name>. We make a good team. Let's do this again sometime.

passages.title: The Wrath of Grapes
passages.text:
You look familiar. Do you owe me money? Wait... no, that's not it.

If you are here to learn, I could show you my secret mining technique, bu- Ugh...

I'm a little busy trying to see straight right now. Ugh... it feels like someone is swinging a pick at my skull. 

The best cure for a hangover is pickle juice, a big greasy breakfast, and whatever I did not finish last night.

Tell you what, get me those things, preferably quickly and quietly, and I will teach you whatever ya want.

passages.title: The Wrath of Grapes
passages.text: These shadows are loud. Can you fix that, too?

passages.title: The Wrath of Grapes
passages.text:
I needed this!

<Franklin spends several moments shoveling food into his mouth.>

Mmm... Right! If I recall correctly, you were asking about storm silver seams?

Let me tell you my secret technique, not even Myra knows. The metal is prone to stress fractures, but instead of scoring the metal where it meets the rock and breaking it off, just remove the rock.

The metal naturally forms prisms, and can be easily pulled out of the stone without wasting anything once it is loosened up.

passages.title: Island Expedition
passages.text:
Alright! Let's snap to it! We've got to get to that island before the Horde does, don't we?

You ready?

passages.title: Island Expedition
passages.text: Ready when you are.

passages.title: Island Expedition
passages.text: You and I make a pretty good team, don't we? Let's, uh, do this again sometime.

passages.title: Uniting Zandalar
passages.text: The people of Zandalar are diverse and capable. If we can bring them all together under the banner of the Horde, the Alliance has no chance of stopping us.

passages.title: Uniting Zandalar
passages.text:
Good. The people of Zandalar stand with us, thanks to you, <name>.

Now, the real work begins.

passages.title: Uniting Kul Tiras
passages.text: The people of Kul Tiras are diverse and capable. If we can bring them all together under the banner of the Alliance, the Horde has no chance of stopping us.

passages.title: Uniting Kul Tiras
passages.text: The Alliance is counting on you, <name>.

passages.title: Uniting Kul Tiras
passages.text:
Good. The people of Kul Tiras stand with us, thanks to you, <name>.

Now, the real work begins.

passages.title: Return to Boralus
passages.text:
I think that's enough excitement for today, <lad/lass>!

Why don't ya get back ta Wyrmbane and tell the man we've got this place all under control.

I'll make sure the blood trolls don't get any more of our folk! Ha!

passages.title: Return to Boralus
passages.text:
The lands of Nazmir are cruel to all who enter, but Fort Victory shall stand firm in the face of danger.

Well done, <name>.

passages.title: Return to Boralus
passages.text:
You know, a lot has happened since you arrived in Zuldazar! I'm sure Mr. Wyrmbane would appreciate a report.

Oh, not from me. Maybe somebody a bit more serious... like you!

I bet Daria over here could get you back pretty quick!

passages.title: Return to Boralus
passages.text:
We'll base our operations out of Xibala, then. And I'll have some reinforcements sent out to assist Brigadier Thom.

Thank you for your report, <name>. Well done.

passages.title: Return to Boralus
passages.text:
Shatterstone Harbor is an expansive foothold, and one that we will use to great advantage against the Horde.

I will leave Umbric and the others in charge here. Let's get back to the Wind's Redemption and return to Boralus.

passages.title: Return to Boralus
passages.text:
The waters outside Vol'dun are rough, but Jes-Tereth is one of the best helmsmen on the sea!

Let us roll one victory into another.

passages.title: Storm's Rage
passages.text: Horde forces are pushing deeper into Stormsong Valley. We can not allow this aggression to go unchecked!

passages.title: Storm's Rage
passages.text: We cannot rest until the people of Stormsong Valley are protected from the Horde!

passages.title: Storm's Rage
passages.text: You served the people of Stormsong Valley, and the Alliance, well today. Thank you, <name>. With persistence, we will drive the Horde from this land.

passages.title: Return to Zuldazar
passages.text:
Look at dis place, boss-mon! We got da pirates, a location close to da Kul Tiran capital...

I tink we should be bein' pretty proud of dis one.

We should get goin' back and tell Nathanos about our success. Maybe we can even get him to crack a smile.

passages.title: Return to Zuldazar
passages.text:
That's quite a location Ty'jin scoped out.

The pirates are another boon. If we ever need some bodies to fall on swords for us... they will do.

passages.title: Return to Zuldazar
passages.text:
You know kid, I think I've got it all covered here. My guys will find all the Azerite they can here and make me rich!

I mean, you know, make the Horde rich. With power!

Anyway, you can go tell Nathanos we're done here. This base is the best place to launch any attacks against the Kul Tirans here in Drustvar -- that's a Gallywix guarantee!

passages.title: Return to Zuldazar
passages.text:
You've established a foothold in Drustvar with the goblins? Good.

I will have my men keep an eye on Gallywix's activities there. Just in case.

passages.title: Return to Zuldazar
passages.text:
Warfang Hold is our most secured of the footholds we hold in Kul Tiras.

Kaga and her forces will be able to keep fortifications running, thanks to you. The Alliance will never see us coming!

Tell Nathanos that we have succeeded in our mission. I will help here until I am needed.

passages.title: Return to Zuldazar
passages.text:
Warfang Hold is an important strategic base for the Horde.

It is imperative that it stays safe. Rexxar will see to that.

passages.title: Ritualistic Preparations
passages.text:
I have received a request for a shipment of storm silver. It is a fine metal, lightweight and resistant to corrosion. We use it althroughout our ships. It is so strong even de naga use it in some of their weapons!

However, any parts that go into de ship have to be blessed by a wavesinger. I can not be bothered with dat nonsense. I do not believe it needs these extra blessings, but what do I know?

Harvest a bucketful of ore and get it blessed for me, and I will teach you how to mine it easier.

passages.title: Ritualistic Preparations
passages.text: Did you get those storm silver bars? Don't forget dat it needs to be blessed. Otherwise dey are 'land metal' and will curse a ship.

passages.title: Ritualistic Preparations
passages.text:
Nice, dis looks good. Dey should not be able to tell dat I didn't gather it myself.

These bars will be used as part of our next warship. Well, after dey get gold plated.

What? You did not think dat de ornaments were solid gold, did you?  Ha! Dat would cause dem to weigh tons!

Now then, you scratched my back, and I will scratch yours. Storm silver is very brittle naturally. When you mine it, use several small swings instead of one big one. Dis keeps de metal from being chipped away.

passages.title: Three Sheets to the Wind
passages.text:
You want to know more about storm silver?

Fine, if you are mining from a seam and make a mistake, you can make a deadly cloud of powderized metal. Now go.

<After a moment Secott's face softens.>

I am very busy, but if you insist on not dying, you should talk to my former apprentice, Biru. He is a drunk at Spirits Be With You, but he has some knowledge.

Talk to Ximo, de Innkeeper, and buy him a drink. If he likes it, he'll talk, if not... well, I hope you have enough coin for more drinks.

passages.title: Three Sheets to the Wind
passages.text:
<Secott's former apprentice, Biru, drunkenly stares at you.>

Whadda you wan?

passages.title: Three Sheets to the Wind
passages.text:
<Biru rambles almost incoherently, explaining the mechanics of mining storm silver from a seam>

... and dat is how you... get de most of mining... Zzz...

<As Biru drifts to sleep amidst a pungent cloud of brandy vapors, you think of the advice he provided.

Eager to experiment with your new mining technique, you leave the sleeping troll laying where he is.>

passages.title: Classic Reliquary
passages.text:
Another goblin surveyor, and this one's reporting to a blood elf overseer of some sort. We're closing in on them, <name>.

You know the drill.

passages.title: Classic Reliquary
passages.text: Sunwatcher will be ours soon.

passages.title: Classic Reliquary
passages.text: A map! Perfect. This should give us all the information we need...

passages.title: They Have Alpacas Here
passages.text:
Did you see? Did you see them? The floofy alpacas?!

I'VE ALWAYS WANTED A... I mean, ahh, ahem! I would like to acquire an alpaca. To study. For scientific reasons. Nothing to do with floofiness at all.

Here, this should help you wrangle one back here.

passages.title: They Have Alpacas Here
passages.text: So... floofy...

passages.title: They Have Alpacas Here
passages.text:
What a cutie. Look at her!

LOOK AT HER.

passages.title: The Wrath of Grapes
passages.text:
You look familiar. Do you owe me money? Wait... no, that's not it.

If you are here to learn, I could show you my secret mining technique, bu- Ugh...

I am currently busy trying to see straight right now, amongst other things. Ugh... it feels like someone is swinging a pick at my skull. 

De best cure for a hangover is pickle juice and a big greasy breakfast.

Tell you what, get me those things, preferably quickly and quietly, and I will teach you whatever want.

passages.title: The Wrath of Grapes
passages.text: Dese shadows are loud. Can you fix dat, too?

passages.title: The Wrath of Grapes
passages.text:
Dis is just what I needed.

<Biru spends several moments shoveling food into his mouth.>

Mmm... Right! If I recall correctly, you were asking about de storm silver seams?

Let me tell you my secret technique, not even Secott knows. De metal is prone to stress fractures, but instead of scoring de metal where it meets de rock and breaking it off, just remove de rock.

The metal naturally forms prisms, and can be easily pulled out of the stone without wasting anything once it is loosened up.

passages.title: An Exceptional Platinum Shard
passages.text:
Out of dumb luck, you've managed to extract an exceptionally large shard of platinum, instead of several smaller chunks.

You wonder to yourself if Secott could teach you to harvest this much every time.

passages.title: An Exceptional Platinum Shard
passages.text:
Hey, dis is actually pretty impressive. A decently sized shard of platinum in a single piece.

I can only assume dat dis was done unintentionally?

Let me save us both some time, I will tell you everything I know about platinum. If you have any further questions, take dem to someone else.

De ore forms with striations, like de grain in wood. Keep your pick aligned with de strata when you swing and it will keep de chunks intact, instead of breaking apart.

passages.title: Vol'jin, Son of Sen'jin
passages.text:
Even in da Echo Isles we have heard of da traditions of da Golden Road.

We must walk in da presence of royalty and hail da accomplishments of Vol'jin so dat his spirit be welcome here amongst da ancient kings.

I shall carry da ashes, if you light da fires.

Know that any member of any other tribe may contest us. As our champion, we will need you to fend them off if they do.

passages.title: Vol'jin, Son of Sen'jin
passages.text: Vol'jin. I must admit, I am impressed with his deeds. Had we met in dis world, I am sure he and I would have had much in common.

passages.title: Honoring a True Leader
passages.text:
Vol'jin. I have often felt our old chieftain's spirit whisperin' to me. His strength was da lifeblood of da Darkspear tribe. Some would even say he was da spirit of da true Horde.

Princess Talanji's offer is a great one. I shall travel with Vol'jin's ashes to Atal'Dazar.

If ya be wishin' to join us for dis procession, meet us upon da famed Golden Road.

passages.title: Honoring a True Leader
passages.text: Da power here... it be in da very earth. Da spirits be strong and ancient in dis land.

passages.title: Cutting Out the Competition
passages.text:
I've never cared much for battle, but I'll be damned if those fiends think they're gettin' this mill.

Best if we clear the area quickly. Grab an axe and show me what you got.

passages.title: Cutting Out the Competition
passages.text: What're you waiting for?

passages.title: Cutting Out the Competition
passages.text: You're a natural.

passages.title: The Winged Typhoon
passages.text: NYI - Parrot poop bombing run

passages.title: Relics of Ritual
passages.text:
There is a reason why I am accompanying you on this mission, and it's more than familiarity. The Abyssal Scepter is locked behind a ritual, the components for which are held by three separate lieutenants spread across the compound.

You get the relics, I perform the ritual, we grab the Scepter and we get out.

passages.title: Relics of Ritual
passages.text: Have you collected the relics yet?

passages.title: Relics of Ritual
passages.text: Please do not tell me who you had to get through to obtain these relics. I do not want to know.

passages.title: The Bulk of the Guard
passages.text:
If all has gone according to plan, Proudmoore has sent her elite forces to recapture her son's body.

Let's make sure they stay out of the way of our real mission, hmm?

passages.title: The Bulk of the Guard
passages.text: Oh, Katherine. You play right into our trap.

passages.title: The Bulk of the Guard
passages.text: It's almost as if I could hear their screams from here.

passages.title: Old Colleagues
passages.text:
The people in charge of those two ships are old colleagues of mine, <name>.

They did not achieve their rank through hard work as I did, but rather through deception and blackmail.

I think they deserve the hammer of karma. Or whatever weapon you prefer.

passages.title: Old Colleagues
passages.text: I am not a vengeful person... but appropriate punishment? Consider me a fan.

passages.title: Old Colleagues
passages.text: Each one of those people deserved nothing less than what you gave them.

passages.title: A Thicker Thread
passages.text:
<name>! I was hoping you would show up!

Xanjo is nearly finished with de suit of ceremonial armor he has been working on, but dere is a problem.

He says dat de thread he used is too thin, and dat de weight of de leather is ripping out de stitching.

He asked me to get something dat will hold, and de best thing I can think of is de thick webbing of jungleweb crawlers.

You can find dem in northern Vol'dun. Bring me back some strands of their thick webbing, and my knowledge of scales is yours.

passages.title: A Thicker Thread
passages.text: So, did you get de silk?

passages.title: A Thicker Thread
passages.text:
Yes, dis should do nicely.  Once de thread is replaced with dis webbing, dat armor is never going to fall apart!

Although... dis is stickier dan I was expecting. I will have to ask Xanjo if dat is going to be a problem.

But first, your lesson. Learn quickly, my pupil.

<Rana picks up a skin covered in scales, and shows you how to more effectively remove the skin without damaging the scales.>

passages.title: Brinepinch
passages.text:
You! <name>! I have a business proposition for you.

There is a monstrous crab nesting in some of my favorite hunting grounds.

I've already been forced out of some areas because of the sirens, I'm not about to lose more to a CRAB!

Bring me the head of Brinepinch! In return I'll teach you how to get more leather when skinning.

<Camilla pauses for a second before clarifying her thought.>

Sorry, most creatures that wrong me have heads. Just bring me some part of it as proof of its death.

passages.title: Brinepinch
passages.text: Have you slain the beast yet?

passages.title: Brinepinch
passages.text:
Excellent! I'll have to celebrate by going hunting later today.

As for you, <name>, allow me to show you a technique you've probably never seen before...

passages.title: In Pursuit of Fashion
passages.text:
Despite me REPEATEDLY stating that I'm not a leatherworker, one of the fat nobles of this city has commissioned me to make him a belt of 'the finest saurolisk' hide.

So... I'm just going to get the materials together, give them and some of the gold to Cassandra to make the actual belt, and pocket the difference.

That said, I need you to bring me saurolisk leather, enough to circle a very wide lord.

For your efforts, I'll look at the skins and see if I can give you pointers on how to harvest more.

passages.title: In Pursuit of Fashion
passages.text:
Have ya got the hides?

My employer is becoming... incessant.

passages.title: In Pursuit of Fashion
passages.text:
<Camilla takes a moment to look over the hides.>

Acceptable work. We'll lose some material trimming, but there should be enough to encompass our esteemed and honorable benefactor.

Also, I think I see an error that, if corrected, could help when you're harvesting from anything with scales. Show me what you did.

<Camilla hands you a knife and watches your movements as you explain. She occasionally stops you to adjust the position of your hands and states that it'll help next time.>

passages.title: Atal'Dazar: An Unbreakable Bone Needle
passages.text:
Hey, <name>, lookin' for work?

I've heard through Alliance Intelligence that the trolls have a dead god or something similar. 'Rezan' I think was the name, over in Atal'Dazar.

After the last time I broke a bone needle, I can't help but think that one made from the bone of a god has got to be indestructible, right?

I want you to retrieve one of his bones. Or at least something big enough that I can carve an eye in and use.

In return, I'll show you everything that I know about harvesting bones.

passages.title: Atal'Dazar: An Unbreakable Bone Needle
passages.text:
I hope this works. Going the rest of my life without needing to replace that damn needle...

Have ya got it?

passages.title: Atal'Dazar: An Unbreakable Bone Needle
passages.text:
Good! This is the perfect size for some of the smaller, more delicate work, the kind that would break needles constantly.

Are you ready for your lesson?

<Camilla spends the next several minutes showing you how to dislocate and quickly flay bones that were previously too time consuming to bother trying to collect.>

passages.title: Right Beneath Their Nose
passages.text:
We must continue with our primary goal, plant bombs on major Zandalari ships. There is one docked within the Warport.

You know what to do. Get beneath the boat, plant the bombs, and ensure no one sees... a blood troll using bombs.

My invisibility flask will give you the stealth you need, and Umbric believes the ritual will give you some other power to tap into.

passages.title: Right Beneath Their Nose
passages.text: Good luck, <name>, and stay safe.

passages.title: Right Beneath Their Nose
passages.text: Good work. The Zandalari will be in for a rude awakening when we blow up their flagships moments before our first naval incursion.

passages.title: Fallen Idols
passages.text:
Little creature, please... listen to me. 

I am Krag'wa. 

Once, my worshipers were many and my powers great. Now, my followers are all but gone. What little power I have left was placed within several idols, but the idols have been stolen by the heretical blood trolls.

I ask you, please recover my idols so that I can become whole once more!

passages.title: No-Landing Zone
passages.text:
These pirates are ruthless - they're bringing in landing boats to cut off our escape!

The guards are down at the riverside holding them off, but I'm afraid they'll be overrun before my family and I can get away!

passages.title: No-Landing Zone
passages.text: Please help the guards fend off those pirates!

passages.title: No-Landing Zone
passages.text: Oh thank you, thank you so much!

passages.title: Tol Dagor: The Fourth Key
passages.text:
Hey, wait a second. I know the type of key our fourth lock needs. This is the same sort of lock the Ashvane company uses. Resists lockpicks like nothing else, but they have a standard skeleton key. There was a set hanging on the wall in the Tol Dagor Armory. Given the state we left it in, it'd be easy to grab it.

Taelia and I will take the chest back to the Harbormaster's office for safe keeping. 

You go in to Tol Dagor and get that last key!

passages.title: Tol Dagor: The Fourth Key
passages.text: I knew securing that last key wouldn't be a problem for you, <name>!

passages.title: Tol Dagor: The Fourth Key
passages.text: Well, you have your answer. Jaina was sent to Fate's End.

passages.title: Battlefield Scavenging
passages.text:
Our efforts to reclaim the keep have left our supplies a bit lighter than we anticipated. If our forces are to continue, we'll need to restock.

Check the enemy camps for anything of value. We'll make use of what you find.

passages.title: Battlefield Scavenging
passages.text: Find anything of interest?

passages.title: Battlefield Scavenging
passages.text:
Pilfering is a dangerous business, though I must admit I am quite impressed.

We'll be sure to put these supplies to good use.

passages.title: Raiding Their Stores
passages.text:
Our rations are low. We need to keep our forces fed if we're to continue our efforts.

Before it was overrun, Newstead had plenty of food in their stores. I only hope there's something left.

passages.title: WANTED: Ayame
passages.text:
Wanted: For the death of twelve pilgrims and their escort to Torga's Rest. A reward is offered to anyone who brings in the head of the great serpent, Ayame. 

-Korkush

passages.title: WANTED: Ayame
passages.text: Yeah, I put up the poster. Got anything for me?

passages.title: WANTED: Ayame
passages.text:
It's good to see that snake got what it deserved!

Here's your reward, you earned it.

passages.title: WANTED: Ayame
passages.text:
Well equipped exterminator wanted.

Huge snake seen lurking north of Fort Victory. 

Reward offered for anyone who brings in the head of the pest.

-Garrick Blacksteel

passages.title: WANTED: Ayame
passages.text: Got anything fer me?

passages.title: WANTED: Ayame
passages.text:
Ah! Good! I've nae been able ta sleep a wink since I first saw this thing!

Here's ye reward, ye earned it!

passages.title: Into Darkness
passages.text:
I didn't think you would find a way. Though at this point, I guess I shouldn't be surprised when you accomplish what seems impossible.

I guess all that is left is to brave the Crimson Forest and see if this thing works.

First, however, Katherine has ordered me to send word when you have found a way to Jaina. You can use one of our falcons to take a message to her.

passages.title: Into Darkness
passages.text: We've made it this far. There's no turning back.

passages.title: Into Darkness
passages.text: It looks like the effigy's magic is working, but I think there's something we're missing here.

passages.title: Ritual Effects
passages.text:
I will need some assistance in conducting the ritual to allow us to gain passage to Fate's End. To help me with that, you will require the proper items and attire.

Normally I have free access to these things, but the recent upheaval has blocked myself and many of my brothers and sisters from obtaining them easily. However, the fallen tidesages across the span have all you will need.

Collect a ritual knife, lantern and robes from the fallen and these so-called prophets.

passages.title: Ritual Effects
passages.text: It warms my heart to see these used for good once more.

passages.title: Ritual Effects
passages.text: Wonderful. These are more than just a costume, they're an essential part of our traditions. For the ritual to work, you'll need to step into the role as fully as you can.

passages.title: Shrine of the Storm: The Missing Ritual
passages.text:
The ritual which allows safe passage to Fate's End is a closely guarded secret to keep the curious from venturing there and suffering the same fate as the condemned. I have never conducted it before, but there is a scroll with instructions.

It is held in the Shrine of the Storms. To access the scroll, use the staff you have empowered to break the dark energy surrounding it.

Collect the Ritual of Safe Passage and bring it to me.

passages.title: Shrine of the Storm: The Missing Ritual
passages.text: Were you able to recover the Ritual of Safe Passage?

passages.title: Shrine of the Storm: The Missing Ritual
passages.text: Good! Time is of the essence if we are to save Lady Jaina. I have made what preparations I can. Allow me a moment to read through the ritual and then we may begin.

passages.title: The War Cache
passages.text:
<name>. Let's talk.

This war won't be won simply by adding the Kul Tirans to our ranks. We eventually need to crush the Horde.

You and I will be leading an expedition to... disrupt the Horde operations in Zandalar. But first, we need resources.

passages.title: The War Cache
passages.text: Ready to sail when you are, <name>.

passages.title: The War Cache
passages.text:
<Halford looks over the gathered resources.>

This should do it.

passages.title: The War Cache
passages.text:
First things first. Remember... this is a war.

We accomplish nothing by simply adding the Zandalari to our ranks. We eventually need to crush the Alliance.

You and I will be leading operations in Kul Tiras. But first, we need resources.

passages.title: The War Cache
passages.text:
<Nathanos looks over the gathered resources.>

This should do it.

passages.title: Deep Dive
passages.text:
We need you to retrieve Marshal M. Valentine's body at the ocean floor below.

I should warn you: this part of the ocean is going to be very deep, and very dark, and very cold.

Speak with Hobart at the starboard side of the ship. He's brought all the machinery you'll need to get to the ocean floor.

passages.title: Biolumi-Nuisance
passages.text:
<static>

... having trouble hearing you ...

<static>

... electrical interference ... bioluminescent creatures ...

<static>

... getting annoying ...

<static>

passages.title: Grab and Go
passages.text:
Nothin' left to do but grab that Marshal and bring him back up to the surface, then.

Though I guess you might as well search the shipwreck for anything else of value. You spent all that time gettin' down there, and time is money.

passages.title: Grab and Go
passages.text:
<Nathanos looks at the two sailors' bodies, pauses for a moment, and then laughs.>

Not only did you succeed, but you've also brought me the corpse of Lady Proudmoore's firstborn son?! You make my job easy, <name>.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Akunda's Bite
passages.text: Jus' the kinda stuff I was hopin' for.

passages.title: Seal of Wartorn Fate: Gold
passages.text: A good choice.  Remember, only two seals a week.

passages.title: Seal of Wartorn Fate: Marks of Honor
passages.text: A good choice.  Remember, only two seals a week.

passages.title: Seal of Wartorn Fate: War Resources
passages.text: A good choice.  Remember, only two seals a week.

passages.title: Seal of Wartorn Fate: Piles of Gold
passages.text: A good choice.  Remember, only two seals a week.

passages.title: Seal of Wartorn Fate: Additional Marks of Honor
passages.text: A good choice.  Remember, only two seals a week.

passages.title: Seal of Wartorn Fate: Stashed War Resources
passages.text: A good choice.  Remember, only two seals a week.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Coarse Leather
passages.text: With a donation like this you are truly saving our hide.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Monelite Ore
passages.text:
Heh. A generous amount of ore.

This'll keep our smiths busy for a while.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Gold
passages.text:
Our friends here are accepting all kinds of donations on behalf of the war effort, but if ya ask me, no battle was ever won without proper funding. That's right, bub. I'm talking about money! And lots of it.

If you got it, we need it!

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Gold
passages.text:
A <class> like you's surely gotta have a little extra cash in your stash.

Waddaya say? Lemme help lighten your load a bit?

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Gold
passages.text: Ain't nothin' more valuable than sweet, sweet gold.

passages.title: The World Awaits
passages.text: When the sign of the emissary shines in the night sky, the stars strengthen existing bonds and forge new ones. Friendship is still not cheaply won, and deeds will prove loyalty, but trust comes more readily during these days. Venture across these lands, and give aid where you may, to prove your worth.

passages.title: The World Awaits
passages.text: I foresee that you will win many friends this week.

passages.title: The World Awaits
passages.text: Well done, <name>.

passages.title: Boulderfist Beatdown
passages.text:
The Boulderfist ogres have plagued Arathi since the Second War, and they still remain.

You know what must be done.

passages.title: Boulderfist Beatdown
passages.text: Boulderfist ogres still plague Arathi.

passages.title: Boulderfist Beatdown
passages.text: You have thinned the clan's numbers? Well done.

passages.title: Boulderfist Beatdown
passages.text:
If the Boulderfist ogres will not join the Horde, there is no place for them in Arathi.

You know what must be done.

passages.title: Boulderfist Beatdown
passages.text: You have thinned the clan's numbers? Well done.

passages.title: Wiping Out the Witherbark
passages.text:
The Witherbark tribe has a long and bloody history in the highlands of Arathi.

Show them how much bloodier it can get.

passages.title: Wiping Out the Witherbark
passages.text: Witherbark drums still echo across the Highlands.

passages.title: Wiping Out the Witherbark
passages.text: Have the trolls been defeated? Well done.

passages.title: Wiping Out the Witherbark
passages.text:
The bloodthirsty Witherbark tribe has always refused to join the Horde... and now that the Horde holds Arathi, we will succeed where the Alliance has failed.

Drive the forest trolls from the Highlands.

passages.title: Wiping Out the Witherbark
passages.text: Have the trolls been defeated? Well done.

passages.title: Death to The Defilers
passages.text:
Even with the destruction of Undercity, the Defilers continue to combat our hold on the Arathi Highlands.

The farmland at Go'Shek will belong to the Alliance once more. Go, and defeat the Forsaken.

passages.title: Death to The Defilers
passages.text: The Defilers still hold Go'Shek Farm.

passages.title: Death to The Defilers
passages.text: You've driven them off? Well done.

passages.title: The League Will Lose
passages.text:
Even with the fall of Stromgarde, the League of Arathor continues to operate in the Highlands.

The northern farmland will belong to the Horde. Go, and defeat the humans.

passages.title: The League Will Lose
passages.text: You've driven them off? Well done.

passages.title: Sins of the Syndicate
passages.text:
As if the Defilers were not trouble enough, Syndicate agents still slither down from the Alterac mountains to drive off honest Alliance farmers.

Punish them.

passages.title: Sins of the Syndicate
passages.text: The Syndicate has been driven back to Alterac? Well done.

passages.title: Sins of the Syndicate
passages.text:
As if the League of Arathor was not trouble enough, Syndicate agents still slither down from the Alterac mountains to drive off honest Horde laborers.

Punish them.

passages.title: Sins of the Syndicate
passages.text: The Syndicate has been driven back to Alterac? Well done.

passages.title: Executing Exorcisms
passages.text:
Even in death, the Horde foolishly clings to Alliance territory.

Drive their vengeful ghosts from the ruins of Ar'gorok before their foulness spreads.

passages.title: Executing Exorcisms
passages.text: Vengeful ghosts remain in Ar'gorok.

passages.title: Executing Exorcisms
passages.text: You've cleared the ruins of ghosts? Well done.

passages.title: Warfront Contribution
passages.text:
A well-trained army will only get us so far, <name>. We also need money, food, and supplies to keep our army funded, fed, and ready to fight.

Alliance coffers fund most of the war effort, but the rest is paid for by the hard work of citizens like you and me. Loosen up those purse strings and do what you can. For the Alliance!

passages.title: Warfront Contribution
passages.text: The Alliance appreciates your generosity, <name>. You've pushed us that much closer to victory!

passages.title: Executing Exorcisms
passages.text:
Even in death, the Alliance foolishly clings to Horde territory.

Drive their vengeful ghosts from the ruins of Stromgarde before their foulness spreads.

passages.title: Executing Exorcisms
passages.text: Vengeful ghosts remain in Stromgarde.

passages.title: Executing Exorcisms
passages.text: You've cleared the ruins of ghosts? Well done.

passages.title: Twice-Exiled
passages.text:
Elementals of all sorts are bursting free of their bonds across the Highlands.

Return them to the primordial chaos from whence they came.

passages.title: Twice-Exiled
passages.text: The elementals have been banished? Well done.

passages.title: Twice-Exiled
passages.text:
Elementals of all sorts are bursting free of their bonds across the Highlands.

Return them to the primordial chaos from whence they came.

passages.title: Twice-Exiled
passages.text: Hostile elementals still befoul the Highlands.

passages.title: Twice-Exiled
passages.text: The elementals have been banished? Well done.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Akunda's Bite
passages.text:
Greetings!

With the war effort in full swing I'll be your point of contact for herbalism and alchemical donations! It's a pleasure to meet you!

Now, let's see here... Ah, yes. Siren's Pollen. It appears our stockpiles reported a shortage as of late last night. It would be a great help to us all if you were able to donate to our efforts.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Akunda's Bite
passages.text: Have some herbs for me?

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Akunda's Bite
passages.text:
The scent of these herbs is unmistakable.

I'll make sure they're put to good use.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Monelite Ore
passages.text:
Ye look like the kind o' <lad/lass> that ought ta be carryin' loads o' ore around with ya! If my assumption is right about ye, we could use yer help to gather a bit more ore for the war effort.

Have ye any ore ta spare?

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Monelite Ore
passages.text:
Ye look like the kind o' lad that ought ta be carryin' loads o' ore around with ye!

Got any ta spare?

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Monelite Ore
passages.text:
Ah hah! I knew you were the type!

I could tell by the way yer breeches were saggin' a bit low.

passages.title: Warfront Contribution
passages.text:
A well-trained army will only get us so far, <name>. We also need money, food, and supplies to keep our army funded, fed, and ready to fight.

Show some pride and give what you can. For the Horde!

passages.title: Warfront Contribution
passages.text: Lok'tar ogar!

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Coastal Healing Potion
passages.text: I've received word our allies are looking to stash away a few supplementary items for the battle to come. If you happen to stumble across a few Coastal Healing Potions I'd be more than happy to add them to our stores.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Coastal Healing Potion
passages.text:
I don't suppose you have any healing potions to spare.

I'm trying to maintain a healthy supply for the battle to come.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Coastal Healing Potion
passages.text:
Oh, no...

<Chelsea catches a falling potion in the palm of her hand before it hits the ground.>

That was a close one!

These wouldn't be very helpful if I dropped them, now would they?

Thanks again, <name>.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Coastal Mana Potion
passages.text:
One of our latest shipments of alchemical supplies was raided en route to storage. We're scrambling to get our stock back on track, but I'm worried we won't make our quota.

You wouldn't happen to know where one can acquire additional mana potions, would you?

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Coastal Mana Potion
passages.text: I'm looking to acquire a few potions to sustain our allies in a long-fought battle. Have anything of the kind?

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Coastal Mana Potion
passages.text: This is just what I was looking for.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Coarse Leather Barding
passages.text:
It's not just our allies we need to protect in the upcoming battle, but our equine friends as well!

Can you lend a hand and ensure our allies receive the best possible armor for the battle ahead?

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Coarse Leather Barding
passages.text: It's not just our allies needing protection in the battle to come, but our beasts as well.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Coarse Leather Barding
passages.text: These ensure our riders and beasts are well prepared.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Monel-Hardened Hoofplates
passages.text:
Battles aren't decided by which side has the best armor, or the sharpest blades, but it sure does help! Matter o' fact is it's not just ye allies needin' help, but our beasts of battle as well.

If ye can provide any additional hoofplates fer our brave beasts I'll be sure ta have our farriers take good care of 'em.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Monel-Hardened Hoofplates
passages.text:
Battles aren't decided by which side has the best armor, or the sharpest blades, but it sure does help! Matter o' fact is it's not just ye allies who're needin' help, but our beasts of battle as well.

If ye can provide any additional hoofplates fer our brave beasts I'll be sure ta have our farriers take good care of 'em.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Monel-Hardened Hoofplates
passages.text: Quite generous of ye, <name>. I'll be sure they're put ta good use.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Monel-Hardened Stirrups
passages.text:
In times like this it's important ta be ready fer battle at a moments notice. Outfittin' our beasts with proper stirrups is a step in the right direction.

If yer able ta bring me a few I'll be sure they're put ta good use.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Monel-Hardened Stirrups
passages.text:
In times like this it's important ta be ready fer battle at a moments notice. Outfittin' our beasts with proper stirrups is a step in the right direction.

If yer able ta bring me a few I'll be sure they're put ta good use.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Monel-Hardened Stirrups
passages.text:
Excellent work, lad.

I'll get these ta our riders right away.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Grilled Catfish
passages.text:
Greetings, traveler.

I was asked to ensure our food supplies are never left wanting and our fish supplies have been running low lately. Have anything you would care to donate?

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Grilled Catfish
passages.text:
I was asked to ensure our food supplies are never left wanting, though lately our fish supplies have been running low.

Have any fish you would care to donate?

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Grilled Catfish
passages.text: This will do just fine. I'll be sure our allies are well fed before the battle begins.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Seasoned Loins
passages.text:
A nice, hearty meat provides the nourishment our allies deserve before shipping off to battle, not to mention it also makes quite a stew, something our troops seem to rather enjoy when the winds are at their best and the chill of night lingers in the air.

If you bring me some freshly seasoned loins I would be more than happy to deliver it to our supply officers.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Seasoned Loins
passages.text:
A hearty meat provides the nourishment our allies deserve.

If you bring me some freshly seasoned loins I would be more than happy to deliver it to our supply officers.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Seasoned Loins
passages.text: I'll get these to our supply officers right away.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Great Sea Catfish
passages.text:
Fish--it's what's for dinner! Or so say our supply officers. And this weeks meals are based around one delicious ingredient--catfish.

If we're going to keep our allies well fed and full of fish we'll need to gather more stock and begin meal preparations soon. 

If you find yourself swimming in an abundance of catfish I'd be happy to send them along to our stores.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Great Sea Catfish
passages.text:
If we're going to keep our allies well fed and full of fish, we'll need to make sure our stockpile is ready.

If you find yourself swimming in an abundance of catfish I'd be happy to send them along to our stores.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Great Sea Catfish
passages.text:
Looks like the great fish feast continues.

Our allies will be delighted.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Battle Flag: Spirit of Freedom
passages.text: I have a keen eye for quality when it comes to handcrafted items. I'm looking for one item in particular that may be of use to us on the field of battle.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Battle Flag: Spirit of Freedom
passages.text: Splendid work, <name>. Absolutely beautiful.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Battle Flag: Phalanx Defense
passages.text:
Threading and craftsmanship are not all that matter. Our work speaks to the heart of our dedication, providing a beacon of hope on the field of battle.

I am looking for such an item, one that is crafted by a highly skilled tailor. Have you seen anything of the sort?

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Battle Flag: Phalanx Defense
passages.text:
What beautiful craftsmanship. I could spend hours looking this over, though I must continue with our preparations.

Thank you for this.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Enchant Ring - Seal of Critical Strike
passages.text:
I was just about done filling orders for the next shipment then realized I was out of materials!

Do you think you can help me fill the remaining orders?

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Enchant Ring - Seal of Critical Strike
passages.text: Thanks for helping keep things on track. Where would we be without generous people like you?

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Enchant Ring - Seal of Versatility
passages.text: I know it's short notice, but I'm trying to find a few more enchantments to add to our next shipment.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Enchant Ring - Seal of Versatility
passages.text:
Nice work! Ya know, you're the reason we're able to prepare so quickly.

Thanks a bunch!

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Gloom Dust
passages.text:
I've been able to keep pace with our orders until recently. Now I'm afraid I won't be able to keep up without help.

Would you be willing to donate a few supplies?

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Gloom Dust
passages.text: Wow! I knew I could count on you.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Incendiary Ammunition
passages.text:
Though our ammunition stockpiles are faring well, it's my duty to find additional resources, especially those that are harder to come by.

Today I'm looking for a specific type of ammunition, one with incendiary properties. I could really use your help tracking a few of these down.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Incendiary Ammunition
passages.text:
Though our ammunition supplies are faring well, it's my duty to maintain a stockpile of additional resources, especially those that are harder to come by.

Would you let me know if you stumble upon munitions with incendiary properties?

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Incendiary Ammunition
passages.text: I'll be sure to handle these with care.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Frost-Laced Ammunition
passages.text:
Hey there!

Transmission's come down from up top--we need more ammunition! Something with a bit more kick. Something really unexpected!

From what I've heard there's a special frost-based ammunition crafted only by the most experienced engineers. If you were to bring me a few I'm sure our munitions officers would be ecstatic!

Maybe they'd even let me keep one to examine!

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Frost-Laced Ammunition
passages.text: I've heard there's a special frost-based ammunition crafted only by the most experienced engineers. If you were to bring me a few of these I'm sure our munitions officers would be ecstatic!

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Frost-Laced Ammunition
passages.text:
Wow! These are magnificent! The craftsmanship alone is... 

Apologies, I get carried away sometimes.

Take care!

passages.title: Arathi Donations: F.R.I.E.D.
passages.text:
You never know when you'll need to deliver a big bang on the battlefield, if you know what I mean. Luckily we can plan for the unexpected!
