We've begun to store a special stockpile of explosives for scenarios where we'll need a little something extra to get our point across. I've added one particular item to the list. 

If you have any to spare I'll make sure they're put to good use.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: F.R.I.E.D.
passages.text:
We've started a special stockpile of explosives for scenarios where we'll need a little something extra to get our point across. I've added one particular item to the list.

If you have any to spare I'll make sure they're put to good use.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: F.R.I.E.D.
passages.text:
What a find!

I'll make sure these are handled with care.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: War-Scroll of Intellect
passages.text:
Enlightenment guides our path to victory. In battle, we fight as one.

Share your knowledge and skills with me. Generosity is never forgotten.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: War-Scroll of Intellect
passages.text: Enlightenment presents opportunity for victory.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: War-Scroll of Intellect
passages.text: Your gift is most appreciated.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: War-Scroll of Fortitude
passages.text: The opportunity for strength and fortitude present themselves when facing difficult situations.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: War-Scroll of Fortitude
passages.text: May preparation guide us, and bravery shine within.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: War-Scroll of Battle Shout
passages.text: With preparation comes success.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: War-Scroll of Battle Shout
passages.text: My thanks.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Versatile Kyanite
passages.text: Our gem supplies are running low. Any you can spare would be greatly appreciated.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Versatile Kyanite
passages.text: Splendid.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Straddling Viridium
passages.text: We need more gems!

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Straddling Viridium
passages.text:
Wonderful specimens.

Thank you for your support.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Deadly Solstone
passages.text: Have you seen any of these lately?

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Deadly Solstone
passages.text: You're quite the gem, aren't you?

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Coastal Mana Potion
passages.text:
I be passin' dese along.

Thanks for ya donation.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Coastal Healing Potion
passages.text: I be knowin' I can count on you.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Coarse Leather Barding
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. I will see to it that our allies get the protection they deserve.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Shimmerscale
passages.text:
A delivery like this will keep us busy.

Thanks for your help.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Monel-Hardened Hoofplates
passages.text: Good work. I'll get them loaded into our shipment immediately.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Monel-Hardened Stirrups
passages.text: Strong craftsmanship. Did you make these yourself?

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Battle Flag: Phalanx Defense
passages.text: Quite the piece. I'll make sure it is put to good use.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Tidespray Linen
passages.text: Very generous of you, <name>.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: War-Scroll of Fortitude
passages.text: These will do quite nicely.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: War-Scroll of Battle Shout
passages.text: Yes. This will do.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: War-Scroll of Intellect
passages.text: Fine work.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Enchant Ring - Seal of Versatility
passages.text: If ya got somethin' ta give ta be helpin' out da effort, I be here waitin'.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Enchant Ring - Seal of Versatility
passages.text: Ah, yes. Dis be exactly what I was lookin' for.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Enchant Ring - Seal of Critical Strike
passages.text: Armor, blades, spears... we be ready. Only ting missin' is a few more enchantments.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Enchant Ring - Seal of Critical Strike
passages.text: Very nice.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Gloom Dust
passages.text:
Special enchantments contain de power ta give our allies a fightin' chance.

You be findin' any in ya journeys?

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Gloom Dust
passages.text: Ya read my mind.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Straddling Viridium
passages.text: Yes. These will do just fine.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: F.R.I.E.D.
passages.text:
Kaaaa-boooom! Hah!

I can't wait to see these in action.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Incendiary Ammunition
passages.text: I can't wait to see these in action!

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Frost-Laced Ammunition
passages.text: They're never gonna see it comin'!

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Gold
passages.text:
We've spent a great deal of time and resources preparing for the battle to come. 

As we begin final preparations, we'll be setting aside additional funding to ensure further training and supplies are available at a moment's notice. 

Would you like to make a donation?

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Gold
passages.text:
As we begin final preparations, we'll be setting aside additional funding to ensure further training and supplies are available at a moment's notice.

Would you like to make a donation?

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Gold
passages.text: How generous of you, <name>.

passages.title: Do Your Part
passages.text:
The b-b-barber shop? I'm sorry, what? You want to know where the barber shop is?

I'm sorry <race>, do you know there is a W-A-R going on right now?

Speaking of which, what have you done for the Alliance lately? Get out there and slay some Horde, or I'll shave your head myself.

passages.title: Do Your Part
passages.text:
There we go, <class>. Good job. 

But yea, I have no idea where the barber shop is around here. It's like a maze, right?

passages.title: From the Ashes...
passages.text: We must return to Stormwind, quickly!

passages.title: From the Ashes...
passages.text: I... am at a loss for words, <name>.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: War Resources
passages.text: Thank you for your contribution.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: War Resources
passages.text: A generous donation. I will let the commander know of your contributions.

passages.title: Prove your Worth
passages.text:
See many Alliance out there, <race>? We're getting reports of more and more Alliance showing up here on Zandalar.

Don't forget that this is a W-A-R. Prove your worth, and get out there and slay as many of them as you can.

For the Horde!

passages.title: Prove your Worth
passages.text: A good first start, here's something from our engineers that may prove useful...

passages.title: Molten Core
passages.text:
We'll need a fragment o' the core tae repair the Black Anvil an' who knows how much dark iron tae achieve the necessary purity. Thaelin can figure that part out.

In fact, I think he oughta go with ye tae get yerself a Fragment o' the Molten Core.

It's too dangerous tae go deep via mole machine, but he's got a hardy tank that can get ye the rest o' the way from the top.

Talk tae me when yer ready.

passages.title: Molten Core
passages.text: Sometimes it's hard tae understand Thaelin's ramblin's, but he's a smart one.

passages.title: Molten Core
passages.text: Good work, <name>. That fragment gets us a long way toward fixin' the Black Anvil.

passages.title: WANTED: Thundersnout
passages.text:
Thundersnout is the largest of the boars in the valley. She poses a serious threat to our troop movements in the south.

As such, Centurion Kaga Warmstone has issued a bounty for proof of her demise.

Thundersnout's location is near the Briarback kraul, so beware the local quilboar!

passages.title: WANTED: Thundersnout
passages.text: Yes?

passages.title: WANTED: Thundersnout
passages.text: The death of the matriarch means the next generation of boars will be delayed. Nice work.

passages.title: Firelands
passages.text:
Alright, the hard part should be behind us, <name>.

Now, we just need tae take that Molten Core fragment ye recovered into Firelands an' charge it up by Ragnaros' old swimmin' pool.

Dinna worry! I'm sendin' Anvil-Thane Thurgaden with ye.

Just give me a nudge when ye're ready.

passages.title: Firelands
passages.text: I hope ye're nae afraid o' a little bit o' fire.

passages.title: Firelands
passages.text: High Justice Grimstone calls himself the Herald o' Ragnaros now, does he? That traitor will rue the day he turned his back on the Dark Iron dwarves.

passages.title: Echo of Garrosh Hellscream
passages.text:
Our final destination will take us to the depths beneath your city of Orgrimmar.

The way there is barred, but I can get us inside.

Meet me outside the gates of Orgrimmar and we will descend together.

passages.title: Echo of Garrosh Hellscream
passages.text: Yes, this thrums with power! This is precisely what I needed.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Steelskin Potion
passages.text: Don't ya be worryin'. I be handlin' these with special care.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Steelskin Potion
passages.text:
Steelskin Potions are a great source of protection.

If you should find any in your travels, I'd gladly take them off your hands.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Steelskin Potion
passages.text: Wonderful! This is exactly what I was looking for.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Meaty Haunch
passages.text: Your donation is most appreciated.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Drums of the Maelstrom
passages.text:
In battle, those who are victorious march to the beat of the same drum.

What say we provide our allies with a little drumming of our own?

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Drums of the Maelstrom
passages.text:
Finely crafted, taught hide... is this bone? This work is quite masterful.

I'll make sure these are put to good use.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Drums of the Maelstrom
passages.text:
The craftsmanship on these drums are extraordinary.

I'll be sure to pass these along. Thank you, <name>.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Battle Flag: Rallying Swiftness
passages.text: What beautiful work.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Battle Flag: Rallying Swiftness
passages.text:
The finest threading and craftsmanship create the most beautiful standards.

Have you any to offer?

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Battle Flag: Rallying Swiftness
passages.text:
Truly magnificent.

Our allies will rally beneath our colors on the battlefield.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Organic Discombobulation Grenade
passages.text: Wonderful work, <name>. And lighter than I expected. Magnificent.

passages.title: Arathi Donations: Organic Discombobulation Grenade
passages.text: Spectacular! This is just what I was looking for.

passages.title: Battle for Azeroth: Hour of Reckoning
passages.text:
Champions of the Alliance, 

At last the time has come for us to reclaim what is rightfully ours! Our final push to retake Lordaeron Keep shall commence at dawn. 

The Horde and their Warchief must answer for their crimes!

passages.title: Battle for Azeroth: Hour of Reckoning
passages.text: The Horde will pay for what they've done.

passages.title: Let's Bee Friends
passages.text:
We just need to collect some slime from the animated honey creatures that are still roaming around the farm.

If you can bring back a few vials of that, we can put all our ingredients together and give the mixture to Bumbles.

We should only feed him once a day, or he might get sick like some of the other bees.

We're gonna have him all healed up in no time!

passages.title: Let's Bee Friends
passages.text: Did you collect enough of the slime?

passages.title: Let's Bee Friends
passages.text: He's looking so much better!

passages.title: Battle for Azeroth: Hour of Reckoning
passages.text:
Champions of the Horde, the time has come. 

The Alliance seek to overthrow the Undercity and are laying siege to Lordaeron Keep. You are to report High Overlord Saurfang at once.

Make haste, Brill has already fallen and there is no time to spare.

passages.title: Battle for Azeroth: Hour of Reckoning
passages.text:
The Alliance moves against the Undercity, seeking retribution for the burning of Teldrassil.

We will not allow them to take what is ours, <class>.

passages.title: Unlocking the Heart's Potential
passages.text:
I sense the Heart of Azeroth gettin' stronger, <name>. Perhaps we can unlock even more of the amulet's potential.

Yer gonna need every bit o' its might. As if there weren't already forces fightin' over Azerite, lately it seems the servants o' the Old Gods have begun tae seek it out as well!

Come. We can use the Azerite ye've gathered tae strengthen the Heart.

passages.title: Unlocking the Heart's Potential
passages.text: Hold still, champion, while I empower the Heart of Azeroth.

passages.title: Unlocking the Heart's Potential
passages.text:
We're on the right track, champion. Keep absorbin' Azerite and stoppin' those who seek tae abuse it.

Azeroth seems confused... worried. I don't know what tae make of it, but I fear things are gonna get worse before they get better.

passages.title: The Chamber of Heart
passages.text:
That amulet ye wear keeps gettin' stronger, <name>. But tae unlock further potential, we need tae go somewhere closer tae Azeroth's world soul.

The Chamber of Heart!

I know the last time ye saw it, things were lookin' bleak. But meet me there, and I think ye'll agree that we're makin' progress on healin' our world's wounds!

passages.title: The Chamber of Heart
passages.text: The Chamber of Heart is the key to that amulet's might.

passages.title: The Chamber of Heart
passages.text:
Ye pushed the darkness back, <name>. But that ain't the last we'll see of it.

The mightier the Heart of Azeroth becomes, the bigger the target ye have on yer back.

Stay on yer guard, champion. We cannae lose the Heart... and we cannae lose ye.

passages.title: Warfront: The Battle for Stromgarde
passages.text:
If the Horde thinks it can assault Stromgarde, it is sorely mistaken! We will not let Arathi fall!

Prepare yourself for battle.

passages.title: Warfront: The Battle for Stromgarde
passages.text: We must do what we can to claim Arathi for the Alliance.

passages.title: Warfront: The Battle for Stromgarde
passages.text: Well fought, <name>, though I'm afraid it may be premature to let our guard down just yet. I am sure our enemy will not sit idly while we rebuild Stromgarde.

passages.title: Warfront: The Battle for Stromgarde
passages.text:
Our enemies are relentless in their quest to seize Arathi for themselves. We will never allow it to fall into their hands! We must stop them before the keep is rebuilt!

Take up arms. The Alliance is upon us.

passages.title: Warfront: The Battle for Stromgarde
passages.text: We will claim Arathi as our own!

passages.title: Warfront: The Battle for Stromgarde
passages.text: A battle well fought, <name>. You have once again proven yourself a great warrior of the Horde.

passages.title: Azerite for the Horde
passages.text: Assist the Horde by collecting Azerite on Island Expeditions.

passages.title: Azerite for the Horde
passages.text: Return to me when you have finished aiding de Horde, <name>.

passages.title: Azerite for the Horde
passages.text: For de Horde!

passages.title: Azerite for the Alliance
passages.text: Assist the Alliance by collecting Azerite on Island Expeditions.

passages.title: Azerite for the Alliance
passages.text: Return to me when you have finished aiding the Alliance, <name>.

passages.title: Azerite for the Alliance
passages.text: For the Alliance!

passages.title: Blood in the Tides
passages.text:
We do not have sirens in Zandalar, but our sailors know of dem. In Zandalari, we call dem bwon'tulak - de death singers.

My ship was run aground and my fellow sailors all murdered by de death singers.

Jane saved my life, so now I help to protect dese people.

Sirens are a plague on da seas, no matter who ya serve. Run the tides red wit dere blood!

passages.title: Blood in the Tides
passages.text: You have made de seas safer for all. You have my thanks.

passages.title: My Favorite Things
passages.text:
It's tough out here.

Pirates. Deadly monsters. 

Hungry Sam's seemingly endless battle with indigestion.

Nothing sets the nerves at ease like an old keepsake. Somethin' to remind you of home. Somethin' to keep you going.

Ask around the camp. Find out what folks might have lost out there in the tideways. If you can bring any of it back, it'd be a mighty kind gesture.

Me? Oh... I had a locket... 

Never mind, it's too small, you'd never find it. It's nothing. Don't worry about it.

passages.title: My Favorite Things
passages.text:
We've all lost something in the tides.

Some more than others.

passages.title: My Favorite Things
passages.text:
I didn't think you'd actually find all this stuff!

We don't have much, but here's a little something for your troubles.

passages.title: WANTED: Raging Earthguard
passages.text:
I have been receiving formal complaints about some big earth elemental in the middle of our scouting path.

Normally I'd elect to ignore these, but the sooner we get done here, the better. Nobody wants to be stuck in this frozen hill any longer than we need to.

Payment goes to the person who brings it down!

passages.title: WANTED: Raging Earthguard
passages.text: Now the complaints should stop. Thanks a lot, pal!

passages.title: Quartermaster's Bounty
passages.text: Victory at any cost.

passages.title: All Wrapped Up
passages.text:
I'm not the only one trapped here in this mine. Grimelock left all of the other miners to the spiders, too.

There might be some of them still alive out there. Could you help? I'd appreciate it if not all of my friends died.

passages.title: All Wrapped Up
passages.text:
Whew! I'm glad some of us were able to make it out of here.

I'm pretty sure I'm ending up with arachnophobia after this..

passages.title: Conquest's Reward
passages.text: Your prowess on the field of battle is without peer.

passages.title: Dark Iron Dwarves
passages.text:
I can't thank ye enough, <name>. Without yer help, Ironfoe would be lost tae us and the Black Anvil could've ne'er been made whole.

But even more than that, ye've proven to every Dark Iron in the mountain what it means tae be part o' somethin' bigger. Tae be part o' the Alliance.

The time has come tae let King Anduin know that my people stand with him.

passages.title: Dark Iron Dwarves
passages.text:
By securing the Dark Iron clan's commitment to the Alliance, you have brought renewed strength to our cause. 

Queen-Regent Thaurissan and I are both in your debt. Thank you, <name>.

passages.title: Flightgineer's Network
passages.text:
Now that we control High Perch the skies are ours!

I've laid out a few plans for expanding our routes in this here note. If you'd be so kind as to deliver it to our commander, I'm sure they'll be pleased with our progress.

Let me know when you're ready and l'll send ya on your way.

passages.title: Flightgineer's Network
passages.text:
Our goblin friend assures me he is able to expand our travel network as long as we hold key positions.

Looks like we've got our work cut out for us.

passages.title: Establishing a Connection
passages.text:
Now that we control High Perch the skies are ours!

I've drafted plans for a flight network that provides our allies safe passage. Please, take these notes and deliver them to our commander at once.

I'm happy to provide you with a gryphon that will deliver you to the base when you are ready.

passages.title: Establishing a Connection
passages.text:
Excellent news. I've been assured retaining control of key battlefield positions allows our gryphons to soar through the skies without interruption to various locations.

We must press our efforts even further.

passages.title: A Drust Cause
passages.text: Horde armies are pushing into the heart of Drustvar. Hold the line and drive them back to the holes they crawled out of. Kul Tiras is ours!

passages.title: A Drust Cause
passages.text: We cannot rest while the Horde assault Drustvar!

passages.title: A Drust Cause
passages.text: The Horde got what they deserved.

passages.title: A Sound Defense
passages.text: Horde forces are attacking Tiragarde Sound. Make them regret every footstep upon our soil!

passages.title: A Sound Defense
passages.text: The Horde dares to assault us here in Boralus?! Our response must be swift, massive, and merciless!

passages.title: A Sound Defense
passages.text: Everyone in Boralus cheered when we saw the explosions up on that airship! The Horde will think twice before assaulting Boralus again.

passages.title: Allegiance of Kul Tiras
passages.text:
It is time for her maiden voyage, <name>.

This aptly named vessel will carry us and her crew across the vast sea to Stormwind Harbor. There we will meet Anduin and I will seal the pact we made so many moons ago.

Kul Tiras will stand with the Alliance so long as I am Lord Admiral.

Thank you for your assistance in this endeavor.

passages.title: Allegiance of Kul Tiras
passages.text:
I accept this gesture in the spirit in which it was made, <name>.

The Kul Tirans have been valuable allies, and now we have a physical manifestation of that bond.

I thank you for your continued support of the Alliance. We continue to grow with your aid.

passages.title: Wisdom of the Warchief
passages.text:
Champion. For a brief moment after the battle with G'huun, the spirit of our old warchief, Vol'jin, appeared in view of all in Zuldazar.

I had a hundred questions to ask my old friend, but his spirit faded before I could muster my voice.

I have asked Talanji to perform her seance once more, so that I might speak with the spirit of Vol'jin.

Will you collect the Glaive of Vol'jin from its resting place at the base of the pyramid and then join us at Zanchul?

passages.title: Wisdom of the Warchief
passages.text: Have you brought the glaive?

passages.title: Wisdom of the Warchief
passages.text: Baine has been an excellent advisor in dese trying times. It is my honor to aid him in his search for answers.

passages.title: Shades of Disruption
passages.text:
Vol'jin's spirit is a slippery one. I have asked Master Gadrin and Spiritwalker Ebonhorn to aid us in calling him forth.

Dis ritual will not be easy, and I ask you to be on your guard should anything other than Vol'jin appear.

passages.title: Shades of Disruption
passages.text: Ya know you be askin' a good question when someone be tryin' to have you killed for askin' it.

passages.title: Where He Fell
passages.text:
Dis be da spot, mon. Dis be where da Legion led our forces into a trap and drove a blade into me belly.

Sylvanas pulled me from da ruin of da battlefield. She saved da Horde dat day. Come, let us walk around dis place and see what we can learn from da echoes of da past.

passages.title: Where He Fell
passages.text:
Somethin' was definitely helpin' our enemies dat day. But who or what could dat have been?

Da loa were silent and their powers were gone, as if I'd lost their favor.

With so much death, I be havin' one person in mind who might be behind it.

passages.title: Eyir
passages.text:
Not many got da stones or da mojo to take what be mine. Ol' Bwonsamdi always be gettin' his share.

Da way Talanji be tellin' it, Vol'jin's spirit may be gettin' help from some other power. And dere be few who love to mess with souls like Eyir. A meddlin' one she be, with her wings and her valor.

Ya best be seein' her in person. She be found in her vault at Skold-Ashil. And ya best not mention me name, or she might be sendin' ya back to me faster dan any death gate.

passages.title: Eyir
passages.text: Dis is a strange land. De spirits feel different here.

passages.title: Modular Construction
passages.text:
The Abandoned Junkheap is home to some seriously deadly gnomish constructs. These constructs contain Mecha-Cores which could come in handy for crafting the Ub3r-Spanner. Legend has it that it could forge creations unlike anything we've ever seen!

You look like the adventurous type, <name>. Can you go scrap up some mechs?

Don't forget your Arclight Spanner!

passages.title: Children's Week
passages.text:
Thank you for coming by to celebrate Children's Week, <class>. You are going to make one little boy very happy!

Take this whistle. With it, you will be able to call for the child you have agreed to take care of this week. It will serve no use after Children's Week ends, as is custom.

When you are ready, use the whistle and meet your new ward! I know he is ecstatic to meet you.

passages.title: Children's Week
passages.text:
Whoa, are you a <class>? That's amazing! My name's Liam!

I'm so, so excited to leave the city. I haven't been outside the gates since I was really little.

Miss Westerson says that we should think about what we want to be when we grow up, but how can I choose when there are so many cool things you can be?!

Can you take me to meet people I've heard stories of? I think meeting grown ups like you might help me decide!

passages.title: The Ub3rlode
passages.text:
Looks like Gryzix's suspicions were correct. Not only is it the Venture Co, but it's Mogul Razdunk himself! 

We now owe it to not only ourselves as engineers, but the Horde proper to secure the recipe before he can craft it! 

Go to Kezan, <name>. Stop Mogul!

passages.title: Legacy of the Bronzebeard
passages.text:
You must present this armor to Muradin at once! This is an historic day for the dwarven people.

This isn't just a suit of armor, it's a symbol of our heritage.

passages.title: Legacy of the Bronzebeard
passages.text:
<name>, you have long been a champion for the dwarven people. Your acts of valor and bravery will be sung in these halls for ages.

I can see no other <race> more deserving to wear this armor than you.

passages.title: The Mountain Folk
passages.text:
All Kul Tirans are really tough, but the Roughnecks are the roughest and toughest of them all!

They can wrestle gryphons with their bare hands! They can knock down a yeti with a single punch!

I wanna meet a Roughneck and prove that I can be really strong like them! Can you take me to their camp? I've heard it's up in the mountains by Anglepoint.

passages.title: The Mountain Folk
passages.text: I'm gonna be big and strong and eat raw goat with my teeth!

passages.title: The Mountain Folk
passages.text:
Did you hear that?! He said I could be a Roughneck!

I'm gonna eat a lot of food so I can be big and strong like he is!

passages.title: Yo Ho, Yo Ho!
passages.text:
The orphan matron is always telling us what to do! Study your books, practice your words, behave in public...

What if I want to be a pirate when I grow up? A scourge of the high seas! Finding buried treasure, dueling my enemies on the mast, wearing cool hats!

Pirates never come into Boralus, so I've only ever heard stories. I wanna meet a real one! Can you take me to Freehold? I'll practice my pirate voice on the way.

YARRRRR!

passages.title: Yo Ho, Yo Ho!
passages.text: Yo ho, yo ho!

passages.title: Yo Ho, Yo Ho!
passages.text: Look at my new hat! What a nice pirate man.

passages.title: The Squid Shrine
passages.text:
Sometimes tidesages come to the orphanage and tell us about the sea and how they can talk to it.

I wanna talk to water!

We've gone on field trips to their monastery here in Boralus, but I heard their home in Stormsong is much more impressive. Can you take me to go see it? I heard there's a great view from the Brineworks!

passages.title: The Squid Shrine
passages.text: The tidesages always say that the water talks to them. How does it talk without a mouth?

passages.title: The Squid Shrine
passages.text:
That tidesage was so mysterious! Do you know him?

I wanna be mysterious like him! He could make water tornadoes! He even said the water talked to him! How cool is that?!

... I'm all wet now.

passages.title: Bird Friends
passages.text:
My best friend at the orphanage is named Billy. He's just a kid like me, though. I heard that some people in Drustvar have FALCONS as their best friend.

How cool is that?!

Can we go meet a falconer? Pretty please? I want to have a bird friend too.

I hear there's a big statue in Arom's Stand of some dead guy who was friends with birds. Maybe we can find a falconer there!

passages.title: Bird Friends
passages.text: I wish I had feathers like a bird!

passages.title: Bird Friends
passages.text:
Hmm...

I think the first step to being a friend to birds is to stop chasing seagulls and start feeding them instead!

passages.title: Shapeshifters!
passages.text:
Being a human is alright and all, but what if I could be a BEAR?

Druids can be bears. And cats! And who knows what else!

I've heard rumors of druids in the mountains of Drustvar. It would be so cool to meet one. I wanna see them turn into animals! Maybe they can teach me, too!

passages.title: Shapeshifters!
passages.text: Roar! Growl! Bear sounds!

passages.title: Shapeshifters!
passages.text: Can you take me back here sometime? That game sounds pretty fun!

passages.title: Return to the Orphanage
passages.text:
This has been the best Children's Week ever!

I was scared to grow up, but now I'm really excited! There are so many cool things I can be!

But how can I choose?

I think it's time for you to take me back to the orphanage, <name>. I'll think about what I want to be when I grow up on the way.

passages.title: Return to the Orphanage
passages.text: What a great trip!

passages.title: Return to the Orphanage
passages.text: I've had so much fun with you, <name>! Thanks for bringing me all over Kul Tiras!

passages.title: Shores of Zuldazar
passages.text: Alliance forces are attacking Zuldazar. Make them regret every step taken on our soil!

passages.title: Shores of Zuldazar
passages.text: The Alliance dares to assault us in Zuldazar?! We must crush these fools so cruelly and so swiftly that they never consider this again.

passages.title: Shores of Zuldazar
passages.text:
Attacking Zuldazar was unusually arrogant, even for the Alliance.

Thank you for personally showing them how poor of a choice that was. Our Zandalari allies will be reassured of our commitment to them, and inspired by our show of force in their defense.

passages.title: The Financial Participation Incentive
passages.text:
I see Buxdoggle running some sort of game over dere. Getting people to guess de fight's winner in exchange for Brawler's Gold.

See if you can figure out how his game works. If you win enough money from him, he might start talking...

passages.title: The Financial Participation Incentive
passages.text: Lookin' to make some gold, bub?

passages.title: The Financial Participation Incentive
passages.text: Say, <name>, was it? You're not half bad at this! You'll put me in the poor house if you keep this up!

passages.title: The Pit Boss's Debts
passages.text:
I'm not too proud to commit a few acts of violence to set a wrong right. And you know what's wrong? I'm out of money!

Only one person's won more gold from me than you have, and his name's Lord Sylysthrel. Real skeezy guy. I think he was cheating.

Sure would be nice if I could get that gold back...

passages.title: The Pit Boss's Debts
passages.text: Once I get back the gold I lost, then I can REALLY start gambling!

passages.title: The Pit Boss's Debts
passages.text:
<Buxdoggle stares, misty-eyed, at the huge pile of money.>

I just love gold. There ain't NOTHIN' I wouldn't do to get my hands on gold. Ya hear me? Nothin'.

passages.title: Soul Splinters
passages.text:
<Skrizzik mumbles to himself.>

Oh dear, oh dear... it's getting hungry again. Where am I going to find enough souls to feed it? Ohh... if only I could get my hands on some of those brawler's purses...

<He notices you.>

Oh! Hello there! Pay no attention to the mindless babbling of an innocent warlock. Nothing suspicious going on here!

passages.title: Soul Splinters
passages.text: Oh dear, oh dear... must not let it get too hungry...

passages.title: Soul Splinters
passages.text: These... these might help! They'll help me with... my problem that I have. That I can't tell you about.

passages.title: Super Soul Splinters
passages.text:
<Skrizzik mutters to himself again:>

Will these be big enough, though? It gets SO hungry for souls, and when it doesn't get enough, it gets angry, and we definitely don't want to trigger a void apocalypse in the middle of Orgrimmar. Oh dear, oh dear...

<He notices you lingering.>

Oh! The <race> is still here! Heh heh. Never mind me! Nothing evil going on here!!

passages.title: Super Soul Splinters
passages.text:
<Skrizzik looks around the arena in a panic.>

Where can I find more souls? Maybe the quartermaster sells some? Oh, right, he's dead. Hmm...

passages.title: Super Soul Splinters
passages.text:
These... are... PERFECT!

Now if you'll please give me some privacy, I have some completely harmless shadow magic to perform. Goodbye!

passages.title: The Precious 13-Tooth Gogglegear
passages.text:
We're going to have to invent something. Something capable of seeing into alternate dimensions. Something explosive that you strap directly onto your eyes.

That's right, I'm talking about goggles.

I already have all the goggle parts except for one: a 13-tooth gear. They're nearly impossible to find, but I KNOW that the G.G. Engineering boys have one, and Card Trader Ami has their challenge card.

passages.title: The Precious 13-Tooth Gogglegear
passages.text: Are you ready to goggle up?

passages.title: The Precious 13-Tooth Gogglegear
passages.text:
<Mollivox forcefully smashes the gear into a pair of goggles.>

There! Goggles done.

passages.title: The Mollivox Goggle Experiment
passages.text:
Okay, before we start, I've got a few rules:

First, these goggles will only work at close range. We're looking for something INSIDE the arena, so you'll have to be inside the arena to use them.

Second rule: if you feel something starting to explode, try to blink real hard.

Lastly, remember, we're looking for an evil shadow monster. You don't need to kill it, we just need you to see it so we can report it as evidence.

Alright, go get in that arena and try them out!

passages.title: The Mollivox Goggle Experiment
passages.text: <Mollivox listens intently as you recount the horror that you witnessed within the arena.>

passages.title: Undercover Agent: Nugg Lumbo
passages.text:
I've got one more suspect I'm investigating: Libbiara Blightrunner. She's a wealthy blood elf death knight socialite who spends most of her time spectating the arena from the zeppelin up above.

I've got my best agent on the case: Nugg Lumbo. Check in with him to see how his report is coming along.

passages.title: Undercover Agent: Nugg Lumbo
passages.text:
Shh! No blow Nugg cover.

She over there. You go talk. Nugg watch.

passages.title: Flaunt It If You Got It
passages.text:
Sigh... so dull...

Oh, it's you! <name>, was it? I've seen a few of your fights. They're slightly less tedious than the standard humdrum bloodsport this arena has been producing lately.

Let's spice things up a bit. Maybe buy some expensive drinks for ourselves? Buy a round of the cheap stuff for the riffraff below? Maybe even toss a few amberseed buns off the boat?

passages.title: Flaunt It If You Got It
passages.text: <The death knight socialite sighs.>

passages.title: Flaunt It If You Got It
passages.text:
Ha hah! I KNEW you knew how to party.

I'm in a much better mood now. This is the most entertained I've been since that quartermaster was murdered!

passages.title: Modular Construction
passages.text:
The Abandoned Junkheap is home to some seriously deadly gnomish constructs. These constructs contain Mecha-Cores which could come in handy for crafting the Ub3r-Spanner. Legend has it that it could forge creations unlike anything we've ever seen!

You look like the adventurous type, <name>. Can you go scrap up some mechs?

Don't forget your Arclight Spanner!

passages.title: Children's Week
passages.text:
Thank you for offering your help with Children's Week, <name>. We have a little girl who is excited to explore Zandalar!

Take dis whistle. With it, you will be able to call de child you have agreed to take care of dis week. It will serve no use after Children's Week ends.

When you are ready, use de whistle and meet your new ward! She is a feisty one.

passages.title: Children's Week
passages.text:
Who are you? My name's Azala.

My ma'da and fa'da died when I was little. I've been living here since den, with de other casteless kids. 

Since we don't have castes, we gotta try real hard to have good lives when we're grown. If we don't got a connection to de loa or skills dat we can use in battle, we're on our own.

I'm not much of a fighter, but I like de loa. Take me around Zandalar to meet de different loa so dat I can make a connection to dem!

passages.title: Loa of Winds
passages.text:
I heard dat Pa'ku lives somewhere in Zuldazar. Her priests tell stories about her when dey come to de Hall of Castes.

She's a pretty popular loa. I mean, she's in charge of de sky AND de sea! Dat's a lot of blue, and blue is my favorite color!

Maybe I could be one of her followers?

passages.title: Loa of Winds
passages.text: Do you think dat I'll get wings if I follow Pa'ku?

passages.title: Loa of Winds
passages.text: I don't know about dis, <name>. De pterrorchicks are pretty cute, but I'm not sure how I feel about heights.

passages.title: The Frogmarsh
passages.text:
De caretakers are always telling us stories in de Hall of Castes. Sometimes dey warn us about danger, sometimes dey're about de loa... dere's usually a point to dem.

One time, dey told us about Krag'wa, and how blood trolls killed his followers, and how he hasn't been seen since.

But I heard dat he's back! He's in Nazmir again, and he's plotting his revenge against de blood trolls.

Can we go see him?

passages.title: The Frogmarsh
passages.text: Where do loa go when dey don't have followers? I hope dey aren't too sad.

passages.title: The Frogmarsh
passages.text:
If I followed Krag'wa, would he eat me? Or not eat me?

I don't want to find out.

passages.title: The Shifting Pack
passages.text:
Dere's one loa I'm extra interested in seeing: Gonk! I've heard de priests say dat he's de most welcoming of de loa. He even lets his followers worship other loa as well!

But de best thing about him is dat he and his followers can change into many forms. I want to do dat!

Will you take me to meet him?

passages.title: The Shifting Pack
passages.text: Gonk's followers can turn into lots of different things. I think dey're pretty great.

passages.title: The Shifting Pack
passages.text:
Did you see how Gonk changed me into all dose shapes?

Maybe one day I can do dat by myself!

passages.title: Hunting for Gold
passages.text:
I know dis trip is supposed to focus on de loa...

But I want to see de island of gold!

I heard stories of undead pirates and an island covered in gold coins and treasure! Can we go see it?! 

Pleeeease?

passages.title: Hunting for Gold
passages.text: An island made entirely of gold? I gotta see it!

passages.title: Hunting for Gold
passages.text: It's hard to leave so many shinies behind, but curses are some nasty voodoo!

passages.title: The Sethrak Queen
passages.text:
De caretakers are always talking about how de sethrak attack caravans... but dey say dat de sethrak and de Zandalari used to be friends!

I heard dat dere are some sethrak who still want to be friends, and dat dey have a loa who wants peace more dan anything!

Can you take me to meet de sethrak and deir loa? I want to meet dem for myself!

passages.title: The Sethrak Queen
passages.text: Do you think de sethrak queen is pretty? Do you think she has shinies?

passages.title: The Sethrak Queen
passages.text:
Sethraliss seems wise... but very scary, too.

...Are you sure we can't go back for de shiny?

passages.title: Return to the Hall of Castes
passages.text:
I can't believe I got to visit so many places. I've never even left Zuldazar before!

I may be casteless, but now dat I've met so many loa, maybe I can follow one and have a future off of de streets.

But for now, we should go back to de Hall of Castes. De caretakers must be waiting for me.

passages.title: Return to the Hall of Castes
passages.text: Wait til de others hear about my trip!

passages.title: Return to the Hall of Castes
passages.text: You know, I kinda missed dis place.

passages.title: Dark Ranger Round-Up
passages.text:
These night elf ambushes have left us undermanned. We need reinforcements if we are to hold Darkshore.

Brynja, one of the Dark Lady's val'kyr, can provide us with those reinforcements. Slay the night elves and command her to raise them into our service. Should any prove unwilling... deal with them.

Did I not make myself clear? Go. The Dark Lady has plans for these dark rangers.

passages.title: Dark Ranger Round-Up
passages.text: How quickly they turn against their own goddess.

passages.title: More Power
passages.text:
Welcome back, dear test subject.

My dear sister has kindly asked me to administer today's experiment, which falls below our typical standards of legality...

You may, as always, choose not to participate and we will acquire sufficient replacement test subjects.

Our new project requires more energy than our generator can manage. We must supercharge it with a jolt of power from the outside.

Bondo's Yard has the best power line in Mechagon, so we shall siphon what we need from those rapscallions.

passages.title: More Power
passages.text: Our generator is bristling with power... I've never felt so alive!

passages.title: Grease The Wheels
passages.text:
Kerchunk said you guys was working on getting that mechaspider running again. Well I'm not gonna let you have all the fun!

That rusty old thing's gonna need a lot of grease to get moving again. So I jury-rigged a special Grease Trap to help you gather grease from the slimes nearby.

passages.title: Grease The Wheels
passages.text: That was greasy work, glad it wasn't me doing it!

passages.title: Rocket Hop
passages.text: Horde forces are attacking Tiragarde Sound. Make them regret every footstep upon our soil!

passages.title: Our New Friends
passages.text:
I heard that the Alliance is growing! More and more different kinds of people are joining all the time to fight the mean Horde.

I'm not sure where the embassy is, but I heard it's somewhere here in Stormwind. Can you show me how to get there? I want to see all our new friends!

passages.title: Our New Friends
passages.text: I bet all of our new friends came from really far away!

passages.title: Our New Friends
passages.text: We have so many new friends in the city now! I hope they'll play with me!

passages.title: Romp in the Swamp
passages.text: Alliance armies are landing on the shores of Nazmir. Drive them back to the sea. Zandalar is ours!

passages.title: Romp in the Swamp
passages.text: Nazmir belongs to the Zandalari, and the Horde!

passages.title: Romp in the Swamp
passages.text:
Thank you, <name>. We cannot allow anyone to take dis land from us.

Not de blood trolls. Not de Alliance. Not any outsiders.

Dis land belong to de Zandalari... and de Horde. Forever.

passages.title: Strong New Allies
passages.text:
I heard some adventurers saying that there are new members of the Horde, unlike all the rest! And the best part? They're right here in Orgrimmar!

I don't know where the embassy is... but I bet you do! Can you take me? I heard there are orcs from another planet!

passages.title: Strong New Allies
passages.text: New friends in Orgrimmar! That means I can come back and visit them all the time.

passages.title: Strong New Allies
passages.text: Our new friends are so cool! I can't wait to come back and visit all the time.

passages.title: Set Sail
passages.text: Assist the Horde by collecting Azerite on Island Expeditions.

passages.title: Set Sail
passages.text: Assist the Alliance by collecting Azerite on Island Expeditions.

passages.title: Gnomeregan's New Guardians
passages.text:
My personally-modified Mayhem Detection Device has been giving readings off the charts for the last few days. You might be thinking that mayhem and Gnomeregan are synonymous, and to an extent they are, but these readings are beyond anything I've seen before!

I'm not totally sure what's going on inside of Gnomeregan, but something is different. If you are feeling brave enough, I can teleport you deep in there and you can see for yourself.

Let me know when you are ready.

passages.title: Gnomeregan's New Guardians
passages.text: I can teleport you in. Getting out might be more of a challenge.

passages.title: Gnomeregan's New Guardians
passages.text: Someone stole a schematic from one of Thermaplugg's inventions?  This isn't good, we've heard that a mischievous group has been collecting odd parts from the Wailing Caverns and the Deadmines as well. What crazy thing could they be doing? Who is this group? We better start finding some answers, and soon.

passages.title: Battle of Dazar'alor
passages.text:
Zandalar is already under attack! My people are fleeing and de Alliance are infesting my streets.

Rakera's scouts say dat Jaina Proudmoore is leading de assault.

She and her kind will pay for dis brazen assault on my people. 

Gather your allies and push de Alliance back. We must protect my father and destroy de Alliance!

passages.title: Battle of Dazar'alor
passages.text:
To say that this attack was catastrophic would be an understatement. We have lost our major weapon in this war.

You did manage to give us some victories, though. Mekkatorque is dead, and Jaina Proudmoore badly injured.

Get your rest. Lady Sylvanas has been informed of what has happened and is forming a counterattack as we speak.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: War Resources
passages.text: A generous donation. I will let the commander know of your contributions.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Platinum Ore
passages.text: Your donation will not be forgotten.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Star Moss
passages.text: Very generous of ya, <name>.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Storm Silver Ore
passages.text: This should be enough.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Electroshock Mount Motivator
passages.text: These should give our allies the boost they need!

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Unstable Temporal Time Shifter
passages.text: With a donation like this you are truly saving our hide.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: XA-1000 Surface Skimmer
passages.text: Oh yes! This will do quite nicely!

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Umbra Shard
passages.text:
Dese are hard ta come by, you know?

We be appreciatin' ya donation to da cause.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Thermo-Accelerated Plague Spreader
passages.text: Our enemies will be quite surprised to have to deal with these!

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Potion of Rising Death
passages.text: Yes. These will do just fine.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Potion of Bursting Blood
passages.text: Dese will do quite nicely.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Potion of Replenishment
passages.text: Fine work.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Crimson Ink
passages.text: Yes. This will do.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Gold
passages.text:
Our friends here are accepting all kinds of donations on behalf of the war effort, but if ya ask me, no battle was ever won without proper funding. That's right, bub. I'm talking about money! And lots of it.

If you got it, we need it!

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Gold
passages.text:
A <class> like you's surely gotta have a little extra cash in your stash.

Waddaya say? Lemme help lighten your load a bit?

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Gold
passages.text: Ain't nothin' more valuable than sweet, sweet gold.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Ultramarine Ink
passages.text: You are very kind, <name>. Thank you.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Deep Sea Satin
passages.text: Our allies will be delighted. Thank you.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Tidespray Linen Bandage
passages.text: These will help immensely.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Tidespray Linen Net
passages.text: I'll be sure to send these along.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Deep Sea Bandage
passages.text: I suspect these will tend to many a wound.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Shimmerscale Diving Suit
passages.text: They're never gonna see us coming!

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Blood-Stained Bone
passages.text:
Bones are abundant these days, but only within our fallen allies and foes. We need stronger bones, from the beasts of these lands.

Have you come across any in your travels?

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Blood-Stained Bone
passages.text: These will do perfectly.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Shimmerscale Diving Helmet
passages.text:
I was just about done filling orders for the next shipment then realized I was out of diving helmets!

Do you think you can help me fill the remaining orders?

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Shimmerscale Diving Helmet
passages.text: Many thanks.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Mistscale
passages.text: Our leatherworking supplies having been running low. If you're able to spare any, it would go a long way in preparing our allies for the battle to come.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Mistscale
passages.text: Quite the contribution. Thank you, <name>.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Quick Golden Beryl
passages.text: Your donation is most appreciated.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Scarlet Diamond
passages.text: Good work. I'll get them loaded into our shipment immediately.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Sand Shifter
passages.text: I'll make sure these get to our allies. Thank you.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Stringy Loins
passages.text:
I will pass these along.

Thanks for your donation.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Wild Berry Bread
passages.text: I knew I could count on you.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Seasoned Steak and Potatoes
passages.text: Don't worry, <name>. I'll make sure these get to our allies.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: War Resources
passages.text: Thank you for your contribution.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Storm Silver Ore
passages.text: Our miners work their hands down to the bone gathering materials fer us, but they can only find so much. Ye wouldn't happen ta have any spare storm silver, would ye?

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Storm Silver Ore
passages.text: Fantastic! This will get us closer to our goal.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Winter's Kiss
passages.text:
Our winter's kiss supplies are running low.

You wouldn't happen to be an herbalist? Or know an herbalist? Or have some winter's kiss with you?

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Winter's Kiss
passages.text: That should put us back in business. Thank you, <name>.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Platinum Ore
passages.text: Ore isn't easy ta come by nowadays and platinum ore is even harder. But if ye have any ta spare, it would go a long way.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Platinum Ore
passages.text: Every bit helps. Many thanks, <name>.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: XA-1000 Surface Skimmer
passages.text:
Ye look like the kind o' <lad/lass> that ought ta be carryin' loads o' ore around with ya! If my assumption is right about ye, we could use yer help to gather a bit more ore for the war effort.

Have ye any ore ta spare?

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: XA-1000 Surface Skimmer
passages.text: The battle may take to the sea, and we need deployable means of dealing with our enemies.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: XA-1000 Surface Skimmer
passages.text: By land or sea, our enemies have nowhere to run now. Many thanks.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Thermo-Accelerated Plague Spreader
passages.text:
It's not just our allies we need to protect in the upcoming battle, but our equine friends as well!

Can you lend a hand and ensure our allies receive the best possible armor for the battle ahead?

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Thermo-Accelerated Plague Spreader
passages.text: Our allies are in need of offensive choices in the battle to come.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Thermo-Accelerated Plague Spreader
passages.text: The enemy will never know what him them.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Umbra Shard
passages.text:
Battles are won by those with power. Power comes from within oneself.

But enchantments help too and our supplies are running low.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Umbra Shard
passages.text:
These are hard to come by, you know?

We appreciate your donation to the cause.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Enchant Ring - Seal of Haste
passages.text: We need more enchantments for our troops!

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Enchant Ring - Seal of Haste
passages.text:
These will do nicely.

Thank you for your support.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Potion of Rising Death
passages.text: Our combat potions are running low. Any you can spare would be greatly appreciated.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Potion of Rising Death
passages.text: Splendid.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Enchant Ring - Seal of Mastery
passages.text: Have you seen any of these lately?

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Enchant Ring - Seal of Mastery
passages.text: You're quite the gem, aren't you?

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Potion of Replenishment
passages.text: With preparation comes success.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Potion of Replenishment
passages.text: My thanks.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Crimson Ink
passages.text:
Enlightenment guides our path to victory. In battle, we fight as one.

Share your knowledge and skills with me. Generosity is never forgotten.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Crimson Ink
passages.text: Enlightenment presents opportunity for victory.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Crimson Ink
passages.text: Your gift is most appreciated.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Potion of Bursting Blood
passages.text: The opportunity for strength and fortitude present themselves when facing difficult situations.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Potion of Bursting Blood
passages.text: May preparation guide us, and bravery shine within.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Contract: 7th Legion
passages.text:
Greetings!

With the war effort in full swing I'll be your point of contact for herbalism and alchemical donations! It's a pleasure to meet you!

Now, let's see here... Ah, yes. Siren's Pollen. It appears our stockpiles reported a shortage as of late last night. It would be a great help to us all if you were able to donate to our efforts.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Contract: 7th Legion
passages.text: Have some contracts for me?

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Contract: 7th Legion
passages.text: These will ensure that those we hire will be bound by more than just words.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Gold
passages.text:
We've spent a great deal of time and resources preparing for the battle to come. 

As we begin final preparations, we'll be setting aside additional funding to ensure further training and supplies are available at a moment's notice. 

Would you like to make a donation?

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Gold
passages.text:
As we begin final preparations, we'll be setting aside additional funding to ensure further training and supplies are available at a moment's notice.

Would you like to make a donation?

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Gold
passages.text: How generous of you, <name>.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Ultramarine Ink
passages.text:
Greetings, traveler.

I was asked to ensure our food supplies are never left wanting and our fish supplies have been running low lately. Have anything you would care to donate?

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Ultramarine Ink
passages.text:
I was asked to ensure our inscription supplies are never left wanting, though lately they have been running low.

Have any ink you would care to donate?

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Ultramarine Ink
passages.text: This will do just fine. I'll be sure our scribes are given an ample supply for the battle to come.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Deep Sea Satin
passages.text:
Fish--it's what's for dinner! Or so say our supply officers. And this weeks meals are based around one delicious ingredient--catfish.

If we're going to keep our allies well fed and full of fish we'll need to gather more stock and begin meal preparations soon. 

If you find yourself swimming in an abundance of catfish I'd be happy to send them along to our stores.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Deep Sea Satin
passages.text:
If we're going to keep our casters clothed, we'll need to make sure our stockpile is ready.

If you find yourself swimming in an abundance of deep sea satin I'd be happy to send them along to our stores.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Deep Sea Satin
passages.text: Our allies will be delighted. Thank you.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Shimmerscale Diving Suit
passages.text:
Hey there!

Transmission's come down from up top--we need more ammunition! Something with a bit more kick. Something really unexpected!

From what I've heard there's a special frost-based ammunition crafted only by the most experienced engineers. If you were to bring me a few I'm sure our munitions officers would be ecstatic!

Maybe they'd even let me keep one to examine!

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Shimmerscale Diving Suit
passages.text:
I've heard there's a special underwater suit that's crafted by the most experienced of leatherworkers.

If you were to bring me a few of these I'm sure our aquatic forces would be ecstatic!

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Shimmerscale Diving Suit
passages.text:
Wow! These are magnificent! The craftsmanship alone is... 

Apologies, I get carried away sometimes.

Take care!

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Tidespray Linen Net
passages.text:
Though our ammunition stockpiles are faring well, it's my duty to find additional resources, especially those that are harder to come by.

Today I'm looking for a specific type of ammunition, one with incendiary properties. I could really use your help tracking a few of these down.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Tidespray Linen Net
passages.text:
If we're going to handle our enemies rushing our allies, we'll need something sturdy to slow them down.

I've heard tailors can produce some fine netting. Would you happen to have any?

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Tidespray Linen Net
passages.text: I'll be sure to send these along.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Tidespray Linen Bandage
passages.text: Spectacular! These will help immensely.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Deep Sea Bandage
passages.text:
You never know when you'll need to deliver a big bang on the battlefield, if you know what I mean. Luckily we can plan for the unexpected!

We've begun to store a special stockpile of explosives for scenarios where we'll need a little something extra to get our point across. I've added one particular item to the list. 

If you have any to spare I'll make sure they're put to good use.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Deep Sea Bandage
passages.text:
We've started a special stockpile of bandages for scenarios where we'll need a little something extra to keep our allies going. I've added one particular item to the list.

If you have any to spare I'll make sure they're put to good use.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Deep Sea Bandage
passages.text: I suspect these will tend to many a wound.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Blood-Stained Bone
passages.text: I know it's short notice, but I'm trying to find a few more bones to add to our next shipment.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Blood-Stained Bone
passages.text: Nice work! These bones smell... well, they'll work for what we need.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Shimmerscale Diving Helmet
passages.text:
I was just about done filling orders for the next shipment then realized I was out of diving helmets!

Do you think you can help me fill the remaining orders?

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Shimmerscale Diving Helmet
passages.text: Thanks for helping keep things on track. Where would we be without generous people like you?

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Mistscale
passages.text:
I've been able to keep pace with our orders until recently. Now I'm afraid I won't be able to keep up without help.

Would you be willing to donate a few supplies?

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Mistscale
passages.text: I knew I could count on you.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Masterful Kubiline
passages.text:
A nice, hearty meat provides the nourishment our allies deserve before shipping off to battle, not to mention it also makes quite a stew, something our troops seem to rather enjoy when the winds are at their best and the chill of night lingers in the air.

If you bring me some freshly seasoned loins I would be more than happy to deliver it to our supply officers.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Masterful Kubiline
passages.text:
Our jewelcrafters work night and day preparing gems for the battle to come.

If you have any spare cut gems, it would help alleviate their burden.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Masterful Kubiline
passages.text: I'll get these to our supply officers right away.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Quick Golden Beryl
passages.text:
A nice, hearty meat provides the nourishment our allies deserve before shipping off to battle, not to mention it also makes quite a stew, something our troops seem to rather enjoy when the winds are at their best and the chill of night lingers in the air.

If you bring me some freshly seasoned loins I would be more than happy to deliver it to our supply officers.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Quick Golden Beryl
passages.text: Enhancement gems go a long way. If we're to endure the battle, we've got to be prepared.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Quick Golden Beryl
passages.text:
These will be adequate.

Thank you, <name>.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Sand Shifter
passages.text:
In times like this it's important ta be ready fer battle at a moments notice. Outfittin' our beasts with proper stirrups is a step in the right direction.

If yer able ta bring me a few I'll be sure they're put ta good use.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Sand Shifter
passages.text: Our food supplies are running low. Specifically our supply of fish. Would you happen to be a master angler?

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Sand Shifter
passages.text: Perfect, this is plenty.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Scarlet Diamond
passages.text:
Battles aren't decided by which side has the best armor, or the sharpest blades, but it sure does help! Matter o' fact is it's not just ye allies needin' help, but our beasts of battle as well.

If ye can provide any additional hoofplates fer our brave beasts I'll be sure ta have our farriers take good care of 'em.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Scarlet Diamond
passages.text:
We have our own jewelcrafters hard at work, adoring armor with their special cuts.

However, our supply of raw gems is rather low. Have you any to spare?

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Scarlet Diamond
passages.text: Quite generous of you, <name>. I'll be sure they're put to good use.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Stringy Loins
passages.text:
One of our latest shipments of alchemical supplies was raided en route to storage. We're scrambling to get our stock back on track, but I'm worried we won't make our quota.

You wouldn't happen to know where one can acquire additional mana potions, would you?

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Stringy Loins
passages.text: Our food stock has been running low trying to keep everyone fed. Do you have any supplies you can spare?

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Stringy Loins
passages.text: This is just what I was looking for.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Seasoned Steak and Potatoes
passages.text: I've received word our allies are looking to stash away a few supplementary items for the battle to come. If you happen to stumble across a few Coastal Healing Potions I'd be more than happy to add them to our stores.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Seasoned Steak and Potatoes
passages.text:
A hearty meal provides the nourishment our allies deserve.

If you bring me some freshly seasoned steak and potatoes I would be more than happy to deliver it to our supply officers.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Seasoned Steak and Potatoes
passages.text:
Mmm...

<Senedras takes in the scent of the food you've brought him.>

This smells delicious. Thank you, <name>.

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Wild Berry Bread
passages.text: Have you heard of this new dessert the chefs are making? I think it's called Wild Berry Bread. You wouldn't happen to have any, would you?

passages.title: Darkshore Donations: Wild Berry Bread
passages.text: Thank you for giving us so much.

passages.title: Battle of Dazar'alor
passages.text:
Our naval forces are ready to sail for Zuldazar. By the time we're there, the Horde and Zandalari forces should be in Nazmir.

Keeshan and Kelsey checked on the bombs placed within Zuldazar harbor. They're primed and ready to destroy the Zandalari fleet.

Gather any of your allies and prepare to set sail for Zuldazar. 

We will strike down the Zandalari and remove the Horde's most powerful ally from this war.

passages.title: Battle of Dazar'alor
passages.text: We must move, there is no more time.

passages.title: Battle of Dazar'alor
passages.text:
We have achieved victory, but at a grave cost. Mekkatorque is dead, frozen within a device from his mech.

Lady Jaina is being tended to by our best healers. She is badly wounded, but should survive.

As for Telaamon... our scouts found his body torn to shreds. Every last soldier sent to Nazmir was killed.

But we did it. The Zandalari fleet is decimated, and King Rastakhan is dead.

Our war with the Horde is almost over. King Anduin will wish to speak with us soon.

passages.title: Twice-Exiled
passages.text:
Elementals of all sorts are bursting free of their bonds across the Highlands.

Return them to the primordial chaos from whence they came.

passages.title: The League Will Lose
passages.text:
Even with the fall of Stromgarde, the League of Arathor continues to operate in the Highlands.

The northern farmland will belong to the Horde. Go, and defeat the humans.

passages.title: Boulderfist Beatdown
passages.text:
If the Boulderfist ogres will not join the Horde, there is no place for them in Arathi.

You know what must be done.

passages.title: Wiping Out the Witherbark
passages.text:
The bloodthirsty Witherbark tribe has always refused to join the Horde... and now that the Horde holds Arathi, we will succeed where the Alliance has failed.

Drive the forest trolls from the Highlands.

passages.title: Twice-Exiled
passages.text:
Elementals of all sorts are bursting free of their bonds across the Highlands.

Return them to the primordial chaos from whence they came.

passages.title: Boulderfist Beatdown
passages.text:
The Boulderfist ogres have plagued Arathi since the Second War, and they still remain.

You know what must be done.

passages.title: Wiping Out the Witherbark
passages.text:
The Witherbark tribe has a long and bloody history in the highlands of Arathi.

Show them how much bloodier it can get.

passages.title: Paragon of the Honorbound
passages.text: Commanders of the Honorbound forces have requested your presence. They wish to reward you for your exceptional efforts.

passages.title: Paragon of the Honorbound
passages.text:
Huntmaster, thanks to your efforts against the Alliance, our forces have been able to secure additional resources from the battlefield.

The more you continue to dominate the battlefield the more resources our forces can spare.

passages.title: G.E.A.R. Up
passages.text:
That was a close one, but we managed to defeat Sparkspanner! Gnomanity and Azeroth are saved from a threat they didn't even know about.

Hopefully, that's the last time we'll hear from any of Thermaplugg's old goons.

We should return to Captain Sparknozzle. He will want a full report.

passages.title: G.E.A.R. Up
passages.text: At attention, soldier!

passages.title: Lumbering Along
passages.text:
We will need more lumber if we're going to build up Bashal'Aran into a proper fortress.

You should find an axe in the supplies we brought in for the effort. Grab it, and see what you can do with it to help us get our base rebuilt.

passages.title: Lumbering Along
passages.text: We need that wood to accomplish our goals here.

passages.title: Lumbering Along
passages.text: I thought I smelled fresh sawdust. This wood will go a long way toward building our forces here.

passages.title: For the Queen
passages.text:
<You chose not to side with the traitor Saurfang and his troll lackey.

Now that you know where Saurfang is, and who is with him, you should report to Sylvanas to see if she has any further orders.>

passages.title: For the Queen
passages.text:
Your loyalty will not go unrewarded, champion. Lyana departed here only moments ago.

I have dispatched the dark ranger and a contingent of loyal deathguard to apprehend the traitor Saurfang in Swamp of Sorrows.

He may come peacefully, or he may not. Your hands should not, in any case, be bloodied in this confrontation. You are to remain a hero, golden in the eyes of the people, as we have need of.

And as for that troll you mentioned, I have special plans for him.

passages.title: Thank Your Guide
passages.text:
The balance has been restored, and Thunder Bluff is safe. Thank you.

We owe our victory to your spirit's guidance. We must honor the old ways by giving thanks to the ones who came before us.

To the southwest lies a beautiful vista where my father once took me. It would be a fitting place to reflect upon all that has transpired.

Please take this offering there to honor our ancestors.

passages.title: Thank Your Guide
passages.text: <You find a set of traditional <race> vestments and a ceremonial totem.>

passages.title: What's For Lunch?
passages.text:
My Shadowtrade Mercenaries will fight for Stormarion Cores, no questions asked, but they do get hungry also!

Food is quite scarce here, so we need supplies!

Take a mercenary out with you and find some food for them to eat. I'll make it worth your while!

passages.title: What's For Lunch?
passages.text: Is that mercenary well fed?

passages.title: What's For Lunch?
passages.text: When it comes to mercenaries, nothing keeps them loyal like a full stomach... and gold.

passages.title: Stubborn as a Bronzebeard
passages.text:
It's kind o' Brann tae offer, but his flying machine would drop like a rock with me aboard. Best if it carry just the two of ye.

Brann will fly ye down to Uldir. I'll find me own way and meet ye inside.

passages.title: Stubborn as a Bronzebeard
passages.text: Ah good, I see ye've arrived in one piece. Now let's see if MOTHER can lend us a hand.

passages.title: More Mouths To Feed
passages.text:
The naga attack us relentlessly, so there is precious little time to hunt for food and supplies.

You have brought many soldiers to our camp, so we must hunt while we have the chance or we will soon run out of food.

passages.title: More Mouths To Feed
passages.text: The meat from this hunt shall nourish our bones.

passages.title: More Mouths To Feed
passages.text: There is nothing like fresh meat to strengthen the bones and lift the spirits of weary soldiers!

passages.title: Emergency First Aid
passages.text:
We have to patch everyone up before we can begin the search for the missing expedition.

Take this first aid kit and tend to the wounded.

passages.title: Emergency First Aid
passages.text: Walk up to Austin, Bjorn, and Kee-La and use the first aid kit to heal them. Do not move while using it.

passages.title: Emergency First Aid
passages.text: We're ready to move. Let's find that missing expedition.

passages.title: Under Lock and Keys
passages.text:
Three keys? It seems Sylvanas didn't trust any one member of this crew to have access to Proudmoore.

We won't be able to rescue Derek Proudmoore if we can't get his cage open. 

We'll need to keep an eye out for keys while we clear the ship.

passages.title: Under Lock and Keys
passages.text: This will all be for nothing if we can't open that lock...

passages.title: Under Lock and Keys
passages.text:
We've done it!

I was worried I would have to try to bend the cage bars apart.

passages.title: A Way Home
passages.text:
We are only alive thanks to the ankoan and Azshara's desire to toy with us.

We will learn more of Okani's people in the times ahead, I am sure.

For now, we must establish a portal home. While Azshara is blocking our traditional methods of magical travel, I can sense a powerful convergence of energies nearby.

I believe we can use it to open a way home.

passages.title: A Way Home
passages.text: We are exceptionally lucky to have met the ankoan. Perhaps things are not as dire as they seem.

passages.title: Against Overwhelming Odds
passages.text:
We've received numerous reports of the Horde overwhelming our forces within both Kul Tiras and Zandalar. 

Brute forcing the Alliance with sheer numbers is an age-old tactic of the Horde, but we can't allow them to get the upper hand.

Venture forth throughout and thin their numbers the best you can. I recommend bringing reinforcements.

passages.title: Against Overwhelming Odds
passages.text: Great work, <class>.

passages.title: Against Overwhelming Odds
passages.text:
It appears we've allowed the Alliance forces to fester. If these reports are correct, they're outnumbering us in nearly every bastion we hold. 

Arm yourself, grab a few of your most trusted allies and put them into the ground, <class>!

passages.title: Under False Colors
passages.text:
If we wish to stay the executioner's axe, we'll need to throw Sylvanas off of our scent. I will take the ship near Chandlery Wharf, which has recently been taken by Irontide pirates. There, I will leave it under the guise of a pirate raid gone wrong.

Your task will be to ensure that Sylvanas' forces find this ship.

You must report to Nathanos that you spotted a stolen Forsaken vessel in that area. You have no connection to Derek Proudmoore, so it should raise no suspicions.

passages.title: Under False Colors
passages.text: Out with it, <class>.

passages.title: Under False Colors
passages.text:
A pirate crew dared abscond with a vessel of the Dark Lady's fleet? Clearly, they must be made to pay. I will dispatch our forces to search the area for the stolen ship. 

Thank you for this information, <name>. I will personally inform the Dark Lady of your... involvement.

passages.title: The Financial Participation Incentive
passages.text:
I see Lord Browne running some sort of game over there. Getting people to guess the fight's winner in exchange for Brawler's Gold.

See if you can figure out how his game works. If you win enough money from him, he might start talking...

passages.title: The Financial Participation Incentive
passages.text: Lookin' to make some gold, old chap?

passages.title: The Financial Participation Incentive
passages.text: Say, <name>, was it? You're not half bad at this! You'll put me in the poor house if you keep this up!

passages.title: Lord Browne's Debts
passages.text:
I've always said that I'm not too proud to commit a few acts of violence to set a wrong right. And you know what's wrong? I'm out of money!

Only one person's won more gold from me than you have, and his name's Lord Sylysthrel. Quite the scoundrel, that one. I believe he was cheating.

It sure would be nice if I could get that gold back...

passages.title: Lord Browne's Debts
passages.text: Once I get back the gold I lost, then I can REALLY start gambling!

passages.title: Lord Browne's Debts
passages.text:
<Lord Browne stares, misty-eyed, at the huge pile of money.>

I do love gold. There is nothing I wouldn't do to get my hands on gold. Indeed, I would stoop quite low to pick up a single piece of gold. And I have in the past!

passages.title: Soul Splinters
passages.text:
<O'Flannerty mumbles to himself.>

Achh, what a mess... it's getting hungry again. Where am I going to find enough souls to feed it? Ohh... if only I could get my hands on some of those brawler's purses...

<He notices you.>

Oh! Ahoy there! Pay no attention to the mindless babbling of an innocent warlock. Nothing suspicious going on here!

passages.title: Soul Splinters
passages.text: Oh dear, oh dear... must not let it get too hungry...

passages.title: Soul Splinters
passages.text: These... these might help! They'll help me with... my problem that I have. That I can't tell you about.

passages.title: Super Soul Splinters
passages.text:
<O'Flannerty mutters to himself again:>

Will these be big enough, though? It gets SO hungry for souls, and when it doesn't get enough, it gets angry, and we definitely don't want to trigger a void apocalypse in the middle of Stormwind. Oh dear, oh dear...

<He notices you lingering.>

Oh! The <race> is still here! Heh heh. Never mind me! Nothing evil going on here!!

passages.title: Super Soul Splinters
passages.text:
<O'Flannerty looks around the arena in a panic.>

Where can I find more souls? Maybe the quartermaster sells some? Oh, right, he's dead. Hmm...

passages.title: Super Soul Splinters
passages.text:
These... are... PERFECT!

Now if you'll please give me some privacy, I have some completely harmless shadow magic to perform. Goodbye!

passages.title: The Precious 13-Tooth Gogglegear
passages.text:
We're going to have to invent something. Something capable of seeing into alternate dimensions. Something explosive that you strap directly onto your eyes.

That's right, I'm talking about goggles.

I already have all the goggle parts except for one: a 13-tooth gear. They're nearly impossible to find, but I KNOW that the G.G. Engineering boys have one, and Card Trader Leila has their challenge card.

passages.title: The Precious 13-Tooth Gogglegear
passages.text: Are you ready to goggle up?

passages.title: The Precious 13-Tooth Gogglegear
passages.text:
<Saralara forcefully smashes the gear into a pair of goggles.>

There! Goggles done.

passages.title: The Fizzlesprang Goggle Experiment
passages.text:
Okay, before we start, I've got a few rules:

First, these goggles will only work at close range. We're looking for something INSIDE the arena, so you'll have to be inside the arena to use them.

Second rule: if you feel something starting to explode, try to blink real hard.

Lastly, remember, we're looking for an evil shadow monster. You don't need to kill it, we just need you to see it so we can report it as evidence.

Alright, go get in that arena and try them out!

passages.title: The Fizzlesprang Goggle Experiment
passages.text: <Saralara listens intently as you recount the horror that you witnessed within the arena.>

passages.title: Undercover Agent: Silent Jussho
passages.text:
I've got one more suspect I'm investigating: Grant Lazarby. He's a wealthy worgen death knight socialite who spends most of his time spectating the arena from the VIP area.
