I've got my best agent on the case: Silent Jussho. Check in with him to see how his report is coming along.

passages.title: Undercover Agent: Silent Jussho
passages.text:
Shh! Don't blow my cover.

He's over there. You go talk to him. I'll watch.

passages.title: Flaunt It If You Got It
passages.text:
Sigh... so dull...

Oh, it's you! <name>, was it? I've seen a few of your fights. They're slightly less tedious than the standard humdrum bloodsport this arena has been producing lately.

Let's spice things up a bit. Maybe buy some expensive drinks for ourselves? Buy a round of the cheap stuff for the riffraff below? Maybe even toss a few amberseed buns at the combatants?

passages.title: Flaunt It If You Got It
passages.text:
Ha hah! I KNEW you knew how to party.

I'm in a much better mood now. This is the most entertained I've been since that quartermaster was murdered!

passages.title: It's Scrap Work...
passages.text:
<name>, I'm glad you stopped by.

The Ub3r-Spanner, capable of crafting powerful constructs, and its schematic have been lost for years. Intel tells us that its schematic is located in a locked cache in The Abandoned Junkheap.

You'll need to overcharge its electric barrier to gain access. Take my Current Culler and soak up some of the latent current from the sentries there and zap that chest open!

<Layla makes finger guns and explosion sounds>

Up for some treasure huntin'?

passages.title: It's Scrap Work...
passages.text: Did you find the schematic?

passages.title: It's Scrap Work...
passages.text: Great, let me see what it says!

passages.title: It's Scrap Work...
passages.text:
<name>, I'm glad you stopped by.

The Ub3r-Spanner, capable of crafting powerful constructs, and its schematic have been lost for years. Intel tells us that its schematic is located in a locked cache in The Abandoned Junkheap.

You'll need to overcharge its electric barrier to gain access. Take my Current Culler and soak up some of the latent current from the sentries there and zap that chest open!

<Shuga makes finger guns and explosion sounds>

Up for some treasure huntin'?

passages.title: It's Scrap Work...
passages.text: Did you find the schematic?

passages.title: It's Scrap Work...
passages.text: Great, let me see what it says!

passages.title: Unchained Resistance
passages.text:
The naga have enslaved a tribe of makrura and sent them to labor as mindless thralls.

The naga forces may be more in number, but the makrura have an innate advantage in both size and strength.

If we break the makrura from their chains, they will surely overwhelm their naga overseers and put a dent in Queen Azshara's plans.

passages.title: Unchained Resistance
passages.text: The makrura will make short work of their former masters.

passages.title: Unchained Resistance
passages.text: The naga will be no match for the makrura prisoners that we have freed.

passages.title: Under False Colors
passages.text:
If we wish to stay the executioner's axe, we'll need to throw Sylvanas off of our scent. You'll need to have your men take the ship to Chandlery Wharf, where they can disguise it as a pirate's bounty.

Your task will be to ensure that Sylvanas' forces find the ship there.

You must report to Nathanos that you spotted a stolen Forsaken vessel in that area. You have no connection to Derek Proudmoore, so it should raise no suspicions.

passages.title: Under False Colors
passages.text:
So not only did Baine and Zelling conspire to free Derek Proudmoore, but they turned him over to our enemy? 

They have signed their own death warrants.

Your assistance in this matter is appreciated, <name>. The Dark Lady will know of your loyalty.

passages.title: My Brother's Keeper
passages.text:
While I trust Valeera believes she is not leading us into a trap, I do not trust this isn't a Horde manipulation.

<name>, I want you to come with me. I will meet with Baine, but I will not do so alone.

passages.title: My Brother's Keeper
passages.text: This is... surprising news.

passages.title: My Brother's Keeper
passages.text:
He returned her brother?

That... took guts on his part. I wonder at the repercussions for both him and for us here.

passages.title: A Way Home
passages.text:
We can harness the power within this place to open a portal home.

I will require your assistance. Isn't this fun? You get to be my assistant!

Ah, yes. Just come with me and all you have to do is wave that Heart of Azeroth of yours around. I'll handle the rest.

passages.title: A Way Home
passages.text: A job well done!

passages.title: Blueprint: G99.99 Landshark
passages.text:
<This blueprint details how to build what appears to be a subterranean robot shark.

You should be able to upload the blueprint to Pascal-K1N6's database in Rustbolt.>

passages.title: Blueprint: G99.99 Landshark
passages.text:
Have you recovered a new blueprint, my fleshy friend?

I will add it to my database posthaste.

passages.title: Send My Father a Message
passages.text:
My people are once again safe... for now.

King Mechagon won't stop sending his armies at us as long as he does not fear us.

We must send him a message.

Climb to the top of the ramparts, and hack one of my father's projectors to proudly shine the banner of the Rustbolt Resistance big enough for the whole island to see.

I'm sure that'll attract the attention of my father, King Mechagon.

passages.title: Send My Father a Message
passages.text:
Rustbolt already looks improved, doesn't it?

It's not the first time we've had to rebuild it, and it won't be the last.

passages.title: Creature Study: Zanj'ir Naga
passages.text: <Scrawled upon the magical scroll are Maedin's incomplete notes on the Zanj'ir naga.>

passages.title: The Laboratory of Mardivas
passages.text:
<Several pages are devoted to notes on an experiment, a hastily written journal entry follows.>

At last, my research into the base elements has begun to bear fruit!

With careful application of the right base reagents and some arcane power I've managed to combine the essence of the elements in such a way as to create life!

Further investigation will be needed to determine what the various mixes of the elements will yield.

<The writing ends here.>

passages.title: The Laboratory of Mardivas
passages.text: <The remaining pages are filled with gibberish and strange doodles.>

passages.title: The Laboratory of Mardivas
passages.text: <The magic of the system appears to have been drained. Perhaps after some time has passed it can be used again.>

passages.title: For the Horde
passages.text:
Thank you for meeting me upon my throne, <name>.

With our recent partnerin' with de Horde, I need worthy champions to represent the might of the Zandalari. 

I have chosen you to be among their ranks, <name>. Go and meet with the ambassador in Orgrimmar. 

We have prepared a portal just behind you. When you are ready, step through to a new world.

Remember, you bow only to the throne of Zandalar. Hold your head high, <name>.

passages.title: For the Horde
passages.text:
Are you the new one? I'm supposed to welcome you. Here, take this letter.

<Blackguard lets out an exasperated sigh.>

passages.title: For the Alliance
passages.text:
Thank you for meeting with me, <name>.

I need representatives to go to Stormwind to represent our loyalty and commitment to our newly forged bond with the Alliance. 

I've had Yvia and her magi prepare a portal to the city for you in the Sanctum of the Sages. Once there, go to the Stormwind Embassy and meet with Ambassador Moorgard.

You will face many challenges on the long journey ahead. Remember where you came from and make your people proud!

passages.title: For the Alliance
passages.text: Welcome to Stormwind, <race>.

passages.title: For the Alliance
passages.text: There you are! You must be <name>. We've been expecting you.

passages.title: Cooking Meat
passages.text:
Alaria is nearly starved to death. We need to get her something to eat!

Slay some of the nearby wildlife for their meat. Bring whatever you find here to cook.

If we can help Alaria regain her strength, she might be able to tell us what happened to the others.

I'll stay here and help stabilize her wounds.

passages.title: Cooking Meat
passages.text: Please... I need... some food...

passages.title: Cooking Meat
passages.text:
<Alaria quickly eats the meat that you cooked.>

By the Light... I feel so much better.

You need to keep moving... quilboar have kidnapped the expedition, including Captain Garrick's son!

passages.title: Quilboar Shadow Magic
passages.text:
Quilboar are primitive and savage. They rarely practice any magic other than geomancy.

But these particular quilboar seem to be dabbling in shadow magic. They must be stopped.

Slay the quilboar in the den. They cannot spread this magic in the island!

passages.title: Quilboar Shadow Magic
passages.text: The quilboar are a powerful foe. Be careful.

passages.title: Quilboar Shadow Magic
passages.text: Good work. I hope those quilboar learn that necromancy is not a path to power.

passages.title: Stocking Up on Supplies
passages.text:
Quartermaster Richter was able to scavenge supplies from the wreckages on this island.

Why don't you visit her and see if she has anything that you need?

You'll want to be well equipped for whatever we encounter next.

passages.title: Stocking Up on Supplies
passages.text: Quartermaster Richter should have a few supplies that you could use.

passages.title: Stocking Up on Supplies
passages.text:
All stocked up? That's great.

Private Cole and Quartermaster Richter also found this bag in the nearby ruins. They thought you might make good use of it.

passages.title: Energy Cells for Everyone
passages.text:
The wondrous scuttlebutt around town is that the charging station in Bondo's Yard is going to be repaired today!

That charging station is the best way to recharge all the Empty Energy Cells that've been piling up in your bag. Or in other people's bag. Or inside the mechanical innards of robots you don't own but are legally allowed to destroy.

After you've acquired Empty Energy Cells, help build the charging station in Bondo's Yard and charge all of your Empty Energy Cells!

passages.title: Energy Cells for Everyone
passages.text:
Empty Energy Cells can always be found on the island, but the Charging Station isn't always available.

Chat with that wondrous Miss Gearhart if you want to know more.

passages.title: Energy Cells for Everyone
passages.text:
Wondrous! I hope those nasty troggs let you charge up in peace.

They simply do not comprehend technology to any degree. Frankly, I'm embarrassed for them.

passages.title: Fishing For Something Bigger
passages.text:
There's a huge fish lurking these waters, and it's been causing lots of problems! 

It eats other fish, fishermen, and a lot of expensive gear. I saw it swallow a beautiful Zigby 300 Fishing Rod along with its owner just the other day!

I've got a plan, but I've lost a lot of my equipment in the waters around here. Can you help fish up some of these items for me?

passages.title: Fishing For Something Bigger
passages.text: Did you get me the items?

passages.title: Fishing For Something Bigger
passages.text: Great work, <name>.  Now I can build the Minnow Vac!

passages.title: Knock 'Em Out The Box
passages.text:
Steelarm Pillagers have been taking all our parts and selling them to Bondo's gang.

Last night they stole all our Spiderspring Gears. The parts are in a bunch of crates they're guarding.

We need you to get our gears back, and show those Steelarm Pillagers they should pick on someone else.

passages.title: Knock 'Em Out The Box
passages.text: Get our gears back.

passages.title: Knock 'Em Out The Box
passages.text: Now we can assemble the mount's main spring drive!

passages.title: Scouting the Pens
passages.text:
Some of our scouts have not returned.

They have been keeping an eye on the Zanj'ir Slave Pens. 

The naga there take our people. They break their minds. Our scouts watch them, and when there is a window, they rescue them.

Something is going on. We need to get them home!

passages.title: Scouting the Pens
passages.text: Did we find everyone?

passages.title: Scouting the Pens
passages.text:
Thank you, <name>, for helping us.

We have lost too many, we can't stop here!

passages.title: The Stuff Dreams Are Made Of
passages.text:
All that remains is to throw the emerald fragments you collected into the lake. I will use my power to bind them together.

If this works, they will be reforged into a powerful dragonscale that you can use to empower the Heart of Azeroth.

I believe that my mother would be pleased that some of our power will go toward saving the world. I hope she would be proud of us.

passages.title: The Stuff Dreams Are Made Of
passages.text: These waters may no longer be tainted by the Void, but the green dragonflight must remain vigilant lest it ever return.

passages.title: The Stuff Dreams Are Made Of
passages.text: You hold the coalesced power of the green dragonflight in your hands, <name>. I trust you will use it well.

passages.title: What Will It Grow?
passages.text: <The small seed is starting to sprout. Perhaps there's a place nearby that it could be planted.>

passages.title: What Will It Grow?
passages.text: What have you brought me?

passages.title: What Will It Grow?
passages.text:
Ah, what do we have here? A rare plant, indeed! 

Coral Lashers are remarkable specimens. They grow rapidly after every meal, gaining both size and strength. 

The largest ones are exceptional, but also quite dangerous, so feed with caution.

passages.title: Aid From Nordrassil
passages.text:
Look at what they've done to this island, <name>.

Nature is nearly extinguished, its death cry falling on the deaf ears of mechagnomes.

But I have heard the teeny tiny animals of Mechagon, and bring aid from afar!

It won't be easy to restore balance to a land so severely wounded. Nature's scars run deep here.

Thankfully, we are not alone. I've brought living sap from Nordrassil, the World Tree of Mount Hyjal. Use it to regrow the forests and speed nature's recovery in this land.

passages.title: Aid From Nordrassil
passages.text:
A small steps towards bringing balance to Mechagon.

I thank you, <name>. And so do the adorable lil' animals who will find home in those trees you grew. I will report our progress back to the druids of Nordrassil.

passages.title: Scouting the Palace
passages.text:
We cannot hide here forever, <name>. We have to deal with Azshara.

We will need to assault her palace but we do not know what defenses she has in place. I dispatched a scouting team while you were gone and they have not reported back.

I cannot afford to lose any more people. Speak with Spiritwalker Ussoh. His abilities will let us see where the scouts are.

passages.title: Scouting the Palace
passages.text: Have you spoken with Ussoh yet?

passages.title: Scouting the Palace
passages.text: The Tidestone! Of course....

passages.title: Speak with the Dead
passages.text:
So many souls perished beneath the waves. Too many sacrificed for her ambition.

It is strange that the spirits here have not departed. I wonder if they even know they are dead?

Still, their knowledge might be useful to us. If you could question the spirits, they might be able to point us in the right direction.

passages.title: Speak with the Dead
passages.text: The Javelins? I thought them lost!

passages.title: Victory in Wintergrasp
passages.text:
Commander Zanneth might be satisfied with a pile of Horde corpses at his feet, but controlling Wintergrasp is of the utmost importance to the Valiance Expedition. Make sure it remains in our control.

However, don't think we'll just let you stand around while your allies do your dirty work for you. If you're not at least a second level recruit by the end of the battle, don't come back.

passages.title: Victory in Wintergrasp
passages.text: Just what I wanted to hear!  A victory in Lake Wintergrasp - even a temporary one - is crucial to our overall strategy against the Horde.

passages.title: Victory in Wintergrasp
passages.text:
While Dardosh might be content with slaying our foes, it is of the utmost importance that we control Wintergrasp Fortress. Do whatever it takes to ensure Wintergrasp is ours.

However, don't think we'll just let you stand around while your allies do your dirty work for you. If you're not at least a second level recruit by the end of the battle, don't come back.

passages.title: Victory in Wintergrasp
passages.text: It is a truly great thing you have accomplished this day. Be recognized for your sacrifice!

passages.title: No Mercy for the Merciless
passages.text: Welcome to Wintergrasp, <name>. Your mission is simple. Defeat ten of the Horde's finest. Now, go! Bring victory to the Alliance!

passages.title: No Mercy for the Merciless
passages.text: Glorious! Truly, you are among the champions of the Alliance.

passages.title: Slay them all!
passages.text:
Welcome to the Wintergrasp, <name>. Warlord Garrosh demands one thing: Slay them all!

Return to me when ten of the strongest members of the Alliance are dead.

passages.title: Slay them all!
passages.text: Lok'tar! Victory for the Horde!

passages.title: Healing Nordrassil
passages.text:
Azerite elementals are runnin' wild, driven mad by Azeroth's pain. They're menacin' the spirits o' nature that protect the World Tree.

The roots o' Nordrassil run deep, nurtured by these sacred waters. For the sake o' Azeroth's world soul, the tree must be defended.

Quiet the restless elementals and use yer Heart o' Azeroth tae mend the wounds ye find. We cannae let Hyjal become another gapin' scar like Silithus!

passages.title: Healing Nordrassil
passages.text: This just keeps gettin' worse. If too many wounds open up, we may not be able tae stop the cascade.

passages.title: Healing Nordrassil
passages.text:
Ye did it, <name>! I can feel her pain diminishin'.

And the Heart seems tae be even stronger now!

passages.title: No Backs
passages.text: <The murloc seems hungry. Next to it is a series of crude drawings which seems like a shopping list. Perhaps you can help the creature.>

passages.title: No Backs
passages.text: Locate murloc traders and obtain the items that Mrrl requires.

passages.title: No Backs
passages.text:
<Mrrl eats the Slimy Naga Eyeball, squeezes the Flatulent Fish, rubs the Unidentified Mass on its feet, then throws the Sweet Sea Vegetable.

It looks satisfied.>

passages.title: What Will It Mine?
passages.text: <Although worn from repeated use, the pickaxe still seems salvageable. Perhaps there's something nearby that can be mined?>

passages.title: What Will It Mine?
passages.text: What have you brought me?

passages.title: What Will It Mine?
passages.text:
Ah, what do we have here? A rare find, indeed! 

Brinestone is quite volatile and should only be mined with special equipment. 

Even then, its collection frequently disturbs the elements, so mine with caution.

passages.title: Rustbolt Gramophone
passages.text:
<The large gramophone that you crafted is capable of blasting music across all of Rustbolt.

Now, you just need to find a good place to install it.>

passages.title: Rustbolt Gramophone
passages.text: <This looks like a great place to install the gramophone.>

passages.title: The Tipsy Tinkerer
passages.text:
The massive kegerator that you built should be able to house all of the Rustbolt Resistance's beverages.

Find a spot to set it up in Rustbolt, and let the town know it's ready for use!

passages.title: The Tipsy Tinkerer
passages.text: This looks like a great place to install the kegerator.

passages.title: One Gnome's Trash
passages.text:
The garbage in these trash heaps is full of rare metals: Dalaranium, Suramarite, even Gnomeisium! 

I've not seen this much easy gold to be had, since they left the vault door open in Boralus! You help me collect some of the metal, and my friend Gao will sell it on the black market.

I've got a device that can tear the metal right out of the trash!

passages.title: One Gnome's Trash
passages.text: There's gold to be made!

passages.title: One Gnome's Trash
passages.text: This is going to sell quickly, here's your share of the profits to be!

passages.title: Sun-Speckled Dunes
passages.text:
<Surveying the shrine, you believe that the sandy winds in this area have worn down the embedded gems, producing odd shapes and cracks in some.

Looking at your notes, the earthen mentions coming across dunes sprinkled with orange gems. He said it reminded him of the soft sunlight in this area.

Checking your notes, it appears that these dunes were located south of your current location.>

passages.title: Sun-Speckled Dunes
passages.text: <These gems have a very strong structure. Time, in addition to the winds, must have also taken its toll on them.>

passages.title: Sun-Speckled Dunes
passages.text:
<You carefully remove the old, weathered gems from the shrine and replace your polished gems in their place.

As you place the final gem, a similar pulse of energy radiates from the shrine as the light in the area seems to draw into it. A strange glow now emanating from the shrine leads you to believe it is once again active.>

passages.title: Insight into Our Enemies
passages.text:
There's no telling what awaits us within this land. We cannot press forward without first knowing exactly what we're up against. 

Our new allies have long been embattled with the naga. They would know best how to navigate these waters. 

Speak with Blademaster Okani and see if they can provide some insight into how our enemies operate.

passages.title: Insight into Our Enemies
passages.text:
You wish to know more about the naga of Nazjatar? 

I am afraid these waters are as new to me as they are to you, but we may still be able to help each other.

passages.title: Deteriorating Knowledge
passages.text:
My clan came to Nazjatar, eager to destroy the naga queen. 

We were not prepared for the darkness that she commands. 

Our scouts knew this land best, but their knowledge now deteriorates as their minds are controlled by Azshara's forces. 

Find and free our scouts, and you may still have a chance to access their knowledge.

passages.title: Deteriorating Knowledge
passages.text:
Compelled to do the mindless bidding of our enemies is a fate worse than death. 

There is no honor in that life.

passages.title: What We Know of the Naga
passages.text:
I owe you a debt. That much is clear. 

My mind still reels from the zoatroid's influence, but I fear the others suffer more visible wounds. 

Apply this salve to their wounds, and I will do my best to share what I know of the naga.

passages.title: What We Know of the Naga
passages.text: I will tell you what I know of the naga.

passages.title: What We Know of the Naga
passages.text: Whatever is hidden within the stronghold needs to be destroyed.

passages.title: Shop Project
passages.text:
As a reward for all your help here, I was planning to fix this old mechaspider mount to give to you.

I could use some more of your help though to get this project started!

I'll need parts off a few of the bots nearby, and maybe you could talk to Cork Stuttgard at Bondo's Yard and see if you can get a Mechanobot Ignition system.

passages.title: Shop Project
passages.text: Did you find those parts yet?

passages.title: Shop Project
passages.text: These parts will get us started, but there's a lot of work to do still.

passages.title: Pearls of Unimaginable Power
passages.text:
Thousands of years ago, when the Well of Eternity was destroyed and this land plummeted to the depths of the ocean, a great storm of magical energy was unleashed.

Remnants of this magical energy still exist today.

Gather the pearls from the ancient mana-infused clams. These enchanted pearls may be powerful weapons in our fight against the naga!

passages.title: Pearls of Unimaginable Power
passages.text: We must make use of every advantage in our fight against the naga.

passages.title: Pearls of Unimaginable Power
passages.text: You have done well. I can sense a powerful energy from emanating from within these pearls.

passages.title: The Sunken Chest
passages.text:
<This waterlogged chest appears to be in salvageable condition, but it is too heavy to move due to the contents within.

The lock on the device appears to be operational.

Perhaps there is a key nearby...>

passages.title: The Sunken Chest
passages.text: <The chest is locked and requires a key.>

passages.title: The Sunken Chest
passages.text: <It takes some effort, but the lock eventually opens...>

passages.title: A Life's Work
passages.text:
<A voice whispers to you from beyond the veil of death.>

I spent more than one-thousand years researching the mysteries of the arcane before the Great Sundering tore our world apart.

I perished amidst the destruction and my work was lost.

Search the area for my ancient writings and put my spirit to rest...

passages.title: A Life's Work
passages.text: The bookcase appears empty...

passages.title: A Life's Work
passages.text: With the arcane tomes and ancient scrolls restored to the bookcase, it feels as though a long held weight has been lifted from your shoulders.

passages.title: Poor, Unfortunate Souls
passages.text:
Countless lives were lost in the Great Sundering when this great city was plunged into the depths of the abyss.

The fortunate among us died quickly in the explosion, but some survived only to cling onto dear life as the cold, unforgiving ocean waves crashed down upon them.

Those poor, unfortunate souls suffer a fate worse than death to this day. They drown endlessly, forced to relive the torture of their death.

Put them to rest so that they may have peace at last.

passages.title: Poor, Unfortunate Souls
passages.text: I hear them as we speak... crying out for help. Yet, I am powerless to save them...

passages.title: Poor, Unfortunate Souls
passages.text: They will never gain back the lives they lost that day so long ago, but at least they will suffer no longer.

passages.title: Making Kelpberry Wine
passages.text:
<This is an empty kelpberry juice cask.

There is someone nearby that may appreciate a refill.>

passages.title: Making Kelpberry Wine
passages.text: Did you bring me something?

passages.title: Making Kelpberry Wine
passages.text: Oh, you know exactly what this ol' girl likes!

passages.title: Who Lurks in the Pit
passages.text:
The winds whisper of people being trapped in the pit. It seems there may be more members of the expedition within.

I fear it will be up to you to make the descent and save the survivors.

There should be six in total... though the winds say that one is farther away from the others...

With our luck, the last survivor is at the bottom of the pit.

Good luck, <name>. And... make sure no spiders follow you back out.

passages.title: Who Lurks in the Pit
passages.text:
Ralia Dreamchaser is a druid of the Cenarion Circle, an order dedicated to protecting the wilds of Azeroth.

Thank you for rescuing her. Her aid is sure to be of use against the ogres.

passages.title: In the Shadow of Crimson Wings
passages.text:
It is unlike Alexstrasza to remain out of contact for so long, particularly when the very essences of the dragonflights' power are being made manifest. 

While our allies here tend to the injured, we must seek out the Life-Binder at once.

When you are ready, we shall ride to the Vermillion Redoubt together.

passages.title: In the Shadow of Crimson Wings
passages.text: We must rely on your aid once more, champion.

passages.title: In the Shadow of Crimson Wings
passages.text: We owe you a great deal of gratitude. You have the support of the red dragonflight in your efforts to save Azeroth.

passages.title: Relics of the Sundering
passages.text:
It's not every day that you encounter the remnants of a lost civilization beneath the ocean!

I never would have imagined that I'd have the opportunity to explore the lost city of Nazjatar... and on solid ground at that!

There are many secrets here to uncover. If you come across any ancient highborne artifacts, please bring them to me. These relics could provide us with valuable clues regarding the mysteries of the Great Sundering.

I feel as though we are barely scratching the surface so far...

passages.title: Relics of the Sundering
passages.text: Whatever mysteries were hidden here beneath the ocean are now waiting to be revealed!

passages.title: Relics of the Sundering
passages.text: Excellent work! Look at all of these highborne relics you've found! I will begin examining them at once.

passages.title: Fighting Venomous With Venom
passages.text:
There are many uses for the poison of the snapdragons.

Immediate use would be to create antivenin for healing, or harvesting poison for attacking the naga.

Let's get to the root of the issue, literally.

Use some collected venom against a Terrormaw to weaken it. Kill one and bring me their fangs.

I think we can come up with something handy from there.

passages.title: Fighting Venomous With Venom
passages.text: Did you get the fangs?

passages.title: Fighting Venomous With Venom
passages.text:
Need to be careful not to scratch myself with these.

With a little learning, we should be able to create an antidote... and maybe a weapon of our own!

passages.title: Arcane Cache
passages.text:
<The heavily reinforced chest is of naga construction and appears to be reinforced with a magical lock of some kind.

Magical reinforcement aside, the cache still requires a key to unlock.

The key is most likely being held by one of the nearby naga soldiers.>

passages.title: Arcane Cache
passages.text: <The chest is locked and requires a key.>

passages.title: Arcane Cache
passages.text: <The magical barrier dissipates as you insert the key.>

passages.title: Broken Controller
passages.text:
It is too late for me, my friends.

The Controllers work us and work us and we have no rest.

We have lost so many. 

Please, free the others! Don't let them share my fate!

passages.title: Broken Controller
passages.text:
Every kelfin we set free, makes the naga a little weaker.

I heal who I can.

passages.title: A Blow to Morale
passages.text:
This place is the source of all of our corruption. 

The kelfin are taken and broken here. 

Hit them where it hurts. Break their power, kill every naga you see, wreak havoc!

Every little crack we make, weakens their foundation.

passages.title: A Blow to Morale
passages.text: Did you damage their morale?

passages.title: A Blow to Morale
passages.text:
It's going to take them a while to clean that up, <name>!

I love watching them scurry.

passages.title: The Dark Garden
passages.text:
Look, <name>, I know we have bigger battles ahead, but these gardens are horrific.

Innocent creatures captured and imprisoned for the naga's amusement. 

They bring them out, torture them, change them, break them... you get the idea.

Help me free those the naga have taken, and punish them for their hubris!

passages.title: The Dark Garden
passages.text: Were you able to wreak some havoc in there?

passages.title: The Dark Garden
passages.text:
I'm pretty sure I heard an otter giggle as it ran past. 

Your fighting skills were most rad.

passages.title: Crab Marks The Spot
passages.text:
<This appears to be the remains of some kind of treasure map. However, the map is in poor condition after so many years of being subjected to the ocean.

According to the map, the treasure should be somewhere nearby; but it's impossible to tell what exact location is from the ruined map.>

passages.title: Forgotten Memories
passages.text:
Have we met before? I'm sorry... but I don't remember your name.

My name is... Arylina... I think. My memory has been so foggy since the great explosion happened that sent us underwater.

Oh! But look! I can see the sun and the stars again... I wonder what happened?

I used to keep a diary, but I can't find it anywhere. If I just had my diary back, I'm sure I could remember more.

Will you help me find it?

passages.title: Forgotten Memories
passages.text: Where did I put that diary?

passages.title: Forgotten Memories
passages.text: Oh... I remember now. This all happened so long ago. I think it's time for me to rest...

passages.title: Test Drive
passages.text:
There's still a lot of work to do, but it's running! We need to give the engine, brakes and gyro-balance actuator a good test. 

You want to take it out for a drive and see how well they work?

passages.title: Test Drive
passages.text: Take it for a drive!

passages.title: Test Drive
passages.text: I was afraid you may not make it back!

passages.title: Snapdragon Claws
passages.text:
Snapdragons are savage creatures that hunt in packs. Their presence in Nazjatar requires us to stay vigilant at all times.

They are crafty beasts, preferring to ambush their prey when it is weak or wounded. We will need to reduce the number of snapdragons in the area.

The last thing we need after a battle with the naga is to be finished off by a pack of blood-thirsty snapdragons!

Hunt down any nearby snapdragons and bring me a claw from each kill so that I may keep track of their numbers.

passages.title: Snapdragon Claws
passages.text: The snapdragon threat cannot be underestimated.

passages.title: Snapdragon Claws
passages.text: Good work, <name>. The fewer snapdragons in Nazjatar, the better.

passages.title: Void Cache
passages.text:
<The heavily reinforced chest is of naga construction and appears to be reinforced with a magical lock of some kind.

Magical reinforcement aside, the cache still requires a key to unlock.

The key is most likely being held by one of the nearby naga soldiers.>

passages.title: Void Cache
passages.text: <The chest is locked and requires a key.>

passages.title: Void Cache
passages.text: <The magical barrier dissipates as you insert the key.>

passages.title: Feed Them All
passages.text:
When we're doing our job right, we always have more mouths to feed!

If you could help with my stock, we could care for even more.

Big, strong friends are what this revolution needs!

passages.title: Feed Them All
passages.text: Do we have enough protein?

passages.title: Feed Them All
passages.text: What a great help you are! I may grow to like you land creatures.

passages.title: Time for Heroics
passages.text:
That card you found was a gold rare Huolon! 

I think that card belonged to Adalin Halfheight, one of our junior explorer league members. If he dropped it, he and our other junior members maybe in trouble!

We need to find Leona Mistcaller, Dunkin Crackjaw, and Adalin Halfheight immediately!

passages.title: Time for Heroics
passages.text: Let's find these people!

passages.title: Time for Heroics
passages.text: You certainly are the hero they all talk about!

passages.title: Requisition: A Few Starfish
passages.text:
Our forward scouts have been using starfish scales as camouflage. The trouble is that the scales deteriorate too quickly. We are going to need more scales if we want to keep tabs on naga movements.

If you happen upon any Angel Scale Starfish, please deliver them to the quartermaster as soon as possible.

passages.title: Requisition: A Few Starfish
passages.text: Thank you for your contribution.

passages.title: Requisition: A Few Carp
passages.text: Our local sea life is in danger! If you spot a fish out of water, please return it to the nearest lake, stream, or river. Conservation is everyone's responsibility!

passages.title: Requisition: A Few Carp
passages.text: Thank you for your contribution.

passages.title: Requisition: A Few Spiral Leaf
passages.text:
We are dangerously low on our medicine stores. If you find any Spiral Leaf, please leave your stores with the quartermaster.

I should warn you, Spiral Leaf is immensely poisonous. Make sure to handle it with care. Some symptoms of spiral leaf poisoning include bouts of rage, immense bursts of strength, and murderous impulses. If you are exposed, find some naga and use your murderous energy for good.

passages.title: Requisition: A Few Spiral Leaf
passages.text: Thank you for your contribution.

passages.title: Requisition: A Few Cone Shells
passages.text:
If we are going to arm ourselves against the naga, we will need far more supplies and armaments. Cone Shells make most of our armor and weapons. It's light, it's strong, and it's plentiful in this region. However, our supplies are running short and our forces need support.

If you find yourself carrying Impregnable Cone Shells, please leave your stores with the quartermaster.

passages.title: Requisition: A Few Cone Shells
passages.text: Thank you for your contribution.

passages.title: Reinforced Cache
passages.text:
<The heavily reinforced chest is of naga construction and appears to be reinforced with a heavy-duty lock of some kind.

Reinforcement aside, the cache still requires a key to unlock.

The key is most likely being held by one of the nearby naga soldiers.>

passages.title: Reinforced Cache
passages.text: <The chest is locked and requires a key.>

passages.title: Reinforced Cache
passages.text: <As you turn the key you can hear the heavy latches of the chest snap open with considerable force.>

passages.title: Drill Rig Construction
passages.text:
<Prince Erazmin sifts through the resources you both collected.>

Yes... This appears to be sufficient material to repair that drill rig.

I'll do what I can with the parts that I have, but you will need to complete the repairs with yours.

When you're ready, return to that broken drill rig we found and open it up.

Together, we'll have it up and running in no time.

passages.title: Drill Rig Construction
passages.text: You didn't lose your parts did you?

passages.title: Drill Rig Construction
passages.text:
Keep an eye out for other construction projects across the island.

There's always something to build in Mechagon.

passages.title: Defending the Maelstrom
passages.text:
The shaman of the Earthen Ring are powerful, but this is more than even they can handle! And from the sound o' it, some o' their own are still trapped down below.

Like ye did in Nordrassil, use yer Heart of Azeroth tae seal up the wounds inflicted here. An' lay any crazed elementals tae rest before they make even more o' a mess.

passages.title: Defending the Maelstrom
passages.text: This just keeps gettin' worse. If too many of these wounds open up, we may not be able tae heal the damage.

passages.title: Defending the Maelstrom
passages.text: That was close! If ye hadn't stopped the spread of these wounds in time, I don't know what might've happened!

passages.title: WANTED: Lady Naz'jess
passages.text:
Wanted for attacks against the Alliance!

Lady Naz'jess is responsible for leading several raids and ambushes against our soldiers. Extreme caution advised!

Upon completion of the mission, report to Lieutenant Hawkins for commendation.

passages.title: WANTED: Lady Naz'jess
passages.text: Have anything to report?

passages.title: WANTED: Lady Naz'jess
passages.text: Well done, <class>. Lady Naz'jess was a formidable foe and a high-ranking commander among the naga.

passages.title: The Heart of the Water
passages.text:
You see a lot up here. 

Even the water is a slave to the will of the naga.

I believe we can help them reform away from here.

Bring back what you can!

passages.title: The Heart of the Water
passages.text: Did you free them?

passages.title: The Heart of the Water
passages.text:
Well done, <race>!

We will hope for the best!

passages.title: She Sells These Shells
passages.text:
Suva is so proud of her seashells. 

After everything she has done for our people, helping her supplies is the least we can do!

Head down the hill and pick up some of the shiniest seashells you can find!

You will make her day.

passages.title: She Sells These Shells
passages.text: <Excited clicks and squeaks.>

passages.title: She Sells These Shells
passages.text: <Suva's feelers are twitching joyfully.>

passages.title: Misdirection
passages.text:
We came in friendship and those pesky murlocs jumped us and stole my treasure.

They threw it in one of those big clams and ran off into the village.

They keep moving them around and I have no idea where it is now!

Can you please help?

passages.title: Misdirection
passages.text: Any luck?

passages.title: Misdirection
passages.text:
That's it! Dexter was so sad!

They thought they were so clever.

Next time they're getting a kick to the dorsal fin.

passages.title: Emergent Sea Weeds
passages.text:
There is a special kind of kelp that only grows near the vents.

Our healers use these to help treat our friends in Newhome.

My kind don't have much of a chance down there, but you do!

Gather up some of the vent kelp sprouts in the Dragon's Teeth Basin and bring them to Nevin.

passages.title: Emergent Sea Weeds
passages.text: Were you able to find the special vent kelp?

passages.title: Emergent Sea Weeds
passages.text:
These are perfect! 

A little kelp goes a long way!

passages.title: WANTED: Commander Sarj'eth
passages.text:
Wanted for attacks against the Alliance!

Commander Sarj'eth is responsible for leading several raids and ambushes against our soldiers.

Last seen near the vicinity of this command poster.

Extreme caution advised!

Upon completion of the mission, report to Lieutenant Hawkins for commendation.

passages.title: WANTED: Commander Sarj'eth
passages.text: Have anything to report?

passages.title: WANTED: Commander Sarj'eth
passages.text: Well done, <class>. Sarj'eth was a formidable foe and a high-ranking commander among the naga.

passages.title: WANTED: Lord Ha'kass
passages.text:
Wanted for attacks against the Alliance!

Lord Ha'kass is responsible for leading several raids and ambushes against our soldiers.

Last seen near the vicinity of this command poster.

Extreme caution advised!

Upon completion of the mission, report to Lieutenant Hawkins for commendation.

passages.title: WANTED: Lord Ha'kass
passages.text: Have anything to report?

passages.title: WANTED: Lord Ha'kass
passages.text: Well done, <class>. Lord Ha'kass was a formidable foe and a high-ranking commander among the naga.

passages.title: WANTED: Lady Narjiss
passages.text:
Wanted for attacks against the Alliance!

Lady Narjiss is responsible for leading several raids and ambushes against our soldiers. Extreme caution advised!

Upon completion of the mission, report to Lieutenant Hawkins for commendation.

passages.title: WANTED: Lady Narjiss
passages.text: Have anything to report?

passages.title: WANTED: Lady Narjiss
passages.text: Well done, <class>. Lady Narjiss was a formidable foe and a high-ranking commander among the naga.

Gler'thogg is responsible for the gruesome deaths of several of our best soldiers. Extreme caution advised!

Upon completion of the mission, report to Lieutenant Hawkins for commendation.

Last seen near the vicinity of this command poster.

passages.title: Requisition: More Starfish
passages.text:
Our forward scouts have been using starfish scales as camouflage. The trouble is that the scales deteriorate too quickly. We are going to need more scales if we want to keep tabs on naga movements.

If you happen upon any Angel Scale Starfish, please deliver them to the quartermaster as soon as possible.

passages.title: Requisition: More Starfish
passages.text: Thank you for your contribution.

passages.title: Requisition: More Carp
passages.text: Our local sea life is in danger! If you spot a fish out of water, please return it to the nearest lake, stream, or river. Conservation is everyone's responsibility!

passages.title: Requisition: More Carp
passages.text: Thank you for your contribution.

passages.title: Requisition: More Spiral Leaf
passages.text:
We are dangerously low on our medicine stores. If you find any Spiral Leaf, please leave your stores with the quartermaster.

I should warn you, Spiral Leaf is immensely poisonous. Make sure to handle it with care. Some symptoms of spiral leaf poisoning include bouts of rage, immense bursts of strength, and murderous impulses. If you are exposed, find some naga and use your murderous energy for good.

passages.title: Requisition: More Spiral Leaf
passages.text: Thank you for your contribution.

passages.title: Requisition: More Cone Shells
passages.text:
If we are going to arm ourselves against the naga, we will need far more supplies and armaments. Cone Shells make most of our armor and weapons. It's light, it's strong, and it's plentiful in this region. However, our supplies are running short and our forces need support.

If you find yourself carrying Impregnable Cone Shells, please leave your stores with the quartermaster.

passages.title: Requisition: More Cone Shells
passages.text: Thank you for your contribution.

passages.title: The Tide Turns
passages.text:
The time to strike is now. We must take the Tidestone of Golganneth and the Javelin of Suramar is our best chance of piercing the barrier around it.

Every minute we wait is another minute when the sea can come crashing down on us. What forces we have will be arrayed below, just outside their encampment.

We will need your strength in addition to the Javelin, <name>. We do not have enough forces to take it on our own.

passages.title: The Tide Turns
passages.text: Quickly, the Tidestone!

passages.title: Requisition: We Need It All
passages.text:
We are dangerously low on all of our supplies. Please, you must go out and collect as much as you can.

Please return with any resources you find to the quartermaster!

passages.title: Requisition: We Need It All
passages.text: Thank you for your contribution.

passages.title: Bounty: Dangerous Creatures
passages.text:
There are creatures in Nazjatar that are far more dangerous than their peers. I leave it to you to find them and defeat them.

When you've done your part, report to the quartermaster to claim your reward.

passages.title: Bounty: Dangerous Creatures
passages.text: I know it is dirty work, but someone must do it.

passages.title: Bounty: Dangerous Creatures
passages.text: This will ease our efforts in Nazjatar.

passages.title: Plans of Attack
passages.text:
<The attack plans are written on the parchment in fluorescent squid-ink and bound together with Azshara's seal.>

Orders from our queen:

Queen Azshara has commanded that all naga forces prepare for a full assault upon the Alliance invaders in our land. Details for the attack have been distributed to your various unit commanders.

The Alliance shall tremble at the might of our queen!

passages.title: Plans of Attack
passages.text: What news do you bring from the front?

passages.title: Plans of Attack
passages.text: Excellent work, <class>. You've done the Alliance a great service. With these plans in hand, we will be able to prepare our defenses in advance of the attack.

passages.title: Forbidden Rituals
passages.text:
The naga use dark, forbidden rituals to subjugate the elements to their will.

But such rituals threaten to destroy the elemental balance that binds this world together. The rituals must be stopped. 

Fortunately, the rituals the naga use are too elaborate to commit to memory. The ritual instructions are contained within ancient texts.

If we destroy the ancient tomes that contain the rituals, the knowledge will be lost to the naga forever.

Retrieve the tomes and I will see that they are destroyed

passages.title: Forbidden Rituals
passages.text: Do you have the tomes?

passages.title: Forbidden Rituals
passages.text: I will see to it that the tomes of binding are destroyed at once. May Neptulon guide your journey, <class>.

passages.title: Sea Slug Liquidation
passages.text:
My brief studies have shown that the refinement process creates a byproduct that is invisible to the naked eye, but is easily seen with refracted bioluminescent light. 

The sea floor is littered with creatures that produce just what we need to track down this weapons cache.

passages.title: Sea Slug Liquidation
passages.text: Do you have the ooze?

passages.title: Sea Slug Liquidation
passages.text: The substance is stickier than expected, but should still work.

passages.title: Deteriorating Knowledge
passages.text:
The kelfin are no strangers to Azshara's cruelty. 

She commands creatures of darkness that entrap my kind and warp their minds. They eat away at their memories until nothing's left but an empty husk. 

If you can get to them soon, perhaps they'll still be in a state worth saving.

passages.title: Deteriorating Knowledge
passages.text:
I thought I'd die in that cave. Sometimes, I wished it. 

Thank you for getting me out of there, <name>.

passages.title: What We Know of the Naga
passages.text:
It feels good to be me again. I have you to thank for that.

My head still hurts from the zoatroid's influence, but I think the others are worse off.

Put some of this salve on their wounds, and I'll do my best to tell you what I know about the naga.

passages.title: What We Know of the Naga
passages.text: You're interrupting.

passages.title: What We Know of the Naga
passages.text: Whatever is hidden within the stronghold needs to be destroyed.

passages.title: Sea Slug Liquidation
passages.text:
The Azerite refinement process creates a byproduct that is invisible to the naked eye, but is easily seen with refracted bioluminescent light. 

The sea floor is littered with creatures that produce just what we need to track down this weapons cache.

passages.title: Sea Slug Liquidation
passages.text: Do you have the ooze?

passages.title: Sea Slug Liquidation
passages.text: It's stickier than expected, but should still work.

passages.title: Gather Friends
passages.text:
Outside is dangerous.

It is safe in the Kelfin Pocket. 

We find the lost crabs, and slugs, and other friends.

Here they get a new name and a new home. 

Find friends like these, and bring them home.

passages.title: Gather Friends
passages.text: Did you bring us friends?

passages.title: Gather Friends
passages.text:
They are already my friends. Now they are safe.

Thank you, <name>.

passages.title: Where They Hide
passages.text:
Those sneaky snakes have started to send assassins.

They hide nearby and kill those they cannot take away to the slave pens.

Even the sponges want to be rid of them! 

The spores will reveal the naga treachery... and then you can go ahead and kill them. 

We must keep our people safe!

passages.title: Where They Hide
passages.text: Did you find them all?

passages.title: Where They Hide
passages.text:
Ha! They hate those things.

Nicely destroyed.

passages.title: Kill the Kritch
passages.text:
Mrgglrr! Mrlg rmglr grlmrrgrr, grmm mrgl grrmrrgllrr. 

<Rlgmrr jumps around anxiously and points toward the cave.>

Grrmrlgr mrg lrglgllmrrglm mlr mrlglmrgm mrl Kriiitchrglgr.

<He makes a scary face and pinching motions with his hands.>

Mrglrmgr lrg, mrgglmmmr! Mrlg grrrrml lrg.

passages.title: Kill the Kritch
passages.text: Mrgglrmr grm?

passages.title: Kill the Kritch
passages.text:
Llrmmrgl! Mrgggl mrgl!

<Rlgmrr laughs.>

passages.title: Plug the Geysers
passages.text:
We're getting a geyser hit any minute now.

The effects of the Tidestone are far-reaching.

We have to do what we can to prevent any further destruction.

Use this sealant to stall off the next round of eruptions!

passages.title: Plug the Geysers
passages.text: Did you take care of all of them?

passages.title: Plug the Geysers
passages.text:
Did it get you once? I feel like it got you.

Happens to the best of us! Great work.

passages.title: Plug the Geysers
passages.text:
Just keep watching this spot... any second now...

Once those geysers start firing, get in there and seal them up.

The more they shake, the more everything breaks apart!

We have to keep these things under control.

passages.title: Plug the Geysers
passages.text: Is it all sealed up?

passages.title: Plug the Geysers
passages.text:
Good work!

I was hoping for a little help from the Reefwalkers, but we take what we can get!

passages.title: Plug the Geysers
passages.text:
Earthquakes! Snakes! Water coming from every direction.

What is going on around here?

Neri said to plug some holes in the defenses - didn't think she'd mean it literally.

Take some of this goo, next eruption, stick it in the hole.

passages.title: Plug the Geysers
passages.text: Goop them all up?

passages.title: Plug the Geysers
passages.text: Yeah! That was some surftastic heroing!

passages.title: Plug the Geysers
passages.text:
We have been keeping an eye out for these unstable geysers.

Since the water went away, the ocean has been trying to find a way back in.

If we let it burst up just anywhere, we could all be doomed!

Help me plug these up!

Be careful, though, I found out the hard way they have a bit of a kick.

passages.title: Plug the Geysers
passages.text: Did you prevent the disaster?

passages.title: Plug the Geysers
passages.text: The ocean's own luck was with us! Well done, <race>.

passages.title: Plug the Geysers
passages.text:
Have you heard about the geysers? 

All over the newly exposed areas, water trying to fill where it was pulled away.

The ocean, she is angry. I don't think she likes Azshara either.

We will keep filling this in until we can find a permanent fix.

passages.title: Plug the Geysers
passages.text: Get them stopped up for now?

passages.title: Plug the Geysers
passages.text:
Thank you, friend.

I have a feeling that won't hold for long.

passages.title: Ride of the Scientifically Enhanced Boar
passages.text:
We don't know how long the re-sizing will last, so let's get moving.

You're going to ride this giant boar and mow down the army of undead between us and Wrathion.

The large ones are pulsing with shadow magic. If you kill them, I bet it they'll take out any enemies near them.

Let's hope Wrathion is willing to help us find Kalecgos.

passages.title: Ride of the Scientifically Enhanced Boar
passages.text: Please... help! I won't last much longer!

passages.title: Ride of the Scientifically Enhanced Boar
passages.text:
Thank you, stranger. I thought I was going to be punished for failing to save my friends.

I'm relieved that I was mistaken.

passages.title: Purge the Totems
passages.text:
The harpies' totems are scattered throughout the area.

Harpies are known for using their magic to corrupt those nearby. Even now, I can hear foul whispers in the air...

We must destroy these totems before any of us are tainted by their dark magic!

passages.title: Purge the Totems
passages.text: The totems are not particularly powerful. A simple light and tinder should do.

passages.title: Purge the Totems
passages.text: The foul magic in this area is dissipating. I think we're safe for now.

passages.title: Message to Base
passages.text:
We did it! We're one step closer to getting off this island.

Let's get back to camp and inform the captain of our success.

passages.title: Message to Base
passages.text:
I'm relieved you rescued Meredy. That's one more life saved and one fewer sacrificed.

And I'm glad to see you helped Henry get back to his old self.

We'll work with Meredy to figure out a plan of action.

passages.title: To Soar Like a Ray
passages.text:
I like to find the eggs of the fathom rays before they hatch so we can form a bond with them.

At least, when we can't swim, we can fly!

Bring me a few more eggs to start a new thing - we'll call them Rayriders!

passages.title: To Soar Like a Ray
passages.text: Did you find many eggs?

passages.title: To Soar Like a Ray
passages.text: Ah! Perfect! Soon we will feel the wind!

passages.title: Abduction Reduction
passages.text:
We got actual ABDUCTIONS happenin' here, <name>!

Honest to gold, flying robots are swoopin' into town and snatchin' up people like it's closin' time at Gallywix's buffet!

Lucky for the Rustbolt Resistance, Gazlowe called in me and my explosives to save the day.

You wanna pitch in? Take one of my rocket launchers and blast those containment crates outta the sky.

Whatever they've got trapped inside will come tumblin' down real fast, so you gotta run underneath and catch 'em.

passages.title: Abduction Reduction
passages.text:
Nice shootin' out there!

And, hey, don't worry if you "accidentally" missed a Mechagnome or two... I did too!

<Penny winks at you.>

passages.title: Turn the Scale
passages.text:
I have been trying to gather some of the scales from the young hydra nearby. 

Their flexibility and strength makes them incredibly versatile.

With all the cranky old hydra tromping around, I don't stand much of a chance. 

Can you gather some up for me?

passages.title: Turn the Scale
passages.text: Do you have enough?

passages.title: Turn the Scale
passages.text: You aren't as slow as I thought you'd be, with those land foots.

passages.title: A Good Offense
passages.text:
Korl was told to watch the naga, so watching the naga I am.

They're bad, friend, you know... just... terrible, horrible, bad monsters. 

I don't think I can just watch any more.

They say the best defense is.. something...

Help me teach them being being bad gets you smashed!

passages.title: A Good Offense
passages.text: Did you have fun?

passages.title: A Good Offense
passages.text: This was my best day. Thank you, friend.

passages.title: Extra Shiny
passages.text:
In the pools below are some small, lovely pearls. 

They were tossed in during some Azsh'ari ritual. 

Do they mean something? I have no idea. But I would like to have some of them. 

Be a lovely heavyfoot and go grab some for me, please!

passages.title: Extra Shiny
passages.text: Did you find all of the pearls?

passages.title: Extra Shiny
passages.text:
I can feel them glowing! They tingle through my hand and into the ocean floor.

Very lovely.

passages.title: Break a Few Eggs
passages.text:
This chamber is lovely and terrifying. 

What is born here will ruin the lives of so many. 

We cannot hurt the pods, but we can destroy the eggs of the serpents that guard them.

Take out the eggs, every little bit helps.

Poor eggs...

passages.title: Break a Few Eggs
passages.text: Did you destroy the eggs?

passages.title: Break a Few Eggs
passages.text: The fewer creepy flying snakes we have guarding the naga, the better.

passages.title: Like Ogres to the Slaughter
passages.text:
This is bad, <name>. Captain Kelra is bound by magic, the ogres are preparing to attack our friends, and the ritual is almost complete!

I have to stay calm. We can't give up now, right?

This may sound risky, but we need to take the fight to the ogres.

We're behind enemy lines, so we'll be able to get the jump on them and draw their focus away from the camp.

Take down any ogres that you can. That should keep them away from our friends.

passages.title: Like Ogres to the Slaughter
passages.text: You need to slay the ogres so they don't go after our friends back at the camp.

passages.title: Like Ogres to the Slaughter
passages.text: This should buy us enough time to stop the ritual!

passages.title: Controlling their Stones
passages.text:
Captain Kelra won't last much longer. We need to acquire the ward stones to break the ritual before it kills her.

I'll continue weakening the main ritual. Get those ward stones from the ogre lieutenants nearby.

passages.title: Controlling their Stones
passages.text: So, these were the stones used to bind me? The ogres clearly were concerned about you thwarting their plans.

passages.title: Controlling their Stones
passages.text: Thank you for saving me, but we have no time to lose. The ogres will not stop until they have raised the dragon!

passages.title: An End to Beginnings
passages.text:
You've done fine work within Exile's Reach, recruit. You should continue on to the Dragon Isles.

I'm afraid I must change my plans and go back to Stormwind. I need to find out how the ogres found such powerful shadow magic.

I'm sure we'll meet again. I can tell you've got many adventures ahead of you.

passages.title: An End to Beginnings
passages.text:
It's good to be back in Stormwind. 

I must report our mission's success to the king, but I have an idea for what you can do in the meantime...

passages.title: Dungeon: Darkmaul Citadel
passages.text:
You've slown down Gor'groth's efforts to control Kalecgos atop the citadel, but the ritual itself needs to be thwarted.

You must storm the citadel and stop him from completing the ritual. His dark magic is an affront to the Light.

We will need all the help we can get. Gor'groth's most elite lieutenants await within the citadel.

passages.title: Dungeon: Darkmaul Citadel
passages.text: You must go and slay Gor'groth before it is too late!

passages.title: Dungeon: Darkmaul Citadel
passages.text: It seems things are finally looking up for us. I think it's time we returned to Stormwind.

passages.title: A Little Edge
passages.text:
In the darkest cavern. Below the naga city. You will find them.

Creepy little crabs with sharp and pointy spines. 

I think we can find a way to use them. Projectiles didn't work so well in water, but now...

Harvest some for us!

Be careful, some of them are much sneakier than they have any right to be.

passages.title: A Little Edge
passages.text: Did you gather the spines?

passages.title: A Little Edge
passages.text: Ouch! These might just do the trick!

passages.title: We Can Fix It
passages.text:
<This drill rig looks capable of breaking through the nearby debris, but is clearly broken.

If you can collect the parts required, Prince Erazmin should be able to show you how to repair it.>

passages.title: We Can Fix It
passages.text: Us mechagnomes are always building something. Mechagon is littered with broken or half-completed construction projects.

passages.title: We Can Fix It
passages.text:
Do these small parts appear insignificant to you?

Use your imagination. Find their purpose. Give them value.

passages.title: We've Got Crabs!
passages.text:
<name>, you're just in time. Everything's ready for the crab hunt!

Okay, okay... I know what you're thinking. A founding member of D.E.H.T.A. that condones hunting?

I'm going to level with you, <name>. I've got a bar full of hungry murlocs that only eat three things: crabs, fish, and people.

If that's not reason enough, crabs are overpopulated in this region and they're decimating the local grub worm population!

How many innocent grub worms need to die before we do something, <name>?

passages.title: We've Got Crabs!
passages.text: How many innocent grub worms need to die before we do something, <name>?

passages.title: We've Got Crabs!
passages.text: That's quite the case of crabs you've got there, <name>. Well done! Please set it down behind the bar and I'll take care of the rest.

passages.title: Drunk Angry Murlocs
passages.text:
Those no-good Bloodfins ran off with all of the beer!

I've been experimenting with brews that only use ingredients native to Nazjatar, but it's still a work in progress. For now, I must rely on whatever I can scrounge up from the shipwreck.

My supply of beer was already limited, but now it's all gone thanks to those thieving Bloodfin murlocs! We're going to have some very angry customers here if we don't get it back.

Please recover the stolen lager from Bloodfin Village before it's too late!

passages.title: Drunk Angry Murlocs
passages.text: Those no-good Bloodfins ran off with all of the beer!

passages.title: Drunk Angry Murlocs
passages.text: Good work, <name>! You've recovered pretty much all of the stolen beer. Those Bloodfins are more trouble than they're worth!

passages.title: Mgglurky's Mugglrgl
passages.text:
My cook, Mgglurky, lost his mugglrgl and he's refusing to work until he gets it back.

I've got a bar full of hungry murlocs and nothing to feed them until Mgglurky starts cooking. If Mgglurky doesn't find his mugglrgl soon, we're going to have a riot on our hands!

I don't know about you, but I definitely don't want to be the main course tonight.

There were some Bloodfins lurking around earlier. Search Bloodfin Village for the mugglrgl and bring it back to me once you find it.

passages.title: Mgglurky's Mugglrgl
passages.text: If Mgglurky doesn't find his mugglrgl soon, we're going to have a riot on our hands!

passages.title: Mgglurky's Mugglrgl
passages.text: You've found it! So this is a mugglrgl? For some reason I thought it would be bigger. Mgglurky will be happy you returned it!

passages.title: Most Delicious Clams
passages.text:
This pool is filled with creepy fish. 

It is also the home of some of the most delicious clams you will ever eat. Fresh water somehow mixes into the ocean water in this one part of Nazjatar, and that gives the meat a totally new flavor.

Every now and then, we come down here and collect them for our friends in Newhome.

We could sure use some help with all these extra mouths to feed!

passages.title: Most Delicious Clams
passages.text: Did you find enough?

passages.title: Most Delicious Clams
passages.text:
Everyone is going to be so happy!

Thank you!

passages.title: Stealing the Naga's Secrets
passages.text:
<Upon closer inspection, it becomes clear that the blades have been forged from Azerite. 

Weapons of this power should never be in the hands of the naga.>

passages.title: Stealing the Naga's Secrets
passages.text:
I recognize the craftsmanship. This is Priscilla Ashvane's work.  

She must have taught the naga how to forge Azerite weaponry, but why?

passages.title: Stealing the Naga's Secrets
passages.text:
We cannot expect to succeed in any battle where our enemies are using Azerite weaponry. 

No, we must find a way to even the playing field.

passages.title: Stealing the Naga's Secrets
passages.text:
<Upon closer inspection, it becomes clear that the blades have been forged from Azerite. 

Weapons of this power should never be in the hands of the naga.>

passages.title: Stealing the Naga's Secrets
passages.text:
I recognize the craftsmanship. This is Priscilla Ashvane's work.  

She must have taught the naga how to forge Azerite weaponry, but why?

passages.title: Stealing the Naga's Secrets
passages.text:
We cannot expect to succeed in any battle where our enemies are using Azerite weaponry. 

No, we must find a way to even the playing field.

passages.title: Dark Tides
passages.text:
A Tidemistress leads the naga in this area.

She is performing some damnable ritual outside, demanding sacrifices of our soldiers.

Stop her before more of our own meet a cruel fate.

passages.title: Dark Tides
passages.text: With her death, the ritual is over. But there is not time for celebration.

passages.title: Assault: The Black Empire
passages.text:
I cannot believe my eyes. The Black Empire is materializing right here in the Vale!

We must spring to action!

passages.title: Assault: The Black Empire
passages.text:
Thank goodness you arrived when you did! I still cannot believe that N'Zoth would strike at my very doorstep.

The pandaren will recount this tale for countless generations.

passages.title: Vengeance for the Venthyr
De-Synced Vibro Blade
passages.text: The wildly shaking blade reminds you of the blades the Rustbolt defenders use. No doubt someone will be able to fix it up.

passages.title: Stolen Power
passages.text:
From the void these naga pull their strength. 

Each scroll they record, shared knowledge -- that knowledge is power.

It stands to reason, if we take away their knowledge, we steal their power.

My logic may be flawed, but let's do it anyway!

passages.title: Stolen Power
passages.text: Did you get all of the scrolls?

passages.title: Stolen Power
passages.text:
Take away a little magic, get a little weaker.

If nothing else, we will win this war through erosion.

passages.title: Usurper's Scent Gland
passages.text:
When a new queen is born and old enough to start proliferating her own hive, she will leave the nest. Her scent will attract some of the hive to fly with her to their new home. This one likely never got the chance to do so, thanks to you.

The Hivemother will be interested in this item.

passages.title: Usurper's Scent Gland
passages.text: <The Hivemother quickly devours the scent gland and wiggles at you.>

passages.title: Hivethief's Jelly Stash
passages.text:
This ettin was a well known and oft dreaded face among the bees of the Honeyback hive. Their jelly stores will benefit from his demise.

The Hivemother will be interested in this item.

passages.title: Hivethief's Jelly Stash
passages.text:
<The Hivemother buzzes animatedly.>

Bzzz! Bzzz!

passages.title: Legacy of Nar'anan
passages.text:
Hey there, <race>. Mind helping me out?

You see, I found these pylons here and it seems they contain memories from a notable Highborne who lived here long ago.

I can't get any closer to the rest of em' because of the snapdragons. Especially the terrormaws...

Can you go and activate the pylons for me? We Tortollans love old things, and this is a potential goldmine!

Oh, and be sure to write down what you see!

passages.title: Legacy of Nar'anan
passages.text:
Let me see what you got. 

<Collector Kojo reads your notes... slowly>

I think we may have just found the origin of Snapdragons! Let's see what else we can learn.

passages.title: Snap Back
passages.text:
I have a favor to ask of you, if you would be so kind.

Scrollsage Nola gave me this scroll to protect me on my adventures here in Nazjatar. She is a kind soul, but her scroll-work isn't always the most...accurate.

You look like a brave adventurer who's seen a thing or two. Could you test out the scroll for me? While you're there you may as well cull their numbers a tad.

passages.title: Snap Back
passages.text:
Wow! That powerful huh? 

I will be sure to keep this with me then!

passages.title: Heroic Warfront: The Battle for Stromgarde
passages.text:
If the Horde thinks it can assault Stromgarde, it is sorely mistaken! We will not let Arathi fall!

Prepare yourself for battle.

passages.title: Heroic Warfront: The Battle for Stromgarde
passages.text: Well fought, <name>, though I'm afraid it may be premature to let our guard down just yet. I am sure our enemy will not sit idly while we rebuild Stromgarde.

passages.title: Heroic Warfront: The Battle for Stromgarde
passages.text:
Our enemies are relentless in their quest to seize Arathi for themselves. We will never allow it to fall into their hands! We must stop them before the keep is rebuilt!

Take up arms. The Alliance is upon us.

passages.title: Heroic Warfront: The Battle for Stromgarde
passages.text: A battle well fought, <name>. You have once again proven yourself a great warrior of the Horde.

passages.title: Adapt, Improve, Overcome!
passages.text:
Izira Gearsworn is still alive, she is Rustbolt's strongest fighter, but her legs are broken. If we're going to survive I need parts to repair and upgrade her.

There are machines all over with parts we can salvage. With some perseverance we should be able to fix Izira's legs.

Help me obtain the following parts.

passages.title: Adapt, Improve, Overcome!
passages.text: We need to start searching!

passages.title: Adapt, Improve, Overcome!
passages.text: These are in excellent shape!

passages.title: The Fate of Professor Elryna
passages.text:
From the looks of it, Elryna's story should have a very interesting end. This pylon here has been acting up, but I think I know why!

These things use memory cores, little crystals found within the center of the orb. I bet there's one in that old magi tower. 

There's a snapdragon that's bigger than the terrormaws in there so here, keep the scroll for now. It should help in your fight. She's a big one!

passages.title: The Fate of Professor Elryna
passages.text: What happened that fateful day?

passages.title: The Fate of Professor Elryna
passages.text:
So. She was betrayed by that general?

He probably proceeded to take all the credit himself. 

Shame. But at least now we have the knowledge! Thank you, <name>.

passages.title: Old Nasha's Paw
passages.text:
The old bear's paw is sticky with honey. She likely ransacked a number of hives before you stopped her.

The Hivemother will be interested in this item.

passages.title: Old Nasha's Paw
passages.text:
<The Hivemother hums contentedly.>

Bzzz.

passages.title: Making Kelpberry Wine
passages.text:
<This is an empty kelpberry juice cask.

There is someone nearby that may appreciate a refill.>

passages.title: Making Kelpberry Wine
passages.text: Did you bring me something?

passages.title: Making Kelpberry Wine
passages.text: Oh, you know exactly what this ol' girl likes!

passages.title: Feed Them All
passages.text:
I am grateful for the help that your Alliance has given my people, but we are desperately short on food and supplies.

If we do not gather enough supplies to take care of both the Alliance and my clan, we will run out of food within the week.

Thankfully, there appears to be an abundance of fathom rays in the area, but I will need help hunting them in order to gather enough food for our camp.

Take this fathom hook and use it to pull down the fathom rays from above.

passages.title: Feed Them All
passages.text: Have you returned from the hunt?

passages.title: Feed Them All
passages.text: You have brought back a hefty supply of fathom meat. I will make sure that it gets hauled back to camp. Thank you for your service, <class>.

passages.title: Kill the Kritch
passages.text:
Mrgglrr! Mrlg rmglr grlmrrgrr, grmm mrgl grrmrrgllrr. 

<Rlgmrr jumps around anxiously and points toward the cave.>

Grrmrlgr mrg lrglgllmrrglm mlr mrlglmrgm mrl Kriiitchrglgr.

<He makes a scary face and pinching motions with his hands.>

Mrglrmgr lrg, mrgglmmmr! Mrlg grrrrml lrg.

passages.title: Kill the Kritch
passages.text: Mrgglrmr grm?

passages.title: Kill the Kritch
passages.text:
Llrmmrgl! Mrgggl mrgl!

<Rlgmrr laughs.>

passages.title: Poen's Favorite Dish
passages.text:
Poen is always helping us take care of every rescue we find.

Can you collect some meat from the eels south of here?

I like to make his favorite dish every now and then, to repay him.

It also has a great effect on the ones recovering. 

The power of deliciousness, I tell you!

passages.title: Poen's Favorite Dish
passages.text: Did you get enough meat?

passages.title: Poen's Favorite Dish
passages.text:
This really is a special treat for all of us.

Thank you!

passages.title: Turn the Scale
passages.text:
I am in need of your help, <class>. I have been hunting the nearby hydras for their scales, but my weapon was broken in the melee.

The scales of the hydra make durable and resilient armor for our warriors. Our clan requires the scales to craft and repair our armor.

If we do not resupply soon, we will be ill-equipped in our fight against the naga.

passages.title: Turn the Scale
passages.text: Have you completed the hunt?

passages.title: Turn the Scale
passages.text: Thank you, <class>. These scales will help us greatly in our war against the naga.

passages.title: Most Delicious Clams
passages.text:
Neptulian clams are an important part of the ankoan diet.

Many forget how important proper nutrition is during a time of war. A warrior can be armed with the finest weapons and training, but if she is not healthy and well-nourished she will be ineffective in battle.

Now that Mezzamere is home to your Alliance, we must work hard to gather enough food to feed our soldiers.

Gather as many Neptulian clams as you can find and I will see that they make it back to camp safely.

passages.title: Most Delicious Clams
passages.text: Have you gathered the Neptulian clams?

passages.title: Most Delicious Clams
passages.text:
These will serve us well.

Thank you, <class>.

passages.title: Where They Hide
passages.text:
The naga are sending assassins to eliminate our forces.

They hide nearby and murder those they cannot steal away to the slave pens.

Take this special sea sponge with you. The spores will reveal the naga in all their treachery.

Once revealed, slay the assassins before they can flee for reinforcements.

Azshara will fall!

passages.title: Where They Hide
passages.text: Have the naga assassins been eliminated?

passages.title: Where They Hide
passages.text: Well done, <class>. The road is now much safer to travel.

passages.title: Plug the Geysers
passages.text:
The geysers are dangerously unstable and will be erupting any moment now.

I fear that Azshara's misuse of the Tidestone is causing irreparable damage to the elements within Nazjatar.

We have to do what we can to prevent any further destruction.

Take this sealant and use it to stave off the next round of eruptions. In the meantime, I will do what I can to stabilize the elements.

passages.title: Plug the Geysers
passages.text: Were you able to prevent the geysers from erupting further?

passages.title: Plug the Geysers
passages.text: Good work, <name>. Thanks to your help sealing the geysers, I've been able to stabilize the elements and redirect the pressure to a safer location.

passages.title: Plug the Geysers
passages.text:
There are several geysers nearby that will be erupting soon.

Unfortunately, the elements in this area are not stable enough to handle the force of the eruptions.

I need someone to plug the geysers while I use the elements to redirect the pressure to a safer area of Nazjatar.

Take this sealant and use it to plug the geysers while I work to restore the elemental balance.

passages.title: Plug the Geysers
passages.text: Good work, <name>. Thanks to your help sealing the geysers, I've been able to stabilize the elements and redirect the pressure to a safer location.

passages.title: Plug the Geysers
passages.text:
The elements are becoming increasingly unstable due to Azshara's abuse of the Tidestone.

Geysers will be erupting nearby at any moment. Each eruption threatens to destroy the delicate balance of life on the surface.

Take this sealant and use it to plug the geysers while I work to restore the elemental balance and redistribute the explosive underground pressure to a safer location.

passages.title: Plug the Geysers
passages.text: Good work, <name>. Thanks to your help sealing the geysers, I've been able to stabilize the elements and redirect the pressure to a safer location.

passages.title: Plug the Geysers
passages.text:
The geysers are dangerously unstable and will be erupting any moment now.

I fear that Azshara's misuse of the Tidestone is causing irreparable damage to the elements within Nazjatar.

We have to do what we can to prevent any further destruction.

Take this sealant and use it to stave off the next round of eruptions. In the meantime, I will do what I can to stabilize the elements.

passages.title: Plug the Geysers
passages.text: Were you able to prevent the geysers from erupting further?

passages.title: Plug the Geysers
passages.text: Good work, <name>. Thanks to your help sealing the geysers, I've been able to stabilize the elements and redirect the pressure to a safer location.

passages.title: Plug the Geysers
passages.text:
There are several geysers nearby that will be erupting soon.

Unfortunately, the elements in this area are not stable enough to handle the force of the eruptions.

I need someone to plug the geysers while I use the elements to redirect the pressure to a safer area of Nazjatar.

Take this sealant and use it to plug the geysers while I work to restore the elemental balance.

passages.title: Plug the Geysers
passages.text: Have the geysers been sealed?

passages.title: Plug the Geysers
passages.text: Good work, <name>. Thanks to your help sealing the geysers, I've been able to stabilize the elements and redirect the pressure to a safer location.

passages.title: Save Ebonhorn
passages.text:
<The potion appears to be powerful and chaotic. It changes color seemingly at random.
