passages.text: This place is teemin' with tech. Betcha can find prototypes anywhere.

passages.title: Prototypes for Profit
passages.text:
<Gazlowe flicks through the prototypes you brought.>

Some good stuff in here, <name>... We'll get a lotta use outta these...

passages.title: Prototypes for Inspiration
passages.text:
<Overspark pulls you in close and whispers.>

As the leader of this momentous expedition, I must stay with Prince Erazmin to ensure he's not swindled by this Horde hooligan.

But I cannot stop my research, or the Horde will gain the advantage!

Underlings like yourself must collect the technology samples required to fuel my legendary brainstorms.

Bring me prototypes from the island, and I will turn them into groundbreaking new innovations for the Alliance!

passages.title: Prototypes for Inspiration
passages.text: I don't care where you get the prototypes from. Take them from Gazlowe's thugs if you have to.

passages.title: Prototypes for Inspiration
passages.text:
<Tinkmaster flicks through the prototypes you brought.>

Interesting... provocative... inspiring! I can certainly turn these into something useful.

passages.title: Deeper Into the Darkness
passages.text:
This recent change of events allows us to continue our journey to discover what darkness lies beyond the sands.

It will not be easy, <name>. We stand on the precipice of the unknown, but now the tables have turned.

<Wrathion glances at your new attire.>

You do dress the part. 

Let's see what insights your return to the Halls of Origination bring to light.

passages.title: Deeper Into the Darkness
passages.text: I await your return.

passages.title: Deeper Into the Darkness
passages.text: Removing the corruption from the Halls of Origination has shifted N'Zoth's attention elsewhere. The attacks on Uldum and Vale of Eternal Blossoms continue to grow.

passages.title: Descending Into Madness
passages.text:
As unfortunate as the spreading corruption may seem, I believe it provides us the opportunity to prepare for what lies ahead.

Locate one of these incursions and see what happens when you peer beyond the dark veil.

passages.title: Descending Into Madness
passages.text: I believe it is time we put this new knowledge to good use.

passages.title: Into the Darkest Depths
passages.text:
With our connection secured, it is time for us to breach the veil and discover what lies beyond.

What you find may provide us the key to unlocking our success.

passages.title: Into the Darkest Depths
passages.text: Your expertise in these matters are invaluable.

passages.title: Into the Darkest Depths
passages.text:
You've done well, but do not let what you've just seen play you for a fool. Even the safety of this chamber can create a false sense of security.

The mind is easily manipulated.

passages.title: Remnants of a Shattered World
passages.text:
The knowledge gained from these visions affords us a unique opportunity to further protect one's mind from corruption. To continue our research, we must investigate the deeper mysteries of these experiences.

Seek out those of power within these visions. Should you come across anything of interest do not hesitate to share your findings.

In the meantime, MOTHER and I shall continue our research here in the chamber. 

We await your return, <name>.

passages.title: Remnants of a Shattered World
passages.text: Find anything of interest?

passages.title: Remnants of a Shattered World
passages.text: Fascinating. It appears we have our work cut out for us.

passages.title: Reconstructing "The Curse of Stone"
passages.text:
I came across several references to this book in my research of Ny'alotha. Penned by a neophyte cultist, it documents the "lies of the Titans" and the "injustices" they inflicted upon the denizens of Azeroth.

Mad ravings, intended to erode the reader's acceptance of reality.

Still, by studying this work, we can gain a better understanding of the Old God's power, and thus tailor the cloak to offer better protection against it.

Bring as many pages from this tome as you can find.

passages.title: Reconstructing "The Curse of Stone"
passages.text: What have you been able to find?

passages.title: Reconstructing "The Curse of Stone"
passages.text: Excellent work. This tome should prove quite enlightening.

passages.title: Reconstructing "The Curse of Stone"
passages.text:
Thus far, the contents of this book are unsettling to say the least. Nevertheless, I have been able to glean valuable information on the nature of N'Zoth's power, and have made alterations to your cloak accordingly.

There remains much to learn, however. Continue your search for additional pages as you delve into the visions.

passages.title: Reconstructing "The Curse of Stone"
passages.text: Urgent matters require a great deal of attention. Unless it is of the utmost importance, I must see to my work.

passages.title: Reconstructing "The Curse of Stone"
passages.text: Fine work, indeed.

passages.title: Stepping Through the Darkness
passages.text:
By now you've noticed the protection of your cloak wavering the deeper you delve into these visions. 

To further bolster your resistance to N'Zoth's influence, we will need to gain an even deeper understanding of his nefarious power.

Seek out knowledge from manifestations deeper within the visions, and we shall have our answers soon enough.

passages.title: Stepping Through the Darkness
passages.text: Dark and deep are the shadows.

passages.title: Stepping Through the Darkness
passages.text:
How curious. 

Give me a moment. I will examine this closely.

passages.title: Reconstructing "Fear and Flesh"
passages.text:
Another tome written by one lost to N'Zoth's madness. I dread to think of what vile words await us within it.

But if we are to strengthen your cloak, then we must know more of that which it was meant to resist. See if you can find the remaining pages so that we can complete this tome and make use of the knowledge it holds.

passages.title: Reconstructing "Fear and Flesh"
passages.text:
The missing pages must reside deeper within these visions. 

As dark and difficult these times may seem, we mustn't forget the possibility remains of a time of great success and discovery.

passages.title: Reconstructing "Fear and Flesh"
passages.text:
Perseverance in the face of darkness.

Our work continues...

passages.title: Reconstructing "Fear and Flesh"
passages.text:
Adherents of the Old Gods maintain that flesh is a gift, not a curse. This tome reflects on the Old Gods' supposed benevolence in granting us such a generous blessing.

Naturally, it omits any mention of what occurs when their corruption is allowed to run unfettered.

Gather more of these pages for me. As wretched as these words might be, studying them will allow us to increase the efficacy of your cloak.

passages.title: Reconstructing "Fear and Flesh"
passages.text: Anything to share?

passages.title: Reconstructing "Fear and Flesh"
passages.text: I see you have found more pages from the book. Well done.

passages.title: Reconstructing "Fear and Flesh"
passages.text:
Adherents of the Old Gods maintain that flesh is a gift, not a curse. This tome reflects on the Old Gods' supposed benevolence in granting us such a generous blessing.

Naturally, it omits any mention of what occurs when their corruption is allowed to run unfettered.

Gather more of these pages for me. As wretched as these words might be, studying them will allow us to increase the efficacy of your cloak.

passages.title: Reconstructing "Fear and Flesh"
passages.text:
Nearly halfway there, <name>.

Have you found anything new?

passages.title: Reconstructing "Fear and Flesh"
passages.text: Magnificent. Our work is coming together nicely.

passages.title: Reconstructing "Fear and Flesh"
passages.text:
Perhaps the most insidious element of the Old Gods' whispers is that they contain within them the smallest kernel of truth. There is something to be said for the joy that comes with feeling the sun on one's skin and the wind in one's hair.

But you have braved N'Zoth's visions. You have seen where their designs are ultimately meant to lead. The curse of flesh has nothing to do with bringing us joy.

Continue to collect the pages of this book. We have nearly finished piecing it back together.

passages.title: Reconstructing "Fear and Flesh"
passages.text:
The darkness lingers.

Never hurried. Never sleeping. Patiently waiting...

passages.title: Reconstructing "Fear and Flesh"
passages.text:
Ah, the final pages.

I believe we're ready to advance our efforts yet again, dear <name>.

passages.title: Walking in the Darkness
passages.text:
The end nears. The darkest corners of these visions await.

Our work has ensured you are well equipped to seek out the most horrific manifestations these visions have to offer. The final answers lie just beyond. Our preparations for Ny'alotha are nearly complete.

passages.title: Walking in the Darkness
passages.text: I await your return.

passages.title: Walking in the Darkness
passages.text:
Be grateful your eyes needn't stare upon these pages.

With the final pieces falling into place, we begin our preparations for Ny'alotha.

passages.title: Reconstructing "The Final Truth"
passages.text:
I know of this book. It is a sacred tome to those who worship the Old Gods, containing the deepest secrets and most incomprehensible mysteries of the Void. Only the most devout cultists are allowed to gaze upon its pages.

Even incomplete, holding it makes my skin crawl. I must take care not to read too much of it in a single sitting.

That being said, we must find its missing pages in order to continue our research. Retrieve them from the darkest corners of N'Zoth's visions.

passages.title: Reconstructing "The Final Truth"
passages.text:
I often find my own thoughts wandering, weary of what lies ahead.

How are you faring, <name>? Have you any news?

passages.title: Reconstructing "The Final Truth"
passages.text: Another piece falls into place. We are so very close, <name>.

passages.title: Reconstructing "The Final Truth"
passages.text:
I dare not repeat aloud the horrors that are recorded in these pages. The words themselves seem to shift and morph as I read them, as if the book itself is attempting to induce a descent into madness.

This is taxing work, but it is necessary if we are to fully prepare you for the dangers of Ny'alotha. For as disturbing as its descriptions might be, setting foot within it will prove more challenging by an order of magnitude.

Keep looking for pages from the book, <name>. But... leave the reading to me.

passages.title: Reconstructing "The Final Truth"
passages.text: Your success has brought us this far, <name>. Perhaps you have something to share?

passages.title: Reconstructing "The Final Truth"
passages.text: Our journey's end approaches. The darkness gathers.

passages.title: Reconstructing "The Final Truth"
passages.text:
Long have I studied the secrets of the Old Gods. I have traversed the whole of Azeroth in search of esoteric texts, lost archives, and forbidden knowledge, all in the name of preparing for the horror to come.

No amount of research could have prepared me for the depths of the insanity I would find within this book. A madness so absolute that only the Shath'yar language can convey it.

Find me the final pages of this accursed tome, <name>. I wish to learn what I need from it and be done with it forever.

passages.title: Reconstructing "The Final Truth"
passages.text: The whispers of Ny'alotha surround us. I believe you are ready for the final task, are you not?

passages.title: Reconstructing "The Final Truth"
passages.text:
The works are complete. Together, they tell the tale of a descent into complete madness. How one deception leads to another, until reality itself is held in contempt. There is no "truth" to be found here.

No longer should you feel the need to run from the whispers, <name>. You are ready to silence them.

passages.title: Reconstructing "The Curse of Stone"
passages.text:
N'Zoth is nothing if not subtle and insidious. I can see how an impressionable mind could be turned against the Titans by reading these words. Thankfully, we are not so susceptible to such manipulation, are we?

The book is nearly complete. Continue retrieving its pages from within the visions.

passages.title: Reconstructing "The Curse of Stone"
passages.text: I believe we are on the precipice of a something grand.

passages.title: Reconstructing "The Curse of Stone"
passages.text:
A job well done, <name>.

It's time we advanced our efforts.

passages.title: Reconstructing "Fear and Flesh"
passages.text:
Perhaps the most insidious element of the Old Gods' whispers is that they contain within them the smallest kernel of truth. There is something to be said for the joy that comes with feeling the sun on one's skin and the wind in one's hair.

But you have braved N'Zoth's visions. You have seen where their designs are ultimately meant to lead. The curse of flesh has nothing to do with bringing us joy.

Continue to collect the pages of this book. We have nearly finished piecing it back together.

passages.title: Reconstructing "Fear and Flesh"
passages.text: Making progress?

passages.title: Reconstructing "Fear and Flesh"
passages.text:
The words in this tome build and expand on the writings from the one we completed previously.

Stay the course, <name>. I expect we shall have answers soon enough.

passages.title: Land of Opportunity
passages.text:
<The grandmaster's voice rings out over the roaring crowd.>

This is it! The final event of the tournament!

These two Maldraxxi gladiators have cut down challenger after challenger. Now the only thing left...

Is for one to slay the other!

passages.title: Land of Opportunity
passages.text:
In ages past, the Primus founded that tournament to showcase the might of Maldraxxus. 

Today, it has sparked an all-out war.

passages.title: My Terrible Morning
passages.text:
You simply won't believe what happened to me!

I was out for my daily stroll when Marquis Pummeler and his band of ruffians assailed me!

Amongst the many unfortunate and ungentlemanly behaviors they displayed was destroying my parasol.

A tragedy of the highest order!

Without it, I'm afraid I'm left quite vulnerable to the oppressive Light that curses this land.

The Marquis controls a coveted shaded hideout nearby. Will you avenge my parasol and teach this ruffian some manners?

passages.title: My Terrible Morning
passages.text: The Marquis and his ruffians must be taught some manners!

passages.title: My Terrible Morning
passages.text:
<Exposure to the Light is clearly causing Theotar to lose control of himself.>

Justice... for parasols... everywhere...

passages.title: Mushroom For Improvement
passages.text:
The mushrooms are under attack! I need your help, or we risk losing it all!

Some fae wearing strange masks came in and demanded to gain access to the rings. When I told them they were closed due to the drought, they attacked me!

I'm too weak to fight back now, and I'm cut off from the center ring. These fae have destroyed so much, but there is something we can do.

Sprinkle some of these spores on their corpses so we can regrow the rings. Even when slain, our enemies can still serve Ardenweald.

passages.title: Mushroom For Improvement
passages.text: They'd be feeding the mushrooms anyway, so you might as well accelerate the process.

passages.title: Mushroom For Improvement
passages.text: Their bodies will nourish the growth and restoration of the fae rings. It is a worthy end for them.

passages.title: An Uneventful Stroll
passages.text:
I hope I wasn't too unpleasant while under the Light's influence. I do try to restrain myself, but the pain it causes is... maddening.

Anyway, that tea picked me right up!

When I last saw Prince Renathal, the Master was dragging him off to that big tower looming over the Ember Ward.

Myself and a few others have been working to gain access to that tower from below, but there are... obstacles.

When you're ready to depart, I will lead you to our headquarters of sorts, the Sanctuary of the Mad.

passages.title: An Uneventful Stroll
passages.text:
<Theotar takes a slow sip from his tea cup.>

What a delightful stroll!

passages.title: Dream Catcher
passages.text:
It appears that the focus remains stable, and its containment field remains intact. I daresay we can empower it even further.

Hunt down and defeat formidable enemies to acquire additional remnants of N'Zoth's influence. This time, we will infuse the focus with even greater amounts of the Old God's power. I am confident that the containment field will continue to hold.

passages.title: Dream Catcher
passages.text: Fortune favors the bold, <name>. And few acts are as bold as wielding the power of an Old God.

passages.title: Dream Catcher
passages.text:
Well done, <name>.

Once we have imbued the focus with the power we now hold, you will be able to create the most devious items of which N'Zoth's twisted mind can conceive.

passages.title: Maintaining Focus
passages.text:
At present, the focus holds but a fraction of N'Zoth's true power. If we further empower it, we could craft even more effective weapons to wield against him.

N'Zoth's influence is everywhere, <name>, and is most concentrated within powerful foes. Vanquish them and claim whatever vestiges of the Old God's power remain.

passages.title: Maintaining Focus
passages.text: We are embarking on a dangerous gambit, <name>. Caution is of the utmost importance.

passages.title: Maintaining Focus
passages.text:
Excellent. These should provide just what we need.

I will draw out the corruption from these physical vessels and infuse it into the focus. Then you will be able to use it to create more powerful items.

passages.title: Dredger Duty
passages.text:
You fixed up the muck pool so we can make some dredgers, but them devourers are gonna keep causin' trouble.

We're gonna need a Gem of Binding so we can dredge up a biggun to protect the pool.

I'll show you how to dredge up some disposable dredgers to work with for now.

Get 'em digging in the rubble to find us a Gem of Binding, and then we'll reshape 'em all into a biggun to kick them devourers outta here!

passages.title: Dredger Duty
passages.text: You got the gem?

passages.title: Dredger Duty
passages.text: Got a bit of devourer gunk on it, but it will have to do.

passages.title: Better... Stronger... Less Dead
passages.text:
King Mechagon may have been crazy, but his minions did have exemplary robotic creation capabilities. 

There are a few residual creations wandering Mechagon. Refusing to accept King Mechagon's dethroning.

The logical conclusion to defeat is withdrawal, if one remains operational. Some do not excel at logic.

They currently bear the latest in technical advancement. I believe retrieving specific pieces from these units would greatly benefit our recovery endeavor.

passages.title: Better... Stronger... Less Dead
passages.text: Did you acquire the parts we need?

passages.title: Better... Stronger... Less Dead
passages.text:
Barely a scratch on them!

A couple of upgrades and you could do that in half the time, you know.

passages.title: Through the Fire and Flames
passages.text:
Margrave Krexus was pleased to hear of your service to our house. He senses great potential within you.

Potential that must be tested.

A stone stands at the center of our citadel, surrounded by magma. Reaching the stone is a challenge of endurance and fortitude.

This trial is usually attempted only by our most renowned soldiers, but Margrave Krexus commands you to attempt the rite at once.

Go on, then. Prove your worth.

passages.title: Through the Fire and Flames
passages.text: What happened?

passages.title: Through the Fire and Flames
passages.text:
This blade was inside the stone all this time... 

Margrave Krexus was right about your potential.

passages.title: Accessing the Archives
passages.text:
The information you've gathered has allowed us to better understand these manifestations.

I believe MOTHER is waiting to share some of her findings with you.

passages.title: Accessing the Archives
passages.text: Do you require assistance?

passages.title: Accessing the Archives
passages.text: Archival database now available.

passages.title: Pride of Place
passages.text:
The Mantle of the Primus. It belongs on his statue.

You were the one to recover it, so you will have the honor of returning it to its proper place.

passages.title: Pride of Place
passages.text: Each answer leads to another question. Each enemy defeated reveals another secret.

passages.title: Pride of Place
passages.text: We must find the source of Gharmal's stockpiled anima. But for now, let us enjoy our victory.

passages.title: Disturbance Detected: Firelands
passages.text:
You're early <name>, I hadn't even sent for you yet.

Another temporal disturbance has flared up, this time in the Firelands. If Ragnaros hadn't been dealt with when he was, well, you've already seen one way the end time could turn out.

Some intricate time weaving is required to be sure you catch Ragnaros early, but still after whatever is causing the disturbance. Whoever is doing this isn't messing around any more.

passages.title: Disturbance Detected: Firelands
passages.text: Bring me the temporal anomaly as soon as you can, so we can get back to yesterday's problems tomorrow.

passages.title: Disturbance Detected: Firelands
passages.text: Oh no, time-locking?! Who knows how long this had been there before we were able to detect it! This is far worse than I had imagined...

passages.title: Korrak the Bloodrager
passages.text:
The indigenous Winterax trolls of the region are ruthless savages that would love nothing more than to have our bones added to their foul stew.

We must show them our might!

We have recovered tomes from their caves that detail their leadership hierarchy. The artifacts indicate that their leader, Korrak the Bloodrager, tends to remain hidden until given a reason to make his presence known.

Death to Korrak would mean death to Winterax Clan! Slay him and return.

passages.title: Korrak the Bloodrager
passages.text: Be warned, soldier: The Frostwolf also hunt for Korrak.

passages.title: Korrak the Bloodrager
passages.text: Well done. With Korrak dead, our full attention can be focused upon purging the Frostwolf filth from the region.

passages.title: The Legend of Korrak
passages.text:
The invading Stormpike are not the only threat in the region, soldier. The war in the Valley is waged on two fronts. The cannibal Winterax trolls also vie for power.

They are lead by Korrak the Bloodrager - a cruel and cunning beast.

A strike against Korrak could prove to be a crushing blow to the Winterax clan. Slay the beast and be rewarded!

passages.title: The Legend of Korrak
passages.text: Be warned, soldier, the Stormpike also hunt for Korrak.

passages.title: The Legend of Korrak
passages.text: Only the invading Stormpike armies remain, soldier. Well done!

passages.title: The Tithelord
passages.text:
With his army defeated, the Tithelord is vulnerable. Now, he has but a small contingent to protect him. Let us strike him down decisively. 

He draws power from these anima wells, keeping it all for himself. If you can hold his attention, I can not only empower you to defeat him but also disable the wells.

Speak to me when you are ready to begin. When the time is right, the baroness will lead our new recruits into battle.

passages.title: The Tithelord
passages.text: An Archlich? This complicates things.

passages.title: The Tithelord
passages.text:
A Maldraxxus archlich manipulating our Harvesters... This cannot go unanswered.

I am pleased that Baroness Draka is equally eager to strike at Kel'Thuzad directly.

General Draven will ready our armies while Laurent repairs the mirror. Be ready and take these as we prepare. We will ensure vengeance is met alongside our new allies.

passages.title: Unbeelievable Quality
passages.text:
<Now that your harvester has matured, the Honeyback hive is creating additional honey.

Someone in Brennadam could certainly find a use for this honey.>

passages.title: Unbeelievable Quality
passages.text:
I don't believe it! Honey from bees instead of those... blobs... at the meadery?

I'll make sure this gets to Raimond.

passages.title: A Soulbind In Need
passages.text:
Pelagos is my Soulbind. He is my brother, my closest friend, my mentor, and my student. He knows me completely, and I him. It is a bond stronger than any other.

That he now struggles is a torment to me, but I am forbidden from intervening. An aspirant must succeed or fail on their own merits, or the trial is forfeit.

I am bound by this law... but you are not.

Please bring Pelagos back to me. This will not be his last trial. Not when he may finally have a chance.

passages.title: A Soulbind In Need
passages.text: I owe you a great debt, <name>.

passages.title: Suggested Reading
passages.text:
Greetings. You must be the new aspirant everyone is talking about.

I thought you might like to learn more about us. There are three tomes that would serve you well as a starting point, but they are not currently in the library.

Aspirant Leda was the last to hold "Worlds Beyond Counting." Aspirant Ikaran has yet to return "The Infinite Treatises."

It seems "Bear Witness: The Watcher's Code" went missing some time ago. I would search the village.

Once returned, you can read them at your leisure.

passages.title: Suggested Reading
passages.text: Did you find the scrolls I suggested?

passages.title: Suggested Reading
passages.text:
I will see that they are returned to their proper places for everyone to enjoy.

I appreciate your help in retrieving them, and I hope they were informative.

passages.title: The Work of One's Hands
passages.text:
Too long have my hands been idle!

<Forgelite Sophone smiles warmly at you.>

You cannot know what this means to me, but I might be able to show you. For your aid in restoring my forge, please allow me to craft you a piece of armor.

It will not be an extravagant affair, but through good works we grow to know ourselves better.

I will need your aid once more. Sika and I will guide you on the specifics. All you need to do is listen and do as instructed.

What do you say?

passages.title: The Work of One's Hands
passages.text: There is no greater pleasure than creating something from nothing.

passages.title: The Work of One's Hands
passages.text: I hope you like it. It is far from my finest work, but it will serve you well while you are here.

passages.title: Assessing Your Spirit
passages.text:
It is clear to all that you are indeed a skilled combatant.

There is one challenge here that continues to test even the strongest among us. I would have you attempt to best a well-known centurion, beloved by all aspirants. It is called Athanos.

Consider this a test of your spirit.

If you can withstand this trial, then I will deem you ready for what lies ahead.

passages.title: Assessing Your Spirit
passages.text: <Kleia watches you impassively.>

passages.title: Assessing Your Spirit
passages.text: This is always a painful lesson. We do not think less of you for it.

passages.title: A Wayward Disciple?
passages.text:
While you are here and as yet unaffected by this--rash of doubt, we shall call it--there is one other errand I would ask of you.

I sent one of the disciples to investigate reports of the fallen fleeing our temple. For their own safety, they must be taken to the Temple of Loyalty.

Disciple Nikolon has yet to return. If he is to be found nearby, it will be near the border of our temple to the north.

Please, seek him out and ensure that he is not injured or in peril.

passages.title: A Wayward Disciple?
passages.text: Have you located Disciple Nikolon?

passages.title: A Wayward Disciple?
passages.text: Thank you for bringing him to me, <name>. He is in a worse state than any of us might have guessed.

passages.title: Bound in Stone
passages.text:
Some of our warriors were camped in the small settlement near Guo-Lai when the Baruk invaded the area. Some managed to escape, but they returned with tales of their brothers and sisters in arms being petrified by the mogu stoneshapers into living statues!

We can't leave our warriors behind! 

The stoneshapers must carry some means to reverse the spell and free them from their stone prisons. Bring our soldiers back!

passages.title: Bound in Stone
passages.text:
Your deeds honor us, <name>. 

I can't imagine what fate would've befallen our warriors if left to the Baruk.

passages.title: Champions of the Mogu
passages.text:
These lesser clans warring with each other in the Vale need to be taught their place.

Seek out their champions and eliminate them. Show them that only the Rajani have rightful claim here!

passages.title: Champions of the Mogu
passages.text:
The wayward clans should learn that such fate awaits all that would oppose the Rajani.

Take your reward, outsider. We are done here.

passages.title: Spoils of War
passages.text:
The warring clans are relentless and our warriors are going through armor faster than I can keep it repaired.

If you find yourself in battle with the other clans, see if you can salvage any undamaged armor pieces from their soldiers. We should not let good resources go to waste.

passages.title: Spoils of War
passages.text: What have you managed to salvage, outsider?

passages.title: Spoils of War
passages.text:
The wayward clans should learn that such fate awaits all that would oppose the Rajani.

Take your reward, outsider. We are done here.

passages.title: Securing Sinfall
passages.text:
They're all still active...

The stoneborn, the gargon, the stone fiends... All of 'em!

Don't got much time. They're always watching.

<Breakfist points up.>

Vulca told me to follow that big beam of Light in the sky.

Goes to a tower guarded by a big old brute, though. Couldn't get in.

passages.title: Securing Sinfall
passages.text: Now that we have cleared out the Master's forces, let us continue the search for Prince Renathal!

passages.title: Assault: The Endless Swarm
passages.text:
The mantid swarm is surging! There's no way the Golden Lotus will be able to handle this many of them.

We must do something to drive them back!

passages.title: Assault: The Endless Swarm
passages.text: Are you with me?

passages.title: Assault: The Endless Swarm
passages.text:
It looks like they're retreating. That was a close one. 

The Vale should be safe, for now.

passages.title: Ramkahen Rescue
passages.text:
Mar'at was overrun by those foul K'thir before we could safely evacuate our citizens. 

I fear the worst has happened to them.

Please, if anyone is left alive within the city, tell them to come to Ramkahen.

passages.title: Ramkahen Rescue
passages.text: I appreciate your effort in rescuing our people, <name>.

passages.title: An Unwelcome Incursion
passages.text:
The Tithelord sent his stoneborn to further reap the anima from these citizens. How long has this been going on? These acts reek of unfathomable greed.

There is but one answer to this dilemma: to send a message. Crush these oppressors. Drain their anima and return it to Stonevigil's anima well.

The incursion will be dealt with and the downtrodden's spirits lifted. Two birds, one stone.

<Draka hands you an anima container.>

Take this. I stole it from one of the guards earlier.

passages.title: An Unwelcome Incursion
passages.text:
Stone to rubble. 

Great work.

passages.title: Close to Tears
passages.text:
Our warriors have observed foul manifestations coming forth from numerous void tears within the surrounding jungle. 

They have been but mere weaklings, clearly intended to test our defenses before the real forces arrive.

If we do not deal with this threat now, however, it will only be a matter of time until we are overrun by their fodder.

Find a way to close those portals!

passages.title: Close to Tears
passages.text: Have you had any luck with the portals yet?

passages.title: Close to Tears
passages.text: That should help to hold back the tide... for now.

passages.title: Nine Lives
passages.text:
Scouts have returned recently, nearly on the verge of death, with reports that I find... disconcerting.

Neferset have been spotted wandering the streets of their city to the south.

This would normally be no cause for alarm, except the Neferset were completely wiped out.

I must ask you to investigate further... and if by some foul magic these reports turn out to be true, you must do whatever you can to contain this threat!

passages.title: Nine Lives
passages.text: Have you news of Neferset City?

passages.title: Nine Lives
passages.text:
I cannot believe what I am hearing... 

This is truly much worse than I feared.

passages.title: How to Become Forsworn
passages.text:
The Forsworn have taken control of Kalliope's Rest and are looting its antiquities. They must be looking for the Spear of Kalliope, a relic of great power.

Their numbers are far too great and we are no match. Perhaps there is another way? 

A small group of aspirants is removing artifacts from the shrine. If you gather uniform pieces and an insignia from them, we can get you inside the shrine unnoticed.

passages.title: How to Become Forsworn
passages.text: Do you have everything we need to make a disguise?

passages.title: How to Become Forsworn
passages.text: What did you do to this armor? You are a savage, yet effective, fighter it seems.

passages.title: The Games We Play
passages.text:
Do not worry about me. We have a bigger problem.

I heard their leader around here somewhere during the attack. I have been keeping watch from here but I have not been able to see them. They must be using some sort of glamour to hide themselves.

I have yet to meet a spriggan who can resist a game. If you find one eager to play and can win, then perhaps you can learn something about their leader.

passages.title: The Games We Play
passages.text: Very interesting. This will be quite useful.

passages.title: "Accidental" Arson
passages.text:
It's no use trying to get Andrei to tell us who he's working with. He won't talk, and we can't risk alerting his accomplice. 

We need to get rid of him, and it needs to look like an accident. 

Once Andrei's been dealt with, set fire to his rug and let the whole estate burn down. 

Andrei isn't someone you want coming into power. He's as ruthless as he is cruel.

passages.title: "Accidental" Arson
passages.text: You're quite thorough, aren't you? I can see the flames from here. While you were out I took the liberty of having some proper leg wear altered to fit you. I am sure I have you sized up properly.

passages.title: Our Eternal Charge
passages.text:
You have been fully inducted into our sacred covenant, Maw Walker, and may stand tall forevermore as a kyrian. There will be many challenges ahead of us--we shall face them together.

For now, return to Polemarch Adrestes and inform him that your training is complete. We are few in number as of late and I am sure he will have need of you. 

Go in service, <name>.

passages.title: Our Eternal Charge
passages.text: On behalf of our glorious Archon, may you follow the path always towards a brighter tomorrow.

passages.title: Phalynx Malfunction
passages.text:
As part of their training, I order my phalynx units to march the fields, keeping an eye on the wildlife and any goings-on.

Unfortunately, last time they returned they were one fewer in number.

Please search the Golden Pasture and search for the missing unit, then return it here.

passages.title: Phalynx Malfunction
passages.text: My phalynx units require occasional repairs to keep them operational. If one is overlooked, it may malfunction.

passages.title: Phalynx Malfunction
passages.text: This unit seems to be malfunctioning. We will have to perform some repairs.

passages.title: Laser Location
passages.text:
Phalynx have precise detection mechanisms that allow for excellent scouting.

In the cave below we have scattered gems that our units are trained to locate. Escort Gatamatos to run some drills and recalibrate his training.

passages.title: Laser Location
passages.text:
The technical process behind phalynx tracking and locating their targets is quite fascinating.

However... you do not seem the type who is interested in the details.

passages.title: Laser Location
passages.text: I would like to see a larion track that accurately!

passages.title: Souls Come Home
passages.text:
To the tree, to the tree! It is time for us to return to the grove.

We have our anima. We have our forms. The Tall Tree needs the anima. The Tall Tree will be happy!

I will see you there!

passages.title: Souls Come Home
passages.text:
From acorns grow forests, from souls comes vital anima. Small though they be, on them our fates depend.

The forest sighs in gratitude.

passages.title: Revenge Is Easy
passages.text:
There's still a lot of us here, trying to survive in these ruins.

These constructs have been encroaching on us constantly. They steal what they can, and haul off any of us they capture to be recycled in their labs.

The solution here requires an extensive use of violence, by you!

passages.title: Revenge Is Easy
passages.text: I still see a lot of abominations walking around.

passages.title: Revenge Is Easy
passages.text: You can kill more of them if you want.

passages.title: You Go First
passages.text:
You've proven useful. So, I am going to require you to disarm the defenses of this hall. 

Please take care not to die too quickly. I'd like to have the spear before the end of this eon.

passages.title: You Go First
passages.text: Continue to be of use and you just might make it out of this intact.

passages.title: You Go First
passages.text: Your efforts have brought me what I desire. For your reward, I won't kill you.

passages.title: The Ones in Charge
passages.text:
They have been collecting kyrian... and our corpses... for some dark purpose.

Whatever they are planning, we must put a stop to it.

I have overheard mention of three individuals who seem to be in charge. We need to find them and eliminate them.

passages.title: The Ones in Charge
passages.text:
It seems one of the house's barons is overseeing this operation... and he is unaware that we are free. 

We have a chance to strike him down!

passages.title: Two of Them, Two of Us
passages.text:
A construct made entirely of kyrian flesh...

This betrays everything Maldraxxus stands for! We are meant to defend the Shadowlands and all within it, not slaughter and exploit them!

Come, adventurer! We end this now!

passages.title: Two of Them, Two of Us
passages.text: I sense something within this construct... something familiar...

passages.title: Finish What He Started
passages.text:
Finding Sha'lor is our main priority. But there is another opportunity.

Take the Gormherd Branch that he dropped. I know he was tinkering with it so that it would work on wild gorm.

Use it on the gorm in the burrows, and see if you can collect any of their gorm gris.

Don't bother with the little ones; get the really potent stuff from the bigger gorm.

Perhaps if we can collect enough, and find that silly sylvar, he will not rush horns-first into the burrows again.

passages.title: Finish What He Started
passages.text: Have you had any luck?

passages.title: Finish What He Started
passages.text:
Well done. You've collected enough gorm gris to hopefully keep Sha'lor from venturing into the burrows all by himself, again.

And we should be able to send some to our friends in Glitterfall, once all this is over. 

Thank you.

passages.title: When a Gorm Eats a God
passages.text:
There is nothing more we can do here. I will get Master Sha'lor safely back to Tirna Vaal.

When you get there, report to the droman what we found here. 

If the gorm have started to eat the dead wildseeds, and are absorbing the power of the spirits within, we are all in serious danger.

passages.title: When a Gorm Eats a God
passages.text:
Those that speak, think. A different kind of Queen is born.

The forest worries. For this will surely not be the last.

passages.title: All Natural Chews
passages.text:
A huge part of larion care is providing for them and keeping them happy.

Larions need to keep their teeth sharp and healthy, and for that they need to chew. If you do not give them proper things to chew on, they can get destructive.

One of their favorite chew toys are the antlers from the cloudstriders in the nearby field. Please, collect some antlers for the pride to enjoy.

passages.title: All Natural Chews
passages.text: Antlers are great for keeping my pack's teeth sharp and clean.

passages.title: All Natural Chews
passages.text: The larions will be ecstatic to have more antlers to chew on!

passages.title: Plague is Thicker Than Water
passages.text:
Come closer, my apprentice... I have a mission of dire import!

A necromancer came to our house recently, sent by the lich Margrave Sin'dane! He seemed so polite, always eager to lend a hand in my lady's most volatile creations.

But I grew wise, my apprentice. The way he skulked around, prodding for our most sensitive experiments...

He was trying to steal our slimes! I know it!

You should admonish him quite harshly. Show that no harm will come to our friends!

passages.title: Plague is Thicker Than Water
passages.text: Have you chided the defiler?

passages.title: Plague is Thicker Than Water
passages.text: Our slimes will be safe, my dear apprentice!

passages.title: The Master of Lies
passages.text:
Once more unto the fangs of death himself, sword drawn, peace with oblivion made. Let us meet death together and bring him low.

Be sure you are prepared for a sustained assault. For once we reveal ourselves, there will be no stopping. 

When you are ready, direct the Focal Mirror at the gates of Castle Nathria. Let us descend upon our burning enemies with ferocity and swiftness of action.

passages.title: The Master of Lies
passages.text: What has he done?

passages.title: Theater of Pain: Help Wanted
passages.text:
Oh, bother--the Lich champion has withdrawn from the contest.

Well, then... It appears we have an opening! Would anyone like to enter in her stead?

Perhaps to increase the odds for their house?

Anyone?

Oh, <name>! So kind of you to volunteer. No better way to get experience than to just jump right in unprepared!

Remember, we can't all be winners.

passages.title: Theater of Pain: Help Wanted
passages.text: A spectacular show, Maw Walker.

passages.title: For the Alliance
passages.text:
As High Tinker, and leader of both Gnomes and Mechagnomes, I am proud to welcome you to the Alliance!

A world of adventure awaits you beyond the walls of Mechagon City.

When you are ready, step on the teleporter. Ambassador Moorgard will be awaiting your arrival at the Stormwind Embassy.

There will be many potential avenues of advancement available to you.

Choose wisely, improve, and remember to share your data.

passages.title: For the Alliance
passages.text: Welcome to Stormwind, <race>.

passages.title: For the Alliance
passages.text: Ah, there you are, <name>! We've been inspecting--err--expecting you!

passages.title: Minions of N'Zoth
passages.text:
The howling winds that surround us may some day be drowned out, masked by these increasingly dark, yet familiar whispers.

Something must be done.

Enter the darkness, <name>, and strike down the enemy.

passages.title: Minions of N'Zoth
passages.text: The winds envelop us, comforting, calming... but beneath it all lurks a great, ever-present darkness.

passages.title: Minions of N'Zoth
passages.text: Your work will not go unnoticed. Of that, I am certain.

passages.title: A Hand in the Dark
passages.text:
Imagine being trapped in a world you didn't know existed--a reality unbeknownst to even yourself.

Thoughts, fears, and dark desires cloud the mind, coupled with irresistible temptation.

So many are lost to the darkness, unable to resist these temptations, but not all.

Do what you can to preserve those that fight against the darkness. We mustn't allow them to fall.

passages.title: A Hand in the Dark
passages.text: It is best not to linger in darkness.

passages.title: A Hand in the Dark
passages.text: The withering whispers lie in wait. Remain vigilant, <name>.

passages.title: Vanquishing the Darkness
passages.text:
The darkness grows. The cycle continues.

Do what you can to stay N'Zoth's efforts. If we do not stand against the corruption we may some day find ourselves drowning in darkness.

passages.title: Vanquishing the Darkness
passages.text: We both know what must be done.

passages.title: Vanquishing the Darkness
passages.text: Your dedication to stemming the corruption remains invaluable, <name>.

passages.title: Unknown Assailants
passages.text:
This must be the stone he found. I do not recognize the mark.

You should bring this to the nearby droman. They are wise and retain much of the knowledge of the forests and the realms beyond. They will know what to do.

passages.title: Unknown Assailants
passages.text: What rustles you so, young one?

passages.title: Preventative Measures
passages.text:
Waves of darkness continue their assault on the shores of our world. I am afraid the waters at our feet may soon wash over us. Perhaps it is time for a different approach.

Make your way into the twisted realm and seek out their dark portals. If we are able to slow their advance it might just buy us the time needed to expose a fatal weakness.

passages.title: Preventative Measures
passages.text: Darkness lurks beneath the waters.

passages.title: Preventative Measures
passages.text: A brief reprieve to catch our breath. Let us hope it lasts.

passages.title: A Dark, Glaring Reality
passages.text:
Their eyes are upon us, <name>, watching every move from the shadows. It is no wonder our efforts thus far have felt... lacking.

The fault is by no means your own. We should have suspected this was the case long ago.

If we are to continue our efforts with meaningful expectations we must go undetected.

Our old friend has offered an elixir to aide in exposing our enemy. While there may be a few... unknown side effects, the result provides the imbiber true sight in the darkness.

passages.title: A Dark, Glaring Reality
passages.text: Seeing things more clearly?

passages.title: A Dark, Glaring Reality
passages.text: Keep your eyes open, <name>.

passages.title: Refining Ego
passages.text:
I will locate Phaestus. In the meantime, task for you!

The Forsworn use my forge to make their centurion army. Their vile intentions warp the metals we use!

Destroy their centurions, take their parts. Smelt them down in the forge to purify the metals, then return to me.

I need much metal for my plan.

passages.title: Refining Ego
passages.text: I keep my resources here. The Forsworn stole from me! I cannot let this stand.

passages.title: Refining Ego
passages.text: We shall use this metal for many purposes. For the Crest, and for my goliath!

passages.title: Instruments of Perfection
passages.text:
Mikanikos is no ordinary steward. He is wise! Talented! The smartest of us all!

Also very particular!

He cannot work without his tools. The Forsworn scattered them around the forge!

You need to rebuild Crest? Retrieve his tools!

passages.title: Instruments of Perfection
passages.text: I cannot work in these conditions.

passages.title: Instruments of Perfection
passages.text:
Sika sent you to retrieve my tools?

She knows what I need to be productive.

passages.title: Phaestus, Genesis of Aeons
passages.text:
Sika reports the Forsworn are widespread. They not only took over production, but the rise as well!

They organize their armies from the cliffs, send word back to their leaders.

They've ransacked our shrine to the First Forgelite and took her hammer. My hammer!

Defeat their commander, retrieve Phaestus. You must go now!

passages.title: Phaestus, Genesis of Aeons
passages.text: Without Phaestus, we cannot work on the Crest.

passages.title: Phaestus, Genesis of Aeons
passages.text:
Phaestus returns! Glorious day.

Many thanks, friend. This hammer has been passed down for eons! It belongs in my masterful hands.

passages.title: Pumped Up
passages.text:
When this necropolis collapsed, plenty of its parts got submerged in the riverbed flowing just outside. I hope you're really dedicated to fixing this place, because we're gonna dredge those parts back up!

Take this pump. If you find any places bubbling in that sludge, that's a good sign parts will be there!

Just be careful with whatever you pull up! You could face some resistance.

passages.title: Pumped Up
passages.text: Have you recovered anything useful?

passages.title: Pumped Up
passages.text: You love to see it!

passages.title: A Rallying Cry
passages.text:
Our lands have been infested by the minions of the Old Gods. They strike at every front, even assailing the very minds of our soldiers.

Our forces cannot handle this for long. We must strike a decisive blow to try to salvage some of their morale.

Find the biggest, slimiest, tentacle-faced monstrosities that you can and bring them down. My men will rally to your example.

passages.title: A Rallying Cry
passages.text:
My men will look to your victories this day to bolster their spirits. 

Ramkahen owes you a debt, <class>.

passages.title: Blind the Eyes
passages.text:
Strange forces have been interfering with my visions of late. The ever-watching eyes pierce through the veil, shattering my clairvoyance.

The eyes of our enemy peer into our very souls and pierce our minds. We must rip them out, if we truly wish to be rid of the curse on this land.

passages.title: Blind the Eyes
passages.text: Is it done?

passages.title: Blind the Eyes
passages.text:
The eyes are closed, and my clairvoyance returns.

Thank you, <class>.

passages.title: Wisdom From Madness
passages.text:
In my visions I hear... voices...

Their words are nonsense, but over time patterns arise. I believe there is something important behind what these voices say, but I have yet to decipher a word.

We will need to learn from the source. Find any writings you can among the cultists who travel with these dark creatures. Their ramblings may be the key to understanding the message beneath this madness.

passages.title: Wisdom From Madness
passages.text: Have you found the writings?

passages.title: Wisdom From Madness
passages.text:
As I suspected, the writings of the cultists appears to be completely incoherent.

Let us hope some truth lies within this madness.

passages.title: Order Among Chaos
passages.text:
It has been a long time since the tol'vir have squared off against the forces of an Old God, so our tactical knowledge of their forces is limited.

However, one tenet of combat always holds true -- striking down those that issue the orders will weaken the foe much greater than the rank and file. 

I have observed that the larger faceless minions act as commanders of the Old Gods' forces. Silence them, and perhaps we can sow a different kind of chaos in their ranks.

passages.title: Order Among Chaos
passages.text:
A decisive strike against their commanders should buy us some time.

Thank you, <class>.

passages.title: Questionable Sourcing
passages.text:
My clairvoyance provides a great strategic asset to the people of Ramkahen. However, the potency of my visions of late has proven taxing to my health.

I have devised a tonic that may serve to dull the harm these visions cause, but it will require the coalesced essence of the Old Gods' corruption.

If you could retrieve some samples of this for me, it could prove invaluable in our efforts.

passages.title: Questionable Sourcing
passages.text: Have you acquired the reagent?

passages.title: Questionable Sourcing
passages.text:
You've returned with the samples? Excellent.

Let us hope this has the intended effect.

passages.title: Anchors of the Black Empire
passages.text:
This invasion struck us without warning, with structures reminiscent of the Black Empire materializing out of nothing, pouring out the forces of the Old Gods. We have no idea how they came to be or where they came from.

However, whenever a new structure appears, it is preceded by malefic obelisks. We believe these obelisks act as anchors to usher in more of the Old Gods' forces.

If we truly wish to stem the tide of this invasion, we must destroy the obelisks.

passages.title: Anchors of the Black Empire
passages.text:
While the threat has far from subsided, it is comforting to know that our enemy's reinforcements have been slowed. 

We may just survive to see an end to this battle.

passages.title: Symbolic Destruction
passages.text:
The cultists that follow this dark legion befoul our lands with symbols of the tyrants they follow. 

Their mindless followers flock to these banners, worshipping them as unholy idols.

Burn them down, and cleanse their taint from our lands.

passages.title: Symbolic Destruction
passages.text: Good. It will be a fine day when these disgraceful sigils no longer befoul our land.

passages.title: Cleansing Uldum
passages.text:
Every moment that N'Zoth's forces remain in Uldum, his corruption seeps further into the land itself.

Even if we were to drive back his minions, the damage he has done to Uldum may be irreversible. 

We must seek out his corruption where it festers and eliminate it.

passages.title: Cleansing Uldum
passages.text: We must put a stop to N'Zoth's Corruption.

passages.title: Cleansing Uldum
passages.text:
Even now, I sense N'Zoth's corruption waning.

You have done well.

passages.title: Lost and Tormented
passages.text:
Our citizens here in Ramkahen have managed to escape the brunt of N'Zoth's assault. 

Our brothers in the Lost City were not so fortunate. Those not immediately slain have been held captive only to be tortured by N'Zoth's minions.

I know that you will be taking the fight to N'Zoth's forces. If you can free our allies as well, Ramkahen will be in your debt.

passages.title: Lost and Tormented
passages.text:
Our citizens owe you a debt they may never be able to repay, <name>.

Ramkahen thanks you for this service.

passages.title: Lessons in Brigandry
passages.text:
The Wastewanders have spent many generations as brigands, whether on land or sea. Though we have decided to hang up that life for a chance at a more peaceful existence, we have not forgotten the lessons we've learned in those days.

One such lesson I feel is particularly relevant now -- when faced with a superior opponent, it often helps to use their weapons against them.

Find their hidden caches and take whatever you can carry. You may just find something that can turn the tide of this battle.

passages.title: Lessons in Brigandry
passages.text: Found anything worthwhile?

passages.title: Lessons in Brigandry
passages.text:
I hope you found what you were looking for.

We can use all the help we can get in this fight.

passages.title: Queens And Future Kings
passages.text:
A swarm of marrowbore queens have been laying eggs atop the ruins of our house. We may be able to use this to our advantage.

With Twigin's help, eliminate the queens and recover larvae from the eggs.

I have a plan for the larvae that may allow us to use the marrowbore to our advantage.

passages.title: Queens And Future Kings
passages.text: It's dirty work, but we need those larvae.

passages.title: Queens And Future Kings
passages.text: Now to put these to a useful purpose.

passages.title: Servant of N'Zoth
passages.text:
<class>...

I have watched you... I have felt your bloodlust. 

But you serve false prophets... the Horde is an illusion... I am a god!

Prove to me you are worthy of my gift... kill those who are to betray you...

Kill... the Horde!

I have watched you... I have felt your bloodlust. 

But you serve false prophets... the Alliance is an illusion... I am a god!

Prove to me you are worthy of my gift... kill those who are to betray you...

Kill... the Alliance!

passages.title: Dark Deceivers
passages.text:
The Old Gods have many faceless minions at their disposal, but none so deceiving as the ones they call k'thir.

Though not nearly as imposing as their brethren, the k'thir manipulate in the shadows, bending the wills of men and even reality itself.

We must not allow their machinations to go unchecked.

passages.title: Dark Deceivers
passages.text:
We cannot let these creatures roam Uldum unhindered.

You have done well to cull their numbers.

passages.title: Quartermaster's Bounty
passages.text: Victory at any cost.

passages.title: Ancient Armaments
passages.text:
Fighting a war on several fronts has taken its toll on our supplies. Our blacksmiths cannot repair and replace our soldiers' armor quickly enough, which is leaving us ill-equipped to face so many foes.

Though the Amathet's armor is ancient, it is titan-forged and formidable. If we were able to salvage any, it could prove very useful to our defensive efforts.

Can you help?

passages.title: Ancient Armaments
passages.text: Have you returned with the armor?

passages.title: Ancient Armaments
passages.text:
Thank the Light you've returned! Our soldiers need this armor badly. 

Your efforts will safeguard the lives of many in Ramkahen, <class>.

passages.title: Down From the Sky
passages.text:
The archers of Ramkahen are highly skilled, but the bows of the Amathet have the advantage of range. This makes our incursions into their territory highly dangerous.

You have a knack for fighting behind enemy lines. If you could thin out their ranks, it could provide us an opportunity to push their lines back for once.

Will you help?

passages.title: Down From the Sky
passages.text:
The Amathet's arrows no longer darken our skies.

We must take this opportunity to strike!

passages.title: Blind Leading the Blind
passages.text:
The Sun Priests are an ancient order for the tol'vir who have walked among all of the tribes. 

Those that follow the Amathet, however, have twisted our beliefs and weaponized them to justify their crusade against Ramkahen. Their soldiers follow them blindly, never questioning.

They must be stopped.

passages.title: Blind Leading the Blind
passages.text:
I take no joy in the deaths of my brethren, but the Amathet must be stopped.

You have my thanks.

passages.title: Writs of the Sun King
passages.text:
Very little is known about the Sun King that leads the Amathet. Our observations suggest that those closest to him are the "Suntouched," a unique caste of solar magic practitioners.

I would like very much to learn more about this Sun King but, unlike some members of the Explorers' League, I'm not willing to risk the lives of my researchers to do so. 

You seem to be able to hold your own, though. If you happen upon any records about the Sun King, I'd gladly take them off your hands.

passages.title: Writs of the Sun King
passages.text: Have you found anything interesting?

passages.title: Writs of the Sun King
passages.text:
The markings on these are fascinating!

I'll have my researchers begin deciphering these right away!

passages.title: Unearthed Artifacts
passages.text:
Ever since the Amathet came out of their tombs, they've been busy unearthing titan relics from the surrounding areas. 

I'm not sure what they intend to do with them or if they're just hoarding it so we can't have them. Sufficed to say the Explorers' League would love to study some of what they found!

Of course, we can't get anywhere close to them without the Amathet trying to stick an axe in us, but that's not a problem for you, is it? 

Care to help?

passages.title: Unearthed Artifacts
passages.text: Any luck with the titan artifacts?

passages.title: Unearthed Artifacts
passages.text:
You really do come through, don't you?

You know, we could use some reliable folks like you in the League...

passages.title: A Smashing Plan
passages.text:
Reports from my scouts mention various idols and monuments that the Amathet use to channel their solar magic. 

I don't know exactly what they're up to, but we should take away any possible advantage they have. So, I want you to go over there, and break anything that looks remotely magical.

Just don't tell the Explorers' League. I'll never hear the end of it.

passages.title: A Smashing Plan
passages.text:
Good work, <class>.

Slowly but surely, we chip away at the Amathet's resolve.

passages.title: The Sun King's Chosen
passages.text:
On the surface the Amathet appear to be unwavering, but all soldiers have their breaking point. We need to send a message to their forces that we are not to be trifled with.

Seek out the strongest of their numbers and bring them down in front of their eyes. 

We will show them the strength of Uldum!

passages.title: The Sun King's Chosen
passages.text:
Well struck, <class>!

We will find a way to break the Amathet yet!

passages.title: Champions of the Amathet
passages.text:
The soldiers of Ramkahen are hearty and reliable. 

I would stand them up against any footman of the Amathet, but some of their higher-caste fighters are too much for even our toughest to handle.

I don't think they'd be a problem for you, though. It would be a boon to our defense efforts if you could handle them while my soldiers engage the rank and file.

passages.title: Champions of the Amathet
passages.text: Good work, <class>. My soldiers should be able to take care of the rest.

passages.title: Encroaching Poachers
passages.text:
The Wastewanders used the pelts of the local hyenas to construct our armor. Unfortunately since the Amathet arrived, their hunters have overrun our normal hunting grounds.

We need those pelts, and will pay handsomely for them. Either take them from the hunters or skin the hyenas yourself, if you have the skill.

passages.title: Encroaching Poachers
passages.text: Have you brought back the pelts?

passages.title: Encroaching Poachers
passages.text:
You're a life-saver, friend.

Here's your reward, as promised.

passages.title: Uncommon Core
passages.text:
Our scouts have reported that the Amathet are constructing new titanic watchers. 

We had long thought this art was lost to the sands of time. It would appear we were mistaken.

I needn't tell you what a boon it would be to have the aid of watcher constructs in our battles for Uldum. We must unlock the secrets of their construction!

The power of a titanic watcher lies in its core. I ask that you bring one to me, so that our artificers might divine its construction.

passages.title: Uncommon Core
passages.text: Have you obtained the core?

passages.title: Uncommon Core
passages.text:
Marvelous! I have never seen its like!

I will have this sent to my artificers at once! With luck, they can unlock the lost knowledge within.

passages.title: Snacks for Stonehead
passages.text:
<Stonehead has amassed a wide variety of half-eaten oddities.

He'd certainly appreciate you bringing some new, creative snacks for him to try.>

passages.title: Snacks for Stonehead
passages.text: Tummy rumbly...

passages.title: Snacks for Stonehead
passages.text:
<Stonehead's eyes light up when he sees the massive pile of semi-edible delicacies you brought him.>

You best bud! Best bud free to go wherever he want!

passages.title: Lead the Way
passages.text:
We must move now. That won't be the last assassin we face.

I can provide some cover of darkness, but mind that the spell is not infallible.

Enough talking. The Curator needs us and my mirror shard to get to her as soon as possible.

passages.title: Lead the Way
passages.text:
Thank you for bringing him here safely, <name>. I am glad he is alive.

With his mirror shard in hand, we now have the unfortunate task of obtaining Mateo's mirror shard.

I cannot believe he betrayed us. Many venthyr have reverted to their sinful ways it seems...

passages.title: Ny'alotha: MOTHER's Guidance
passages.text:
Ny'alotha does not obey the rules of space and time, and we may be able to use this to our advantage.

MOTHER theorizes that if we obtain specific objects from N'Zoth's chosen, we can utilize them to bend space and expedite our passage here in the future. Though, it is doubtful they will relinquish these items willingly.

passages.title: Ny'alotha: MOTHER's Guidance
passages.text: Without the items MOTHER cannot guarantee safe passage.

passages.title: Ny'alotha: MOTHER's Guidance
passages.text: With these items, MOTHER can guarantee safe access to this area.

passages.title: Ny'alotha: MOTHER's Guidance
passages.text:
Ny'alotha does not obey the rules of space and time, and we may be able to use this to our advantage.

MOTHER theorizes that if we obtain specific objects from N'Zoth's chosen, we can utilize them to bend space and expedite our passage here in the future. Though, it is doubtful they will relinquish these items willingly.

passages.title: Ny'alotha: MOTHER's Guidance
passages.text: Without the items MOTHER cannot guarantee safe passage.

passages.title: Ny'alotha: MOTHER's Guidance
passages.text: With these items, MOTHER can guarantee safe access to this area.

Ny'alotha does not obey the rules of space and time, and we may be able to use this to our advantage.

MOTHER theorizes that if we obtain specific objects from N'Zoth's chosen, we can utilize them to bend space and expedite our passage here in the future. Though, it is doubtful they will relinquish these items willingly.

passages.title: Ny'alotha: MOTHER's Guidance
passages.text: With these items, MOTHER can guarantee safe access to this area.

passages.title: Enough Vengeance For One Day
passages.text:
After the Sunwell's destruction and the near extermination of my people, I vowed to claim vengeance upon Arthas and Kel'Thuzad. But I needed power to see that happen, and to seize that power I...

<Kael'thas grows quiet.>

I... am ready to return to Sinfall. I must recover my strength for what lies ahead.

As the Accuser is so fond of reminding me, I have... much to ponder.

Let us inform our allies of the enemy we have revealed.

passages.title: Enough Vengeance For One Day
passages.text:
Maldraxxus is sworn to defend Revendreth from outside invaders, not siphon off our anima.

Accept this gift for your role in bringing this conspiracy to light, <name>.

We will need time to calculate our next move, but I am certain that you will be a key part of it.

passages.title: The Medallion of Dominion
passages.text:
Laurent speaks the truth. We must not delay. 

This mirror is our entryway into the heart of Maldraxxus. 

Together with Kael'thas, we will find Kel'Thuzad and rip the Medallion of Dominion from his undeserving grasp.

passages.title: The Medallion of Dominion
passages.text:
Revendreth can now begin the return to its true purpose. May we walk into brighter futures together.

<Prince Renathal smiles.>

I could not help but notice that Vrednic, my loyal gargon, has taken an affinity to you, as I have.

If you would have him, I am certain he would enjoy accompanying you. Together, you shall instill fear into our enemies as he bears you into our next battle.

passages.title: A Foul Annoyance
passages.text:
The Hozen are opportunistic and weak. It does not surprise me that some of their kind have thrown their lot in with the Old Gods.

We should take care of them before they become more than a nuisance.

passages.title: A Foul Annoyance
passages.text: Good. The Vale is better off without their filth.

passages.title: Mark of the Conquerors
passages.text:
The invading minions of N'Zoth lay claim to lands they are not entitled to. 

The Vale will not be conquered while even one of the Rajani still draws breath.

Burn down their banners as a reminder of this.

passages.title: Mark of the Conquerors
passages.text: Have you sent our message?

passages.title: Mark of the Conquerors
passages.text:
Good.

These invaders should know that we are not so easily conquered.

passages.title: The Strongest Among Them
passages.text:
You have shown great strength in your conquests, but new enemies assail the Vale with each day.

Seek out the strongest that our foes have sent forth, and bring them down for their allies to see.

passages.title: The Strongest Among Them
passages.text: Tell me of your victories.

passages.title: The Strongest Among Them
passages.text:
Even minions of the Old Gods must take pause when their champions are laid out before them.

Remember this as the battle rages on.

passages.title: Pool of Potions
passages.text:
I shall teach you about the Pool of Potions. The potions we create here have a variety of beneficial effects.

Kill the slimes in the surrounding ruins and collect the Oozing Ingredient: Viscous Oil they may drop. Each slime can produce a great quantity of oil, so you'll only be able to carry one slime's worth at a time. 

Deliver this oil to the Pool of Potions and toss it in.

passages.title: Pool of Potions
passages.text: Have you brought enough oil?

passages.title: Pool of Potions
passages.text: We shall all share in this fabulous brew you have created!

passages.title: Tracking the Shadows
passages.text:
The quarry has been slain, and my duties fulfilled. The tirnenn are more than capable of defending their home from the lesser devourers. Nature will take its course.

I will report back to Lord Herne and meet you at the Heart of the Forest. There we shall see what I will be hunting next.

passages.title: Tracking the Shadows
passages.text:
Even in the afterlife, the legend of Huln Highmountain continues to grow.

You have done well to secure his aid, <name>. Now let our search begin.

passages.title: Marshals of Madness
passages.text:
The n'raqi have long served as the commanders and taskmasters of the Old Gods' forces. Their presence on the field of battle shows that this invasion is a coordinated effort rather than a random outbreak of corruption.

Led by these faceless masters, the chaotic forces of the Old Gods transform into capable military.

We must make it a priority to fell these creatures. Only then might we take the upper hand against N'Zoth.

passages.title: Marshals of Madness
passages.text:
The loss of their leaders should prove to scatter N'Zoth's forces in the Vale.

This should provide us with the advantage we need to crush them once and for all.

passages.title: Tomes of Ancient Madness
passages.text:
In times like these, it becomes necessary for all of the denizens of the Vale to pitch in and do their part. Unfortunately, I have never been much of a fighter, so my usefulness in times of war is limited.

However, I may be able to do some good. You see, we know very little about the invaders we face, and knowledge can be a very powerful weapon.

I think I have seen tomes carried by some of the k'thir. If you could bring some to me, I may be able to glean something useful from their writings.

passages.title: Tomes of Ancient Madness
passages.text: Have you managed to procure the tomes?

passages.title: Tomes of Ancient Madness
passages.text:
Yes, this is exactly what I was looking for! I'll start researching these at once!

Ah, it's good to feel useful!

passages.title: Windows to the Soul
passages.text:
Were it not enough for our enemy to apply deadly force against us, their minions also strike into the very heart of our defenders.

I speak, of course, of the eyes. They peer into the souls of our warriors and produce their darkest fears against them.

If we have any hope to defeat this foe, they must be destroyed.

passages.title: Windows to the Soul
passages.text: Is your task complete?

passages.title: Windows to the Soul
passages.text:
The foul eyes are no more, and our warriors' courage is restored.

Thank you, <name>.

passages.title: Spawns of Madness
passages.text:
To see the Vale of Eternal Blossoms recover from the Sha to its former beauty, only to see it tainted by the Old Gods once more, it makes the blood boil!

We must root out the Old God's corruption before it can take hold of this land again. I have seen the fleshbeasts that accompany N'Zoth's forces spreading his corruption where they tread.

Make sure they tread no longer.

passages.title: Spawns of Madness
passages.text: I will not see the Vale fall again!

passages.title: Spawns of Madness
passages.text:
You have done well.

We must not let N'Zoth take hold of this land!

passages.title: Deephive Decimation
passages.text:
A sect of the mantid swarm calling themselves the "Deephive" have taken hold of the Big Blossom mine. These mantid have fully given themselves up to the Old Gods' corruption, making them especially dangerous.

We cannot allow the Deephive to run amok in the Vale. Do what must be done.

passages.title: Deephive Decimation
passages.text: Have the Deephive been taken care of?

passages.title: Deephive Decimation
passages.text:
The mantid are incessant, but we will drive them back.

At least you've taken care of the worst of their numbers.

passages.title: Corruption Manifest
passages.text:
The corruption of the Old Gods is often so foul it manifests itself in physical form. 

We have seen this with the Sha. This time is no different.

Cull this corruption wherever you see it spread. It must not be left to flourish.

passages.title: Corruption Manifest
passages.text:
I can see the stains of N'Zoth's corruption on your weapons.

Well struck, <class>.

passages.title: Torment From Beyond
passages.text:
As if it were not bad enough that N'Zoth seeks to dominate those living in the Vale, my scouts report they now seek to dominate the dead!

The Shado-Pan have their hands full defending the living. Can we rely on you to put an end to this disgrace?

passages.title: Torment From Beyond
passages.text: N'Zoth must be stopped.

passages.title: Torment From Beyond
passages.text:
I had my misgivings about your people at first, but it seems you truly have Pandaria's well-being at heart.

Thank you, <class>.

passages.title: Prisoners of Mind and Body
passages.text:
N'Zoth's forces struck the Vale suddenly. By the time I and my Shado-Pan arrived, many of the Golden Lotus had already been taken captive by the Old God's forces.

Even with our combined might, we have only been able to hold off the invaders from taking more of our people. Those already taken, however, are still within the clutches of the Old God.

I know we have had our differences, <name>, but if you could aid us in their recovery, the Shado-Pan would be in your debt.

passages.title: Prisoners of Mind and Body
passages.text: Any news of the captives?

passages.title: Prisoners of Mind and Body
passages.text:
I do not wish to dwell upon the fate that would have otherwise befell those you rescued.

You are a true champion of pandaria, <class>.

passages.title: A Growing Darkness
passages.text:
Shado-Pan scouts have spotted evidence of a new mantid hatchery within the Big Blossom mine. It seems these Deephive mantid are looking to create new corrupted spawn to serve N'Zoth.

If these eggs were allowed to hatch, a new swarm empowered by the Old God could blacken the skies of the Vale and plunge Pandaria into darkness.

We will not allow that to happen, will we?

passages.title: A Growing Darkness
passages.text:
The swarm has been abated, for now.

Keep an eye out for any new hatcheries. We cannot afford to leave the Deephive unchecked.

passages.title: Tears in the Vale
passages.text:
As N'Zoth's influence spreads within the Vale, our very reality begins to break down. 

The Old God's power has created tears in the fabric our world, acting as doorways for his minions to invade from his dark realm.

As long as these tears exist, we will never be free from N'Zoth's grasp. Close them, and stem the tide of his corruption!

passages.title: Tears in the Vale
passages.text: Our reality weakens with each passing day.

passages.title: Tears in the Vale
passages.text:
The paths are closed, and the Vale is more itself again.

Thank you, <name>.

passages.title: Corrupted Curiosities
passages.text:
I understand that the Black Empire poses a grave threat to Pandaria, but we may also use this as an opportunity!

Though we've faced them several times before, very little is known about the Old Gods or N'Zoth's mysterious realm of Ny'alotha. 

When studying ancient civilizations, we often rely on artifacts to unlock the deepest mysteries lost to time. I wonder if some such artifacts could be found among the Old God's forces?

It can't hurt to check, right?

passages.title: Corrupted Curiosities
passages.text: Did you find anything interesting?

passages.title: Corrupted Curiosities
passages.text:
Spendid! Just think of what ancient mysteries we could learn from these artifacts!

I hope you didn't go through too much trouble to get these.

passages.title: Aggressive Notation
passages.text:
Even given the Sha's origins with the Old Gods, we in Pandaria still know very little of them.

I would like to take this opportunity to add whatever information I can about them to the archives of the Lorewalkers. Of course, that becomes a bit problematic when they're trying to kill us.

That doesn't seem to be a problem for you, though. Could you do me a favor and jot down some notes about what you encounter out there? It could help a great deal towards understanding what we're fighting.

passages.title: Aggressive Notation
passages.text:
Fantastic! This is very thorough!

I must ask, though, how do you maintain such impeccable penmanship in the heat of battle?

passages.title: Bringing the Thunder
passages.text:
All of the mogu clans are formidable, to be sure, but it is the Zan-Tien that pose the most direct threat to the Golden Lotus. 

Even now, their numbers are amassing outside the Golden Pagoda. Many of our warriors are fresh-faced and inexperienced. They would not withstand a mogu assault for long.

An experienced <class> like you could serve to slow them down significantly. 

Care to help?

passages.title: Bringing the Thunder
passages.text: What's the word from the front?

passages.title: Bringing the Thunder
passages.text: You've probably saved the lives of many Golden Lotus warriors today.

passages.title: Through Blood and Dirt and Bone
passages.text:
The Dokani see themselves fit to wield the ancient magic of anima, but their golems and manifestations are but a fraction of anima's true power.

Liberate them of their prized substance, so that the Rajani may put it to better use.

passages.title: Through Blood and Dirt and Bone
passages.text: What do you bring?

passages.title: Through Blood and Dirt and Bone
passages.text:
This will do.

Go now. I am sure you are needed elsewhere.

passages.title: No Stone Unbroken
passages.text:
When the warring clans came into the Vale, the Baruk deigned themselves worthy to lay claim to the ancient grounds of Guo-Lai.

They are not.

Show these usurpers their place, and you may earn a modicum of favor with the Rajani.

passages.title: No Stone Unbroken
passages.text:
The Baruk will soon learn their place under the foot of the Rajani.

Well done.

passages.title: Lightning Crashes
passages.text:
The Zan-Tien like to claim mastery over the power of storms, yet they resort to machines to harness lightning from the sky.

Show these pretenders that the true power of storm and thunder comes from within. Break their toys, and see how they fare without.

passages.title: Lightning Crashes
passages.text:
Hah! Let's see how these so-called "masters of storm" fare without their precious contraptions!

This should be entertaining.

passages.title: Read the Roots
passages.text:
When my grove withered, I answered the Queen's call and joined the Wild Hunt.

Nothing can be done for Tirna Noch. But it wounds me to see it crawling with foes of the forest.
