If the necromancer's brood descends upon us fully before the colossus is charged, we will perish. There is no question.

We must keep his attention until Mikanikos's work is complete.

He believes that the day is already won -- that we are pawns to be toyed with. We can use his hubris to our advantage to buy precious seconds.

May it be enough.

passages.title: The Final Countdown
passages.text: Our only move now is forward, outsider.

passages.title: Necrotic Wake: A Paragon's Plight
passages.text:
Xandria, the mighty Paragon of Courage, is the finest warrior among all the ascended. But even she may be overwhelmed by the strongest of Maldraxxus' forces.

Your fate is intertwined with hers, now. You must gather your allies and plunge into the Necrotic Wake to ensure both Amarth and Nalthor do not make it back to the safety of their realm.

May the Archon guide your blade into their hearts.

passages.title: Necrotic Wake: A Paragon's Plight
passages.text: Word has spread throughout Bastion of your actions at the Temple of Courage, <name>. Xandria sent word that you were to be amply rewarded for your heroism.

passages.title: Wrath of the Lich King: To Northrend!
Wrath of the Lich King: To Northrend!
Drust and Ashes
passages.text:
The Drust encroach upon the Grove of Awakening, <name>!

We must fly in defense of Ardenweald!

passages.title: Drust and Ashes
passages.text:
Well done, huntsman.

You have saved Ardenweald from the Drust, and in so doing, protected countless other realms from their darkness.

passages.title: Burning Crusade: To Outland!
Burning Crusade: To Outland!
The Divine's Shield
passages.text:
This island has foul necromancy here in addition to the shadow magic. The Light can only just reach this place.

Call upon its Divine Shield to step through the barrier before us unharmed and destroy this vile altar.

Show the darkness on this island that you are protected by the Light's embrace.

passages.title: The Divine's Shield
passages.text: Do you require aid? Use Divine Shield to safely cross pass the necrotic barrier.

passages.title: The Divine's Shield
passages.text:
You have done well, <name>. Dispel this foul magic wherever you encounter it.

My task has been fulfilled. The Light calls to me. 

Good luck, and remember that the Light's warmth will always embrace you.

passages.title: Reason for the Treason
passages.text:
If you ask me, the attack on our convoy is suspicious. I told Mistress Mihaela that there must be a traitor in the village, but she isn't concerned. It's understandable. She's got to worry about gathering a new tithe.

I've taken it upon myself to figure this out and I could use your help. I'm making discreet inquiries but I can't be seen speaking with the help. That's where you come in. You can be my assistant sleuth.

passages.title: Reason for the Treason
passages.text: Have you identified the traitor yet?

passages.title: Reason for the Treason
passages.text: Well, isn't that interesting information you've dug up.

passages.title: Trench Warfare
passages.text:
These would-be recruits seek a way to prove themselves. Let us give them the chance.

The specter known as Malifis has grown in strength by consuming our anima reserves. In this time of drought, we cannot afford to lose any of our most precious resource. 

This threat needs to be dealt with immediately.

Use this horn to signal the scavengers we've recruited. Let us see how well they fight under our banner!

passages.title: Trench Warfare
passages.text: Take care, our quarry is formidable.

passages.title: Trench Warfare
passages.text:
A threat removed for the House of the Chosen, and new recruits that show potential.

Good work.

passages.title: Timely Gate Crashers
passages.text:
Did you see that giant mechanical monstrosity just walking around in the dunes outside? How about the icky shadowy Sha of Anger? Or that big frost giant in the north? Yeah, they aren't native to this area. 

They tell me the timeways are screwy around this time of year. They have asked me to organize a clean-up crew.

Would you be up to the challenge? If you like this challenge, I have another for you as well.

passages.title: Timely Gate Crashers
passages.text: How's it going?

passages.title: Timely Gate Crashers
passages.text: Thanks for taking out Doomwalker, let's hope that doesn't happen again! It will though!

passages.title: Old Stomping Grounds
passages.text:
Once, long ago, I journeyed to Ardenweald to assist in putting down a threat now long forgotten.

I remember that while there, I saw small creatures taking tiny clusters of anima--animacones, the fae called them--and buried them under the soil.

If those clusters are still there, we must gather them for ourselves!

I should be able to unearth any of the animacones we encounter. Let's go hunt for them!

passages.title: Old Stomping Grounds
passages.text: Thank you, Maw Walker. This extra anima will tremendously aid our efforts.

passages.title: Trading Favors: Necrotic Wake
passages.text:
We of the brokers place value on things that may seem strange to an outsider like yourself. Objects that are unusual or one-of-a-kind are things we may find more valuable than others.

So let us make a deal, hm? Should you find yourself in possession of one such object, I will offer a trade for something you may find more valuable.

I hear that the forces of Maldraxxus have made an attack on Bastion. Such things rarely happen without objects of power in tow, no?

passages.title: Trading Favors: Necrotic Wake
passages.text: Have you found any objects of interest?

passages.title: Trading Favors: Necrotic Wake
passages.text:
Ah, quite a find, we rarely get a glimpse into the mechanisms by which the House of Rituals enact their dark designs. I am eager to delve into this tome, purely in the interests of knowledge of course.

You may choose from some of our procured items as a reward.

passages.title: Trading Favors: Sanguine Depths
passages.text:
The generals of Revendreth are outfitted with only the finest arms and armor, procured by Sire Denathrius in his unquenchable appetite for power. In terms of profitable trades and exchanges, he has been a shrewd partner in trade to us.

It would please me greatly to see the return of some relics that were traded in a way that benefited him far more than us. There are few things more insulting to my kind.

passages.title: Trading Favors: Sanguine Depths
passages.text: What have you brought before me?

passages.title: Trading Favors: Sanguine Depths
passages.text:
Yes, yes this is exactly what I was speaking about. The foolish generals of Revendreth would use this medallion to orient themselves during travel in unknown areas, but their ambitions were small.

For my people, who have traveled beyond the known lands, such a thing is invaluable when attempting to chart a way to return.

We will make great use of this, it is good to see it returned. Here, a prize for you.

passages.title: Trading Favors: Halls of Atonement
passages.text:
The mechanisms by which each land of the Shadowlands operates are quite intriguing. Yet, I have always held a particular fascination with the venthyr of Revendreth.

How they siphon souls of their sins, storing them in strange stones, and dredge up minions from the muck that surrounds them -- it is all quite novel.

They keep their secrets close at hand, however, and will not willingly part with information. I offer trades for any of their tomes you might come into possession of.

passages.title: Trading Favors: Halls of Atonement
passages.text: Have you found something of interest?

passages.title: Trading Favors: Halls of Atonement
passages.text:
A tome from Revendreth? Yes, let me see.

It chronicles the alchemical formulae necessary to form the dredger pools, and various recipes for forming and utilizing the little creatures. They are quite a curiosity, as much a minion as a reagent.

I will gladly take this off of your hands in exchange for a trade. Here, choose.

passages.title: Trading Favors: De Other Side
passages.text:
Mueh'zala is an ancient and primitive creature that commands a place known as De Other Side. Little is known about this land, as we are not permitted to visit. We have sent many offers of trade, yet there has never been a reply. 

A pity, as the few that have escaped Mueh'zala's clutches claim his domain to be a place of many oddities.

We would never ask you to venture into such danger. There is, however, a standing offer of trade for things procured from Mueh'zala's grasp.

passages.title: Trading Favors: De Other Side
passages.text: You have the stench of death about you.

passages.title: Trading Favors: De Other Side
passages.text:
Oh, this is quite a find, is it not? Something from De Other Side. We so rarely get to glimpse such things, I shall study this with interest. It would appear to be from a forgotten, primitive race that worshipped Mueh'zala.

A reward, of course, is in order. Make your choice.

passages.title: Trading Favors: Tirna Scithe
passages.text:
The gorm devour anything in their path when left unchecked. We have sold more than a few of them as both pets and weapons. You do not want to see what a world looks like when they are introduced to it and allowed to infest.

Or perhaps, mhm, you do? For some, that is entertainment.

It is difficult for us to explore Ardenweald with things as they are at this time. A fat, healthy gorm larva would fetch a fine price on the markets. I trust my meaning is understood?

passages.title: Trading Favors: Tirna Scithe
passages.text: Have you completed the task?

passages.title: Trading Favors: Tirna Scithe
passages.text:
Oh, what is this? It is so bulbous and squirming, it must be close to the next molting. I am something of an amateur gorm-breeder myself, and will find a proper place to raise this one. 

You may trust that I intend to destroy no worlds, I give you my word.

Now, I must tend to him, gather something from our stocks on your way out.

passages.title: Trading Favors: Theater of Pain
passages.text:
Grandmaster Vole runs the arena in Maldraxxus, where the champions of each of the houses compete for glory. Naturally, prizes are often awarded to the victors. 

Those of our kind do not often participate in such battles. To find such a prize for sale by one of us would be quite unusual indeed.

I trust I need say no more? Let us keep this transaction between us, and I will be happy to part with some valuable goods.

passages.title: Trading Favors: Theater of Pain
passages.text: Six, seven, eight... oh, yes? Do you have an offer of trade? I have much more inventory to catalogue.

passages.title: Trading Favors: Theater of Pain
passages.text:
Quite interesting, these coins are only granted to champions of the Maldraxxus arena after a certain amount of time in service. Purely ceremonial, they are worthless to most, but priceless to those that value ceremony. 

You may take something with you in compensation.

passages.title: Trading Favors: Plaguefall
passages.text:
Is is such a shame what happened to poor Margrave Stradama. Just between us, she was once one of our most favored trading partners. When things get lost in Maldraxxus they tend to end up at the bottom of her blighted pools.

You would not, perhaps, be interested in continuing this relationship on her behalf? We would, of course, compensate you quite well.

I am sure she has little use for these possessions in her current state.

passages.title: Trading Favors: Plaguefall
passages.text: Oh, it is you again.

passages.title: Trading Favors: Plaguefall
passages.text:
Oh my, this is quite a find. It is a catalogue of some of Stradama's procured objects, hidden away within her pools of plague. We will make good use of this, to be sure. 

Choose something to take with you, you have earned it.

passages.title: Trading Favors: Spires of Ascension
passages.text:
The Kyrians of Bastion serve a unique role in the Shadowlands, ferrying mortal souls from their realms to ours. They are able to do so in great numbers, it would seem, in times of crisis or devastation.

We would like to know more about their travels to the realms beyond. 

Surely one of them has brought something back from another land? They are, after all, so very interested in memories.

passages.title: Trading Favors: Spires of Ascension
passages.text: How may I assist you?

passages.title: Trading Favors: Spires of Ascension
passages.text:
A strange bauble, likely from another world. Yet, why would the paragon have brought this with her? 

Perhaps when carrying the soul of a child, as a reminder of something she had thought lost within herself? I will ponder this.

You may choose a reward from our stores.

passages.title: A Valuable Find: Theater of Pain
passages.text:
The Theater of Pain in Maldraxxus is a brutal place, where only the strongest survive. 

With the houses so fiercely in competition with one another, it is considered a great point of pride to house a champion with a winning record.

As such, the house lords often outfit their contenders with powerful arms, armor, and trinkets. Often these are storied items that have been passed down through many battles.

I would very much like to see such an item.

passages.title: A Valuable Find: Theater of Pain
passages.text: Were you victorious, or have you come to tend to your wounds?

passages.title: A Valuable Find: Theater of Pain
passages.text:
The fools, giving away an object such as this as a mere trinket to be used in battle. Do they not know of its significance? Clearly not.

Let me explain.

There is much we do not understand about the workings of this world. This city, Oribos, is made of a strange ore that we have not found anywhere else. Who made this place, and why?

Relics of similar make like this are all that we have to tie together the threads of mystery.

We thank you for this gift. Please, take a treasure.

passages.title: A Valuable Find: Plaguefall
passages.text:
Life in Maldraxxus is one of constant warfare, the great houses in perpetual competition with one another. Every once in a great while, a house lord obtains an item or piece of knowledge of such rarity that it tips the scales in their favor.

It is possible, even probable, that this was the cause of the fate that befell the House of Plagues.

I do not need to tell you how valuable such a rarity would be to us, do I?

passages.title: A Valuable Find: Plaguefall
passages.text: Yes? I am quite busy here.

passages.title: A Valuable Find: Plaguefall
passages.text:
I can only decipher a few words of this missive, give me a moment.

It appears to be a warning from the Margrave to another lord of Maldraxxus, or perhaps another place.

I see mention of the Primus, and discussion of his fate. Or someone else's? It is hard to tell. It appears to point to a location, but I cannot understand the description of the location.

This may be more valuable than you know for the fate of the Shadowlands. Choose a reward, I will continue my work on this.

passages.title: A Valuable Find: Spires of Ascension
passages.text:
You have, no doubt, visited Bastion and seen what happens to souls that are accepted there. Their memories are extracted, viewed, and even stored in their great Temple of Wisdom.

This temple houses memories that may answer some of the greatest questions we have about our realm and the worlds beyond. It is a shame they are locked away.

We have heard that the fallen Paragon of Loyalty has interest in these memories. Any memory that would catch her attention would surely be worth trading for.

passages.title: A Valuable Find: Spires of Ascension
passages.text: You have the look of one who has something to say.

passages.title: A Valuable Find: Spires of Ascension
passages.text:
This memory glass is old, very old. It may be the memory of a soul that moved on many years ago, we can never be certain. What is known is that the knowledge contained within can never be replicated, and soon, will never be seen again.

I will immediately get to work in preserving what of it I can. I must ask that you take your leave now, please choose a suitably rich reward for your efforts.

passages.title: A Valuable Find: Necrotic Wake
passages.text:
Once in a rare while, we find ourselves in possession of an object of exceptionally cryptic origin. These objects allow us a brief glimpse into the realms beyond our comprehension. 

It may seem to you that I speak in riddles, yet so much of this realm is shrouded in mystery, even to us.

There are others that have sought to unravel the history of this realm. Should you happen upon one of their works, I will offer you a trade of exceptional value.

passages.title: A Valuable Find: Necrotic Wake
passages.text: What have you found?

passages.title: A Valuable Find: Necrotic Wake
passages.text:
What sort of tome is this? May I leaf through it for a moment?

Well then, this is quite a find. It represents many years cataloguing everything Nalthor knew about the origins of our world. The many curiosities of this place, from Zovaal's domain in the Maw, to the function of this strange city of Oribos.

It is surmised that they all tie together.

I shall devour it with glee. Come, you may take one of our most prized possessions for it.

passages.title: A Valuable Find: Tirna Scithe
passages.text:
The gorm are indiscriminate in what they consume, so long as it does not contain anima. A gorm queen that has lived for many generations may have any number of indestructible artifacts lodged within her belly. For this reason, sifting through a queen's carcass is not unlike treasure hunting for us.

One of the largest queens is currently consuming Tirna Scithe. She surely is bloated with valuables. Should you come upon anything particularly unusual, know that we will compensate you in kind.

passages.title: A Valuable Find: Tirna Scithe
passages.text: You look as if you have been sifting through gorm carcass, or perhaps that is simply what you always look like?

passages.title: A Valuable Find: Tirna Scithe
passages.text:
We have found only a few objects similar to this in all of our time here, that I am aware of. Whether it belonged to a race of creature or automatons that came before us, or they still exist somewhere, we do not know.

The metallic fragments of this piece appear similar in design to the walls that surround us here in Oribos, yet we have never seen something like this moving around in the city.

I will add it to the cache of relics related to these mysteries. Take a suitable reward with you.

passages.title: A Valuable Find: De Other Side
passages.text:
Mueh'zala has been around for many generations, how many exactly we cannot say. His domain is a land of mystery to us all. 

But we are a people of probabilities and margins. A creature of that age, with such power, and the many ancient souls within his domain, has a great chance to be in possession of a relic of unfathomable rarity.

<The light around Ta'lan's head flares brightly for a moment. He seems... excited?>

Slay the foolish creature, bring me his secrets, I will reward you handsomely!

passages.title: A Valuable Find: De Other Side
passages.text: Have you brought something of interest?

passages.title: A Valuable Find: De Other Side
passages.text:
This mask is similar in features to some of the automaton parts we have found in our time here in the Shadowlands. Perhaps it belonged to an ancient civilization? The information we have is scattered and incomplete.

Any further pieces you may find of this sort will help us unravel these great mysteries. There seems to be a greater design to this place than we can see, yet so much of it eludes us.

I will take it off of your hands, in exchange you make take one of our most valuable pieces.

passages.title: A Valuable Find: Halls of Atonement
passages.text:
The aristocracy of Revendreth trade in decadent and priceless shows of status with one another, but rarely with our kind. Often they will travel with a piece or two affixed to their garb as a show of status.

Now, many of their kind have sided with Sire Denathrius and against the denizens of the Shadowlands. They must, of course, be stopped. 

Of course.

Yet should you, in the process of doing so, relieve them of some of these possessions, know that I will trade generously.

passages.title: A Valuable Find: Halls of Atonement
passages.text: How does the battle fare?

passages.title: A Valuable Find: Halls of Atonement
passages.text:
Now this is quite a find. A functional piece of the mysterious machinery that can be found around the Shadowlands.

Look at how intricate the weaving of the golden orb is, how the energy seems to be contained from somewhere within, yet in a construct that is almost beyond imagining. What could have made such an object? Where are they now?

We shall begin to investigate with fervor. Do drop in if you find anything similar, and take a reward before you go.

passages.title: A Valuable Find: Sanguine Depths
passages.text:
General Kaal has slain many foes, and in a bag at her side, she holds the skulls of those she considers her most precious kills. Not all of them, of course, have skulls -- it is a bag of eclectic contents.

Contained within, we have heard, is the head of one of our kind. We do not know to whom it might belong, for we do not often find ourselves running afoul of the venthyr.

Such a strange mystery must be solved. I will, of course, provide great compensation.

passages.title: A Valuable Find: Sanguine Depths
passages.text: What information do you bring?

passages.title: A Valuable Find: Sanguine Depths
passages.text:
This... is not what I expected.

It is similar in appearance to our people, yet so very different. Are there others of our kind out there? Who are they, and where do they reside? Why have they not made contact with us? Or are they hiding themselves purposefully?

Is this a history we knew but have forgotten? I have so many questions.

I thank you for this, it is quite meaningful to us. Please, take a relic of power from the treasury.

passages.title: Specter Of War: Visectus
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. Your contribution has been logged in our records for posterity to appreciate!

passages.title: Rule 1: Have an Escape Plan
passages.text:
Many doomed souls suffer within the Maw. You must be careful if you do not wish to join them.

Your Soulkeeper can hold a small number of souls until you return to your covenant. But that will be of little benefit if you do not survive this place yourself.

There is a substance, stygia, that is found on some creatures within the Maw. The stronger the soul, the more stygia they have.

Collect some of it for me and I can fashion it into many things you will find quite useful.

passages.title: Rule 1: Have an Escape Plan
passages.text: I will gladly assist you in the acquisition of survival tools... provided you bring me the stygia.

passages.title: Rule 1: Have an Escape Plan
passages.text:
You seem to have a knack for drawing the Jailer's attention.

This changes the terms of our arrangement.

passages.title: WANTED: Altered Sentinel
passages.text:
Praetor broken! At Aspirant's Crucible. Attacking everybody!

Something wrong. Maybe changed?

Simo not know how to fix. Tried everything!

Must destroy!

passages.title: WANTED: Altered Sentinel
passages.text: Oh! Broke praetor is gone? Sad. So sad. But thank you-hoo!

passages.title: Gildenite Grab
passages.text:
Took our gildenite! Stole it! Stole it and took it away!

<Sika's feathers ruffle.>

Need it, need it to make armor! Weapons!

Can't make armor without gildenite!

<Sika moves her arms as if explaining how armor is made.>

You understand? Yes? Why you still here?

passages.title: Gildenite Grab
passages.text:
Hshh... the golden ore, we need it.

Golden ore of Bastion. Make their armor with it. 

We need, many uses. Armors, weapons, trinkets and rings. Many uses.

Travel to Bastion. The eyes have shown me stores of it, stolen and hidden throughout their lands.

They do not use it. We will. Go now.

passages.title: Gildenite Grab
passages.text:
Our allies in Bastion are in possession of a special ore known as gildenite. A golden metal used for many things in their lands, it is also useful to us.

Once upon a time, we would have traded for it. Now, we have little to trade, and they have little to give.

Yet it is a necessary component to focus our magics, capable of harnessing magical energy and amplifying it.

Should you come across any in your travels, liberate it, and return it to me. I shall use what we need, and share the remainder.

passages.title: Gildenite Grab
passages.text:
The golden ore known as gildenite is found only in Bastion. Used to make many of their own armors, it is useful to us all. We harden our own armors and weapons with it, and it holds magical charge well.

Our stores are nearly depleted, and we have little to trade, but our needs are great.

Let us reflect. 

In Bastion, there are those that have turned their backs on their own people.

We may relieve these deceivers of their gildenite without remorse.

passages.title: WANTED: Darkwing
passages.text:
The Cloudfeather matriarch, Darkwing, has fallen to a great and terrible sickness. She has grown aggressive, dominating her children and driving them to violence.

Darkwing must be slain if her flock is to ever return to the Archon's grace.

Please use the attached whistle to call her to her nest. I shall consider one of her crown feathers sufficient proof of the deed.

--Eumelia, Stable Master

passages.title: WANTED: Darkwing
passages.text: Until Darkwing rests at last I fear her brood will know no peace.

passages.title: WANTED: Darkwing
passages.text: You have my gratitude for restoring balance to these fascinating creatures. We all have our part to play.

passages.title: A Wealth of Wealdwood
passages.text:
The shapers of our lands cultivate a very special form of wood we call wealdwood.

It contains the essence of Ardenweald, of the plants and animals that make up our soil and our air. It can be enchanted with powerful magics, and it will not burn.

It is the basis of our arms and armor, and in these dark days, it is a target of our enemies.

They steal and hoard it, out there in the wilds. 

Find them, and return our treasures to us.

passages.title: A Wealth of Wealdwood
passages.text:
In Ardenweald, the shapers form boughs into a magical form of wood. Wealdwood, an enchanted substance used for many sorcerous purposes, is a key component in our rituals.

Without it, our magics pale in comparison to those of our enemies.

Yet in these times, Ardenweald is beset by many foes. They steal the supplies of the Night Fae and scurry off into the dark places.

Travel to those places, and return to us once you have brought atonement to these vile creatures.

passages.title: A Wealth of Wealdwood
passages.text:
The eyes have shown me supplies, in Ardenweald. Hidden in the boughs, hidden from us, but they cannot hide from the eyes.

They do not use it, not as we would. We must use it. It is ours to take.

Kshhhh... bring it to us, the shaped wood. Many uses, very magical. Holds magic as a pitcher holds slime, fills with it.

Need it for our sorcerers. Cannot win in battle without our magic. Must win, no other way.

passages.title: A Wealth of Wealdwood
passages.text:
Ardenweald in trouble! We in trouble too! No Ardenweald, no wealdwood.

wealdwood magical, help us make many thing.

You find some? Bring to Sika? Yes? Hoo?

Yes. 

<Sika writes your name on a scroll and underlines it twice, then shows it to you.>

See?

passages.title: A Source of Sorrowvine
passages.text:
There is a dark, evil vine that grows in Revendreth, known as sorrowvine.

They say it feeds off of the anguish of the souls as they are broken.

Regardless of its origins, it is used in many of our potions and spells. It contains a powerful magic, likely a product of its origin.

Revendreth has little opportunity to trade with us these days. Should you find any of these vines, I will gladly accept them.

passages.title: Bonemetal Bonanza
passages.text:
The denizens of Maldraxxus are used to a life of battle, and in doing so, find themselves in possession of so very many bones.

They form their armors out of a cultivated form of bone we call bonemetal. Harder than most metals, yet pliable, it can be forged into a variety of shapes without losing its strength.

We have many uses for it, both as a means of attachment, and when ground up, as a reagent.

We cannot ask them for resources now, but if you find any, I would use it.

passages.title: Bonemetal Bonanza
passages.text:
Maldraxxus no longer answers our calls, and the houses are in disarray.

Yet we have need of them. Once, they supplied us with bonemetal, a strong yet malleable material useful for many armors.

There are those in Maldraxxus that hoard the material, seeking to profit from the chaos.

They must atone for these sins.

passages.title: Bonemetal Bonanza
passages.text:
Ksh-ksh-ksh... you are needed.

So many betrayers in our lands, many deaths, much armor destroyed. 

Need to rebuild.

The eyes have shown me stores of bonemetal, hoarded by our foes.

Bring them to me.

passages.title: Bonemetal Bonanza
passages.text:
<Sika is studying a scroll.>

No bonemetal! Again, out of bonemetal!

<Sika throws a pile of scrolls into the air.>

Hoo! Where you come from?

Oh, OH. bonemetal! You get? Get from Maldraxxus. Help us out!

<Sika points in the direction of Maldraxxus.>

That way!

passages.title: A Source of Sorrowvine
passages.text:
Sorrowvine grows only here, in the lowlands of Revendreth. It has power contained within the leaves and seeds, perhaps a byproduct of the cleansing of sins.

We use it for many things, from potions to venoms. It is a versatile reagent.

Our stores are low, and we have little ability to forage these days with the forces of our enemies bearing down on us.

As you travel our lands, should you come upon any, we would make good use of it.

passages.title: A Source of Sorrowvine
passages.text:
Kshh... need you today. Stores of sorrowvine getting low, need it for our venoms.

Revendreth does not answer our calls. The eyes show me conflict and strife in their lands.

This matters little to us.

Shh... travel there, find their vines, return to me.

passages.title: A Source of Sorrowvine
passages.text:
Need sorrowvine! Please help!

Revendreth not sending us supplies, not answering Sika! Can't make potions now. What we do?

<Sika seems to have just remembered that you were there.>

You go! 

<Sika pushes you.> 

Go go!

passages.title: Training in Revendreth
passages.text:
The dark lands of Revendreth, ruled over by the traitor Denathrius, pose a great risk to us, and a great opportunity for training.

Come here, trainee! Today, you hunt with the Maw Walker. Should you return to me, we will celebrate, with a hunt.

For tomorrow, we hunt.

passages.title: Training in Revendreth
passages.text: I smell a group of successful hunters, good. Each successful hunt brings us one step closer to a trained hunting pack.

passages.title: Training in Maldraxxus
passages.text:
The forces of Maldraxxus are some of the most highly trained and well-regimented in all of the Shadowlands. Once, they defended us all, now we must fend for ourselves.

There is little better place for our trainees to gain real combat and strategy experience than on their blood-soaked battlefields.

Take this one with you on your travels today, so that they may see what real combat looks like.

passages.title: Training in Maldraxxus
passages.text: Do you return with a trainee, or a coward?

passages.title: Training in Maldraxxus
passages.text: There is little better than real combat experience to train our next generation of hunters. Thank you for keeping this one alive.

passages.title: Training in Maldraxxus
passages.text:
Our aspiring warriors must be trained in the thick of battle, in the harshest conditions, for wars do not happen lightly, and never will it give them pause for breath.

Take this one to Maldraxxus--the heart of the armies of the Shadowlands resides there. It is a land in chaos and turmoil, filled with fallen champions and gladiators.

There, they will face true challenges, and return with great knowledge.

passages.title: Training in Maldraxxus
passages.text: Has your trainee survived the fields of battle?

passages.title: Training in Maldraxxus
passages.text: Ah, good, you returned with your trainee intact. Truthfully, each time we send them on such an errand, it is a game of chance. It is good you were with them.

passages.title: Training Our Forces
passages.text:
Our armies are nothing without some combat training, but every time we send them out, they come back as a pile of bones and meat.

Take a trainee out and pit them against the forces of the other houses. Just don't get them killed, alright? Not all the way killed. A little killed is fine.

passages.title: Training Our Forces
passages.text: Any luck out there?

passages.title: Training Our Forces
passages.text: By my bones, you came back and your trainee isn't a pile of mush. Can't believe my eye sockets.

passages.title: Training in Maldraxxus
passages.text:
Another trainee needs some looking after, if you don't mind.

Maldraxxus is a place of constant battle, and probably the best place to take them. They've got to learn about war and strategy and, you know, all that.

Just throw them in the arena or something. 'Sink or swim' is an effective training strategy.

passages.title: Training in Maldraxxus
passages.text: Could really go for a nap I could.

passages.title: Training in Maldraxxus
passages.text: Your trainee's looking a little roughed up, but none the worse for wear. Probably learned a thing or two.

passages.title: Training Our Forces
passages.text:
I have yet more troops for you to train, and there are plenty of things to do right here in our domain. 

Take them out and give them a good, solid, and probably bloody taste of what we're up against.

Now, if you get them killed? That's none of my business.

<Sakaa sips a thick and sweet-smelling beverage.>

passages.title: Training Our Forces
passages.text: Did you manage to bring them back alive?

passages.title: Training Our Forces
passages.text: Well, it looks like you drilled some good experience into this one today. Only a few broken bones!

passages.title: Training in Revendreth
passages.text:
Lousy, useless, bunch of bones. This army's less of an army than it is a bunch of dead meat walking.

Do me a favor, take out this trainee and head over to Revendreth. Give them some good battle training against some of our enemies, a little taste of strategy and tactics and maybe getting hit in the face with a little magic.

Won't do us any good unless we find a way to train them that doesn't end up in a bunch of dead minions.

passages.title: Training in Revendreth
passages.text: Well? You bring back a pile of bones or a trainee?

passages.title: Training in Revendreth
passages.text: Looks like this one's got a bit more in the head now, maybe they'll survive beyond a battle now.

passages.title: Training in Revendreth
passages.text:
A trainee is in need of your guiding hand.

Take them to Revendreth, where you will find the armies of Denathrius thirsting for our demise. Wade in to battle with them against our mighty foes.

Return victorious, as their shield and mentor, so that our armies will be bolstered this day.

passages.title: Training in Revendreth
passages.text: Another glorious day of training in the name of the Archon! We will let this one rest now, to train another day.

passages.title: Rare Resources
passages.text:
The Brokers are odd characters, but useful. They can find many things across the vast realms of the Shadowlands that we cannot. 

We have relied upon them to bring us useful materials for many years, but these days, we have little to trade.

They value a currency of their own making, coins of brokerage, as a general means of trade.

If you find any in your travels, I would appreciate a handful, as it would allow me to procure some rare and necessary items.

passages.title: Rare Resources
passages.text: Have you found any coins?

passages.title: Rare Resources
passages.text: Oh, this is quite a find. These will allow me to procure some rather rare ingredients and materials, and with them, we may turn the tide against our foes. Well done.

passages.title: Rare Resources
passages.text:
Hello! Yes! Hello.

Brokers, you know them? 

<Sika does her best attempt at looking like a broker. It is not convincing.>

Trade many things with us. Things we no get. Things we want.

Need coins. Clink clink!

<Sika makes a circle with her finger feathers.>

Find them everywhere, bring them to Sika!

passages.title: Rare Resources
passages.text: Bring coins to Sika? Need trade with brokers. You know this?

passages.title: Rare Resources
passages.text:
Coins! Coins for Sika! Happy Sika, happy friends. Can buy many things, strange things, you no understand, is ok.

<Sika takes the coins and waves at you.>

passages.title: Rare Resources
passages.text:
Kh-kh-kh... the brokers, they go to many places. Many places we cannot. The eyes cannot follow them.

Find many secrets, they do. Bring us supplies, strange and rare.

Need things to trade. Need broker coins.

They trade with all. Find coins in all lands. Slay those that hold them, bring the coins to me. 

You may eat their corpses, I will not judge. Just need coins.

passages.title: Rare Resources
passages.text: Bring me coins? Coins for brokers. Many uses. You see?

passages.title: Rare Resources
passages.text: The clink of the coins is the sound of secrets being revealed. Many uses, many things I will purchase. More powerful will we become, due to this. A good find.

passages.title: Rare Resources
passages.text:
The brokers are an enigmatic group. We know little about them, save that they can travel to many lands in the Shadowlands that we cannot. How they do this, we are not sure.

They are willing partners in trade, though, and through them we have acquired many rare and valuable resources that cannot be found elsewhere.

They hold in high regard a currency of their own creation, you may find such coins in your travels. 

I will gladly take them off of your hands to bolster our supplies.

passages.title: Rare Resources
passages.text: Have you found any of the broker's coins?

passages.title: Rare Resources
passages.text:
This small handful of coins will purchase many things of use to us. I will contact them directly.

Thank you, Maw Walker.

passages.title: A Call to Bastion
passages.text:
Our allies in Bastion are absolutely necessary for the Shadowlands to function at all. They alone can bring us the souls we need to keep the cycle moving. 

If they fall to darkness, it's only a matter of time before we, too, dwindle and fade.

They are beset by all manner of problems. We have to get over there and help them!

passages.title: A Call to Bastion
passages.text: How are the Kyrians?

passages.title: A Call to Bastion
passages.text: I've gotten word from our Kyrian allies that you did them a great service! Thank you!

passages.title: Troubles at Home
passages.text:
They say that all of the Shadowlands is a stage, and right now, I think we're in a tragedy! 

All throughout Ardenweald, we are under attack. They seek our anima and the souls that we protect.

If the cycle stops here, so many great souls will be lost... forever.

There's no time to waste, we need your help! Defend Ardenweald!

passages.title: Troubles at Home
passages.text: Are things improving in the glades?

passages.title: Troubles at Home
passages.text:
I've heard many tales of your greatness, the Winter Queen is quite pleased! 

Please take this, and keep up the fight!

passages.title: A Call to Maldraxxus
passages.text:
I'm glad you're here! We've got some problems in Maldraxxus.

The forces of Maldraxxus are the defenders of the Shadowlands. They've always managed to balance one another out, like actors on a stage, never stealing too much of the spotlight. 

But now, some of the houses have overthrown the balance, and seek to conquer the rest of us!

Our allies there need our help! Aid them however you can.

passages.title: A Call to Maldraxxus
passages.text: Are things improving in Maldraxxus?

passages.title: A Call to Maldraxxus
passages.text:
The houses of Maldraxxus are once again in balance, and not a threat to us... for now at least. 

You did great!

passages.title: A Call to Revendreth
passages.text:
Oh, I'm glad you're here, we've got a problem!

Our friends in Revendreth are struggling under the rule of Sire Denathrius. He was always a cruel leader, and now he's thrown in his lot with the Jailer! 

If Denathrius's control of Revendreth isn't broken, he'll come for us next...

Let's do whatever we can to help them out!

passages.title: A Call to Revendreth
passages.text: How are things in Revendreth?

passages.title: A Call to Revendreth
passages.text: Ha, take that Denathrius. He won't be allowed to rule the Shadowlands if you have anything to say about it!

passages.title: A Call to Ardenweald
passages.text:
We cannot stand alone. If one section of the Shadowlands falls, we will all be in danger.

The great soul-trees of Ardenweald are under assault from many foes that seek to harness their power.

We must aid our allies in the Night Fae, and punish their enemies for these transgressions.

We are stronger together.

passages.title: A Call to Ardenweald
passages.text: Have you completed your task?

passages.title: A Call to Ardenweald
passages.text: You have secured our alliance with the Night Fae, and in doing so, we hold a stronger position across the Shadowlands.

passages.title: A Call to Ardenweald
passages.text:
Ardenweald was once a place of peace and regrowth, now beset by dark forces from all sides. 

Maldraxxus alone is responsible for challenging those that would disrupt the cycle.

Take our banners, steady your weapons, and bring war to Ardenweald.

For the Shadowlands.

passages.title: A Call to Ardenweald
passages.text: How do the boughs break?

passages.title: A Call to Ardenweald
passages.text:
The cycle will continue, as we have willed it to be so. 

With every foe you slay, the name of Maldraxxus is spoken with glory and purpose.

passages.title: A Call to Ardenweald
passages.text:
Ardenweald is one of our closest allies, and to them we ferry some of the most powerful souls.

Should the weald fall, the devastation that would be unleashed could destroy us all.

We must aid the Winter Queen. It is the will of the Archon.

Go now, and provide support to the Night Fae.

passages.title: A Call to Ardenweald
passages.text: Have things improved in Ardenweald?

passages.title: A Call to Ardenweald
passages.text:
Our allies in Ardenweald have sent word of your many deeds. You have shown once more that the Kyrian will fight for the Shadowlands and our allies, no matter the cost. 

Courage and wisdom to you.

passages.title: Troubles at Home
passages.text:
Sometimes we must look inward to find true darkness. Here, in Bastion, where once there was harmony, now we face many foes.

Today, we root them out.

Head into the golden fields, with your weapon in hand. Cleanse us of these foul creatures, aid our forces when they have need of you.

In the name of the Archon.

passages.title: Troubles at Home
passages.text: Are the fields cleansed?

passages.title: Troubles at Home
passages.text:
The bells chime in the distance, heralding your return. A glorious sound.

You have performed a great service today, and truly secured your place among us.

Hail, victor!

passages.title: A Call to Bastion
passages.text:
We, the defenders of the Shadowlands, will never let a great foe go unchallenged.

The Kyrians of Bastion have long served all denizens of the Shadowlands by ferrying souls. We would be lost without their services.

Now, they too are under attack from within. We must defend them in their time of need.

Go now, and bring glory in the name of the Primus.

passages.title: A Call to Bastion
passages.text: Are the golden fields bathed in blood?

passages.title: A Call to Bastion
passages.text:
We will always rise to the defense of the Shadowlands, even if we are weakened from within. 

You have shown that no foe is too far to escape the reach of Maldraxxus.

passages.title: A Call to Bastion
passages.text:
The denizens of Bastion are a key component to the cycle of power here in the Shadowlands. Without them, we cannot replenish our ranks, and the forces of the Jailer will grow ever stronger.

They have their own troubles in these times, as well. Today, we must look without, and aid our allies.

Travel to the golden fields, and rid them of their foes. 

Only with allies do we stand a chance against Denathrius.

passages.title: A Call to Bastion
passages.text: Have you completed your task?

passages.title: A Call to Bastion
passages.text: The Archon has sent word of your deeds, and agreed to support us in the battles to come. We will fix this broken cycle, with steps such as this leading the way.

passages.title: Troubles at Home
passages.text:
Look! Look around you! All around us, foes await the crushing hand of victory.

There is an upset in the balance of power, and with it, the defenders of the Shadowlands are weakened.

The only cure is more combat!

Challenge the houses that sought to disrupt Maldraxxus, bring them to heel under the weight of your boots.

passages.title: Troubles at Home
passages.text: Have you littered the ground with the bones of your enemies?

passages.title: Troubles at Home
passages.text: The stories of your power reverberate across the landscape. The bones of the fallen tremble at your name. Let us revel in your victory today!

passages.title: A Call to Maldraxxus
passages.text:
The forces of Maldraxxus have long defended the Shadowlands from threats outside of our lands.

Now, they face their greatest threats from within. The balance of power between the houses is broken. It has led them to assault us, and others.

Their problems are many, our solutions are just. 

Travel to Maldraxxus and slay those that would do the Shadowlands harm, providing shelter to your allies when you find them.

passages.title: A Call to Maldraxxus
passages.text: With the houses of betrayal brought to their knees, you have brought us one step closer to peace. The Archon thanks you for your service to the Shadowlands.

passages.title: A Call to Maldraxxus
passages.text:
The forces of Maldraxxus were once intended to defend the Shadowlands against threats from beyond. They are all but broken, now.

The houses are in disarray, infighting with one another. We have few allies there, and those that have sided with us are bruised and beaten.

Go now, aid them, and slay their foes. Bring balance back to Maldraxxus, and in turn, will they aid us.

passages.title: A Call to Maldraxxus
passages.text: The warriors of Maldraxxus speak your name, a great victory to have achieved this day. The balance of power will be restored one day, and our alliances will pay dividends.

passages.title: Troubles at Home
passages.text:
There are many tasks that need your attention outside of the walls of Sinfall.

Our closest allies are under assault from all sides, and the forces of Denathrius are unrelenting.

Take your weapon and steel yourself. Today, we defend Revendreth, and in doing so, further bulwark ourselves against our enemies.

We will take back what is ours.

passages.title: Troubles at Home
passages.text: Have you reclaimed our homeland?

passages.title: Troubles at Home
passages.text: We are more secure in our position due to your actions today. Revendreth will not fall to the sway of Denathrius, not as long as we hold firm.

passages.title: A Call to Revendreth
passages.text:
We fight not only for might and glory, but for the greater good of the Shadowlands. It is our calling to bring war upon those that would disrupt the flow of souls.

There is one such betrayer - Sire Denathrius.

Bring the vengeance of Maldraxxus down upon his foul crown. 

Slay his allies, serve his foes, end his reign in carnage.

passages.title: A Call to Revendreth
passages.text: How fares the battle for Revendreth?

passages.title: A Call to Revendreth
passages.text:
Denathrius did not expect us to rally so quickly, to serve our great purpose in the cycle. 

He underestimated our house for the last time, and has paid the price in blood.

passages.title: A Call to Revendreth
passages.text:
We all serve the greater purpose here, even those in Revendreth that we may not agree with. We take souls to them in need of a harsher form of cleansing, and it is just.

Yet Sire Denathrius has gone too far, and now seeks to control all of the Shadowlands.

We have friends there, amongst the Venthyr. Aid them, and put their enemies to rest.

The Word of the Archon is with you.

passages.title: A Call to Revendreth
passages.text: Have you returned victorious?

passages.title: A Call to Revendreth
passages.text:
The crimes of Sire Denathrius could not go unpunished, and you have meted out a proper response today. 

<Polemarch Adrestes bows his head in your direction.>

passages.title: Challenges in Revendreth
passages.text:
We never truly counted the forces of Denathrius as our allies, and now he has shown his true colors.

Over many years, he has built an army. One capable of destroying any other land, provided we were divided, and not united. He has empowered monstrous creations and broken them to his will.

What better way to secure our allies and test our strength, than to eliminate his most fervent champions.

Go now, and hunt.

passages.title: Challenges in Revendreth
passages.text: Have you thinned Denathrius's forces?

passages.title: Challenges in Revendreth
passages.text:
The generals that serve our enemies in Revendreth will think twice before attempting to control the Shadowlands. 

We have aided unlikely allies, and forged true bonds with Revendreth today, and it is thanks to you.

passages.title: Challenges in Maldraxxus
passages.text:
Maldraxxus is a land of conflict and strife. There is little better place than to test yourself against the might of the Shadowlands.

There, you will find warriors that are bred on combat, honed by the sword and hammer, tested in arenas and battlegrounds.

Crash into them like the felling of a great branch, let them see the might of Ardenweald is no less terrifying.

passages.title: Challenges in Maldraxxus
passages.text: Have you returned victorious?

passages.title: Challenges in Maldraxxus
passages.text:
In a land of champions and war, you have proven your worth. Few can claim to have taken on the greatest defenders of the Shadowlands and survived, yet here you stand, a monument to the strength of the Night Fae. 

May it never wane.

passages.title: Challenges in Bastion
passages.text:
Bastion has long been one of our closest allies, and a key to the inner workings of the Shadowlands. We cannot abide dysfunctions in the passage of souls.

They are beset by a host of issues brought on by dissension in their ranks. Every day, doubt gnaws at their forces, bleeding away their hope, and plunging us further into chaos.

Doubt is a powerful foe, and not easily dispatched. Keep your wits about you and crush these dark thoughts.

passages.title: Challenges in Bastion
passages.text: Have you aided the denizens of Bastion?

passages.title: Challenges in Bastion
passages.text: You have shown courage in the face of great doubt. There are many kinds of strength, and you have shown that you possess one that goes beyond the blade and bow.

passages.title: Challenges in Ardenweald
passages.text:
The Wild Hunt count as our prey the most dangerous creatures in the weald. Here, you may test yourself against challenges the likes of which you may not have faced in your previous life.

In our current state, my gravest concern is with Tirna Scithe. Once full of life, it is now overtaken by multitudes of foul creatures. They siphon its power, and though we may never regain the glade, we must not allow this to continue.

Take on this trial, and put an end to the invaders of Tirna Scithe.

passages.title: Challenges in Ardenweald
passages.text: How goes the hunt?

passages.title: Challenges in Ardenweald
passages.text: A quiet has overtaken the glade, the leaves no longer rustle in anguish. This is your doing, and we will not forget this kindness.

passages.title: Challenges in Ardenweald
passages.text:
Our close companions in Ardenweald face challenges unlike any that have previously plagued their peaceful glades.

Ready your weapons, for now is the time that the golden shields of Bastion shine. Now is the time to take flight into the weald and show courage in the face of darkness.

It is not always about us, you see. True courage means fighting for others when necessary, even against overwhelming odds and the most vile of evils.

Light shines only in darkness.

passages.title: Challenges in Ardenweald
passages.text: Have you cleansed the weald?

passages.title: Challenges in Ardenweald
passages.text: I have received word of your great deeds in Ardenweald. They are thankful for your service, and you have proven your courage tenfold today.

passages.title: Challenges in Ardenweald
passages.text:
Looking to prove yourself? I hear there are powerful creatures invading Ardenweald. Sounds like a challenge, no?

So ready your weapon and get out there! What better place to prove your might?

Smash them to pieces, in the name of Maldraxxus!

passages.title: Challenges in Ardenweald
passages.text: Rip and tear!

passages.title: Challenges in Ardenweald
passages.text:
It is a shame your job was completed so quickly. So many foes, so little time!

You are a good addition to our forces, I really enjoy all of this slaying.

passages.title: Challenges in Ardenweald
passages.text:
Ardenweald was once a place of peace and regrowth, but no longer.

Foes assault the weald from all sides, dark creatures that serve no masters.

They will not be exempted from the hand of justice. We will bring the trials of Revendreth to bear upon them.

They will see what we do to those that must be broken.

I accuse these souls of sins against the Shadowlands. Mete out justice in the name of Revendreth.

passages.title: Challenges in Ardenweald
passages.text: Has justice been served?

passages.title: Challenges in Ardenweald
passages.text:
Those that have no masters have learned a lesson today.

We are their masters, in the end.

passages.title: Challenges in Bastion
passages.text:
Sometimes we need look no further than our own golden hills to find a suitable challenge.

Doubt has crept into the minds of some of the most stoic shieldbearers of the Kyrian people. It has poisoned them against us, and in doing so, harmed the ability of the Shadowlands to heal from this blight.

We must stand against them, now. 

It will not be easy, but things that are worth fighting for rarely are.

passages.title: Challenges in Bastion
passages.text: Have you seen the face of doubt and shown it certainty?

passages.title: Challenges in Bastion
passages.text: You have uprooted the seeds of doubt and crushed them with certainty. May their doubts now be about only their own dark paths.

passages.title: Challenges in Bastion
passages.text:
We consider the denizens of Bastion to be allies of a sort. Without their service, we would have no souls, and without souls, we could not raise armies, and without armies, we could not smash our fists against one another in the glorious theatre of battle!

<Grandmaster Volo laughs and smashes his weapon around.>

We must aid them against their foes, or else the arena will sit barren, and we can't have that!

Find their greatest enemies and turn their bones into golden dust.

passages.title: Challenges in Bastion
passages.text: Have you clipped their wings?

passages.title: Challenges in Bastion
passages.text: You return victorious, atop a mountain of bloody feathers! Ha ha! Glorious!

passages.title: Challenges in Bastion
passages.text:
Our allies in Bastion have long served the cycle of the Shadowlands, delivering souls in need of our services.

Yet, within their ranks, doubt has grown and festered. If this continues, we will all pay.

Their loss of focus shall not be allowed to continue. We will punish their wandering hearts.

I accuse these souls of sins against the Shadowlands. Mete out justice in the name of Revendreth.

passages.title: Challenges in Bastion
passages.text: Has justice been served?

passages.title: Challenges in Bastion
passages.text: The sins of the doubtful have been purged.

passages.title: Challenges in Maldraxxus
passages.text:
The purpose of Maldraxxus is to raise the most competent and confident warriors that the Shadowlands has ever seen, to create the perfect army in order to defend us against threats from the outer worlds.

Here, you will find some of your greatest challenges.

Seek out the champions of the strongest houses, stand against them, and let them see your might.

passages.title: Challenges in Maldraxxus
passages.text: Do you stand victorious?

passages.title: Challenges in Maldraxxus
passages.text: You stand alone atop a pile of bones, as a true master of combat. You have shown yourself a real Necrolord today!

passages.title: Challenges in Maldraxxus
passages.text:
Those of Maldraxxus are the chosen warriors of the Shadowlands, charged with defending us against threats from other worlds.

For many years, a careful balance has been maintained between the houses. Now, there are those that have broken this balance, and we are all left weakened and defenseless.

They must pay for these transgressions.

I accuse these souls of sins against the Shadowlands. Mete out justice in the name of Revendreth.

passages.title: Challenges in Maldraxxus
passages.text: Has justice been served?

passages.title: Challenges in Maldraxxus
passages.text: Let this be a lesson to them, Revendreth will not stand by and let the balance be disturbed.

passages.title: Challenges in Maldraxxus
passages.text:
In Maldraxxus, the House of the Chosen have taken control of large swaths of land, upsetting the balance of power amongst the houses. To them flock the most seasoned gladiators and warriors.

What better place to test yourself?

Head into the land of bones and blood, and stand against their most powerful minions. Prove true what you know to be inside of yourself.

passages.title: Challenges in Maldraxxus
passages.text: Have you found the truth in courage?

passages.title: Challenges in Maldraxxus
passages.text: The mightiest gladiators have fallen to your hand, and in doing so, you have shown that we, too, will defend the Shadowlands if necessary. Let this be a lesson to them.

passages.title: Challenges in Revendreth
passages.text:
Those that have taken up arms against us in the name of Sire Denathrius and the Jailer have turned their backs on us all.

Some are mere pawns in this game, others command them. Those that lead the charge of this crisis bear the greatest responsibility. 

They are the mightiest of Denathrius's allies, and they must be brought to justice.

I accuse these souls of sins against the Shadowlands. Mete out justice in the name of Revendreth.

passages.title: Challenges in Revendreth
passages.text: Has justice been served?

passages.title: Challenges in Revendreth
passages.text: Justice has been served.

passages.title: Challenges in Revendreth
passages.text:
I've never really trusted the Venthyr of Revendreth. Maybe it's those long coats they wear, or maybe it's those pointy teeth, but something about them creeps me out.

Their leader, Denathrius, has sided with the Jailer against the rest of us, so I guess I was right.

I want you to find his most powerful allies in Revendreth and smash them to a bloody pulp. Send him a message from Maldraxxus.

passages.title: Challenges in Revendreth
passages.text: You didn't let them bite you, right?

passages.title: Challenges in Revendreth
passages.text:
I have heard of your bloody exploits in Revendreth, and I am pleased. 

Did you bring me back any of their teeth? No? Well, maybe next time.

passages.title: Challenges in Revendreth
passages.text:
Challenging oneself is a necessary part of ascension, for what is courage in the face of normalcy? 

In this current state of unrest, opportunities abound to prove ourselves. Consider it the gilded lining to a tarnished shield.

None more so than in Revendreth, where Sire Denathrius has consolidated power and influence, and seeks to overthrow the natural order of the Shadowlands.

And here is where you must challenge yourself today.

passages.title: Challenges in Revendreth
passages.text: Have you proven your worth in Revendreth?

passages.title: Challenges in Revendreth
passages.text: Even so far from our fields, you stood strong against the evils you found, unflinching. This is true courage.

passages.title: Anima Salvage
passages.text:
So many souls that should have been nurtured here have been lost to the Maw, it pains me to think of it.

Maw Walker, we ask you now to do that which we cannot. Traverse the Jailer's domain, walk his barren fields, climb his accursed tower.

Bring us that which we lack.

passages.title: Anima Salvage
passages.text: Have you recovered the Anima Embers?

passages.title: Anima Salvage
passages.text: You have done us a great service today, Maw Walker. We shall use these to nourish what we can.

passages.title: Anima Salvage
passages.text:
The Arbiter has done us a great disservice. Our armies dwindle in number as souls are cast into the Maw instead of taking their place on the battlefields of Maldraxxus.

The Undying Army must not be snuffed out. If the Shadowlands are to survive, we must be able to supply our troops.

Travel now into the Maw, Maw Walker, and enter Torghast. Return with Anima Embers to help kindle our supplies.

passages.title: Anima Salvage
passages.text: Have you brought Anima Embers for our stockpiles?

passages.title: Anima Salvage
passages.text: The armies of the undying will not fall today, Maw Walker. You emerge victorious once more in the face of great power, impressive.

passages.title: Anima Salvage
passages.text:
Revendreth is not a place that many souls choose to go, but it is a place that they must go. Here, their sins are laid bare before them, and they are broken and re-formed to function in our society.

This is a necessary part of the cycle.

Yet now, the cycle is broken, and are unable to serve our great purpose.

In order for us to do our work we require Anima. Travel to Torghast, Maw Walker, gather that which we can not. Without it, we wither and fade.

passages.title: Anima Salvage
passages.text: Have you brought the Anima Embers to us?

passages.title: Anima Salvage
passages.text: These Anima Embers will serve us well, Maw Walker.

passages.title: Anima Appeal
passages.text:
Maw Walker!

The Anima Reservoir is nearly depleted. Without more anima, the groves shall soon wither and die.

Search the realms for additional nourishment and deliver it to the sanctum.

Ardenweald cannot continue without your aid!

passages.title: Anima Appeal
passages.text:
Maw Walker!

Our anima stores have run low, and soon we will have nothing to sate our thirst...

Seek out additional sources of anima amongst the realms of the Shadowlands and deliver it to the sanctum.

These are dire circumstances. Our fate is in your hands.

passages.title: Anima Appeal
passages.text:
Maw Walker!

Our anima reserves are nearly depleted. Without an additional supply of anima, our mission of conquest will be lost!

Scour the realms for all the anima you can gather and deliver it here to the sanctum.

Victory depends on your success!

passages.title: Anima Appeal
passages.text:
Maw Walker!

Our supply of anima is dwindling and the reservoir is nearly depleted. We must replenish our reserves before it is too late!

Search the realms for all the anima you can gather and deliver it to the sanctum.

Time is short. Move swiftly, <class>.

passages.title: The Old Ways
passages.text:
You there! Might I ask your help?

I must confess, with the lack of new souls arriving, our supplies have dwindled. We lack the means to clothe arrivals in proper kyrian attire.

Before the forging of the centurions, aspirants trained against the native wildlife. Perhaps there is another way these beasts can prove useful.

If you collect materials from the cloudstriders and larions nearby, we can use them to ensure our new arrivals look the part.

Oh, and some thread from Mirene, if you would!

passages.title: The Old Ways
passages.text: How goes the hunt?

passages.title: The Old Ways
passages.text: These are perfect! Go in service, always.

passages.title: Spawn Tracking Unit-Specified World Effect in a WMO Bug
See With My Eyes
passages.text:
After the destruction of our house, the spiders in this area become increasingly hostile. They expand their domain, and prey upon the few survivors that live here. 

There are weapons we could use to help protect ourselves, but they lie hidden within the Sightless Hold, webbed over by the weavers that inhabit it now.

Journey to the hold, use my sightless vision to see the weapons and recover what you can.

passages.title: See With My Eyes
passages.text: Have you recovered the weapons.

passages.title: See With My Eyes
passages.text: You can kill more of them if you want.

passages.title: Humble Gatherer
passages.text:
Before your soulbinds step foot in the coliseum, you must challenge your first opponent.

There is a tradition to this, as with all things. You will need to gather specific items, then bring them back here to fashion armaments to help execute your challenge.

In the case of your first challenge, you will find the materials throughout Bastion. Return to me once you have collected everything, then we will continue.

passages.title: Humble Gatherer
passages.text: Though the Path of Ascension leads to glory, participants must remember to stay humble and grounded in the tradition.

passages.title: Humble Gatherer
passages.text: You have taken the first steps. A commendable feat!

passages.title: A Suitable Opponent
passages.text:
The opponents you train against in the coliseum are not physical beings, but rather manifestations of such.

Your first opponent is one you and your soulbinds have met numerous times before -- the Ascended Kalisthene.

Asking another kyrian to be your opponent in the Path is a great honor, as it tells them that you have much to learn from them.

Go to Aspirant's Awakening and use the cores to summon Kalisthene by calling back to your first introduction. It is as ceremony states.

passages.title: A Suitable Opponent
passages.text: Kalisthene will train your friends well.

passages.title: Halls of Atonement: Medallion of Pride
passages.text:
Our attempts at a parley were met with skepticism, at best. Acquiring the medallions may take more work than originally intended. However, not all hope is lost. 

I do believe that we can win over many of the Harvesters, and for those we cannot, a more direct approach will need to be taken. 

Lord Chamberlain falls into this latter category. His medallion must be taken by force.

passages.title: Halls of Atonement: Medallion of Pride
passages.text: Have you recovered the medallion?

passages.title: Halls of Atonement: Medallion of Pride
passages.text: With this, we are one step closer to realizing the revitalization of Revendreth.

passages.title: Strengthen the Bond
passages.text:
To bond souls is but the first step. You must now explore its potential.

Just as Pelagos will gain strength from you, so too shall you grow from him. As your bond grows over time you will touch deeper into one another's souls, and so your strength shall increase. 

All you must do is place your hand upon the Forge of Bonds to augment your bond. There is no price to pay--the only limitation is your connection to our sacred covenant.

passages.title: Strengthen the Bond
passages.text: This device is merely a pathway to the strength that lies within you both.

passages.title: Strengthen the Bond
passages.text: May you prove worthy allies to one another in the trials to come.

passages.title: Spider's Lair
passages.text:
When our house fell in ruins, Manipulator Zalisar seized the opportunity to reform the house under his leadership. He found few followers and soon vanished into the ruins nearby. 

He has begun to manipulate the spiders and train them to be his soldiers. Spiders under his control have begun to prey upon our forces. We need to deal with this threat before it grows any worse.

I need you eliminate Manipulator Zalisar and his spider forces.

passages.title: Spider's Lair
passages.text: Your help is always welcome, Maw Walker.

passages.title: Hunting Trophies
passages.text:
To be a hopebreaker is to conquer all prey, not just souls.

The Banewood is home to many dangerous creatures: deathwalkers, fearspinners, and the horrifying doomfangs. If you wish to really master the art of the hunt, you should be able to defeat these foes.

Bring me trophies as proof of your conquests. Then, you may just earn my respect.

passages.title: Hunting Trophies
passages.text: Have you conquered the creatures of the Banewood?

passages.title: Hunting Trophies
passages.text:
<Constantin examines what you have brought him>

Well done. You may make a fine hopebreaker yet.

passages.title: Belly Full of Fae
passages.text:
The local flora have gone somewhat wild during this anima drought.

It seems they swallowed most of the young fae who were tending to the wildseeds here.

At least now we know where they've been.

Oh, don't worry. This isn't the first time this has happened. We can last quite a while inside those plants.

Take my dagger. Use it to cut through the shrubbery and free the other wildseed tenders.

passages.title: Belly Full of Fae
passages.text: How goes the gardening?

passages.title: Belly Full of Fae
passages.text:
Great work. This should help get the Tranquil Pools back to normal.

I admit, I had thought the worst when I couldn't find any of the tenders. I'm glad they were only eaten by the local vegetation.

passages.title: Visions of the Dreamer: The Betrayal
passages.text:
I sense that in the spirit's vision, she struggles with the memory of a betrayal that is truly profound. 

Someone as close to her as a brother, turned to an enemy.

Go to the second Dreamshrine in the Basin, and help vanquish the pain of this nightmare.

passages.title: Visions of the Dreamer: The Betrayal
passages.text: Have you seen what dreams have come?

passages.title: Visions of the Dreamer: The Betrayal
passages.text:
To have an old friend turn against you, in the most terrible way. How very painful. 

But we are so close now, to soothing the spirit within the wildseed.

passages.title: Wrap it Up
passages.text:
<The seems quite excited about the presence of the new egg. You get the sense that this is an important occasion for these murlocs--there may be few eggs left.

The oracle waves a small piece of seaweed in front of you, showing you the young buds of the immature plant.

She warps the seaweed around a small part of the egg, then points at you, then back at the wrapped seaweed.

It appears that the egg needs to be wrapped in more immature seaweed stalks.>

passages.title: Wrap it Up
passages.text: <The oracle blinks at you.>

passages.title: Wrap it Up
passages.text: <The oracle wraps the egg gently in the seaweed.>

passages.title: I Know Your Face
passages.text:
This voice... I have heard it before. Though it is distorted and vengeful now.

He hunts us.

But I am not prey. And I will not let him gloat over his slain quarry. That is not the way of the Wild Hunt.

Though he may draw us to ground of his choosing, we will fight him.

And we will win. Are you with me?

passages.title: I Know Your Face
passages.text:
It cannot be easy for Korayn to hunt one of our own... but she is right. The forest is not safe so long as Lorkron lurks within it.

What a terrible fate... both for those who become possessed, and those who must hunt them down.

passages.title: The Traitor
passages.text:
Right, looks like I should let you in now.

Can't promise Mateo will be too kind though. I prefer my old boss, but don't tell him that.

Wonder what happened to her. Denathrius seemed awfully upset when they last spoke.

Anyways, let me just get that door open for ya.

passages.title: The Traitor
passages.text: Do you have Mateo's mirror shard?

passages.title: The Traitor
passages.text:
He showed so much promise in his duties.

I suppose the promise of power was too much for him to resist. But now is not the time to dwell on such things, <name>. Let us proceed.

passages.title: Heartless
passages.text:
So many of my friends have returned to the cycle... all because of those strange masks.

Why did they take my friends? What was the point of destroying the heart of my grove?

You have to return to Tirna Vaal and tell Droman Tashmur what happened here. 

I'll make my way there eventually. I just... need some time to say goodbye.

passages.title: Heartless
passages.text:
Shadows loom over the weald, harbingers of tragedy to come.

The river of fate flows swiftly, its currents inexorable. Where they lead... cannot yet be seen.

passages.title: A Message from Icecrown
passages.text:
Our forces in Northrend have sent word. Justicar Trueheart requests our immediate assistance.

We must respond to this summons at once, no matter what terrors await us in Icecrown.

A <class> like you would do much to bolster our chances on the battlefield.

You have my word that Orgrimmar will be protected in your absence.

Battle calls, <name>. I trust you are ready.

passages.title: A Message from Icecrown
passages.text: You arrive just in time. Commander Throgg spoke highly of you.

passages.title: Skeleton Key
passages.text:
I see Thrall. But... the path to him is sealed.

You must find the key.

The task ahead is fraught with peril. You must journey to the Maw, and deliberately invoke the Eye of the Jailer to fall upon you. Tempt fate until his strongest assassins strike.

One of them will possess the key we need.

passages.title: Return of the Scourge
passages.text:
Deliver these reports to Commander Throgg. He must be told of the full extent of the threat we face.

If we fail to hold the line against the Scourge... then Light help us all.

passages.title: Return of the Scourge
passages.text:
I will pass this report onto the Regent Lord. I fear this is only the beginning. 

Word has come from Icecrown. The darkness stirs, and your strength is needed.

passages.title: Cure For All Ills
passages.text:
Many survivors from the House of Plagues are still in need help. Their suffering fills me with great sadness.

Maw Walker, I'd do anything to help them. Even saving a few is better than saving none.

Please, help me cure them!

passages.title: Cure For All Ills
passages.text: You and Roseboil have done well to help the survivors from the House of Plagues.

passages.title: Return of the Scourge
passages.text:
Deliver my report to Commander Gregor. He must be informed of what we are up against. 

The Scourge's numbers are on the rise, and if they do not abate... then the Light help us all.

passages.title: Return of the Scourge
passages.text:
I will see to it that King Greymane and the Lord Commander receive these reports, though I fear this is only the beginning.

This courier has just brought us dire news from Icecrown.

It appears we are not the only ones under assault.

passages.title: Cult Couture
passages.text:
Though our scouts have been able to infiltrate the cultist forces at Aldur'thar, sneaking into Mord'rethar has proven all but impossible.

Perhaps it is time to explore other methods of ingress.

Start by investigating the cult's nearby ritual chambers. You may find something of use.

passages.title: Cult Couture
passages.text: Find something?

passages.title: Cult Couture
passages.text: These should suffice.

passages.title: Toppling the Brute
passages.text:
A nearby monstrosity has been thwarting our efforts to clear the meadow.

Together, we can bring it down.

You and I will face off against the beast. When the time is right, I will call for the hunt to charge.

The Wild Hunt has suffered too many losses. Today we will claim victory against these monsters!

passages.title: Toppling the Brute
passages.text: Fine work, <name>. This won't win our war... but it will at least help us in the fight for Soryn's Meadow.

passages.title: Souls of the Forest
passages.text:
If you're standing in for Lady Moonberry, then maybe you can help!

Wagonmaster Derawyn was escorting a bunch of us to a new grove when we were attacked by a pack of hungry predators! The wolf be a fast soulshape, so I got away... but some of the little ones weren't so lucky. They're being hunted like prey!

Come on! They're just down the road!

passages.title: Souls of the Forest
passages.text: Well, that was exciting.

passages.title: Souls of the Forest
passages.text:
It's been a while since a new soul arrived in Ardenweald, so each one already here is precious to us.

I'll be sure to let Lady Moonberry know of your heroic rescue efforts on her behalf. She might even decide she owes you a favor!

passages.title: Secrets in Shadows
passages.text:
Though we have been monitoring the cultist presence at Mord'rethar, we have not yet discovered what mysteries lie within its chambers.

Take these robes. Make your way into the inner sanctum and see what you can discover.

This may be our only chance to learn their intentions, <name>.

passages.title: Secrets in Shadows
passages.text: Find something?

passages.title: Secrets in Shadows
passages.text: <This news is rather unsettling.>

passages.title: A Message from Above
passages.text:
This is troubling news, adventurer. Whoever this "Banished One" may be, it is clear he is behind the Scourge's return.

That the undead are amassing in great numbers outside Icecrown Citadel cannot be a coincidence. Lead our hippogryph riders in surveying the area from above.

Determine if the dark herald you saw is among them, and then clear a path for reinforcements.

Let us hope she possesses the answers we seek.

passages.title: A Message from Above
passages.text: The skies over the citadel may be dangerous, but we need to know what we're up against.

passages.title: A Message from Above
passages.text: With their numbers momentarily reduced, now is our chance to strike.

passages.title: With Hope in Hand
passages.text:
You must bring word of what we have uncovered back to Orgrimmar. One of our mages can open a portal for you at the tournament grounds.

As for the Argent Crusade, we must remain a bulwark against the Scourge. If you wish to continue aiding us, I will see to it that your skills are put to good use.

May the Light protect you, <name>.

passages.title: With Hope in Hand
passages.text: This is troubling news, <name>. To think that Sylvanas would willingly ally with such a dark power...

passages.title: With Hope in Hand
passages.text:
You must bring word of what we have uncovered back to Stormwind. One of our mages can open a portal for you at the tournament grounds.

As for the Argent Crusade, we must remain a bulwark against the Scourge. If you wish to continue aiding us, I will see to it that your skills are put to good use.

May the Light protect you, <name>.

passages.title: With Hope in Hand
passages.text: These are grim tidings, <name>. It seems the Banshee has aligned herself with a darker power than we know.

passages.title: The Seat of the Primus
passages.text:
