This cannot be a coincidence. It is clear that your runeblade is somehow connected to the Seat of the Primus.

I will not pretend to know the Primus's agenda. But I would not be surprised if he left behind a way for the worthy to open the door to his sanctum.

Draka will bring you to the Seat of the Primus. If you hold the key, mortal, then our victory is all but assured.

passages.title: The Seat of the Primus
passages.text: What is it?

passages.title: The Seat of the Primus
passages.text: We cannot lose sight of the battles ahead of us. The door will have to wait.

passages.title: Infusing the Wildseed
passages.text:
Dreamweaver tells me of a ritual to quell the wildseed's nightmares... but it will require anima.

A soul named Proglo lives beneath this tree, gathering anima for the grove's caretakers to use.

His mortal life came to a violent end, and his soul has been skittish ever since. He will not respond well to your current form.

I will grant you the ability to assume the soulshape of a fox. Approach Proglo in your new form to gain his trust and ask for his anima.

passages.title: Infusing the Wildseed
passages.text: I hope we can aid this wildseed.

passages.title: Infusing the Wildseed
passages.text: It's going to be difficult, but I know of a place where there may be enough anima to help this wildseed.

passages.title: Report to Lord Herne
passages.text:
I will do whatever it takes to save Gweyir from the Drust's curse.

Lord Herne must be informed of what befell my hunting party. Deliver my report to him while I escort Gweyir back to the Heart of the Forest.

Gweyir was under my leadership during the ambush... she is my responsibility. I will make sure she gets home safely.

passages.title: Report to Lord Herne
passages.text: Did you find the lost hunting party?

passages.title: Report to Lord Herne
passages.text: So Gweyir and Ara'lon are the only survivors... this is grave news.

passages.title: Face Your Fears
passages.text:
The temple is now accessible. We must go now to aid Mikanikos in breaking the Sire's influence on the crown.

Prepare yourself. Denathrius's magic has always been potent and destructive. 

This won't be easy.

passages.title: Face Your Fears
passages.text:
With the echo of Denathrius defeated, Mikanikos assures me the crown is pure.

This is a key victory for Revendreth and all the Shadowlands.

passages.title: A Spark of Light
passages.text:
Gorgoa is a protean force fueled by souls that trickle in from many worlds. They wash in from the head of the river, a place they have named the Crucible of the Damned.

The Jailer's unblinking eyes patrol the river and watch for souls who attempt escape.

Blind the eyes that find them. Close them for good. 

Take this and do what must be done.

passages.title: A Spark of Light
passages.text: Have you closed the Jailer's eyes?

passages.title: A Spark of Light
passages.text: Well done, Maw Walker. The Jailer's eyes are dangerous, indeed.

passages.title: Return to the Den
passages.text:
There may be a way to break the curse and free your friend's mind, but it will require some work.

Ulfar was wise to send you to me. He knew that a portion of Gorak Tul's power would be necessary, but the other reagents we need do not exist on Azeroth.

My den is not far from here. Meet me there and I will help you prepare a ritual to break the curse.

passages.title: Return to the Den
passages.text: It feels good to be out of that cage and back home in my den.

passages.title: Manifesting Power
passages.text:
As you know, shedding our memories of life can result in dangerous creatures known as manifestations. They have increased in number and strength as of late, but I believe we can find use for them yet.

Manifestations carry great power within them--power we may purify and use in our own creations at the forge here. In making something positive out of such negativity, we do a noble act of service.

Simply eliminate any you come across, and collect their essence. That is all.

passages.title: Manifesting Power
passages.text: Be cautious in your travels. Manifestations are no simple foe.

passages.title: Manifesting Power
passages.text: These will do quite nicely! Go in service, Maw Walker.

passages.title: Where There's a Quill...
passages.text:
In times long past, Aspirants trained against the fauna of Bastion. The creation of the Centurions rendered such unstructured progression obsolete.

The many flying denizens of this realm are known for their quills. They are light and sturdy, perfect for our purposes.

Gather all that you can, please. Any flying creature shall suffice.

passages.title: Where There's a Quill...
passages.text: Have you the quills?

passages.title: Where There's a Quill...
passages.text: Acceptable portion received. You have my thanks.

passages.title: Straight to the Point
passages.text:
The horned beasts of Bastion were once commonly used in aspirant training, but centurion sparring units have mostly taken their place. Over the past few eons, their numbers have grown and now must be culled.

Their horns are critical components to our work. Many specimens are broken from use in battle--they will not suffice. You must be careful in collecting them.

Face them, defeat them, and bring back their horns.

passages.title: Straight to the Point
passages.text: We require as many horns as you are able to procure.

passages.title: Straight to the Point
passages.text: Acceptable quality and quantity level. Thank you.

passages.title: Signs of Demise
passages.text:
All members of the Forsworn carry an insignia on their person at all times. We suspect they are imbued with the power of the Temple of Loyalty, bolstering their strength against us.

Collect these insignias from their deceased forms. Strip them of this power, and we shall put it to better use in our own machinations.

Such is the Archon's will, as it is ours.

passages.title: Signs of Demise
passages.text: Each insignia is a shift of power in our favor.

passages.title: Signs of Demise
passages.text: These will prove most useful. Well done.

passages.title: Reduce, Reuse, Recycle
passages.text:
Centurions need lots of parts. But so do we!

Kofi needs their metal. Can be from Centurions or the ground. Your choice!

Not too damaged, ok? Hard to clean!

passages.title: Reduce, Reuse, Recycle
passages.text: You have metal?

passages.title: Reduce, Reuse, Recycle
passages.text: This is HEAVY metal! Just like Kofi's favorite music!

passages.title: Unbroken Bonds
passages.text:
The Drust will pay for this foul curse that they've unleashed upon us.

We have lost too many allies... too many friends to give up now. Even though we cannot save those who have fallen into possession, we can end their torment. I will instruct the hunt to put down all possessed they encounter.

Please deliver this report to the Winter Queen. She must be told what we have learned.

Thank you for your service, <name>. You are a true friend and guardian of Ardenweald.

passages.title: Unbroken Bonds
passages.text: What news do you bring?

passages.title: Unbroken Bonds
passages.text: If the Thornspeakers have no way to break the curse, then perhaps there truly is no hope for the possessed. These are tidings most dire.

passages.title: Pollen Your Weight
passages.text:
You know Twirlpetal flowers?! They spin around in the light!

We need pollen. Only pollen if in bloom!

Get a bunch! Flowers in golden fields. And they spin! Round and round!

passages.title: Pollen Your Weight
passages.text: Pollen very fragile. Won't last long!

passages.title: Pollen Your Weight
passages.text: So much! Yes, yes, great! Perfect!

passages.title: A Light Touch
passages.text:
Need Firstborne's Light! You know?

Named after Archon! Always in water. Kofi's favorite!

Shine big light when grown. And go to shore! Easy to see!

passages.title: A Light Touch
passages.text: Only grown flowers! Little ones won't work.

passages.title: A Light Touch
passages.text: SO SHINY! Kofi need shades next time!

passages.title: The Secret Ingredient
passages.text:
At times, even the most seasoned kyrian may have difficulty meditating. Recently, such problems have become increasingly common.

There is a special draught crafted from our purest waters that can be used to focus the mind. I believe it may prove useful in our work here as well, perhaps as a catalyst for more potent reactions.

Will you gather some? Move swiftly, for the liquid becomes unstable once removed from our sacred pools.

passages.title: The Secret Ingredient
passages.text: Were you able to find the draught?

passages.title: The Secret Ingredient
passages.text: I will put test these samples at once! You have my thanks.

passages.title: Arms Day
passages.text:
Many battles here. Especially lately!

Now weapons all over. Too many. We can use!

Go to big battle places and grab them. We will use better!

passages.title: Arms Day
passages.text: Careful with the pointy end!

passages.title: Arms Day
passages.text: These are perfect! Thank you-hoo!

passages.title: A Somber Melody
passages.text:
Though we kyrian cease to be should we perish in battle here, there is much power within Bastion itself that can call forth echoes of our former brothers and sisters.

These memories wander the roads. At times, they take on some purpose they served in their eternity here--crafting goods, guarding our sacred grounds, and the like.

Take my lyre. Its ancient melody will dispel the memories, and in the process charge it with the residual energy of our realm.

passages.title: A Somber Melody
passages.text: The lyre thrums with power! We shall make good use of it.

passages.title: See What You've Done
passages.text:
We have gathered what forces we can. I hope it is enough.

Within the ruins of our necropolis awaits one final challenge. The one leading the salvage effort calls herself Gorgantus.

To preserve all that remains to us, we must end her. 

Lead the attack, and the Eyes will join you. We will reclaim our home.

passages.title: See What You've Done
passages.text: I shall execute Akarek's will once more.

passages.title: Echthra, Dame of Hatred
passages.text: That should satisfy our contact. Well done.

passages.title: Alderyn and Myn'ir
passages.text: This spear should be exactly what they need to take down their quarry.

passages.title: Nuuminuuru
passages.text: Though their request was quite nonstandard, I am sure this fountain will be exactly what they need.

passages.title: Mad Mortimer
passages.text:
<Dactylis inspects the catalyst.>

Well crafted. This should work perfectly for the scientist's needs.

passages.title: Splinterbark Nightmare
passages.text: May a great blow be struck to the drust this day.

passages.title: Tactical Operation
passages.text:
Your target lies near the Oaken Assembly in Ardenweald on the Elder Strand. Take caution, for powerful drust forces lurk nearby.

Once your target is in sight, activate the beacon and protect the praetors that arrive as they work to subdue the beast. You will only be able to capture its memory once it has been fully incapacitated.

Make haste, and good luck. Follow the path.

passages.title: Tactical Operation
passages.text: The Nightmare's memory will prove a formidable opponent. May its physical form remain at rest.

passages.title: Thran'tiok
passages.text: This crystal will be useful in finding and capturing the memory you seek.

passages.title: Craven Corinth
passages.text: I am pleased that I retained the designs for this venthyr key for all those millenia. It was not easy to come by.

passages.title: Athanos
passages.text: May Athanos' return be upon us at last.

passages.title: Azaruux, the Realm Ender
passages.text:
You must act at once!

A devourer of incredible strength has opened a rift in the coliseum and even now threatens to consume it! What few fighters were present at the time struggle to keep the creature at bay.

If this horror is not stopped, it will continue into the rest of the spires. You must take what anima you can in the area and subdue it.

Once the threat has been negated, take this spare mirror and capture its memory so we may learn more of its kind for future encounters.

passages.title: Azaruux, the Realm Ender
passages.text: You must not delay!

passages.title: Azaruux, the Realm Ender
passages.text: A heroic effort! We will learn much from battling its kind.

passages.title: A Journey Made Together
passages.text:
Binding souls is but the first step. 

Over time, the power of our bond will grow in strength and manifest itself in the form of amazing new abilities!

To tap into this newfound strength, all you must do is place your hand upon the Forge of Bonds. There is no price to pay--the only limitation is your connection to Necrolords.

passages.title: A Journey Made Together
passages.text: This device is merely a conduit to the strength that lies within us both.

passages.title: A Journey Made Together
passages.text: May we prove worthy allies for the battles to come.

passages.title: Ember Court: Traditional
passages.text:
Of course Darkhaven is honored to provide traditional decorations for Prince Renathal's court.

Venthyr decor is all about setting a certain mood. That means lurking stonefiends and death blossom scented candles in vast quantity.

Our resources are stretched thin, <name>. We can supply stonefiends easily, but our artisans need wax to melt with fresh death blossom. There should be candle remnants and drips in the village to scrape up. Death blossoms can be harvested from the plants themselves.

passages.title: Ember Court: Traditional
passages.text: Have you managed to gather the raw materials for our artisans yet?

passages.title: Ember Court: Traditional
passages.text: We had best get to work right away. Thank you.

passages.title: Ember Court: Mortal Reminders
passages.text:
For a reasonable renumeration, Ta Cartel can supply the decorations you require. 

Restocking unique and intriguing items is an important aspect of doing business. As you can freely return to your own world, you can provide me some new and exciting products to offer.

Your world has captured the imagination of many of our clients. I have buyers looking for some specific things native to Azeroth.

passages.title: Ember Court: Mortal Reminders
passages.text: Have you found something that fits each item on the list?

passages.title: Ember Court: Mortal Reminders
passages.text: Yes, yes, this is excellent work. Our clients will love these.

passages.title: Ember Court: Mystery Mirrors
passages.text:
I support Prince Renathal's efforts and will certainly help the Ember Court!

Mystery mirrors will be dangerous but add real excitement to the party. I will need a lot of mirror fragments to complete enough of them in time.

You will also need to refresh my supply of Ashen Cores so I can get the glass sufficiently molten to work.

passages.title: Ember Court: Mystery Mirrors
passages.text: Have you found the mirror fragments and an Ashen Core?

passages.title: Ember Court: Mystery Mirrors
passages.text: Thank you for collecting the necessary ingredients to make the mirrors.

passages.title: Ember Court: Stoneborn Reserves
passages.text:
To call up the reserves to provide security for the Ember Court we will need anima. Good, loyal troops are ready as soon as we can animate them.

We will also need weapons for them.

Sort that out and I will make sure the Prince and his guests are well protected.

passages.title: Ember Court: Stoneborn Reserves
passages.text: Have you filled the anima canister and found enough weapons to equip our new comrades?

passages.title: Ember Court: Stoneborn Reserves
passages.text: Good. This will be sufficient for me to get those reserves ready.

passages.title: Ember Court: Maldraxxus Army
passages.text:
So your prince's little parties have attracted unwanted attention?

<Emeni laughs.>

I have my own long list of enemies, and far too many of them hide from me in the land of the living. Cowards!

But I have finally found a solution.

Take this crystal to my remains on Azeroth, and use it to project my image among the living for a short time so that I may exact revenge on my old kin.

passages.title: Ember Court: Maldraxxus Army
passages.text: What are you waiting for? Those sethrak won't impale themselves.

passages.title: Ember Court: Maldraxxus Army
passages.text:
So much slaughter... So many names removed from my list...

A whole new generation of sethrak will fear my name!

passages.title: Ember Court: Divine Desserts
passages.text:
Recipes very important. Must not be lost!

I learn new foods from many mortals, add to my book. Best way is taste some of thing so can know what is good. You teach recipe to me this way and bring me right ingredients so I cook too. Then taste yours, then taste mine. Helps me learn.

I bring desserts to Ember Court.

Fair, yes?

passages.title: Ember Court: Divine Desserts
passages.text: You ready to give ingredients and taste test?

passages.title: Ember Court: Divine Desserts
passages.text: Ones that seem simple are harder. All ingredients must be perfect.

passages.title: Ember Court: Atoning Rituals
passages.text:
If Prince Renathal wishes to impart knowledge of Revendreth's highest calling to his guests, we would be honored to demonstrate the rituals of atonement.

However, I must ask for your assistance preparing the necessary components quickly.

Capture nearby fugitive souls that hide from the Lord Chamberlain's corrupt venthyr. Bring them to our avowed ritualists across the halls. They will prepare the souls for our purpose.

Sinstone fragments will also help us identify the sins of these lost souls.

passages.title: Ember Court: Atoning Rituals
passages.text: Fugitive souls can be found hiding in the darkest corners of the Halls of Atonement.

passages.title: Ember Court: Atoning Rituals
passages.text:
Thank you, <name>. The Accuser and I will personally lead the rituals during the Ember Court.

We will remind everyone of Revendreth's true purpose.

passages.title: Ember Court: Glimpse of the Wilds
passages.text:
It would be wonderful to show Revendreth the wild creatures of Ardenweald!

You can get some Radiant Groupers near the waterfalls. They're fast so you have to grab them as they swim by. 

Here's a net to use to subdue the Territorial Waders. They should follow you once you've caught them.

Highland Runestags will let you ride them if you aren't aggressive. Bring a few here to me, please. Watch out for the bulls, they're not at all friendly.

We will get others to help too. This sounds like fun.

passages.title: Ember Court: Glimpse of the Wilds
passages.text: We need Radiant Groupers, Highland Runestags, and Territorial Waders please.

passages.title: Ember Court: Glimpse of the Wilds
passages.text: Thank you <name>.

passages.title: Sourcing Your Own Materials
passages.text:
I can aid you in crafting many pieces of equipment for your soulbinds.

Though they may only equip one at a time, each piece grants a new ability that they may not have without it.

This time you must source your own materials from around the Shadowlands. When you have collected them, return to me and we can create the footpads!

passages.title: Sourcing Your Own Materials
passages.text: You find materials okay? Blueprint can help!

passages.title: Sourcing Your Own Materials
passages.text: Boots? Very nice! I hold on for safe keeping.

passages.title: War of Information
passages.text:
Ah, the anointment oil. I had expected one of Adrestes' recruits.

No matter. You seek my memory for your trials, yes? I am afraid mere oil will not suffice.

With our house gone, we are left to fend for ourselves. Though this tower offers some protection, we are left cornered to any who may desire our end.

Information is the key to survival. Use my anointed talisman to give me eyes across all the realms...even in Bastion. Follow the list precisely--no questions.

Then can we resolve payment.

passages.title: War of Information
passages.text: There will be no negotiation in this matter.

passages.title: War of Information
passages.text: Already my vision grows. The pact is sealed.

passages.title: Shinies of Bastion
passages.text:
Chordy is bored, boooored!

You want to go look for luckydos? Go on adventure with Chordy?

We go to land of wing people, go look for valuable luckydos there.

Ready?

passages.title: Shinies of Bastion
passages.text: Did we find anything good?

passages.title: Shinies of Bastion
passages.text:
Interesting, these are in better condition than most of Chordy's finds.

These will serve us well. Thank you, Maw Walker.

passages.title: Strengthening the Bond
passages.text:
I know how you feel... and what you have endured for the sake of your world. 

You now know of my own triumphs and tragedies as well.

Our bond will grow stronger over time. But for now, let us see what it has granted us.

Ardenweald has needs of us. We must do everything in our power to save it.

passages.title: Strengthening the Bond
passages.text: We are stronger together.

passages.title: Strengthening the Bond
passages.text: Together, we can do anything.

passages.title: Crush 'Em All
passages.text:
The mooring platform will be our best launching point to access the necropolis above. But one more fight remains before us.

Enforcer Borgulla oversees all of the work efforts that take place here. We'll need to eliminate her if we are to proceed unhindered.

She is a formidable foe. It appears Ansid has kept some of his explosives on his person. Let us utilize this advantage.

passages.title: Crush 'Em All
passages.text: Your strength never fails to impress me.

passages.title: The Ember Court
passages.text:
We've got everything we need to host our first real Ember Court whenever you're ready, Maw Walker.

Take a moment to finalize everything, and then we'll open court!

Remember, we're trying to impress Cryptkeeper Kassir and convince him that we know what we're doing, so make sure you choose the refreshments and entertainment we hired for him!

Once everything's ready, let me know and I'll open the court!

passages.title: The Ember Court
passages.text: Cryptkeeper Kassir is going to love this!

passages.title: The Ember Court
passages.text:
Incredible! Flawless! The perfect party herald!

And you did well too.

Let's do this again next week!

passages.title: A New Age
passages.text:
With the final empowerment in place, our renewed Crest of Ascension stands bolstered by the might of not just Bastion, but all covenants.

Soon new Ascended will grace these halls once more as aspirants finish their long-awaited trials.

None of this would be possible without your aid, Maw Walker. The honor of activating the Crest at last is yours.

passages.title: A New Age
passages.text: This is a glorious moment for all kyrian.

passages.title: A New Age
passages.text:
With the Crest complete at last, we must next turn our eyes back to the Forsworn.

<You notice Grubby looking at you expectantly.>

passages.title: Ember Court: Refreshments
passages.text:
We should always serve refreshments in the Ember Court, tailoring our choice of refreshment type to the preferences of our guests.

Luckily, I know our first guest well. Like Theotar, he prefers it to be Formal.

Work with Picky Stefan to acquire everything we need to throw a fancy tea party.

passages.title: Ember Court: Refreshments
passages.text: You smart! Tubbins tea is best tea!

passages.title: Ember Court: Entertainment
passages.text:
Everyone loves entertainment!

Our first guest is from the Halls of Atonement, so he will certainly appreciate a presentation of the powerful rituals the Accuser is capable of.

Work with Hips to acquire everything we need to host atoning rituals at the Ember Court.

passages.title: Ember Court: Entertainment
passages.text: A new court in Revendreth? The Accuser must be pleased that you chose to include rituals of atonement in the festivities.

passages.title: Crumbled Reality
passages.text:
As the drought and devourers eat our buildin's, the structures lose their hold on reality. Thing is, it ain't a clean process. Some of that debris is still infused with anima.

When your out, be a stoneback an' bring us whatever infused debris you can find.

See, we can recycle it into new structures as you hero types go and get the anima flowin' again.

Bring it here an we'll get it sorted.

passages.title: Crumbled Reality
passages.text: Impressed 'ow much you can carry with 'em 'itty bitty arms.

passages.title: Crumbled Reality
passages.text: Everythin's bricks n' mortar with you. Love it.

passages.title: Old Habits Never Die
passages.text:
Your redistribution of anima has been commendable so far.

But venthyr are still venthyr. They may spend eons educating souls on the folly of greed and hoarding, but they often fail to acknowledge the return of that trait in themselves, given enough time.

My scouts have witnessed a number of venthyr siphoning the anima you have redistributed and hoarding it within their estates and dwellings. 

Search these places and recover this hoarded anima so that we might put it to better use.

passages.title: Old Habits Never Die
passages.text:
Greed. One of the few sins not fully purged but actually encouraged in the venthyr by Sire Denathrius in recent ages. 

We have watched as he used this as a tool to control his populous, to keep them stagnant and un-unified. 

Renathal's methods are the only way forward.

passages.title: Big Bag of Creepers
passages.text:
Right. You've been a polished bit of gray so far and it's appreciated from the bottom up for sure.

Well, now I got a task for 'ou that would help all of us dredgers put that anima you obtained to good use.

Creepers.

Not just any creepers, but 'em mire creepers. 'Ey got a look about 'em and a taste about 'em that just sings when you put it to good use.

As you go trippin' around Revendreth, grab any creepers ya find an' stick 'em in this here sack. I'll pay ya.

passages.title: Big Bag of Creepers
passages.text: Creepers. 'Ey like chewin' on the mortar at holds all these walls up.

passages.title: Big Bag of Creepers
passages.text:
Well then, look at that!

A big ol' bag of Creepers, with their squinty eyes and mold smellin' breath.

Ain't 'ey cute? 

Havin' a few a these around the lads while they work will really help morale. Much appreciated from all of us.

passages.title: Census of Sins
passages.text:
The Curator once knew the contents and locations of every sinstone in Revendreth dating back to the founding of this realm.

Sadly, her time in the Maw disrupted those essential parts of her vast intellect and we can no longer rely upon her for such knowledge. At least, not for a while. And so it falls to me to rebuild a 'living' archive.

As you venture into Revendreth I would ask that you recover the contents and location of certain sinstones. This will help us orient our archive.

passages.title: Census of Sins
passages.text: With time and enough information we may be able to anchor the Curator's knowledge so that she once again becomes the invaluable resource that she once was.

passages.title: Awaken Our Allies
passages.text:
I have need of your services.

I have identified a collection of stoneborn throughout Revendreth whom may be swayed to our cause, or were already members of our cause before returning to their stone slumber.

You have provided us with the anima we needed, now it is time to put it to use. Seek out our allies and awaken them. I have fashioned an anima container for easier transport to aid in this endeavor. 

We need an army if we are to face an army.

passages.title: Awaken Our Allies
passages.text:
Terrifying, aren't they? Magnificent weapons crafted by the finest arts perfected since the coalescing of the Shadowlands themselves. 

They shall prove invaluable in the times to come.

passages.title: Ember Court: Lost Chalice Band
passages.text:
Hips was smart to send you my way. The Lost Chalice Band plays the best music this side of the Maw!

The band is not quite ready to tour yet, however.

The musicians are all safe in the crypt behind me, but their instruments have been confiscated by our obnoxious neighborhood authorities!

Noise complaints and all that.

Help me get those back, and perhaps recruit a few groupies and roadies along the way to help out, and we shall throw the best concert your court has ever seen!

passages.title: Ember Court: Lost Chalice Band
passages.text: Any venthyr or dredger will do. We are not picky about our fans.

passages.title: Ember Court: Lost Chalice Band
passages.text:
I do not know what promotional tricks you used, but it worked.

A whole stream of dredgers and venthyr stopped by to join the band crew!

The Lost Chalice Band is ready to tour!

passages.title: Pilfered Power
passages.text:
The illusion ritual will require a substantive amount of anima to complete. Since such a resource isn't simply lying around these days, we will need to take some.

The abominations from the House of Constructs recently arrived with a delivery of anima-rich spoils from the raid on Bastion. 

Use the maldracite crystal I've included in the parcel to extract enough anima for our ritual.

passages.title: Pilfered Power
passages.text:
This should be sufficient.

Let us prepare for the ritual.

passages.title: The Hall of Tomes
passages.text:
Very well, you can have your list. The volumes you seek can be found in the Hall of Tomes.

Now, run back to your master like a good little pet.

passages.title: The Hall of Tomes
passages.text: You have returned? Do you have my tomes?

passages.title: The Hall of Tomes
passages.text:
Ah yes, these will do.

It will take some time to study these tomes. In the meantime, I have more need of you.

passages.title: The Final Reagent
passages.text:
I have gathered most of the remaining reagents on your master's list. All that remains is the special shipment he requested from Oribos.

The brokers have yet to deliver the shipment. When it arrives, your master will have all he needs to complete his ritual.

passages.title: The Final Reagent
passages.text: Let us see what we have here.

passages.title: The Final Reagent
passages.text:
Let me hold onto these for now.

I will need you to get your hands on that shipment!

passages.title: The Traitor Unmasked
passages.text:
We must waste no time in warning the margrave of Kel'Thuzad's treachery. His reckless toying with forbidden powers could bring ruin to the house and beyond!

Let us put an end to this!

passages.title: The Traitor Unmasked
passages.text: We must stop Kel'Thuzad before it's too late!

passages.title: The Traitor Unmasked
passages.text:
I didn't think we would make it out of that encounter intact.

You are truly a skilled <class>, <name>.

passages.title: Dredging up an Assistant
passages.text:
Here we go, onto the dredging part.

Just like we made that biggun here earlier!

I mean we don't need the stone of binding or three other dredgers, but you'll still be throwing stuff into the muck!

So it's the same. 

You head to the shore with this here Kaja-Infused Dredger Mix I whipped up for you.

Toss it into that muck pool and let's meet that new dredger butler of yours!

passages.title: Dredging up an Assistant
passages.text: It worked! Of course I knew it would. Now what to name this guy... but first I am go'n to dismiss him so y'can test out the binding of the contract.

passages.title: Words of Warding
passages.text:
The towering citadel in the distance is protected by perilous walls, but its greatest dangers cannot be seen with mortal eyes.

The Mawsworn have placed invisible runes of warding throughout Perdition Hold. These traps have caught many intruders unaware.

The runes can be dispelled, but only if you can see them. I believe one of their soulcloaks should give you the sight you require.

Good luck.

passages.title: Words of Warding
passages.text: Are the wards gone? I am eager to resume surveillance of our enemy.

passages.title: Words of Warding
passages.text: I trust you did not let your eyes wander while wearing the soulcloak? It can reveal some truly terrible things...

passages.title: A Perilous Journey
passages.text:
Mograine has rallied the House of the Chosen to strike at Margrave Gharmal and his House of Constructs. They grow in strength with each passing day--this may be our only chance.

We will join them on the field of battle. We will have justice for the fallen at my temple, as well as Mograine's own fallen kin.

Rendezvous at Spider's Watch within Maldraxxus' northern reaches. We will move from there.

passages.title: A Perilous Journey
passages.text: Now we can join our new allies.

passages.title: Descended
passages.text:
Though we have stopped the creation of more juggernauts, one of their most vile creations yet draws breath. It was born of one of the most pained souls they took from my temple.

As I flew above their ranks I could hear their surgeons chanting its name above the din of combat--Woeblade. It is an affront to all the kyrian stand for, an atrocity beyond any other.

Mark it with the flames of courage when you engage, and we will help you destroy it.

passages.title: Descended
passages.text: May our victory bring them peace.

passages.title: Pursuit of Justice
passages.text:
Draka stands ready to unleash the power of the Zerekriss upon Gharmal. We need only buy her time to focus its weapon.

What we do now, we do for all of us. Bastion and Maldraxxus have both lost many to these fiends.

He will not be defeated easily, but united our forces will finally bring him to justice!

passages.title: Pursuit of Justice
passages.text: Our fallen may finally rest in peace.

passages.title: Edict of Doom: Devourers
passages.text:
The infusion of anima within Revendreth has led to a resurgence in devourer infestations. These eaters of the world must be slain.

By order of Prince Renathal and the rightful Court of Harvesters, this edict decrees the doom upon these aberrations.

Complete this quota of destruction within Revendreth and receive a reward equal to your efforts.

passages.title: Edict of Doom: Devourers
passages.text:
Devourers. Filthy aberrations. We should have recognized their coming as the sign of the end times that they were.

You have our gratitude, Maw Walker.

passages.title: Edict of Doom: Dredbats
passages.text:
The recent suffusion of anima in the region has led to an increase in dredbats being animated far and above any intended volume.

By order of Prince Renathal and the true Court of Harvesters an edict of doom is declared on dredbats within Revendreth. 

Avoid those used for transport or assigned to specific duties, but slay any in the less tamed regions of the realm and a reward shall be proffered.

passages.title: Edict of Doom: Dredbats
passages.text: Maw Walker?

passages.title: Edict of Doom: Dredbats
passages.text: Ah, well done. Dredbats are useful entities when they serve their intended purpose. Left unchecked and untamed, however, they become competing predators for what few souls remain in our care.

passages.title: Overdue Purging
passages.text:
There are many duties of a stoneborn that have been forsaken by the plans of Denathrius. 

One such duty is the elimination of manifestations. The process venthyr use to extract anima from souls is not clean, and often leads to unresolved issues made manifest. 

These entities are dangerous if left unchecked, and increase in number thanks to your revivication of anima to these droughted lands.

While you patrol Revendreth, destroy any manifestations you encounter and I shall provide you recompense.

passages.title: Overdue Purging
passages.text:
Your efforts are much appreciated. 

When this conflict is over, the Stone Legion should once again return to its noble purpose of protecting Revendreth, instead of satisfying the dark whims of Denathrius and his allies.

passages.title: Edict of Doom: Sinstone Golems
passages.text:
By order of the true Court of Harvesters an edict of doom is issued for any Sinstone Golems that have coalesced into dangerous sizes within the realm. 

These entities are the manifestation of unresolved sins of those souls who failed their redemption and were condemned to the Maw. With the recent suffusion of anima to the region they have grown dangerously strong.

Expunge them from existence and recompense shall be provided.

passages.title: Edict of Doom: Sinstone Golems
passages.text: You do the work the Stone Legion was once tasked to accomplish in better times. You have our gratitude.

passages.title: Take the Bite Out of 'Em
passages.text:
Right. So you got a quota of venthyr you need offed and I got a mean need for some payback.

See, you may not think it to look at me but 'em venthyr loooove to chew on me specifically. Not sure what dark habit followed them across the veil but I just was a squishy bag of indulgence for far too long.

As you go about offin' 'em venthyr for your normal... motivations... I'd ask you to bring me a bunch of fangs off 'em you off, as it were. 

I'll pay for payback!

passages.title: Take the Bite Out of 'Em
passages.text: I'm gettin' quite a collection goin'.

passages.title: Take the Bite Out of 'Em
passages.text: Much obliged. This will go a long way to servin' "restitutions" as 'em fang heads would say.

passages.title: Ember Court Ambassador
passages.text:
Expanding your influence is quite simple.

Find someone. Ask them what they want. Give it to them.

Congratulations. You now have influence with them.

If we wish to engage the other realms and win them over to our side, we must do the same on a larger scale.

So go to the other realms. Give them what they want. Expand our influence.

passages.title: Ember Court Ambassador
passages.text:
Our contacts in the other realms have already reported positive chatter surrounding your actions there.

<Lady Ilinca smiles.>

Our influence grows.

passages.text:

Find someone. Ask them what they want. Give it to them.

Congratulations. You now have influence with them.

If we wish to engage the other realms and win them over to our side, we must do the same on a larger scale.

So go to the other realms. Give them what they want. Expand our influence.

<Lady Ilinca smiles.>

Our influence grows.

So go to the other realms. Give them what they want. Expand our influence.

<Lady Ilinca smiles.>

Our influence grows.

passages.text:
Our contacts in the other realms have already reported positive chatter surrounding your actions there.

<Lady Ilinca smiles.>

Our influence grows.

passages.title: Undercover Security
passages.text:
Do you know why the venthyr carve stoneborn into different shapes?

Because diversity in form allows for diversity in strategy. Our different shapes give us different purpose.

We need a new shape to solidify our court defenses.

With the right training and tools, venthyr guards could be hidden in plain sight--posed as greeters.

Able to be among the guests without raising concerns, they'd be the first to respond to active threats.

passages.title: Undercover Security
passages.text: Undercover guards? Interesting idea...

passages.title: Undercover Security
passages.text: This was the easy part. The hard part will be finding guards who want to listen to socialites prattle for hours on end.

passages.title: Replenish the Reservoir
passages.text:
Greetings, Maw Walker.

The Tirna Achiad, Heart of Ardenweald, flourishes in our care, yet more anima is needed for our Sanctum.

The cycle of rebirth, our purpose, must continue.

To help our Queen, we must acquire more. Will you help us replenish the reservoir?

passages.title: Replenish the Reservoir
passages.text: Have you come to dedicate anima to our sacred purpose?

passages.title: Replenish the Reservoir
passages.text: The anima you have provided will nourish our precious groves. We thank you.

passages.title: Necromantic Power
passages.text:
My old master, Thran'tiok, is the epitome of paranoia. She believes everybody will turn on her, and it led to my exilement from not only her service, but the House of Rituals as a whole.

I had no intent to cross her... but that has changed.

Take the crystal casing you have built and slay my old colleagues to infuse it with necromantic energy. It shall lead you to Thran'tiok's phylactery, which should be exactly what we both seek.

passages.title: Necromantic Power
passages.text:
Thran'tiok thinks I am a threat...

I will show her what that word truly means.

passages.title: Necromantic Power
passages.text: We do not have much time. Thran'tiok will appear herself soon.

passages.title: Castle Nathria: Getting a Head
passages.text:
We need to show Denathrius that we mean business. His dredger... pet... should do the trick.

Bring me his head. Four times should do it. Dredgers are curious creatures.

passages.title: Castle Nathria: Getting a Head
passages.text: I need the heads or we cannot make a profound statement.

passages.title: Castle Nathria: Getting a Head
passages.text: With these I'm certain we'll catch the attention of Sire Denathrius.

passages.title: Castle Nathria: Getting a Head
passages.text:
We need to show Denathrius that we mean business. His dredger... pet... should do the trick.

Bring me his head. Four times should do it. Dredgers are curious creatures.

passages.title: Castle Nathria: Getting a Head
passages.text: I need the heads or we cannot make a profound statement.

passages.title: Castle Nathria: Getting a Head
passages.text: With these I'm certain we'll catch the attention of Sire Denathrius.

passages.title: Castle Nathria: Getting a Head
passages.text:
We need to show Denathrius that we mean business. His dredger... pet... should do the trick.

Bring me his head. Four times should do it. Dredgers are curious creatures.

passages.title: Castle Nathria: Getting a Head
passages.text: I need the heads or we cannot make a profound statement.

passages.title: Castle Nathria: Getting a Head
passages.text: With these I'm certain we'll catch the attention of Sire Denathrius.

passages.title: ...Why Me?
passages.text:
<The dense, chunky liquid inside the vessel emits a horrendous odor.

The initials O.K. are etched into the side. It seems someone stole Overseer Kalvaros' canteen.>

passages.title: ...Why Me?
passages.text:
I've been wondering where my canteen went. Where did you find this, <name>? Did you take a drink before returning here?

No matter, I suppose.

passages.title: Aiding the Shadowlands
passages.text:
There is much to do within the Shadowlands. Many areas are suffering from the anima drought.

The choice of who to help first is yours. Where will you go?

passages.title: Aiding the Shadowlands
passages.text: This is your first step towards thwarting the Jailer.

passages.title: A Proper Cover
passages.text: Is that a cap for me? It is so floppy, I love it! And it will go around my ears!

passages.title: Satchel of Culexwood
passages.text: This lost satchel is filled with wood given by the nearby Culex trees. Fluttercatch would surely appreciate its return.

passages.title: Satchel of Culexwood
passages.text: A whole sackful?! Wonderful! I'll be sure to put this to good use.

passages.title: Fighting Words
passages.text:
Throughout the Shadowlands, there is so much magic to learn!

A threat in Bastion has put many of their ancient teachings in danger. I wish to study their scrolls before they are lost forever. We must travel there and safeguard what we can!

Help me fight back the Forsworn at the Temple of Humility and save the scrolls within.

passages.title: Fighting Words
passages.text: You have helped strengthen our forces, Maw Walker.

passages.title: Forces of Perdition
passages.text:
Survival requires that we keep our enemies in check, Maw Walker.

With Gorgoa overflowing, the Mawsworn continue to gain strength.

Perdition Hold has been fortified with fresh troops. We cannot allow the Mawsworn to bolster their ranks any further.

Make your way into Perdition Hold and decimate their forces. When the work is done, you may return to me for your reward.

passages.title: Forces of Perdition
passages.text: I trust the Mawsworn did not trouble you?

passages.title: Forces of Perdition
passages.text: A small victory, Maw Walker. Many more will be required.

passages.title: My Own Death Pony!
passages.text:
<Your butler is nearly in tears.>

I get my own death pony to ride? You are the best mortal I have ever met!

passages.title: Power of the Colossus
passages.text:
I have another task for you, Maw Walker.

Deep within Perdition Hold, there lurks a menacing mechanization known as the Soulsteel Colossus. It must be destroyed before it wreaks havoc upon us.

Travel to the Hold, and then across the bridge into the Altar of Domination. There, casting its vast shadow upon The Maw, you will find the Soulsteel Colossus.

Shatter the colossus and bring me its power source as proof of your victory.

passages.title: Power of the Colossus
passages.text: The power source... I trust it was not too heavy?

passages.title: Power of the Colossus
passages.text: The souls trapped within the power core may yet be saved. Leave me to my research, Maw Walker.

passages.title: A New Adventure Awaits
passages.text:
<name>! You're needed in the present. Things have... well, you should just come back to see.

I would finish what you're doing then head back. I can't keep you in the past for much longer!

passages.title: A New Adventure Awaits
passages.text: Welcome back to the present! There's a lot you have to do.

passages.title: Asset Extraction
passages.text:
Hey, it's my good pal <name>! Listen, I'm in a bit of a bind here. I've been trying to negotiate a deal with the broker Au'larrynar and he needs a little something, a job done before he'll accept.

The deal is he had an associate who went missing with a rare item. He's asked that I... we... locate and return the missing property.

The associate was last seen in Ardenweald. I know, strange place, way too bright for me. But, I... we... really need this deal to go through! 

So, you ready to go?

passages.title: Asset Extraction
passages.text: I trust you have held up to your part of the deal?

passages.title: Asset Extraction
passages.text:
Ah, now this is exquisite. Your reconstructed companion said you would be able to come through and you've done so magnificently!

Let him know I'll count this toward the repayment of his debts.

passages.title: Anima-Laden Dreamcatcher
passages.text: You stumble upon an enchanted dreamcatcher, placed so remotely that it has managed to collect a significant amount of anima without being harvested. Droman Dawnblossom in nearby Dreamsong Fenn would surely appreciate its safe return.

passages.title: Anima-Laden Dreamcatcher
passages.text: Oh my! How did that get there? No matter. This anima will nurture many souls. Thank you, traveler!

passages.title: A New Adventure Awaits
passages.text:
<name>! You're needed in the present. Things have... well, you should just come back to see.

I would finish what you're doing then head back. I can't keep you in the past for much longer!

passages.title: A New Adventure Awaits
passages.text: Welcome back to the present! There's a lot you have to do.

passages.title: Observing Battle
passages.text:
It is clear that you mortals thrive on conflict. Members of my cartel have a keen interest in observing your combat prowess in action.

You seem to be fond of squabbling over contested ground. Observing such territorial behavior would benefit me, and could provide opportunities for you as well.

Can I count on your participation?

passages.title: Observing Battle
passages.text: Observation in progress.

passages.title: Observing Battle
passages.text: Excellent. You fight so fiercely to claim a piece of ground. The Observer will find that intriguing.

passages.title: Observing War
passages.text:
Your appetite for conflict is a subject of much discussion here in Oribos, mortal. Members of my cartel have a keen interest in observing your combat prowess in action.

Though I understand a great war recently concluded on your world, I am told large-scale conflicts continue to play out in certain locations.

Any chance you could arrange a demonstration?

passages.title: Observing War
passages.text: Observation in progress.

passages.title: Observing War
passages.text: A most enlightening conflict. The Observer will be pleased.

passages.title: Observing Skirmishes
passages.text:
Fascinating how much entertainment your kind draws from conflict, mortal. Members of my cartel have a keen interest in observing your combat prowess in action.

I am told that small-scale skirmishes allow your greatest champions to demonstrate their martial superiority over their rivals. No doubt my people would learn much from observing such a contest.

Might I have the honor of a demonstration?

passages.title: Observing Skirmishes
passages.text: Observation in progress.

passages.title: Observing Skirmishes
passages.text: Fascinating. Fascinating indeed. The Observer will be pleased.

passages.title: Observing Arenas
passages.text:
The denizens of your world seem to thrive on conflict, mortal. Members of my cartel have a keen interest in observing your combat prowess in action.

Small-scale encounters in a constrained setting could prove informative for me, and potentially lucrative for you.

What do you say?

passages.title: Observing Arenas
passages.text: Observation in progress.

passages.title: Observing Arenas
passages.text: I do so enjoy the completion of a successful arrangement! The Observer will be pleased.

passages.title: Observing Teamwork
passages.text:
It's truly fascinating how conflict drives your kind, mortal. Members of my cartel have a keen interest in observing your combat prowess in action.

I am told that some of your most impressive martial demonstrations involve combat between predetermined teams. My people are unfamiliar with such contests.

Would you be willing to offer a demonstration?

passages.title: Observing Teamwork
passages.text: Observation in progress.

passages.title: Observing Teamwork
passages.text: Our arrangement allowed me to gather some very useful information. The Observer will be pleased.

passages.title: One Lich's Trash...
passages.text:
It is said that one person's trash, is another's treasure. When it comes to relics, the adage is particularly true.

The House of Rituals is notoriously secretive, which means any knowledge we can glean from them will be all the sweeter.

If we sift through their detritus, I'm sure there are all sorts of treasures we will find.

passages.title: One Lich's Trash...
passages.text: Did you find anything of interest?

passages.title: One Lich's Trash...
passages.text: This is simply marvelous! This will provide some excellent insight into the history of Margrave Sin'dane... and possibly something we can use to our own benefit later on.

passages.title: Mantle of Mastery
passages.text:
You have done much to establish yourself as a promising acolyte. Your superiors have made it known that you are ready to be tested for your ritualist's mantle. 

When you are ready, begin the Ritual of Ancient Summoning to call forth an elder spirit of Maldraxxus. Conquer the spirit, and prove your mettle!

passages.title: Mantle of Mastery
passages.text:
You have proven yourself worthy to don the mantle, acolyte.

Wear it with honor and pride.

passages.title: Volatile Reactions
passages.text:
The living slime within Maldraxxus naturally produces a powerful catalyst used in many of the House of Eyes's poisons. There is always a need for the substance.

It would be of great help if you could retrieve some for us.

passages.title: Volatile Reactions
passages.text: Worry not, despite its appearance the catalyst is not toxic on its own.

passages.title: Volatile Reactions
passages.text: A respectable amount. We will make good use of this.

passages.title: Heavy Lifting
passages.text:
The stronger members of the House of the Chosen tend to take a fairly specific form. No doubt you've seen the larger warriors in the house?

They are the greatest threat in their collective force. Thin them out.

passages.title: Heavy Lifting
passages.text: I must thank you. We are no match for the Chosen when it comes to brute strength.

passages.title: Dire Learning
passages.text:
Necromancers and liches often use powerful tomes to assist in their rituals. Now that the House of Rituals has expanded their reach, the tomes can be found anywhere where their members are active.

Find these books and destroy them. It won't end their vile experiments but it should at least delay them.

passages.title: Dire Learning
passages.text: Good. The House of Rituals will learn not to make enemies of the House of Eyes.

passages.title: Careful Creations
passages.text:
What better way to stop our enemies in their tracks than to use their own experiments against them?

Lucky for us, some of our... friends have left a few samples unattended. And I know just where to test it...

As menacing as they may be, those abominations down there are delicate creations.

It would be a shame if you were to get your hands on some of their equipment and disrupt the process...

passages.title: Careful Creations
passages.text: Everything going as planned?

passages.title: Careful Creations
passages.text:
Hah! That worked better than expected. They'll be busy cleaning up that mess for a while!

Oh, um...

<Darkrider Arly points at your shoulder.>

Still got a little bit on you...

passages.title: Body Count
passages.text:
I am acquainted with a few fleshcrafters who work outside of the House of Constructs. If we can find reagents for them, they can supply our war effort with constructs.

The House of Constructs has plenty of excess body parts. Find them and bring them back here.

passages.title: Body Count
passages.text: We'll take any quality of parts you can find.

passages.title: Body Count
passages.text: I will give these to the fleshcrafters. If we don't have enough soldiers, we will just have to build some.

passages.title: Strange Scourgestones
passages.text:
The Lich King's minions once carried scourgestones given to them by their dark master. 

New ones have been found on the corpses of the undead. We do not know their purpose... but they have been touched by even more sinister magic.

As you slay the Scourge across Icecrown, keep your eyes open for such stones. If you bring them back to me, I shall turn them over to the confessors for study.

passages.title: Strange Scourgestones
passages.text: How goes your slaying of the undead?

passages.title: Strange Scourgestones
passages.text:
I will turn these over to the confessors immediately. There is more to these scourgestones than it seems. 

Perhaps they will grant us more knowledge of the creatures that assail us from the rift in the sky.

If you find any additional scourgestones while you are adventuring, please bring them to me.

passages.title: Boared to Death
passages.text:
The boars around Maldraxxus have a peculiar trait. Their tusks absorb liquid. Depending on where it has been, these bones may contain a powerful compound of poisons or other alchemical rarities.

It takes a trained eye to tell what the bone is made of, so just bring back a large amount of them. From there I will see if any of them are valuable.

passages.title: Boared to Death
passages.text: Take care not to let any of the bones touch your skin for too long. They may cause irritation.

passages.title: Boared to Death
passages.text: A fine amount. There will surely be something useful in this collection.

passages.title: Fair Exchange for a Soul
passages.text:
While we work away here in the Conservatory, we must not forget to support the rest of the covenant.

I am needed here, but you can range far, even though your legs are short. 

Please, help our covenant recover the anima we need. I can then dedicate my time to preparing another spirit for you to restore.

passages.title: Fair Exchange for a Soul
passages.text: Go, find more anima. I shall tend to the spirits while you do.

passages.title: Fair Exchange for a Soul
passages.text:
You continue to serve the conservatory well. For this you have my thanks.

Now you may choose from the spirits I have collected myself for restoration.

passages.title: A Rare and Unusual Spirit
passages.text:
I awaken. I exist once more. And yet...

There is an emptiness within. A lingering tether to a home that no longer exists. So much wonder... so much splendor... lost.

Now I have no purpose. No fate. No path.

Will you teach me of this place, awakener? I sense there is much to be understood. Many secrets. Many truths.

In so doing, perhaps a new fate will emerge.

passages.title: A Rare and Unusual Spirit
passages.text: Return to me when you have the essences from each realm.

passages.title: A Rare and Unusual Spirit
passages.text:
Perhaps a new purpose awaits me.

You have rekindled my curiosity, at least.

passages.title: The Great Vault
passages.text:
"The Purpose." Utter nonsense, of course.

The attendants are so blinded by devotion that you could drop stewards on their heads and say the Purpose told you to do so, and they'd ramble on about it being a mysterious portent of some grand destiny.

Kah-Toll is the most insufferable of all. I've been observing that vault for quite some time, and I assure you it has never opened for anyone.

Of course, if someone COULD open it, I'd pay handsomely to know what's inside.

passages.title: The Great Vault
passages.text: Perhaps I can convince Kah-Toll that the Purpose demands that the attendants should stand on their hands for a week.

passages.title: The Great Vault
passages.text:
So, you succeeded where others, myself included, have failed.

From what I hear, that's the second time a relic of the First Ones responded to your presence.

I must admit, I haven't the slightest idea how you managed it. Interesting. Very interesting indeed.

passages.title: Werk In Progress
passages.text:
We received an... unusual delivery recently. I'm still in a bit of shock.

Some sort of flying contraption released a huge crate just overhead, parachute and all. If it weren't for the wind it would have landed nearby. Instead, it drifted down the hill below.

They left a note too. It would have been lost had it not been wrapped around a sizeable rock.

<Darkrider Arly massages a spot on her forehead.>

I don't know what it is, but if it'll help clear out the area, I'm all for it.

passages.title: Werk In Progress
passages.text: Any luck locating that thing?

passages.title: Werk In Progress
passages.text: I was not expecting that!

passages.title: Delaying Their Efforts
passages.text:
The Scourge continue to replenish their weapons of war from blighted grounds. Stopping their workers slows their production, but a decisive blow to their stockpiles would be far more effective.

Take these and head to the area southeast of here. Plant the bombs, then make a quick exit.

Weakening their supply lines should provide us ample time to retaliate.

passages.title: Delaying Their Efforts
passages.text: Your dedication to the cause is much appreciated, <name>. You have once again put yourself at risk to ensure the safety of our allies.

passages.title: A Touch of Humility
passages.text:
With the Temple of Humility under our control, its power shall flow back into the Crest of Ascension once more.

Join me below so that we may witness it together. Mikanikos has ensured it will become even more magnificent as its power grows.

passages.title: A Touch of Humility
passages.text: The Archon shall convene the Paragons to discuss our next moves. Go in service.

passages.title: Back Again!
passages.text:
Gorgantus just won't give up!

We've defeated her several times already, but the scavengers salvage the body, fix her up and send her right back in here!

She thinks this time she will defeat us... prove her wrong.

passages.title: Back Again!
passages.text: You made that look easy. Let's hope she learned his lesson this time.

passages.title: Frontline Resupply
passages.text:
This forward camp relies heavily on our supply line from the tournament grounds. A recent shipment was attacked while in transit through the valley below us.

Salvage what you can, and if possible, eliminate the threat so this does not happen again.

passages.title: Frontline Resupply
passages.text:
Caught in the frozen wastes, cold and alone... I only hope our allies put up a fight.

<Crusader Renn shakes her head.>

Were you able to salvage any of the shipment?

passages.title: Frontline Resupply
passages.text:
Thank you for your swift action, <name>.

These supplies should see us through to the next shipment.

I will see to it that the bodies of those we lost are recovered and given their last rites.

passages.title: Master of Inner Calm
passages.text:
You have come a long way.

You are almost prepared to access your inner calm anywhere.

Just one more journey under my guidance. 

It is a short one. Peace was here in this garden all along.

One more location of calm to experience.

Then you shall shed your spiritual shackles. 

I shall be proud.

passages.title: Master of Inner Calm
passages.text: That was such a pleasant dream, I am glad to you got to experience the reality.

passages.title: Finding Inner Peace
passages.text:
This is a lovely spot don't you think?

I knew the myths of Ardenweald. 

Even glimpsed it in dream.

Yet it swells with tranquility unimagined. 

Calm is what my kind live for. Even in chaos.

You can always find calm. I can show you if you would like? 

I can sense a nearby convergence of calm. That will provide a suitable demonstration.

passages.title: Finding Inner Peace
passages.text: Do you see now? There is great power in being able to find calm. To be able to center ones self offer solace in even the most turbulent of times.

passages.title: Hyphae Patrol: Heartwood Grove
passages.text:
Those masked fiends have taken over Heartwood Grove, and I mean to stop their plans.

Heartwood Grove was so beautiful before. And now, it's... No matter. We're going to fix this, you and me. Right now.

Come, join me in battle. We'll give those monsters a thrashing that will make their masters think twice before desecrating that sacred place again!

passages.title: Hyphae Patrol: Heartwood Grove
passages.text: Hurry up. I won't stand to let them spend one moment more in that grove.

passages.title: Hyphae Patrol: Heartwood Grove
passages.text: There, it's done. They should be driven back, if only for a while. I appreciate the help.

passages.title: Hyphae Patrol: Gossamer Cliffs
passages.text:
Bad news from the Gossamer Cliffs. We need to help.

The varmints terrorizing the poor silk striders have become more cruel and aggressive lately. The silk striders are important to Ardenweald; more important than almost anyone else knows. We can't lose any more.

Let me know when you're ready to go and we'll scare those gits away for good!

passages.title: Hyphae Patrol: Gossamer Cliffs
passages.text: Quickly! The striders are counting on us!

passages.title: Hyphae Patrol: Gossamer Cliffs
passages.text: The little misses should be safe for now. Their purpose is vital to Ardenweald, and I won't have any more of them dying on my watch!

passages.title: The World Awaits
passages.text: When the sign of the emissary shines in the night sky, the stars strengthen existing bonds and forge new ones. Friendship is still not cheaply won, and deeds will prove loyalty, but trust comes more readily during these days. Venture across these lands, and give aid where you may, to prove your worth.

passages.title: The World Awaits
passages.text: Well done, <name>.

passages.title: A Burning Path Through Time
passages.text: The blazing star shines upon the land, searing the earth and parching the landscape. This star is relentless, malevolent almost. While its influence holds, new paths may open up, to distant places and even distant times. No sage truly understands the nature of this sign, but fortune favors the daring.

passages.title: A Burning Path Through Time
passages.text: Ah, <name>, you have returned. An otherworldly air hangs heavy about you.

passages.title: A Frozen Path Through Time
passages.text: The chill star shines upon the land with its cold light as even the spirits retreat to the shadows. This star is unlike any other in the skies, sapping warmth and life. While its influence holds, new paths may open up, to distant places and even distant times. No sage truly understands the nature of this sign, but fortune favors the daring.

passages.title: A Frozen Path Through Time
passages.text: Ah, <name>, you have returned. An otherworldly air hangs heavy about you.

passages.title: A Shattered Path Through Time
passages.text: The Destroyer's star shines upon the land with its piercing light as even the spirits retreat to the shadows. This star is unlike any other in the skies, laying bare the weaknesses of even the boldest heroes. While its influence holds, new paths may open up, to distant places and even distant times. No sage truly understands the nature of this sign, but fortune favors the daring.

passages.title: A Shattered Path Through Time
passages.text: Ah, <name>, you have returned. An otherworldly air hangs heavy about you.

passages.title: A Shrouded Path Through Time
passages.text: The shrouded star flickers upon the land with its intermittent light ushering in an eerie mist upon the land. This star and the mists bring deep shadows to the land hiding its secrets and dangers. While its influence holds, new paths may open up, to distant places and even distant times. No sage truly understands the nature of this sign, but fortune favors the daring.

passages.title: A Shrouded Path Through Time
passages.text: Ah, <name>, you have returned. An otherworldly air hangs heavy about you.

passages.title: A Savage Path Through Time
passages.text: The brutal star shines upon the land, threatening to trample underfoot all who stand in its path. This star is many things: primal, fierce, and noble. While its influence holds, new paths may open up to distant places and even distant times. No sage truly understands the nature of this sign, but fortune favors the daring.

passages.title: A Savage Path Through Time
passages.text: Ah, <name>, you have returned. An otherworldly air hangs heavy about you.

passages.title: A Call to Battle
passages.text: The favorite star of warlords and generals dominates the sky, offering good fortune to tacticians everywhere. Some say that the battle star hones the instincts of commanders to the point of near-prophecy. If ever you were going to test yourself on the field of battle, now is the time.

passages.title: A Call to Battle
passages.text: I trust your battles went well. And that's not just a turn of phrase. I know they did. I knew they would.

passages.title: Emissary of War
passages.text: When the sign of the warrior shines in the night sky, fortune favors the daring. Powerful foes may yield even greater rewards. Venture deep into caverns and strongholds to prove your worth.

passages.title: Emissary of War
passages.text: Well done, <name>. I knew you could do it.

passages.title: The Arena Calls
passages.text: This alignment of the stars is a dire sign, stirring bloodlust and calling warriors to battle to the death in close quarters. Arena masters turn a tidy profit during these days, likely not understanding why their stands are overflowing. Amidst the excitement, great rewards do await those brave, or foolhardy, enough to venture into the arena....

passages.title: The Arena Calls
passages.text: Well done, <name>. I knew you would do it.

passages.title: Stop the Inquisition
passages.text:
The Lord Chamberlain's inquisitors still torment the poor souls trapped under their care.

You must put a stop to their wicked deeds!

Speak with Archivist Fane, whom you worked with before to defeat an inquisitor, to acquire the sinstone of another inquisitor in the halls.

With their sinstone, you will be able to shatter that inquisitor's defenses and lead the charge to defeat them.

Bring friends, adventurer. Many of the inquisitors are far too dangerous to approach alone.

passages.title: Stop the Inquisition
passages.text: Archivist Fane can help you acquire an inquisitor's sinstone.

passages.title: Stop the Inquisition
passages.text:
<Archivist Janeera does not look up from her scroll as she responds to you.>

Noted and logged.

passages.title: Maw Walker
passages.text:
I believe now it is time for you to leave.

You are a Maw Walker, one who can activate the waystone between the Maw and the lands beyond. While your friends may not hold the same title, there is a way to send them through the gate. 

Souls can be connected. In theory, if you let someone attune themselves to your soul while you activate the waystone, you both should be able to leave. Even fleeting connections may produce some result.

Go with your other two guests and see if my hypothesis is correct.

passages.title: Maw Walker
passages.text: You return in one piece. And with not just Darion, but his father as well. You continue to succeed, Maw Walker.

passages.title: The Threads of Fate
passages.text:
It is my duty to observe the strands of fate. The wondrous possibilities that the Purpose lays before us.

Fate flows around you, mortal. It shifts. It changes. But I have stilled its movements to offer you... a choice.

You may journey through the Shadowlands in the same manner as those who came before you have done.

Or you may choose a different path. One that lets you forge a bond with a covenant now, and move freely through the realms of Death to forge your own destiny.

What say you, mortal?

passages.title: The Threads of Fate
passages.text: Fate is not fickle. Should you accept its offer, there will be no turning back.

passages.title: The Threads of Fate
passages.text: Your choice is made. The Purpose will guide you forward.

passages.title: The Final Pieces
passages.text:
The final components you'll need to acquire are... vessels... rune vessels! Armor to hold the might that will be imbued.

And... powers? No... missives? Yes! Missives will allow your item to enhance your own personal strengths. But they cannot be the same. No, the two must offer different benefits.

All of these can be obtained from souls with the correct crafting knowledge.

And lastly, more of my memories. Memories of the runes, of the powers... of myself.

passages.title: The Final Pieces
passages.text: Have you acquired the remaining items?

passages.title: The Final Pieces
passages.text:
You've collected all the necessary pieces. Now all that's left is to combine them.

Speak with me again when you are ready, and I will create the prize you seek.

passages.title: Bolstering Bastion
passages.text:
You are no aspirant, but I welcome any aid that Oribos might bring us in these dire times.

Please, aid our people in any way you can. With anima in low supply and the insidious Forsworn encroaching from all sides, there is no shortage of trials to overcome.

Do this for us, and I will see to it myself that our almighty Archon hears of your deeds in service of the kyrian. Mark well my words, and follow the path.

passages.title: Bolstering Bastion
passages.text:
Word has spread across Bastion of your deeds since your arrival here.

You have proven yourself a worthy ally of the kyrian. Take this gift in thanks, and go in service.

May we cross paths again soon.

passages.title: Rallying Maldraxxus
passages.text:
We need all the help we can get! It's taking all we have to hold our ground against the other houses, let alone gain any ground against them.

Truth be told, your blade will be welcome anywhere. There are no shortage of battles to be won, foes to be toppled, or weary soldiers to be relieved.

Help us regain control of Maldraxxus, and in the name of the Primus I will see you are amply rewarded.

passages.title: Rallying Maldraxxus
passages.text:
All who have reported back to me have said the same--you have brought victory upon victory to the House of the Chosen!

On behalf of all who serve the Primus, you have my eternal gratitude.

passages.title: Support the Court
passages.text:
Groves are under attack everywhere! There simply aren't enough of us to protect them all!

You just might be our only hope.

We must restore order, or more precious souls will be lost to us. Please, help anyone you can, anywhere you can. My heart cannot bear to see any more pain!

I'll make sure the Winter Queen hears of your deeds, don't you worry!

passages.title: Support the Court
passages.text:
You have done a great service to not only Ardenweald, but the countless nature spirits we protect.

Thank you. Today you are a hero of Ardenweald!

passages.title: Reinforcing Revendreth
passages.text:
Denathrius must be stopped at all costs. However, we've no hope of taking him out while his forces still control much of Revendreth.

If you are here to aid us, then there is no shortage of work to be done. Disposing of my father's many allies being chief among that work, of course, but any aid you can provide will be of use.

There is too much at stake for all the Shadowlands if we fail. I will see to it that you are handsomely rewarded for your efforts.

passages.title: Reinforcing Revendreth
passages.text:
You have my sincere gratitude for aiding our cause. Together we will see Denathrius's hold on our realm broken, and with it win the freedom of my people.

I cannot offer as much as I would like, but I hope it will suffice until our victory is achieved.

passages.title: It's All Coming Together
passages.text:
Our brothers and sisters are spread thin fighting the Forsworn, maintaining order among aspirants waiting to ascend, and countless other duties.

The willing souls you recovered from the Maw will be a great boon to our capabilities in these dire times.

Go to Haephus at once--he has long been searching for aid in activating some of our sanctum's most powerful features. It is time we saw Elysian Hold brought to its full potential.

passages.title: It's All Coming Together
passages.text: I could feel their presence as soon as you brought them to the hold. What a momentous occasion!

passages.title: Enhancing the Hold
passages.text:
As thanks for your efforts in recovering the anima and souls we now have available, you may decide which of Elysian Hold's features we upgrade first.

Once active, it shall expand our capabilities to help not only Bastion, but all the Shadowlands.

Do not worry--as you continue to recover anima and willing souls we will activate them all in time. For now, a single upgrade must suffice.

passages.title: Enhancing the Hold
passages.text: Take your time. The first step on the path is always the most difficult.

passages.title: Enhancing the Hold
passages.text: A wise decision. It will take some time to activate, but all good things are worth waiting for, are they not?

passages.title: Signs of the Lion
passages.text:
Thanks to your efforts, Thrall, Jaina Proudmoore, and Baine Bloodhoof are safe. Yet so long as the Jailer holds any hero of Azeroth, I fear he has power over us all.

It seems Anduin has been taken deeper into the tower than the others. Before I risk peering inside, you must make one last attempt to find him.

You say the Jailer spoke of honing a weapon. I fear we are running out of time.

Do not relent, <name>. Search the twisting corridors of Torghast for any sign of the Young Lion.

passages.title: Signs of the Lion
passages.text: Did you find any sign of Anduin?

passages.title: Signs of the Lion
passages.text:
Three sure signs of Anduin's presence, yet no sign of him.

This is dire news indeed.

passages.title: Return to Draka
passages.text:
Baine suffers within Torghast, but at least we know that he yet lives.

Rushing to his rescue would prove disastrous without a plan of attack. I will do what I can to prepare one.

In the meantime, you received a summons from Baroness Draka asking that you return to the Seat of the Primus.

The Necrolords are the key to saving the Shadowlands, <name>. I suggest you return to them as soon as you are able.

passages.title: Return to Draka
passages.text:
You have returned, Maw Walker. 

Good. We have much to do.

passages.title: Bringing It All Together
passages.text:
With all of the houses against us, our forces are hard pressed to hold the line.

The souls you rescued from the Maw will help strengthen our position and bolster our defenses.

Bring them to Arkadia Moa. She will know how best to put them to use and empower our sanctum.

passages.title: Bringing It All Together
passages.text: I could feel the presence of those souls as soon as you brought them here. Their potential will increase our power!

passages.title: Return Lost Souls
passages.text:
Souls continue to pour into the Maw. As long as this is still happening, we need to save as many as possible!

The Jailer twists the cycle of life and rebirth. This cannot be allowed to continue! We must thwart his plans.

Return to the Maw and rescue those that you can.

passages.title: Return Lost Souls
passages.text: Were you able to save anyone?

passages.title: Return Lost Souls
passages.text:
Oh, wonderful news!

I will make sure these souls are well taken care of here in Ardenweald.

passages.title: Return Lost Souls
passages.text:
Souls continue to pour into the Maw, circumventing the natural order of the Shadowlands.

The Jailer denies these souls their rightful eternities. Only you, Maw Walker, can set things right.

Return to the Maw and save all that you can.

passages.title: Return Lost Souls
passages.text: There is no fate worse than the Maw.

passages.title: Return Lost Souls
passages.text: Well done. They have been spared a truly cruel existence.

passages.title: Return Lost Souls
passages.text:
Maw Walker, I'm sure you've seen firsthand the souls that continue to pour into the Maw. 

We must act now to cut off the Jailer's power, denying him as many souls as possible. That power belongs to the Necrolords.

I shall direct your efforts to save these souls, and help find them a place among the armies of Maldraxxus.

Return to the Maw and rescue those that you can.

passages.title: Return Lost Souls
passages.text: There is no fate worse than the Maw.

passages.title: Return Lost Souls
passages.text: Excellent, Maw Walker. Our armies here will grow stronger with each soul you return.

passages.title: Return Lost Souls
passages.text:
Souls continue to pour into the Maw. 

Their anima, our very lifeblood of the Shadowlands, is going with those souls to fuel the Jailer. You rescued me from the Maw. I see no reason you cannot pull more souls from that abyss. 

Bring souls you rescue from the Maw to me and I shall see them put to better use. At least in Revendreth they have a chance of redemption.

passages.title: Return Lost Souls
passages.text:
A very good collection of souls. Not too broken, not too drained, and not too innocent.

Never fear. Their fate is better in our hands than the Jailer's.

passages.title: Souls for Sinfall
passages.text:
Baine suffers within Torghast, but at least we know that he yet lives.

Rushing to his rescue would prove disastrous without a plan of attack. I will see to preparing one.

In the meantime, I suggest you bring the souls you rescued back to Sinfall. 

Denathrius's machinations have left the venthyr poorly provisioned, and Prince Renathal will require all the souls he can muster.

passages.title: Souls for Sinfall
passages.text:
Ah, so you were successful. As I knew you would be.

Now, let us put these souls to use.

passages.title: Against Overwhelming Odds
passages.text:
Your eternal enemy, the Horde, grow in strength and number throughout the Shadowlands.
