Will you and your comrades simply roll over and yield to their might? 

No, I expect not. It seems that not even death has quelled your thirst for battle. 

If you succeed in cutting down your foes, despite the odds, I will reward you handsomely.

passages.title: Against Overwhelming Odds
passages.text: Well done, <class>. Well done indeed.

passages.title: Strengthening the Bond
passages.text:
Do you feel it, too? Our connection is stronger than I imagined could be possible. 

I have been told that the bond will continue to grow over time, though we do have the ability to accelerate the process. 

Sinfall needs our strength. Perhaps it is best we engage in this method now.

passages.title: Strengthening the Bond
passages.text: This will benefit us both.

passages.title: Strengthening the Bond
passages.text: We will accomplish much together.

passages.title: Our True Purpose
passages.text:
We are grateful for this partnership, Maw Walker. 

With your help, Renathal will lead us into a new era, one that will see Revendreth reclaim its true purpose. 

Return to him now so that the real work can begin.

passages.title: Our True Purpose
passages.text: I hope you've found everything to your liking.

passages.title: Explore Torghast
passages.text:
Baine is safe, but our other allies are still prisoners of the Jailer. They remain in grave peril.

Torghast is a constantly changing place, shifting according to the will of its master. It may be impossible to track them through normal means.

Enter its cell blocks and see what information you can find. Seek any clue that might lead us to our missing friends, and bring it back to me.

passages.title: Explore Torghast
passages.text: What did you find?

passages.title: Explore Torghast
passages.text:
<Bolvar studies the object intently.>

I sense a familiar essence. The holder of this key may have been involved in the capture of Jaina Proudmoore.

I require time for further research. I will contact you once I determine our next course.

passages.title: Finding a Witness
passages.text:
You have rescued two of our allies from Torghast, but Anduin and Thrall have yet to be found.

That tower's corridors are vast... seemingly endless. You could spend an eternity wandering those unholy halls.

In your expeditions, you have encountered many unfortunate prisoners. Perhaps one of them has seen or heard something that could guide our search.

Seek out any captives that might have the information we need, <name>.

passages.title: Finding a Witness
passages.text:
I am heartened to know that Thrall yet lives. By the Light, we will find him.

I fear for Anduin. Darkness hungers for his soul.

We must make ready. You will hear from me when it is time to proceed.

passages.title: Guaranteed Delivery
passages.text:
<The broker appears to be from Cartel Ve. Perhaps they were once an associate of Ve'nari.

Clutched in their hand is a list of items and a containment orb.

Finishing this broker's task and sending the items back to Ve'nari will surely earn you some compensation.>

passages.title: Guaranteed Delivery
passages.text:
Excellent, <name>. I wondered what had become of that particular associate. 

It pleases me to know that their demise was not a complete loss.

passages.title: A Monument to Vengeance
passages.text:
<Corpses of Ebon Blade knights litter the Crucible of the Damned, displaying the aftermath of your first foray into this desolate place.

Their sacrifice should not be forgotten.>

passages.title: A Monument to Vengeance
passages.text:
<This precipice is highly visible throughout the Maw. 

Building the monument here will surely draw the Jailer's ire.>

passages.title: A Monument to Vengeance
passages.text:
<The Ebon Blade monument radiates with energy from the fallen knights' runeblades.

It is a small tribute to their sacrifice, but it will have to do.>

passages.title: Guaranteed Delivery
passages.text:
<The broker appears to be from Cartel Ve. Perhaps they were once an associate of Ve'nari.

Clutched in their hand is a list of items and a containment orb.

Finishing this broker's task and sending the items back to Ve'nari will surely earn you some compensation.>

passages.title: Guaranteed Delivery
passages.text:
Excellent, <name>. I wondered what had become of that particular associate. 

It pleases me to know that their demise was not a complete loss.

passages.title: Feed Your Soul
passages.text:
They... drained my anima... to fuel their ritual...

Souls of great power are brought here... to this altar... and sacrificed to conjure unspeakable horrors bound to the Jailer.

I was powerful once... Imbue me with the anima they stole... and I can be powerful again.

Then, together... we will destroy the one who leads their efforts.

passages.title: Feed Your Soul
passages.text: Quite the tale, <name>. Few motivations are as potent as revenge.

passages.title: At a Moment's Notice
passages.text:
No longer must you take a larion across Bastion, Maw Walker.

With our gateways active once more, you shall enjoy instantaneous travel wherever you are needed.

Do note that you must still utilize a larion to return to Oribos or travel to the other realms.

Give it a try and see for yourself.

passages.title: At a Moment's Notice
passages.text: It really is amazing, is it not?

passages.title: At a Moment's Notice
passages.text: In time we may open new destinations for our gateways. Haephus can direct you further.

passages.title: Torment for the Taking
passages.text:
<A broker device has been abandoned here. It seems like it was being used to siphon energy from rifts of soul energy that have erupted in the area.

The brokers surely would not have sought to harness this energy if it didn't have a use. Perhaps you should finish what they started.>

passages.title: Torment for the Taking
passages.text:
You've found my siphoner. You are just full of surprises, Maw Walker.

The unique way that pain and suffering manifests physically in the Maw is a mystery... one which this energy you've collected may help unravel. 

Well done.

passages.title: What They Know
passages.text:
<It looks like this broker was gathering information before he met his unfortunate end. Ve'nari would likely be very interested in what he found.

Unfortunately, his notes look to have been scattered far and wide by the local beasts.>

passages.title: What They Know
passages.text: That book... that is a pathfinder's journal you carry!

passages.title: What They Know
passages.text:
It would seem that Cartel Ve has not given up their pursuit of the Maw.

You did well to bring me this pathfinder's journal. Whatever the cartel has learned about this place will surely serve us better than it would a corpse.

passages.title: Acquisition: Stygic Ore
passages.text:
<The rock columns in this area are teeming with veins of a glowing, otherworldly metal. 

The Mawsworn have employed souls to mine it, but it looks like they didn't last long.

Ve'nari could certainly find use for some of this ore, if you can manage to mine it.>

passages.title: Acquisition: Stygic Ore
passages.text: What do you carry, Maw Walker?

passages.title: Acquisition: Stygic Ore
passages.text:
Fascinating, the metal here seems to be fabricated entirely of stygia!

There is much I can do with this. Take this reward, with my thanks.

passages.title: A Shadowed Fate
passages.text:
The Mawsworn... torture and torment souls within Ruin's Cradle.

I... barely escaped, but I'm afraid I won't last long.

Their twisted rituals... breaking souls to serve as wretched shades. 

Spare them this fate!

passages.title: A Shadowed Fate
passages.text:
You have... saved these souls from a terrible fate.

Even a... true end... cannot be worse than this torment...

passages.title: Path of Ascension: Artemede's Challenge
passages.text:
Are you prepared for a challenge, <name>?

It seems Pelagos has been struggling with his trials. I believe, with your guidance, some extra training on the Path is just what he needs!

Athanos has many lessons to teach. With your aid, Pelagos can achieve victory and new experience to meditate on.

passages.title: Path of Ascension: Artemede's Challenge
passages.text: I knew you would rise to the challenge. Well done.

passages.title: Path of Ascension: Artemede's Challenge
passages.text:
Are you prepared for a challenge, <name>?

Pelagos's time spent in Ardenweald taught him many lessons. I would like to witness what he has learned.

A trial against Nuuminuuru should allow him this chance. With your aid, Pelagos can achieve victory and new experience to meditate on.

passages.title: Path of Ascension: Artemede's Challenge
passages.text: Are you up for the challenge?

passages.title: Path of Ascension: Artemede's Challenge
passages.text: I knew you would rise to the challenge. Well done.

passages.title: Path of Ascension: Artemede's Challenge
passages.text:
Are you prepared for a challenge, <name>?

Mikanikos has requested an additional trial to train Bron. Splinterbark Nightmare's memory was captured with the help of his praetors, and should prove a worthy challenge for his goliath.

With your guidance, Mikanikos and Bron can overcome another trial.

passages.title: Path of Ascension: Artemede's Challenge
passages.text: I knew you would rise to the challenge. Well done.

passages.title: Path of Ascension: Artemede's Challenge
passages.text:
Are you prepared for a challenge, <name>?

Kleia is ready for another challenge. She is hungry to get back to the Path so she may exercise her new abilities further.

Echthra's memory shall provide her with new lessons. With your aid, Kleia can overcome this challenge and incorporate its lessons into her eternal training.

passages.title: Path of Ascension: Artemede's Challenge
passages.text: Are you up for the challenge?

passages.title: Path of Ascension: Artemede's Challenge
passages.text: I knew you would rise to the challenge. Well done.

passages.title: Path of Ascension: Artemede's Challenge
passages.text:
Are you prepared for a challenge, <name>?

Kleia is ready for another challenge. She is hungry to get back to the Path so she may exercise her new abilities further.

If she is to bear souls across the veil, she will need be prepared to contend against devourers like Azaruux. With your aid, Kleia can overcome this challenge and incorporate its lessons into her eternal training.

passages.title: Path of Ascension: Artemede's Challenge
passages.text: I knew you would rise to the challenge. Well done.

passages.title: Path of Ascension: Artemede's Challenge
passages.text:
Are you prepared for a challenge, <name>?

Mikanikos has requested an additional trial to train Bron. Mad Mortimer's memory should prove a good challenge, as he and Mikanikos share a mind with a passion to further their research.

With your guidance, Mikanikos and Bron can overcome another trial.

passages.title: Path of Ascension: Artemede's Challenge
passages.text: I knew you would rise to the challenge. Well done.

passages.title: Path of Ascension: Artemede's Challenge
passages.text:
Are you prepared for a challenge, <name>?

Though most kyrian have their preferences, every kyrian must learn to fight with a multitude of weapons and equipment. This allows them to keep both their minds sharp and their muscles and movements honed.

Let us see how your soulbinds fare against the memory of Craven Corinth while utilizing the Ring of Warding.

passages.title: Path of Ascension: Artemede's Challenge
passages.text: I knew you would rise to the challenge. Well done.

passages.title: Path of Ascension: Artemede's Challenge
passages.text:
Are you prepared for a challenge, <name>?

Though most kyrian have their preferences, every kyrian must learn to fight with a multitude of weapons and equipment. This allows them to keep both their minds sharp and their muscles and movements honed.

Let us see how your soulbinds fare against the memory of Kalisthene while utilizing the Spiritforged Aegis.

passages.title: Path of Ascension: Artemede's Challenge
passages.text: Are you up for the challenge?

passages.title: Path of Ascension: Artemede's Challenge
passages.text: I knew you would rise to the challenge. Well done.

passages.title: Soulless Husks
passages.text:
Some of the Mawsworn begin as inanimate suits of armor, forged by the stygian smiths of Zovaal's Cauldron. Once fashioned, they await infusion of a decrepit shade to complete their genesis.

It is at this time they are the most vulnerable, and so it is then you should strike.

The hammers wielded by the Mawsworn runesmiths hold the power to break as well as they shape. Procure one of them and smash our foes to dust before they can rise against us.

passages.title: Soulless Husks
passages.text: Have you satisfactorily dismantled our enemies?

passages.title: Soulless Husks
passages.text:
Satisfying, is it not?

The fewer Mawsworn to rise into the Jailer's ranks, the better for our continued existence.

passages.title: The Next Step
passages.text:
Your efforts have not gone unnoticed, but there are other realms that still require your aid.

Consider the next step in your journey, mortal.

passages.title: The Next Step
passages.text: A wise decision. See to it that they receive your aid swiftly.

passages.title: Furthering the Purpose
passages.text:
There are realms which still require your aid, mortal.

You must journey to one of their realms and ensure they stand strong.

Where will you go next?

passages.title: Furthering the Purpose
passages.text: May your efforts prove fruitful.

passages.title: The Last Step
passages.text:
Just one realm remains which requires your aid, mortal.

Speak with me when you are ready, and I shall inform you further.

Such is the Purpose.

passages.title: The Last Step
passages.text: Good luck.

passages.title: Blood Knight
passages.text:
The power of the ranseur has been spent, but we are victorious! With Vorath defeated, perhaps the Scourge will be more easily dealt with--thanks to you.

Meet me back in Silvermoon. Your efforts and heroism today will not go unrecognized.

passages.title: Blood Knight
passages.text: Congratulations, and well earned.

passages.title: Necrolord Assault
passages.text:
The Jailer's forces have been caught off guard by our attack. We shall overrun Perdition Hold and defeat his champions at the Altar of Domination!

Your help is needed Maw Walker. Assist our forces on the battlefield!

passages.title: A Paladin's Soul
passages.text:
Bolvar Fordragon has seen visions of a vault hidden deep within Torghast where the Jailer keeps souls he deems valuable.

Uther was struck down by a mourneblade. When such a weapon is wielded with rage, it can shatter a soul into fragments.

If the Jailer holds a part of Uther's soul, it cannot be fully mended until the lost piece is restored.

Take this attuned shard to Torghast, adventurer. It should guide you to the vault's location.

Find the lost fragment of Uther's soul so that he can be made whole.

passages.title: A Paladin's Soul
passages.text: Greetings Maw Walker. Your arrival is fortuitous.

passages.title: A Paladin's Soul
passages.text: I believe this soul fragment may be the key to Uther's recovery.

passages.title: Blind Loyalty
passages.text:
The path forward for the kyrian is clear to me now.

First we will speak with Nikolon. I urge you to stay and listen.

Afterward, we must return to Elysian Hold.

There I will request an audience with the Archon, and I need you all by my side as I do so.

passages.title: Blind Loyalty
passages.text: The kyrian must forge a new path.

passages.title: Blind Loyalty
passages.text:
<Adrestes bows his head deeply.>

It is an honor. But we have only just begun.

passages.title: The Grand Reception
passages.text:
<name>, you have aided the kyrian in the most trying of times. Your devotion to our cause has helped usher in a new beginning for all of us.

We would be honored if you would join us for a gathering prior to the ceremony. Many members of our covenant wish to express their appreciation for all you have done.

This is a day of great joy. I am so pleased that you are here to witness it!

passages.title: The Grand Reception
passages.text: The time of ceremony has come.

passages.title: The New Path
passages.text:
Today, a new paragon is anointed. And for the first time since the dawn of our realm, a temple is rededicated to represent our devotion to one another.

A new paragon, a new sigil, and a new path for all kyrian.

This ceremony shall be glorious indeed!

passages.title: The New Path
passages.text:
This honor is more than I could have hoped.

There is a long road ahead, but with the help of my fellow kyrian--all kyrian--the Temple of Devotion will embody the future of our people.

Let the true work begin.

passages.title: Clearing the Walls
passages.text:
<This scroll shows the locations of a series of pylons, that protect Perdition Hold from assault.

Destroying these Pylons could aid in the success of our attack>

passages.title: Clearing the Walls
passages.text: Have you cleared the walls?

passages.title: Clearing the Walls
passages.text: The defenses are broken! Most excellent, Maw Walker.

passages.title: Hooking Over
passages.text:
I've made some solid hookshots and grapple points. Don't worry--if they hold my weight, they'll hold yours!

They can get us across the chasm to the next anima conduit.

I'll go on ahead and wait for you. No telling what might be lurking over there.

The sooner we get the anima conduit working, the sooner we get into the vault and claim the Primus's sigil.

passages.title: Hooking Over
passages.text:
What a ride! Keep that hookshot.

Just be careful using it. That thing will chew through any normal grapple points.

passages.title: The Primus Returns
passages.text:
The Jailer has four of the five sigils required for what he is planning.

He is a fool for allowing us to live. His desire to see us bend to his will shall be his undoing.

All is not lost, if you are willing to put in the work. There is still something that can be done.

Come. I will meet with the rest of your forces and formulate our next attack.

passages.title: The Primus Returns
passages.text:
We can dwell on our past mistakes when this is over. For now, we must move forward.

You aided me during my imprisonment as the Runecarver. Take this as a token of my gratitude.

passages.title: The Caged Bird
passages.text:
Remain quiet. We must not attract attention.

Many of my sisters have already been lost. It will soon be my turn to perish in that witch's vile ritual.

Release me from this cage and I can see us both to safety. Keeper Odyn must be warned of this foul betrayal!

The Mawsworn called Kjellrun holds the seal that can free me. You can find her gloating in the nearby hall.

passages.title: The Caged Bird
passages.text: This is no fate for a Val'kyr!

passages.title: The Caged Bird
passages.text: I will tell the tale of your noble deeds, <name>. Your actions this day will be remembered.

passages.title: You and What Army
passages.text:
The Jailer has dispatched a force of elite troops to strike our rear lines. Their attack threatens our whole assault! 

I need you and one other soldier to eliminate these enemies. A volunteer from each of the five houses of Maldraxxus has requested to assist you, <name>.

Pick one and give them the honor of serving alongside you.

passages.title: You and What Army
passages.text: Victory will be ours, Maw Walker!

passages.title: An Embarrassment of Corpses
passages.text:
Look around us, adventurer. Everywhere you turn there are corpses piling up like mountains. These disembodied souls are desperate to return to battle.

We will use their fervor to turn the tide.

Rally the disembodied souls around the battlefield and bring them to my stitchers at the corpse piles to build them new bodies!

passages.title: An Embarrassment of Corpses
passages.text: Find the disembodied souls and bring them to my stitchers!

passages.title: An Embarrassment of Corpses
passages.text: The work of a Maldraxxian soldier is never complete!

passages.title: Cryptograms and Keys
passages.text:
The repositories of knowledge within Korthia have layers of security--for very good reasons.

Each vault requires cryptographs in order to decode and disable the barriers. They are, for lack of a better term, the keys to every secret.

Search outside the Vault for cryptographs stolen by the Mawsworn and return them to me. I will keep them, and the secrets they protect, safe.

passages.title: Cryptograms and Keys
passages.text: We cannot allow the Jailer to raid the Vaults of Korthia.

passages.title: Cryptograms and Keys
passages.text: I am deeply grateful for your service in keeping our secrets from the Jailer.

passages.title: Anima Reclamation
passages.text:
Our efforts here need a constant supply of troops, supplies, and anima. The last one is the hardest, for obvious reasons. But I've learned to be resourceful. 

Nearby there is a plentiful source of anima: the devourers that currently swarm the Sanctuary of Guidance. It's not as easy as beating it out of a soul, but it's just as effective, if you're strong enough. Are you?

passages.title: Anima Reclamation
passages.text: Every drop of anima we reclaim is a potential weapon against the Jailer.

passages.title: Anima Reclamation
passages.text: You can trust me with this anima. I will see it is turned against the Jailer and his forces.

passages.title: Sweep the Windswept Aerie
passages.text:
The skies over Korthia are a dangerous place.

Not only do the Mawsworn threaten our forces; the native creatures are also openly hostile. We must keep the skies safe for our own winged allies and beasts.

The source of the native flyers is the Windswept Aerie. Go there and clear the aerie of aggressive creatures.

Then, we shall have aerial supremacy.

passages.title: Sweep the Windswept Aerie
passages.text: Excellent work, Maw Walker. With the Windswept Aerie under control, our flyers stand a chance of ruling the skies.

passages.title: Broker's Bounty: Hungering Behemoth
passages.text:
New lands bring new opportunity. We will provide a quantity of valuables to any interested party in return for a substantial amount of devourer blood, preferably the goliath kind.

Faint-hearted collectors need not bother.

Please bring this sample to Ta'nasi in Keeper's Respite.

passages.title: Broker's Bounty: Hungering Behemoth
passages.text: Have something to trade?

passages.title: Broker's Bounty: Hungering Behemoth
passages.text:
<Ta'nasi holds the sample up to the sky.>

An excellent specimen. This will do nicely.

As promised, here is your reward in trade.

passages.title: A Hate-Hate Relationship
passages.text:
When the first of my sisters went missing, we were concerned. Those sent to find her did not return. Nor did the next.

What we have discovered is a dreadful betrayal by someone we once trusted.

Come, we must tell Odyn what we have witnessed in the Maw.

His wrath will be great.

passages.title: A Hate-Hate Relationship
passages.text: I do not fault the messenger, <name>.

passages.title: A Hate-Hate Relationship
passages.text: Helya has gone too far!

passages.title: Night Fae Assault
passages.text:
The Jailer's forces have been caught off guard by our attack. We shall overrun Perdition Hold and defeat his champions at the Altar of Domination!

We need your help Maw Walker. Assist our forces on the battlefield!

passages.title: Kyrian Assault
passages.text:
The Jailer's forces have been caught off guard by our attack. We shall overrun Perdition Hold and defeat his champions at the Altar of Domination!

Your help is needed Maw Walker. Assist our forces on the battlefield!

passages.title: Wrath of the Party Herald
passages.text:
Oh, you're back so soon, adventurer!

...Or have we not already met? It is difficult to remember at times...

Regardless, I trust you are making progress with Cryptkeeper Kassir's plan to weaken our adversaries.

Details of the plan escape me, but I am certain Temel was involved. I hear he fancies himself a "party herald" nowadays...

<The Curator looks beyond you for a moment.>

"Party herald"... I must have been gone from Revendreth for longer than I thought.

passages.title: Wrath of the Party Herald
passages.text: You can find Temel on the ramparts near the Curator.

passages.title: Wrath of the Party Herald
passages.text: Ha! I presume the Jailer had never considering planning for a party herald's attack.

passages.title: Duelist's Challenge
passages.text:
<Nadjia continues to parry attacks from enemy Mawsworn while she turns to face you.>

As you can see, we have our hands full here on the barricade.

I will hold the line while you challenge the champions of the Mawsworn army.

Defeat them in full view of their underlings.

No mercy, adventurer. Demoralize them.

passages.title: Duelist's Challenge
passages.text: Boot the Beaut can throw you up to the ramparts if needed.

passages.title: Duelist's Challenge
passages.text:
Nadjia single-handedly held off an entire platoon of Mawsworn while the dredgers established our base.

Even General Draven was impressed.

passages.title: If Even One is Worthy
passages.text:
I have seen firsthand that worthy souls have been unjustly cast into the Maw.

Gresit here was almost cast in himself by the Lord Chamberlain's minion. He has more than proven himself under my care.

Look among the souls that the Jailer's filth have deemed "unworthy". Inspect each to confirm that they deserve their fate.

Even if we examine every soul in the Tremaculum and find only a single worthy one to bring back to Revendreth, it will still be valuable.

passages.title: If Even One is Worthy
passages.text:
Even in the depths of the Maw, the Accuser remains focused on saving any soul she can...

Her devotion to Revendreth's true purpose continues to inspire me.

passages.title: The Skyhunt
passages.text:
Boot the Beaut and the other large dredgers are being hit hard from air assaults.

The dredgers may not be able to reach them, but the Wild Hunt can reach any prey.

Take my spear and use it to ground the Mawsworn in the sky above the western bridge.

Once they are grounded, they will be easy to dispatch.

My trappers will help slow them down for you.

passages.title: The Skyhunt
passages.text: The Mawsworn flyers appear to be focusing their attention on the western bridge.

passages.title: The Skyhunt
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. Our biggun dredgers are critical to troop movement in the area.

passages.title: The Chosen Few
passages.text:
I have need of more val'kyr to join Danica in the battle to come. <name>, you are granted the honor of choosing the most worthy.

The strongest will present themselves in challenge at the Circle of Glory. Fight hard, <class>, and do honor to your weapons.

passages.title: The Chosen Few
passages.text: Have the worthy been selected?

passages.title: The Chosen Few
passages.text: Well fought. Kolfinna, Dryfinna, and Aeskir have risen to the challenge and await you in Odyn's hall.

passages.title: Wrath of Odyn
passages.text:
The horn has been forged and the worthy have been selected.

Now, <name>, we have only to bind my chosen val'kyr to the horn and infuse them with my power that they may strike with my fury.

Come, bear witness.

passages.title: Wrath of Odyn
passages.text: Yes? Did you have a question?

passages.title: Wrath of Odyn
passages.text: It is done. Danica and her sisters are infused with my power and wield my wrath.

passages.title: Hearing Aid
passages.text:
How fortuitous! You just happened to be transferred to a location in which I have a certain... interest. Place the aural sequencers I gave you and I will attempt to establish a functional signal.

Such a perilous location will require the utmost discretion. You will want to use your ethereal cloak to avoid being seen.

passages.title: Hearing Aid
passages.text:
Perfect. Their secrets will soon be mine.

Pardon me. I meant to say "ours."

passages.title: Talisman of the Eternal Scholar
passages.text:
<The talisman is dented and spattered with muck. Whoever stashed this here handled it roughly.

Archivist Roh-Suir has a spot for this talisman in the Reliquary of Remembrance.>

passages.title: Talisman of the Eternal Scholar
passages.text:
Where... where did you find this?

<The Archivist brings the talisman closer for inspection.>

 I haven't seen this in eons. I thought it had been lost.

passages.title: Beginning the Collection
passages.text:
Let us continue our work by retrieving the most important item of any scholarly study--the lost codex.

It will take some time, but as we continue our work the pages of this work will continue to grow and flourish, just as Korthia has itself for eons.

As for its location, it previously resided deep within the underbelly of Korthia itself inside the Cavern of Contemplation to the south.

We can only hope the Jailer's forces have yet to locate it.

passages.title: Beginning the Collection
passages.text: Have you found the codex? I hope we're not too late.

passages.title: Beginning the Collection
passages.text:
Yes, yes. This is it. Magnificent, don't you agree?

<The damp codex catches The Archivist by surprise. He gently runs his hand along the binding, muttering an incantation in a soft, enigmatic tone.>

That should help preserve it for now, but the incantation won't last. We must get to work.

passages.title: Anger Management
passages.text:
I am no musician, though I've spent many an hour enjoying the entertainment in Tazavesh.

Giving this horn a voice will require the harvest of strong emotions.

Anger seethes unrestrained within the damned unfortunates consigned to the River of Souls. Use this siphoning device to drain the rage of these furious shades into your instrument.

The shrieks of fury that you acquire should allow you to pierce the Maw and reach your allies.

The tune, I suspect, will not be a popular one.

passages.title: Anger Management
passages.text: The instrument's voice will not be pleasing to most ears, but I believe it will serve its purpose.

passages.title: Diviner's Rune Chits
passages.text:
<Inside the pouch is a single rune chit. It rotates and flips as if moved by an unseen hand.

Runes vaguely reminiscent of the Vrykul language are delicately carved into the stone. On the back of the chit is an indication that it is part of a set.>

passages.title: Diviner's Rune Chits
passages.text: Goodness, is that a pouch of rune chits? How many do you have?

passages.title: Diviner's Rune Chits
passages.text:
You have acquired a complete set of Diviner's Rune Chits!

This was one of the first relics that I studied as an acolyte scholar. If you cast the chits, the resulting scatter and orientation will answer any question you ask of them, though it takes experience and a good deal of intuition to interpret their meaning.

I never expected to see a complete set again.

passages.title: Book of Binding: The Mad Witch
passages.text:
<You hear a muffled voice speaking from within this book, interspersed with crackling static. Though the utterances are mostly unintelligible, you can make out the repeated request to recover crimson pages.

Flipping through the volume, you note that many of its pages are missing.

If the pages were retrieved, the book could be returned to the Archivist and reassembled.>

passages.title: Book of Binding: The Mad Witch
passages.text: Is that book... speaking?

passages.title: Book of Binding: The Mad Witch
passages.text:
Scholars at the Seeker's Quorum were researching this tome.

It appears as though it was a fellow scholar, not mawsworn or wildlife, that tore it apart. This is troubling. 

For our safety, I will stitch all but one missing page back into the binding before I add this to the archive. Until we know more about this relic, we cannot risk restoring it entirely.

passages.title: Focusing the Eye
passages.text:
The combination of grief and rage you have harvested is sufficient for your needs. Most likely. 

If you insist on seeing this ill-advised endeavor through, use the horn at the Terminus Platform, where the River of Souls flows upward to Torghast. The energies there are most potent indeed.

The presence of your golden allies should draw the Jailer's Eye. I only hope this does not prove to be the end of you. I hate to see an investment wasted.

passages.title: Focusing the Eye
passages.text: Songs will immortalize the deeds of this day, <name>.

passages.title: Storming the Sanctum
passages.text:
The Jailer has seized the sigils of all four covenants. It is clear he means to escape the Maw and steal the Arbiter's sigil from Oribos.

We cannot allow this to happen.

Atop Torghast sits the Sanctum of Domination, the Jailer's seat of power. The time has come to enter this dark domain.

No doubt Sylvanas Windrunner will command the forces that will attempt to thwart us. We must defeat her... and save Anduin Wrynn from her grasp.

Gather your forces, <name>. The Ebon Blade will stand with you.

passages.title: Storming the Sanctum
passages.text: How fares the battle in the Sanctum?

passages.title: Storming the Sanctum
passages.text:
The Jailer has what he wanted... along with Anduin at his side.

Our only victory--if you can call it that--is that we have Sylvanas in custody.

I pray she possesses knowledge that can give us an edge to stop whatever the Jailer is planning next.

passages.title: Bulwark of Divine Intent
passages.text:
<Your familiarity with the Archivists' Codex confirms that this is one of the missing relics.

Archivist Roh-Suir has a spot for this shield in the Reliquary of Remembrance.>

passages.title: Bulwark of Divine Intent
passages.text:
This shield is from the afterlife we refer to informally as the Inn of Forever.

When one's spirit reaches the Inn, they hang up their arms. This shield was forever retired as its owner went to join the eternal fireside festivities. It would not quite be correct to say that the shield is imbued with their sense of duty and selflessness... it IS these concepts.

I am curious whether this shield could be used in the field. The results of that testing would be fascinating. Perhaps someday...

passages.title: Guise of the Changeling
passages.text:
<Your familiarity with the Archivists' Codex makes it clear that this is one of the missing relics.

Archivist Roh-Suir has a spot for this mask in the Reliquary of Remembrance.>

passages.title: Guise of the Changeling
passages.text:
Now this is quite a find!

The Guise of the Changeling has the power to convincingly modify the appearance of its bearer, but it has a mind of its own. The wearer cannot control the illusion, and the mask is wont to place them into embarrassing or dangerous situations.

passages.title: The Netherstar
passages.text:
<You recognize this relic from the Archivists' Codex.

The power source is nearly empty. However, it could be restored with exposure to raw, unfiltered anima. Nearby fissures would do the trick.>

passages.title: The Netherstar
passages.text: When we scholars consider relics that are important to keep secured, the Netherstar is precisely the type of relic that we have in mind. Can you imagine how much damage could be done were this to fall into the hands of an... opportunist?

passages.title: Singing Steel Ingot
passages.text:
<The ingot wails, in a warbling vibrato.>

Woe! These ruffians hammer upon me with nary a care, bending my body to suit their ill aims.

Fie! Fie upon them.

<The ingot emits a high-pitched battle cry.>

Take the hammering to these mawsworn!

passages.title: Singing Steel Ingot
passages.text: In all of my years as a researcher, I never would have expected this.

passages.title: Celestial Shadowlands Chart
passages.text:
<You recognize this relic from the Archivists' Codex.

The mawsworn discarded it, believing it to be useless.

And the chart is useless, without the accompanying data to plot the relative locations of Shadowlands afterlives. If the research were retrieved from deceased scholars, the chart could be returned to the Archivist, fully functional.>

passages.title: Celestial Shadowlands Chart
passages.text: Is that the missing chart?

passages.title: Celestial Shadowlands Chart
passages.text:
Aha! You have recovered the Celestial Shadowlands Chart.

With the chart and the data you collected, it can be restored to its fully functional form. It will take some time to analyze and interpret the results, which I can get started on now that the relic has been returned to the Archive.

Allow me a moment to find a good spot for it...

passages.title: Unstable Explosive Orb
passages.text:
<Your familiarity with the Archivists' Codex makes it clear that this is one of the missing relics.

Archivist Roh-Suir has a spot for this device in the Reliquary of Remembrance.>

passages.title: Unstable Explosive Orb
passages.text: I appreciate you handling this relic carefully. It is nothing short of a miracle that it did not detonate when Korthia was invaded.

passages.title: Cipher of Understanding
passages.text:
<Your familiarity with the Archivists' Codex makes it clear that this is one of the missing relics.

Archivist Roh-Suir has a spot for the cipher in the Reliquary of Remembrance.>

passages.title: Cipher of Understanding
passages.text: My stars! To comprehend any of these languages would allow one the insight to translate all of them. We must look into this further.

passages.title: Drum of the Death Loa
passages.text:
<Your familiarity with the Archivists' Codex makes it clear that this is one of the missing relics.

Archivist Roh-Suir has a spot for this drum in the Reliquary of Remembrance.>

passages.title: Drum of the Death Loa
passages.text: I could hear you approaching with this drum before I saw you. And strangely, I though someone else might be with you.

passages.title: Sack of Strange Soil
passages.text:
<Your familiarity with the Archivists' Codex makes it clear that this is one of the missing relics.

Archivist Roh-Suir has a spot for this soil in the Reliquary of Remembrance.>

passages.title: Sack of Strange Soil
passages.text:
This soil can grow any type of plant, anywhere.

Not the most dangerous relic missing from the archive, and yet it could be the most useful. With enough time, one could restore the verdant beauty of Korthia.

passages.title: Everliving Statuette
passages.text:
<Your familiarity with the Archivists' Codex makes it clear that this is one of the missing relics.

Archivist Roh-Suir has a spot for this statuette in the Reliquary of Remembrance.>

passages.title: Everliving Statuette
passages.text:
I trust you did not listen to anything that this little monster told you.

It is absolutely incapable of uttering the truth.

passages.title: Obelisk of Dark Tidings
passages.text:
<Your familiarity with the Archivists' Codex makes it clear that this is one of the missing relics.

Archivist Roh-Suir has a spot for this obelisk in the Reliquary of Remembrance.>

passages.title: Obelisk of Dark Tidings
passages.text:
We must be cautious around this obelisk.

More than one attendant was driven mad while researching the relic.

passages.title: Book of Binding: The Tormented Sorcerer
passages.text:
<You hear a muffled voice speaking from within this book, interspersed with crackling static. Though the utterances are mostly unintelligible, you can make out the repeated request to recover azure pages.

Flipping through the volume, you note that many of its pages are missing.

If the pages were retrieved, the book could be returned to the Archivist and reassembled.>

passages.title: Book of Binding: The Tormented Sorcerer
passages.text: I find these strange speaking tomes... discomfiting.

passages.title: Book of Binding: The Tormented Sorcerer
passages.text:
This appears to be a companion tome to the crimson book that was under the care of scholars in the Seeker's Quorum.

Knowing that this book binding was separated from its pages intentionally, I will stitch all but one azure page back into it before returning it to the archive.

passages.title: Enigmatic Decrypting Device
passages.text:
<Your familiarity with the Archivists' Codex makes it clear that this is one of the missing relics.

Archivist Roh-Suir has a spot for this device in the Reliquary of Remembrance.>

passages.title: Enigmatic Decrypting Device
passages.text: Though I have only a passing understanding of its operation, this relic can strip the complexity of communication into a form that is free from subtlety, guile, or metaphor. Pure logic.

passages.title: Ring of Self-Reflection
passages.text:
<Your familiarity with the Archivists' Codex makes it clear that this is one of the missing relics.

Archivist Roh-Suir has a spot for this ring in the Reliquary of Remembrance.>

passages.title: Ring of Self-Reflection
passages.text: I am curious to learn how this strange ring functions.

passages.title: Shadow Slicing Shortsword
passages.text:
<Your familiarity with the Archivists' Codex makes it clear that this is one of the missing relics.

Archivist Roh-Suir has a spot for this shortsword in the Reliquary of Remembrance.>

passages.title: Shadow Slicing Shortsword
passages.text: Though the blade's shadow severing properties may appear to be no more than a parlor trick, I believe this is one of the most dangerous relics in our care.

passages.title: Lang Family Wood-Carving
passages.text:
<Your familiarity with the Archivists' Codex makes it clear that this is one of the missing relics.

Archivist Roh-Suir has a spot for this wood-carving in the Reliquary of Remembrance.>

passages.title: Lang Family Wood-Carving
passages.text: I believe this relic can teach us something about the history as well as the future.

passages.title: Gorak Claw Fetish
passages.text:
<Your familiarity with the Archivists' Codex makes it clear that this is one of the missing relics.

Archivist Roh-Suir has a spot for this fetish in the Reliquary of Remembrance.>

passages.title: Gorak Claw Fetish
passages.text: Some mote of Gorak Tul yet lives within this fetish. His corruption is barely contained.

passages.title: Devoured Anima
passages.text:
Sika has idea!

Devourers... devour. They eat anything! So they eat anima, too.

If we take anima from devourers, then that anima is ours!

passages.title: Devoured Anima
passages.text: Sika wonders what anima tastes like.

passages.title: Devoured Anima
passages.text:
Thank you! Wow... you can't tell this was inside devourer!

Sika will get anima to those most in need.

passages.title: The Soul Blade
passages.text:
The runeblade of a Necrolord can be a potent weapon in this realm. An abundance of souls are willing to contribute their anima to end their own suffering and bring defeat to the Jailer.

Take one of my runeblades and charge it with the anima of the willing souls you find here.

Once charged, use it lay waste to their forces here.

passages.title: The Soul Blade
passages.text: Has my blade tasted victory?

passages.title: The Soul Blade
passages.text:
<Bonesmith Heirmir takes her runeblade back from you and examines it carefully.>

Not bad, <name>. Always room for improvement... but not bad.

passages.title: Shaping Fate
passages.text:
The Jailer's power and malevolence continue to grow. So must our resilience.

Stand amongst your allies, <name>. Push back against the darkness that would consume us all.

Together, we will yet prevail.

May the Purpose guide your hand.

passages.title: Shaping Fate
passages.text: One cannot run from history, but one's actions may shape the outcome.

passages.title: Shaping Fate
passages.text:
The threads of fate weave through you, Maw Walker.

Just as the prophecies foretold.

passages.title: A Shady Place
passages.text:
Existence is not a simple thing, adventurer. It is layers upon layers of realities.

The Jailer's traps are pulling our troops into one such rift, hidden from normal sight.

I have obtained an Unbalanced Riftstone. It will give you the ability to enter the rift and destroy the traps keeping our troops trapped inside, before they are lost forever.

After you've destroyed the Rift-Veiled Traps, exit the rift and pull the trapped soldiers back into our reality.

passages.title: A Shady Place
passages.text: There is much we cannot see.

passages.title: A Shady Place
passages.text: Excellent work Maw Walker.

passages.title: Heavy-Handed Tactics
passages.text:
We need more constructs on the front lines, but we have no bodies, heads, or legs! 

Rathan's making the best constructs possible with what we DO have... a lot of hands.

Don't ask questions!

There are enemies in Calcis that we need dead. Take the hands and kill things!

passages.title: Heavy-Handed Tactics
passages.text: Rathan is nothing if not resourceful.

passages.title: Heavy-Handed Tactics
passages.text:
<Margrave Sin'dane looks impressed... or annoyed... or disgusted... or concerned?>

Hm. I suppose with enough hands, anything IS possible...

passages.title: Observational Records
passages.text:
Greetings, Maw Walker, a moment of your time?

As you no doubt know, my cartel has quietly spread observational devices all across Korthia. But that data is no good to us if it is not retrieved. Which is where you come in.

The Sanctuary of Guidance records should be ready to collect. You won't see the devices themselves, but the data will appear to you as a bright orb.

Bring those data to me, and I will reward you handsomely.

passages.title: Observational Records
passages.text: Have you retrieved the observational records from the Sanctuary of Guidance?

passages.title: Observational Records
passages.text:
The devourers have destroyed much of what might have been useful at the Sanctuary of Guidance. But this information will still prove valuable.

And here is your reward, as promised.

passages.title: Observational Records
passages.text:
Greetings, Maw Walker, a moment of your time?

As you no doubt know, my cartel has quietly spread observational devices all across Korthia. But that data is no good to us if it is not retrieved. Which is where you come in.

The records from the Windswept Aerie and Estuary of Awakening should be ready to collect. You won't see the devices themselves, but the data will appear to you as a bright orb.

And don't forget to look below ground!

Bring those data to me, and I will reward you handsomely.

passages.title: Observational Records
passages.text: Have you retrieved the observational records from the Windswept Aerie and Estuary of Awakening?

passages.title: Observational Records
passages.text:
Places like the Aerie and Estuary must have been desolate even before all the destruction. What interesting creatures congregate there.

Will they all survive these changes? Will some adapt, and become even more fearsome?

Here is your reward, as promised.

passages.title: Looming Darkness
passages.text:
The Winter Queen called for a hunt in this location due to reports of a massive, unnatural darkness swelling in its upper regions.

The Wild Hunt is brave, but not foolish. We must learn what we can about this darkness before we charge into it.

Search the bodies of our enemies nearby for clues.

passages.title: Looming Darkness
passages.text: Have you learned anything regarding the darkness yet?

passages.title: Looming Darkness
passages.text: We will discover the source of this darkness, and end it.

passages.title: No Soul Left Behind
passages.text:
Do you hear the cries of tormented souls trapped in Gorgoa?

The twisted river of souls flows before us, swelling with cruelty and the torment of undeserving victims.

Our brave regiment of druid spirits led the charge into the river to seek out those lost souls, but I fear many have instead joined in their suffering.

Summon your courage and take my cradle with you into the river. Load the lost souls you find onto the cradle, then order the cradle to come back to me.

passages.title: No Soul Left Behind
passages.text: I admire Thiernax's dedication to even the least among us.

passages.title: No Soul Left Behind
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. We must not forget to help one another as we stride deeper into the darkness.

passages.title: Snail Stomping
passages.text:
Careful where you step. You wouldn't want to accidentally squish a Mawsworn, would you?

Of course you would! It's so fun!

<Lady Moonberry giggles and points at the snails around her.>

It's so much easier to squish Mawsworn after you've transformed them into stinky little snails.

Here, take my wand and try it out on whatever you like.

You may need to weaken them a bit first, but it'll work on almost anything!

passages.title: Snail Stomping
passages.text: Lady Moonberry never ceases to surprise me.

passages.title: Snail Stomping
passages.text:
<Lord Herne grins.> My record was squishing four in a single jump.

One of the many benefits of being a quadruped.

passages.title: Just Don't Ask Me to Spell It
passages.text:
It's getting dangerous out there for druid spirits!

Thankfully, we always have room for another friend in our group, and this fine tirnenn has offered to help me and the gang get around the battlefield safely.

<The tirnenn behind Choofa begins speaking slowly, but Choofa just talks louder.>

Good ol' Kirriprkar- I mean, Karripkraker- I mean, Krackerkrisp...

<Choofa laughs.>

Let's just call her "Big K"!

Hop on, everybody!

passages.title: Just Don't Ask Me to Spell It
passages.text: Krrprripripkraak and Choofa are teaming up? This, I must see.

passages.title: Just Don't Ask Me to Spell It
passages.text: I have received many reports from hunters who were aided by Krrprripripkraak and her friends. Thank you for helping them.

passages.title: That's Going to Sting
passages.text:
<Niya speaks loudly to be heard over the buzzing coming from the collection of needler nests behind her.>

I've caught Moonberry trying to steal these nests for her pranks over ten times already!

The other faeries said I was crazy to bring the needlers out here. Too wild! Too unpredictable!

But that's exactly why we need them.

Lord Herne's scouts report powerful Heralds among our enemy's forces.

Take one of these nests, and use it to surprise the Heralds!

passages.title: That's Going to Sting
passages.text: Niya is proving to be quite the clever tactician...

passages.title: That's Going to Sting
passages.text:
I wish I could've been there to see it myself!

A fitting end for the Heralds...

passages.title: Oozing with Character
passages.text:
Apprentice! I've been looking for you.

Kevin has been such a wonderful helper in our experiments, I'd like to train my other oozes to be able to assist as well!

For Ooz, I'd like to know if they are able to consume organic material and increase in size.

passages.title: Oozing with Character
passages.text: They're good oozes, <name>.

passages.title: Oozing with Character
passages.text: How did the tests go? OH! Ooz! You're huge! You're even more beautiful than normal!

passages.title: Local Reagents
passages.text:
Korthia is an odd place. The wildlife here is different, likely due to years of exposure to the Vault and everything it contains.

Are you ready to try some experiments? We'll need a good stock of reagents first.

Near the Seeker's Quorum, you should be able to find shardhides, gromits, and razorwings. Watch out for their needles!

passages.title: Local Reagents
passages.text: Feel like taste testing my newest experiment? It probably won't kill you.

passages.title: Local Reagents
passages.text: This needle is so long and perfect! Well done apprentice. I can't wait to get started on our new tests!

passages.title: Hunting Huln
passages.text:
Huln is somewhere in the area, but the Stonewright isn't letting anyone in to her territory because of the recent, ah, troubles with Dreadlords. The guards won't let anyone in, and they're kicking out anyone who doesn't look like they belong.

Luckily for Huln, Cudgelface and I came up with a foolproof plan!

We just need to look like we belong and then we can ask around and find Huln. Easy!

passages.title: Hunting Huln
passages.text: I'm busy with this piece of dreadlord filth. Find something useful to do before the Stonewright gets angry. You don't want to see her angry.

passages.title: Paw Patrol
passages.text:
While Speedy IV was collecting supplies, Stringfellowe was scouting the rest of the Eye of Azshara.

Turns out there is a whole mess of pirates to the west. That must be where the pets are at.

Head over there and rescue the pets.

passages.title: Paw Patrol
passages.text: Have you found them, <name>?

passages.title: Paw Patrol
passages.text:
Nice work freeing the pets, <name>. 

But still no sign of Gurgl.

passages.title: Tower Knowledge
passages.text:
The woven power of this box can only be unlocked by feeding it pride and memory. In its weave are incantations I have seen used in the other realms to siphon or condition a soul. This... abomination... has used these tools of redemption and honor to create a lock.

As you challenge the floors of Torghast, your skill, speed, and efficiency will all contribute to Tower Knowledge which this box can feed upon. 

Feed it to retrieve the powers within.

passages.title: Tower Knowledge
passages.text: <The Box of Many Things thrums with power.>

passages.title: Tower Knowledge
passages.text: <The box hungers, reaching into your memories of Torghast for past deeds to feed upon.>

passages.title: Security Measures
passages.text:
It seems the hidden traps I placed around the grotto are not as effective as I would like, considering your presence in my home. 

However, they are still useful in preventing the majority of unwanted attention. 

Since you so kindly brought assassins to me, I cannot reset the traps myself. 

So you will need to do it for me. I will stay here to guard both myself and my precious research. Use this Sensory Synchronizer I placed nearby to show you which traps need to be reset.

passages.title: Security Measures
passages.text: Good. That should shield us from notice for a while.

passages.title: Cyphers of the First Ones
passages.text:
The way is not quite clear, but the first steps have been made.

It seems the divine construct has taken more of a liking to you than to me. 

Now that it has given you the beginnings of understanding, see what else it wishes to show you.

The results should be enlightening.

passages.title: Cyphers of the First Ones
passages.text: You have been blessed.

passages.title: Cyphers of the First Ones
passages.text:
Can't you feel the knowledge you've gained coursing through you?!

To think it is you who will unlock the secrets of Zereth Mortis...

I will be watching you very closely.

passages.title: Picking Up the Pieces
passages.text:
Much was lost when Korthia was pulled into the Maw.

Priceless relics were torn asunder. I have seen creatures carrying the remnants of these items. 

They must be recovered.

Confront the Jailer's forces and search what remains of Korthia for these fragments of our once glorious vault.

passages.title: Picking Up the Pieces
passages.text: These will do nicely. There is much I can do to improve them.

passages.title: Collecting Research
passages.text:
You have done well to collect these fragments. They will go a long way to restoring our archives. 

I can use what you have found to gather more research about what was lost within Korthia. 

Afterwards, it will be up to you to find more fragments and relics within Korthia to boost our archives.

passages.title: Collecting Research
passages.text: We thank you for your aid so far, Maw Walker.

passages.title: Collecting Research
passages.text: This should do nicely. The reliquary will improve with more research.

passages.title: Empowering Equipment
passages.text:
The research you find can unlock many possibilities.

One such avenue is improving some equipment that you may find within Korthia.

Speak with my assistant nearby. He can use our research to restore this equipment to its former power.

passages.title: Empowering Equipment
passages.text: I will do what I can to aid you, Maw Walker.

passages.title: Empowering Equipment
passages.text: This is the least we can do to help you in your efforts, Maw Walker.

passages.title: Helsworn Battle Plans
passages.text:
<These battle plans detail possible movements into Korthia, and include detailed reports of the defensive capabilities of the Death's Advance in the region.

Duchess Mynx in Keeper's Respite would be able to spread this information rapidly to those who need it.>

passages.title: Helsworn Battle Plans
passages.text:
<Duchess Mynx's eyes widen as she browses the documents you brought her.>

I will disseminate these immediately. Thank you!

passages.title: Stolen Korthian Supplies
passages.text:
<These supplies are marked with the seal of the Death's Advance, stolen from the Rift without being noticed.

Duchess Mynx in Keeper's Respite would be very grateful to have this returned.>

passages.title: Stolen Korthian Supplies
passages.text:
<Duchess Mynx looks at you incredulously.>

You found these WHERE?!

Well, how am I supposed to stop thieves I cannot even see? Cowardly shades!

passages.title: Mysterious Rifts
passages.text:
Thank you so much for your aid, <name>. I have uncovered more relics from the codex that remain intact.

The key to finding these relics rests within the strange rifts within Korthia.

I can now craft a way for you to enter these rifts, in order to gain access to these missing relics.

As before, take note of the echoes to understand what these relics look like. Please be sure to examine them before you depart.

passages.title: Mysterious Rifts
passages.text: Have you seen the missing relics?

passages.title: Mysterious Rifts
passages.text: Thank you for your continued aid. The reliquary will be restored, thanks to your diligent work.

passages.title: Observing the Chase
passages.text:
In our observations of your kind's conflict, we have noticed a high rate of escape among the prey.

This is unadvantageous to our observation efforts.

The Observer has acquired a tool we believe will improve your ability to force conflict.

Before I give it to you, we ask that you prove your willingness to participate in such conflicts, so that we know we will receive a worthy return on this investment.

passages.title: Observing the Chase
passages.text: Your hesitation to set out and hunt your prey is not promising, <name>...

passages.title: Observing the Chase
passages.text: Excellent. We will be watching your future endeavors with great interest.

passages.title: The Final Relics
passages.text:
I have excellent news, <name>. I have uncovered the last set of our missing relics! 

It may be difficult for you to locate them, but I have developed the proper research to aid you.

Please, review the last of our missing relics. We are so close to finding them all!

passages.title: The Final Relics
passages.text: Have you seen the missing relics?

passages.title: The Final Relics
passages.text: Thank you for your continued aid. The reliquary will be restored, thanks to your diligent work.

passages.title: Legend of the Animaswell
passages.text:
<This appears to be an incomplete set of notes detailing one archivist's search for a mythical font of anima hidden somewhere deep in Korthia.

Merick Feldscar in the Seat of the Primus would be able to help you put together a team to search for it.>

passages.title: Legend of the Animaswell
passages.text:
<Merick Feldscar carefully studies the documents you brought him.>

The documentation is incomplete. It is unclear if the archivist even survived...

But the tales of the anima are impressive, and there are enough details here to launch an expedition.

It will not be easy. The archivist warns of many dangers protecting the anima source...

passages.title: Legend of the Animaswell
passages.text:
<This appears to be an incomplete set of notes detailing one archivist's search for a mythical font of anima hidden somewhere deep in Korthia.

Tactician Sakaa in Sinfall would be able to help you put together a team to search for it.>

passages.title: Legend of the Animaswell
passages.text:
<Tactician Sakaa carefully studies the documents you brought her.>

The documentation is incomplete. It is unclear if the archivist even survived...

But the tales of the anima are incredible, and there are enough details here to launch an expedition.

It will not be easy. The archivist warns of many dangers protecting the anima source...

passages.title: Venthyr Assault
passages.text:
The Jailer's forces have been caught off guard by our attack. We shall overrun Perdition Hold and defeat his champions at the Altar of Domination!

Your help is needed Maw Walker. Assist our forces on the battlefield!

passages.title: In Need of Assistance
passages.text:
The inhabitants of Korthia have been through much. Were it not for our arrival, the Jailer's forces would have rampaged through the remainder of the City of Secrets, leaving destruction in their wake.

To continue our efforts, we must assist those in need.

Heed the call of our allies, Maw Walker. See to it no stone is left unturned and no ally of the Jailer left alive.

passages.title: In Need of Assistance
passages.text: This work brings us one step closer to ending Zovaal's reign over this forsaken land.

passages.title: Anima Reclamation
passages.text:
Our efforts here need a constant supply of troops, supplies, and anima. The last one is the hardest, for obvious reasons. But I've learned to be resourceful. 

Nearby there is a plentiful source of anima: the devourers that currently swarm the Sanctuary of Guidance. It's not as easy as beating it out of a soul, but it's just as effective, if you're strong enough. Are you?

passages.title: Anima Reclamation
passages.text: Every drop of anima we reclaim is a potential weapon against the Jailer.

passages.title: Anima Reclamation
passages.text: You can trust me with this anima. I will see it is turned against the Jailer and his forces.

passages.title: Observational Records
passages.text:
Greetings, Maw Walker, a moment of your time?

As you no doubt know, my cartel has quietly spread observational devices all across Korthia. But that data is no good to us if it is not retrieved. Which is where you come in.

The records from the Windswept Aerie and Estuary of Awakening should be ready to collect. You won't see the devices themselves, but the data will appear to you as a bright orb.

And don't forget to look below ground!

Bring those data to me, and I will reward you handsomely.

passages.title: Observational Records
passages.text: Have you retrieved the observational records from the Windswept Aerie and Estuary of Awakening?

passages.title: Observational Records
passages.text:
Places like the Aerie and Estuary must have been desolate, even before all the destruction. What interesting creatures congregate there.

Will they all survive these changes, or will some adapt, and become even more fearsome?

And here is your reward, as promised.

passages.title: Hollow Efforts
passages.text:
The large metal spheres that litter the landscape of Zereth Mortis are spent forges, discarded during the creation process. 

These empty metal husks still contain residual materials of creation that may be useful to us.

Use my Forge-Tap near these metal spheres to harvest any Remnant Neomotes. You may also find other useful proto-materials!

passages.title: Hollow Efforts
passages.text: Have you gathered the materials already?

passages.title: Hollow Efforts
passages.text: Excellent work, <name>. These resources will bolster our efforts here.

passages.title: Historic Protection
passages.text:
The outsiders have disrupted the sands. We cannot reach the terraforming records we need in order to collect necessary historical information.

Will you assist us?

Help Mai Obet collect historical records in the Endless Sands.

passages.title: Historic Protection
passages.text: We have archived the necessary records. Thank you for your assistance.

passages.title: Sanctum of Domination - Damned If You Don't
passages.text:
I feel Kel'Thuzad's presence in these halls. Claim shards from his phylactery and I'll be able to open a new pathway into his chambers.

Four shards should be enough. We wouldn't want him coming back again would we?

passages.title: Sanctum of Domination - Damned If You Don't
passages.text: Four shards should allow us to access his chamber.

passages.title: Sanctum of Domination - Damned If You Don't
passages.text: This should help us gain access to his chamber more readily.

passages.title: Sanctum of Domination - Damned If You Don't
passages.text:
I feel Kel'Thuzad's presence in these halls. Claim shards from his phylactery and I'll be able to open a new pathway into his chambers.

Four shards should be enough. We wouldn't want him coming back again would we?

passages.title: Sanctum of Domination - Damned If You Don't
passages.text: Four shards should allow us to access his chamber.

passages.title: Sanctum of Domination - Damned If You Don't
passages.text: This should help us gain access to his chamber more readily.

passages.title: Sanctum of Domination - Damned If You Don't
passages.text:
I feel Kel'Thuzad's presence in these halls. Claim shards from his phylactery and I'll be able to open a new pathway into his chambers.

Four shards should be enough. We wouldn't want him coming back again would we?

passages.title: Sanctum of Domination - Damned If You Don't
passages.text: Four shards should allow us to access his chamber.

passages.title: Sanctum of Domination - Damned If You Don't
passages.text: This should help us gain access to his chamber more readily.

passages.title: Tazavesh: A Hard Bargain
passages.text:
Ah, my work looks marvelous on you. You are the very image of legitimacy!

And now that I've provided you with my talents, you shall provide me with yours. Seek out my business associate, Fe'tajid, at the Gilded Landing and offer him your assistance.

I look forward to hearing of your success.

passages.title: Tazavesh: A Hard Bargain
passages.text: Have you spoken with my associate?

passages.title: Tazavesh: A Hard Bargain
passages.text:
It seems our efforts to deceive the Zo were unsuccessful. But their efforts to kill you failed as well, so no harm done, yes?

Perhaps a more generous reward is in order. Please accept this, along with my sincerest gratitude.

passages.title: Reap What We Have Sown
passages.text:
We told the constructor that we will use the Foundry to reset this land.

We must stop it and protect the new automa.

passages.title: Reap What We Have Sown
passages.text:
Learning about new creatures that are infused with living growth--well, that sounds right up my alley! 

I think I'll stay with them and see how I can help... and maybe pick up their language as well. 

Thanks for coming on this adventure with me, friend!

passages.title: Whispering Felflame Crystal
passages.text:
The crystal pulses with an eerie, felfire green glow. Holding it, you hear faint echoes of guttural demonic voices. Although the words are jumbled, one is both decipherable and repeated often: Dalaran. 

Perhaps someone in the city floating over the Broken Isles can tell you more about this crystal and its purpose.

passages.title: Whispering Felflame Crystal
passages.text: I will just put this back when it belongs. Thank you for bringing it to me, <name>.

passages.title: Materials of Creation
passages.text:
The large metal spheres that litter the landscape of Zereth Mortis are spent forges, discarded during the creation process.

The spheres near the Forge of Afterlives contain trace amounts of materials unique to that location.

I have modified my Forge-Tap to harvest those materials. Use it near the forges I have identified. The rare Eidolic Fragments have the greatest chance to be found on the largest of Progenitor Forges.

passages.title: Materials of Creation
passages.text: Have you collected what we need?

passages.title: Materials of Creation
passages.text: I shall make use of these immediately. These will help Saezurah and the automa resist the effects of the domination magic.

passages.title: Knocking On Death's Door
passages.text:
This is it, mortal. The forces you have assembled should be enough to break through the Mawsworn and reach the Crypts. Getting inside, however, will require more effort. The Mawsworn have barricaded the entrance.

Kbato will carry you into battle. Eliminate the Mawsworn, and destroy the devices that power the barrier.

passages.title: Knocking On Death's Door
passages.text: By the First Ones... I never dreamed I would see this place with my own eyes.

passages.title: Help From Beyond
passages.text:
If we stand any chance of breaking through the Mawsworn forces, we will need the help of all of the covenants.

I will speak with the Kyrian. You and Pelagos can speak with the others. But before you go, ask Firim if there is any way we can gain the support of the Enlightened as well.

passages.title: Help From Beyond
passages.text: Between the strength of the covenant forces and the help of the automa, we should be able to reach the Crypts!

passages.title: Selfless Preservation
passages.text:
The automa were once abundant here, singing, constructing various things, carrying out the purpose of the First Ones. Then, invaders from the Maw slaughtered them all.

The last automa to fall were protecting something important in a nearby structure. 

I witnessed one of the cursed Mawsworn steal a device by the door. The Elders say we should not meddle with artifacts, but would it be a transgression to recover what was stolen?

passages.title: Selfless Preservation
passages.text: This automa still lives! But it is so weak.

passages.title: Core Competency
passages.text:
The poor thing.

The sacred should not be disturbed, but... will the elders judge us if we help it survive? This is preservation, not interference.

...I hope. 

We can power it back up. Use this depleted core as a conduit. Perhaps the larger wild animates in the nearby sands have enough energy to charge it.

passages.title: Core Competency
passages.text: This lonely one will be strong again.

passages.title: Access Request
passages.text:
The architect alone possesses the Restoration Matrix required for the restoration. The architect will restore the Protoform Repository.

The mortal will gain access to the Chamber of Shaping and inform the architect of recent progress. The architect will restore the repository.

Fulfillment of the task is imminent.

passages.title: Access Request
passages.text: The architect will assist us.

passages.title: Access Request
passages.text:
The Restoration Matrix is acquired. The architect is not present. The architect is therefore lost. 

Restoration of the repository is mandatory, even so.

passages.title: Overgrown Story
passages.text:
Since our arrival here the Untamed Verdure has been a mystery waiting to be solved. The lush foliage of the area grows on everything as the creatures run amok without purpose.

There could be valuable research data to be obtained from these creatures.

Use a Containment Trap to subdue the elemental creatures. Once subdued, examine them for research data.

passages.title: Overgrown Story
passages.text: Have you completed the research?

passages.title: Overgrown Story
passages.text: This information will help, but I'm afraid those ruins still remain a mystery!

passages.title: What We Overcome
passages.text:
I understand now. All of us that were touched by Domination were able to tap into something. Whether nobility or vengeance, it gave the strength to resist.

With all that I have faced, I have to remember that I am still here.

And if there are those willing to stand with Sylvanas, I have to believe they will stand with me as well.

I'm ready to try again. This time, I will overcome whatever I face.

passages.title: What We Overcome
passages.text: We will not fail. There is no other choice but oblivion.

passages.title: What We Overcome
passages.text:
All the shards are now infused with the resistance we gained from our experiences with Domination.

It was not easy, for any of us. But I am proud of what we were able to accomplish, together.

As for the rest, our future is in the hands of the Primus.

passages.title: The Not-Scientific Method
passages.text:
The language of the First Ones is not static like most others. It evolves.

Creatures like the sentries are more advanced than your average poultrid, obviously. Their more complex thought processes give them an innate resistance to the invaders' overriding magic. 

But you should not take my word for it. We can actually test this! 

In the grotto there is a librarian. Take those phrases you memorized and infuse them into it. Then try out your helm.

passages.title: The Not-Scientific Method
passages.text:
You see! It took far longer for Domination to overtake the librarian's native purposing.

Of course it did fail in the end, but I would call that a success for your particular interest.

Do not worry, another automa will take that one's place. There must always be a librarian.

passages.title: Aggressive Excavation
passages.text:
Elder Eru said that we could find the most complex examples of the First Ones' language out here. 

We'll need to fight our way to the vaults, and then infuse the helm once we find those phrases.

On a personal note, I never thought I'd have the chance to fight alongside my father. Though with the stakes this high, it somehow feels like exactly the place I'm supposed to be.

I am ready when you are.

passages.title: Aggressive Excavation
passages.text:
We've done it. The broken half of the helm is infused with the most advanced pieces of the First Ones' power that we could readily find.

We are so close to success.

passages.title: Seeking Haven
passages.text:
I am at a loss.

We have no way to follow Zovaal and Anduin. I'll open a portal back to Haven. We will discuss our next steps there.

passages.title: Seeking Haven
passages.text: We will look into how to follow them into the Sepulcher. Until then, you should focus your efforts on more immediate issues.

passages.title: Reclaiming Provis Esper
passages.text:
Provis Esper is overrun with devourers, buzzing around like hungry vespoids.

They are destroying the local automa, which is not at all what the First Ones intended. A cleansing is in order.

For our safety and to restore the natural order, clear some of them out.

passages.title: Reclaiming Provis Esper
passages.text: Have you cleansed Provis Esper?

passages.title: Reclaiming Provis Esper
passages.text: More devourers will come, but you have lessened their impact for now.

passages.title: Flora Frenzy
passages.text:
Those guardian automa will shoot down anything that attempts to reach the Creation Catalyst.

May I suggest fighting fire with fire? Or rather, fighting the creations of the First Ones with the creation energy of the First Ones?

I have had little time to adequately test my theory, but this potion should provide the boost you need to destroy them... ideally without dying from exposure to the creation energy in the process.

passages.title: Flora Frenzy
passages.text: Your safety is probable, but not guaranteed.

passages.title: Flora Frenzy
passages.text: It was quite poetic, I think, using their own growth energy against them.

passages.title: Tower of the Damned
passages.text:
We know little of Torghast. However, Fatescribe Roh-Tahl claims there is work that must be done there.

He believes there is a path for you to reach this place... and that someone there requires your aid.

Do what you must to reach Torghast and aid anyone who is within.

passages.title: Tower of the Damned
passages.text:
Stay back! 

Wait... you're not one of the Jailer's forces.

Box! We have a visitor, play the nice music would you?

passages.title: Traversing Torghast
passages.text:
I've heard of you, the Maw Walker! You must know of me, the legendary Ve'nish.

I am here to find great treasures within Torghast with the aid of my box. I can see you admiring it.

Perhaps we can work together. Why don't you go into Torghast ahead of me to scout ahead?

I shall even reward you for anything you discover within.

passages.title: Traversing Torghast
passages.text: How goes exploring the darkness of Torghast?

passages.title: Traversing Torghast
passages.text:
Ah, the place is filled to the brink with all sorts of terrible creatures... and also plenty of powers!

Perfect! Did you hear that, box? We'll find plenty in this place... perhaps even more than that coward Ve'nari out in the Maw.

Ahem, thank you, Maw Walker. You've done your part well. I shall have more questions later.

passages.title: Trappings of Success
passages.text:
The wildlife of Zereth Mortis are attracted to the frenetic creation energy that flows throughout the land. When the wildlife finds something charged with that energy... they eat it!

The Mawsworn Cryptoseers have become aware of this and are attempting to find such wildlife to extract any remnants of that energy.

Eliminate the Cryptoseers, and use the Containment Trap to subdue and examine the wildlife for our research.

passages.title: Trappings of Success
passages.text: You have collected data before the Cryptoseers?

passages.title: Trappings of Success
passages.text: This information will help us continue to unravel the mysteries of Zereth Mortis.

passages.title: Borrowed Power
passages.text:
The land provides. The land thirsts. Invaders devour what we require.

Reclaim what has been consumed. Absorb what remains abundant.

Wings need wind to fly. We need power to ascend.

passages.title: Borrowed Power
passages.text: More power to Pocopoc.

passages.title: Borrowed Power
passages.text: Power thrums. A renewal of hope.

passages.title: Match Made in Zereth Mortis
passages.text:
The cyphers are the key. Each one, a step along the path. You must find them all.

Enter the inner chamber. The Prime Locus Arrangement awaits.

The first step toward ascension. Toward the vessel.

passages.title: Match Made in Zereth Mortis
passages.text: Need to gather the cyphers to reach the door where the vessel waits.

passages.title: Match Made in Zereth Mortis
passages.text: The last leg of the journey begins.

passages.title: The Forces Gather
passages.text:
I am relieved that you survived the passage to Zereth Mortis. From what I've overheard of Pelagos's conversation with Kleia, it sounds like you had an incredible journey.

These Enlightened brokers could make valuable allies. Their knowledge of the automa and the land itself should help us against the Jailer.

Our forces are gathered and ready to follow you to Zereth Mortis.

The final battle lies before us, adventurer.

passages.title: The Forces Gather
passages.text:
You defended Haven, and now you bring allies to preserve this sacred land.

Blessings of the First Ones be upon you, mortal.

passages.title: A Defector's Request
passages.text:
<Unrolling the scroll, you can make out that it's a coded arms requisition from the Maldraxxi of Death's End to their venthyr allies... all servants of the Jailer.

Surely someone among the Death's Advance in Korthia will be able to help you fully break the code and learn exactly what they were planning.>

passages.title: A Defector's Request
passages.text:
<A smile creeps across Duchess Mynx's face as she looks over the scroll you provided. A moment later, an echoing laugh bursts from her.>

The forces of the Jailer use such pathetic codes! This scroll of yours doesn't say where, but it seems there's a weapons cache ready to be claimed. A team of your allies should be able to investigate and retrieve it without too much trouble.

passages.title: Choose Your Fighter
passages.text:
