The presence of the Jailer's forces at Provis Strata have been causing untold damage to the region. If left unchecked, we will lose all knowledge in the area.

One of our kin has prepared some automa to deal with the Mawsworn. Meet with them, and fight back against those who would disrespect Zereth Mortis in this manner.

passages.title: Choose Your Fighter
passages.text: Is the task complete?

passages.title: Choose Your Fighter
passages.text: Good work.

passages.title: Step Into the Ring
passages.text:
One of the remarkable things we have found about these lands is that they seem to be adaptive and changing, even as ancient as they are. Things are not stationary.

In the depths of the Nexus of Actualization there is a forge that appears made to test these various designs, and to learn. These creatures may one day be used to defend Zereth Mortis from threats, so you should test their effectiveness where possible.

Go there, challenge what the forge creates and report back to me.

passages.title: Step Into the Ring
passages.text: What a remarkable device. Of course there is clearly some improvement to be made in what it creates. But perhaps it will learn from the lessons you have provided.

passages.title: Not Safe for Work
passages.text:
Rana's discovery of Progenitor relics at the Ageless Shards has created quite a stir among the Enlightened. These relics predate our earlier discoveries, and through them we may gain a deeper understanding of the workings of Zereth Mortis.

Rana is collecting the relics, but I fear she is in danger. Agents of Cartel Xy have been spotted in the area, and will likely attempt to steal the relics.

Please travel to the Ageless Shards, and help Rana collect the relics.

passages.title: Not Safe for Work
passages.text: Have you collected the Progenitor Relics?

passages.title: Not Safe for Work
passages.text: Your help is always appreciated, <name>.

passages.title: Your Death Or Mine
passages.text:
We have obtained a wealth of information from relics discovered at the Ageless Shards. 

The Mawsworn are aware of our discoveries, and are trying to stop us. They have placed traps around the area to block access to the relics. 

We cannot allow the Jailer to cut off our access to those relics.

Please eliminate this Mawsworn threat, and recover as many relics as possible.

passages.title: Your Death Or Mine
passages.text: Have you secured the relics at the Ageless Shards?

passages.title: Your Death Or Mine
passages.text: Blessed be your effort!

passages.title: How to Glide with Your Dragon
passages.text:
Let us start with the basics.

If you fly straight you will wear yourself out right now. Use gravity as an aid and aim slightly down to fly a long distance. The rings will give you the general angle that you should use for basic gliding.

First, call upon your drake, or our Red Drake friend here can give you a lift.

Then, fly through the rings and land at the target location.

If you find yourself stuck, use the Bronze Timepiece and Celormu will reset you.

passages.title: How to Glide with Your Dragon
passages.text: Well done, 0xcp.

passages.title: How to Glide with Your Dragon
passages.text: Excellent work!

passages.title: How to Dive with Your Dragon
passages.text:
Gliding will get you to where you want to go. But what if you want to get there faster?

Diving after jumping from somewhere high will give you a speed boost.

Fly through the rings to the target location.

If you find yourself stuck, use the Bronze Timepiece and Celormu will reset you.

passages.title: How to Dive with Your Dragon
passages.text: Well done, <name>.

passages.title: How to Dive with Your Dragon
passages.text:
See? That was much better.

If you start your flights with a dive you will get to where you want to go so much faster.

passages.title: Portal Play
passages.text:
To aid in my studies, I have used a network of travel portals to install monitoring devices all over Zereth Mortis.

My devices have been quite successful at collecting large amounts of research data. It's time now to collect the data they have obtained.

Use my portal network to locate my Prying Eyes and collect any data they have gathered. I'll give you a portal initiator as well, allowing you to re-enter the portal network, incase you find yourself lost!

passages.title: Portal Play
passages.text: Have you collected all the data?

passages.title: Portal Play
passages.text: This will do fine, but there is still so much more to understand. With my Prying Eyes still out there, we shall be able to collect some more data very soon.

passages.title: Fruit of the Bloom
passages.text:
We never know when something new may emerge from the confluence of creation and energy.

The Catalyst Gardens have blossomed with a new crop of fruit. Their seeds may have special properties, and we wish to understand them.

Please gather what you can find, and make the gardens safer for the future.

passages.title: Fruit of the Bloom
passages.text: How can one understand what cannot be defined?

passages.title: Fruit of the Bloom
passages.text:
There is so much to learn from just these little seeds. What will they grow into? Will the vombata eat them?

Thank you for helping me to understand this place further.

passages.title: Fleet-Footed and Fastidious
passages.text:
When the Mawsworn came to Zereth Mortis, they brought mawrats with them! 

A swarm of their mawrats overran my cave, making off with many of our research items!

Rana is assembling a team to help recover the items. Meet up with her and aid in the effort.

passages.title: Fleet-Footed and Fastidious
passages.text: Have you dealt with those mawrats?

passages.title: Fleet-Footed and Fastidious
passages.text: A most excellent effort! I had feared these items lost for good.

passages.title: Souls Entwined
passages.text:
I must confess, at first I thought Pelagos was making a horrible sacrifice. But now I see--he was giving the Shadowlands all the hope and compassion he holds in his heart. We should go and see him.

Speak with Tal-Inara when you reach Oribos.

I will meet you there, my friend.

passages.title: Souls Entwined
passages.text: Pelagos is right. But if anyone can accomplish what is needed... I believe it is you, my friend.

passages.title: Forcing the Cycle
passages.text:
The forces of Zovaal have been spreading their malign influence into the natural life within Provis Fauna. With the rate of their corruption, attempting to cleanse them one by one would be ill advised.

Instead, we can just return their energies into the systems of Zereth Mortis to be used to create new fauna. Use this orb, let it absorb their energy as they die, and then cleanse it once it has been charged.

passages.title: Forcing the Cycle
passages.text: Have you finished?

passages.title: Forcing the Cycle
passages.text: Their energy will serve the cycle.

passages.title: Cluck, Cluck, Boom
passages.text:
The endemic poultrids of Zereth Mortis have been influenced in an unseemly way by all these invaders.

Use this device on the ones that have malfunctioned. Otherwise, they will do too much damage to the land.

passages.title: Cluck, Cluck, Boom
passages.text: These mysterious ways must be understood.

passages.title: Cluck, Cluck, Boom
passages.text: Those poultrid do make quite a mess. Thank you for your assistance.

passages.title: Heart of the Sepulcher
passages.text:
Soon after we stepped forth into the realms of Death, a message left behind by the Primus gave warning that the Jailer must not be allowed to reach the Sepulcher.

Despite all our efforts, he has done so.

Within the heart of that ancient place lie secrets the Jailer could use to dominate the entire cosmos. If he succeeds, everything we hold dear will be lost.

Gather your allies, <name>. Claim victory for the Shadowlands... and for Azeroth.

passages.title: Heart of the Sepulcher
passages.text:
At long last, our campaign is at an end. Thanks to you, the Jailer has been defeated.

Your efforts have saved us all, <name>.

passages.title: A Long Walk
passages.text:
The Arbiter awaits us. Though few are allowed within the Crucible, several who hail from Azeroth have been granted permission to bear witness as he passes judgment on Sylvanas.

Yet we are far from the only ones affected by all the carnage Sylvanas has wrought. Her actions have brought pain and suffering to a great many.

Screaming back at the Banshee as she passes might be their only chance to speak their mind. Let them be heard.

passages.title: A Long Walk
passages.text:
Thank you for joining us, my friend. 

I felt it important that you be here to witness this moment.

passages.title: Operation: Relocation
passages.text:
Devourers have disrupted the avians nesting at Provis Esper.

This may be our last chance to examine them before they become tainted, like the others.

Capture several of the avians at Provis Esper and return them to Pilgrim Arizh for relocation and study. Deal with any problems that get in your way.

passages.title: Operation: Relocation
passages.text: Well done, <name>. The avians will be moved to a safer location where we can observe them.

passages.title: Buried Remnants
passages.text:
Much has been lost to the invading forces, those that came with destruction in their hearts.

We cannot preserve this land as the First Ones intended if the Mawsworn are allowed to pulverize all remnants of their knowledge.

See what you can recover from the sands of Provis Strata.

passages.title: Buried Remnants
passages.text: What was before, will be again.

passages.title: Buried Remnants
passages.text: Without the context in which these were first made, they may remain mysteries. But at least they are not trampled underfoot anymore.

passages.title: Lost Research
passages.text:
We have uncovered a promising source of Korthian research. Previous Archivists hid knowledge within repositories that were then placed within the rift.

I fear that the repositories are no longer safe and that shades of that realm will consume them. It is imperative that we secure this research before it is lost forever.

Use a Repaired Riftkey to enter the Korthia Rift. Recover the Korthian Repositories.

passages.title: Lost Research
passages.text: The archive would be lost without you, Maw Walker.

passages.title: Lost Research
passages.text: The research within these repositories is invaluable. I may ask you to return to the rift again in the future.

passages.title: Smash 'Em to Feathereens
passages.text:
I was curious about these strange, winged creatures and attempted to introduce myself. I would have been eaten if not for Professor Chirpsnide and her large mechanical fowl!

Could you help us deal with these "Screechflight"? The native bluefeather rocs are having a difficult time defending their nests from them.

Also, I'd hate for any more introductions to go the way mine did with them...

passages.title: Smash 'Em to Feathereens
passages.text: The only thing I can thank these harpies for is giving me the chance to meet the professor!

passages.title: Smash 'Em to Feathereens
passages.text:
Thank you, <name>!

I've been assisting the good Professor while you've been gone. I'm afraid to say I've made things worse for her...

passages.title: Bzzzzt!
passages.text:
The vespoids of the region use debris in the area to form the core of their nests. While this is normally something we'd allow them to naturally do, they've started taking some of the relics we were studying.

I have a device that should hopefully allow for the removal of such relics from their hives without damaging the core structure. Use it to retrieve these relics.

passages.title: Bzzzzt!
passages.text: That is enough for now, thank you.

passages.title: Obvious Plant
passages.text:
The situation in the Catalyst Gardens is troubling.

But most troubling of all is that we do not know more. If we had an understanding of the changing levels of energy emitted by the Creation Catalyst, we could make better decisions as to how to proceed.

Take these sensors. Place them below the catalyst at the locations marked upon your map.

passages.title: Obvious Plant
passages.text: Were you able to place the sensors?

passages.title: Obvious Plant
passages.text: Our brightest scholars will track the sensor data. First Ones willing, they will show us the way.

passages.title: The Way Forward
passages.text:
I see you have a new friend, Maw Walker!

With Pocopoc at your side, I wonder what else you will discover about Zereth Mortis? The secrets we uncover here will be of great help against the Jailer. Perhaps they can teach us how to awaken this oracle.

Highlord Bolvar will surely want to hear of them.

Please go to Haven and inform him. There is a transporter just outside the cave you may want to use. 

I will remain here and keep watch over the oracle.

passages.title: The Way Forward
passages.text: You have returned, Maw Walker. What news do you have for me?

passages.title: Mercy First
passages.text:
The toxicity in the creche nearly claimed us all. While the antidote is being prepared, I need you to seek out the wounded and heal them. 

Yes, even the blue drakonid. The Healing Wings do not stand idly by while others suffer.

passages.title: Mercy First
passages.text: The toxins flooding the creche could not penetrate the stasis magic, but it engulfed us when we awakened.

passages.title: Mercy First
passages.text: Violence is not the only avenue to victory.

passages.title: Patterns Within Patterns
passages.text:
We stand at the origin of the Shadowlands. We must not allow this place to become its undoing.

Work with our new allies, <name>. Their assistance will be the difference between our success and the unmaking of all things.

passages.title: Patterns Within Patterns
passages.text: In this place, all fates are intertwined.

passages.title: Patterns Within Patterns
passages.text: We move closer to our goal. Ever onward.

passages.title: Motes of Knowledge
passages.text:
The creatures of Untamed Verdure are ingesting everything in sight. They have consumed our Compilation Nodule, and the Composition Motes needed for compilation. We Jiro require these resources.

This area is too hazardous for unprotected Jiro operation.

Please help us reclaim our resources. Mai Obet will assist you.

passages.title: Motes of Knowledge
passages.text: Have you recovered our resources?

passages.title: Motes of Knowledge
passages.text: You have recovered our resources. Your assistance is appreciated.

passages.title: Circle of Strife
passages.text:
Automa need assistance to operate properly. We fulfill this purpose, but outsiders have caused too many interruptions. We cannot properly address them all. 

Please assist Mai Obet in inspecting and reviewing the performance of the automa.

passages.title: Circle of Strife
passages.text: Do the automa meet expectations?

passages.title: Circle of Strife
passages.text: The automa are functioning properly. Thank you for your assistance.

passages.title: Arbiter in the Making
passages.text:
Maw Walker, I ... I do not know what to say. I did not expect this.

She speaks of preparations and a new Arbiter. We must tell our friends in Haven.

passages.title: Arbiter in the Making
passages.text: Everyone will want to know that we are going to make a new Arbiter.

passages.title: Arbiter in the Making
passages.text: An Arbiter? I had not imagined we could set that to rights.

passages.title: Not of the Body
passages.text:
Enemies of Zereth Mortis wear the guise of productive automa. They do not complete any desired tasks.

Scan the automa to reveal enemy threats, then eliminate them.

Mai Obet shall assist.

passages.title: Not of the Body
passages.text: You have exceeded expectations. Thank you for your assistance.

passages.title: Dangerous State
passages.text:
Enemies have attacked the jiro and severed them from the circle. The jiro are no longer stable. They are a danger to the order of things.

They must be removed.

passages.title: Dangerous State
passages.text: Have you removed the threat?

passages.title: Dangerous State
passages.text: Order has been restored. Thank you for your assistance.

passages.title: Super Jiro
passages.text:
The outsiders have disrupted the tasks and purpose of the jiro. We cannot allow this to continue.

We will empower a larger jiro to help combat these threats. Jiro Prime will destroy the enemies that threaten Zereth Mortis.

Help direct Jiro Prime to resolve our crisis.

passages.title: Super Jiro
passages.text: Have the threats been eliminated?

passages.title: Super Jiro
passages.text: Order has been restored. We thank you for your assistance.

passages.title: Gut Check
passages.text:
The crescendal is a powerful tool created by automa. They are given to jiro when work is hard or important. When the devourers attacked, crescendals were likely... eaten.

crescendals are strong. They do not easily damage. Check the stomachs of bigger devourers. Perhaps find one intact?

passages.title: Gut Check
passages.text: We have very few crescendals. It is important to recover one.

passages.title: Gut Check
passages.text:
<The jiro looks over the guts-spattered device.>

Not ideal. But mostly intact... it will need cleaning.

passages.title: A Nest of Our Own
passages.text:
The scroll you found is a command that all bluefeather eggs are to be brought to the harpy chef, Fry-Aerie. Apparently, the Screechflight's matriarch won't eat anything that hasn't been properly prepared and seasoned.

So we'll bring her a special egg of our own. One that's EXPLOSIVELY delicious... and will explode when she eats it. Of course.

How will you deliver it? In disguise!

Slay the creatures on the lower cliffs, collect up this list of parts, and I'll whip you up a full-feathered outfit.

passages.title: A Nest of Our Own
passages.text: Got everything I asked for yet?

passages.title: A Nest of Our Own
passages.text:
Perfect! And a little gross. Just as I planned.

Time to craft a disguise and take this matriarch out to roost!

passages.title: Climb Every Mountain
passages.text:
Hope ye are a quick study, <class>. 'Cause I got no time for a lesson! 

Grab a pack and find a path tae the top o' that peak.

Once yer up there, toss this parachute to our pal Yips. Poor kid got stuck on some vines when these air elementals crashed our plane!

Quickly now, so we can get outta here!

passages.title: Climb Every Mountain
passages.text: Hurry on, now! Yips can't hold fer long!

passages.title: Climb Every Mountain
passages.text:
Nice climbing! Yips owes ye a drink or two!

Oh, the elementals? Nah, don't worry 'bout 'em. This is OUR adventure!

<Rocky resumes gleefully shooting bullets through the air elementals.>

passages.title: Treasure Hunting Ain't Easy
A New Architect
passages.text:
The architects prototype designs to fulfill the purposes of the First Ones. 

This archive contained many such designs.

A number of design entries are lost or corrupted due to the Maw invasion. 

An untouched design lattice and tools are detected nearby. The mortal will retrieve them to begin the synthesis process.

passages.title: A New Architect
passages.text: Have the necessary materials been located?

passages.title: A New Architect
passages.text:
Success. 

The Protoform Repository is now restored.

passages.title: Expeditionary Coordination
passages.text:
Pleasure to meet you, I am Naleidea Rivergleam.

The invitation to visit the Dragon Isles is quite an exciting prospect. Don't you agree?

The Reliquary has combined forces with our expeditionary counterparts to help coordinate our efforts. As a member of the Dragonscale Expedition, it is my honor to welcome you.

Though first we must gather a few more members for our journey. Shall we begin?

passages.title: Expeditionary Coordination
passages.text: Have you spoken with the others yet?

passages.title: Expeditionary Coordination
passages.text: I believe this expedition shall be a great success.

passages.title: To the Dragon Isles!
passages.text:
Our preliminary expedition has made landfall in the Dragon Isles.

Thanks to the efforts of those brave Dragonscale Expedition members, we've established a protected landing site in the Dragon Isles and made contact with the dragonflight's embassy.

Are you prepared to accompany us on our next voyage to the Dragon Isles?

passages.title: To the Dragon Isles!
passages.text: Welcome to the Dragon Isles!

passages.title: Necessary Resourcing
passages.text:
Devourers are consuming neomotes.

We need neomotes for necessary creation work. Without them, we are unable to complete our work.

Eliminate the devourers and retrieve the neomotes.

passages.title: Necessary Resourcing
passages.text: Have you collected the neomotes?

passages.title: Necessary Resourcing
passages.text: You have completed the task. Thank you for your assistance.

passages.title: Explorers in Peril
passages.text:
Don't mistake the expedition's scholarly pursuits as timidness, adventurer.

We are not recluses studying books in far-off towers.

We are adventurers, hunting down knowledge first-hand in every corner of Azeroth!

That passion for adventure often leads us onto the path of perils and hazards, and a few expedition members have bitten off a little more than they could chew...

passages.title: Explorers in Peril
passages.text: Are the expedition members safe?

passages.title: Explorers in Peril
passages.text: The dragons are not here to meet us as Ebyssian said they would be...

passages.title: Rolling in the Screech
passages.text:
<You pull a scrap of parchment from the gooey, blood-soaked satchel of the Roc-Muncher. All you can make out is imagery of harpies devouring large eggs.

You're positive the thick, unintelligible scratch marks will make plenty of sense to your favorite senior ornithologist, Harleen Chirpsnide.>

passages.title: Rolling in the Screech
passages.text: Back from the caves already?

passages.title: Rolling in the Screech
passages.text:
Ho, now! That's certainly no dinner menu you're holding!

Or maybe it is...

passages.title: A New Deal
passages.text:
Ah, Maw Walker! Opportunities abound now that you have found a way into Zereth Mortis. 

Let us discuss further business, yes?

We have an interest in observing the potential this new pathway has provided. I trust you will procure what we require. Do not let anyone get in your way.

If this is not agreeable, I am certain I can find someone else to solve both of our problems.

passages.title: A New Deal
passages.text: I trust you are not returning empty-handed, yes?

passages.title: A New Deal
passages.text:
Good! You have done well.

Here, a token of our appreciation. Your contributions were well observed.

passages.title: Assemble the Forsaken
passages.text:
It's heartening to see progress has been made in rebuilding Brill, but this is only a first step. The ruins of the capital remain inaccessible because of the blight.

And here is where I hope you will aid the cause.

Restoring as much of the land as possible will require a gathering of minds all working toward a singular purpose.

A number of influential figures have risen to prominence among the Forsaken. Please help bring them together so we can meet and discuss the path forward.

passages.title: Assemble the Forsaken
passages.text: Everyone is working hard to get back on their feet. Might not be the feet they started out with, but they work.

passages.title: Assemble the Forsaken
passages.text:
Looks like we're ready to get started.

I don't think there have been this many Forsaken in one place since... well, Darkshore.

But we are in our own lands now, and it's time we take care of our own.

passages.title: Walk of Faith
passages.text:
I promised that I would help, and I shall. We need that pure sample of the plague afflicting Lordaeron, but we cannot put anyone else at risk.

Come with me. I will call forth a shield of Holy Light to safeguard us deep into the blighted area so that we can collect that sample.

This spell will require my full focus. I'll trust you to protect us from anything that might try to stop us.

Are you with me?

passages.title: Walk of Faith
passages.text: I guess I should have faith.

passages.title: Walk of Faith
passages.text: That's something you don't see every day.

passages.title: Return to Brill
passages.text:
We've strengthened our plague eater, and now it looks ready to take on a much, much bigger meal.

Let's get it back to Faranell. He said he can replicate its properties and disperse plague eaters all across the ruins.

Then maybe, just maybe, we can set foot in our home again.

Here, take my hearthstone. It'll bring you back to Brill.

passages.title: Return to Brill
passages.text: What have you brought me?

passages.title: Return to Brill
passages.text:
Wonderful! Not only did you manage not to lose my plague eater, you brought it back stronger than ever!

Now, witness the genius and rapidity of my machines. There will be more than enough plague eaters to spread across the surface of the Undercity.

passages.title: The Remedy of Lordaeron
passages.text:
The time has come. By the Light, I pray our plan works.

Master Apothecary Faranell's wagons have reproduced the plague eater many times over, and the bats are ready to deploy them.

If you see a place where our forces could spread even more of the remedy, you can signal them with a flare.

Take to the skies, and let's put an end to this blight. For Lordaeron, and for the Forsaken.

passages.title: The Remedy of Lordaeron
passages.text:
We did it. By working together, we've cleared the surface level of the deadly plague cloud.

It will take more time to clean up the lower reaches of the Undercity, but it's a fine start.

passages.title: Driven Mad
passages.text:
The Azure Archives was once a place where the blue dragons would gather to discuss magic.

Now I am the only one of my kind here.

This place controls the ley lines beneath the Azure Span, but it and its servants have gone out of control.

I believe if we bring order to this place that I can then reclaim the Azure Oathstone.

The various constructs and elements are brimming with unstable arcane energy that needs to be redirected.

Destroy them and collect what you can.

passages.title: Driven Mad
passages.text: The archives are in a perpetual state of recreation for most of its guardians. We need to fix its flow.

passages.title: Driven Mad
passages.text: Excellent work. The creations here are already being soothed with just this amount of unstable arcana removed.

passages.title: Arcane Pruning
passages.text:
We cannot activate the oathstone in the Azure Archives until we fix the issue with the out of control ley energy here.

Two out of the three draconic runes that are meant to control it are being choked by unstable arcana.

I apologize that this falls to you, given Khadgar's responsibilities and the lack of my brethren appearing.

There should be a ley scepter within that bag of helpful goods you have.

Use it to help repair the runes nearby.

passages.title: Arcane Pruning
passages.text: The ley scepter should allow you to properly align and configure the runes nearby.

passages.title: Arcane Pruning
passages.text:
Excellent work. It seems these runes are able to transport us to the top of the archives.

I believe that may be where our last problem resides...

passages.title: Stealing Its Thunder
passages.text:
It's you! Thank Ohn'ahra. I was pretending to be hurt to fool the next brute who dared come in here. Ugh--the hoof lickers put some binding spell on me. I'll figure it out.

They've got Lizi in the cave. Please save her. I'll figure out how to free myself.

Do what you have to do.

passages.title: Stealing Its Thunder
passages.text: Anyone whose laid a hoof on Lizi will pay!

passages.title: Stealing Its Thunder
passages.text: <Radiya is unusually quiet and trembling slightly as she looks upon the tortured beast.>

passages.title: Leading Motives
passages.text:
<A small object catches your eye. It glitters with Progenitor magic--ancient, yet... strangely more refined.>

<Soft vibrations and tones are woven into the device in a repeating refrain that almost seems to be trying to... speak?>

<Firim would be very interested in this.>

passages.title: Leading Motives
passages.text:
By the First Ones... once again, you bring me the extraordinary. You say you found this when you defeated the Jailer? How curious.

It almost seems as if it's trying to... to communicate somehow. The implications alone are--ah! Forgive me for getting carried away. This will require more than simple research, I'm afraid. 

Please, take this in return. It was one of my first discoveries--I suspect you have more to gain from its mobility than I do. 

Thank you, my friend.

passages.title: The Burrowed Bufonid
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. Let us see if this does the trick.

passages.title: The Burrowed Bufonid
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. Let us try this for Bud's sake, if not our own curiosity.

passages.title: The Burrowed Bufonid
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. Let us hope this works.

passages.title: The Burrowed Bufonid
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. Let us see if this produces results.

passages.title: The Burrowed Bufonid
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. Maybe our bufonid friend just has more refined taste.

passages.title: The Burrowed Bufonid
passages.text:
Thank you, <name>. This is a piece of a past long lost and forgotten...

But it is not for me. Let us see if this at last will attract our hidden bufonid friend.

passages.title: The Patient Bufonid
passages.text:
Look, another magnificent creature of Zereth Mortis! By the glint in its eye, I would say it was playing along the whole time.

Patience delights. Bud is pleased. 

Excellent work, Maw Walker.
